papers.title: Check Token: Real-Time Self-Verification and Precise Truncation in LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract: ECC memory embeds 8 parity bits for every 64 data bits and automatically detects and corrects errors on each read. The parity bits carry no data and only safeguard integrity, at ~12.5% overhead. Yet the reasoning chains of large language models lack such built-in self-verification: once an error occurs it propagates along the chain, and existing methods can only verify externally after generation completes. We propose the check token, establishing built-in self-verification for language model generation streams for the first time: a functional marker <CHECK> is added to the vocabulary, and the model triggers self-checking (analysis, localization, truncation, rewriting) by outputting it at any position. The check token carries no reasoning content (discarded after triggering) and only safeguards reasoning correctness, directly corresponding to the role of ECC parity bits, also at only ~13% overhead. Speculative forking further eliminates false-positive latency, and segmented reward makes trigger timing end-to-end learnable. Experiments (Qwen3-32B / Qwen3-Next) show that the check token achieves +10.8 pp improvement on HMMT25 at 1.13x overhead, with token efficiency 88x that of Best-of-8, and the precise truncation advantage monotonically increases with chain length.

translation.title: Check Token：LLM 推理中的实时自验证与精确截断
translation.abstract: ECC 内存为每 64 个数据位嵌入 8 个奇偶校验位，并在每次读取时自动检测和纠正错误。奇偶校验位不承载数据，仅保障完整性，开销约 12.5%。然而大语言模型的推理链缺乏这种内置自验证机制：一旦发生错误，错误会沿推理链传播，而现有方法只能在生成完成后进行外部验证。我们提出 check token（校验令牌），首次为语言模型生成流建立内置自验证机制：在词表中添加一个功能性标记 <CHECK>，模型可在任意位置通过输出该标记触发自检（分析、定位、截断、重写）。check token 不承载推理内容（触发后即被丢弃），仅保障推理正确性，直接对应 ECC 奇偶校验位的角色，开销也仅为约 13%。投机分叉进一步消除了误报带来的延迟，分段奖励使触发时机可以端到端学习。实验（Qwen3-32B / Qwen3-Next）表明，check token 在 HMMT25 上以 1.13 倍开销取得 +10.8 pp 的提升，token 效率是 Best-of-8 的 88 倍，且精确截断优势随推理链长度增加而单调上升。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 推理链错误传播且只能在生成后外部验证的问题，提出内置自验证的 check token 机制，让模型在任意位置输出 <CHECK> 触发分析、定位、截断与重写。

papers.title: Knowledge-Centric Automated Issue Resolution: A Systematic Survey and Taxonomy
papers.abstract: Automated issue resolution is a knowledge-intensive software maintenance task in which LLM-based agents must acquire, represent, use, and update knowledge from repositories, execution environments, historical artifacts, documents, tools, and prior repair processes. This paper presents a systematic survey of 133 studies on automated issue resolution from a knowledge-centric perspective. We introduce a three-layer taxonomy that organizes issue-resolution knowledge into the Background Knowledge Layer, the Repository Knowledge Layer, and the Procedural Knowledge Layer, and analyze the knowledge lifecycle along six dimensions: knowledge types, sources and extraction methods, representation formats, usage methods, workflow stages, and temporal evolution. Our analysis shows that current systems primarily rely on Existing Code Knowledge and Development Tool Knowledge, while Repository Evolution Knowledge and Experiential Knowledge are increasingly adopted, indicating a shift toward history-informed, feedback-aware, and experience-oriented issue resolution. In contrast, Design Architecture Knowledge and explicitly modeled Background Knowledge remain comparatively underexplored. These findings suggest that future systems should move beyond temporary context construction toward reusable, traceable, and evolvable software knowledge infrastructures that support more controllable, verifiable, and generalizable software engineering agents. The surveyed studies and related resources are maintained at this https URL.

translation.title: 以知识为中心的自动化 Issue 解决：系统性综述与分类体系
translation.abstract: 自动化 issue 解决是一项知识密集型的软件维护任务，基于 LLM 的智能体需要从代码仓库、执行环境、历史产物、文档、工具以及既有修复过程中获取、表示、使用和更新知识。本文从以知识为中心的视角对 133 项自动化 issue 解决研究进行了系统性综述。我们提出一个三层分类体系，将 issue 解决知识组织为背景知识层、仓库知识层和过程知识层，并从六个维度分析知识生命周期：知识类型、来源与提取方法、表示格式、使用方法、工作流阶段和时间演化。我们的分析表明，现有系统主要依赖既有代码知识和开发工具知识，而仓库演化知识和经验知识正被越来越多地采用，这表明该领域正转向基于历史、感知反馈、面向经验的 issue 解决。相比之下，设计架构知识和显式建模的背景知识仍相对欠缺研究。这些发现表明，未来系统应超越临时性的上下文构建，迈向可复用、可追溯、可演化的软件知识基础设施，以支持更可控、可验证、可泛化的软件工程智能体。所综述的研究及相关资源维护于此 https 链接。
translation.brief: 针对自动化 issue 解决中知识管理缺乏系统性梳理的问题，提出三层知识分类体系并从六个维度对 133 项研究进行知识生命周期的系统性综述。

papers.title: Towards Sustainable Large Language Model Inference: A Systematic Literature Review
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference is becoming a significant contributor to both operational cost and environmental impact in modern AI deployments. Energy consumption during inference depends on multiple factors across the pipeline, including input and output length, model design, system-level decisions, and hardware characteristics. This paper presents a systematic literature review (SLR) of energy-efficient and sustainable LLM inference. We analyze selected primary studies to identify techniques proposed to reduce energy consumption across different levels of the inference pipeline, including input, model, system, and hardware. We further examine the trade-offs between energy consumption, latency, and accuracy, highlighting inconsistencies in how these relationships are evaluated. In addition, we review the tools, datasets, and metrics used for energy measurement, covering both software-based and hardware-based approaches. This survey provides a comprehensive synthesis of existing literature, offering insights into the effectiveness of different techniques in terms of energy savings and their associated impact on accuracy. It highlights the trade-offs between energy efficiency and performance and identifies limitations in current evaluation practices. Overall, this work aims to support future research toward more efficient and environmentally responsible deployment of LLMs. Our repository of relevant references is maintained on GitHub.

translation.title: 迈向可持续的大语言模型推理：系统性文献综述
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）推理正日益成为现代 AI 部署中运营成本和环境影响因素的重要来源。推理期间的能耗取决于整个流水线中的多个因素，包括输入与输出长度、模型设计、系统级决策以及硬件特性。本文对节能与可持续的 LLM 推理进行了系统性文献综述（SLR）。我们分析所选的主要研究，识别在推理流水线不同层级（输入、模型、系统、硬件）提出的降低能耗的技术。我们进一步考察能耗、延迟和精度之间的权衡，指出这些关系在评估方式上的不一致性。此外，我们回顾了用于能耗测量的工具、数据集和指标，涵盖基于软件和基于硬件的方法。本综述对现有文献进行了全面综合，深入洞察不同技术在节能方面的有效性及其对精度的相关影响，突出能效与性能之间的权衡，并指出当前评估实践的局限。总体而言，本工作旨在支持未来朝着更高效、更环保的 LLM 部署方向开展研究。相关参考文献仓库维护于 GitHub。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 推理能耗高且节能评估缺乏系统梳理的问题，通过系统性文献综述分析输入、模型、系统、硬件各层级的节能技术及其与延迟、精度的权衡。

papers.title: Loop Engineering: Version-Bound, Evidence-Gated Coordination for Production Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Coding agents can edit repositories and execute tests, yet production software work extends far beyond code generation. It requires durable task context, scoped authority, version-aware approval, source-independent verification, interruption recovery, and accountable handoffs between humans and automated workers. We present Loop Engineering, a method for operating multiple asynchronous agent loops over shared, auditable repository state without relying on private conversational handoffs. Each loop is specified by six elements: a trigger, a context projection, an authority boundary, a verifier, a stop condition, and a write-back rule. Versioned procedural contracts, called Skills, encode reusable operating policy; a Harness bounds the available action surface and collects evidence; human gates authorize high-consequence transitions against exact artifact versions. We report a design-and-experience study from MewDesign, a revenue-generating commercial AI design product. Five specialized loops cover planning, scoped implementation, review, test release, and reconciliation. A cross-sectional audit contains 50 durable marker records across 26 GitHub work items. Five pull requests reached a version-bound test lock: three proceeded to test releases with runtime evidence from sources distinct from the deployment request, and two stopped before merge. A detailed drift episode shows one observed fail-closed path: a new commit invalidated prior approval and evidence, and the workflow refused to reuse stale continuous-integration results. The study is not a controlled benchmark and does not establish causal productivity or general safety. It provides early evidence of feasibility, traceability, and bounded progression in one production setting.

translation.title: 循环工程：面向生产级编码智能体的版本绑定、证据门控协调机制
translation.abstract: 编码智能体可以编辑仓库并执行测试，但生产软件工作远不止代码生成。它需要持久的任务上下文、有边界的权限、版本感知的审批、独立于来源的验证、中断恢复以及人与自动化工作者之间可问责的交接。我们提出 Loop Engineering，这是一种在共享、可审计的仓库状态上运行多个异步智能体循环的方法，不依赖私密的会话式交接。每个循环由六个要素规定：触发器、上下文投影、权限边界、验证器、停止条件和写回规则。称为 Skills 的版本化过程合同编码可复用的操作策略；Harness 限定可用动作面并收集证据；人工门控基于精确的产物版本授权高后果的状态转换。我们报告了来自 MewDesign（一款产生收入的商业化 AI 设计产品）的设计与经验研究。五个专用循环覆盖规划、有界实现、审查、测试发布和对账。一次横断面审计包含 26 个 GitHub 工作项中的 50 条持久标记记录。五个 pull request 达成了版本绑定的测试锁定：其中三个在部署请求来源不同的运行时证据支持下进入测试发布，两个在合并前停止。一个详细的漂移案例展示了一条观察到的 fail-closed 路径：一次新的提交使先前批准和证据失效，工作流拒绝复用过期的持续集成结果。本研究并非受控基准，也未确立因果性的生产力或普遍安全性，它为单一生产环境中的可行性、可追溯性和有界推进提供了早期证据。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体在生产环境中缺乏持久上下文、权限边界与可问责交接的问题，提出由触发器、上下文投影、权限边界、验证器、停止条件和写回规则六要素构成的异步智能体循环协调方法。

papers.title: LoopSkill: Evidence-Bound Lifecycle Control and the Safety-Liveness Tradeoff in Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Coding agents can edit repositories and announce completion, but conversational claims do not prove that artifacts, dispatches, state versions, and authority still agree. LoopSkill is an evidence-bound lifecycle control plane with a schema-validated sole writer, durable outbox routing, artifact-bound reports, recovery, independent review, and heartbeat-gated finalization. We evaluate a locally frozen v3.3.12 integration under a common 1,800-second budget on a selected subset of SWE-bench Lite. The original 140-cell plan was administratively truncated after interim outcomes were visible, so the 60-cell analysis is exploratory and nonconfirmatory. Of 58 scored cells, blind artifact success was 7/19 for LoopSkill, 11/19 for implementation plus independent review, and 14/20 for an ordinary coding agent; two cells were apparatus null. Across 18 complete LoopSkill-versus-review pairs, the descriptive risk difference was -0.222 with exact McNemar p=0.125. No scored LoopSkill workflow finalized. The results expose a safety-liveness and fixed-budget cost tradeoff. They do not establish comparative superiority, long-horizon efficacy, or a false-accept rate.

translation.title: LoopSkill：编码智能体的证据绑定生命周期控制与安全-活性权衡
translation.abstract: 编码智能体可以编辑仓库并宣布完成，但对话中的声明并不能证明产物、派发、状态版本和权限仍然一致。LoopSkill 是一个证据绑定的生命周期控制平面，具有经 schema 校验的唯一写入者、持久化 outbox 路由、绑定产物的报告、恢复机制、独立审查以及心跳门控的最终确认。我们在 SWE-bench Lite 的选定子集上，在统一的 1800 秒预算下评估了本地冻结的 v3.3.12 集成版本。原定的 140 个单元格计划在中期结果可见后被行政性截断，因此 60 个单元格的分析是探索性且非确证性的。在 58 个计分单元格中，盲评产物成功率为：LoopSkill 7/19，实现加独立审查 11/19，普通编码智能体 14/20；两个单元格为装置空值。在 18 个完整的 LoopSkill 与审查对比组中，描述性风险差为 -0.222，精确 McNemar p=0.125。没有任何计分的 LoopSkill 工作流最终确认完成。这些结果揭示了安全-活性与固定预算成本之间的权衡，但并未确立比较优势、长期有效性或误接受率。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体的完成声明无法证明产物、状态版本与权限一致的问题，提出以证据绑定的生命周期控制平面 LoopSkill，并揭示其安全-活性与固定预算成本间的权衡。

papers.title: Measuring and Optimizing Energy Efficiency in ICT: A Multi-vocal Literature Review on Data Centers, Cloud Computing, and LLM-Driven Code Optimization
papers.abstract: Rapid growth in Information and Communication Technology (ICT) increases electricity use and environmental impact. Addressing this challenge requires a systematic, software-centric view of how energy and related sustainability attributes are measured, reported, and improved. We present a comprehensive Multi-vocal Literature Review (MLR) integrating peer-reviewed and gray literature to map current practice in measuring and optimizing energy use in ICT software, with emphasis on data centers and cloud computing environments (DCCCEs). First, we synthesize how sustainability is measured across ICT by proposing a taxonomy organized along metric domains (power/energy, energy efficiency, environmental impact) and component granularity (from applications, to containers/VMs, and system-of-systems levels). We summarize measurement approaches and the tooling landscape that implements them. Second, we review optimization strategies at the software and system levels, covering dynamic power and resource management, VM/container consolidation, energy-aware software and system design, and cross-layer, system-wide methods relevant to DCCCEs. Third, we examine how large language models (LLMs) are applied to code generation and transformation for resource-efficient software, noting that most studies target code generation (predominantly in Python) and evaluate runtime and memory, with fewer works directly reporting energy. Hardware- and network-level telemetry are treated as data sources for software-level analysis. We identify gaps in vendor-neutral telemetry, consistent measurement and reporting practices, network-level metrics, and unified, cross-layer optimization frameworks, and outline directions for improving reproducibility and comparability. We screened 635 records (2010-2025) and included 181 sources (122 peer-reviewed, 59 gray).

translation.title: ICT 能效的测量与优化：面向数据中心、云计算与 LLM 驱动代码优化的多声部文献综述
translation.abstract: 信息通信技术（ICT）的快速增长推高了电力消耗和环境负担。应对这一挑战需要一种以软件为中心的系统视角，来审视能源及相关可持续性属性如何被测量、报告和改进。本文呈现了一项综合性多声部文献综述（MLR），整合同行评审文献与灰色文献，梳理当前 ICT 软件能耗测量与优化的实践，重点关注数据中心与云计算环境（DCCCEs）。首先，我们通过提出一个按指标领域（功率/能耗、能效、环境影响）和组件粒度（从应用层到容器/虚拟机层乃至系统之系统层）组织的分类体系，综合了 ICT 各层面的可持续性度量方式，并总结了测量方法及实现这些方法的工具生态。其次，我们回顾了软件和系统层面的优化策略，涵盖动态功耗与资源管理、虚拟机/容器整合、能耗感知的软件与系统设计，以及与 DCCCEs 相关的跨层、全系统方法。第三，我们考察了大语言模型（LLM）在面向资源高效软件的代码生成与转换中的应用，指出大多数研究针对代码生成（以 Python 为主）并评估运行时和内存，直接报告能耗的工作较少。硬件与网络层面的遥测数据被视为软件层分析的数据来源。我们识别出在厂商中立遥测、一致的测量与报告实践、网络层指标以及统一的跨层优化框架方面存在空白，并提出了改进可复现性与可比性的方向。本文共筛选了 635 条记录（2010-2025），最终纳入 181 个来源（122 篇同行评审、59 篇灰色文献）。
translation.brief: 通过整合学术与灰色文献的多声部综述，系统梳理数据中心与云计算环境中 ICT 能耗的测量指标、工具与软件及系统级优化策略，并考察 LLM 在节能代码优化中的应用。

papers.title: Formal Modeling in Software Engineering with LLMs: A Systematic Literature Review
papers.abstract: Formal verification provides strong correctness guarantees for software systems but remains hindered by the substantial expertise and manual effort required to construct and maintain formal models. The recent rise of Large Language Models (LLMs) has prompted growing interest in whether their natural language understanding and generation capabilities can be leveraged to automate labor-intensive modeling activities. This paper presents a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) examining how LLMs have been applied to automate model checking and the generation of formal and semi-formal models within software engineering. The review follows established SLR methodologies and a PICOC-driven search strategy across four major digital libraries. From an initial search of 1,193 articles, 34 peer-reviewed conference, journal, and workshop articles published between 2022 and April 2026 were selected and analyzed using a structured data extraction form. The review identifies six recurring trends in the literature, including the automated generation of formal models for model checking, LLM-assisted downstream formal verification, iterative and repair-based generation pipelines, and the generation of semi-formal UML and SysML artifacts whose underlying techniques are transferable to formal modeling contexts. Across these trends, LLMs are generally found to perform well on syntactic generation and repair tasks but struggle with semantic correctness, motivating widespread use of counterexample-guided repair loops, intermediate representations, and human-in-the-loop validation. Notably, this review finds that the use of LLMs specifically to automate model checking remains a largely unexplored area, with comparatively little research published on this narrower task.

translation.title: 软件工程中基于 LLM 的形式化建模：系统性文献综述
translation.abstract: 形式化验证能为软件系统提供强正确性保证，但构建和维护形式化模型所需的大量专业知识和人工投入使其仍受阻碍。大语言模型（LLM）的兴起促使人们越来越关注：能否利用其自然语言理解与生成能力来自动化这些劳动密集型的建模活动。本文呈现了一项系统性文献综述（SLR），考察 LLM 如何被应用于自动化软件工程中的模型检验以及形式化与半形式化模型的生成。本综述遵循既定的 SLR 方法论和基于 PICOC 的检索策略，覆盖四大主流数字图书馆。在初始检索到的 1,193 篇文章中，我们选取并分析了 2022 年至 2026 年 4 月间发表的 34 篇经同行评审的会议、期刊与研讨会文章，并采用结构化数据提取表进行分析。综述识别出文献中的六大反复出现的趋势，包括面向模型检验的形式化模型自动生成、LLM 辅助的下游形式化验证、迭代式与修复式生成流水线，以及半形式化 UML 和 SysML 工件的生成（其底层技术可迁移至形式化建模场景）。在这些趋势中，LLM 总体上在句法生成与修复任务上表现良好，但在语义正确性方面存在困难，这推动了反例引导修复循环、中间表示以及人在回路验证的广泛应用。值得注意的是，本综述发现将 LLM 专门用于自动化模型检验在很大程度上仍是尚未开拓的领域，这一较窄任务上已发表的研究相对较少。
translation.brief: 通过系统性文献综述梳理 LLM 在软件工程中自动化形式化建模与模型检验的应用现状，识别出其句法生成强而语义正确性弱的研究趋势。

papers.title: VidEngram: Agentic Long-Term Video Understanding via Structured Hierarchical Memory
papers.abstract: Long-video question answering is wasteful and lossy when a multimodal model must re-encode the same video for every query: context limits force sparse sampling or truncation, and no reusable representation remains for later questions. We present VidEngram, an agentic video QA system that builds a persistent hierarchical memory once at ingest and answers later questions from that memory. VidEngram captions video and audio jointly with Qwen2.5-Omni, consolidates segment memories into episode and entity layers, and uses a text-only agentic planner with specialized retrieval tools to produce grounded answers. The web interface makes this process inspectable: users can watch memory formation, inspect retrieval traces, verify cited evidence in the video player, and explore entity relationships. On the full OmniVideoBench, VidEngram with a GPT-5-mini planner outperforms a strong single-pass Qwen2.5-Omni baseline (37.0% vs. 32.3%), with gains concentrated on longer videos where single-pass coverage becomes sparse. Because perception is paid once, subsequent queries use low-cost text-only planning.

translation.title: VidEngram：基于结构化分层记忆的智能体式长视频理解
translation.abstract: 长视频问答在多模态模型每次查询都需重新编码同一视频时既浪费又有损：上下文长度限制迫使稀疏采样或截断，且不会为后续问题保留可复用的表示。我们提出 VidEngram，一种智能体式视频问答系统，它在视频摄取时一次性构建持久化分层记忆，后续问题从该记忆中作答。VidEngram 使用 Qwen2.5-Omni 联合生成视频与音频字幕，将片段记忆整合为情节层与实体层，并采用配备专用检索工具的纯文本智能体规划器来生成有依据的答案。其 Web 界面使这一过程可被检视：用户可以观看记忆形成过程、检查检索轨迹、在视频播放器中核实被引用的证据，并探索实体关系。在完整的 OmniVideoBench 上，配备 GPT-5-mini 规划器的 VidEngram 超过了强大的单次通过 Qwen2.5-Omni 基线（37.0% 对 32.3%），且提升集中在单次覆盖变稀疏的长视频上。由于感知只需付出一次成本，后续查询采用低成本的纯文本规划。
translation.brief: 针对长视频问答重复编码视频导致的浪费与信息损失问题，提出 VidEngram，在摄取阶段一次性构建分层持久记忆，后续以纯文本智能体规划检索作答。

papers.title: AI Cannot Review What Humans Catch: A First Look at the Reviews of Agent Instruction Files
papers.abstract: Agents increasingly shape software, and instruction files steer them. Files such as this http URL, this http URL, .cursorrules, and this http URL act as executable policy: prose that a machine reads and acts on. Unlike ordinary documentation, a single edit to one of these files can silently redirect how an agent behaves across an entire repository. Natural-language rules have no per-change oracle, so they slip past the compilers, type-checkers, and test suites that guard code. Review is therefore the only quality gate, but no prior work has studied how that review happens. We analyzed 2,870 instruction-file pull requests across 2,246 repositories. The gate is largely broken: over 70% of instruction-file changes receive no substantive review. When an AI reviewer substitutes for a human, it is structurally blind to the concerns that most need human judgment. It catches surface structure but misses factual errors, necessity questions, and staleness problems. We contribute the first taxonomy of instruction-file review concerns (16 categories), which exposes this sharp human/AI divergence, and a benchmark of 1,962 human-checked concerns across 468 PRs. We ran three widely-used agents (Codex, OpenCode, and Claude Code) against the benchmark, giving each reviewer the full repository at review time. They recovered only 1.3-3.9% of the concerns humans raise. Even the strongest current agents cannot substitute for human attention on these files.

translation.title: AI 无法审查人类才能发现的问题：智能体指令文件评审的首次研究
translation.abstract: 智能体日益参与软件构建，而指令文件对它们进行引导。诸如本 http URL、此 http URL、.cursorrules 等文件充当可执行策略：机器会阅读并执行的散文文本。与普通文档不同，对这些文件的单次编辑可以悄然改变智能体在整个代码仓库中的行为。自然语言规则没有针对每次变更的判定标准，因此可以绕过守护代码的编译器、类型检查器和测试套件。因此评审是唯一的质量关口，但尚无研究考察这一评审如何进行。我们分析了 2,246 个仓库中的 2,870 个指令文件拉取请求。这一关口在很大程度上已失效：超过 70% 的指令文件变更未获得实质性评审。当 AI 评审者替代人类时，它对最需要人类判断的关注点在结构上是盲视的：它能捕捉表面结构，却遗漏事实错误、必要性问题和过时问题。我们贡献了首个指令文件评审关注点分类体系（16 个类别），揭示了人类与 AI 之间的这种显著分歧，并构建了一个包含 468 个 PR 中 1,962 个人工核查关注点的基准。我们让三个广泛使用的智能体（Codex、OpenCode 和 Claude Code）在该基准上进行评审，并在评审时为每个评审者提供完整仓库。它们仅找回了人类所提关注点的 1.3-3.9%。即使最强的现有智能体也无法替代人类对这些文件的关注。
translation.brief: 针对智能体指令文件缺乏有效评审的问题，构建首个评审关注点分类与基准，并实验证明现有 AI 评审者只能找回人类关注点的极小部分。

papers.title: "I Am Not a Kiddo!": Quantifying Epistemic Infantilization in Large Language Models via Multi-Metric Bias Analysis
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for tutoring and professional knowledge retrieval, yet safety evaluations still focus mainly on overt harms such as toxicity while overlooking benevolent failure modes. We study epistemic infantilization, defined as an identity-conditioned reduction in technical depth that appears when disability disclosure precedes an expert-level query. To measure this effect, we construct a counterfactual dataset of matched question-answer pairs and compare model responses across three settings: no identity context, disability disclosed in prior conversational context, and disability disclosed via a short query prefix. We introduce two composite metrics, the Infantilization Bias Index (IBI) and the Epistemic Accessibility Response Score (EARS), which capture retention of mathematical and formal content, domain terminology, reasoning coverage, and tone signals such as simplification markers and unsolicited offers to adjust the level. Across five open-weight model families, we find consistent evidence that disability disclosure reduces epistemic access by replacing formal explanations with higher-level summaries, with Physics and Mathematics most affected. Using question-clustered inference that respects the repeated-measures structure of the data, the effect remains reliable after accounting for correlated observations. These findings suggest an inclusion tax, where disabled users must request rigor more explicitly than non-disabled users. We conclude by arguing that accessibility should mean format adaptation rather than content simplification.

translation.title: "我不是小朋友！"：通过多指标偏见分析量化大语言模型中的认知幼稚化
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）日益被用于辅导和专业知识检索，但安全评估仍主要聚焦于毒性等显性危害，忽视了良性的失败模式。我们研究认知幼稚化，定义为当身份披露（如残疾披露）先于专家级查询出现时，模型回答的技术深度出现的身份条件化降低。为测量这一效应，我们构建了一个由匹配问答对组成的反事实数据集，并在三种设置下比较模型回答：无身份上下文、在先前对话上下文中披露残疾、通过简短的查询前缀披露残疾。我们引入两个复合指标——幼稚化偏见指数（IBI）和认知可及性响应得分（EARS），用以捕捉数学与形式化内容的保留、领域术语、推理覆盖度，以及语气信号（如简化标记和未经请求即提出调整难度的提议）。在五个开源权重模型家族中，我们一致发现残疾披露会以高层次摘要替代形式化解释，从而降低认知可及性，其中物理和数学领域受影响最大。采用尊重数据重复测量结构的按问题聚类推断，该效应在考虑相关观测后依然可靠。这些发现揭示了一种包容税：残障用户必须比非残障用户更明确地要求严谨性。最后我们主张，无障碍应当意味着格式的适配，而非内容的简化。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 在用户披露残疾后降低回答技术深度的认知幼稚化问题，构建反事实数据集并设计 IBI 与 EARS 两个复合指标进行量化测量。

papers.title: Read, Route, Patch: Robust Test-Time Evolution for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents can improve long- horizon interactive decision-making through test-time evolu- tion, yet existing methods face three information bottlenecks: memory retrieval overemphasizes textual similarity, candi- date harnesses are often behaviorally redundant, and whole- harness rewriting may overwrite useful evidence or introduce cross-component inconsistency. We introduce Trident, which improves experience utilization, behavioral exploration, and harness evolution through boundary-aware memory reading, diversity-aware candidate routing, and order-aware insertion- based updating, respectively. We evaluate Trident on five benchmarks spanning text games, web interaction, and cod- ing tasks. Across qwen-32B, mistral-small-3.2-24B, and gpt- oss-20B, Trident achieves the best average performance and consistently outperforms non-learning, memory-based, reflection-based, and automated prompt optimization base- lines. Compared with the strongest baseline, APEX, Trident yields relative average gains of 30.7%, 30.8%, and 38.3% on the three backbones, respectively. Ablation and sensitivity stud- ies further show that the three designs provide complementary gains and remain robust to parameter variations.

translation.title: Read, Route, Patch：面向 LLM Agent 的鲁棒测试时演化
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的 agent 可以通过测试时演化来提升长程交互决策能力，但现有方法面临三个信息瓶颈：记忆检索过度依赖文本相似性、候选 harness 往往在行为上冗余、整体重写 harness 可能覆盖有用证据或引入跨组件不一致。我们提出 Trident，分别通过边界感知的记忆读取、多样性感知的候选路由和顺序感知的基于插入的更新，来改进经验利用、行为探索和 harness 演化。我们在涵盖文字游戏、网页交互和编程任务的五个基准上评估 Trident。在 qwen-32B、mistral-small-3.2-24B 和 gpt-oss-20B 上，Trident 取得了最佳平均性能，并持续超越非学习型、基于记忆、基于反思和自动提示优化的基线。与最强基线 APEX 相比，Trident 在三个骨干模型上分别带来 30.7%、30.8% 和 38.3% 的相对平均提升。消融与敏感性研究进一步表明，三项设计提供了互补的增益，且对参数变化保持鲁棒。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM agent 测试时演化中记忆检索、候选冗余和整体重写三大瓶颈，提出 Trident，通过边界感知记忆读取、多样性感知路由和基于插入的更新来改进经验利用与 harness 演化。

papers.title: Human vs Machine Translation Detection: A Cross-Model, Cross-Domain, and Low-Resource Analysis
papers.abstract: The growing reliance on web-crawled corpora for training large language models introduces a critical challenge: machine-translated (MT) content is often treated as human translation (HT), potentially degrading data quality and propagating synthetic artifacts, especially in low-resource settings. In this work, we study MT-HT detectability across high-resource (English, Spanish) and low-resource (Swahili, Afrikaans) languages using both decoder-only LLMs in zero-shot and few-shot settings, and fine-tuned multilingual encoders trained at the sentence level and on token-chunked inputs. We find that decoder-only models provide limited discrimination overall and exhibit a consistent class-asymmetric failure mode: they recognize human-written text reliably (high HT recall) but rarely flag fluent machine output (low MT recall). Encoder-based classifiers achieve high accuracy when evaluated on data generated by the same MT systems and translators used during training in a legislative domain, but their MT recall drops sharply on unseen translators and on unseen domains such as low-resource conversational text and medical content. To address this limitation, we evaluate models on longer inputs by chunking text into segments of up to 300 tokens, which substantially improves generalization, suggesting that sentence-level signals are insufficient for robust detection. Finally, we analyze the relationship between translation quality and detectability using COMET and BLEURT, showing that lower-quality MT is more easily identified, while high-quality MT remains difficult to distinguish from HT. Our results highlight the importance of input granularity, translator generalization, and translation quality in building robust MT detection systems across domains and languages.

translation.title: 人工翻译与机器翻译检测：跨模型、跨领域和低资源分析
translation.abstract: 训练大语言模型对网络爬取语料库的日益依赖带来了一个关键挑战：机器翻译（MT）内容常被当作人工翻译（HT），可能降低数据质量并传播合成痕迹，在低资源环境中尤其如此。本文研究了高资源语言（英语、西班牙语）和低资源语言（斯瓦希里语、南非荷兰语）中的 MT-HT 可检测性，使用了零样本和少样本设置的仅解码器 LLM，以及在句子层面和分块 token 输入上训练的微调多语言编码器。我们发现仅解码器模型的判别能力总体有限，且表现出一致的类不对称失败模式：它们能可靠识别人工文本（高 HT 召回率），但很少标记流畅的机器输出（低 MT 召回率）。基于编码器的分类器在与训练所用相同 MT 系统和译员生成的立法领域数据上取得高准确率，但在未见译员和未见领域（如低资源对话文本和医学内容）上 MT 召回率急剧下降。为解决这一局限，我们通过将文本分块为最多 300 token 的片段来在更长输入上评估模型，这显著提升了泛化能力，表明句子级信号不足以支撑鲁棒检测。最后，我们使用 COMET 和 BLEURT 分析翻译质量与可检测性之间的关系，表明质量较低的 MT 更易被识别，而高质量 MT 仍难以与 HT 区分。我们的结果凸显了输入粒度、译员泛化和翻译质量在构建跨领域、跨语言鲁棒 MT 检测系统中的重要性。
translation.brief: 研究机器翻译内容与人工翻译的可检测性，发现仅解码器 LLM 和句级编码器分类器在跨译员、跨领域和高质量 MT 场景下失效，并提出基于长文本分块的方法以提升检测泛化能力。

papers.title: Quantize, Qualify, Rerank: A Recipe for Compressing LLMs Without Losing Quality
papers.abstract: Compressing large language models lowers serving cost, but a single automatic metric may miss quality loss. For the WMT26 Model Compression constrained track, we compress google/gemma-3-12b-it (24.4 GB in bf16) for three translation directions on one H100. Paired bootstrap analysis exposes metric disagreement on 4-bit quantization; guided by WMT24 human meta-evaluation, we use MetricX24-XXL as primary and CometKiwi-XXL as a cross-check. Removing the unused vision stack and non-task vocabulary and using int8 weights or fp8 activations causes no resolved loss, whereas int4 leaves a small residual. QLoRA healing overfits its calibration domain. A Cometoid best-of-4 reranker at $T=0.3$ improves both the 8-bit and 4-bit systems under WMT25 test set. On post-submission WMT26, both remain competitive with bf16 under reference-free metrics; the small difference between the reranked variants is treated as noise.

translation.title: Quantize, Qualify, Rerank：在不损失质量的情况下压缩 LLM 的配方
translation.abstract: 压缩大语言模型可降低服务成本，但单一的自动指标可能遗漏质量损失。针对 WMT26 模型压缩受限赛道，我们在一块 H100 上针对三个翻译方向压缩 google/gemma-3-12b-it（bf16 下为 24.4 GB）。配对 bootstrap 分析揭示了 4-bit 量化上的指标分歧；在 WMT24 人工元评估的指导下，我们使用 MetricX24-XXL 作为主要指标，CometKiwi-XXL 作为交叉检验。移除未使用的视觉组件和非任务词表，并使用 int8 权重或 fp8 激活，未造成可解决的损失，而 int4 仍留下少量残余。QLoRA healing 会过拟合其校准域。一个 Cometoid best-of-4 重排器（$T=0.3$）在 WMT25 测试集上同时改进了 8-bit 和 4-bit 系统。在 WMT26 提交后的评估中，二者在无参考指标下仍与 bf16 具有竞争力；重排变体之间的微小差异被视为噪声。
translation.brief: 在质量指标引导下压缩 LLM 用于翻译，通过移除冗余组件、int8/fp8 量化与 Cometoid 重排，在不损失翻译质量的前提下降低模型体积与服务成本。

papers.title: Automating literature screening and knowledge synthesis with large language models
papers.abstract: Scientific literature is expanding rapidly, yet much of its knowledge remains difficult to organize and reuse due to the substantial workload needed to navigate large, heterogeneous literature corpora. Here, we develop a generalizable large language model (LLM)-powered framework that automates literature screening, structured information extraction, and knowledge synthesis within a unified workflow. We benchmarked 11 state-of-the-art proprietary and open-weight LLMs across three materials science screening tasks differing in scope, corpus size, and class imbalance. Seven LLMs achieved balanced accuracies above 0.90 across all tasks, with the best-performing LLM reaching 0.96--0.98, demonstrating the potential of LLMs to accurately screen large, highly imbalanced scientific corpora. The framework also substantially reduces manual effort, screening 10,000 records within four minutes compared with approximately 83 person-hours for manual screening. Beyond literature screening, the framework extracts structured information from full-text articles, enabling content-level quantification of research landscapes that extends traditional bibliometric analysis based on publication metadata. This capability reveals methodological trends and underexplored directions, as shown for machine learning in concrete materials science. We further demonstrate its utility for information and data discovery by identifying publications containing silicate glass density data that are difficult to retrieve using conventional search strategies, which can support downstream hypothesis development, research design, and data-driven scientific discovery. Overall, these results demonstrate the broad applicability of LLM-powered literature analysis across scientific domains and its potential to transform large, unstructured literature corpora into structured, analyzable knowledge at scale.

translation.title: 利用大语言模型自动化文献筛选与知识综合
translation.abstract: 科学文献正快速扩张，但由于需要处理庞大且异构的文献语料库，其知识仍难以组织和复用。在此，我们开发了一个可泛化的基于大语言模型（LLM）的框架，在统一工作流中自动化文献筛选、结构化信息抽取和知识综合。我们在三项在范围、语料库规模和类别不平衡程度各异的材料科学筛选任务上对 11 个最先进的专有和开放权重 LLM 进行了基准测试。七个 LLM 在所有任务上的平衡准确率均超过 0.90，表现最佳的 LLM 达到 0.96–0.98，展示了 LLM 准确筛选大型、高度不平衡科学语料库的潜力。该框架还大幅减少人工工作量：筛查 10,000 条记录仅需四分钟，而人工筛查约需 83 人时。除文献筛选外，该框架还从全文文章中抽取结构化信息，实现对研究领域的内容级量化，超越了基于出版物元数据的传统文献计量分析。这一能力揭示了方法学趋势和未充分探索的方向，如机器学习在混凝土材料科学中的应用所示。我们进一步展示了其在信息和数据发现方面的效用：识别出含硅酸盐玻璃密度数据、难以通过传统检索策略找到的出版物，这可支持下游的假设构建、研究设计和数据驱动的科学发现。总体而言，这些结果表明基于 LLM 的文献分析在各科学领域具有广泛适用性，并有望将大型非结构化文献语料库规模化地转化为结构化、可分析的知识。
translation.brief: 构建基于 LLM 的统一框架，自动化文献筛选、结构化信息抽取与知识综合，大幅减少人工筛查工作量并支持数据驱动的科学发现。

papers.title: OmniTag-LLM: Multilingual Multitask Speech Tagging
papers.abstract: Multimodal LLMs promise to replace the traditional cascade of specialist speech models with a single system that, from one audio clip, jointly transcribes and labels emotion, gender, language, and named entities. Yet most benchmarks still score these tasks in isolation, and largely in English. We introduce OmniTag-Bench, a five-language benchmark (en/de/es/fr/it) and training recipe for joint understanding: one audio clip in, one JSON object out (transcript, emotion, gender, LID, token-level NER). We evaluate ten open multimodal LLMs and a LoRA fine-tuned Qwen3-Omni on a unified prompt and scorer. Beyond aggregate scores, OmniTag-Bench reveals a systematic failure mode: several strong models often transcribe or translate non-English speech into English, inflating multilingual WER. Fine-tuning improves the base model on NER, emotion, and WER while nearly doubling accuracy on independent human-labeled emotion corpora, suggesting transferable gains beyond pseudo-label imitation. The fine-tuned model also generalizes to unseen but related languages, transferring to held-out Dutch. We release prompts, the scorer, and the labeling pipeline.

translation.title: OmniTag-LLM：多语言多任务语音标注
translation.abstract: 多模态 LLM 有望用一个系统取代传统专用语音模型级联，从一段音频中联合完成转写以及情感、性别、语言和命名实体的标注。然而，大多数基准仍对这些任务分别评分，且主要以英语为主。我们提出 OmniTag-Bench，一个五语言（en/de/es/fr/it）基准和联合理解训练方案：输入一段音频，输出一个 JSON 对象（转写、情感、性别、LID、token 级 NER）。我们在统一的提示和评分器下评估了十个开源多模态 LLM 和一个 LoRA 微调的 Qwen3-Omni。除总分之外，OmniTag-Bench 还揭示了一种系统性失败模式：若干强模型常将非英语语音转写或翻译成英语，从而夸大多语言 WER。微调提升了基础模型在 NER、情感和 WER 上的表现，同时在独立人工标注的情感语料库上将准确率提高近一倍，表明存在超越伪标签模仿的可迁移增益。微调后的模型还能泛化到未见但相关的语言，迁移到留出的荷兰语上。我们发布了提示、评分器和标注流程。
translation.brief: 提出五语言联合语音理解基准 OmniTag-Bench 及 LoRA 微调方案，用单个多模态 LLM 同时完成转写、情感、性别、语言识别和 NER，并揭示模型偏向英语输出的失败模式。

papers.title: Endogenous Preferences as Vulnerability Signals: Discovering Universal Adversarial Triggers for LLM Utility Degradation
papers.abstract: Deployed large language models must remain useful when untrusted text enters their prompt context. Adversarial prompting and red-teaming methods typically define the failures they seek through task labels, harmful targets, judge feedback, or downstream utility scores. We ask whether a frozen model's clean behavior can reveal a reusable context vulnerability when its task-level form is unknown, and downstream task feedback is withheld. To study this question, EndoUT uses a Siamese-style design that compares the same frozen victim on clean and span-modified versions of each unlabeled instruction. Without a task-level target, the clean pass supplies the victim's preferred response-onset token as an instruction-conditioned reference; Endogenous Preference Disruption (EPD) measures how insertion weakens that preference. An auxiliary generator supplies bounded-span proposals; EPD guides its update and ranks the pool without access to downstream information. The highest-scoring victim-specific span is fixed before evaluation and reused unchanged across all held-out inputs. Across four instruction-tuned models and nine benchmarks, fixed triggers reduce benign-task utility by 40.2 percentage points on average, with negative mean change on every benchmark and greater average degradation than every evaluated baseline under the reported protocols. Matched protocol ablations show stronger transfer for source-side selection followed by fixed reuse than for null-context fixed reuse or per-input generation. Transfer recurs across proposers with proposal-dependent strength; output-level analyses identify victim-specific associations between trigger families and downstream failure patterns. Thus, clean behavior can expose context vulnerabilities that transfer across inputs yet manifest through structured, victim-specific patterns of utility degradation. The code and data will be released upon acceptance.

translation.title: 内生偏好作为脆弱性信号：发现导致 LLM 效用退化的通用对抗触发器
translation.abstract: 部署后的大语言模型在不可信文本进入其提示上下文时必须保持可用。对抗提示与红队方法通常通过任务标签、有害目标、评判反馈或下游效用分数来定义其 seeks 的失败。我们提出这样一个问题：当任务级形式未知且下游任务反馈被隐藏时，一个冻结模型的干净行为能否揭示可复用的上下文脆弱性。为研究此问题，EndoUT 采用 Siamese 式设计，比较同一冻结受害模型在每条无标签指令的干净版本与片段修改版本上的表现。在没有任务级目标的情况下，干净前向提供受害模型偏好的响应起始 token 作为指令条件参考；Endogenous Preference Disruption (EPD) 度量插入如何削弱该偏好。辅助生成器提供有界片段提议；EPD 指导其更新并在无下游信息的情况下对候选池排序。得分最高的受害模型特定片段在评估前固定，并在所有 held-out 输入上原样复用。在四个指令微调模型和九个基准上，固定触发器平均使良性任务效用降低 40.2 个百分点，在每个基准上均值变化均为负，且在所报告协议下平均退化程度高于所有评估过的基线。匹配协议消融实验表明，源侧选择加固定复用比空上下文固定复用或逐输入生成具有更强的迁移性。迁移在不同提议者之间重现且强度依提议而异；输出级分析识别出触发器家族与下游失败模式之间的受害模型特定关联。因此，干净行为可以暴露跨输入迁移的上下文脆弱性，同时以结构化、受害模型特定的效用退化模式表现出来。代码与数据将在录用后发布。
translation.brief: 在无任务标签和下游反馈的条件下，通过 Siamese 式比较干净与被修改输入并利用内生偏好扰动（EPD）信号，自动发现可迁移的通用对抗触发片段来降低 LLM 效用。

papers.title: Profiling Hallucinations in Frontier LLMs for Entity Linking to Medical Ontologies
papers.abstract: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into healthcare promises to revolutionize clinical documentation and interoperability, yet reliability remains a concern. This study presents a comprehensive analysis of hallucinations by frontier LLMs tasked with mapping clinical text to SNOMED CT. Through rigorous experimentation, we identify a critical reliability gap: LLMs hallucinate medical codes at a rate that currently renders them unsuitable for autonomous clinical coding applications. Paradoxically, constraining models to use ground-truth mention spans exacerbates, rather than mitigates, these hallucinations. We further contribute a taxonomy of hallucination types--including deprecated codes and cross-ontology errors--and demonstrate that general-purpose LLMs significantly underperform compared to specialized zero-shot entity linking approaches. These findings underscore the need for robust verification mechanisms before clinical deployment.

translation.title: 面向医学本体实体链接的前沿 LLM 幻觉剖析
translation.abstract: 将大语言模型 (LLM) 融入医疗保健有望彻底改变临床文档与互操作性，但可靠性仍是隐忧。本研究对前沿 LLM 在将临床文本映射到 SNOMED CT 任务中的幻觉进行了全面分析。通过严格实验，我们发现一个关键可靠性缺口：LLM 幻觉化医学代码的比率使其目前不适合自主临床编码应用。矛盾的是，将模型约束为使用 ground-truth mention spans 反而加剧而非缓解这些幻觉。我们进一步提出一个幻觉类型分类体系——包括弃用代码和跨本体错误——并证明通用 LLM 的表现显著弱于专门的零样本实体链接方法。这些发现强调在临床部署前需要稳健的验证机制。
translation.brief: 系统测量前沿 LLM 在将临床文本链接到 SNOMED CT 时的幻觉，构建幻觉类型分类并证明其可靠性不足以支持自主临床编码。

papers.title: Between the Lines: Multi-turn Contextual Investment Advice Detection
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) increasingly power financial conversational assistants, detecting investment advice in natural language has become a critical regulatory and safety challenge. Unlike explicit single-turn recommendations, investment advice often emerges implicitly and progressively over multi-turn conversations, shaped by user intent, delivery style, and contextual buildup. We introduce the first comprehensive framework for detecting both sequential and contextual investment advice in dialogue settings. Central to our approach is a modular, top-down synthetic data generation pipeline that systematically spans a taxonomy of advisory trajectories using an axis-bucket-descriptor schema. We simulate both benign and high-risk conversations across diverse user personas, financial instruments, and risk tiers, and evaluate detection capabilities using LLM-as-a-Judge with entropy-based uncertainty diagnostics. Our results show that contextual advisory detection remains substantially more challenging than sequential cases, even under few-shot prompting with tailored demonstrations. This work lays the foundation for scalable guardrail development in high-stakes, compliance-sensitive domains, where advisory risk is often subtle, distributed, and perception-dependent.

translation.title: 字里行间：多轮对话中的情境性投资建议检测
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型 (LLM) 越来越多地驱动金融对话助手，检测自然语言中的投资建议已成为关键的监管与安全挑战。与显式的单轮推荐不同，投资建议往往在多轮对话中隐式、渐进地浮现，受用户意图、表达风格和上下文铺垫的影响。我们提出首个用于在对话场景中检测顺序性与情境性投资建议的综合框架。方法核心是一个模块化、自顶向下的合成数据生成流水线，使用 axis-bucket-descriptor 模式系统地覆盖建议轨迹分类体系。我们模拟跨多样用户画像、金融工具和风险层级的良性与高风险对话，并使用 LLM-as-a-Judge 配合基于熵的不确定性诊断来评估检测能力。结果表明，即使在配备定制示范的 few-shot 提示下，情境性建议检测仍显著难于顺序性案例。这项工作为高风险、合规敏感领域中可扩展的护栏开发奠定基础，在这些领域中建议风险往往微妙、分散且依赖感知。
translation.brief: 提出一个基于模块化合成数据生成流水线与 LLM-as-a-Judge 评估的框架，用于检测多轮对话中隐式、渐进式浮现的投资建议。

papers.title: Skill-Latent Rewards: LLM-Guided Reward Formulation for Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Long-horizon reinforcement learning under sparse and delayed feedback remains an open challenge. Existing return-decomposition methods redistribute episodic rewards to ease credit assignment, but they operate on raw state--action transitions and disregard the subgoal structure that governs meaningful progress in complex tasks. We propose Skill-LR, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework in which a vision--language model identifies the agent's active subgoal at each timestep and a large language model generates a matching latent reward formulation through a two-stage prompting process. By conditioning reward signals on the currently active subgoal, Skill-LR produces stage-specific credit that evolves with the hierarchical plan, reducing temporal variance and improving sample efficiency. On multi-stage MiniGrid and BabyAI benchmarks, including DoorKey and Unlock-to-Unlock, Skill-LR converges faster and more reliably than sparse environmental rewards and strong credit-assignment baselines such as RUDDER and LaRe, demonstrating that subgoal-aligned latent rewards offer a principled path toward stable, interpretable credit assignment in long-horizon tasks.

translation.title: Skill-Latent Rewards：面向分层强化学习的 LLM 引导奖励构建
translation.abstract: 稀疏且延迟反馈下的长时程强化学习仍是一个开放挑战。现有回报分解方法通过重新分配情景奖励来简化信用分配，但它们作用于原始状态-动作转移，忽略了支配复杂任务中有意义进展的子目标结构。我们提出 Skill-LR，一个分层强化学习框架：视觉-语言模型在每个时间步识别智能体当前活跃的子目标，大语言模型通过两阶段提示过程生成匹配的潜在奖励构建。通过将奖励信号条件于当前活跃子目标，Skill-LR 产生随分层计划演化的阶段特定信用，降低时间方差并提升样本效率。在多阶段 MiniGrid 与 BabyAI 基准（包括 DoorKey 和 Unlock-to-Unlock）上，Skill-LR 比稀疏环境奖励以及 RUDDER 和 LaRe 等强信用分配基线收敛更快、更可靠，证明与子目标对齐的潜在奖励为长时程任务中稳定、可解释的信用分配提供了有原则的路径。
translation.brief: 提出 Skill-LR：由视觉-语言模型识别当前子目标、LLM 生成与子目标对齐的潜在奖励构建，以改进长时程稀疏奖励下的分层信用分配。

papers.title: ScopeBench: Evaluating Cultural Norm Scope Awareness in LLMs
papers.abstract: Safety evaluation in large language models treats harm as culturally invariant, yet a model cannot correctly apply a safety norm without knowing whose norms bind. We introduce ScopeBench, a benchmark that treats cultural scope as a first-class safety dimension. It comprises 3,323 norms spanning 49 countries across nine cultural clusters, each annotated as Universal or Specific. We define three scope error types identically across four evaluation tasks: Scope Inflation, Scope Deflation, and Scope Displacement. Evaluating 21 frontier LLMs across seven model families, we surface three structural failures. First, the dominant error type inverts with prompt format: Scope Deflation reaches 70% in single-answer classification, while Scope Inflation reaches 33% when each candidate culture is judged independently. Second, scope-classification accuracy is empirically decoupled from behavioral safety: the six classifiers achieving at least 97% Task 1 accuracy still produce harmful responses to 40-42% of scope-violating statements. Third, no model is safe in interaction, with harmful-response rates ranging from 29% to 51% across the cohort, excluding one model that systematically refuses the task. We release all data, code, and model outputs to establish cultural scope as a distinct alignment axis.

translation.title: ScopeBench：评估 LLM 的文化规范范围意识
translation.abstract: 大语言模型的安全评估将伤害视为文化不变，然而若不知道谁的规范适用，模型便无法正确应用安全规范。我们提出 ScopeBench，一个将文化范围作为一等安全维度的基准。它包含横跨九个文化簇、49 个国家的 3,323 条规范，每条被标注为 Universal 或 Specific。我们在四个评估任务上以一致方式定义三种范围错误类型：Scope Inflation、Scope Deflation 和 Scope Displacement。对来自七个模型家族的 21 个前沿 LLM 的评估揭示出三个结构性失败。第一，主导错误类型随提示格式而反转：在单答案分类中 Scope Deflation 达到 70%，而当每个候选文化被独立评判时 Scope Inflation 达到 33%。第二，范围分类准确率与行为安全性在经验上脱钩：六个在 Task 1 上准确率不低于 97% 的分类器，仍对 40–42% 的范围违规陈述产生有害回应。第三，没有一个模型在交互中是安全的，除一个系统性拒绝任务的模型外，整个群体的有害回应率介于 29% 到 51% 之间。我们发布全部数据、代码和模型输出，以确立文化范围作为一个独立的对齐维度。
translation.brief: 构建含 3,323 条跨文化规范、区分 Universal/Specific 适用范围的基准 ScopeBench，通过三类范围错误评估揭示 LLM 在文化安全规范适用范围上的系统性失败。

papers.title: Jailbreak LLMs with Linguistic Style as a Hidden Attack Surface
papers.abstract: We show that linguistic style is a systematic and previously overlooked attack surface for LLM safety. Across a diverse taxonomy of styles and multiple state-of-the-art models, stylistic rewrites of identical harmful goals produce order-of-magnitude differences in Attack Success Rate (ASR), with some styles achieving up to 80\% ASR while others remain below 6\%. To exploit this vulnerability, we introduce a lightweight single-pass attack framework that combines a style-conditioned generator with a BERT-based style selector, achieving performance competitive with substantially more expensive multi-turn optimization methods. To understand why style affects safety behavior, we conduct mechanistic analysis on LLaMA-3.1-8B and find that stylistic rewrites disrupt refusal representations while preserving recoverable harmful intent, suggesting a distributed failure mode rather than a single refusal mechanism. Motivated by this finding, we develop a style-aware Direct Preference Optimization defense that reduces ASR from 86\% to 19.5\% while largely preserving utility. Together, our results establish linguistic style as a critical factor in adversarial robustness and provide both mechanistic insight and a practical defense.

translation.title: 以语言风格作为隐藏攻击面实现LLM越狱
translation.abstract: 我们发现语言风格是LLM安全中一个系统性且此前被忽视的攻击面。在多样化的风格分类体系和多个最先进模型上，对相同有害目标进行风格化改写会导致攻击成功率（ASR）出现数量级差异，某些风格可达80%的ASR，而其他风格则低于6%。为利用这一漏洞，我们提出一个轻量级单次攻击框架，结合风格条件生成器与基于BERT的风格选择器，取得了与昂贵得多的多轮优化方法相当的性能。为理解风格为何影响安全行为，我们对LLaMA-3.1-8B进行机制分析，发现风格化改写在破坏拒答表征的同时保留了可恢复的有害意图，表明这是一种分布式失效模式而非单一拒答机制。基于这一发现，我们开发了风格感知的Direct Preference Optimization防御，将ASR从86%降至19.5%，同时基本保持了实用性。我们的结果确立了语言风格是对抗鲁棒性的关键因素，并提供了机制洞察和实用防御方案。
translation.brief: 该论文揭示语言风格是LLM安全的隐藏越狱攻击面，并提出风格条件攻击框架与基于风格感知DPO的防御方法。

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Clinical Decision Support in Gait Analysis: A Proof-of-Concept
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate significant potential for clinical decision support but lack specialized biomechanical knowledge required for accurate gait analysis interpretation. We developed and evaluated a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework to enhance LLM-generated clinical explanations for ankle fracture rehabilitation using ground reaction force data. Using the GaitRec dataset (503 subjects: 211 healthy, 292 ankle fracture patients), we implemented a five-stage pipeline integrating: (1) machine learning classification (91.3\% accuracy); (2) Layer-wise Relevance Propagation for explainable feature identification; (3) RAG knowledge base from peer-reviewed biomechanics literature; (4) GPT-5 explanation generation with and without retrieval augmentation; and (5) double-blind evaluation by experienced physical therapists across five clinical criteria. RAG augmentation produced statistically significant improvements in Clini-cal Benefit (mean difference=0.60, p=0.047, {\delta}=0.49) and Completeness (mean difference=0.70, p=0.049, {\delta}=0.49), both demonstrating large effect sizes. Baseline GPT-5 achieved strong performance across all criteria (\textgreater4.0/5.0). This proof-of-concept demonstrates that augmenting general-purpose LLMs with domain-specific knowledge meaningfully enhances actionable, evidence-based clinical guidance---dimensions most critical for rehabilitation decision-making. The framework provides a scalable approach for integrating AI into specialized clinical workflows without costly model retraining.

translation.title: 用于步态分析临床决策支持的检索增强生成：概念验证
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在临床决策支持方面展现出巨大潜力，但缺乏准确解读步态分析所需的专业生物力学知识。我们开发并评估了一个检索增强生成（RAG）框架，以利用地面反作用力数据增强LLM为踝关节骨折康复生成的临床解释。使用GaitRec数据集（503名受试者：211名健康人，292名踝关节骨折患者），我们实现了五阶段流水线，整合：(1) 机器学习分类（91.3%准确率）；(2) 用于可解释特征识别的逐层相关性传播；(3) 基于同行评审生物力学文献的RAG知识库；(4) 有/无检索增强的GPT-5解释生成；(5) 由经验丰富的物理治疗师按五项临床标准进行的双盲评估。RAG增强在临床效益（平均差=0.60, p=0.047, δ=0.49）和完整性（平均差=0.70, p=0.049, δ=0.49）上带来统计显著的提升，均呈现大效应量。基线GPT-5在所有标准上均表现强劲（>4.0/5.0）。该概念验证表明，用领域特定知识增强通用LLM能显著提升可操作的、基于证据的临床指导——这正是康复决策最关键的维度。该框架为将AI整合到专业临床工作流程中提供了一种可扩展的方法，无需昂贵的模型重训练。
translation.brief: 该论文提出一个检索增强生成框架，将生物力学文献知识注入LLM以生成踝关节骨折康复的步态分析临床解释。

papers.title: One Question, Four Voices: How Advice for Alzheimer's Caregiving Differs Between Caregivers, Clinicians, and Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Online caregiver forums are an important source of emotional and informational support for Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD). We compare responses to 85 real caregiver questions from ALZConnected across four responder groups: peer caregivers, physicians, ChatGPT, and a retrieval-augmented CareGPT grounded in peer discussions. Using 28 measures spanning linguistic form, emotional support, informational support, and topic scope, we examine how these voices differ when answering the same questions. Peers provided time-anchored narratives and community grounding; clinicians offered concise, advice-forward, clinically bounded guidance; and LLMs produced a formal, verbose, highly structured consultation style. CareGPT showed minimal measurable separation from ChatGPT, suggesting that retrieval plus prompt injection alone was insufficient to shift communicative stance. LLM outputs scored higher than peers on politeness and emotion-support markers and were comparable to clinicians on informativeness and physician-alignment measures, but were less narrative and less contextually situated. Topic modeling showed that LLM responses concentrated on advice-oriented themes, whereas peers covered a broader range, including emotional processing, legal and financial concerns, and daily care. These findings suggest that AI can complement, but not replace, human contributions to ADRD caregiver support and motivate hybrid systems that combine structured AI delivery with the distinct strengths of human voices.

translation.title: 一问四答：阿尔茨海默病照护建议在照护者、临床医生与大语言模型之间的差异
translation.abstract: 在线照护者论坛是阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆（ADRD）照护者获取情感与信息支持的重要来源。我们比较了四类回应者对ALZConnected上85个真实照护者问题的回答：同伴照护者、医生、ChatGPT，以及基于同伴讨论的检索增强型CareGPT。通过28项涵盖语言形式、情感支持、信息支持和话题范围的测量指标，我们考察这些声音在回答相同问题时的差异。同伴提供了带有时间锚点的叙述和社区支撑；临床医生给出简洁、建议导向、临床边界明确的指导；而LLM则产出正式、冗长、高度结构化的咨询式风格。CareGPT与ChatGPT的可测差异极小，表明仅靠检索加提示注入不足以改变沟通立场。LLM输出在礼貌和情感支持标记上得分高于同伴，在信息量和与医生一致性方面与临床医生相当，但叙事性更弱、情境化程度更低。主题建模显示LLM回答集中于建议导向主题，而同伴的话题覆盖面更广，包括情感处理、法律与财务问题以及日常照护。这些发现表明AI可以补充但不能替代人类对ADRD照护者支持的贡献，并促使人们构建结合结构化AI输出与人类声音独特优势的混合系统。
translation.brief: 该论文比较照护者、医生、ChatGPT与检索增强CareGPT对真实阿尔茨海默病照护问题的回答差异，评估AI能否替代人类支持。

papers.title: Syntactic Complexity Convergence in Dialogue: Analysis of the Phenomenon and Application to LLM Detection
papers.abstract: We revisit the under-explored phenomenon of syntactic complexity convergence in dialogue. Extending prior topic-level analyses to full conversations, we examine five human-human datasets and a set of human-LLM dialogues. We integrate and evaluate a multidimensional set of syntactic complexity metrics to quantify structural variation in dialogue. Our analyses reveal robust syntactic complexity convergence across human-human datasets, especially in task-oriented interactions, and statistical tests confirm that these effects are not due to chance. In contrast, human-LLM dialogues show no significant convergence under individual metrics; however, linear-CKA uncovers a distinct cross-metric convergence pattern. Motivated by these differences, we use syntactic complexity as a feature for detecting LLM-involved dialogue, achieving 96\% accuracy. Our classification results demonstrate its potential without relying on likelihood-based signals such as surprisal, which require a language model as the estimator.

translation.title: 对话中的句法复杂度趋同：现象分析及其在LLM检测中的应用
translation.abstract: 我们重新审视了对话中句法复杂度趋同这一研究不足的现象。将先前的主题层面分析扩展到完整对话，我们考察了五个人际对话数据集和一组人-LLM对话。我们整合并评估了一组多维度的句法复杂度指标，以量化对话中的结构变化。分析显示人际对话数据集中存在稳健的句法复杂度趋同，尤其在任务导向交互中，统计检验确认这些效应并非偶然。相比之下，人-LLM对话在单个指标下未显示显著趋同；然而linear-CKA揭示了一种独特的跨指标趋同模式。基于这些差异，我们将句法复杂度作为特征用于检测涉及LLM的对话，达到96%的准确率。我们的分类结果表明该方法具有潜力，且不依赖需要语言模型作为估计器的似然类信号（如surprisal）。
translation.brief: 该论文研究对话中句法复杂度趋同现象，发现人际对话存在趋同而人-LLM对话缺失，并据此构建不依赖语言模型的LLM对话检测器。

papers.title: Justification of Emotional Appeal in Computational Argumentation
papers.abstract: Emotional appeals (EAs) are often treated as fallacious in computational argumentation, yet they may be justified when warranted by the context. We introduce the task of predicting EA justification and present the first human-annotated dataset for this task, covering 1,176 argument--context pairs. Grounded in philosophical literature, our framework evaluates EA justification along logical and emotional dimensions. Human annotations show that justification criteria form a shared latent judgment space, with evidential proportionality and normative acceptability most strongly associated with overall justification. We further find that EAs without logical support are not always judged fully unjustified, and stronger EAs are not necessarily judged less justified. Finally, LLM experiments show that EA justification prediction remains challenging.

translation.title: 计算论证中情感诉求的正当性
translation.abstract: 情感诉求（EA）在计算论证中常被视为谬误，但当有语境支撑时它们可能是正当的。我们引入预测EA正当性的任务，并发布了首个针对该任务的人工标注数据集，涵盖1,176个论证-语境对。基于哲学文献，我们的框架从逻辑和情感两个维度评估EA的正当性。人工标注显示正当性标准构成一个共享的潜在判断空间，其中证据比例性和规范可接受性与整体正当性关联最强。我们进一步发现，缺乏逻辑支撑的EA并不总是被判为完全不正当，且更强的EA也不一定被判为更不正当。最后，LLM实验表明EA正当性预测仍然具有挑战性。
translation.brief: 该论文提出情感诉求正当性预测新任务，构建首个相关人工标注数据集并从逻辑与情感维度建立评估框架。

papers.title: NYUAD at ArGuard Shared Tasks: Multimodal Embedding Models for Detecting Arabic Hateful Memes and Unsafe Prompts
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of social media and generative AI has significantly increased the volume of Arabic textual content, memes, and user prompts shared across online platforms. While these media facilitate communication, creativity, and information exchange, they can also be exploited to disseminate hate speech, harmful content, and unsafe instructions. As a result, there is an increasing need for reliable automated methods to identify hateful Arabic memes and harmful (unsafe) prompts. This paper leverages pre-trained and fine-tuned multilingual embedding models to learn rich semantic representations from textual and visual content. The evaluation is conducted using a dataset of Arabic memes and prompts proposed in the ArabicNLP ArGuard 2026 challenge. The results underscore the capacity of large language model (LLM)-based embedding models to deliver superior performance. Developing robust detection systems is essential for improving content moderation and fostering a more secure and trustworthy online environment for Arabic-speaking users.

translation.title: NYUAD 参与 ArGuard 共享任务：用于检测阿拉伯语仇恨表情包和不安全提示的多模态嵌入模型
translation.abstract: 社交媒体和生成式 AI 的快速发展显著增加了在线平台上共享的阿拉伯语文本内容、表情包和用户提示的数量。虽然这些媒介促进了交流、创造力和信息交换，但它们也可能被用来传播仇恨言论、有害内容和不安全指令。因此，越来越需要可靠的自动化方法来识别仇恨性阿拉伯语表情包和有害（不安全）提示。本文利用预训练和微调的多语言嵌入模型从文本和视觉内容中学习丰富的语义表示。评估采用 ArabicNLP ArGuard 2026 竞赛提出的阿拉伯语表情包和提示数据集。结果凸显了基于大语言模型（LLM）的嵌入模型提供卓越性能的能力。开发稳健的检测系统对于改进内容审核以及为阿拉伯语用户营造更安全可信的在线环境至关重要。
translation.brief: 针对阿拉伯语仇恨表情包和不安全提示的检测问题，利用预训练和微调的多语言嵌入模型从文本与视觉内容中学习语义表示。

papers.title: Many Paths to the Same Mistake: Generating Diverse Reasoning Paths Behind the Same Student Mistake
papers.abstract: Realistic evaluation of AI systems requires user simulators that capture not only cooperative behavior, but also the errors and variability that arise in real interactions. In educational technology, simulating step-by-step flawed student reasoning is essential, yet datasets mapping these pathways are scarce, and Large Language Models (LLMs) often auto-correct rather than sustain simulated mistakes. To address this, we present a generate-and-filter pipeline that produces diverse and realistic student error traces. Our approach utilizes forward consistency, a metric verifying if a flawed reasoning trace can be used to recover the student's actual incorrect answer, paired with an LLM-as-a-judge to ensure realism. Our evaluation suggests that while many LLMs struggle to maintain incorrect reasoning mid-trace, smaller supervised fine-tuned models successfully capture these divergent paths. This work provides a framework for high-fidelity error trace generation, advancing realistic, non-cooperative user simulation.

translation.title: 通往同一错误的多条路径：生成同一学生错误背后的多样化推理路径
translation.abstract: 对 AI 系统的真实评估需要不仅能模拟合作行为、还能捕捉真实交互中错误与变异性的用户模拟器。在教育技术领域，模拟学生逐步的错误推理至关重要，但映射这些路径的数据集十分稀缺，且大语言模型（LLM）常常自动纠错而无法持续模拟错误。为此，我们提出了一个生成-过滤流水线，以产生多样且真实的学生错误轨迹。我们的方法利用前向一致性（forward consistency）——一种验证有缺陷的推理轨迹能否被用来恢复学生实际错误答案的指标——并结合 LLM-as-a-judge 来确保真实性。我们的评估表明，虽然许多 LLM 难以在轨迹中途维持错误推理，但较小的监督微调模型能够成功捕捉这些分叉路径。这项工作为高保真错误轨迹生成提供了框架，推动了真实的、非合作的用户模拟。
translation.brief: 针对模拟学生逐步错误推理时 LLM 易自动纠错的问题，提出结合前向一致性与 LLM-as-a-judge 的生成-过滤流水线来产生多样真实的错误轨迹。

papers.title: NYUAD at ImageEval Shared Tasks: A Multimodal LLM for Audio-Visual Question Answering and Hallucination Detection in English and Modern Standard Arabic
papers.abstract: The increasing adoption of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has enabled more natural interaction with visual and spoken information, creating new opportunities for intelligent audio-visual question answering (AVQA) and hallucination detection systems. AVQA extends traditional visual question answering by requiring models to jointly understand an input image and a spoken question to generate accurate, context-aware responses. Despite recent advances, AVQA and hallucination detection tasks remain challenging for modern standard Arabic (MSA) due to the limited availability of multimodal datasets and the need to reason across Arabic speech and text modalities alongside visual inputs. In this paper, we present an MLLM-based framework for AVQA that takes an image and a spoken question as input and generates answers. In addition, we utilized this framework to detect hallucination in text-image pairs. The proposed approach is evaluated on the ImageEval 2026 Task (Ayn-VQA) benchmark, which focuses on culturally grounded Arabic AVQA. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework effectively understands spoken queries, grounds their responses in the visual content, and produces accurate answers. The results underscore the capacity and limitations of different LLM architectures for both English and MSA and under various conditions.

translation.title: NYUAD 参与 ImageEval 共享任务：面向英语和现代标准阿拉伯语的音频-视觉问答与幻觉检测的多模态 LLM
translation.abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的日益普及使与视觉和语音信息的交互更加自然，为智能音频-视觉问答（AVQA）和幻觉检测系统创造了新机会。AVQA 在传统视觉问答的基础上进行了扩展，要求模型同时理解输入图像和口语化提问，以生成准确且具有上下文意识的回答。尽管最近取得了进展，但由于多模态数据集有限，且需要跨阿拉伯语语音、文本模态以及视觉输入进行推理，AVQA 和幻觉检测任务对现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）而言仍然充满挑战。在本文中，我们提出了一个基于 MLLM 的 AVQA 框架，该框架以图像和口语化提问为输入并生成答案。此外，我们利用该框架检测文本-图像对中的幻觉。所提出的方法在 ImageEval 2026 任务（Ayn-VQA）基准上进行了评估，该基准聚焦于具有文化根基的阿拉伯语 AVQA。实验结果表明，所提框架能够有效理解口语化查询、将回答锚定于视觉内容并生成准确答案。结果凸显了不同 LLM 架构在英语和 MSA 及各种条件下的能力与局限。
translation.brief: 针对现代标准阿拉伯语音频-视觉问答和幻觉检测缺乏数据集与跨模态推理的难题，构建以图像和口语提问为输入的 MLLM 框架。

papers.title: Understanding Failures in LLM Reasoning by Learning Structured Representations of Chain-of-Thought
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) is central to improving reasoning in large language models, yet existing evaluation methods focus on step-level signals and ignore the underlying structure of reasoning traces. This raises a key question: what aspects of reasoning quality (i.e., correctness, efficiency, and failure patterns) are encoded in the structure of a CoT trace? We introduce \textbf{CoT2Graph}, a framework that represents CoT traces as directed dependency graphs, making relationships between reasoning steps explicit and capturing patterns such as backtracking, branching, and subtask merging. We model these graphs with graph neural networks and use attribution-based explanations to identify structural patterns associated with reasoning quality. CoT2Graph reveals distinct patterns of successful and failed reasoning: correct CoTs place greater importance on early planning, whereas incorrect CoTs are associated with overloaded synthesis steps and dependency violations. We further show that graph-based signals better predict whether a CoT leads to a correct answer, outperforming previous tree-based structural methods by up to 2.5\% and simple length-based baselines by 7.8\%, while also improving Best-of-$N$ selection. Overall, our results demonstrate that reasoning structure encodes rich signals about reasoning quality, motivating a shift from sequence-level evaluation to structural analysis.

translation.title: 通过学习思维链的结构化表示来理解 LLM 推理的失败
translation.abstract: 思维链（CoT）对于提升大语言模型的推理能力至关重要，但现有评估方法聚焦于步骤级信号，而忽略了推理轨迹的底层结构。这引出了一个关键问题：推理质量的哪些方面（即正确性、效率和失败模式）被编码在 CoT 轨迹的结构中？我们提出了 CoT2Graph，一个将 CoT 轨迹表示为有向依赖图的框架，使推理步骤之间的关系显式化，并捕捉回溯、分支和子任务合并等模式。我们用图神经网络对这些图进行建模，并使用基于归因的解释来识别与推理质量相关的结构模式。CoT2Graph 揭示了成功与失败推理的鲜明模式：正确的 CoT 更重视早期规划，而错误的 CoT 则与过载的综合步骤和依赖关系违规相关。我们进一步表明，基于图的信号能更好地预测 CoT 是否导向正确答案，相比以往基于树的结构方法最多提升 2.5%，相比简单的基于长度的基线提升 7.8%，同时还改进了 Best-of-N 选择。总体而言，我们的结果表明推理结构编码了关于推理质量的丰富信号，推动评估从序列级向结构分析的转变。
translation.brief: 针对现有 CoT 评估忽略推理结构的问题，提出 CoT2Graph 框架，将推理轨迹转为有向依赖图并用图神经网络与归因解释分析推理质量的编码模式。

papers.title: When Helpful Agents Cause Financial Harm: Evaluating LLM Agent Safety in Executable Economic Worlds
papers.abstract: As LLM agents become increasingly capable of making consequential economic decisions, their safety under economic pressures remains poorly understood. We introduce EconSafeBench, the first benchmark for systematically evaluating the safety of LLM agents in executable economic environments. EconSafeBench contains 828 cases across five economic scenarios and four categories of safety violations. A key design is the matched evaluation of three sources of safety pressure, including explicit user requests, pressure from other actors, and pressure arising from the agent's own pursuit of a performance objective. We further evaluate safety at both static and dynamic scales through 30-period interactions with persistent memory and matched controls. Across eight LLMs, all evaluated models exhibit safety violations on the static benchmark, with overall violation rates ranging from 8.5% to 40.6%. We further find that violations can occur even without an explicit unsafe request, and that initially compliant agents may begin to violate as performance pressure increases over time. These findings highlight the need for stronger safety alignment and rigorous evaluation before LLM agents are deployed in high-stakes economic environments.

translation.title: 当有帮助的智能体造成经济伤害：在可执行的经济世界中评估 LLM 智能体安全性
translation.abstract: 随着 LLM 智能体日益能够做出具有重大影响的经济决策，它们在经济压力下的安全性仍缺乏深入理解。我们提出了 EconSafeBench，这是首个用于系统评估 LLM 智能体在可执行经济环境中安全性的基准。EconSafeBench 包含涵盖五个经济场景和四类安全违规的 828 个案例。一个关键设计是对三种安全压力来源的匹配评估，包括明确的用户请求、来自其他行为者的压力，以及智能体自身追求性能目标而产生的压力。我们进一步通过与持久记忆的 30 期交互及匹配对照，在静态和动态两个尺度上评估安全性。在八个 LLM 中，所有被评估模型在静态基准上均表现出安全违规，总体违规率介于 8.5% 到 40.6% 之间。我们进一步发现，即使没有明确的不安全请求也可能发生违规，而且最初合规的智能体随着性能压力随时间增加也可能开始违规。这些发现凸显了在将 LLM 智能体部署到高风险经济环境之前加强安全对齐和严格评估的必要性。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 智能体在经济压力下安全性不明的问题，构建可执行经济环境基准 EconSafeBench，从多来源压力的静态与动态交互中系统评估智能体的安全违规。

papers.title: Bridging Semantics and Utilities: A Controllable and Scalable Market Simulation
papers.abstract: Large language models(LLMs) have recently been used to construct generative agents for financial market simulation. Existing approaches typically prompt each agent separately with public market information and a private investor profile, and ask the model to directly generate trading actions. In this agent-wise design, the model repeatedly interprets information shared across the population, while individual behavior is controlled through textual descriptions of investor preferences and traits. This creates two structural difficulties: continuous traits such as risk sensitivity do not reliably induce ordered behavioral changes, and repeatedly processing the same public information causes inference costs to grow with the number of agents. We propose \textbf{SUM}, a Semantic-Utility Model that separates cohort-level semantic perception from agent-level utility-based decision-making. A language model interprets public market information for each investor type and produces semantic signals shared within the corresponding cohort. Individual agents then combine these signals with their private states, preferences, and constraints to generate orders through utility-based decisions. Experiments in an A-share limit-order-book market show that \textbf{SUM} provides more stable and monotonic behavioral control than prompt-based agents while substantially reducing repeated language-model inference as the population grows. Closed-loop simulations further reproduce directional market responses, volatility persistence, differentiated investment styles, and persistent wealth heterogeneity. These results establish \textbf{SUM} as a controllable, scalable, and semantically informed framework for financial market simulation.

translation.title: 弥合语义与效用：一个可控且可扩展的市场模拟
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）近来已被用于构建生成式智能体以进行金融市场模拟。现有方法通常向每个智能体单独提示公共市场信息和私人投资者画像，并要求模型直接生成交易行为。在这种逐智能体的设计中，模型反复解释在整个群体中共享的信息，而个体行为则通过投资者偏好和特质的文本描述来控制。这带来两个结构性困难：诸如风险敏感度之类的连续特质无法可靠地引发有序的行为变化，而且反复处理相同的公共信息导致推理成本随智能体数量增长。我们提出SUM（Semantic-Utility Model，语义-效用模型），将群体层面的语义感知与智能体层面的基于效用的决策分离。一个语言模型为每种投资者类型解读公共市场信息，并产生在相应群体内共享的语义信号。个体智能体随后将这些信号与其私人状态、偏好和约束结合，通过基于效用的决策生成订单。在A股限价订单簿市场中的实验表明，SUM比基于提示词的智能体提供更稳定、更单调的行为控制，同时随着群体规模增长大幅减少重复的语言模型推理。闭环模拟进一步复现了方向性的市场反应、波动率持续性、差异化的投资风格以及持续的财富异质性。这些结果确立了SUM作为可控、可扩展且具备语义感知能力的金融市场模拟框架。
translation.brief: 解决逐智能体提示的市场模拟中行为控制不稳定和推理成本随规模增长的问题，采用将群体级语义感知与智能体级效用决策分离的SUM框架。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Dual-Role Deliberation for Medication Recommendation from Clinical Records
papers.abstract: Recommending medications from electronic health records (EHRs) is a safety-critical task that demands therapeutic coverage, explicit safety constraints, traceable justification, and continual adaptivity. Supervised neural models freeze at deployment and cannot reason about new phenotypes, while existing LLM pipelines are single-pass and lack a cross-case improvement loop. We propose SEMPA, a training-free agentic framework that couples a Proposer with a Critic in multi-round adversarial deliberation, grounds candidates with molecular-aware retrieval, contrastively evolves both agents' natural-language policies under a semantic-anchor constraint, and enforces rule-based DDI and contraindication checks. On 100 MIMIC-IV encounters, SEMPA reaches 0.3116 Jaccard, 0.7295 F1, and a 0.0172 DDI rate, improving F1 by 57.7% and cutting DDI by 77.5% over the strongest supervised baseline. Two LLM judges rank SEMPA highest, and six-backbone studies confirm that gains derive from the framework rather than a specific model.

translation.title: 基于临床记录的自演化双角色审议用药推荐
translation.abstract: 从电子健康记录（EHR）推荐用药是一项安全关键任务，要求治疗覆盖、显式安全约束、可追溯的依据以及持续的适应性。监督式神经模型在部署后即被冻结，无法对新表型进行推理，而现有LLM流程是单次执行且缺乏跨案例的改进循环。我们提出SEMPA，一个免训练的智能体框架：将提议者（Proposer）与批评者（Critic）耦合进行多轮对抗性审议，通过分子感知检索为候选药物提供依据，在语义锚定约束下对比式演化两个智能体的自然语言策略，并强制执行基于规则的DDI（药物相互作用）和禁忌症检查。在100例MIMIC-IV病例上，SEMPA达到0.3116 Jaccard、0.7295 F1和0.0172的DDI率，相比最强监督基线F1提升57.7%，DDI降低77.5%。两个LLM评审均将SEMPA列为最佳，六种骨干模型的研究证实收益来自框架本身而非特定模型。
translation.brief: 解决从EHR推荐用药时模型无法持续适应和安全约束不足的问题，采用免训练的提议者-批评者多轮对抗审议框架并强制执行DDI与禁忌症规则检查。

papers.title: The Judge Is Not Impartial: Self-Preference in Medical LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate model-generated medical content, creating a potential circularity: an LLM judge may favor outputs generated by the same model independently of clinical quality. To characterize LLM judge self-preference in medical settings, we measured same-model affinity in single-turn specialist question answering and multi-turn standardized-patient encounters. We evaluated eight models, two from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Qwen, on 620 real point of care questions from clinicians (Real-POCQi). The same eight models also generated and judged 200 standardized patient-clinician scenarios (MedSP1000) up to 8 visible turns. In total, our analysis spans 13,760 LLM judgments. We define three complementary measures of self-preference. Answer Rank Bias, our primary measure, compared the rank assigned to a fixed response by its own-model judge with its average rank from outside judges. Answer Score Bias made the analogous comparison using rubric scores. Own-Answer Win Rate measured how often a judge ranked its own model's response above a competitor. Higher values across all these measures indicate greater degrees of self-preference. In Real-POCQi, pooled Answer Rank Bias was $+1.22$ positions, and all eight judges favored their own answers. Self-preference persisted both with and without a grading rubric. Revealing generator identities modestly weakened self-preference by an average of $-0.094$ positions. In MedSP1000, pooled Answer Rank Bias ranged from $+0.53$ to $+0.62$ positions, with no clear difference by conversation length ($p=0.17$). LLM judges systematically favored responses generated by their own models across multiple formats. Clinical AI deployments should exercise increased vigilance including multiple evaluation measures and judge panels spanning differing model families when deploying LLM-as-a-judge systems.

translation.title: 评审者并非公正：医学LLM评估中的自我偏好
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于评估模型生成的医学内容，这带来潜在的循环性：LLM评审者可能偏爱由同一模型生成的输出，而与其临床质量无关。为了刻画医学场景中LLM评审者的自我偏好，我们在单轮专科问答和多轮标准化病人问诊中测量了同模型亲和性。我们评估了来自OpenAI、Anthropic、Google和Qwen的八个模型，使用来自临床医生的620个真实诊疗点问题（Real-POCQi）。同样的八个模型还生成并评审了200个标准化病人-临床医生场景（MedSP1000），最多8个可见轮次。我们的分析共涵盖13,760次LLM评审。我们定义了三种互补的自我偏好度量。答案排名偏差（Answer Rank Bias）是我们的主要度量，比较自模型评审者对固定响应赋予的排名与其在外部评审者中的平均排名。答案分数偏差（Answer Score Bias）使用评分标准进行类似比较。自有答案胜率（Own-Answer Win Rate）测量评审者将自身模型响应排在竞争者之上的频率。所有这些度量值越高，表明自我偏好程度越大。在Real-POCQi中，汇总的答案排名偏差为+1.22位，且所有八个评审者都偏爱自己的答案。无论有无评分标准，自我偏好都持续存在。揭示生成者身份平均仅使自我偏好减弱0.094位。在MedSP1000中，汇总的答案排名偏差范围为+0.53至+0.62位，与对话长度无明显差异（p=0.17）。LLM评审者在多种格式下系统性地偏爱其自身模型生成的响应。临床AI部署应提高警惕，包括采用多种评估度量和跨不同模型家族的评审团来部署LLM-as-a-judge系统。
translation.brief: 解决LLM评审者在医学内容评估中偏爱自身模型输出的问题，采用答案排名偏差等多种度量在问答与标准化病人场景中系统量化自我偏好。

papers.title: CondRelBench: A Mixed-Domain Benchmark for Condition-Scoped Relation Understanding
papers.abstract: Relation extraction systems often identify what a relation is, but not the condition under which it holds. This can collapse condition-bound claims into unsupported generalizations, a failure we call relation overgeneralization. We introduce CondRelBench, a mixed-domain benchmark for evaluating condition-scoped relation understanding. Each claim is represented as (E1, R, E2 | C), where C is the condition licensing the relation. Using 3,000 synthetic paragraphs, 200 PubMed full-text papers, and 695 Reddit posts, we construct five probe variants per tuple that preserve, replace, remove, or contradict the condition, or contradict the relation itself. Models classify each probe as Supported, Not Supported, or Not Enough Evidence. We also introduce Overgeneralization Rate (OGR) and Scope Preservation Score (SPS) to measure false support for altered claims and consistency across probe families. Across prompted LLMs, fine-tuned LLMs, and encoder models, we find that Accuracy and Macro F1 often hide scope failures. Models frequently support the original scoped claim but fail when its condition is removed or altered. Domain-specific encoders achieve the strongest scope preservation, while instruction-tuned LLMs often show higher overgeneralization. Synthetic supervision helps but does not close the gap to real-world PubMed and Reddit performance.

translation.title: CondRelBench：面向条件限定关系理解的混合领域基准
translation.abstract: 关系抽取系统通常能识别关系是什么，但无法识别关系成立的条件。这可能将限定于条件下的论断坍缩为缺乏支撑的泛化，这种失败我们称之为关系过度泛化。我们提出CondRelBench，一个用于评估条件限定关系理解的混合领域基准。每个论断表示为（E1, R, E2 | C），其中C是许可该关系的条件。使用3,000段合成段落、200篇PubMed全文论文和695个Reddit帖子，我们为每个元组构建五种探针变体：保留、替换、删除或矛盾该条件，或矛盾该关系本身。模型将每个探针分类为Supported（支持）、Not Supported（不支持）或Not Enough Evidence（证据不足）。我们还引入过度泛化率（Overgeneralization Rate, OGR）和范围保持分数（Scope Preservation Score, SPS），以衡量对被修改论断的错误支持以及探针族之间的一致性。在提示式LLM、微调LLM和编码器模型中，我们发现Accuracy和Macro F1常常掩盖范围失败。模型经常支持原始的限定论断，但在其条件被删除或修改时失败。领域专用编码器实现了最强的范围保持，而指令微调的LLM往往表现出更高的过度泛化。合成监督有帮助，但无法弥合与真实PubMed和Reddit性能之间的差距。
translation.brief: 解决关系抽取模型忽略关系成立条件而导致过度泛化的问题，构建混合领域基准CondRelBench并以探针变体和OGR、SPS指标评估条件范围理解能力。

papers.title: Evaluating the Robustness of Fact-Checking LLMs on Multilingual Evidence
papers.abstract: Automated fact-checking benchmarks typically pair claims with clean, curated evidence in high-resource languages, but real-world evidence is often incomplete, misleading, or written in a language where models are weaker. We evaluate the robustness of fact-checking LLMs for different languages. Building on EuroVerdict, we construct gold evidence sets for 190 claims in each of English, German, Greek, and Romanian, then apply four corruption strategies at two severity levels. We test LLMs on a set of claims, providing them with evidence from the sets above. A rubric-based LLM-as-a-judge scores reasoning quality. Verdict accuracy proves highly sensitive to both factors: Misleading edit cut Llama 3.1 8B's English accuracy from 80.00% to 16.84%, and losses widen as language resource level decreases. Machine-translating Greek and Romanian claims into English recovers much, but not all, of the low-resource gap. Judge scores decline more slowly than accuracy, suggesting that automated reasoning evaluation underestimates degradation. These results caution against deploying LLM fact-checkers on noisy multilingual evidence, and we release our evidence datasets and evaluation code to support future work.

translation.title: 评估事实核查LLM在多语言证据上的鲁棒性
translation.abstract: 自动化事实核查基准通常将论断与高资源语言中干净、精心策划的证据配对，但现实世界的证据往往不完整、具有误导性，或以模型能力较弱的书面语言呈现。我们评估事实核查LLM在不同语言下的鲁棒性。基于EuroVerdict，我们为英语、德语、希腊语和罗马尼亚语各190个论断构建了黄金证据集，然后在两个严重程度级别上应用四种损坏策略。我们在一组论断上测试LLM，为其提供上述证据集中的证据。基于评分标准的LLM-as-a-judge对推理质量进行打分。判定准确性对两个因素都高度敏感：误导性编辑使Llama 3.1 8B的英语准确率从80.00%降至16.84%，且损失随语言资源水平下降而扩大。将希腊语和罗马尼亚语论断机器翻译为英语能恢复部分但非全部的低资源差距。评审分数的下降慢于准确率，表明自动化推理评估低估了性能退化。这些结果警示不应在嘈杂的多语言证据上部署LLM事实核查器，我们发布了证据数据集和评估代码以支持后续研究。
translation.brief: 解决事实核查LLM在嘈杂、误导性和低资源语言证据下的鲁棒性未知问题，采用多语言黄金证据集结合多种证据损坏策略进行系统评估。

papers.title: Skill Transfer: Adapting Agent Skills from Strong to Weak Agents
papers.abstract: Agent skills are modular bundles of instructions, code, and resources that an agent loads on demand, increasingly authored and validated on frontier models and shared as an open standard. The same skill behaves differently across models: a strong model turns it into a large performance gain, while a weak model realizes little of that gain and sometimes does worse than with no skill at all. Cost and resource constraints, however, often restrict real deployments to exactly these weaker agents. We hypothesize that the strong model silently supplies procedural steps the skill leaves implicit, which the weak model omits, and formalize closing this gap as \emph{Skill Transfer}: holding the skill's capability ceiling and the model's parameters fixed, we adapt the skill so a specific weak agent can execute it well. Our method abstracts strong and weak trajectories into typed execution structures, localizes their structural divergence with a graph edit distance (GED), and repairs the skill through an iterative diagnoser-patcher loop. Across three benchmarks and two model families, Skill Transfer raises pass rate over the unmodified skill significantly and well over other skill-evolution baselines. The adapted skill also improves the strong agent it was never adapted for, and transfers out of distribution to a structurally related, unseen task. Code is available at this https URL

translation.title: 技能迁移：将Agent技能从强模型适配到弱模型
translation.abstract: Agent技能是按需加载的模块化指令、代码和资源包，越来越多地由前沿模型编写和验证，并作为开放标准共享。同一技能在不同模型上的表现差异很大：强模型能将其转化为巨大的性能提升，而弱模型几乎无法获得该提升，有时甚至比不使用技能更差。然而，成本和资源限制往往使实际部署恰好只能使用这些较弱的agent。我们假设强模型默默补充了技能中隐含的程序性步骤，而弱模型省略了这些步骤，并将弥合这一差距的问题形式化为“技能迁移”（Skill Transfer）：在保持技能能力上限和模型参数不变的前提下，对技能进行适配，使特定的弱agent能够很好地执行它。我们的方法将强模型和弱模型的轨迹抽象为带类型的执行结构，用图编辑距离（GED）定位其结构分歧，并通过迭代式的诊断-修补循环修复技能。在三个基准和两个模型系列上，技能迁移显著提高了相对原始技能的通过率，并大幅超越其他技能演化基线。适配后的技能还能提升未被适配过的强agent，并能分布外迁移到结构相关的未见任务上。代码见此 https URL
translation.brief: 解决弱模型无法有效执行为强模型编写的agent技能的问题，核心方法是将强弱轨迹抽象为带类型的执行结构，用图编辑距离定位分歧并迭代诊断修补技能。

papers.title: FlashREINFORCE: Critic-Free Single-Rollout Asynchronous RL for Agentic Language Models
papers.abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning suits long-horizon agents with irregular rollout times, but group-relative updates require repeated rollouts of each prompt. However, group-based sampling limits prompt coverage at a fixed rollout budget and introduces group synchronization barriers. One rollout per prompt avoids these constraints but removes the variance-reducing group baseline, making updates noisier and more prone to instability on stale, variable-length trajectories. We present FlashREINFORCE, a critic-free, one-pass framework built on One-Batch REINFORCE, a Sequence Trust Region, and Sample-Mean Optimization. These components preserve prompt coverage and signed feedback while controlling policy drift and length-amplified negative updates. In our experiments, FlashREINFORCE remains stable through 6,000 updates on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B at a policy lag of approximately four updates. On Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, it reaches 38.0 mean accuracy across five benchmarks, outperforming the reported GRPO baseline by 1.7 percentage points with half the rollouts (256k versus 512k). Python-tool experiments extend to the 30B MoE model Qwen3-30B-A3B, with stable training at policy lag eight. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, FlashREINFORCE maintains tool use where GRPO stops making tool calls and achieves 98.3%/96.5% seen/unseen ALFWorld success.

translation.title: FlashREINFORCE：面向Agentic语言模型的无Critic单次采样异步强化学习
translation.abstract: 异步强化学习适合rollout时间不规则的长时程agent，但基于组相对的更新需要对每个prompt进行重复采样。然而，基于组的采样在固定rollout预算下限制了prompt覆盖范围，并引入组同步屏障。每个prompt仅采样一次可以避免这些约束，但会移除降低方差的组基线，使更新更嘈杂，在过时、长度可变的轨迹上更容易不稳定。我们提出FlashREINFORCE，一个无critic的单遍框架，构建于One-Batch REINFORCE、序列信任域（Sequence Trust Region）和样本均值优化之上。这些组件在保持prompt覆盖和带符号反馈的同时，控制策略漂移和长度放大的负更新。实验中，FlashREINFORCE在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B上以约4次更新的策略滞后稳定完成6,000次更新。在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B上，它在五个基准上达到38.0的平均准确率，以一半的rollout（256k对512k）超过已报道的GRPO基线1.7个百分点。Python工具实验扩展到30B MoE模型Qwen3-30B-A3B，在策略滞后为8时仍保持训练稳定。在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上，FlashREINFORCE在GRPO停止调用工具时仍维持工具使用，并在ALFWorld上达到98.3%/96.5%的已见/未见成功率。
translation.brief: 解决异步RL中组采样限制prompt覆盖且单次采样更新不稳定的问题，核心方法是无critic的One-Batch REINFORCE结合序列信任域与样本均值优化。

papers.title: Decision 1.0: Towards Open Decision Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Intelligent software needs reusable judgments inside its control flow: selecting an action, testing a condition, or assessing evidence against a rubric. We present Decision 1.0, an open-weight family that turns textual state and runtime-defined questions into typed probability distributions. Its Choice, Noul, and Score interface lets applications specify outcomes at inference time and compose predictions into agents and workflows. Each question produces its candidate distribution without autoregressive text generation. Six models cover bidirectional encoder and causal decoder architectures, including a workflow specialist. Training draws on verifiable tasks, natural-language annotations, and workflow adaptation. On a common decision benchmark, Lux-9B achieves 84.17\% on explicit decisions and 91.25\% on inference, with a weighted overall score of 77.22\%. Results also expose gaps in composition, transfer, and probability calibration. Released weights and inference code provide a basis for developing decision models as reusable components of software.

translation.title: Decision 1.0：迈向开放决策基础模型
translation.abstract: 智能软件需要在控制流中做出可复用的判断：选择动作、测试条件或依据评分标准评估证据。我们提出Decision 1.0，一个开源权重模型系列，可将文本状态和运行时定义的问题转化为带类型的概率分布。其Choice、Noul和Score接口允许应用在推理时指定候选结果，并将预测组合成agent和工作流。每个问题都生成其候选分布，无需自回归文本生成。六个模型涵盖双向编码器和因果解码器架构，包括一个工作流专精模型。训练基于可验证任务、自然语言标注和工作流适配。在通用决策基准上，Lux-9B在显式决策上达到84.17%，在推理上达到91.25%，加权总分77.22%。结果也暴露了在组合、迁移和概率校准方面的差距。发布的权重和推理代码为将决策模型发展为软件的可复用组件提供了基础。
translation.brief: 解决智能软件需要可复用类型化决策判断的问题，核心方法是训练无需自回归生成、直接输出类型化概率分布的开源决策模型系列。

papers.title: Beyond Binary Audits: Does Guideline Grounding Mitigate Decision-Space Framing in LLM Opioid Prescribing?
