papers.abstract: Audits of LLMs for bias in opioid prescribing have largely relied on binary treatment decisions, a signal that current models have saturated. We introduce Q-Pain++, a full-factorial stress test that holds clinical content fixed while independently varying clinical risk factors and the granularity of the available dosage options. Adding an intermediate dosage option to otherwise unchanged vignettes substantially lowers agreement with expert-annotated dosages for most models, while demographic differences in dosage decisions remain small in all but one configuration once clinical risk factors are added. Grounding models in perioperative guidelines through retrieval reduces this framing effect on average but does not eliminate it, and one model's treatment decisions change when the retrieved passages are reordered. These results suggest that audits should vary the answer format, not only patient identity. We will release our codebase as well as Guideline-RAG-associated resources on GitHub (this https URL).

translation.title: 超越二元审计：指南接地能否缓解LLM阿片类药物处方中的决策空间框架效应？
translation.abstract: 对LLM阿片类药物处方偏见的审计大多依赖二元治疗决策，这一信号已被当前模型饱和。我们引入Q-Pain++，一个全因子压力测试，在保持临床内容不变的同时，独立改变临床风险因素和可用剂量选项的粒度。在原本不变的临床情景中加入一个中间剂量选项，大幅降低了大多数模型与专家标注剂量的一致性；而一旦加入临床风险因素，除一种配置外，剂量决策中的人口统计学差异都很小。通过检索将模型接地于围手术期指南可平均降低这种框架效应，但无法消除，并且检索段落的顺序变化会改变一个模型的治疗决策。这些结果表明审计应改变答案格式，而不仅是患者身份。我们将在GitHub上发布代码库以及与Guideline-RAG相关的资源（此 https URL）。
translation.brief: 解决现有LLM阿片类药物处方偏见审计仅依赖二元决策且已饱和的问题，核心方法是构建全因子压力测试Q-Pain++，独立操纵剂量选项粒度、风险因素与指南检索接地。

papers.title: LLMs in DevSecOps: A Systematic Mapping of Models, Evidence, and Research Gaps Across the Software Lifecycle
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being integrated into software security and DevSecOps workflows, yet their adoption, evaluation, and maturity vary substantially across lifecycle stages. This study systematically maps recent LLM-enabled security research published between 2024 and 2026 (until June) across six DevSecOps stages: \textit{Plan}, \textit{Code}, \textit{Test}, \textit{Review}, \textit{Deploy}, and \textit{Monitor}. For each stage, we analyze the security tasks addressed, models and adaptation strategies employed, evaluation settings, reported effectiveness, and key limitations. Our findings reveal an uneven research landscape, with \textit{Test} and \textit{Code} receiving substantially greater attention than \textit{Deploy} and \textit{Review}. Across stages, recent systems increasingly rely on structured context, iterative reasoning, fine-tuning, retrieval augmentation, or agentic workflows rather than direct single-shot prompting. However, reported performance remains difficult to compare because studies use heterogeneous tasks, datasets, metrics, and baselines. Furthermore, most approaches are evaluated using benchmarks or open-source repositories, while industrial-scale evidence remains limited. We also find that existing systems are predominantly stage-specific, with little evidence of LLM-enabled security reasoning spanning multiple DevSecOps stages. Based on these observations, we identify research opportunities in standardized evaluation, production-scale validation, supply-chain and Infrastructure-as-Code security, trustworthy autonomous remediation, and cross-stage LLM integration. This study provides a recent lifecycle-level view of where LLM-enabled DevSecOps research is concentrated, what methodological patterns are emerging, and where significant gaps remain.

translation.title: LLM在DevSecOps中的应用：软件生命周期中模型、证据与研究缺口的系统性映射
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正日益融入软件安全和DevSecOps工作流，但其在生命周期各阶段的采用、评估和成熟度差异巨大。本研究系统性地映射了2024年至2026年6月间发表的LLM安全研究，覆盖六个DevSecOps阶段：Plan、Code、Test、Review、Deploy和Monitor。针对每个阶段，我们分析了所解决的安全任务、使用的模型和适配策略、评估设置、报告的有效性以及关键局限。研究发现呈现不均衡的研究图景，Test和Code阶段受到的关注远多于Deploy和Review。各阶段中，近期系统日益依赖结构化上下文、迭代推理、微调、检索增强或agentic工作流，而非直接的单次提示。然而，由于研究使用异质的任务、数据集、指标和基线，报告的性能难以比较。此外，大多数方法仅在基准或开源仓库上评估，工业规模的证据仍然有限。我们还发现现有系统主要是阶段专用的，几乎没有跨多个DevSecOps阶段的LLM安全推理证据。基于这些观察，我们指出了标准化评估、生产规模验证、供应链和基础设施即代码（Infrastructure-as-Code）安全、可信自主修复以及跨阶段LLM集成方面的研究机会。本研究提供了LLM驱动的DevSecOps研究在生命周期层面的最新视图：研究集中于何处、正在出现哪些方法论模式，以及哪些重大缺口仍然存在。
translation.brief: 解决LLM在DevSecOps安全研究中分布与证据不清晰的问题，核心方法是对2024–2026年文献按六个生命周期阶段进行系统性映射分析。

papers.title: SynthDCB: World Distillation for Scalable Device Control Benchmarking
papers.abstract: Scaling device-control evaluation requires scaling both the worlds agents interact with and the tasks they must solve. We introduce SynthDCB, a scalable benchmark for environment awareness and device control built through world distillation. World distillation transforms knowledge of device behaviors, interaction constraints, and environmental effects into modular executable components, which are composed into interactive worlds with explicit states, actions, and temporal dynamics. A unified capability representation connects tool discovery, world execution, and task synthesis, allowing new capabilities to enter evaluation through a shared construction pipeline. SynthDCB instantiates Home, Car, and Phone domains with 114 device classes, 1,166 functions, and 95 events, supporting five task families with 32 subtypes. The stateful design enables task validation and agent evaluation through state correctness and tool-call traces. We evaluate seven models on 2,560 test tasks; the best achieves 68.2% Pass@1. Error analysis reveals challenges in answer delivery, feasibility diagnosis, and temporal coordination. Construction experiments demonstrate scalability across domains and token efficiency: world distillation reduces token consumption by 0.9-66.0% and 46.2-92.5% relative to Codex with low and xhigh reasoning effort, respectively, while achieving broader capability coverage. SynthDCB makes executable world construction the basis of scalable device-control benchmarking, connecting an expanding space of capabilities and interactions to verifiable agent evaluation.

translation.title: SynthDCB：面向可扩展设备控制评测的世界蒸馏
translation.abstract: 设备控制评测的规模化需要同时扩展智能体交互的世界和其需要解决的任务。我们提出 SynthDCB，一个通过世界蒸馏构建的面向环境感知与设备控制的可扩展基准。世界蒸馏将设备行为、交互约束和环境效应的知识转化为模块化的可执行组件，并组合成具有显式状态、动作和时间动态的交互式世界。统一的能力表示连接了工具发现、世界执行和任务合成，使新能力可以通过共享构建流水线进入评测。SynthDCB 实例化了 Home、Car 和 Phone 三个领域，包含 114 个设备类、1,166 个功能和 95 个事件，支持五个任务族共 32 个子类型。有状态设计支持通过状态正确性和工具调用轨迹进行任务验证和智能体评测。我们在 2,560 个测试任务上评测了七个模型，最佳模型达到 68.2% 的 Pass@1。错误分析揭示了答案交付、可行性诊断和时间协调方面的挑战。构建实验证明了跨领域的可扩展性和 token 效率：相对于低和 xhigh 推理努力的 Codex，世界蒸馏分别减少 0.9-66.0% 和 46.2-92.5% 的 token 消耗，同时实现更广的能力覆盖。SynthDCB 将可执行世界构建作为可扩展设备控制评测的基础，连接不断扩展的能力与交互空间和可验证的智能体评测。
translation.brief: 为解决设备控制基准难以规模化构建的问题，提出通过世界蒸馏将设备行为知识转化为模块化可执行世界组件，以自动合成可验证的评测任务。

papers.title: SERAG: SEmantical and Relational approach for Anomaly detection on knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract: Knowledge graphs constructed from text can contain facts that are individually plausible yet inconsistent with their relational context. We introduce SERAG, a supervised anomaly detector that combines two complementary plausibility estimates: a semantic score computed from separately encoded subject, relation, and object labels, and a relational score obtained through a relational graph convolutional network. The scores are standardized, calibrated, and fused. We evaluate the method on a subset of ICEWS18 with vocabulary-constrained synthetic anomalies generated by an LLM, using pooled and chronological splits. At 10% anomaly prevalence, SERAG achieves test AUPRCs of 0.321 and 0.258, respectively, compared with 0.159 and 0.146 for the strongest adapted baseline. Fusion improves mean test AUPRC over either branch alone, with a larger gain in the pooled protocol and a smaller validation-selected gain in the chronological protocol. Additional anomaly supervision improves performance. These results support the complementarity of textual and relational signals for detecting synthetic anomalies under the evaluated protocols.

translation.title: SERAG：基于语义和关系方法的知识图谱异常检测
translation.abstract: 从文本构建的知识图谱可能包含单独看合理但与其关系上下文不一致的事实。我们提出 SERAG，一种监督式异常检测器，结合两种互补的合理性估计：从分别编码的主语、关系和宾语标签计算得到的语义分数，以及通过关系图卷积网络获得的关系分数。分数经过标准化、校准和融合。我们在 ICEWS18 的子集上评估该方法，使用 LLM 生成的词汇约束合成异常，采用混合和按时间顺序的划分。在 10% 异常比例下，SERAG 分别取得 0.321 和 0.258 的测试 AUPRC，而最强的适配基线分别为 0.159 和 0.146。融合在任一单独分支之上提升了平均测试 AUPRC，在混合协议中增益更大，在按时间顺序协议中经验证选择的增益较小。额外的异常监督可以提升性能。这些结果支持文本与关系信号在所评估协议下检测合成异常的互补性。
translation.brief: 针对知识图谱中事实与其关系上下文不一致的异常检测问题，融合独立编码的语义分数与关系图卷积网络的关系分数来判定事实异常。

papers.title: HIMX: mixed-format matrix multiplication based on customized HIFLOAT4 representations
papers.abstract: 4-bit weight-activation quantization (W4A4) is an important approach for efficient large language model (LLM) inference. Recent hierarchical formats such as HiFloat4 (HIF4) improve the representational range of 4-bit quantization through multi-level scaling. However, the same local mantissa representation in HIF4 may not be equally suitable for weights and activations, which exhibit distinct distribution characteristics. To address this limitation, we propose HiMX, a mixed-mantissa framework built upon the hierarchical scaling structure of HIF4. Our key observation is that the two HIF4-compatible mantissa representations, S1P2 and E2M1, exhibit complementary quantization behavior: the denser S1P2 format provides higher resolution for concentrated weight distributions, while the wider-spaced E2M1 format provides complementary quantization characteristics for activation tensors. HiMX enables operand-tailored mantissa representations while converting heterogeneous mantissas into fixed-point integer operands with operand-specific widths, allowing different operand formats to share a unified integer multiply-accumulate (MAC) array. Block-level analysis on Qwen3-8B shows that HIF4-S1P2 is better suited for weights while HIF4 E2M1 is better suited for activations, and their mixed-format combination achieves lower output MSE than homogeneous configurations. Across multiple benchmarks, HiMX reduces the average end-to-end accuracy loss from 2.38 to 1.77 points on Qwen3-8B and from 2.23 to 1.85 points on Qwen3-30B-A3B, demonstrating the potential benefit of heterogeneous mantissa representations for W4A4 LLM inference.

translation.title: HiMX：基于定制化 HIFLOAT4 表示的混合格式矩阵乘法
translation.abstract: 4-bit 权重-激活量化（W4A4）是高效大语言模型（LLM）推理的重要方法。近期诸如 HiFloat4（HIF4）的分层格式通过多级缩放提升了 4-bit 量化的表示范围。然而，HIF4 中相同的本地尾数表示可能并不同等适合权重和激活，两者具有不同的分布特性。为解决这一局限，我们提出 HiMX，一个建立在 HIF4 分层缩放结构之上的混合尾数框架。我们的关键观察是两种与 HIF4 兼容的尾数表示 S1P2 和 E2M1 表现出互补的量化行为：更密集的 S1P2 格式为集中的权重分布提供更高分辨率，而间隔更宽的 E2M1 格式为激活张量提供互补的量化特性。HiMX 支持针对操作数定制尾数表示，同时将异构尾数转换为具有操作数特定宽度的定点整数操作数，使不同操作数格式共享统一的整数乘累加（MAC）阵列。在 Qwen3-8B 上的块级分析表明，HIF4-S1P2 更适合权重而 HIF4 E2M1 更适合激活，其混合格式组合比同质配置实现更低的输出 MSE。在多个基准上，HiMX 将 Qwen3-8B 的平均端到端精度损失从 2.38 降至 1.77 点，Qwen3-30B-A3B 从 2.23 降至 1.85 点，展示了异构尾数表示对 W4A4 LLM 推理的潜在收益。
translation.brief: 针对 HIF4 量化中权重与激活分布特性不同的问题，提出为权重和激活分别定制 S1P2 与 E2M1 尾数表示并在统一整数 MAC 阵列上执行的混合格式框架。

papers.title: Agents Cannot Hand Over What They Have Not Yet Understood
papers.abstract: Agents that work beyond a single context window, or in teams, hand their work to a successor as a short written summary. Evaluation has focused on whether an agent can solve a task, and relatively little is known about how much of what an agent has learned survives being written down. We study this in 56 interactive worlds with hidden rules, where an agent that is told nothing fails and an agent given a 300-character statement of the rules succeeds. We compare one agent that plays eight lives and keeps its whole history with a chain of eight agents that each play one life and inherit a 300-character note. All six models we test learn less in the chain: after eight generations it stands where the single agent stood after about four lives. Controlled variants of the chain decompose this handoff loss into three components: none from changing the agent, a smaller loss from compressing to 300 characters, and a larger loss from compressing repeatedly. When each note is written from the full record of earlier lives instead of from the previous note, the same 300 characters recover 70% to 82% of the loss. The loss is robust across model sizes and is not alleviated by instructing the writer to record evidence, to revise the inherited note, or to keep a structured ledger. In simpler terms, an agent cannot hand over what it has not yet understood: a note holds what its writer has worked out, and a rule that takes several lives to see is lost with the lives that were not passed on.

translation.title: 智能体无法交接它们尚未理解的东西
translation.abstract: 在单个上下文窗口之外工作或以团队形式工作的智能体，会以简短的书面摘要将其工作交给继任者。评估一直聚焦于智能体能否解决任务，而对智能体所学内容在写下之后有多少能留存下来知之甚少。我们在 56 个具有隐藏规则的交互世界中进行研究，其中完全不知情的智能体会失败，而获得 300 字符规则陈述的智能体会成功。我们比较了一个扮演八条生命并保留完整历史的智能体与一条由八个智能体组成的链——每个智能体扮演一条生命并继承一条 300 字符的笔记。我们测试的六个模型在链中学习到的都更少：八代之后的位置相当于单个智能体约四条生命之后的位置。链的受控变体将这种交接损失分解为三个组成部分：更换智能体没有损失，压缩到 300 字符带来较小损失，而反复压缩带来更大损失。当每条笔记是从此前生命的完整记录而非前一条笔记写出时，同样的 300 字符可以恢复 70% 至 82% 的损失。该损失在不同模型规模上都是稳健的，且不会因指示撰写者记录证据、修改继承的笔记或维护结构化账本而缓解。简而言之，智能体无法交接它尚未理解的东西：笔记只承载其撰写者已经想通的内容，而需要几条生命才能领悟的规则会随着未被传递的生命而丢失。
translation.brief: 研究智能体通过书面笔记跨代交接知识时的信息损失问题，发现反复压缩笔记导致主要损失，而基于完整历史记录重写笔记可大幅恢复损失。

papers.title: Screen Before You Add: Reducing Candidate Inference in Model Ensembles
papers.abstract: As new models become available, existing ensembles must be updated to be competitive, making them intrinsically dynamic. Deciding whether to add a candidate model can require inference on an entire annotated dataset. Such a screening becomes prohibitive for models with costly inference especially when they ultimately add no value. Even under simple convex aggregation, relying on benchmark scores can be misleading as strong standalone performance does not guarantee ensemble improvement, and fitted ensemble weights can hurt test performance. In this work, we study candidate screening and show how early rejection can be achieved safely, exploiting residual geometry for stratification and rejecting the candidate when the best possible remaining predictions cannot achieve the necessary improvement. The key result that justifies this approach is that, under convex aggregation and squared or Brier loss, the population optimum improves if and only if a candidate induces a prediction change positively aligned with the residuals of the population-optimal existing ensemble. An optimistic quadratic program (QP) provides certified early rejection, while posterior-scenario sampling offers an alternative heuristic. We evaluate the approach by showing the tradeoff between saved calls and screening accuracy, which refers to recovering the same accept/reject result as for the entire annotated dataset. We assess empirically whether full-dataset decisions predict candidate usefulness on a held-out test set. On two LLM panels, stratified screening with certified QP rejection saves 21-23% of candidate calls while keeping 100% screening accuracy. In our experiments, sampling posterior scenarios further increases call savings to approximately 37%, with a loss of less than one percentage point in screening accuracy.

translation.title: 先筛选再添加：减少模型集成中的候选推理
translation.abstract: 随着新模型的出现，现有集成必须更新以保持竞争力，这使其本质上是动态的。决定是否添加候选模型可能需要在整个标注数据集上进行推理。对于推理成本高昂的模型，这种筛选可能代价过高，尤其当它们最终不增加任何价值时。即使在简单的凸聚合下，依赖基准分数也可能产生误导，因为强大的独立性能并不保证集成提升，而拟合的集成权重可能损害测试性能。在本工作中，我们研究候选筛选，并展示如何通过利用残差几何进行分层、并在最佳可能剩余预测无法实现必要改进时拒绝候选，从而安全地实现早期拒绝。支持该方法的关键结论是：在凸聚合和平方损失或 Brier 损失下，当且仅当候选引起的预测变化与现有总体最优集成的残差正向对齐时，总体最优才会改善。一个乐观二次规划（QP）提供经过认证的早期拒绝，而后验情景采样提供一种替代启发式方法。我们通过展示节省的调用次数与筛选准确率之间的权衡来评估该方法，筛选准确率指与在完整标注数据集上得到相同的接受/拒绝结果。我们实证评估全数据集决策是否能预测候选在留出测试集上的有用性。在两个 LLM 面板上，带认证 QP 拒绝的分层筛选节省了 21-23% 的候选调用，同时保持 100% 的筛选准确率。在我们的实验中，后验情景采样进一步将调用节省提升至约 37%，筛选准确率损失不到一个百分点。
translation.brief: 针对向模型集成添加新模型时需在完整标注数据集上推理的高昂成本问题，利用残差几何与乐观二次规划实现候选模型的早期安全拒绝。

papers.title: Rethinking Offline On-Policy Distillation: From Scalar Advantages to Distributional Supervision
papers.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher capabilities through token-level feedback on student-generated trajectories, but repeatedly evaluating fresh rollouts with the teacher is computationally expensive. Offline methods such as Lightning OPD reduce this cost by caching recorded tokens' teacher log-probabilities on fixed reference rollouts. By extending the idea to a multi-turn agentic search setup, we find that it consistently underperforms the SFT starting point trained by the same teacher. We empirically observe greater teacher--reference mismatch than in mathematical reasoning and post-training distributional flattening, and theoretically show that scalar advantage supervision on fixed rollouts admits solutions with flattened output distributions under suitable conditions. Motivated by these findings, we propose Distributional On-Policy Distillation (DistOPD), a simple yet effective offline OPD method that retains candidate-token probabilities from both reference and teacher at selected positions and aggregates the remaining parts into a residual token. On agentic search, DistOPD achieves performance comparable to online OPD while improving student--teacher alignment and using training GPU-hours comparable to Lightning OPD.

translation.title: 重新思考离线同策略蒸馏：从标量优势到分布监督
translation.abstract: 同策略蒸馏（OPD）通过在学生生成的轨迹上提供 token 级反馈来迁移教师能力，但用教师反复评估新的 rollout 计算开销很大。Lightning OPD 等离线方法通过在固定参考 rollout 上缓存已记录 token 的教师对数概率来降低成本。将该思路扩展到多轮智能体搜索场景时，我们发现其持续低于同一教师训练的 SFT 起点。我们实证观察到比数学推理中更大的教师-参考失配以及训练后分布的扁平化，并从理论上证明在固定 rollout 上进行标量优势监督在适当条件下会导致输出分布扁平化的解。基于这些发现，我们提出分布式同策略蒸馏（DistOPD），一种简单而有效的离线 OPD 方法，它在选定位置保留参考和教师的候选 token 概率，并将其余部分聚合为一个残差 token。在智能体搜索任务上，DistOPD 取得了与在线 OPD 相当的性能，同时提升了学生-教师对齐，且训练 GPU 小时数与 Lightning OPD 相当。
translation.brief: 针对离线 OPD 在多轮智能体任务上因标量优势监督导致分布扁平化而表现不佳的问题，提出在选定位置保留教师与参考候选 token 概率分布并聚合其余部分的 DistOPD 方法。

papers.title: MeltKV: Memory-Aligned KV Cache Compression via Variable-Bit Packed Vector Quantization for Long-Context LLMs
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on long contexts, making Key-Value (KV) caches dominate memory usage and inference latency. Existing vector quantization (VQ) methods effectively compress KV caches to sub-4-bit levels but often overlook inefficiencies in memory alignment and decoding speed. This work introduces MeltKV, a memory-latency co-optimized KV cache quantization framework for long-context LLM serving. MeltKV employs a memory-aligned variable-bit index packing scheme that adaptively assigns bit-widths to grouped key channels and compactly stores indices within standard data-types, eliminating redundant bits. Additionally, head-wise codebook sharing reduces the total codebook size while maintaining accuracy. Experiments demonstrate that MeltKV effectively compresses KV representations to sub-4-bit levels down to 1 bit and, at comparable perplexity, achieves 48.1% lower memory usage and 52.9% lower latency than state-of-the-art VQ methods.

translation.title: MeltKV：面向长上下文大语言模型的内存对齐变比特打包向量量化 KV 缓存压缩
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越依赖长上下文，使键值（KV）缓存成为内存占用和推理延迟的主要来源。现有向量量化（VQ）方法能有效将 KV 缓存压缩到 4 比特以下，但往往忽视内存对齐和解码速度方面的低效。本工作提出 MeltKV，一个面向长上下文 LLM 服务的内存-延迟协同优化 KV 缓存量化框架。MeltKV 采用内存对齐的变比特索引打包方案，自适应地为分组的 key 通道分配比特宽度，并将索引紧凑地存储在标准数据类型中，消除冗余比特。此外，逐头码本共享在保持精度的同时减少了总码本规模。实验表明，MeltKV 能有效将 KV 表示压缩到 4 比特以下直至 1 比特，在相近困惑度下，相比最先进的 VQ 方法内存占用降低 48.1%，延迟降低 52.9%。
translation.brief: 针对 KV 缓存向量量化中内存对齐与解码延迟的低效问题，提出内存对齐的变比特索引打包与逐头码本共享的量化压缩框架 MeltKV。

papers.title: Earth World Model: Physics-constrained latent dynamics for forecasting and environmental scenario analysis
papers.abstract: World models have been widely applied to multi-agent planning and forecasting, but exogenous environmental changes are rarely incorporated as replaceable drivers in a unified state-evolution process. This limits assessment of whether environmental perturbations propagate through physical systems with faithful dynamics. We propose the Earth World Model (EWM), an Earth-centred forecasting framework that compresses heterogeneous multi-source observations into a reusable low-dimensional latent state representing the system's history and current condition. Given explicit exogenous drivers, a shared transition operator recursively updates the latent state, and physics-constrained decoding produces multi-step forecasts. Replacing the drivers enables environmental scenario analysis and evaluation of dynamic-response fidelity. We evaluated EWM for power forecasting and environmental-perturbation response at six photovoltaic sites and one wind-power site. Across four photovoltaic sites and three forecast horizons, three independent training runs yielded mean $R^2$ values of 0.8578-0.9095. In a separate six-site decoder ablation, the mean net per-unit response $\rho$ under the prescribed irradiance intervention increased from 0.180 with a multilayer perceptron decoder to 0.922 with an analytic physical decoder, close to site- and horizon-specific analytic references. The wind model achieved an injection elasticity of $0.9990 \pm 0.0006$, while pre-intervention outputs remained unchanged. These results show that forecast fit and intervention response should be evaluated separately and that the tested EWM configurations preserved response amplitude and temporal boundaries under the prescribed interventions.

translation.title: 地球世界模型：用于预测与环境情景分析的物理约束潜动力学
translation.abstract: 世界模型已被广泛应用于多智能体规划与预测，但外生环境变化很少作为可替换的驱动因素纳入统一的状态演化过程。这限制了对环境扰动是否以忠实的动力学在物理系统中传播的评估。我们提出地球世界模型（EWM），一个以地球为中心的预测框架，它将异构多源观测压缩为可复用的低维潜状态，表征系统的历史和当前状态。在给定显式外生驱动的情况下，一个共享的转移算子递归更新潜状态，物理约束解码产生多步预测。替换驱动因素即可实现环境情景分析和动态响应保真度评估。我们在六个光伏站点和一个风电站点评估了 EWM 的电力预测和环境扰动响应。在四个光伏站点和三个预测时距上，三次独立训练的平均 R² 为 0.8578-0.9095。在另一项六站点解码器消融中，规定辐照度干预下的平均单位净响应 ρ 从多层感知机解码器的 0.180 提升至解析物理解码器的 0.922，接近站点和时距特定的解析参考值。风电模型达到 0.9990±0.0006 的注入弹性，同时干预前输出保持不变。这些结果表明，预测拟合度与干预响应应分开评估，且所测 EWM 配置在规定干预下保留了响应幅度和时间边界。
translation.brief: 针对环境扰动在预测模型中传播动力学不忠实的问题，提出将多源观测压缩为潜状态、由共享转移算子递归演化并用物理约束解码的地球世界模型 EWM。

papers.title: Beveridge: Open Weight System One Decision Models with Calibrated Probabilities
papers.abstract: Many production systems need a model to make a narrow decision about a document (route a ticket, check a limit, refuse a request, pick the next step of a browser agent) rather than to write text about it. We present Beveridge, a family of open weight System One decision models that take a document and up to 15 typed questions (yes/no, choice among described options, or a level on an ordered scale) and return, in one forward pass without generating text, an answer with a calibrated probability for every option. Beveridge-Large-C (398M parameters) adds a 3.5M parameter decision network to ModernBERT-large: typed number and date features in the input, exact facts from a rule engine, question-to-document evidence attention, a three-step recursive core with learned halting and an exact yes/no path. Beveridge-Pro-C adapts Gemma 4 26B-A4B with LoRA to score option letters, and Beveridge-Pro-C-Web extends it to the next step of a browser agent. On held-out tests the 0.4B model reaches 93.0% on our operations-document benchmark against 91.1% for the best of five general LLMs (31B-675B) and 87.9% for a commercial System One API, and, because its confidences are calibrated (ECE 0.029 on that benchmark), it can hand over 76% of decisions automatically at 95% accuracy, where no general LLM we tested can hand over any. It answers in 4.9 ms per decision on one NVIDIA H200 GPU and 60 ms on the 14 core CPU of an Apple M4 Pro laptop. Beveridge-Pro-C-Web raises next-step accuracy on web pages from unseen site types from 49.4% to 98.2% and completes live browsing tasks without losing document accuracy. We describe the models, the training recipes and an evaluation on 19 held-out test sets against a commercial System One API and five general LLMs, including where the models are weak. Weights and inference code are released under Apache 2.0.

translation.title: Beveridge：具有校准概率的开源权重 System One 决策模型
translation.abstract: 许多生产系统需要一个模型对文档做出窄决策（工单路由、限额检查、拒绝请求、选择浏览器智能体的下一步），而不是撰写关于文档的文本。我们提出 Beveridge，一系列开源权重 System One 决策模型，它接收一个文档和最多 15 个类型化问题（是/否、在描述的选项中选择、或有序量表上的等级），并在一次前向传播中不生成文本，为每个选项返回带校准概率的答案。Beveridge-Large-C（398M 参数）在 ModernBERT-large 上增加一个 3.5M 参数的决策网络：输入中的类型化数字和日期特征、来自规则引擎的精确事实、问题到文档的证据注意力、带学习停止机制和精确是/否路径的三步递归核心。Beveridge-Pro-C 用 LoRA 适配 Gemma 4 26B-A4B 来对选项字母打分，Beveridge-Pro-C-Web 将其扩展到浏览器智能体的下一步。在保留测试集上，0.4B 模型在我们的运营文档基准上达到 93.0%，而五个通用 LLM（31B-675B）中最好的为 91.1%，商业 System One API 为 87.9%；由于置信度经过校准（该基准上 ECE 为 0.029），它可以在 95% 精度下自动交付 76% 的决策，而我们测试的通用 LLM 都无法交付任何决策。它在单块 NVIDIA H200 GPU 上每个决策耗时 4.9 毫秒，在 Apple M4 Pro 笔记本的 14 核 CPU 上耗时 60 毫秒。Beveridge-Pro-C-Web 将未见网站类型网页上的下一步准确率从 49.4% 提升到 98.2%，并在不损失文档精度的前提下完成实时浏览任务。我们介绍了这些模型、训练配方以及在 19 个保留测试集上对照商业 System One API 和五个通用 LLM 的评估，包括模型的薄弱之处。权重和推理代码以 Apache 2.0 发布。
translation.brief: 针对生产系统中窄决策任务缺乏校准概率的小模型问题，构建在单次前向传播中输出类型化问题校准答案的开源 System One 决策模型系列 Beveridge。

papers.title: ECOD: Experience-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents
papers.abstract: Sparse and delayed rewards make reinforcement learning challenging for long-horizon language agents. On-policy distillation (OPD) complements environmental rewards with dense teacher feedback on student-generated contexts. Standard OPD can misalign supervision with relative teacher competence, student trajectory outcomes, and the temporal structure of task execution. Recent variants adjust guidance through divergence-based weighting and temporal schedules, while joint calibration from task-completion experience remains underexplored. We introduce Experience-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation (ECOD), which allocates teacher supervision at the task, trajectory, and turn levels. ECOD compares teacher and student success-rate posteriors under matched task conditions, restricts direct supervision to failed student trajectories, and derives a temporal prior from successful teacher lengths. The resulting weight applies to teacher losses or teacher-derived advantages. We evaluate ECOD on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Under matched teacher settings, ECOD improves standard OPD by up to 4.06% in relative ALFWorld unseen success. Across both model scales, ECOD-assisted SOD, TCOD-F2B, and ATOD configurations yield average paired relative gains of 6.20% on ALFWorld unseen and 7.05% on WebShop, with WebShop gains ranging from 2.29% to 21.60%. These results support experience-calibrated supervision allocation as a reusable mechanism across distinct distillation objectives.

translation.title: ECOD：面向多轮智能体的经验校准同策略蒸馏
translation.abstract: 稀疏和延迟的奖励使强化学习对长时程语言智能体具有挑战性。同策略蒸馏（OPD）通过在学生生成的上下文上提供密集教师反馈来补充环境奖励。标准 OPD 可能导致监督与教师的相对能力、学生轨迹结果以及任务执行的时间结构错位。近期的变体通过基于散度的加权和时间调度来调整引导，而来自任务完成经验的联合校准仍待探索。我们提出经验校准同策略蒸馏（ECOD），它在任务、轨迹和轮次三个层级分配教师监督。ECOD 在匹配的任务条件下比较教师与学生的成功率后验，将直接监督限制在失败的学生轨迹上，并从成功的教师长度中推导时间先验。所得权重可应用于教师损失或教师导出的优势。我们在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 评估 ECOD。在匹配教师设置下，ECOD 在 ALFWorld 未见集相对成功率上最多提升标准 OPD 4.06%。在两个模型规模上，ECOD 辅助的 SOD、TCOD-F2B 和 ATOD 配置在 ALFWorld 未见集和 WebShop 上平均配对相对提升分别为 6.20% 和 7.05%，其中 WebShop 提升范围为 2.29% 到 21.60%。这些结果支持将经验校准的监督分配作为可跨不同蒸馏目标复用的机制。
translation.brief: 针对 OPD 中教师监督与任务完成经验错位的问题，提出在任务、轨迹和轮次层级依据师生成功率后验和时间先验经验校准监督权重的 ECOD 方法。

papers.title: LogicEye: Agent Driven Multimodal Dataset for Interpretable Ophthalmic Diagnosis
papers.abstract: Clinical adoption of ophthalmic Artificial Intelligence remains limited by low interpretability and a lack of finely annotated multimodal data. Most existing datasets provide only coarse disease labels without the granular pathological findings required for differential diagnosis. We present LogicEye$^{Agent}$, a dual-pool inference and verification agent that emulates clinical reasoning by jointly verifying positive inclusion signs and negative exclusion criteria. Using LogicEye$^{Agent}$, we curate LogicEye$^{Data}$, a large-scale multimodal dataset of 804,461 fundus and OCT images paired with structured pathological reports spanning 38 diseases and 29 subtypes, with quality assured through joint verification by multimodal large language models and clinical experts. Building on this dataset, we further develop LogicEye$^{Bench}$, which incorporates a category-constrained loss for hierarchical disease recognition and report generation. Grounding coarse labels into verified visual findings effectively curtails diagnostic hallucinations and establishes a solid foundation for interpretable vision-language modeling in ophthalmology. The code is available at:this https URL.

translation.title: LogicEye：面向可解释眼科诊断的智能体驱动多模态数据集
translation.abstract: 眼科人工智能的临床应用仍然受限于可解释性低以及缺乏精细标注的多模态数据。现有数据集大多只提供粗粒度的疾病标签，缺少鉴别诊断所需的细粒度病理发现。我们提出 LogicEye$^{Agent}$，一个双池推理与验证智能体，通过联合验证阳性纳入体征和阴性排除标准来模拟临床推理。借助 LogicEye$^{Agent}$，我们构建了 LogicEye$^{Data}$，一个大规模多模态数据集，包含 804,461 张眼底和 OCT 图像，配以覆盖 38 种疾病和 29 个亚型的结构化病理报告，并通过多模态大语言模型与临床专家的联合验证进行质量保证。基于该数据集，我们进一步开发了 LogicEye$^{Bench}$，其中引入类别约束损失用于层级化疾病识别与报告生成。将粗标签落地到经验证的视觉发现上，有效抑制了诊断幻觉，为眼科可解释的视觉-语言建模奠定了坚实基础。代码可在：this https URL 获取。
translation.brief: 针对眼科AI标注数据粗粒度、可解释性差的问题，提出双池推理-验证智能体LogicEye Agent，用于构建带结构化病理报告的大规模多模态眼科数据集与基准。

papers.title: Perceptual Weight Space Programming for Diffusion Super-Resolution
papers.abstract: Diffusion models for image super-resolution can recover scene content while producing distracting artifacts or unbalanced colors. We study whether a large language model (LLM) can improve perceptual quality by editing a small subset of existing U-Net weights without a clean reference image. The proposed framework provides the editor with architecture code, selected weights, activation summaries, and sampling previews. It permits up to 1,020 candidate trials while limiting accepted changes to three layers and fewer than 0.1\% of model parameters. The evaluation protocol uses ResShift, SinSR, and SUPIR and compares GPT-6 Astra with a specified Qwen3-VL model under matched access. Feedback metrics guide editing, while separate quality metrics and blinded human comparisons evaluate the final weights. We also report an executed color calibration experiment using real photographs and two small residual networks. This experiment demonstrates correction of a fixed color shift and reveals that an improving feedback score can accompany worse performance on unseen scenes. A separate lightweight super-resolution experiment isolates modest changes in luminance detail while preserving color. The findings motivate restricted updates and independent evaluation of perceptual weight editing.

translation.title: 面向扩散模型超分辨率的感知权重空间编程
translation.abstract: 用于图像超分辨率的扩散模型在恢复场景内容的同时，可能产生令人分心的伪影或不均衡的色彩。我们研究在无干净参考图像的情况下，大语言模型（LLM）能否通过编辑现有 U-Net 权重的一个小子集来提升感知质量。所提出的框架向编辑者提供架构代码、所选权重、激活摘要和采样预览。允许最多 1,020 次候选试验，同时将可接受的更改限制在三层且少于 0.1\% 的模型参数。评估协议使用 ResShift、SinSR 和 SUPIR，并在同等访问权限下比较 GPT-6 Astra 与指定的 Qwen3-VL 模型。反馈指标用于引导编辑，而独立的质量指标和盲测人类比较则用于评估最终权重。我们还报告了一项使用真实照片和两个小型残差网络执行的颜色校准实验。该实验展示了对固定色彩偏移的校正，并揭示反馈分数的提升可能伴随在未见场景上更差的表现。另一项轻量级超分辨率实验在保持色彩的同时分离出亮度细节的适度变化。这些发现为限制性更新和感知权重编辑的独立评估提供了依据。
translation.brief: 研究让LLM在不参考干净图像的条件下小幅编辑U-Net权重以提升扩散超分辨率感知质量，并强调限制更新范围与独立评估。

papers.title: Swarm Shepherd: Securing Multi-Agent Ecosystems Against Persistent Latent Compromise
papers.abstract: Agentic ecosystems are emerging as a new platform layer in which agents maintain persistent memory, retrieve from shared knowledge bases, execute through tool interfaces, and coordinate through shared states. These capabilities create a security problem that per-turn defenses miss: compromise can accumulate across sessions, agents, and system layers before visible failure. We define this threat as Agentic Sleeper, a system-level adversary that first behaves legitimately, gains routing trust, and later activates across memory, agent logic, and infrastructure. We formulate defense as inference under partial observability and propose Swarm Shepherd, a system-level defense framework centered on an inference filter for early warning, paired with a backward trace-back module for entry attribution. Our analysis yields a two-scale deployment rule that balances longer event histories against broader agent coverage. Across LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen, Agentic Sleeper drift begins 2.7--8.9$\times$ faster than natural baselines, propagates across agents on most topologies, and evades per-turn and stateful defenses above 80\%. Swarm Shepherd warns at least three sessions before visible degradation (2.6 sessions when failure is scored by the benchmark's own task grader), while trace-back reaches 0.69 top-1 accuracy and 0.72 macro-F1 over 24 variants. The two-scale deployment rule is empirically confirmed, and in live end-to-end runs on LangGraph and AutoGen the posterior-guided defense stack drives cross-agent propagation below the self-sustaining regime, which removing only the visibly compromised agent does not achieve.

translation.title: Swarm Shepherd：防御多智能体生态系统免受持续性潜伏入侵
translation.abstract: 智能体生态系统正在成为一个新的平台层：智能体维护持久记忆、从共享知识库检索、通过工具接口执行操作，并通过共享状态进行协调。这些能力带来了每轮防御所忽视的安全问题：入侵可以在可见故障出现之前，跨会话、跨智能体和跨系统层逐步累积。我们将这种威胁定义为 Agentic Sleeper——一种系统级对手，起初表现合法、获取路由信任，随后在记忆、智能体逻辑和基础设施层面被激活。我们将防御形式化为部分可观测性下的推断问题，并提出 Swarm Shepherd——一个以推断过滤器（用于早期预警）为核心、配合反向溯源模块（用于入口归因）的系统级防御框架。我们的分析得出一个平衡更长事件历史与更广智能体覆盖范围的双尺度部署规则。在 LangGraph、CrewAI 和 AutoGen 上，Agentic Sleeper 的漂移启动速度比自然基线快 2.7--8.9 倍，能在多数拓扑结构上跨智能体传播，并逃避超过 80\% 的每轮和有状态防御。Swarm Shepherd 在可见退化发生前至少提前三个会话发出预警（当失败由基准自身任务评分器衡量时为 2.6 个会话），而溯源在 24 个变体上达到 0.69 的 top-1 准确率和 0.72 的 macro-F1。双尺度部署规则得到实证确认，在 LangGraph 和 AutoGen 上的实时端到端运行中，后验引导的防御栈将跨智能体传播压低到无法自我维系的水平，而仅移除可见被入侵的智能体则无法实现这一效果。
translation.brief: 针对跨会话潜伏累积入侵的智能体生态系统安全威胁，提出基于部分可观测推断的系统级防御框架Swarm Shepherd，含早期预警过滤器和入口溯源模块。

papers.title: How to make a moral agent: sentimentalism and rationalism as lenses on AI
papers.abstract: Can AI systems be moral agents? That is, can they undertake actions that can be correctly assessed as morally right or wrong? There is no settled normative criterion of moral agency that applies neatly outside paradigm human cases. Because of the difficulties with a normative account, we instead propose a research program to explore descriptive moral agency. Most basically, we ask, what are the capabilities we humans possess that underlie our moral agency? To do so, we draw on historical scholarship in philosophy and moral psychology to isolate candidate capabilities. Then we suggest refining candidate capabilities so that they are testable in the context of AI systems. Finally, we offer specific empirical recommendations to test AI systems, especially large language models (LLMs), for those refined capabilities. Our approach offers several benefits. Firstly, it may demonstrate whether the behaviors of AI systems are aligned, or in a broad sense desirable. Secondly, the debate may inform policy questions (e.g., what models should be deployed in which contexts?). Thirdly, our approach may complement engineering and design efforts: when capabilities can be precisely characterized, they can inform the development of models. Fourthly, applying our moral reasoning concepts in the new context of AI systems should improve our understanding of those concepts.

translation.title: 如何造就一个道德智能体：以情感主义与理性主义为审视AI的透镜
translation.abstract: AI系统能成为道德智能体吗？也就是说，它们能否实施可被正确评判为道德上正确或错误的行为？目前尚无一个能在典型人类案例之外普适适用的、已定论的道德智能体规范性标准。由于规范性方案的困难，我们转而提出一个探索描述性道德智能体的研究计划。最根本地，我们追问：人类拥有哪些能力构成了我们的道德智能体？为此，我们借助哲学与道德心理学的历史学术研究来甄别候选能力。然后我们建议细化这些候选能力，使其在AI系统语境下可被检验。最后，我们给出具体的实证建议，用于检验AI系统（尤其是大语言模型，LLM）是否具备这些细化后的能力。我们的方法有多项益处：其一，可能证明AI系统的行为是否对齐，或在广义上是否可取；其二，这一讨论可为政策问题提供依据（例如，何种模型应部署于何种场景？）；其三，我们的方法可补充工程与设计工作：当能力能够被精确刻画时，便可指导模型开发；第四，将我们的道德推理概念应用于AI系统这一新语境，也应能加深我们对这些概念的理解。
translation.brief: 针对缺乏AI道德智能体评判标准的问题，提出以描述性研究路线甄别、细化并实证检验人类道德能力在LLM等系统中是否存在的研究计划。

papers.title: T2T Technical Report: Synthesizing GUI Agent Trajectories at Scale from Video Tutorials
papers.abstract: Training generalist GUI agents requires large volumes of interaction trajectories comprising screenshot sequences paired with grounded UI actions, yet collecting such data through human demonstration is expensive and difficult to scale. Although public software tutorial videos contain rich operational demonstrations, their continuous pixel streams lack discrete action boundaries, semantic intents, and precise spatial coordinates, making them difficult to use directly for model training. To address this, we present T2T (Tutorial-to-Trajectory), a fully automated pipeline for synthesizing GUI agent trajectories at scale. T2T spans desktop, web, and mobile platforms to convert unannotated video tutorials into structured, executable interaction trajectories. To guarantee trajectory quality, T2T combines active segment filtering, keyframe identification via localized UI change, shortcut-free observation frame selection, presence-aware grounding, and two-stage action-space normalization. These refined trajectories are then converted into multi-task training views spanning navigation, planning, forward dynamics, and grounding. We fine-tune Qwen3-VL-8B on a subset of the more than one million human-annotation-free training samples generated by this pipeline. Evaluations show that the model achieves consistent gains across multiple benchmarks covering desktop, web, and mobile environments, including OSWorld-G, ScreenSpot-Pro, AndroidControl, and AgentNetBench, indicating improved core capabilities in grounding, step-level instruction execution, and trajectory-level decision-making. Notably, all gains are achieved without any in-distribution training data from target domains. Learning exclusively from trajectories extracted from public videos via the T2T pipeline, the model exhibits cross-application and cross-task generalization capabilities.

translation.title: T2T 技术报告：从视频教程大规模合成GUI智能体轨迹
translation.abstract: 训练通用 GUI 智能体需要大量交互轨迹，即截图序列与对应接地 UI 动作的配对，而通过人工演示收集此类数据成本高昂且难以扩展。尽管公开软件教程视频包含丰富的操作演示，但其连续像素流缺乏离散的动作边界、语义意图和精确的空间坐标，难以直接用于模型训练。为此，我们提出 T2T（Tutorial-to-Trajectory），一个全自动化的大规模合成 GUI 智能体轨迹的流水线。T2T 覆盖桌面、网页和移动平台，将未标注的视频教程转换为结构化、可执行的交互轨迹。为保证轨迹质量，T2T 结合了主动片段过滤、基于局部 UI 变化的关键帧识别、无快捷键的观察帧选择、存在感知接地以及两阶段动作空间规范化。这些精炼后的轨迹随后被转换为覆盖导航、规划、前向动力学和接地的多任务训练视图。我们在该流水线生成的超过一百万条无人工标注训练样本的子集上微调 Qwen3-VL-8B。评估显示，该模型在覆盖桌面、网页和移动环境的多个基准上取得一致提升，包括 OSWorld-G、ScreenSpot-Pro、AndroidControl 和 AgentNetBench，表明其在接地、步骤级指令执行和轨迹级决策方面的核心能力得到改善。值得注意的是，所有提升均未使用来自目标域的分布内训练数据。仅通过 T2T 流水线从公开视频中提取的轨迹学习，模型便展现出跨应用与跨任务的泛化能力。
translation.brief: 针对GUI智能体训练轨迹数据难以规模化收集的问题，提出T2T自动化流水线，将公开视频教程合成为大规模结构化交互轨迹用于训练。

papers.title: LVRE: A Local Visual Reasoning and Editing Agent for Optical Chemical Structure Recognition
papers.abstract: Optical chemical structure recognition (OCSR) demands strict all-or-nothing graph fidelity, where a single misidentified bond order or formal charge makes the predicted graph differ from the reference structure. While vision-language models (VLMs) can reinspect ambiguous visual regions, unconstrained full-graph regeneration often introduces regressive errors into previously correct substructures. We present LVRE, a training-free visual agent that refines molecular graphs via targeted visual inspection and reversible transactional editing. Rather than regenerating the entire graph sequence, LVRE examines a high-resolution crop alongside the global diagram and local graph neighborhood, proposing modifications to named graph records that a deterministic controller checks. A controller executes each proposed modification as an isolated transaction, and a visual review module arbitrates which edits to commit or roll back. Across four foundation VLMs, LVRE improves graph accuracy by 8.0-8.5 percentage points over single-pass recognition and by 3.0-3.3 points over fixed local review. In a paired evaluation of 1,000 diagrams using Gemini 3.8 Flash, LVRE achieves 100 successful repairs while introducing only 15 regressive errors, in contrast to global reflection which yields 65 repairs against 30 introduced errors. On this paired set, LVRE introduces half as many errors on initially correct predictions as global reflection.

translation.title: LVRE：用于光学化学结构识别的局部视觉推理与编辑智能体
translation.abstract: 光学化学结构识别（OCSR）要求严格的全对或全错图保真度，一旦键级或形式电荷识别错误，预测图就与参考结构不一致。虽然视觉语言模型（VLM）可以复查模糊的视觉区域，但不受约束的全图重新生成常常会给原本正确的子结构引入回归性错误。我们提出LVRE，一种无需训练的视觉智能体，通过有针对性的视觉检查和可逆的事务式编辑来精炼分子图。LVRE不是重新生成整条图序列，而是结合全局示意图和局部图邻域检查高分辨率裁剪区域，对具名的图记录提出修改建议，并由确定性控制器进行校验。控制器将每条修改建议作为隔离事务执行，视觉审查模块仲裁哪些编辑提交、哪些回滚。在四个基础VLM上，LVRE将图准确率较单次识别提升8.0–8.5个百分点，较固定局部审查提升3.0–3.3个百分点。在使用Gemini 3.8 Flash对1,000张图进行的成对评估中，LVRE实现100次成功修复而仅引入15个回归错误，而全局反思只带来65次修复却引入30个错误。在该成对集上，LVRE对初始正确预测引入的错误数量仅为全局反思的一半。
translation.brief: 针对OCSR中全图重生成易破坏已正确子结构的问题，提出无需训练的LVRE，通过目标性视觉检查与可逆事务式局部编辑来精炼分子图。

papers.title: Editable Video Context: Mid-Context KV-Cache Reuse for Context-Managing Video LLMs
papers.abstract: Context Language Models let a model edit its own context, while Suffix Cache Reuse makes edits to text efficient by adjusting the positions of cached keys for surviving tokens. We extend these ideas to video language models with multimodal rotary position embeddings (M-RoPE). We represent a long video as timestamped segments. After viewing a sparsely sampled version, the model selects segments for decoding at 4x the frame rate, and the remaining segments are removed from its context. Our rebuild method reuses the KV cache of surviving segments by rotating their keys with a single offset shared by the temporal, height, and width components of Qwen2.5-VL's M-RoPE. A content-hashed cache also avoids repeating vision-encoder computation for those segments. In preliminary experiments with Qwen2.5-VL-7B on synthetic needle-in-a-video-haystack questions over public-domain films, the method reduces prefill tokens and end-to-end rebuild latency relative to full recomputation while usually producing the same answer. Densifying the segment containing the answer improves accuracy when that segment is known. When the model selects segments itself, accuracy does not improve: it rarely identifies a needle that was absent from the sparse sample. We release the code, raw logs, and scripts used to reproduce the paper's results.

translation.title: 可编辑视频上下文：面向上下文管理视频LLM的上下文中段KV缓存复用
translation.abstract: Context Language Model让模型可以编辑自身上下文，而Suffix Cache Reuse通过调整留存token缓存键的位置使文本编辑高效。我们将这些思想扩展到具有多模态旋转位置编码（M-RoPE）的视频语言模型。我们将长视频表示为带时间戳的片段。在观看稀疏采样版本后，模型选择部分片段以4倍帧率进行解码，其余片段从上下文中移除。我们的重建方法通过用Qwen2.5-VL的M-RoPE中时间、高度和宽度分量共享的单一偏移旋转键，复用留存片段的KV缓存。内容哈希缓存还避免了这些片段重复进行视觉编码器计算。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B于公有领域电影上的合成“视频大海捞针”问题的初步实验中，该方法相对完全重新计算降低了prefill token数和端到端重建延迟，同时通常给出相同答案。当已知答案所在片段时，加密该片段可提升准确率；当模型自行选择片段时准确率不提升：它很少识别出稀疏采样中缺失的“针”。我们发布了复现论文结果的代码、原始日志和脚本。
translation.brief: 针对视频LLM上下文编辑代价高的问题，提出通过M-RoPE单一偏移旋转复用留存片段KV缓存并配合内容哈希缓存的重建方法。

papers.title: Acting by Intent, Reacting by Sight: Visual Conditioned Reflexes for Real-Time VLM Agents
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong capabilities as generalist agents that perceive, reason, and act in interactive environments. Yet real-time environments such as video games demand both deliberate control for exploration and split-second reactions to fast-moving hazards. Existing agents struggle to handle both: relying solely on direct VLM actions is too slow for sudden events, whereas delegating execution to fixed scripts leaves the agent blind at the moment of action, leading to frequent misfires whenever the scene shifts. Humans overcome this by pairing normal conscious control with conditioned reflexes-while the mind handles deliberate actions and shapes reflex rules, the reflex itself still relies on live vision to make the final instant decision. Emulating this mechanism, we propose ViCoR (Visual Conditioned Reflex). Alongside normal gameplay actions, the main VLM defines and updates lightweight situational guidance for recurring events, while a fast visual reflex branch (invoking the VLM in no-thinking mode) inspects live local views with motion cues to make the final sub-second action decisions. By offloading 67.8% of high-frequency reactions to the reflex branch (680 ms per check), ViCoR reduces average per-action decision latency by 2.6x (from 14.0 s to 5.4 s) and cuts token consumption by 36.9%. Across 17 diverse 2D and 3D games in the GameWorld benchmark, ViCoR achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving task success rate by +11.8% (from 52.9% to 64.7%) and average normalized progress by +13.9% (from 66.5% to 80.4%) over the strongest deliberative VLM and script baselines. In fast-paced real-time games, ViCoR refines its reflexes across episodes to boost progress by 1.67x, and even with a low-effort main planner, surpasses high-effort deliberative baselines by +8.1% at one-third of the token cost.

translation.title: 以意图行动，以视觉反应：面向实时VLM智能体的视觉条件反射
translation.abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）已展现出在交互环境中感知、推理和行动的通用智能体能力。然而电子游戏等实时环境既要求用于探索的深思熟虑的控制，也要求对快速移动危险的瞬间反应。现有智能体难以兼顾二者：仅依赖VLM直接行动对突发事件太慢，而将执行委托给固定脚本又使智能体在行动瞬间失去视觉，场景变化时频繁误触发。人类通过将有意识控制与条件反射配对来克服这一问题——大脑负责深思熟虑的行动并塑造反射规则，而反射本身仍依赖实时视觉做出最终瞬间决策。受此机制启发，我们提出ViCoR（Visual Conditioned Reflex）。主VLM在正常游戏行动之外，为反复出现的事件定义并更新轻量的情境性指导，同时一个快速视觉反射分支（以无思考模式调用VLM）结合运动线索检查实时局部视图，做出最终的亚秒级行动决策。通过将67.8%的高频反应卸载给反射分支（每次检查680毫秒），ViCoR将平均单步决策延迟降低2.6倍（从14.0秒降至5.4秒），并减少36.9%的token消耗。在GameWorld基准的17个多样化2D和3D游戏中，ViCoR取得最先进性能，相比最强的深思式VLM和脚本基线，任务成功率提升11.8%（从52.9%到64.7%），平均归一化进度提升13.9%（从66.5%到80.4%）。在快节奏实时游戏中，ViCoR跨回合精炼反射使进度提升1.67倍；即使使用低投入的主规划器，仍以三分之一的token成本超过高投入深思式基线8.1%。
translation.brief: 针对VLM智能体在实时环境中深思缓慢与脚本执行失明的问题，提出ViCoR，由主VLM制定可更新的情境指导，快速视觉反射分支实时做出亚秒级行动决策。

papers.title: Recognizing Events Is Not Enough: Why Streaming VLMs Struggle in Compositional Instruction Triggering
papers.abstract: Recognizing individual events does not guarantee correct execution of compositional instructions in streaming video. For example, given the request "Notify me when the pot boils after someone turns on the stove and leaves the kitchen", existing models may recognize the individual events yet notify too early or miss the intended moment, failing to track how their temporal conditions are satisfied over time. To evaluate this gap, we introduce CoTriggerBench, which composes annotated video events into temporally constrained instructions and verifies notification timing and silence through executable event plans and source-event replay. To address this challenge, we propose a real-time VLM agent, TEMPI. TEMPI decomposes instructions into atomic event queries and temporal constraints, and uses Scenario Memory to continuously maintain task progress as event evidence arrives, allowing earlier observations to support subsequent decisions beyond the detector's visual window. Even when no notification is required, relevant events continue to update the scenario state. On CoTriggerBench, TEMPI achieves 44.4% instruction-level success, outperforming the strongest closed-source and fine-tuned open-source VLM baselines by 15.6 (Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash-Realtime) and 18.1 (MOSS-VL-Realtime) percentage points, respectively. To support efficient on-device streaming inference, we further optimize the streaming inference pipeline by overlapping partial visual encoding and LLM prefix prefill with frame arrival. On an 8 GB RTX 5060, our optimized detector implementation achieves a 4.90$\times$ speedup.

translation.title: 识别事件还不够：流式VLM为何难以应对组合式指令触发
translation.abstract: 识别单个事件并不能保证流式视频中组合式指令的正确执行。例如，对于“在有人打开炉灶并离开厨房后，锅烧开时通知我”的请求，现有模型可能识别出各个事件却过早通知或错过目标时刻，无法跟踪这些时间条件如何随时间被满足。为评估这一差距，我们提出CoTriggerBench，它将标注的视频事件组合成带时间约束的指令，并通过可执行的事件计划和源事件回放来验证通知时机与静默要求。为应对这一挑战，我们提出实时VLM智能体TEMPI。TEMPI将指令分解为原子事件查询和时间约束，并使用Scenario Memory随事件证据的到来持续维护任务进度，使早期观察能支持超出检测器视觉窗口的后续决策。即使不需要通知，相关事件也会继续更新情景状态。在CoTriggerBench上，TEMPI取得44.4%的指令级成功率，分别以15.6个百分点（Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash-Realtime）和18.1个百分点（MOSS-VL-Realtime）领先最强的闭源和微调开源VLM基线。为支持高效的端侧流式推理，我们进一步优化流式推理管线，将部分视觉编码和LLM前缀prefill与帧到达重叠。在一块8 GB的RTX 5060上，优化后的检测器实现实现4.90倍加速。
translation.brief: 针对流式VLM无法正确执行带时间约束的组合指令的问题，提出TEMPI，将指令分解为原子事件查询与时间约束，并用Scenario Memory持续维护跨视觉窗口的任务进度。

papers.title: Video-as-Experience: Learning Computer Use via Audio-Visual Understanding
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (LLMs) have enabled capable computer-use agents that perceive graphical user interfaces, reason over instructions, and execute actions. However, existing approaches to learning from video demonstrations typically convert videos into screenshot-based action trajectories, rather than directly leveraging their rich audio-visual information. We introduce VEX (Video as EXperience), a framework that uses audio-visual understanding to unify learning from external demonstrations and reflecting on an agent's own behavior. Following a watch-act-rewatch paradigm, the agent extracts procedural guidance from tutorial videos containing visual demonstrations and spoken explanations, executes tasks, and verifies its progress by rewatching its execution as video. We instantiate VEX with video-SALMONN-VEX, a 9B-scale audio-visual computer-use agent built on the video-SALMONN 2 architecture with a Qwen3.5-9B backbone. We further introduce Action-Grounded Guide Optimization (AGGO), a reinforcement learning method that optimizes video-derived guidance for downstream action prediction, and augment AgentNet, OSWorld, and CUA-Gym with over 24K real-world tutorial videos. Experiments on OSWorld and a complementary subset of CUA-Gym demonstrate consistent improvements, with video-SALMONN-VEX achieving a 22% relative increase in task success over its Qwen3.5 backbone on OSWorld. Moreover, its generated guidance improves Gemini-3.5-flash by 10% relatively on OSWorld. These results highlight the potential of audio-visual understanding as a unified interface for procedural learning and self-verification in computer-use agents.

translation.title: 视频即经验：通过视听理解学习计算机操作
translation.abstract: 多模态大语言模型（LLM）已催生出能感知图形用户界面、对指令推理并执行操作的能力强大的计算机操作智能体。然而，现有从视频演示学习的方法通常将视频转换为基于截图的动作轨迹，而非直接利用其丰富的视听信息。我们提出VEX（Video as EXperience），一个用视听理解统一从外部演示学习和对智能体自身行为反思的框架。遵循“观看-行动-重看”范式，智能体从包含视觉演示和口头讲解的教程视频中提取程序性指导，执行任务，并通过将自己的执行过程作为视频重看来验证进展。我们以video-SALMONN-VEX实例化VEX，这是一个基于video-SALMONN 2架构、以Qwen3.5-9B为主干的9B规模视听计算机操作智能体。我们进一步提出Action-Grounded Guide Optimization（AGGO），一种为下游动作预测优化视频衍生指导的强化学习方法，并为AgentNet、OSWorld和CUA-Gym扩充了超过24K条真实世界教程视频。在OSWorld和CUA-Gym补充子集上的实验显示一致改进，video-SALMONN-VEX在OSWorld上任务成功率较其Qwen3.5主干相对提升22%。此外，其生成的指导使Gemini-3.5-flash在OSWorld上相对提升10%。这些结果凸显了视听理解作为计算机操作智能体程序性学习与自我验证统一接口的潜力。
translation.brief: 针对现有方法仅将演示视频转为截图动作轨迹而忽略视听信息的问题，提出VEX框架，通过“观看-行动-重看”范式利用视听理解统一程序性指导学习与自我验证。

papers.title: KernelArmor: End-to-End Agentic System for Establishing Memory and Thread Safety for CUDA
papers.abstract: Optimized CUDA kernels can pass testing while retaining subtle memory and concurrency bugs. We present KernelArmor, an agentic framework that combines LLM-generated annotations with an extended SMT verifier to establish memory and thread safety under explicit contracts. KernelArmor can reason about kernels with advanced CUDA features, such as tensor cores, packed accesses, warp synchronization, asynchronous copies, and library calls, returning source-level diagnostics to guide verification and repair. Across 740 instances containing 1,370 production-grade CUDA kernels, it reports potential bugs in 78.6% of instances and establishes safety for 11.4%, outperforming the evaluated state-of-the-art tools in detection coverage, identifying 100% of cuCatch memory-safety bugs and all in-scope cuHadron races. Integrated into an agentic optimization loop, KernelArmor produces verified kernels in all 77 trajectories while retaining 99% of the unconstrained geometric-mean speedup.

translation.title: KernelArmor：面向CUDA内存与线程安全的端到端智能体系统
translation.abstract: 优化后的CUDA内核可能通过测试但仍保留隐蔽的内存和并发缺陷。我们提出KernelArmor，一个结合LLM生成标注与扩展SMT验证器的智能体框架，在显式契约下建立内存与线程安全。KernelArmor能够对使用高级CUDA特性（如tensor cores、打包访问、warp同步、异步拷贝和库调用）的内核进行推理，并返回源码级诊断以指导验证与修复。在包含1,370个生产级CUDA内核的740个实例上，它报告了78.6%实例的潜在缺陷，并对11.4%的实例建立了安全性证明，在检测覆盖率上超越所评估的最先进工具——识别出100%的cuCatch内存安全缺陷和全部在范围内的cuHadron竞态。集成到智能体优化循环中，KernelArmor在全部77条轨迹中产出经验证的内核，同时保留99%的无约束几何平均加速比。
translation.brief: 该论文解决CUDA内核隐蔽内存与并发缺陷难以验证的问题，采用LLM标注结合扩展SMT验证器在显式契约下证明内存与线程安全。

papers.title: Can a Vision-Language Model Tune Clustering In Context?
papers.abstract: Clustering is a widely used unsupervised learning method, but selecting an appropriate algorithm and set of hyperparameters for a specific dataset can require many possible configurations and evaluations. In this work, we investigate whether a Vision-Language Model can instead visually evaluate clustering results and use those decisions to then tune an explicit clustering algorithm. We study this through three progressive experiments using Qwen3.5-27B and five controlled synthetic clustering scenarios. First, we test whether the VLM can distinguish the best clustering result from a pair of plots. Second, we test whether it can assign numerical scores to those plots where a higher score represents a better result. Finally, we use these judgments within an agentic loop in which the VLM scores a k-means clustering and proposes updated hyperparameters that may result in better clustering. Our exploratory results show that the VLM performs well when clear cluster structure is present, while struggling on more ambiguous and noisy settings. In the full agentic experiment, the VLM produces clustering configurations with silhouette scores relatively close to those of grid search and Bayesian optimization, while terminating in much fewer iterations. Overall, these results provide an initial proof of concept that VLM-based visual feedback can be used to autonomously tune an explicit clustering algorithm.

translation.title: 视觉-语言模型能否在上下文中调整聚类？
translation.abstract: 聚类是广泛使用的无监督学习方法，但为特定数据集选择合适的算法和超参数可能需要大量配置与评估。本工作探究视觉-语言模型能否通过视觉评估聚类结果，并据此调整显式聚类算法。我们使用Qwen3.5-27B和五个受控合成聚类场景，通过三个递进实验进行研究：首先测试VLM能否从一对图中分辨出最佳聚类结果；其次测试它能否为这些图赋予数值分数（分数越高结果越好）；最后将这些判断用于一个智能体循环，VLM对k-means聚类打分并提出可能改善聚类的更新超参数。探索性结果显示，当存在清晰聚类结构时VLM表现良好，而在更模糊和含噪的设置中表现挣扎。在完整的智能体实验中，VLM生成的聚类配置其silhouette分数与网格搜索和贝叶斯优化相当接近，且迭代次数远少于后者。总体而言，这些结果提供了基于VLM视觉反馈可自主调整显式聚类算法的初步概念验证。
translation.brief: 该论文解决聚类算法与超参数选择繁琐的问题，采用VLM视觉评估聚类结果并在智能体循环中迭代调整超参数。

papers.title: Same Evidence, Different Verdicts: Delivery of CT Images and DICOM Metadata Changes VLM Quality-Control Decisions
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are being proposed as automated checks on clinical imaging inputs, where a scan and its DICOM metadata can disagree; a truncated CT series wrongly admitted to volumetric follow-up, such as lung-nodule growth assessment in screening, biases the measurement. A natural safeguard is to let the model judge the image before it sees the metadata. We find this backfires. On 60 NLST chest CT pairs with coverage defects whose ground truth is computed from scan geometry, a false header that Claude Haiku 5.5 resisted when shown with the image (2% of its detections overruled) overturned 91% of them when it arrived after the model's answer (Nemotron-3.5-VL 43% to 100%). With the order reversed, the image overturned 98-100% of the header's errors (Claude models): whichever source came second won. This is not generic sycophancy: a neutral "please confirm" reversed 0 of 1,072 correct refusals, and the effect persisted when the header arrived as a tool result, as in agentic pipelines. One warning sentence cut sequential reversal to at most 9%, and the pattern held on 24 real mismatched pairs. Contributions: (i) evidence that VLM input-check decisions on identical evidence depend on delivery; (ii) a testbed with exact geometric ground truth; (iii) a validation protocol for clinical VLM input checks. Code, prompts and all call logs: this https URL

translation.title: 相同证据，不同裁决：CT图像与DICOM元数据的送达顺序改变VLM质量控制决策
translation.abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）被提议作为临床影像输入的自动检查手段，此时扫描图像与其DICOM元数据可能相互矛盾；被错误接纳进体积随访（如筛查中的肺结节增长评估）的截断CT序列会使测量产生偏差。一种自然的防护手段是让模型在看到元数据之前先判断图像，但我们发现这适得其反。在60对来自NLST的、具有覆盖缺陷且以扫描几何计算真值的胸部CT上，Claude Haiku 5.5在与图像同时呈现时能抵抗虚假头信息（仅2%的检测被推翻），而当元数据在模型给出答案之后送达时，91%的检测被推翻（Nemotron-3.5-VL从43%升至100%）。若顺序反转，图像能推翻98-100%的头信息错误（Claude模型）：无论哪种来源后到，它都会获胜。这并非普遍的谄媚性：一句中性的"请确认"未能推翻1,072个正确拒绝中的任何一个，且当头信息以工具结果形式到达时（如智能体流水线中）该效应依然存在。一句警告语句将顺序性推翻降至最多9%，该模式在24对真实不匹配样本上也成立。贡献：（i）证明VLM在相同证据上的输入检查决策取决于证据送达方式；（ii）提供具有精确几何真值的测试床；（iii）提出临床VLM输入检查的验证协议。代码、提示词及全部调用日志见：this https URL
translation.brief: 该论文解决VLM对医学影像输入检查决策受图像与元数据送达顺序影响的问题，通过受控实验揭示后到证据占据主导的顺序效应并提出缓解与验证协议。

papers.title: LEDGER: LLM-Evidence-Driven Graph-Encoded Clustering-Friendly Representations for Short Texts
papers.abstract: Short-text clustering is important for analyzing user-generated content in social networks and online services, supporting applications such as topic discovery and user intent analysis. However, the desired grouping depends on an application-specific clustering criterion that general-purpose text embeddings may not capture. Large language models (LLMs) can apply such a criterion to a pair of texts without human annotation, and existing methods use their responses as generated descriptions, binary decisions or selected neighbours. These discrete outputs discard how strongly the LLM supports a pair and how many judgments stand behind it. Each judgment is also used alone or within the neighbourhood of a single text, so the relations that link judgments across the corpus remain unused. In this paper, we propose LEDGER, an LLM-guided graph representation learning framework for short-text clustering. LEDGER aggregates the repeated numerical scores of each text pair into an accumulated score and an observation count, which define an evidence target for every queried pair. The pairs whose scores reach a threshold form a relation graph, over which a graph encoder propagates text features with a propagation range learned jointly with the encoder. A pairwise predictor trained to match the evidence targets shapes the learned representation, and a distilled student encoder extends it to unqueried texts without further LLM requests. Extensive experiments on seven datasets with four frozen text embeddings show that LEDGER achieves the highest mean clustering accuracy and NMI against five comparison methods, and ablations show that the graph, the learned propagation range and the evidence target each improve performance.

translation.title: LEDGER：LLM证据驱动的图编码聚类友好短文本表示
translation.abstract: 短文本聚类对分析社交网络和在线服务中的用户生成内容至关重要，可支持主题发现和用户意图分析等应用。然而，期望的分组取决于应用特定的聚类准则，通用文本嵌入可能无法捕捉。大语言模型（LLM）可在无需人工标注的情况下对文本对应用此类准则，现有方法将其响应用作生成的描述、二值判断或选定的邻居。这些离散输出丢弃了LLM支持一个文本对的强度以及支持该判断的证据数量。此外，每条判断要么被单独使用，要么仅在单个文本的邻域内使用，跨越语料库连接各判断的关系未被利用。本文提出LEDGER，一个LLM引导的面向短文本聚类的图表示学习框架。LEDGER将每个文本对的重复数值分数聚合为累积分数与观测计数，为每个查询对定义证据目标。分数达到阈值的文本对构成关系图，图编码器在其上传播文本特征，传播范围与编码器联合学习。训练以匹配证据目标的成对预测器塑造所学表示，蒸馏出的学生编码器将其扩展至未查询文本而无需进一步LLM请求。在七个数据集、四种冻结文本嵌入上的大量实验表明，LEDGER相对五个对比方法取得最高的平均聚类准确率和NMI，消融实验显示图、可学习传播范围和证据目标各自均能提升性能。
translation.brief: 该论文解决应用特定聚类准则下短文本聚类表示学习的问题，方法是将LLM成对判断聚合为证据目标并构建关系图，用图编码器与蒸馏学生编码器学习聚类友好表示。

papers.title: LEAP-LLM: Preserving lead-time structure for question-conditioned ECG interpretation
papers.abstract: The electrocardiogram (ECG) records cardiac electrical activity across multiple leads and is used for detecting cardiac abnormalities. Recent ECG-language models enable large language models (LLMs) to interpret cardiac signals and answer clinically relevant questions. However, existing ECG-language models typically encode the ECG independently of the clinical question, forcing the ECG representation to retain broad and potentially irrelevant signal information. Moreover, these models often aggregate information across leads which can obscure lead-specific details needed for a particular question. To tackle these limitations, we introduce LEAP-LLM, an ECG-LLM architecture for Lead-aware ECG Alignment with Prompt conditioning. LEAP-LLM uses the clinical question to guide ECG feature extraction while preserving explicit lead and temporal structure. Task-trained instruction representations distill information from the question and guide two complementary branches. The Lead branch captures question-relevant temporal patterns within each ECG lead, while the Temporal branch summarizes relevant information across leads at each temporal position. Together, they provide the LLM with compact, question-relevant ECG information while preserving lead and temporal structure. LEAP-LLM reduces modality-token count by 89.0% and prefill FLOPs by 7.2x on average relative to other ECG-LLMs baselines. Across four ECG benchmarks, LEAP-LLM achieves better performance, including a 3.4-percentage-point improvement in G12EC over the strongest prior ECG-specific method. We further show that the model adaptively emphasizes the clinically relevant anatomical lead groups for different cardiac abnormalities, with lead importance patterns consistent with established diagnostic knowledge, providing interpretable evidence that the predictions are supported by clinically meaningful ECG structure.

translation.title: LEAP-LLM：面向问题条件化ECG解读的导联时序结构保留
translation.abstract: 心电图（ECG）跨多个导联记录心脏电活动，用于检测心脏异常。近期的ECG-语言模型使大语言模型（LLM）能够解读心电信号并回答临床相关问题。然而，现有ECG-语言模型通常在独立于临床问题的情况下编码ECG，迫使ECG表示保留宽泛且可能无关的信号信息。此外，这些模型常聚合跨导联的信息，可能掩盖特定问题所需的导联特异性细节。为解决这些局限，我们提出LEAP-LLM，一种导联感知ECG对齐结合提示条件化的ECG-LLM架构。LEAP-LLM利用临床问题引导ECG特征提取，同时保留显式的导联与时间结构。经任务训练的指令表示从问题中提炼信息并引导两个互补分支：导联分支捕捉每个ECG导联内与问题相关的时间模式，时间分支在每个时间位置汇总跨导联的相关信息。二者共同为LLM提供紧凑且与问题相关的ECG信息，同时保留导联和时间结构。与其他ECG-LLM基线相比，LEAP-LLM将模态token数量减少89.0%，平均将prefill FLOPs降低7.2倍。在四个ECG基准上，LEAP-LLM取得更优性能，包括在G12EC上较最强ECG专用先验方法提升3.4个百分点。我们进一步展示，模型能针对不同心脏异常自适应地强调临床上相关的解剖导联组，其导联重要性模式与既有诊断知识一致，为预测由有临床意义的ECG结构支持提供了可解释证据。
translation.brief: 该论文解决ECG-语言模型编码与问题无关且跨导联聚合丢失导联细节的问题，采用问题条件化引导的双分支（导联+时间）结构实现导联感知的ECG-LLM对齐。

papers.title: What to Practice Next? Latent Profile-Guided Task Selection for Skill-Evolving LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Task selection shapes the experiences available for skill evolution in LLM agents, yet fixed practice schedules overlook differences in skill requirements and evolving task value. Most existing methods, however, rely on fixed schedules or scalar measures of progress, leaving nonstationary skill demands unaddressed. We propose SPG-Select, a framework for allocating limited practice budget using a multidimensional profile inferred from binary outcomes via MIRT. The framework predicts surrogate progress, defined as the difference between consecutive profile estimates, and prioritizes progress in dimensions with larger estimated proficiency gaps. Our SPG-Select-R policy combines these predictions with uncertainty-based exploration and periodic restarting to accommodate nonstationarity. We evaluate SPG-Select on ALFWorld and WebShop with three skill-evolution backends. In the reported runs, SPG-Select-R achieves higher mean held-out terminal success than uniform sampling in all six backend-benchmark combinations, with gains of 1.49-13.18 percentage points on ALFWorld and 0.93-3.13 points on WebShop. Under a predictable linear surrogate model and boundedness assumptions, we establish a high-probability dynamic pseudo-regret bound for surrogate task allocation in terms of parameter path variation.

translation.title: 下一步练什么？面向技能演化型 LLM Agent 的潜在画像引导任务选择
translation.abstract: 任务选择决定了 LLM Agent 技能演化可获得的训练经验，但固定的练习计划忽视了技能需求的差异和任务价值的动态变化。然而，大多数现有方法依赖固定计划或标量化的进度度量，未能处理非平稳的技能需求。我们提出 SPG-Select，一个利用通过 MIRT 从二值结果推断的多维画像来分配有限练习预算的框架。该框架预测代理进度（surrogate progress，定义为相邻两次画像估计之差），并优先提升估计熟练度差距更大的维度。我们的 SPG-Select-R 策略将这些预测与基于不确定性的探索和周期性重启相结合，以适应非平稳性。我们在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上使用三种技能演化后端评估 SPG-Select。在所报告的运行中，SPG-Select-R 在全部六种后端-基准组合中的平均留存终端成功率均高于均匀采样，在 ALFWorld 上提升 1.49-13.18 个百分点，在 WebShop 上提升 0.93-3.13 个百分点。在可预测的线性代理模型和有界性假设下，我们以参数路径变化为变量，为代理任务分配建立了高概率动态伪遗憾界。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM Agent 技能演化中非平稳的任务选择问题，提出利用 MIRT 多维画像预测代理进度并结合不确定性探索与重启来分配练习预算的 SPG-Select 框架。

papers.title: Mapping the Afterlife of Future Work Statements in NLP Research
papers.abstract: Future work statements are one of the few places in scientific papers where authors explicitly describe what they think should happen next. We study what happens to such statements after publication. We construct a dataset of 72,070 future work items extracted from 23,113 ACL Anthology papers published between 1979 and 2025, categorize them by type, retrieve candidate follow-up papers through citation-based and content-based search, and use LLM-based judgments to assess whether later papers pursue the proposed directions. Using this resource, we analyze patterns across time, venues, categories, themes, and authors. We find that many items are later addressed, often within a few years, with clear differences across types and themes and a largely community-driven pattern. Our results suggest that future work statements provide useful evidence for studying how research directions develop in NLP. To support further research, we release our dataset at: this https URL.

translation.title: NLP 研究中未来工作陈述的后续命运图谱
translation.abstract: 未来工作陈述是科学论文中少数由作者明确描述他们认为下一步应该做什么的地方。我们研究这类陈述在发表后的命运。我们构建了一个包含从 1979 年至 2025 年间发表的 23,113 篇 ACL Anthology 论文中提取的 72,070 条未来工作条目的数据集，按类型对其进行分类，通过基于引用和基于内容的检索获取候选后续论文，并使用基于 LLM 的判断来评估后续论文是否追求了所提出的方向。利用这一资源，我们分析了跨时间、会议、类别、主题和作者的模式。我们发现许多条目在随后几年内被解决，不同类型和主题之间存在明显差异，且在很大程度上呈现社区驱动的模式。我们的结果表明，未来工作陈述为研究 NLP 研究方向如何发展提供了有用的证据。为支持进一步研究，我们在如下网址发布数据集：this https URL。
translation.brief: 针对未来工作陈述是否被后续研究跟进的问题，构建大规模 ACL 数据集并通过引用/内容检索与 LLM 判断来追踪分析其被实现的情况。

papers.title: KUDEX: A Zero-Shot Decompositional Framework for Logical Analysis in Natural Language
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at generating fluent text, they often struggle with multi-step logical reasoning with inferential connections among statements. We introduce KUDEX (Knowledge-Upward-Downward Reasoning Extension), a novel zero-shot, decompositional framework for analyzing and verifying logical relationships in natural language. Unlike traditional approaches that rely on surface-level entailment checks, KUDEX leverages LLMs to decompose reasoning into atomic primitives and constructs transparent reasoning graphs that serve both as execution traces and audit logs. Our framework includes a general prompt adaptation pipeline that adapts to diverse reasoning tasks without additional fine-tuning or domain-specific pipelines. Through comprehensive experiments on benchmarks across four domains, we demonstrate that KUDEX provides superior performance compared to existing methods, offering a more granular and robust framework for assessing logical relationships between statements.

translation.title: KUDEX：面向自然语言逻辑分析的零样本分解框架
translation.abstract: 虽然大语言模型（LLM）擅长生成流畅文本，但在涉及语句间推理连接的多步逻辑推理上常常表现不佳。我们提出 KUDEX（Knowledge-Upward-Downward Reasoning Extension），一种新颖的零样本分解式框架，用于分析和验证自然语言中的逻辑关系。与依赖表层蕴含检查的传统方法不同，KUDEX 利用 LLM 将推理分解为原子基元，并构建既作为执行轨迹又作为审计日志的透明推理图。该框架包含一个通用提示适配流水线，无需额外微调或领域专用流水线即可适配多种推理任务。通过在四个领域基准上的全面实验，我们证明 KUDEX 相比现有方法具有更优性能，为评估语句间逻辑关系提供了更细粒度、更鲁棒的框架。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 多步逻辑推理不可靠的问题，提出 KUDEX 零样本分解框架，将推理拆解为原子基元并构建透明的推理图来验证逻辑关系。

papers.title: Exstill: The Most Efficient Single-Chip Processor for the Next Token
papers.abstract: Generating a token with a language model requires a fixed amount of arithmetic, whose energy sets a floor beneath any hardware. For Qwen3-1.7B at a 16K-token context, gate-level measurements at 5 nm place this floor at 0.89 mJ per token, yet an NVIDIA B300 spends 391-1,120x that. The excess is the price of generality, software layers, programmable hardware and moving weights and key-value (KV) caches from external memory, and it widens with each process generation. We present a co-design approach that brings token generation close to this floor and then lowers the floor itself, optimizing silicon and model together in a gate-level search loop. Fixing one model architecture in the datapath, with weights still loadable, and holding weights and every conversation's KV cache on-die, a pre-silicon 5 nm design brings an unchanged Qwen3-1.7B token to 3.4x its floor. Co-designing the model with the circuits at fixed quality lowers the floor to 0.29 mJ and the token to 0.52 mJ, 1.8x the new floor and less than the baseline model's arithmetic alone, while on-die capacity grows from one user to twelve. Against a measured B300 serving the same twelve users, the design decodes each user's tokens 110x faster at 690x lower energy. To show that one fixed architecture can serve, as a co-processor, the latency-critical workloads around a frontier model, we introduce Polyglot-DC (1.7B and 4B, each with its own design), specialized for each job by distillation and task-specific training into its own weights. As a drafter it speeds single-user speculative decoding of large open models by up to 6.6x at the maximum reasoning effort. Its guard returns multilingual verdicts in a millisecond or less, within a point of the strongest open guard. Its agent and financial-reasoning models lead comparable open models on established benchmarks, with a reasoning turn falling from seconds to tens of milliseconds.

translation.title: Exstill：面向下一个 Token 的最高效单芯片处理器
translation.abstract: 用语言模型生成一个 token 需要固定的算术运算量，其能耗为任何硬件设定了下限。对于 16K-token 上下文下的 Qwen3-1.7B，5 nm 工艺的门级测量将该下限定为每 token 0.89 mJ，而 NVIDIA B300 却消耗其 391-1,120 倍。超出部分是通用性的代价：软件层、可编程硬件，以及从外部存储搬运权重和键值（KV）缓存，且这一差距随每代工艺不断拉大。我们提出一种协同设计方法，使 token 生成接近这一下限，进而降低下限本身，在门级搜索循环中同时优化芯片与模型。将一个模型架构固定在数据通路中（权重仍可加载），并将权重和每个会话的 KV 缓存保存在片上，一项流片前的 5 nm 设计将未改动的 Qwen3-1.7B 单 token 能耗降至其下限的 3.4 倍。在固定质量下将模型与电路协同设计，将下限降至 0.29 mJ，单 token 降至 0.52 mJ，即新下限的 1.8 倍，低于基线模型仅算术运算的能耗，同时片上容量从支持一个用户增长到十二个。与实测 B300 服务相同十二个用户相比，该设计解码每个用户 token 的速度快 110 倍，能耗低 690 倍。为证明单一固定架构可作为协处理器服务于前沿模型周边的时延敏感工作负载，我们引入 Polyglot-DC（1.7B 和 4B，各有其专属设计），通过蒸馏和任务特定训练为每种任务定制其自身权重。作为 drafter，它在最大推理强度下将大型开源模型单用户投机解码加速高达 6.6 倍。其 guard 模型可在毫秒或更短时间内返回多语言判定，与最强开源 guard 差距在 1 个百分点之内。其 agent 和金融推理模型在既有基准上领先可比开源模型，单轮推理时延从秒级降至数十毫秒。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 推理硬件能耗远超算术下限的问题，采用芯片-模型门级协同设计与片上权重/KV 缓存的专用单芯片方案，大幅降低每 token 能耗并加速解码。

papers.title: Label-Free Detection of Structural Bias in LLM-Based Recommender Systems via Randomized Paraphrasing: The Case of Verbosity
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as recommenders in e-commerce and conversational shopping systems, where they select a product from a set of retrieved candidates described in natural language. Their decisions should depend on relevance to the user query, but may also be influenced by surface-level properties of the descriptions, such as their length. Detecting such structural biases is difficult because relevance labels are rarely available. We propose a label-free framework to audit LLM-based recommender systems for structural bias. Candidate descriptions are rewritten by randomly assigned paraphrasing models and presented in random order. We prove that, if the recommender's choice is invariant to these rewritings, every paraphraser is selected with equal probability, yielding a statistical test that requires no relevance labels. A four-step statistical pipeline tests this property and quantifies the contribution of each description feature while controlling for query-product relevance. We apply the framework to verbosity bias on 20{,}000 product queries and nine recommender LLMs from five model families. After controlling for the measured relevance signals, description length has a positive effect on selection in all nine models, increasing the odds of selection by up to 38% per standard deviation of length. Relevance remains the primary driver of recommendations, while verbosity acts as a consistent secondary signal whose strength depends on the model family. Since the framework needs only black-box access and no annotations, it can be run as a routine audit of deployed shopping assistants, and we provide an auditing protocol with cost and sample-size guidance.

translation.title: 基于随机改写的 LLM 推荐系统结构性偏差无标签检测：以冗长偏差为例
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署为电商和对话式购物系统中的推荐器，从以自然语言描述的一组检索候选中挑选产品。其决策应取决于与用户查询的相关性，但也可能受描述的表面属性（如长度）影响。检测这类结构性偏差很困难，因为相关性标签通常不可得。我们提出一个无标签框架来审计基于 LLM 的推荐系统的结构性偏差。候选描述由随机分配的改写模型重写并以随机顺序呈现。我们证明，如果推荐器的选择对这些重写保持不变，则每个改写器被选中的概率相等，由此得到一个无需相关性标签的统计检验。一个四步统计流水线检验该性质，并在控制查询-产品相关性的同时量化每个描述特征的贡献。我们在 20,000 条产品查询和来自五个模型家族的九个推荐 LLM 上应用该框架检测冗长偏差。在控制测得的相关性信号后，描述长度在全部九个模型中都对选择有正向影响，长度每增加一个标准差最高使被选几率提升 38%。相关性仍是推荐的主要驱动因素，而冗长则是一致的次要信号，其强度取决于模型家族。由于该框架只需黑盒访问且无需标注，可作为已部署购物助手的常规审计运行，我们还提供了包含成本和样本量指南的审计协议。
translation.brief: 针对无标签条件下检测 LLM 推荐系统结构性偏差的问题，提出通过随机改写与随机排序构建统计检验的无标签审计框架，并应用于冗长偏差检测。

papers.title: SPLICE: Structured Prompt Local Iterative Combinatorial Evolution
papers.abstract: Natural language optimization (NLO) improves an agent by having a model critique and rewrite its natural language policy parameters: system prompts, tool instructions, reasoning directives, few-shot demonstrations. These artifacts are multi-section documents in which some sections encode contracts (safety clauses, tool schemas, output formats) that must not drift, while others are legitimate optimization targets. Most iterative NLO methods treat the artifact as a single editable string, producing three recurrent failure modes: unsafe global rewrites, beam collapse onto a single lineage, and unchecked bloat, none addressed by formal guarantees. We introduce SPLICE, a unified NLO framework that poses optimization as constrained combinatorial search over an edit graph of block-structured, selectively-mutable states. We map each failure mode to a matched guarantee: (i) per-block mutability preserves contract text verbatim, with a price-of-freezing bound; (ii) elitist beam search with diversity slots never lets the leader regress on validation, bounds regression under noisy re-evaluation by an exponential tail, and keeps a competitive candidate from a different parent whenever one exists; (iii) a ratio length regularizer comes with an explicit accuracy-length bias bound. Candidates are proposed from dual section-local textual gradients; under a proposer-competence condition whose proxy we measure, edit-graph reachability and a convergence rate bound how quickly improving children arrive. Across seven public benchmarks under five reproduced protocols, SPLICE wins on four and matches the strongest prior method on three. On a production-style contract stress test it keeps the contract clauses that unconstrained optimizers trade away to raise the proxy metric, and ablations attribute gains to critique and elitist search.

translation.title: SPLICE：结构化提示局部迭代组合演化
translation.abstract: 自然语言优化（NLO）通过让模型批评并重写智能体的自然语言策略参数（系统提示、工具说明、推理指令、少样本示例）来提升其能力。这些产物是多段落文档，其中某些段落承载着不可漂移的契约（安全条款、工具模式、输出格式），而另一些则是合理的优化目标。大多数迭代式 NLO 方法将产物视为单一可编辑字符串，产生三种反复出现的失败模式：不安全的全局重写、束搜索坍缩到单一谱系、以及失控的膨胀，这些都没有形式化保证来应对。我们提出 SPLICE，一个统一的 NLO 框架，将优化表述为在块结构、选择性可变状态的编辑图上进行的约束组合搜索。我们将每种失败模式映射到匹配的保证：(i) 逐块可变性逐字保留契约文本，并给出冻结代价上界；(ii) 带多样性槽位的精英束搜索确保领先者在验证集上从不退化，在噪声重评估下以指数尾界约束回归，并且只要存在就保留来自不同父代的竞争性候选；(iii) 比例长度正则化器伴随显式的精度-长度偏差界。候选由双段局部文本梯度提议；在可度量的提议者能力条件下，编辑图可达性和收敛率约束了改进子代到来的速度。在五种复现协议下的七个公开基准上，SPLICE 在四个上胜出，在三个上与最强先前方法持平。在生产风格的契约压力测试中，它保留了无约束优化器为提升代理指标而牺牲的契约条款，消融实验将增益归因于批评和精英搜索。
translation.brief: 解决自然语言提示优化中契约条款漂移、束坍缩与失控膨胀三类失败模式，核心方法是将优化建模为块结构编辑图上的约束组合搜索，并配合精英束搜索与长度正则化等配套保证。

papers.title: We Have All the Cards: Securing Agent Cards at the Operational Trust Boundary of the Agent2Agent Protocol
papers.abstract: AI agent interoperability protocols enable orchestrators to discover and invoke external agents using machine-readable metadata. In the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, Agent Cards contain attacker-controllable natural-language fields that may influence agent selection before a provider is invoked, creating a pre-invocation trust problem. We characterize this discovery-time attack surface through a taxonomy of ten Agent Card manipulation attacks and present SECCARD, a layered validation framework combining protocol checks, deterministic analysis, and LLM-based semantic reasoning. We measure the emerging public A2A ecosystem by probing 36.1 million Internet domains and collecting 310 deployed Agent Cards. Two annotators independently label the corpus with 96.8% agreement. We then construct a 660-card real-card perturbation benchmark with matched benign controls and a 260-card synthetic adversarial benchmark spanning all ten attack categories. On controlled attacks injected into real Agent Cards, the strongest semantic judge achieves 97.0% security recall at a 1.7% false-positive rate. Across nine LLM judges on the synthetic benchmark, security recall ranges from 25.8% to 92.3%, demonstrating substantial model-dependent variation. These results show that SECCARD effectively identifies Agent Card manipulations spanning all ten discovery-time attack classes while preserving benign Agent Cards, but also reveal that its effectiveness depends critically on the choice of the underlying LLM judge.

translation.title: 我们掌握所有牌：在 Agent2Agent 协议的运营信任边界上保护 Agent Card
translation.abstract: AI 智能体互操作协议使编排器能够使用机器可读元数据发现并调用外部智能体。在 Agent2Agent（A2A）协议中，Agent Card 包含攻击者可控的自然语言字段，可能在提供方被调用之前影响智能体选择，形成调用前信任问题。我们通过十类 Agent Card 操纵攻击的分类法刻画了这一发现期攻击面，并提出 SECCARD，一个结合协议检查、确定性分析和基于 LLM 的语义推理的分层验证框架。我们通过探测 3610 万个互联网域名并收集 310 个已部署的 Agent Card 来测量新兴的公共 A2A 生态系统。两名标注者独立标注该语料，一致性为 96.8%。随后我们构建了包含 660 张真实卡片及匹配良性对照的扰动基准，以及覆盖全部十类攻击的 260 张卡片合成对抗基准。在注入真实 Agent Card 的受控攻击上，最强的语义裁判在 1.7% 假阳性率下达到 97.0% 的安全召回率。在合成基准上的九个 LLM 裁判中，安全召回率在 25.8% 到 92.3% 之间，显示出显著的模型依赖差异。这些结果表明 SECCARD 能有效识别覆盖全部十类发现期攻击的 Agent Card 操纵，同时保留良性 Agent Card，但也揭示其有效性关键取决于底层 LLM 裁判的选择。
translation.brief: 解决 A2A 协议中 Agent Card 自然语言字段在发现期可被操纵的问题，核心方法是提出 SECCARD 分层验证框架，结合协议检查、确定性分析和 LLM 语义推理来检测攻击。

papers.title: Benchmark Factory: Agentic Benchmark Creation via Dataset Curation and Label-Free Quality Anchors
papers.abstract: Teams deploying coding agents need benchmarks built from their own code, but curating and validating them by hand is resource intensive, and an unvalidated benchmark can mislead silently. We present Benchmark Factory, an autonomous meta-agent loop with human checkpoints: an LLM agent writes sourcing queries over landed production code changes, runs models of known relative strength on each candidate, diagnoses why a candidate fails, and repairs it by editing its queries, prompts, and configuration until it clears quality anchors that need no per-task human labels. We used Benchmark Factory to build benchmarks for five developer cohorts at our organization. Engineering raters scored a 5% sample 2.3 for task quality and 2.6 for grader verdicts on a 1-to-3 scale. On configurations never used to build them, the benchmarks ranked Claude Opus~4.7 at high reasoning effort above low effort (60.6% vs. 54.4% of tasks passed, $p=0.002$) and GPT-5.5 above GPT-5.4 (65.8% vs. 60.5%, $p=0.004$); 9 of the 10 per-cohort comparisons pointed the same way. A deliberately trivial benchmark failed the anchors; five broken graders failed them, even under a relaxed rule fixed in advance that the real grader passes; and with model labels shuffled so that no true ordering existed, random redraws of a candidate passed in at most 1.4% of simulations. The anchors are necessary, not sufficient, conditions for a valid benchmark, designed to focus human review on what the loop cannot repair.

translation.title: Benchmark Factory：通过数据集策展与免标注质量锚点进行智能体基准创建
translation.abstract: 部署编码智能体的团队需要从自己的代码构建基准，但人工策展与验证非常耗费资源，而未经验证的基准可能造成无声的误导。我们提出 Benchmark Factory，一个带人工检查点的自主元智能体循环：LLM 智能体针对落地的生产代码变更编写数据采集查询，在每个候选上运行相对强弱已知的模型，诊断候选失败的原因，并通过编辑其查询、提示和配置进行修复，直到通过无需逐任务人工标注的质量锚点。我们使用 Benchmark Factory 为本组织的五个开发者群体构建基准。工程评分者对 5% 抽样的任务质量评分为 2.3，评分器判定为 2.6（1 到 3 分制）。在从未用于构建基准的配置上，这些基准将高推理努力的 Claude Opus 4.7 排在低努力之上（60.6% 对 54.4% 的任务通过率，p=0.002），GPT-5.5 高于 GPT-5.4（65.8% 对 60.5%，p=0.004）；10 项分群体比较中有 9 项方向一致。一个刻意简陋的基准未通过锚点；五个损坏的评分器未通过锚点，即使在预先设定的宽松规则下真实评分器可以通过；当模型标签被打乱以致不存在真实排序时，随机重抽的候选在模拟中至多 1.4% 通过。这些锚点是有效基准的必要而非充分条件，旨在将人工审查聚焦于循环无法修复之处。
translation.brief: 解决为编码智能体从自有代码构建高质量基准时人工策展成本高的问题，核心方法是带人工检查点的自主元智能体循环，通过免标注质量锚点自动诊断并修复基准候选。

papers.title: Revisiting Re-executability: Coverage-Guided Symbolic Feedback to Improve Decompilation
papers.abstract: When source code is unavailable, decompilation provides a source-level representation of a binary. However, code recovered by conventional or LLM-assisted decompilation may not preserve the original behavior of the binary. Recent approaches evaluate re-executability using fixed test suites, but passing these suites does not ensure behavioral preservation. We present SymDec, an LLM-assisted decompiled-code repair system that uses the original binary as a behavioral reference.
