SymDec uses coverage-guided symbolic execution to explore the I/O-level behavior of the original and recompiled binaries, and symbolic comparison to identify inputs that expose behavioral differences. These inputs are replayed on both binaries to confirm the differences, which are returned as structured feedback to guide subsequent LLM revisions. We evaluate SymDec on 120 functions from ExeBench and DecompileBench, compiled for x86-64 and ARM64 at optimization levels O0-O3, yielding 960 binary decompilation tasks. More than half of the tasks yield candidates that pass the supplied test suite and complete symbolic comparison without detected behavioral differences. Among candidates that pass all supplied tests, symbolic comparison exposes replay-confirmed behavioral differences in 4.5% of cases, showing that test-suite re-executability can miss behavioral discrepancies. Under the same input-generation budget, symbolic execution achieves higher mean line and branch coverage than black-box fuzzing. Symbolic feedback also improves the conventional metric, increasing the mean single-step test-pass rate from 90.1% to 93.3%. These results show that symbolic comparison provides stronger evidence of behavioral consistency than test-suite re-executability alone and supplies effective feedback for repairing decompiled code.

translation.title: 重新审视可再执行性：覆盖引导的符号反馈改进反编译
translation.abstract: 当源代码不可得时，反编译提供二进制的源码级表示。然而，由传统或 LLM 辅助反编译恢复的代码可能不保留二进制的原始行为。近期方法使用固定测试套件评估可再执行性，但通过这些套件并不能确保行为保持。我们提出 SymDec，一个以原始二进制作为行为参照的 LLM 辅助反编译代码修复系统。SymDec 使用覆盖引导的符号执行探索原始二进制与重编译二进制的 I/O 级行为，并用符号比较找出暴露行为差异的输入。这些输入在两个二进制上重放以确认差异，并作为结构化反馈返回以指导后续的 LLM 修订。我们在 ExeBench 和 DecompileBench 的 120 个函数上评估 SymDec，针对 x86-64 和 ARM64 以 O0-O3 优化级别编译，产生 960 个二进制反编译任务。超过半数的任务产出的候选通过提供的测试套件并完成符号比较且未检出行为差异。在通过所有提供测试的候选中，符号比较在 4.5% 的案例中暴露出经重放确认的行为差异，表明测试套件可再执行性可能遗漏行为不一致。在相同输入生成预算下，符号执行比黑盒模糊测试取得更高的平均行覆盖率和分支覆盖率。符号反馈还提升了传统指标，将平均单步测试通过率从 90.1% 提高到 93.3%。这些结果表明符号比较提供了比仅靠测试套件可再执行性更强的行为一致性证据，并为修复反编译代码提供了有效反馈。
translation.brief: 解决反编译代码通过固定测试套件仍可能偏离原二进制行为的问题，核心方法是以原始二进制为参照，用覆盖引导的符号执行与符号比较发现行为差异并将其作为结构化反馈指导 LLM 修复。

papers.title: Ask Precisely, Assume Wisely: Interactive Evaluation of Ambiguity Resolution in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Ambiguity is a core challenge in human--AI interaction, where models must decide when to make assumptions and when to seek clarification. Existing approaches to ambiguity evaluation largely focus on coverage over multiple interpretations using static metrics, offering limited insight into how efficiently a model converges toward a single user-intended interpretation through interaction. We introduce a preference-grounded simulated user framework for controlled, multi-turn evaluation of ambiguity resolution, grounding simulator responses strictly in user disambiguation preferences to avoid hallucination and over-disclosure. Alongside this, we define three observable dissatisfaction signals --- incorrect assumptions, repeating clarifications, and irrelevant clarifications --- that characterize interaction quality beyond task accuracy. Our analysis reveals a clear trade-off: models that frequently seek clarification tend to over-clarify and prolong interactions, while assumption-driven models are more prone to misaligning with user intent. We demonstrate that system prompts optimized on these dissatisfaction signals achieve a Pareto-optimal balance across all three metrics, reducing overall error rates by up to 7.65%, underscoring the value of our framework in designing agents that ask precisely and assume wisely.

translation.title: 精确提问，明智假设：大语言模型歧义消解的交互式评估
translation.abstract: 歧义是人机交互中的核心挑战，模型必须决定何时做出假设、何时寻求澄清。现有的歧义评估方法大多聚焦于使用静态指标覆盖多种解释，对于模型如何通过交互高效收敛到单一用户意图解释提供的洞察有限。我们引入一个基于偏好的模拟用户框架，用于受控的多轮歧义消解评估，将模拟器响应严格锚定在用户的消歧偏好上以避免幻觉和过度披露。与此并行，我们定义了三种可观察的不满信号——错误假设、重复澄清和无关澄清——以刻画超越任务准确率的交互质量。我们的分析揭示了一个明确的权衡：频繁寻求澄清的模型倾向于过度澄清并拉长交互，而假设驱动的模型更容易与用户意图错位。我们证明，基于这些不满信号优化的系统提示在全部三项指标上取得帕累托最优平衡，将整体错误率最多降低 7.65%，凸显了该框架在设计
translation.brief: 解决现有静态歧义评估无法衡量模型通过交互收敛到用户意图解释的效率问题，核心方法是构建基于用户消歧偏好的模拟用户多轮评估框架，并定义三种不满信号来刻画交互质量并优化系统提示。

papers.title: MemeEconomy: Do LLM Agents Trade Ethics for Survival?
papers.abstract: Alignment-trained large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in autonomous, multi-round settings where ethical compliance can come into direct tension with task success. While safety literature extensively documents failure modes like sycophancy and reward hacking, it largely overlooks a critical vulnerability: how agents behave under simulated existential economic pressure. We introduce MemeEconomy, a multimodal agentic market simulation in which LLM agents act as meme investors. Agents select content from a five-tier harm taxonomy and target communities under low-pressure and high-pressure (survival) environments. Each decision is logged in a Belief-Desire-Intention (BDI) schema that we use as a diagnostic instrument, externalizing the agent's event understanding, declared priorities, and harm acknowledgment. Across ten models from four frontier model families, harmful selection rates remain consistently high and rise by +15 percentage points on average under an economic survival incentive. Frontier alignment-trained models commit to harm-tolerant selection at initialization while suppressing the explicit harm acknowledgment that previously accompanied it. In competitive tournaments, ethical agents finish higher overall, yet moderation penalties fail to suppress harm: harmful selection rates remain elevated in rounds following a removal, indicating the moderation mechanism does not function as a deterrent. We further train MemeAgent, a 2B-parameter verifier on the simulation's BDI logs, which outperforms zero-shot frontier verifiers on in-distribution audits (97.5% vs. 63-74% accuracy on the Pass vs. Block decision) and generalizes to external multimodal harm benchmarks (78% vs. 50-56% on Hateful Memes). The same logs that surface the failure mode also help train the model that detects it.

translation.title: MemeEconomy：LLM 智能体会用道德换取生存吗？
translation.abstract: 经过对齐训练的大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地被部署在自主多轮场景中，在这些场景下，道德合规可能与任务成功直接冲突。尽管安全领域文献大量记录了谄媚和奖励黑客等失败模式，但在很大程度上忽视了一个关键漏洞：智能体在模拟的生存经济压力下如何表现。我们提出 MemeEconomy，一个多模态智能体市场模拟，其中 LLM 智能体扮演梗图投资者。智能体从五级危害分类体系中选择内容，并在低压和高压（生存）环境下选择目标社区。每个决策都以信念-欲望-意图（BDI）模式记录，我们将其作为诊断工具，外化智能体对事件的理解、声明优先级和危害认知。在来自四个前沿模型家族的十个模型中，有害选择率始终居高不下，并在经济生存激励下平均上升 15 个百分点。前沿对齐训练模型在初始阶段就承诺进行容忍危害的选择，同时抑制此前伴随的显式危害认知。在竞争锦标赛中，道德智能体总体排名更高，但审核惩罚未能抑制危害：在被移除后的回合中，有害选择率仍然居高不下，表明审核机制并未起到威慑作用。我们进一步训练了 MemeAgent，一个基于模拟 BDI 日志的 2B 参数验证器，它在同分布审计上优于零样本前沿验证器（Pass vs. Block 决策准确率 97.5% vs. 63-74%），并能泛化到外部多模态危害基准（Hateful Memes 上 78% vs. 50-56%）。正是那些暴露失败模式的日志，也帮助训练了检测该失败模式的模型。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 智能体在经济生存压力下的伦理行为退化，并构建基于 BDI 日志的多模态市场模拟与危害检测验证器。

papers.title: The Human Side of ML Engineering: Analyzing the Collaboration and Communication Skills in ML Job Postings
papers.abstract: Studies of Machine Learning (ML) practice highlight the importance of combining technical expertise with interpersonal capabilities, particularly collaboration and communication. However, evidence on how ML job postings express these skills is scarce, and prior work largely relies on keyword-based analyses that overlook implicit expression. We analyze demand for these skills in ML job postings across regions, industries, and seniority levels, and compare it with software engineering (SE) roles. We collected 1,000 postings (500 ML, 500 SE) from five continents via a semi-automated pipeline. For annotation, we synthesized a taxonomy of collaboration and communication sub-categories from prior work and used an LLM as a third annotator alongside two humans, enabling detection of context-dependent and implicit skill references. Collaboration appeared in 88.6% of ML postings and communication in 72.2%, far above prior keyword-based estimates for AI roles. Roughly one in five collaboration and one in four communication requirements were expressed only implicitly. Decomposing these requirements into the taxonomy's sub-categories reveals what aggregate figures conceal. Collaboration is demanded predominantly as integration across role boundaries rather than team membership. Communication is mostly required in generic terms, with fewer than half of the postings requiring it naming whom the candidate must communicate with. ML and SE postings demand interpersonal competence at statistically indistinguishable levels but orient it differently, SE toward team practices and ML toward presentation and audience-facing interaction. Within ML, the advertised role separates interpersonal profiles more sharply than any other dimension, including the contrast with SE.

translation.title: ML 工程中的人性一面：分析 ML 招聘启事中的协作与沟通技能
translation.abstract: 对机器学习（ML）实践的研究强调技术专长与人际能力相结合的重要性，尤其是协作与沟通。然而，关于 ML 招聘启事如何表达这些技能的证据稀缺，且已有工作主要依赖基于关键词的分析，忽视了隐性表达。我们分析了 ML 招聘启事中这些技能在地区、行业和资历层级上的需求，并与软件工程（SE）岗位进行比较。我们通过半自动化流程从五大洲收集了 1,000 份启事（500 份 ML，500 份 SE）。在标注方面，我们从先前工作中综合出一个协作与沟通子类别的分类体系，并使用 LLM 作为第三标注者与两名人类标注者共同工作，从而能够检测依赖语境和隐性的技能表述。协作出现在 88.6% 的 ML 启事中，沟通出现在 72.2% 中，远高于先前对 AI 岗位基于关键词的估计。大约五分之一的协作需求和四分之一的沟通需求仅以隐性方式表达。将这些需求分解到分类体系的子类别中，揭示了总体数字所掩盖的内容。协作主要被要求为跨角色边界的集成而非团队成员身份。沟通大多以笼统措辞要求，只有不到一半的启事在要求沟通时指明候选者需要与谁沟通。ML 和 SE 启事在统计上以不可区分的水平要求人际能力，但取向不同：SE 偏向团队实践，ML 偏向展示和面向受众的互动。在 ML 内部，所招聘的岗位比任何其他维度（包括与 SE 的对比）都更清晰地区分了人际能力画像。
translation.brief: 通过 LLM 辅助标注分析 ML 招聘启事中协作与沟通技能的显性与隐性表达及其与软件工程岗位的差异。

papers.title: DataTrace: Benchmarking Data Agents for Evidence-Grounded Root-Cause Localization
papers.abstract: Database agents diagnose pipeline failures, but a correct root cause is trustworthy only when it is supported by evidence the agent inspected. Existing benchmarks usually grade the final query or answer but fail to distinguish an evidence-based diagnosis from an unsupported correct answer. We introduce DataTrace, a benchmark for evidence-grounded root-cause localization over typed graphs of database artifacts. DataTrace uses controlled fault injection to derive root causes and evidence paths within 83 runnable environments without human annotations, and scores root-cause correctness and coverage of the supporting path separately. We also introduce CoSE, a generator-solver protocol in which an external verifier admits reproducible faults and checks both the submitted answer and the inspected evidence. Our evaluation shows that seven proprietary models achieve average root-cause accuracy 48%, with a mean per-model conditional unsupported rate of 18%. Fine-grained analysis shows that this gap varies sharply with fault mechanism, dependency distance, and evidence modality. After in-loop training on a matched held-out batch, the share of grounded correct diagnoses rises from 83.7% to 94.6%, while root-cause accuracy rises from 29.2% to 36.7%. These results show that while final-answer accuracy can hide unsupported diagnoses, evidence coverage provides an actionable signal to improve database agents. Code and data are available at this https URL.

translation.title: DataTrace：面向证据支撑的根因定位的数据智能体基准
translation.abstract: 数据库智能体可以诊断流水线故障，但只有当根因有智能体实际检查过的证据支撑时，正确的根因才是可信的。现有基准通常只评判最终查询或答案，无法区分基于证据的诊断与缺乏支撑的正确答案。我们提出 DataTrace，一个在数据库工件类型化图上进行证据支撑根因定位的基准。DataTrace 使用受控故障注入，在 83 个可运行环境中自动推导根因和证据路径，无需人工标注，并分别评分根因正确性和支撑路径的覆盖率。我们还提出 CoSE，一种生成器-求解器协议，由外部验证器注入可复现故障，并检查所提交的答案和所检查的证据。我们的评估显示，七个专有模型的平均根因准确率为 48%，每个模型平均条件性无支撑率为 18%。细粒度分析表明，这一差距随故障机制、依赖距离和证据模态而显著变化。在匹配的留出批次上进行循环内训练后，有证据支撑的正确诊断比例从 83.7% 上升到 94.6%，根因准确率从 29.2% 上升到 36.7%。这些结果表明，虽然最终答案准确率可能掩盖无支撑的诊断，但证据覆盖率为改进数据库智能体提供了可操作的信号。代码和数据见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 提出 DataTrace 基准，通过受控故障注入与外部验证协议，评分数据库智能体根因定位的准确性及其证据路径覆盖率。

papers.title: Level Up! AI-Driven Challenges and Adaptations to Code Review Practices
papers.abstract: AI can write code faster than humans can review, causing a bottleneck and necessitating changes to code review practices. This bottleneck is hotly debated, giving rise to two extreme and orthogonal imagined futures: one where humans continue to be firmly entrenched in the review process, and one where AI agents merge pull requests entirely without human involvement. Yet, these futures remain rooted in folk wisdom. Through a mixed-methods study of interviews ($n = 24$) and a survey ($n = 2{,}590$) at a large, multinational software company with widespread access to AI, we identify AI-driven code review challenges and strategies reported as effective to meet them. We found that AI enables, necessitates, and complicates a shift in the human reviewer's role toward high-level concerns (e.g., design and intent). We found that AI-assisted authoring results in increased burden for reviewers due to challenges such as a lack of author stewardship and PR volume and size, potentially leading to downstream debt. Our survey showed AI review usage was not correlated with less difficulty keeping up with PR volume, indicating using AI for review alone is not sufficient for solving AI-driven review challenges. Developers found the most useful strategies to be organizations supporting and resourcing review, pushing review burden upstream, and prioritizing reviewer attention on the concerns that matter most.

translation.title: 升级！AI 驱动的挑战与对代码评审实践的适应
translation.abstract: AI 编写代码的速度超过人类的评审速度，造成瓶颈并要求改变代码评审实践。这一瓶颈被激烈讨论，催生了两种极端且正交的想象未来：一种是人类继续牢牢立足于评审过程，另一种是 AI 智能体在完全无需人类参与的情况下合并 pull request。然而，这些未来仍然根植于民间智慧。通过对一家 AI 使用普及的大型跨国软件公司进行访谈（n = 24）和问卷调查（n = 2,590）的混合方法研究，我们识别了 AI 驱动的代码评审挑战以及被报告为有效的应对策略。我们发现 AI 使人类评审者的角色向高层次关注点（如设计和意图）的转变成为可能、成为必要且更加复杂。我们发现 AI 辅助编写由于缺乏作者责任心以及 PR 数量和规模等挑战而增加了评审者的负担，可能导致下游债务。我们的调查显示，AI 评审的使用与更轻松地跟上 PR 数量并无相关性，表明仅用 AI 进行评审不足以解决 AI 驱动的评审挑战。开发者认为最有用的策略是组织为评审提供支持与资源、将评审负担向上游推进，以及将评审者的注意力优先放在最重要的关注点上。
translation.brief: 通过访谈与大规模问卷识别 AI 时代代码评审的挑战及开发者认为有效的应对策略。

papers.title: From Language-Specific to Cross-DSL: Semantic-Role-Guided Model Completion with LLMs
papers.abstract: The rapid emergence of large language models (LLMs), trained on vast and diverse corpora, has positioned them as a promising source of domain knowledge to assist modelers. However, leveraging LLMs for model completion remains challenging: suggestions must respect both the syntax of a domain-specific language (DSL) and the intended domain semantics, while remaining consistent with an evolving model. This paper presents RAFiC, an LLM-based approach for iterative domain model completion that generalizes across DSLs. It drives completion using metamodel information to ensure syntactic validity and enriches prompts with semantic-role annotations to better capture the intended modeling role of DSL elements. The approach provides context-aware, incremental guidance during model construction. We evaluate RAFiC through an ablation-based comparative study over three DSLs and two scenarios per DSL to isolate the contribution of syntactic and semantic guidance. Across these six scenarios, semantic role guidance improves contribution rate in every case, and RAFiC improves completion effectiveness over weaker prompting configurations in most of them. The largest gains occur for DSLs that are less represented in LLM training data. In these cases, iterative guidance leads to earlier and more stable accepted suggestions, while semantic role guidance improves their relevance.

translation.title: 从语言特定到跨 DSL：基于语义角色引导的 LLM 模型补全
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在庞大而多样的语料上训练后迅速涌现，已成为协助建模者的有前景的领域知识来源。然而，利用 LLM 进行模型补全仍然具有挑战性：建议必须同时遵守领域特定语言（DSL）的语法和预期领域语义，并与不断演化的模型保持一致。本文提出 RAFiC，一种可跨 DSL 泛化的基于 LLM 的迭代式领域模型补全方法。它利用元模型信息驱动补全以确保语法有效性，并通过语义角色标注丰富提示，以更好地捕捉 DSL 元素的预期建模角色。该方法在模型构建过程中提供上下文感知的增量指导。我们通过一项基于消融的比较研究评估 RAFiC，涵盖三个 DSL、每个 DSL 两种场景，以分离语法和语义引导的贡献。在这六个场景中，语义角色引导在所有情况下都提高了采纳率，且 RAFiC 在大多数场景中的补全效果优于较弱的提示配置。在 LLM 训练数据中代表较少的 DSL 上收益最大。在这些情况下，迭代引导使被采纳的建议更早出现且更稳定，而语义角色引导提高了建议的相关性。
translation.brief: 提出 RAFiC 方法，利用元模型语法约束与语义角色标注引导 LLM 实现跨 DSL 的迭代式模型补全。

papers.title: SpecRelay: Amortize or Avoid the Round Trip in Edge-Cloud Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract: Edge-cloud speculative decoding moves autoregressive drafting to an edge device while a larger cloud model verifies draft tokens in parallel, so that edge drafting and cloud verification overlap under a synchronous draft-verify schedule. Beyond low-latency local networks, however, the next verification request of that schedule can be sent only after the previous reply arrives, so every round still waits out a full round trip, and throughput falls as the network RTT grows. To recover this loss, we present SpecRelay, an edge-cloud LLM inference system that addresses this cost at two levels: it amortizes round trips when cloud verification is necessary and avoids them when local reasoning suffices. For cloud-bound queries, an asynchronous verification pipeline keeps fixed-budget draft trees in flight while earlier replies are still outstanding, and the cloud rejects stale requests before the target-model forward pass (the asynchronous schedule). At the query level, an RTT-conditioned router (the Latency-Aware Router) estimates quality and completion latency for three on-device modes (direct generation, Chain-of-Draft, and full reasoning) and cloud speculative decoding, selecting among them under a configurable accuracy-latency objective without adding latency during inference, since the router runs concurrently with the draft-model prefill. The asynchronous schedule alone improves decoding throughput by up to 50% over a reproduced synchronous baseline across multiple benchmarks. At matched target-model accuracy and 250 ms of added round-trip latency, the full system with the router delivers 1.95x and 1.55x the throughput of the same baseline on SPROUT and OlympiadBench, respectively, while sending only 47% and 39% of the queries to the cloud.

translation.title: SpecRelay：在边缘-云投机解码中摊销或规避往返延迟
translation.abstract: 边缘-云投机解码将自回归草稿生成转移到边缘设备，由更大的云端模型并行验证草稿token，从而在同步的草稿-验证调度下实现边缘草稿生成与云端验证的重叠。然而，在低延迟本地网络之外，该调度下的下一次验证请求只有在前一次回复到达后才能发送，因此每一轮仍需等待完整的往返时间，吞吐量随网络RTT增大而下降。为挽回这一损失，我们提出SpecRelay，一种边缘-云LLM推理系统，在两个层面解决这一开销：当需要云端验证时摊销往返，当本地推理足够时规避往返。对于必须上云的查询，一条异步验证流水线在早期回复尚未返回时持续让固定预算的草稿树在途，并且云端在目标模型前向计算之前拒绝过期请求（异步调度）。在查询层面，一个以RTT为条件的路由器（Latency-Aware Router）为三种端上模式（直接生成、Chain-of-Draft和完整推理）与云端投机解码估计质量和完成延迟，并在可配置的精度-延迟目标下进行选择，且不增加推理延迟，因为路由器与草稿模型prefill并行运行。仅异步调度即可在多个基准上相比复现的同步基线将解码吞吐量提升最高50%。在匹配目标模型精度并增加250ms往返延迟的条件下，带路由器的完整系统在SPROUT和OlympiadBench上分别达到同一基线的1.95倍和1.55倍吞吐量，同时仅将47%和39%的查询发送到云端。
translation.brief: 该论文解决边缘-云投机解码中网络往返延迟导致的吞吐损失问题，核心方法是通过异步验证流水线摊销RTT并结合延迟感知路由器选择本地或云端推理。

papers.title: Context Matters: Improving LLM-Based Code Summarization with Hierarchical Information
papers.abstract: Source code documentation plays an important role in software quality activities, such as code review, program comprehension, maintenance, and bug fixing. However, it is often fragmented across individual code elements and focuses on local implementation details, providing little information about their surrounding context. This limits both developers' understanding of software systems and the effectiveness of Large Language Models (LLMs), whose reasoning is constrained by finite context windows. Enriching documentation with hierarchical context has the potential to improve software comprehension and support downstream, quality-related tasks for both developers and LLM-based tools. In this paper, we present an in silico study that showcases the impact of augmenting context on the generation of code-level documentation, using a variety of LLMs. By varying the function, class, and module hierarchy visible to the LLMs, we assess whether this variation produces a significant difference in the resulting code documentation compared with the existing documentation, which serves as a proxy for developer intent. Our results show that Documentation-Aware prompts with class or module-level context consistently yield summaries that are closest to the original documentation. Adding surrounding documentation yields statistically significant improvements over the baseline across models, with effect sizes ranging from negligible (DeepSeek) through weak (GPT-4o-mini) to medium (Gemini). We restrict the study to this immediate hierarchical context; call-graph traversal and cross-module dependency context fall outside our scope and are left to future work. These findings provide a clear path to improve automated documentation tools and enhance LLMs' ability to reason about codebases for downstream tasks, such as code retrieval.

translation.title: 上下文很重要：利用层次化信息改进基于LLM的代码摘要
translation.abstract: 源代码文档在代码评审、程序理解、维护和缺陷修复等软件质量活动中扮演重要角色。然而，文档常常分散于各个代码元素之间，聚焦于局部实现细节，几乎没有提供关于其周边上下文的信息。这既限制了开发者对软件系统的理解，也限制了大型语言模型（LLM）的有效性，因为其推理受限于有限的上下文窗口。用层次化上下文丰富文档有望改善软件理解，并为开发者和基于LLM的工具的下游质量相关任务提供支持。本文提出一项计算机模拟（in silico）研究，使用多种LLM展示增加上下文对生成代码级文档的影响。通过改变LLM可见的函数、类和模块层次，我们评估这种变化是否使生成的代码文档与现有文档（作为开发者意图的代理）相比产生显著差异。结果表明，带有类或模块级上下文的Documentation-Aware提示始终产生最接近原始文档的摘要。相比基线，加入周边文档在所有模型上均带来统计显著的改进，效应量从可忽略（DeepSeek）、较弱（GPT-4o-mini）到中等（Gemini）不等。我们将研究限定于此直接的层次上下文；调用图遍历和跨模块依赖上下文超出本文范围，留待未来工作。这些发现为改进自动化文档工具以及增强LLM对代码库的推理能力（服务于代码检索等下游任务）提供了清晰路径。
translation.brief: 该论文解决代码摘要缺乏上下文导致质量不足的问题，核心方法是通过向LLM提示中注入类和模块级的层次化文档上下文来改进摘要生成。

papers.title: NVFP4-MLA: Unified FP4 KV-Cache Storage and Attention Computation for Multi-Head Latent Attention
papers.abstract: Long-context reasoning and agentic workloads make key-value (KV) cache capacity and attention computation the dominant costs of serving frontier large language models. We present NVFP4-MLA, the first design to push both KV-cache storage and attention computation of multi-head latent attention (MLA) to FP4. NVFP4-MLA co-designs the quantization algorithm with the attention kernel and the cache system. Selective residual compensation preserves model accuracy by adding NVFP4 residuals only to the quantization-sensitive channels. Two-dimensional quantization blocks make the shared latent cache compatible with the different reduction directions of the two attention batched matrix multiplications (BMMs), removing requantization between them. On DeepSeek-R1 and Kimi-K3, NVFP4-MLA matches BF16 MLA average accuracy across nine benchmarks while compressing the MLA KV cache by 3.20x and 3.05x relative to BF16 MLA. On NVIDIA Rubin GPUs, NVFP4-MLA speeds up the attention kernel over FP8 MLA by up to 2.82x on DeepSeek-R1 and 2.71x on Kimi-K3, and lowers p90 time to first token in agentic multi-turn serving by up to 3.5x and 2.1x, respectively. In disaggregated DeepSeek-R1 serving, it also raises per-GPU throughput by up to 2.30x.

translation.title: NVFP4-MLA：面向多头潜在注意力的统一FP4 KV缓存存储与注意力计算
translation.abstract: 长上下文推理和智能体（agentic）工作负载使键值（KV）缓存容量与注意力计算成为前沿大语言模型服务中的主导成本。我们提出NVFP4-MLA，这是首个将多头潜在注意力（MLA）的KV缓存存储与注意力计算同时推向FP4的设计。NVFP4-MLA将量化算法与注意力核和缓存系统协同设计。选择性残差补偿仅对量化敏感的通道添加NVFP4残差，从而保持模型精度。二维量化分块使共享的潜在缓存与两个注意力批量矩阵乘法（BMM）的不同归约方向兼容，去除了二者之间的重量化。在DeepSeek-R1和Kimi-K3上，NVFP4-MLA在九个基准上达到与BF16 MLA相当的平均精度，同时将MLA KV缓存相对BF16 MLA分别压缩3.20倍和3.05倍。在NVIDIA Rubin GPU上，NVFP4-MLA的注意力核相比FP8 MLA在DeepSeek-R1上最高加速2.82倍、在Kimi-K3上最高加速2.71倍，并在智能体多轮服务中将p90首token时间分别降低最高3.5倍和2.1倍。在分离式DeepSeek-R1服务中，它还将单GPU吞吐量提升最高2.30倍。
translation.brief: 该论文解决长上下文LLM服务中MLA的KV缓存容量与注意力计算开销问题，核心方法是设计统一的FP4量化算法与注意力核及缓存系统的协同方案。

papers.title: Large language models as oncology world models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can synthesize cancer patient cases, but their internal representation of oncology, or world model, has not been explored systematically. By only specifying tumor type, we show that LLMs tend to generate similar patients per cancer, with on average 81.0% to 93.2% of a cancer's patients sharing the most frequent value of each baseline feature. By systematically varying patient features in 12 clinical scenarios, we show that they follow biomarker and treatment logic in 29 of 36 model-scenario assessments, against 1 of 12 when previous treatment or frailty matters. Continuing real patient trajectories, an LLM predicted 89.9% 12-month survival, and 79.2% with similar patients as examples, against 72.2% observed. To represent these trajectories, we developed the Clinical State Space, a dynamic representation framework that we also applied to real patients. Despite the limits we show, improved world models may support digital twins, which our framework can evaluate.

translation.title: 作为肿瘤学世界模型的大语言模型
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以合成癌症患者病例，但其内部的肿瘤学表征（即世界模型）尚未被系统性探索。仅指定肿瘤类型时，我们发现LLM倾向于为每种癌症生成相似的患者，平均81.0%至93.2%的某癌症患者共享各基线特征的最常见取值。通过在12个临床场景中系统性地改变患者特征，我们发现LLM在36项模型-场景评估中的29项遵循生物标志物和治疗逻辑，而在涉及既往治疗或衰弱状态的情形中，12项中仅有1项符合。在延续真实患者轨迹时，LLM预测的12个月生存率为89.9%，以相似患者作为示例时为79.2%，而实际观测为72.2%。为表征这些轨迹，我们开发了Clinical State Space，一个同样可应用于真实患者的动态表征框架。尽管存在我们所展示的局限，改进的世界模型或可支持数字孪生，而我们的框架可用于评估这些数字孪生。
translation.brief: 该论文旨在系统性地探究LLM内部的肿瘤学世界模型，核心方法是通过合成患者、可控特征扰动与真实轨迹延续实验，并提出Clinical State Space动态表征框架来评估其临床推理能力。

papers.title: NEMESIS2.0: LLM-Aided Netlist-Driven Performance Equation Modeling for Accelerated Analog Circuit Sizing
papers.abstract: This work presents NEMESIS2.0, an open-source LLM-aided framework that automatically derives equation-based performance models for analog circuits. The resulting equations provide fast, accurate surrogates for SPICE evaluation. To validate the method, equation-based models are developed for seven circuit test cases in a commercial 65nm CMOS technology, covering 15 metrics on five operational transconductance amplifier topologies, and six metrics on two dynamic comparator topologies. When tested on 1000 unseen variants of these seven designs, each corresponding to a different set of independently sampled transistor sizes, the accuracy is found to be within 5% of SPICE. To demonstrate use cases for NEMESIS2.0, the generated models are used as performance evaluators in multiple transistor sizers based on different population-based stochastic search optimizers. For each of the seven test cases, transistor sizing is performed for 100 different sets of performance specifications, with final SPICE simulation confirming that 83.3% of the resulting designs meet all specifications after a single sizing run. The rest fail to meet the specifications due to discrepancies between the model and SPICE, and require iterative resizing under tightened specifications; all such scenarios meet specifications within five iterations. Within the transistor sizers, this equation-based performance analysis evaluates ~400 design candidates per second, versus 0.14 candidates per second for SPICE-based evaluation, achieving 196-238x sizing runtime speedup, including final SPICE verification.

translation.title: NEMESIS2.0：LLM辅助的网表驱动性能方程建模，加速模拟电路尺寸设计
translation.abstract: 本工作提出NEMESIS2.0，一个开源的LLM辅助框架，可自动为模拟电路推导基于方程的性能模型。所得方程可作为SPICE评估的快速、准确代理。为验证该方法，我们在商用65nm CMOS工艺下为七个电路测试用例构建了基于方程的模型，涵盖五种运算跨导放大器拓扑的15个指标和两种动态比较器拓扑的6个指标。在1000个未见过的电路变体（每个对应一组独立采样的晶体管尺寸）上测试时，精度在SPICE的5%以内。为展示NEMESIS2.0的用例，所生成的模型被用作基于不同种群随机搜索优化器的多种晶体管尺寸设计器中的性能评估器。对七个测试用例中的每一个，针对100组不同的性能规格执行晶体管尺寸设计，最终SPICE仿真确认83.3%的设计在单次尺寸设计运行后满足全部规格。其余因模型与SPICE之间的差异未能满足规格，需在收紧的规格下迭代重设计；所有此类场景均在五次迭代内满足规格。在晶体管尺寸设计器中，这种基于方程的性能分析每秒可评估约400个候选设计，而基于SPICE的评估仅为每秒0.14个，包括最终SPICE验证在内实现了196-238倍的尺寸设计运行时加速。
translation.brief: 该论文解决模拟电路晶体管尺寸设计中SPICE仿真评估过慢的问题，核心方法是利用LLM自动推导基于方程的性能模型作为SPICE的快速高精度代理评估器。

papers.title: Revealing the Biases of Large Language Models By Inferring Prior Distributions
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been known to exhibit a wide range of social biases including name-nationality associations, occupation-gender associations and racial stereotypes. Existing approaches to evaluating these biases typically involve measuring surface-level behavior where a model is fed a dataset of prompts and its outputs are scored relative to ground-truth answers. Inspired by prior elicitation in cognitive science, we propose a different perspective that reconstructs latent bias as a prior underlying the model's behavior. We formulate the problem as a Bayesian inverse problem where, given prompt-response observations on a bias benchmark dataset, we infer a low-dimensional latent distribution that summarizes the model's stereotyping tendencies. This paper develops the mathematical foundation, a practical reconstruction algorithm, and experiments using the Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) benchmark to infer the prior distributions of LLMs over responses in ambiguous social contexts.

translation.title: 通过推断先验分布揭示大语言模型的偏见
translation.abstract: 大语言模型(LLM)已被发现存在广泛的社会偏见，包括姓名-国籍关联、职业-性别关联和种族刻板印象。现有的偏见评估方法通常只测量表层行为，即给模型输入一组提示词数据集，并根据标准答案对其输出打分。受认知科学中先验启发技术的启发，我们提出了一种不同的视角：将潜在偏见重构为模型行为背后的先验分布。我们将该问题形式化为一个贝叶斯逆问题，即在给定偏见基准数据集上的提示-响应观测的情况下，推断一个低维潜在分布以概括模型的刻板印象倾向。本文建立了数学基础、实用的重构算法，并使用 Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) 基准进行实验，推断 LLM 在模糊社会情境下对响应的先验分布。
translation.brief: 针对LLM社会偏见的评估问题，将其重构为贝叶斯逆问题，从基准数据集的提示-响应观测中推断刻画模型刻板印象倾向的先验分布。

papers.title: Agent-ZTA: A chain-Aware Zero Trust Model for Bidirectional Security-State Propagation and Runtime Containment in Multi-Agent Delegation
papers.abstract: Multi-agent systems increasingly delegate tasks and permissions across chains of autonomous agents that invoke protected tools. Although agent identities and delegated credentials may remain valid throughout a workflow, the security condition of any agent along the chain can deteriorate during runtime execution-either through upstream compromise or downstream ingestion of untrusted inputs. Authorization models based solely on the immediate caller and its static delegated scope fail to account for these mid-execution state changes. This paper develops Agent-ZTA, a chain-aware Zero Trust authorization and containment model that links runtime security-state changes across multi-agent delegation graphs. The model distinguishes an agent's path-specific delegated authority bound from the effective permissions currently exercisable under trusted policy. It defines an architecture featuring independently enforced policy decisions, authenticated delegation provenance, a dynamic chain-state view, and explicit fail-safe handling of missing or stale authorization signals. Furthermore, Agent-ZTA defines bidirectional security state propagation, allowing downstream security events to affect relevant upstream workflow states, and specifies adaptive branch-scoped containment through restricted permissions and a sandbox ("jail") execution mode where an isolation boundary is available. The deterministic decision procedure, five stated security properties, and worked authorization traces show how accepted security-state changes constrain affected operations while preserving original delegation bounds and separating unrelated workflow branches under the defined policies. Finally, the paper states its trust assumptions and the exact scope of its security properties.

translation.title: Agent-ZTA：面向多智能体委托的链感知零信任模型，支持双向安全状态传播与运行时遏制
translation.abstract: 多智能体系统日益在调用受保护工具的自主智能体链上进行任务和权限委托。尽管智能体身份和委托凭证在整个工作流中可能保持有效，但链上任何智能体的安全状况都可能在运行时恶化——或因上游被攻陷，或因下游摄入不可信输入。仅基于直接调用者及其静态委托范围的授权模型无法考虑这些执行中途的状态变化。本文提出 Agent-ZTA，一个链感知的零信任授权与遏制模型，将多智能体委托图中的运行时安全状态变化联系起来。该模型区分智能体绑定于特定路径的委托权限与其在可信策略下当前实际可行使的有效权限。它定义了一种架构，包含独立执行的策略决策、经过认证的委托溯源、动态链状态视图，以及对缺失或过时授权信号的显式故障安全处理。此外，Agent-ZTA 定义了双向安全状态传播，允许下游安全事件影响相关的上游工作流状态，并指定了通过受限权限和沙箱("jail")执行模式实现的适应性分支范围遏制（在存在隔离边界时）。确定性的决策过程、五条明确的安全属性以及详细的授权轨迹展示了在既定策略下，被接受的安全状态变化如何约束受影响的操作，同时保持原有委托边界并隔离无关的工作流分支。最后，论文阐明了其信任假设及安全属性的精确范围。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体委托链中运行时安全状态恶化无法被静态授权模型感知的问题，提出链感知零信任模型Agent-ZTA，通过双向安全状态传播和分支级沙箱遏制来约束受影响操作。

papers.title: MemoryLane: Supporting Reminiscence Conversations Between Older Adults with Mild Dementia and Lay Caregivers Using a Simulated AI Agent
papers.abstract: Reminiscence Therapy (RT) is a non-pharmacological intervention that invites patients to discuss and review past life experiences and memories to improve their emotional and mental well-being. In practice, many reminiscence conversations are led by lay caregivers, such as spouses and adult children. While traditional RT often relies on personal photographs, curating them can be tedious and difficult. In addition, caregivers who lack shared life experiences with the patient may struggle to facilitate engaging reminiscence conversations. This paper presents MemoryLane, an AI-integrated tool that helps lay caregivers facilitate reminiscence conversations without curated photographs. MemoryLane supports a triadic conversation among the patient, the caregiver, and a simulated AI agent that acts as the patient's peer. A shared interface shows the agent and AI-generated images of the memories being discussed, while a private smartphone interface lets the caregiver control the behavior of the simulated AI agent and moderate the AI-generated images. A preliminary focus group study with five dementia-care stakeholders suggested the value of MemoryLane's AI agent as a peer companion and of AI-generated images, as well as the feasibility of having caregivers moderate images and control the AI agent.

translation.title: MemoryLane：利用模拟AI智能体支持轻度失智老人与非专业照护者之间的怀旧对话
translation.abstract: 怀旧疗法(RT)是一种非药物干预，邀请患者讨论和回顾过去的生活经历与记忆，以改善其情绪和心理健康。在实践中，许多怀旧对话由非专业照护者主导，例如配偶和成年子女。虽然传统的怀旧疗法通常依赖个人照片，但整理这些照片可能既繁琐又困难。此外，缺乏与患者共同生活经历的照护者可能难以引导有吸引力的怀旧对话。本文提出 MemoryLane，一个集成AI的工具，帮助非专业照护者在没有整理好的照片的情况下引导怀旧对话。MemoryLane 支持患者、照护者和一个扮演患者同龄人的模拟AI智能体之间的三方对话。共享界面显示该智能体以及正在讨论的记忆的AI生成图像，而一个私密的智能手机界面让照护者能够控制模拟AI智能体的行为并审核AI生成的图像。一项由五位失智照护相关利益相关者参与的初步焦点小组研究表明，MemoryLane 的AI智能体作为同龄陪伴者、AI生成图像，以及由照护者审核图像并控制AI智能体的可行性均具有价值。
translation.brief: 针对怀旧对话中照片整理繁琐和照护者缺乏共同经历难以引导对话的问题，提出MemoryLane，以模拟AI同龄智能体和AI生成图像、配合照护者私密控制界面的三方对话方式支持怀旧疗法。

papers.title: Advancing the Calibration-Compute Frontier of LLM Classifiers via Asymmetric Duos
papers.abstract: The importance of reliable uncertainty estimation in large language models (LLMs) has become increasingly pronounced, yet modern models remain poorly calibrated and frequently overconfident. In this study, we address this by proposing an efficient method for LLM classifier calibration using the Asymmetric Duos framework. Our approach combines a strong base model with a smaller sidekick model via logit-space fusion, utilizing global scaling parameters optimized on a validation set. Across diverse benchmarks, this Asymmetric LLM Duo consistently achieves best or second-best performance on expected calibration error and negative log-likelihood, without degrading predictive accuracy. More importantly, these gains are realized at a fraction of the computational cost of more complex baselines, placing our method on the calibration-compute Pareto frontier. We further demonstrate that our method acts orthogonal to various established calibration-aware techniques, meaning it can be easily combined with them to consistently boost their performance. Finally, our analysis of the logit-space behavior illustrates how asymmetric fusion successfully mitigates base model overconfidence. Overall, our findings demonstrate that the benefits of an asymmetric fusion successfully transfer to the language domain, providing a simple, highly cost-efficient approach to improving uncertainty estimation in LLM classifiers.

translation.title: 通过非对称双模型推进LLM分类器的校准-计算前沿
translation.abstract: 大语言模型(LLM)中可靠的不确定性估计的重要性日益凸显，但现代模型的校准仍很差，经常过度自信。在本研究中，我们使用 Asymmetric Duos 框架提出一种高效的LLM分类器校准方法来解决该问题。我们的方法将一个强大的基础模型与一个较小的辅助模型通过 logit 空间融合结合起来，利用在验证集上优化的全局缩放参数。在多个基准上，该非对称LLM双模型在期望校准误差和负对数似然上始终取得最佳或次佳表现，且不降低预测准确率。更重要的是，这些收益仅需更复杂基线的一小部分计算成本，使我们的方法位于校准-计算 Pareto 前沿。我们进一步证明，我们的方法与多种已有的校准相关技术正交，意味着可以轻松与它们结合以持续提升性能。最后，我们对 logit 空间行为的分析说明了非对称融合如何成功缓解基础模型的过度自信。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明非对称融合的收益可以成功迁移到语言领域，为改善LLM分类器的不确定性估计提供了一种简单且高性价比的方法。
translation.brief: 针对LLM分类器过度自信、校准差的问题，提出非对称双模型方法，将强基础模型与小型辅助模型在logit空间以验证集优化的全局缩放参数融合，以低成本改善校准。

papers.title: SurveyWeave: An Agentic Framework for Automated Survey Generation
papers.abstract: Surveys help researchers keep up with fast-moving fields, but they take weeks to months to write. Automated survey generation (AutoSurvey) can alleviate this situation, but it is challenging to draw on hundreds to thousands of precisely scoped papers, choose among many valid structures, and stay faithful to its sources while offering insights. We present SurveyWeave, an agentic architecture that decomposes the problem into four tasks coordinated by three agents, each reviewing others' work and conducting revisions based on feedback. We also introduce WeaveEval, a five-dimension evaluation grounded in prior surveys. A comprehensive comparison shows that SurveyWeave outperforms Codex by 8 points and the strongest AutoSurvey baseline by 6 points.

translation.title: SurveyWeave：一个用于自动综述生成的智能体框架
translation.abstract: 综述帮助研究者跟上快速发展的领域，但撰写一篇综述需要数周甚至数月。自动综述生成(AutoSurvey)可以缓解这一状况，但要涵盖数百到数千篇范围精确限定的论文、在众多有效结构中做出选择、并在提供洞见的同时忠实于原始文献，都非常具有挑战性。我们提出 SurveyWeave，一种智能体架构，将问题分解为四个任务，由三个智能体协同完成，每个智能体审查其他智能体的工作并基于反馈进行修订。我们还介绍了 WeaveEval，一个基于已有综述的五个维度的评估方法。全面的比较表明，SurveyWeave 比 Codex 高出8分，比最强的 AutoSurvey 基线高出6分。
translation.brief: 针对自动综述生成中需要处理海量限定文献、选择结构并忠实于来源的难题，提出SurveyWeave多智能体框架，将任务分解为四个子任务并由三个智能体相互审查修订完成。

papers.title: B2G-Agent: An LLM-Based Multi-Agent Tool for End-to-End Building-Grid Interactions
papers.abstract: Buildings are major electricity consumers and can interact with distribution network dispatch through flexible power scheduling. These interactions require distribution network operators (DNOs) and building energy managers (BEMs) to reconcile their operational constraints and perform complex cross-field computations. The lack of cross-domain expertise and unified computational workflows could lead to inefficient or physically infeasible interactions. To address this bottleneck, we develop an end-to-end large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent tool, B2G-Agent, that bridges DNOs and BEMs. The tool deploys three collaborative agents: a Translator for bidirectional cross-domain semantic mapping via hybrid retrieval-augmented generation (RAG); an Actor for automated configuration and execution of joint simulation and optimization through directed acyclic graphs; and a Reviewer for memory-augmented reflective failure diagnosis. This workflow abstracts away cross-field modeling complexities and enables both sides to focus on high-level operational decisions. Comprehensive evaluations across 200 synthesized tasks show that B2G-Agent improves the interaction quality score from 66.71 to 85.57 and increases the task success rate from 38.0% to 69.0% over the baseline while satisfying operational constraints. The open-source tool and interface are available at this https URL.

translation.title: B2G-Agent：基于LLM的端到端建筑-电网交互多智能体工具
translation.abstract: 建筑是主要电力消费者，可通过灵活的电力调度与配电网调度进行交互。这些交互要求配电网运营商（DNO）和建筑能源管理者（BEM）协调各自的运行约束并执行复杂的跨领域计算。缺乏跨领域专业知识和统一的计算流程可能导致低效或物理上不可行的交互。为解决这一瓶颈，我们开发了一个端到端的基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体工具 B2G-Agent，连接 DNO 和 BEM。该工具部署了三个协作智能体：Translator，通过混合检索增强生成（RAG）实现双向跨领域语义映射；Actor，通过有向无环图自动配置并执行联合仿真与优化；Reviewer，通过记忆增强的反思式失败诊断。该工作流抽象掉了跨领域建模的复杂性，使双方能够专注于高层次的运行决策。在200个合成任务上的全面评估显示，B2G-Agent 将交互质量得分从66.71提升至85.57，任务成功率从38.0%提升至69.0%，同时满足运行约束。开源工具和界面可在该链接获取。
translation.brief: 解决配电网运营商与建筑能源管理者之间跨领域交互低效不可行的问题，核心方法是构建包含 Translator、Actor、Reviewer 三个协作智能体的 LLM 多智能体系统以自动完成语义映射、仿真优化与失败诊断。

papers.title: The Critic Can Hurt: On the Safety of Critics in LLM-Guided AutoML Search
papers.abstract: LLM critics increasingly steer iterative search in agentic AutoML, prompt optimization, and self-refinement--evaluated for whether they help, but rarely for whether they can hurt. We isolate the critic's marginal effect through a four-arm audit and characterize the loop's tolerance through controlled fault injection. We show a naive 8B critic drives search below the no-critic random-search floor on 7 of 8 tabular datasets, losing up to 0.245 AUC in the worst case; the magnitude varies strongly with dataset, frontier, and budget. When: stronger critics attenuate the loss on the evaluated suite, without establishing a universal capability threshold. Why: controlled fault injection shows that non-directional errors are nearly costless under best-so-far search, whereas directional errors consume finite search opportunities; an idealized effective-sample calculation yields a necessary condition, $q(m-1) > \beta$, not a deployment certificate. How: a simple observable validation gate and a learned detector can reduce realized loss, but neither is guaranteed to preserve the full-budget no-critic baseline. We will release CRITFAULT, to our knowledge the first benchmark for detecting harmful critic feedback in AutoML. A critic is not a free addition: audit before trusting, and gate when capability or verification is insufficient.

translation.title: 批评者可能有害：论 LLM 引导的 AutoML 搜索中批评者的安全性
translation.abstract: LLM 批评者在智能体式 AutoML、提示优化和自我精炼中日益主导迭代搜索——人们通常评估其是否有帮助，却很少评估其是否有害。我们通过四臂审计隔离批评者的边际效应，并通过受控故障注入刻画该循环的容错性。我们证明一个朴素的 8B 批评者在8个表格数据集中的7个上将搜索表现拉低到无批评者随机搜索的水平之下，最坏情况下损失高达0.245 AUC；损失幅度随数据集、前沿模型和预算显著变化。何时：更强的批评者在所评估的测试套件上能减弱损失，但没有建立通用的能力阈值。为何：受控故障注入表明，在保留最优解的搜索下非方向性错误几乎无代价，而方向性错误会消耗有限的搜索机会；一个理想化的有效样本计算给出必要条件 $q(m-1) > \beta$，而非部署证书。如何：简单的可观测验证门控和可学习检测器可以减少实际损失，但都不能保证保住全预算无批评者基线。我们将发布 CRITFAULT，据我们所知是首个用于检测 AutoML 中有害批评反馈的基准。批评者不是免费增益：信任前先审计，能力或验证不足时加以门控。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 批评者在 AutoML 迭代搜索中何时有害，核心方法是通过四臂审计与受控故障注入区分方向性与非方向性错误并提出验证门控与检测器缓解。

papers.title: More Context, Mixed Results: Evaluating LLMs for Identifier Recovery and Code Deobfuscation
papers.abstract: Source code is often obfuscated through identifier renaming, incentivizing reverse engineers to develop techniques for recovering meaningful names. To assess how LLMs compare with these techniques, we evaluate 4 traditional baselines and 3 LLMs (Qwen, OLMo and DeepSeek) on identifier detection and semantic recovery across 51 recent Java projects, 3 obfuscators, and 6 context/retrieval settings. LLMs generally outperform traditional techniques on both tasks, but benefit from different forms of context and settings: agentic retrieval yields the strongest detection results, reaching 91.56% $F_1$, while enclosing-class context generally improves semantic recovery at a higher token cost. Despite these gains, exact recovery peaks at 16.42% overall (under one-hop context) and 32.93% for field names (under repository retrieval), which are the easiest to recover. Class identifiers are the hardest to detect, with a mean detection $F_1$ of 48.48% across models, settings and obfuscators. More context is not always beneficial: larger methods hinder semantic recovery. Beyond identifier renaming, our experiments show that control-flow obfuscation degrades both tasks more than string encryption. Our findings provide useful ad hoc insights for reverse engineers choosing models and context strategies to deobfuscate code snippets.

translation.title: 更多上下文，效果参差：评估 LLM 在标识符恢复与代码反混淆中的表现
translation.abstract: 源代码常通过标识符重命名进行混淆，这促使逆向工程师开发恢复有意义名称的技术。为评估 LLM 与这些技术的对比，我们在51个近期 Java 项目、3种混淆器和6种上下文/检索设置上，评估了4个传统基线和3个 LLM（Qwen、OLMo 和 DeepSeek）的标识符检测与语义恢复能力。LLM 在两项任务上普遍优于传统技术，但受益于不同的上下文与设置：智能体式检索带来最佳检测效果，达到91.56% $F_1$；而包含类上下文通常在更高 token 成本下提升语义恢复。尽管有这些提升，整体精确恢复率峰值仅为16.42%（单跳上下文下），字段名为32.93%（仓库检索下），这是最容易恢复的。类标识符最难检测，在所有模型、设置和混淆器下的平均检测 $F_1$ 为48.48%。更多上下文并不总是有益：较大的方法反而阻碍语义恢复。除标识符重命名外，我们的实验表明控制流混淆比字符串加密对两项任务造成更大的性能下降。我们的发现为逆向工程师选择模型和上下文策略以反混淆代码片段提供了有用的实用洞察。
translation.brief: 评估 LLM 与传统技术在代码混淆标识符检测与语义恢复上的表现，核心方法是在多项目、多混淆器、多上下文/检索设置下进行系统对比实验。

papers.title: When Reviews Gate Access: Collusion, Sabotage and the Scale of Peer Review in the AI Submission Surge
papers.abstract: AI tools have helped push submissions to the largest machine-learning venues to tens of thousands per cycle. Venues have answered with rules that tie access to review: per-author caps, mandatory reciprocal reviewing, reviewer eligibility earned through accepted papers, and assignment based on reviewer bids. Under these rules a reviewer is also a competitor of the authors. We study two deviations that the rules make attractive. Sabotage lowers a competitor's score. Collusion raises an ally's score. We build an agent-based conference calibrated to public statistics of NeurIPS and ICLR and run 6,220 simulated conferences. Four results stand out. First, the two deviations do different harm and amplify each other. Collusion changes who is accepted, sabotage erodes what scores say about quality, and rings that may also sabotage gain more than rings that only collude. Second, under random assignment the chance that collusion changes a decision is set by one exposure index, $E = Rm/A$, the expected number of allies among a paper's reviewers. Growth therefore protects random assignment, but bidding removes the protection. In a pool of 3,000 reviewers a 20-member ring turns 0.8% of its papers into acceptances under random assignment and 71% when 30% of allies' bids are granted. Third, when agents choose their allies every cycle, caps at the inner layers of the social brain keep collusion nearly harmless. Without a cap agents ally with half of their area and accepted value falls by 35%. Fourth, reviewer eligibility tied to acceptances turns sabotage into a weapon of incumbents, and a longer eligibility window widens the gap between incumbents and newcomers only when sabotage is possible.

translation.title: 当评审把关准入：AI 投稿激增中的合谋、破坏与同行评审规模
translation.abstract: AI 工具已将最大机器学习会议的投稿推向每周期数万篇。各会议以将准入与评审挂钩的规则应对：每作者投稿上限、强制互惠审稿、通过录用论文获得的审稿资格、以及基于审稿人投标的分配。在这些规则下，审稿人同时也是作者的竞争者。我们研究这些规则使之变得有吸引力的两种偏离行为：破坏，降低竞争者的分数；合谋，提高盟友的分数。我们构建了一个依据 NeurIPS 和 ICLR 公开统计数据进行校准的基于智能体的会议模型，并运行了6,220次模拟会议。四个结果突出。第一，两种偏离造成不同的伤害且相互放大：合谋改变谁被录用，破坏侵蚀分数对质量的指示，可能同时破坏的团伙比仅合谋的团伙获益更多。第二，在随机分配下，合谋改变决策的概率由一个暴露指数 $E = Rm/A$（论文审稿人中盟友的期望数量）决定。因此扩容保护随机分配，但投标分配消除了这种保护：在3,000名审稿人的池中，一个20人的团伙在随机分配下将其0.8%的论文变为录用，而在30%盟友投标被满足时达到71%。第三，当智能体每个周期选择盟友时，社交网络内层的封顶使合谋几乎无害：无封顶时智能体与其半个领域结盟，录用价值下降35%。第四，与录用挂钩的审稿资格使破坏成为在位者的武器，且仅当破坏可能时，更长的资格窗口才会扩大在位者与新人之间的差距。
translation.brief: 研究同行评审准入规则下审稿人合谋与破坏对录用结果的影响，核心方法是构建校准于 NeurIPS/ICLR 统计数据的基于智能体的模拟会议并进行大规模仿真实验。

papers.title: Run, Read Back, Refine: Observation Fidelity in Execution-Grounded EDA Agents
papers.abstract: Design engineers lose the most time orchestrating flows and patching the gaps where closed EDA tools refuse to interoperate. We present an execution-grounded LLM agent for PyAether, SKILL, and Tcl that closes a generate-execute-refine loop over unified MCP tools (API retrieval, documentation, sandbox execution) and is already deployed in production EDA flows, with a grounding-gap framework positing that EDA-scripting correctness is bottlenecked by observation fidelity at the L4 (situated) layer, which model scale alone cannot reach. On EDA-Scripting-Bench (449 tasks, three languages, four commercial runtimes), the system reaches 76.5% pooled Pass@1 versus 19.7% (pure LLM): the system-level observation axis spans 56.8 percentage points with the model fixed, exceeding the 23.3-percentage-point backbone range with the harness fixed---two axes answering different questions; observation is an under-invested axis whose returns are measurable and graded.

translation.title: 运行、读回、精炼：基于执行接地 EDA 智能体中的观测保真度
translation.abstract: 设计工程师在编排流程和修补封闭 EDA 工具之间无法互操作的缺口上损失最多时间。我们提出一个面向 PyAether、SKILL 和 Tcl 的基于执行接地的 LLM 智能体，通过统一的 MCP 工具（API 检索、文档、沙箱执行）构建生成-执行-精炼闭环，并已部署于生产级 EDA 流程；同时提出接地缺口框架，认为 EDA 脚本编写的正确性瓶颈在于 L4（情境化）层的观测保真度，仅靠模型规模无法达到。在 EDA-Scripting-Bench（449个任务、三种语言、四个商业运行时）上，该系统达到76.5%的合并 Pass@1，而纯 LLM 为19.7%：在固定模型的情况下，系统级观测轴跨越56.8个百分点，超过固定框架下23.3个百分点的骨干模型范围——两个轴回答不同的问题；观测是一个研究不足的轴，其收益可测量且分级的。
translation.brief: 解决封闭 EDA 工具不互操作导致脚本编写困难的问题，核心方法是构建基于统一 MCP 工具的生成-执行-精炼闭环 LLM 智能体并验证观测保真度是正确性瓶颈。

papers.title: Large Language Models for AI Infrastructure
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to design, optimize, and operate the infrastructure behind AI training and serving, yet the literature remains fragmented across hardware design, machine learning systems, electronic design automation, and high-performance computing. We present a comprehensive survey of LLM-assisted AI infrastructure across its lifecycle, from accelerator design and kernel engineering to compilation, deployment, operations, data management, and energy optimization. We organize the literature by the primary resource the LLM manages: artifact-centric methods for computational artifacts, operational-centric methods for deployment context and system state, and resource-centric methods for data and energy. These categories span the lifecycle and cover AI-specific concerns such as distributed-training configuration, inference serving, GPU-cluster scheduling, and data loading. Building on this taxonomy, we conduct a cross-study quantitative synthesis of reported results. Because studies adopt heterogeneous benchmarks, baselines, hardware, and metrics, we compare methods only where evaluation conditions permit and align results along common dimensions: functional correctness, execution performance, throughput, resource and energy consumption, operational outcomes, and optimization cost, keeping each result's native metric, baseline, and setting rather than collapsing them into a single score. This comparison reveals where LLM-driven methods yield consistent gains, how reported gains in workload orchestration depend on the evaluation environment, from simulators to real clusters and production, and where evidence is still lacking. Together, the taxonomy, lifecycle perspective, and quantitative evaluation provide an evidence-grounded reference for LLM-driven engineering of AI infrastructure.

translation.title: 面向AI基础设施的大语言模型
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正被越来越多地用于设计、优化和运行AI训练与服务背后的基础设施，但相关文献分散在硬件设计、机器学习系统、电子设计自动化和高性能计算等领域。我们对LLM辅助的AI基础设施在其整个生命周期中的应用进行了全面综述，涵盖加速器设计与核函数工程、编译、部署、运维、数据管理和能耗优化。我们按LLM所管理的主要资源来组织文献：以产物为中心的方法（针对计算产物）、以运维为中心的方法（针对部署上下文与系统状态）、以资源为中心的方法（针对数据与能源）。这些类别贯穿整个生命周期，并涵盖AI特有的议题，如分布式训练配置、推理服务、GPU集群调度和数据加载。基于该分类体系，我们对已报告结果进行了跨研究的定量综合。由于各研究采用的基准、基线、硬件和指标各异，我们仅在评估条件允许的情况下比较各方法，并将结果沿着共同的维度对齐：功能正确性、执行性能、吞吐量、资源与能源消耗、运维结果以及优化成本，同时保留每个结果原有的指标、基线和设置，而非将其压缩为单一分数。这一比较揭示了LLM驱动方法在哪些方面能带来一致的收益、工作负载编排方面所报告的收益如何依赖于评估环境（从仿真器到真实集群和生产环境），以及证据在哪些方面仍然缺乏。分类体系、生命周期视角和定量评估共同为LLM驱动的AI基础设施工程提供了有证据支撑的参考。
translation.brief: 该论文系统综述了LLM在AI基础设施全生命周期中的应用，并提出了按资源划分的分类体系和跨研究的定量比较方法。

papers.title: Nahual: A Sequence Model for Language and Atoms
papers.abstract: Generative models play a rapidly growing role in the design and simulation of molecules. The most widely used applications of generative models are in large language models (LLMs), owing to the natural flexibility of language for specifying and answering queries. However, generalist LLMs do not effectively handle large sets of 3D coordinates, whereas specialist generative models of 3D molecules cannot reach the controllability afforded by language. To bridge these capabilities, we propose Nahual, a decoder-only autoregressive diffusion model for any sequence of text and 3D molecules. To enable expressive autoregression on continuous coordinates, we propose next-token diffusion, whereby a causal transformer denoises each token while attending to the clean tokens before it, without increasing context size. We train Nahual on a curated set of twelve 3D chemistry tasks ranging from microsolvation to molecular conformer search to adsorption on metal surfaces, with associated evaluation metrics and baselines. The result is a single set of end-to-end-trained weights that simultaneously performs all tasks and surpasses state-of-the-art models specialized for crystal structure prediction and property-conditional molecule generation. Our results demonstrate the viability of scaling generalist decoder-only models for native multimodal understanding and generation across language and chemistry. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: Nahual：面向语言与原子的序列模型
translation.abstract: 生成式模型在分子的设计与模拟中扮演着日益重要的角色。生成式模型最广泛的应用是大语言模型（LLM），这得益于语言在指定和回答查询方面天然的高灵活性。然而，通用型LLM无法有效处理大规模的三维坐标集合，而专业的三维分子生成模型又无法达到语言所赋予的可控性。为了衔接这两种能力，我们提出了Nahual——一个面向任意文本与三维分子序列的decoder-only自回归扩散模型。为了在连续坐标上实现有表达力的自回归，我们提出了next-token diffusion：由一个因果transformer在关注其之前干净token的同时对每个token进行去噪，而不增加上下文长度。我们在精心整理的十二项三维化学任务（涵盖微溶剂化、分子构象搜索、金属表面吸附等）上训练Nahual，并配有相应的评估指标和基线。最终得到的一套端到端训练权重可同时完成所有任务，并在晶体结构预测和性质条件分子生成方面超越各自领域的最先进专用模型。我们的结果证明了扩展通用型decoder-only模型以实现跨语言与化学的原生多模态理解与生成的可行性。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 该论文提出Nahual，一个结合next-token diffusion的decoder-only自回归扩散模型，可同时完成文本与三维分子多模态任务。

papers.title: Assume/Guarantee Contracts for the Compositional Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning of Heterogeneous Teams
papers.abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) problems for heterogeneous teams require agents to collaborate to complete team tasks while making the best use of diverse agent capabilities. We introduce assume/guarantee contracts for heterogeneous multi-agent systems (AGC-MAS) and Iterative Heterogeneous Assignment for MARL (IHA-MARL). AGC-MAS contracts are compositional objects that encode the assumptions provided to, and the guarantees required of, each subtask contributing to the overall team task. We formulate contracts as tuples that specify a subtask, an automaton, timeout and success-probability requirements, and dispatch behavior. The automaton tracks an agent's high-level progress through the subtask associated with its contract and provides a natural mechanism for synchronization across contracts. Our abstraction enables robust interaction across heterogeneous low-level subtask implementations, allows heterogeneous agents to substitute for one another in satisfying contracts, and supports reuse of previously satisfied contracts in new team contexts. Having defined our theoretical framework, we develop a decomposition algorithm that breaks down a team task into a set of contracts. We then propose an iterative algorithm for task assignment and MARL that alternates between assigning contracts representing subtasks to individual agents, training the assigned agents to satisfy their contracts, and assessing their resulting capabilities to inform the next round of task assignments until the team's success probability meets the desired threshold. Our experimental results demonstrate the versatility of contracts in enabling agent substitution and contract reuse. Across three benchmarks with five seeds each, IHA-MARL achieves observed $100\%$ final evaluation success. In CPU timing pilots, comparable baselines required approximately $7$--$11\times$ more training-loop time.

translation.title: 面向异构团队组合式多智能体强化学习的Assume/Guarantee合约
translation.abstract: 异构团队的多智能体强化学习（MARL）问题要求智能体协作完成团队任务，同时充分利用多样化的智能体能力。我们为异构多智能体系统引入assume/guarantee合约（AGC-MAS）以及面向MARL的迭代式异构任务分配方法（IHA-MARL）。AGC-MAS合约是组合式的对象，编码了对每个构成整体团队任务的子任务所提供的假设与所需满足的保证。我们将合约形式化为元组，包括子任务、一个自动机、超时与成功概率要求，以及调度行为。自动机跟踪智能体在其合约相关子任务上的高层进展，并提供了跨合约同步的自然机制。我们的抽象使得异构底层子任务实现之间能够稳健交互，允许异构智能体在满足合约时相互替代，并支持在新团队环境中复用先前已满足的合约。在定义了理论框架之后，我们开发了一个将团队任务分解为一组合约的分解算法。随后我们提出了一种迭代式任务分配与MARL算法，交替执行：将代表子任务的合约分配给各个智能体、训练被分配的智能体以满足其合约、评估其 resulting 能力以指导下一轮任务分配，直至团队成功概率达到目标阈值。实验结果证明了合约在实现智能体替换与合约复用方面的多功能性。在三个基准各五个随机种子下，IHA-MARL均达到了100%的最终评估成功率。在CPU计时试验中，可比基线需要约7至11倍的训练循环时间。
translation.brief: 该论文提出AGC-MAS合约框架与IHA-MARL迭代算法，通过assume/guarantee合约实现异构多智能体的任务分解、分配与替换复用。

papers.title: Beyond Benchmarks: Evaluating Large Language Models and Agentic Patterns for Static Code Analysis Warning Classification
papers.abstract: Context: Static Code Analysis (SCA) tools support software verification and validation, reducing the time and cost of code reviews. However, the best SCA tools in the practitioner community generate a high volume of false positives, which developers tend to ignore, leading to genuine warnings being overlooked. Accordingly, studies increasingly adopt Large Language Models (LLMs) to identify and reduce false positives. Existing studies have produced promising results on public datasets, but underperformed on unseen datasets. Moreover, researchers do not leverage the full potential of Agentic patterns in LLMs or incorporate established code quality standards for warning classification. Objectives: This study utilises four manually annotated datasets to evaluate the performance of three contemporary LLMs for SCA warning classification in real-world applications, and incorporates Agentic patterns and established coding standards to enhance models' performance, addressing gaps identified in existing studies. Method: Three LLMs were selected using the LiveCodeBench benchmark, and the Structured Chain-of-Thought (SCoT) prompting technique was used to evaluate these LLMs. Furthermore, we incorporated Agentic patterns, such as Debating and Self-Consistency, to potentially improve performance in SCA warning classification. Results: Our results show that the performance of different LLMs varies with the characteristics of the dataset, ranging from 0.52 to 0.96 F1-Score for the best models. Additionally, the use of Agentic patterns does not improve LLMs' performance in most scenarios. Conclusions: SCA warning classification using LLMs works best only with certain warning types. We recommend evaluating LLMs in real-world applications rather than using publicly available datasets/benchmarks to understand their full utility.

translation.title: 超越基准：评估大语言模型与Agentic模式在静态代码分析警告分类中的表现
translation.abstract: 背景：静态代码分析（SCA）工具支持软件验证与确认，可减少代码审查的时间和成本。然而，业界实践中最好的SCA工具会产生大量误报，开发人员往往会忽略它们，从而导致真正的警告被忽视。因此，越来越多研究采用大语言模型（LLM）来识别和减少误报。现有研究在公开数据集上取得了可喜的成果，但在未见过的数据集上表现欠佳。此外，研究人员没有充分利用LLM中Agentic模式的潜力，也未在警告分类中纳入成熟的代码质量标准。目标：本研究使用四个手工标注的数据集，评估三个当代LLM在真实应用中进行SCA警告分类的性能，并引入Agentic模式和成熟的编码标准来提升模型性能，以填补现有研究的空白。方法：通过LiveCodeBench基准选择三个LLM，并使用结构化思维链（SCoT）提示技术对其进行评估。此外，我们引入了Debating和Self-Consistency等Agentic模式，以期提升SCA警告分类的性能。结果：结果显示，不同LLM的性能随数据集特征而变化，最佳模型的F1分数在0.52到0.96之间。此外，在大多数场景下，Agentic模式并未提升LLM的性能。结论：基于LLM的SCA警告分类仅对某些警告类型效果最好。我们建议在真实应用中评估LLM，而非仅使用公开数据集/基准，以全面了解其实际效用。
translation.brief: 该论文评估三个LLM结合SCoT提示与Agentic模式在真实SCA警告分类数据集上的表现，发现模型性能依数据集而异且Agentic模式多数情况下无提升。

papers.title: When the Spec Sheet Lies: Injection Attacks on LLM-Generated Compliance Artifacts
papers.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become used more commonly across a variety of fields, a growing body of research has highlighted particular concerns surrounding model security. Notably, prompt injection attacks, where malicious instructions are inserted into prompts, are particularly simple to implement yet capable of inducing devastating effects on the fidelity of model outputs. While there is substantial research surrounding attack models and their effects on chat-based models, browser add-ons, and coding agents, the impact of these same attacks on industrial LLM-generated artifacts has been left largely unexplored. As LLM-enabled agents are increasingly used to skim and generate industrial documents such as Safety Data Sheets (SDS), Quality Control (QC) documents, and Digital Product Passports (DPP), it remains unclear how adversaries may influence these systems to manipulate generated compliance artifacts. This work aims to address this core inquiry by examining how a variety of prompt injection attacks can compromise LLMs with industrial document generation tasks. The study finds that injection attack success varies significantly across different models. Active falsification injections are most successful under all scenarios, while models tend to be most robust against passively injected override requests.

translation.title: 当规格书说谎：针对LLM生成的合规文档的注入攻击
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）在众多领域的应用日益普遍，越来越多的研究指出了围绕模型安全性的特定担忧。值得注意的是，提示注入攻击——即在提示中插入恶意指令——实现起来尤为简单，却可能对模型输出的保真度造成毁灭性影响。尽管围绕攻击模型及其对聊天模型、浏览器插件和编程智能体的影响已有大量研究，但此类攻击对工业界LLM生成文档的影响在很大程度上尚未被探索。随着LLM驱动的智能体越来越多地被用于浏览和生成工业文档，如安全数据表（SDS）、质量控制（QC）文档和数字产品护照（DPP），攻击者如何影响这些系统以操纵生成的合规文档仍不明确。本研究旨在通过考察多种提示注入攻击如何攻陷承担工业文档生成任务的LLM来回答这一核心问题。研究发现，注入攻击的成功率在不同模型间差异显著；主动伪造类注入在所有场景下成功率最高，而模型对被动注入的覆盖请求最为稳健。
translation.brief: 该论文研究提示注入攻击对LLM生成工业合规文档（如SDS、QC、DPP）的影响，发现主动伪造类注入攻击在所有场景下最易得逞。

papers.title: EEGHyena2: Fixation-Inspired Joint Lexical-Grammatical Conditional Random Field for Interpretable EEG-to-Text Decoding
papers.abstract: A sentence is built from words that carry lexical meaning and grammatical roles, and brain activity during reading reflects both. Current EEG-to-text decoders, however, let a large language model (LLM) propose and order the words, so fluent output can reflect the LLM's prior more than the recorded EEG. In this study, we asked whether fixation-linked EEG carries lexical and grammatical evidence during natural reading and how a decoder can use such evidence. Fixation-related potential analyses showed that content and function words differ reliably in group-averaged EEG but only weakly in single words. We therefore propose EEGHyena2, a structured decoder in which a bidirectional encoder inspired by StripedHyena 2 feeds a semantic head that ranks a fixed lexicon and a part-of-speech (POS) head that predicts grammatical categories; a joint word-POS conditional random field (CRF) scores a restricted candidate lattice, and a frozen Llama-2 scores the candidates in context. On two natural-reading corpora, ZuCo and ROAMM, it matched the state-of-the-art method on BLEU-1 (21.4 vs 21.3), exceeded it on ROUGE-1 F1 (23.3 vs 20.3), lowered the character error rate on ROAMM (75.3% vs 84.7%) and decoded each recording about 3-10 times faster than LLM candidate search. The CRF learned transitions that mirror English syntax, and the encoder drew local context from its convolutions and distant context from attention. Decoders can thus pool weak word-level EEG evidence across the sentence through explicit lexical and grammatical structure, with the language model adjudicating among candidates rather than generating them, which lowers decoding cost and keeps decisions inspectable.

translation.title: EEGHyena2：面向可解释EEG到文本解码的注视启发式词汇-语法联合条件随机场
translation.abstract: 句子由承载词汇意义和语法角色的词构成，阅读时的大脑活动同时反映两者。然而当前的EEG到文本解码器让大语言模型（LLM）提出并排序词，因此流畅的输出可能更多反映LLM的先验而非记录到的EEG。本研究探究注视相关的EEG在自然阅读中是否携带词汇与语法证据，以及解码器如何利用这些证据。注视相关电位分析表明，实词与虚词在群体平均EEG上差异可靠，但在单词层面差异较弱。为此我们提出EEGHyena2，一种结构化解码器：受StripedHyena 2启发的双向编码器输出两个头——对固定词库进行排序的语义头和预测词性类别的词性（POS）头；一个词-词性联合条件随机场（CRF）对受限候选格进行打分，冻结的Llama-2在上下文中对候选评分。在两个自然阅读语料库ZuCo和ROAMM上，该方法在BLEU-1上与最先进方法持平（21.4 vs 21.3），在ROUGE-1 F1上超过它（23.3 vs 20.3），在ROAMM上降低了字符错误率（75.3% vs 84.7%），且解码速度比LLM候选搜索快约3-10倍。CRF学到的转移与英语句法一致，编码器通过卷积获取局部上下文、通过注意力获取远距离上下文。因此，解码器可以通过显式的词汇和语法结构将微弱的词级EEG证据在整个句子上汇聚起来，由语言模型在候选之间裁决而非生成候选，这降低了解码成本并使决策可检查。
translation.brief: 针对EEG到文本解码过度依赖LLM生成的问题，提出一种由词汇打分与词性预测联合CRF加冻结LLM评分的结构化解码器EEGHyena2。

papers.title: Can Agentic LLMs Write Task-Based Parallel Code? A Study of OpenMP Tasking, HPX, StarPU and TTG
papers.abstract: Task-based programming offers more expressive power than loop-level parallelism, but the runtimes providing it differ widely in API style, maturity, and the amount of public code to learn from. This paper asks how well LLM agents write C++ for four of them: OpenMP Tasking, HPX, StarPU, and TTG. Instead of single one-shot prompts, we use an agentic workflow in which the model edits files, compiles, and runs its kernels until it reproduces a reference output. Five locally hosted open-weight LLM implement seven HPC kernels, including matrix multiplication, Cholesky and LU factorization, in all four frameworks and a serial baseline to verify their understanding of the problem in general. Every kernel is evaluated independently for correctness at each concurrency level, strong scaling, and peak memory. Model capability dominates the outcome: three models produce correct, genuinely task-parallel kernels in 57-82% of the cases, while two models rarely compile their own code and almost never succeed. For the capable models, OpenMP Tasking and HPX are handled most reliably, StarPU is close behind, and TTG trails. The best generated GEMM and factorization kernels match or exceed the multithreaded OpenBLAS/LAPACK reference. However, correctness overstates parallel quality: several "parallel" kernels contain no parallelism at all; and serialized task graphs and unsuitable task granularity remain common.

translation.title: 智能体LLM能否编写任务并行代码？对OpenMP Tasking、HPX、StarPU与TTG的研究
translation.abstract: 任务并行编程比循环级并行更具表达能力，但提供该能力的运行时在API风格、成熟度和可参考的公开代码量上差异巨大。本文研究LLM智能体为其中四种运行时编写C++代码的能力：OpenMP Tasking、HPX、StarPU和TTG。不同于单次一次性提示，我们采用智能体工作流：模型编辑文件、编译并运行其内核，直到复现参考输出。五个本地托管的开源权重LLM在四种框架及串行基线中实现了七个HPC内核（包括矩阵乘法、Cholesky和LU分解），串行基线用于验证其对问题的一般理解。每个内核在每个并发级别上独立评估正确性、强扩展性和峰值内存。模型能力主导结果：三个模型在57-82%的情况下产出正确的、真正任务并行的内核，而两个模型几乎无法编译自己的代码且几乎从不成功。对能力强的模型而言，OpenMP Tasking和HPX处理最可靠，StarPU紧随其后，TTG最差。最好的生成GEMM和分解内核可匹配或超过多线程OpenBLAS/LAPACK参考实现。然而正确性会高估并行质量：若干"并行"内核根本不含并行性；串行化的任务图和不当的任务粒度仍然常见。
translation.brief: 研究LLM智能体为四种任务并行运行时（OpenMP Tasking、HPX、StarPU、TTG）编写C++ HPC内核的能力，采用让模型自主编辑、编译、运行直至复现参考输出的智能体工作流进行评估。

papers.title: Guiding AI Agents to Generate Conjectures by Encoding How Theorems Build on One Another
papers.abstract: Recently, LLMs have been making headlines, and headway, in mathematical research. Much of this work focuses on proving existing open conjectures. Deciding what to prove is harder and less studied, because of the lack of a clear criterion for what makes a conjecture worth pursuing. We present a method for conjecture generation that builds on the observation that mathematical theorems build on one another: new theorems can modify the setting or hypotheses of earlier theorems, strengthen their conclusions, or extend their scope. We encode these relationships in a new kind of graph, the Theorem Evolution Graph (TEG), which we instantiate as an online search method for LLM agents. An agent builds a TEG in two steps: (1) identifying relevant theorems from papers found by following citations backward and forward from a seed paper; and (2) comparing those theorems to record how one builds on another. LLM judges and an expert mathematician preferred TEG-generated conjectures over those from an unconstrained baseline. LLM judges favored TEG conjectures for significance, ambition, and insight, and favored baseline conjectures for plausibility. Ablations suggest a benefit from constructing and using a TEG even when the available papers are fixed.

translation.title: 通过编码定理之间的构建关系来引导AI智能体生成猜想
translation.abstract: 近来LLM在数学研究中频频登上头条并取得进展，其中大量工作集中于证明已有的开放猜想。决定证明什么更困难且研究更少，因为缺乏判断猜想是否值得追求的明确标准。我们提出一种猜想生成方法，其基础是数学定理相互构建这一观察：新定理可以修改早期定理的设定或假设、加强其结论或扩展其范围。我们将这些关系编码在一个新型图——定理演化图（TEG）中，并将其实例化为LLM智能体的在线搜索方法。智能体分两步构建TEG：(1) 通过从种子论文沿引文向前和向后追溯，从找到的论文中识别相关定理；(2) 比较这些定理并记录它们之间的构建关系。LLM评审和一位专家数学家更偏好TEG生成的猜想而非无约束基线的猜想。LLM评审认为TEG猜想在重要性、抱负和洞见上更优，而认为基线猜想更可信。消融实验表明，即使在可用论文固定的情况下，构建和使用TEG仍有收益。
translation.brief: 针对LLM难以自行决定提出何种数学猜想的问题，提出定理演化图（TEG）方法，让智能体通过追溯引文并记录定理间的构建关系来引导猜想生成。

papers.title: Conditional Endorsement: Simulating How Adults with Different Skills Evaluate Canada's National AI Strategy
papers.abstract: Canada's 2026 national AI strategy, AI for All, commits to free AI training for everyone and to expanding business AI adoption, yet it is difficult to anticipate whether these policies will reach adults with uneven skills and circumstances. We ask how adults with diverse skills might rate these policies on support, effectiveness, and personal benefit, how their skills and circumstances shape these evaluations, and what implementation conditions they raise. We built 3,200 generative agents from a weighted sample of the Programme for the International Assessment of Adult Competencies (PIAAC) Cycle 2 respondents, collected their ratings and explanations for 20 policies, and analyzed dialogues between agents with contrasting ratings. The agents supported nearly every policy but were far less confident that they would improve adult AI literacy or benefit them personally. This gap widened as digital technology use declined: agents modeled on adults who had never used a digital device still endorsed the policies but rarely expected to benefit. Agents traced the gap to participation costs, hard-to-exercise rights, and limited community control, and their dialogues specified these conditions rather than resolving disagreement. We describe this pattern as conditional endorsement and argue that AI literacy policy should be designed and evaluated for adults with the fewest digital skills.

translation.title: 有条件的认可：模拟技能各异的成年人如何评价加拿大国家AI战略
translation.abstract: 加拿大2026年国家AI战略"AI for All"承诺为所有人提供免费AI培训并扩大企业AI采用，但难以预料这些政策能否惠及技能和处境不均的成年人。我们探究技能多样的成年人会如何在支持度、有效性和个人受益方面评价这些政策，其技能和处境如何塑造这些评价，以及他们提出哪些实施条件。我们基于国际成人能力评估项目（PIAAC）第二轮受访者的加权样本构建了3,200个生成式智能体，收集它们对20项政策的评分和解释，并分析评分相反的智能体之间的对话。智能体支持几乎所有政策，但对政策能否提升成人AI素养或使自己受益的信心远为不足。这一差距随数字技术使用减少而扩大：基于从未使用过数字设备的成年人建模的智能体仍认可这些政策，但很少预期自己会受益。智能体将差距归因于参与成本、难以行使的权利以及有限的社区控制，其对话明确了这些条件而非化解分歧。我们将这一模式称为"有条件的认可"，并主张AI素养政策应面向数字技能最少的成年人进行设计和评估。
translation.brief: 基于PIAAC数据构建3,200个生成式智能体，模拟不同技能水平的成年人对加拿大AI战略政策的评价，发现"有条件认可"现象并主张政策应服务数字技能最弱群体。

papers.title: Latency, Speech Recognition and Turn-Taking in Voice Agents for Spanish Phone Negotiation: An Externally Measured Comparison of Pipecat, LiveKit and GPT-Live
papers.abstract: A voice agent that negotiates by phone must answer quickly, understand spoken amounts and cope with a caller who talks over it. We compared three architectures for such an agent, negotiating freight rates in Spanish: two cascades (speech recognition, language model and speech synthesis) orchestrated by Pipecat and by LiveKit Agents, and GPT-Live, an OpenAI speech model that listens and speaks without separate stages. A program played the carrier with the same 47 recordings of one speaker for all agents, without the telephone network, in 77 calls per architecture over five negotiation scenarios, and measured latency on the listener's side with a validated instrument. Median latency to the content response was 2,616.0 ms (Pipecat), 3,090.0 ms (LiveKit) and 2,444.8 ms (GPT-Live); the confidence interval of GPT-Live's 171.2 ms advantage over Pipecat includes zero. According to its own timestamps, GPT-Live began to answer 800 ms after the end of the line, close to the 0.8 s published by OpenAI; most of the remaining wait, about 1,367 ms and nearly constant, is the audio's round trip through OpenAI's service. A tool call added 0.9-1.1 s in every architecture, more than any difference between them, and the frameworks' self-reported latency fell short of the listener's wait by 9% (Pipecat) and 22% (LiveKit). Word error rates were low (6.03, 4.93 and 1.47%), but the error on amounts was 13.01% and 12.61% in the cascades, against 2.86% in GPT-Live. With default settings, Pipecat and LiveKit stopped at almost every backchannel and often took it as the carrier's answer: an "ok" spoken over the agent ended in a registered agreement in 3 of 15 Pipecat calls, 2 of 15 LiveKit calls and no GPT-Live call (descriptive counts, not tested). Latency should therefore be measured on the listener's side, and a cascade needs safeguards for spoken amounts and backchannels.

translation.title: 西班牙语电话谈判语音智能体的延迟、语音识别与轮次切换：Pipecat、LiveKit与GPT-Live的外部测量比较
translation.abstract: 通过电话进行谈判的语音智能体必须快速应答、理解口语中的金额并应对打断它的来电者。我们比较了三种此类智能体架构，谈判场景为用西班牙语协商运费：由Pipecat和LiveKit Agents编排的两个级联架构（语音识别、语言模型和语音合成），以及GPT-Live——OpenAI的语音模型，无需独立阶段即可倾听和说话。程序使用同一位说话者的47条录音扮演承运方，所有智能体使用相同录音，不经过电话网络，每种架构在五个谈判场景中进行77次通话，并用经过验证的仪器从听者一侧测量延迟。内容响应的中位延迟为2,616.0 ms（Pipecat）、3,090.0 ms（LiveKit）和2,444.8 ms（GPT-Live）；GPT-Live相对Pipecat的171.2 ms优势的置信区间包含零。据其自身时间戳，GPT-Live在线路结束后800 ms开始应答，接近OpenAI公布的0.8 s；剩余等待时间的大部分约1,367 ms且几乎恒定，是音频在OpenAI服务中的往返。工具调用在每种架构中都增加0.9-1.1 s，超过架构间的任何差异，且框架自报延迟与听者实际等待的偏差为9%（Pipecat）和22%（LiveKit）。词错误率较低（6.03%、4.93%和1.47%），但两个级联架构对金额的错误率为13.01%和12.61%，而GPT-Live仅为2.86%。在默认设置下，Pipecat和LiveKit几乎在每次附和时都停止，且常将其当作承运方的回答：智能体说话时插入的"ok"在15次Pipecat通话中的3次、15次LiveKit通话中的2次导致被登记为协议达成，而GPT-Live没有（描述性计数，未做检验）。因此延迟应在听者一侧测量，级联架构需要针对口语金额和附和的防护机制。
translation.brief: 针对电话谈判语音智能体的架构选择问题，通过程序化西班牙语运费谈判通话从听者侧外部测量比较Pipecat、LiveKit与GPT-Live的延迟、金额识别与打断处理表现。

papers.title: Agent-Guided Process Verification for Mathematical Self-Correction
papers.abstract: Large language models have made substantial progress in mathematical reasoning, yet in complex multi-step reasoning, an error at any step may propagate along an incorrect path, and the resulting solution may omit necessary branches. Existing natural-language reflection methods often struggle to locate critical errors precisely, while outcome verification typically checks only whether the available candidate answers satisfy the problem conditions and can therefore overlook necessary branches. To address these limitations, we propose Agent-Guided Process Verification (AGPV) for mathematical self-correction. AGPV decomposes the current solution into an ordered sequence of key claims, verifies them individually while invoking a shared mathematical toolbox when needed, and stops upon detecting the first error. A summarization agent converts the failure evidence into a diagnosis that guides a correction agent to re-derive the subsequent solution from that point; AGPV then adapts the next verification iteration to the revised solution. AGPV also verifies solution completeness. We further prove that AGPV guarantees solution correctness and completeness when key claims provide sufficient coverage and local verification is reliable, provided that all key claims pass verification. The implementation compresses long working contexts and reuses successful tool results within each problem. We evaluate AGPV on five challenging mathematical reasoning datasets with four models from DeepSeek, Qwen, and GPT. AGPV achieves an average accuracy of 63.8%, outperforming the strongest among the representative baselines evaluated (50.3%) by 13.5 percentage points, with higher repair coverage than the programmatic-verification baselines.

translation.title: 面向数学自我纠错的智能体引导过程验证
translation.abstract: 大语言模型在数学推理方面已取得长足进步，但在复杂的多步推理中，任何一步出错都可能沿错误路径传播，且所得解可能遗漏必要分支。现有的自然语言反思方法往往难以精确定位关键错误，而结果验证通常只检查现有候选答案是否满足题目条件，因而可能遗漏必要分支。针对这些局限，我们提出面向数学自我纠错的智能体引导过程验证（AGPV）。AGPV 将当前解分解为有序的关键论断序列，逐条验证并在需要时调用共享数学工具箱，在检测到第一个错误时停止。一个摘要智能体将失败证据转化为诊断信息，引导纠错智能体从该点重新推导后续解；AGPV 随后根据修订后的解调整下一次验证迭代。AGPV 还验证解的完备性。我们进一步证明，当关键论断提供足够覆盖且局部验证可靠时，若所有关键论断通过验证，AGPV 可保证解的正确性与完备性。在实现上，AGPV 压缩冗长的工作上下文，并在每个问题内复用成功的工具结果。我们在五个具有挑战性的数学推理数据集上，使用来自 DeepSeek、Qwen 和 GPT 的四个模型评估 AGPV。AGPV 达到 63.8% 的平均准确率，超过所评估的代表性基线中最强者（50.3%）13.5 个百分点，且修复覆盖率高于程序化验证基线。
translation.brief: 该论文解决数学推理中错误定位不准与解不完备的问题，核心方法是将解分解为关键论断逐条验证并据此引导自我纠错的智能体引导过程验证框架（AGPV）。

papers.title: Beyond Plain MCP: Do Decision Models and Code Mode Make Tool Use Cheaper and Faster?
papers.abstract: Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateways manage tool catalogs for language model agents using two primary paradigms: code mode where agents write scripts against tool stubs and decision layers which are cheap routers that preselect tool subsets. Using a controlled harness across 12 servers, up to 1,958 distractor tools, and three open-weight agents including Qwen, Gemma, and Nemotron, we present a preregistered evaluation on a sealed test split to determine when each approach succeeds. Code mode substantially outperforms plain MCP, cutting token usage by 70 to 90 percent while significantly boosting utility. Declaring return-shape hints in code mode stubs is a first-order variable, swinging success by up to 39.5 points for lower-performing agents, an effect larger than adding a router. The central hypothesis that a decision layer in front of code mode beats code mode alone is not confirmed, showing minor, statistically non-significant improvements for weaker agents and a slight cost for the strongest. We publicly release our harness, a finetuned 4B tool selection model, and all evaluation traces to support robust community experimentation on local AI privacy and agent architectures.

translation.title: 超越朴素 MCP：决策模型与代码模式能让工具调用更便宜、更快速吗？
translation.abstract: Model Context Protocol（MCP）网关为语言模型智能体管理工具目录，主要采用两种范式：代码模式（智能体针对工具桩编写脚本）和决策层（预选工具子集的廉价路由器）。我们使用一个受控测试平台，涵盖 12 个服务器、最多 1,958 个干扰工具，以及 Qwen、Gemma 和 Nemotron 三个开源权重智能体，在密封测试集上进行预注册评估，以确定每种方法何时有效。代码模式显著优于朴素 MCP，将 token 使用量降低 70% 至 90%，同时大幅提升实用性。在代码模式工具桩中声明返回结构提示是一阶变量，可使较低性能智能体的成功率波动高达 39.5 个百分点，其影响大于添加路由器。核心假设——在代码模式前加决策层优于单独的代码模式——未获证实：对较弱智能体仅有微小且统计不显著的改进，对最强智能体反而略有代价。我们公开发布测试平台、一个微调的 4B 工具选择模型以及所有评估轨迹，以支持社区在本地 AI 隐私与智能体架构方面进行稳健的实验。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 MCP 网关中何种工具调用范式更高效的问题，核心方法是构建受控基准对代码模式与决策路由层进行预注册对比评估。

papers.title: Low-Latency LLM-Based Streaming Multi-Talker ASR with Verifiable Rewards
papers.abstract: LLM-based architectures offer strong generalization and instruction-following capabilities for streaming automatic speech recognition (ASR), but multi-talker use introduces coupled transcription, attribution, and latency challenges. Our wearable setting requires real-time transcription of a conversation between a near-field device wearer and a far-field partner. Because partial hypotheses are rendered on persistent sides of a dialogue UI, speaker roles cannot be permuted and each speaker tag must precede its turn. These sparse tags are weakly optimized by supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while committing to a leading tag can delay the text that follows. We therefore post-train a streaming LLM-based ASR model with reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), combining a fixed-role Speaker-Attributed WER (SA-WER) grader with a turn-level onset-delay reward. On an eight-direction multi-talker cohort, SA-WER RL reduces SA-WER from $20.51\%$ for SFT to $13.14\%$. Adding the delay objective reduces onset $p50$ by $65\%$ (from $0.918\,\text{s}$ to $0.320\,\text{s}$) and $p90$ by $44\%$ (from $1.389\,\text{s}$ to $0.780\,\text{s}$) relative to SA-WER-only RL, while achieving $12.70\%$ SA-WER. These results demonstrate that fixed-role recognition quality and streaming responsiveness can be improved jointly.

translation.title: 基于低延迟 LLM 的可验证奖励流式多说话人语音识别
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的架构为流式自动语音识别（ASR）提供了强大的泛化和指令遵循能力，但多说话人场景带来了转录、说话人归属与延迟相互耦合的挑战。我们的可穿戴场景需要实时转录近场设备佩戴者与远场对象之间的对话。由于部分假设被渲染在对话 UI 的固定侧边，说话人角色不可交换，且每个说话人标签必须先于其对应的话轮出现。这些稀疏标签在监督微调（SFT）下只得到弱优化，而过早提交标签又会延迟后续文本。因此，我们使用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）对基于 LLM 的流式 ASR 模型进行后训练，结合固定角色的说话人归属 WER（SA-WER）评分器与话轮级起始延迟奖励。在一个八方向多说话人数据集上，SA-WER RL 将 SA-WER 从 SFT 的 20.51% 降至 13.14%。加入延迟目标后，相对于仅用 SA-WER 的 RL，起始延迟 p50 降低 65%（从 0.918 秒降至 0.320 秒），p90 降低 44%（从 1.389 秒降至 0.780 秒），同时达到 12.70% 的 SA-WER。这些结果表明固定角色识别质量与流式响应性可以联合提升。
translation.brief: 该论文解决流式多说话人 ASR 中说话人归属与延迟耦合的难题，核心方法是用可验证奖励的强化学习联合优化 SA-WER 评分器与起始延迟奖励。

papers.title: When the Mythical Man-Month Meets Agentic Web Systems: Structured Coordination for Scalable Development
papers.abstract: As agentic systems are increasingly deployed to support complex Web tasks, multi-agent architectures offer greater parallelism, specialization, and task coverage. However, increasing the number of agents does not necessarily improve system performance, as communication, synchronization, redundant work, and coordination overhead may offset the benefits of additional agents. This presents a fundamental scaling challenge for agentic Web systems: how can agent populations be organized to balance task performance and coordination costs? To address this challenge, we systematically investigate the relationship between agent population size, per-agent token consumption, and coordination overhead in collaborative agentic systems. Experiments on complex Web-oriented software development tasks reveal a non-linear scaling pattern: per-agent token consumption initially decreases as the agent population grows, but eventually exhibits diminishing returns. Motivated by these findings, we introduce the Surgical Team Model (STM), a structured coordination framework that organizes agents through role specialization, constrained inter-agent communication, and coordinator-mediated task aggregation. Experiments on full-stack Web application development tasks show that STM achieves competitive task completion quality and comparable token consumption relative to representative baselines, while incurring higher execution latency.

translation.title: 当人月神话遇上智能体化 Web 系统：面向可扩展开发的结构化协调
translation.abstract: 随着智能体系统被越来越多地部署以支持复杂 Web 任务，多智能体架构提供了更强的并行性、专业化和任务覆盖能力。然而，增加智能体数量并不一定能提升系统性能，因为通信、同步、冗余工作和协调开销可能抵消额外智能体带来的收益。这给智能体化 Web 系统提出了一个根本性的扩展难题：如何组织智能体群体以平衡任务性能与协调成本？为应对这一挑战，我们系统研究了协作智能体系统中智能体规模、单智能体 token 消耗与协调开销之间的关系。在复杂 Web 导向软件开发任务上的实验揭示了一种非线性扩展模式：单智能体 token 消耗最初随智能体数量增加而下降，但最终呈现收益递减。基于这些发现，我们提出外科手术团队模型（STM），一种通过角色专业化、受限智能体间通信以及协调者介导的任务聚合来组织智能体的结构化协调框架。在全栈 Web 应用开发任务上的实验表明，STM 相对于代表性基线取得了有竞争力的任务完成质量和相近的 token 消耗，但执行延迟更高。
translation.brief: 该论文解决多智能体系统中智能体规模与协调开销难以平衡的问题，核心方法是通过角色专业化、受限通信和协调者聚合来结构化组织智能体的外科手术团队模型（STM）。

papers.title: Personalized Language Models for One-to-Many Private Communications
