papers.abstract: We study relationship-specific continual reply prediction for one-to-many private communication: a system predicts an author's reply to a recurring contact and updates its personalization state when the actual reply becomes available. We propose TRACE (Temporal Relationship-Aware Communication Evolution), which uses author-level lexical habits, contact-specific wording, and temporal expression estimates to guide a frozen language model, with a feedback-driven policy controlling revision. On 216 test emails from eight Enron users, all four main TRACE configurations achieve higher mean BLEU, ROUGE-L, and BERTScore and lower mean Reply Style MSE than Base LLM and Base RAG. Component ablations show mixed effects and do not establish statistically reliable improvements in Reply Style MSE after multiple-comparison correction. More accurate state forecasts and larger revision budgets do not consistently improve reply-level metrics. These exploratory findings expose the challenge of turning evolving relationship-specific expression estimates into useful generation guidance.

translation.title: 面向一对多私密通信的个性化语言模型
translation.abstract: 我们研究一对多私密通信中面向特定关系的持续回复预测：系统预测作者对某位固定联系人的回复，并在实际回复可得时更新其个性化状态。我们提出 TRACE（Temporal Relationship-Aware Communication Evolution），利用作者级词汇习惯、联系人特定措辞以及时间表达估计来引导冻结的语言模型，并由反馈驱动的策略控制修订。在来自八位 Enron 用户的 216 封测试邮件上，TRACE 的全部四种主要配置相比 Base LLM 和 Base RAG 取得了更高的平均 BLEU、ROUGE-L 和 BERTScore，以及更低的平均 Reply Style MSE。组件消融实验显示效果不一，且在多重比较校正后未能确立 Reply Style MSE 的统计可靠改进。更准确的状态预测和更大的修订预算并未持续改善回复级指标。这些探索性发现揭示了将不断演化的关系特定表达估计转化为有效生成引导的挑战。
translation.brief: 该论文解决为一对多私密通信预测特定关系回复的问题，核心方法是利用词汇习惯、联系人措辞和时间表达估计引导冻结语言模型的 TRACE 框架。

papers.title: FundingClaw: Automated Grant Proposal Writing Agents System
papers.abstract: Grant proposal writing remains a manual, labor-intensive bottleneck: proposals must satisfy rigid, agency-specific templates, and the same intellectual content must be repeatedly re-encoded into incompatible formats across funding organizations. We introduce FundingClaw, a multi-agent framework built on template-driven skill selection, where a Template Parser ingests any agency's specification and selects the appropriate writing skills for each stage, so that one research brief can produce compliant proposals for NSFC, NSF, KAKENHI, or ERC without modifying generation logic. A blueprint-skeleton strategy drafts a structured outline before any prose is written, mitigating the semantic drift that plagues long-form generation. Three sequential stages produce the rationale, research content, and research foundation sections, with multi-source verification of the PI's record and optional PDF-grounded extraction of representative works. Optional human feedback checkpoints and a closed-loop self-review complete the pipeline. Evaluated on ten research topics with an eight-dimension rubric, FundingClaw outperforms the baseline, narrowing the gap with human level for laborious funding proposal. The code will be released upon acceptance.

translation.title: FundingClaw：自动化科研基金申请书撰写智能体系统
translation.abstract: 基金申请书撰写仍是手工、劳动密集型的瓶颈：申请书必须满足严格的、资助机构特定的模板要求，同一学术内容需在不同资助机构间反复重编码为互不兼容的格式。我们提出FundingClaw，一个基于模板驱动技能选择的多智能体框架，其中模板解析器可摄入任意机构的规范，并为各阶段选择合适的写作技能，使一份研究简报无需修改生成逻辑即可产出符合NSFC、NSF、KAKENHI或ERC要求的申请书。蓝图-骨架策略在任何正文写作前先起草结构化大纲，缓解长文本生成中常见的语义漂移问题。三个顺序阶段分别生成立项依据、研究内容与研究基础部分，并对申请人的履历进行多源核验，可选地基于PDF提取代表性成果。可选的人工反馈检查点与闭环自审完成整个流程。在十个研究主题上以八维评分标准进行评估，FundingClaw优于基线，缩小了与人工撰写费力基金申请书之间的差距。代码将在录用后发布。
translation.brief: 为解决基金申请书需适配各资助机构不同模板的重复劳动问题，提出模板驱动的多智能体框架，通过蓝图-骨架策略与分阶段生成自动产出合规申请书。

papers.title: A Unified Control Framework, Mathematical Model, and Five-layer Closed-loop Case Study for Embodied Intelligence Control Systems
papers.abstract: Embodied intelligence holds that an agent develops cognition and behavior through real-time body-environment interaction, so its control system must tightly couple perception, decision making, learning, optimization, constraints, and physical execution. This report asks whether a unified framework exists, how its mathematical models unify, and how the framework is realized computably. Four conclusions emerge. (1) No single framework is accepted, but the field converges on a common skeleton: from operational-space and whole-body control to MPC, reinforcement learning, active inference, and diffusion/flow policies, all reduce to constrained sequential decision making on the configuration manifold. (2) Two languages describe it-deterministic optimal control (Euler-Lagrange plus constrained OCP, reduced in real time to a QP) and probabilistic inference (MDP/POMDP plus free-energy minimization)-rigorously bridged by control as inference and KL/path-integral control. (3) Engineering unification is already achieved by constrained optimization; the new frontier is cross-morphology, cross-task shared representation. (4) The hardest gap is provable stability and safety, the entry point for spectral, geometric, differentiable-optimization, and safe-learning methods. A single-link manipulator then runs through all five layers: L4 parses the instruction into a reference, L3 identifies a Koopman lifted linear world model, L2 solves a receding constrained QP, L1 adds torque saturation and a CBF, and L0 is the true nonlinear plant. Closed-loop tracking RMSE is 0.0218 rad with all constraints satisfied and a world-model error near 5 x 10^-6 rad, reported with curves and a 3D animation.

translation.title: 具身智能控制系统的统一控制框架、数学模型与五层闭环案例研究
translation.abstract: 具身智能认为智能体通过实时的身体-环境交互发展认知与行为，因此其控制系统必须紧密耦合感知、决策、学习、优化、约束与物理执行。本报告探讨是否存在统一框架、其数学模型如何统一、以及该框架如何可计算地实现。得出四点结论：(1) 尚无公认的唯一框架，但领域收敛于共同骨架：从操作空间与全身控制到MPC、强化学习、主动推断以及扩散/流策略，都可归结为构型流形上的约束序贯决策。(2) 两种语言可描述它——确定性最优控制（Euler-Lagrange加约束OCP，实时约简为QP）与概率推断（MDP/POMDP加自由能最小化）——由control as inference与KL/路径积分控制严格桥接。(3) 工程层面的统一已由约束优化实现；新的前沿是跨形态、跨任务的共享表征。(4) 最困难的缺口是可证明的稳定性与安全性，是谱方法、几何方法、可微优化与安全学习的切入点。随后单连杆机械臂贯穿全部五层：L4将指令解析为参考，L3辨识Koopman提升的线性世界模型，L2求解滚动约束QP，L1加入力矩饱和与CBF，L0为真实非线性被控对象。闭环跟踪RMSE为0.0218弧度，所有约束均满足，世界模型误差约5×10^-6弧度，并附曲线与3D动画。
translation.brief: 为回答具身智能控制是否存在统一框架的问题，系统梳理其数学模型归约路径，并用五层闭环的单连杆机械臂案例给出可计算实现。

papers.title: What Moves a LoCoMo Score? Memory Context, Answer Prompts and Judges
papers.abstract: LoCoMo is a widely reported benchmark for long-term conversational memory, but published scores mix memory quality with choices of answer prompt, judge and baseline layout that are rarely reported together. We measure how much these choices move a score, and evaluate Becos, a team memory system for coding agents, as a black box under all of them: ten conversations (1,540 questions), two answer models (gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4.1-mini), two answer prompts and three LLM judges, against a whole-conversation baseline rerun under identical conditions. Changing only the judge moves a score by up to 7.2 points and changing only the answer prompt by up to 9.3. A blind human check of 150 answers finds the judges reliable when they agree, and the primary judge's errors on disputed answers working against Becos rather than for it. Becos answers from a context with 90% fewer characters than the whole conversation. Its configuration was developed on LoCoMo itself, so there is no held-out set. With gpt-4o-mini answers it scores clearly higher than the whole conversation (79.7 vs 73.0 with the short prompt, paired 95% interval for the difference +3.8 to +9.5; 88.8 vs 77.5 with a step-by-step prompt). With gpt-4.1-mini answers the two score about the same (83.2 vs 83.1; 92.5 vs 92.1). We release every answer and verdict and the scoring script.

translation.title: 是什么影响了LoCoMo分数？记忆上下文、答案提示与评判模型
translation.abstract: LoCoMo是被广泛报告的长期对话记忆基准，但已发表的分数混合了记忆质量与很少一并报告的答案提示、评判模型和基线设置的选择。我们测量这些选择对分数的影响程度，并将面向编程智能体的团队记忆系统Becos作为黑盒在所有这些设置下评估：十个对话（1,540个问题）、两个答案模型（gpt-4o-mini、gpt-4.1-mini）、两个答案提示与三个LLM评判模型，并在相同条件下重跑全对话基线。仅更换评判模型可使分数变动最多7.2分，仅更换答案提示最多9.3分。对150个答案的盲测人工核查表明，评判模型一致时是可靠的，且主评判模型在争议答案上的错误不利于而非有利于Becos。Becos使用的上下文字符数比全对话少90%。其配置本身就是在LoCoMo上开发的，因此没有保留测试集。使用gpt-4o-mini答案时，其得分明显高于全对话（短提示下79.7 vs 73.0，配对95%差异区间+3.8至+9.5；分步提示下88.8 vs 77.5）。使用gpt-4.1-mini答案时两者得分相当（83.2 vs 83.1；92.5 vs 92.1）。我们发布全部答案、评判结果与评分脚本。
translation.brief: 为厘清LoCoMo基准分数受提示、评判模型等评测设置影响的程度，系统测量各设置引起的分数变化并评估记忆系统Becos。

papers.title: Omni-Workspace: Benchmarking Omni-Modal AI Assistants on Multimodal Workspace Tasks
papers.abstract: Omni-modal agents are expected to move beyond multimodal understanding toward completing complex tasks in realistic multimodal environments. In these settings, information is distributed across heterogeneous files and modalities, with cross-file and cross-modal dependencies requiring agents to continually coordinate perception, reasoning, and tool use as newly gathered evidence informs subsequent actions. However, existing omni-modal benchmarks primarily focus on multimodal perception and understanding, leaving complex task completion through sustained interaction with multimodal workspaces underexplored. We introduce Omni-Workspace, a benchmark comprising 380 deep-research-style tasks across four multimodal workspace types and two difficulty levels. These tasks require agents to inspect and process workspace files, retrieve external information when needed, integrate evidence across files and modalities, and produce artifacts satisfying explicit requirements. Evaluating 18 representative models reveals limitations in long-horizon multimodal workspace execution, with the best model scoring only 65.93 on average. Further analysis identifies multimodal context inflation and task-state drift as recurring challenges. Motivated by these findings, we further propose OmniFocus, a lightweight approach combining multimodal working-memory management with explicit task-state tracking to improve performance and efficiency. Omni-Workspace advances the evaluation and development of omni-modal agents toward autonomous completion of complex tasks in multimodal workspaces.

translation.title: Omni-Workspace：在多模态工作区任务上评测全模态AI助手
translation.abstract: 全模态智能体被期望超越多模态理解，在现实的多模态环境中完成复杂任务。在这些环境中，信息分布于异构文件与模态之中，跨文件、跨模态的依赖要求智能体随着新收集的证据影响后续行动而持续协调感知、推理与工具使用。然而现有全模态基准主要聚焦于多模态感知与理解，对通过与多模态工作区持续交互完成复杂任务的探索不足。我们提出Omni-Workspace，一个包含380个深度研究式任务的基准，覆盖四种多模态工作区类型和两个难度级别。这些任务要求智能体检查和处理工作区文件、按需检索外部信息、整合跨文件与跨模态的证据，并产出满足明确要求的产物。对18个代表性模型的评估揭示了智能体在长时程多模态工作区执行上的局限，最佳模型平均仅得65.93分。进一步分析发现多模态上下文膨胀与任务状态漂移是反复出现的挑战。基于这些发现，我们进一步提出OmniFocus，一种结合多模态工作记忆管理与显式任务状态追踪的轻量方法，以提升性能与效率。Omni-Workspace推动全模态智能体在多模态工作区中自主完成复杂任务的评测与发展。
translation.brief: 为弥补现有基准缺少多模态工作区复杂任务完成评测的空白，构建380个任务的Omni-Workspace基准，并针对发现的上下文膨胀与任务状态漂移问题提出OmniFocus方法。

papers.title: Site-Specific Cell Shaping: An Agentic Framework
papers.abstract: An agentic framework is proposed for cell shaping in future sixth-generation (6G) wireless network planning. Cell shaping controls the coverage and interferences of base stations (BSs) through antenna parameters configuration, providing an important means of improving coverage. In contrast to conventional approaches that reply on costly performance evaluations, the proposed framework achieves intelligent and efficient antenna configuration through a perception-reasoning-reflection loop. Specifically, a Configuration Agent combines scene information, evaluation history, and reflection feedback to generate antenna configuration proposals. Then, a ray tracing(RT)-based evaluator assesses these proposals and returns a structured performance summary. Next, a Reflection Agent interprets these results to diagnose site-specific performance deficiencies, recommend feasible configuration adjustments, and accumulate conditional experience. Through this iterative process, the framework accumulates site-specific experience and progressively refines antenna configurations without human-in-the-loop intervention. Simulations in real-world urban scenarios demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves lower outage probabilities than the considered benchmark methods, highlighting the effectiveness of agentic reasoning and reflection in translating site-specific performance feedback and accumulated experience into adaptive antenna configuration decisions.

translation.title: 面向站点的蜂窝小区赋形：一种智能体框架
translation.abstract: 面向未来第六代（6G）无线网络规划中的小区赋形，提出一种智能体框架。小区赋形通过天线参数配置控制基站的覆盖与干扰，是提升覆盖的重要手段。与传统依赖昂贵性能评估的方法不同，所提框架通过感知-推理-反思循环实现智能化、高效的天线配置。具体而言，配置智能体结合场景信息、评估历史与反思反馈生成天线配置提案；随后基于射线追踪（RT）的评估器评估这些提案并返回结构化的性能摘要；接着反思智能体解读这些结果，诊断特定站点的性能缺陷，建议可行的配置调整，并积累条件化经验。通过这一迭代过程，框架积累站点特定经验并逐步优化天线配置，无需人工介入。真实城市场景的仿真表明，所提框架相比所考虑的基准方法取得更低的中断概率，凸显了智能体推理与反思在将站点性能反馈和积累经验转化为自适应天线配置决策方面的有效性。
translation.brief: 为解决6G网络规划中小区赋形依赖昂贵性能评估的问题，提出感知-推理-反思循环的智能体框架，结合射线追踪评估器自适应优化天线配置。

papers.title: STaSBO: LLM-Guided Strategy Planning and Configuration Selection for Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) enables sample-efficient search for expensive black-box problems, but its performance depends strongly on surrogate-acquisition configurations whose suitability varies across problems and optimization states. We take a significant step toward LLM-driven strategic management of BO with STaSBO, a task-agnostic meta-controller that plans search behavior and jointly selects surrogate-acquisition configurations, while numerical BO retains responsibility for probabilistic modeling and candidate generation. STaSBO comprises two coordinated stages: strategy planning and strategy-guided configuration selection. A structured memory system connects prior plans, configuration selections, and candidate behaviors to optimization states, allowing the controller to revise its trajectory summary and behavioral plans during planning. To navigate the large joint configuration space, the selection stage shortlists configurations using surrogate fit evidence. Prospective BO-action diagnostics then expose the candidate behaviors, supporting final joint selection against the behavioral plans. Across 12 synthetic mathematical and 10 scientific and engineering application tasks, STaSBO achieves the best average rank against 11 baselines: 2.17 and 2.60, compared with 4.08 and 4.10 for the strongest baseline in each suite, respectively.

translation.title: STaSBO：基于LLM引导的策略规划与配置选择的贝叶斯优化
translation.abstract: 贝叶斯优化（BO）能够对昂贵的黑盒问题进行样本高效的搜索，但其性能在很大程度上取决于代理模型-采集函数配置，而这些配置的适用性因问题和优化状态而异。我们通过STaSBO向LLM驱动的BO战略管理迈出重要一步：STaSBO是一个任务无关的元控制器，负责规划搜索行为并联合选择代理-采集配置，同时数值BO仍负责概率建模和候选点生成。STaSBO包含两个协同阶段：策略规划和策略引导的配置选择。一个结构化记忆系统将先前的规划、配置选择和候选点行为与优化状态相连接，使控制器能够在规划过程中修正其轨迹摘要和行为规划。为了在巨大的联合配置空间中进行导航，选择阶段利用代理拟合证据筛选出候选配置。随后，前瞻性的BO动作诊断揭示候选行为，支持依据行为规划进行最终联合选择。在12个合成数学任务和10个科学与工程应用任务上，STaSBO相对11个基线取得了最佳平均排名：分别为2.17和2.60，而每个任务套件中最强基线分别为4.08和4.10。
translation.brief: 针对贝叶斯优化中代理-采集配置难以适配不同问题与优化状态的问题，提出用LLM作为元控制器进行策略规划并联合选择配置的方法STaSBO。

papers.title: Revisiting What Makes a Good Context Subset: A Sparse Latent Basis Perspective
papers.abstract: Selecting context subsets is increasingly important in modern LLM inference, yet what makes a subset effective remains unclear. We study this question in the controlled setting of few-shot demonstration selection. We examine a hypothesis that demonstrations should collectively provide task-relevant information needed by a target query. Assuming that the query representation provides a useful proxy for these requirements, we formulate selection as sparse reconstruction and instantiate it with Residual Explanation Search (RES), a Matching-Pursuit-style diagnostic procedure. Across seven benchmarks and eight open-weight LLMs, no retrieval objective is universally best. RES outperforms MMR in 34 of 56 model--dataset pairs, with its clearest advantage on sentiment tasks, suggesting that query-conditioned collective reconstruction may capture useful complementarity that pairwise dissimilarity misses. Relevance-based retrieval remains strong on template-heavy reasoning benchmarks, while all retrieval methods underperform zero-shot prediction on average on StrategyQA, where a solution-reconstruction analysis is consistent with the query not exposing the required external knowledge. Target-model hidden states further show that retrieval objectives interact differently with representation spaces: middle-layer representations generally favor similarity retrieval, whereas last-layer representations are often stronger for residual- and diversity-based selection. These findings support a conditional, representation-dependent account of context subset quality rather than a universally superior selector.

translation.title: 重新审视何为良好的上下文子集：稀疏潜在基视角
translation.abstract: 在现代LLM推理中，选择上下文子集日益重要，但什么样的子集是有效的仍不清楚。我们在少样本示例选择的受控环境中研究这一问题。我们检验一个假设：示例应集体提供目标查询所需的与任务相关的信息。假设查询表示能作为这些需求的有用代理，我们将选择形式化为稀疏重构，并用残差解释搜索（RES）加以实现——这是一种Matching-Pursuit风格的诊断程序。在七个基准和八个开源权重LLM上，没有任何检索目标是普遍最优的。RES在56个模型-数据集对中的34个上优于MMR，其在情感任务上的优势最为明显，这表明以查询为条件的集体重构可能捕捉到成对不相似性所遗漏的有用互补性。基于相关性的检索在模板化重的推理基准上依然强劲，而在StrategyQA上，所有检索方法平均都不及零样本预测，其中解的重构分析与查询未暴露所需外部知识的解释一致。目标模型隐状态进一步表明，检索目标与表示空间的交互方式不同：中间层表示通常更倾向于相似性检索，而最后一层表示对基于残差和多样性的选择往往更强。这些发现支持一种条件性的、依赖表示的上下文子集质量解释，而非存在普遍最优的选择器。
translation.brief: 针对少样本示例选择标准不明确的问题，将选择形式化为对查询表示的稀疏重构，提出Matching-Pursuit式的残差解释搜索（RES）。

papers.title: Budgeted Decision-Model-Guided Joint-Action Search for Satellite Edge Computing
papers.abstract: Efficient task offloading in satellite edge computing requires coordinated allocation of communication and computing resources. Search methods based on large language models (LLMs) have been shown to generate high-quality resource allocations, but the latency of individual model requests and repeated model interactions can lead to substantial solver overhead. We propose budgeted joint-action search (BJAS), an integrated decision-model-guided solver that jointly optimizes satellite offloading and power allocation to minimize average task-completion latency under explicit search budgets. Its bounded candidate pools combine single-terminal updates with power-inheriting offload replacements for batched selection, retaining two-terminal coordination without enumerating additional power vectors. Across 60 completed runs per method under the workflows' respective configurations, BJAS reduces mean total solver time by 97.16% relative to LLM-generated offloading while achieving a mean task-completion latency close to that of the LLM baseline. BJAS also achieves lower mean task-completion latency than the tested genetic algorithm and deep deterministic policy gradient baselines.

translation.title: 面向卫星边缘计算的资源受限决策模型引导联合动作搜索
translation.abstract: 卫星边缘计算中的高效任务卸载需要通信与计算资源的协同分配。基于大语言模型（LLM）的搜索方法已被证明能生成高质量的资源分配，但单次模型请求的延迟和反复的模型交互会带来可观的求解器开销。我们提出资源受限联合动作搜索（BJAS），一个集成的决策模型引导求解器，在显式搜索预算下联合优化卫星卸载与功率分配，以最小化平均任务完成延迟。其有界候选池将单终端更新与功率继承的卸载替换相结合以进行批量选择，在无需枚举额外功率向量的情况下保留了双终端协调。在各工作流各自配置下每个方法完成60次运行的结果显示，BJAS相比LLM生成卸载将平均总求解时间降低97.16%，同时任务完成延迟接近LLM基线。BJAS的任务完成延迟也低于所测试的遗传算法和深度确定性策略梯度基线。
translation.brief: 针对卫星边缘计算中LLM搜索卸载方案开销过大的问题，提出决策模型引导的预算化联合动作搜索（BJAS），在显式搜索预算下联合优化卸载与功率分配。

papers.title: Can an Agent Rethink What It Knows? Selective Scene Memory Updates in a Changing World
papers.abstract: Task configurations in factories, warehouses, and everyday physical environments change over time. Physical AI systems therefore need to incorporate new facts into scene memory while preserving valid information about equipment, objects, and operating constraints. We study updates to this parametric semantic-memory layer and present a joint evaluation of correction and preservation under finite update budgets. At fixed current fact count and memory parameter count, the protocol combines independent single-fact updates, budget trajectories, old-to-new answer diagnostics, and first stable success. Using a frozen 4B language model with late-layer LoRA, we evaluate seven preparation conditions and six update budgets on four-field synthetic semantic configurations. In two exposure-matched history conditions, increasing the budget from eight to 32 updates raises joint success from 6.25% to 94.79% and 91.15%, respectively, while exact obsolete-value outputs fall from 174/192 and 166/192 to zero. Constant32, which matches preparation steps but repeatedly trains on unchanged content during the first 32 events, achieves higher early joint success at eight steps (53.65%); at 32 steps, it reaches 85.42%, below both changing-history conditions. These results distinguish rapid correction under a small budget from simultaneous correctness of the new fact and the other three facts after further training. For both changing histories, most cases remain jointly correct at all subsequent measured points from step 16 onward. Output analysis shows that short-budget failures primarily retain the old value; repeated training on the new fact together with the other current facts progressively replaces these obsolete answers.

translation.title: 智能体能否重新思考它所知道的？变化世界中的选择性场景记忆更新
translation.abstract: 工厂、仓库和日常物理环境中的任务配置会随时间变化。因此物理AI系统需要将新事实纳入场景记忆，同时保留关于设备、物体和运行约束的有效信息。我们研究这一参数化语义记忆层的更新，并在有限更新预算下对纠正与保留进行联合评估。在当前事实数量和记忆参数数量固定的条件下，该协议结合了独立的单事实更新、预算轨迹、旧到新的答案诊断以及首次稳定成功。我们使用带有晚层LoRA的冻结4B语言模型，在四字段合成语义配置上评估了七种准备条件和六种更新预算。在两个曝光匹配的历史条件下，将预算从8次更新增加到32次，联合成功率分别从6.25%提升至94.79%和91.15%，而精确输出过时值的情况分别从174/192和166/192降至零。Constant32在准备步骤上与之匹配，但在前32个事件中反复训练未变化的内容，在8步时取得了更高的早期联合成功率（53.65%）；在32步时达到85.42%，低于两个变化历史条件。这些结果区分了小预算下的快速纠正与进一步训练后新事实和其他三个事实的同时正确。对于两个变化历史，大多数情况在第16步及之后所有测量点上保持联合正确。输出分析表明，短预算下的失败主要保留旧值；对新事实与其他当前事实的重复训练逐步取代这些过时答案。
translation.brief: 针对物理AI语义记忆在事实变化时需兼顾纠错与保留的问题，通过有限预算下LoRA微调4B语言模型的协议评估更新预算对联合成功的影响。

papers.title: Feedback-Aware Residual Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Timely Communication in Cognitive Radio Networks
papers.abstract: Supporting time-sensitive services in cognitive radio networks requires distributed access strategies that translate shared spectrum opportunities into timely packet delivery. Achieving this objective is challenging because reception conditions are only partially observable to individual transmitters, while dynamic competition and access overhead constrain the service that can be completed within packet deadlines. We formulate a distributed access problem that captures the coupling among interference-dependent reception, queue evolution, and protocol durations. To address this problem, we propose feedback-aware residual multi-agent proximal policy optimization (FAR-MAPPO) under centralized training and decentralized execution. The method constructs channel-specific historical feedback representations that complement instantaneous sensing with evidence from completed access attempts. A residual policy network integrates this experience with current observations and packet urgency to guide local access decisions. Numerical results show improved timely delivery over the baseline methods, particularly under heavy traffic and bursty arrivals with mixed packet deadlines.

translation.title: 面向认知无线网络及时通信的反馈感知残差多智能体强化学习
translation.abstract: 在认知无线网络中支持时间敏感的服务需要分布式接入策略，将共享的频谱机会转化为及时的数据包送达。实现这一目标具有挑战性，因为接收条件对单个发射机而言只是部分可观测的，而动态竞争和接入开销限制了在数据包截止期限前可完成的服务。我们形式化了一个分布式接入问题，刻画了依赖干扰的接收、队列演化与协议时长之间的耦合。为解决该问题，我们在集中训练、分散执行的框架下提出反馈感知残差多智能体近端策略优化（FAR-MAPPO）。该方法构建信道特定的历史反馈表示，用已完成接入尝试的证据补充即时感知。残差策略网络将这些经验与当前观测和数据包紧迫性相结合，以指导本地接入决策。数值结果表明，相比基线方法，及时送达率得到提升，尤其是在重流量和具有混合数据包截止期限的突发到达场景下。
translation.brief: 针对认知无线网络中接收条件部分可观测下的及时包送达问题，提出FAR-MAPPO，利用信道历史反馈表示与残差策略网络指导分布式接入决策。

papers.title: CompoundingKernel: Self-Improving from Zero to First
papers.abstract: We present CompoundingKernel, a self-improving agent system that writes GPU kernels by search. As of 2026-11-11, its generated kernels rank #1 on the public L1, L2 and Quantization boards of SOL-ExecBench (NVIDIA B200). They have held #1 on L1 since 2026-10-27, albeit a short loss on 2026-11-07. All 235 problems have a site-verified correct kernel; on the 209 public-board problems they are 4.40x faster than the benchmark's reference baseline. The search starts from zero: agents get each problem's PyTorch definition but no reference kernels or official scores. A per-problem archive outside the model holds every correct kernel and its lineage. An LLM controller reads it, picks a parent or a new design, and gives each parallel child agent one direction. Checks outside the model decide correctness. At equal wall time, it beat a coded UCB style tree on 35 of 38 problems by making 2.4x as many correct attempts. Over a thousand agents ran at once, and one warm restart fix raised their evaluation rate 3.6x. We find that the rate of reliable measurements, not the number of agents, limits how far such a search scales. Our code and kernels are available on URL.

translation.title: CompoundingKernel：从零到第一的自我改进
translation.abstract: 我们提出了CompoundingKernel，一个通过搜索编写GPU kernel的自我改进agent系统。截至2026-11-11，其生成的kernel在SOL-ExecBench（NVIDIA B200）公开的L1、L2和量化榜单上排名第一。自2026-10-27以来（除2026-11-07短暂失守外）一直保持L1榜首。全部235道题目均有经站点验证的正确kernel；在209道公开榜单题目上，其速度比基准的参考基线快4.40倍。搜索从零开始：agent只获得每道题的PyTorch定义，没有参考kernel或官方分数。模型之外按题目维护一个存档，保存每个正确kernel及其谱系。一个LLM控制器读取存档，选择父节点或新设计，并为每个并行的子agent指定一个方向。正确性判定由模型之外的检查完成。在相同墙钟时间内，它在38道题中的35道上击败了编码实现的UCB风格树搜索，正确尝试次数是其2.4倍。超过一千个agent同时运行，一次热重启修复使评估速率提升3.6倍。我们发现，限制此类搜索规模的是可靠测量的速率，而非agent的数量。代码和kernel见URL。
translation.brief: 该论文解决从零开始自动生成高性能GPU kernel的问题，方法是用LLM控制器驱动带kernel谱系存档的大规模并行agent搜索并靠外部验证保证正确性。

papers.title: Auditable Authorization for LLM Agents: Empirical Evidence Across Model, Harness, and Workflow Layers
papers.abstract: Human approval provides effective control only if rejected work stops and authorized work completes. We formalize refusal safety and bounded authorization completeness, and audit three execution boundaries: the model selects a call, the harness schedules and resumes it, and the workflow routes the decision to a protected effect. Paired decisions, exact traces, and native business-state witnesses support experiments with three models, five prompt arms, four runtime approval designs, two additional framework replays, and 100 public workflow sources. The paired model panel leaves seven of 300 approvals unfinished despite zero denied effects; parallel confirmation loses an approved branch in three tasks per model, restoration omits 336/672 CrewAI approvals, and four of 59 comparable n8n workflows execute after Reject. Comparing intent, generated calls, dispatch, and native effects identifies the first observable divergence and its repair target. This yields a practical audit contract that makes both refusal safety and authorization completeness independently verifiable, converting human approval from a procedural formality into an enforceable control boundary between intent and real-world effect.

translation.title: 面向LLM Agent的可审计授权：跨模型、Harness与工作流层面的实证证据
translation.abstract: 只有当被拒绝的工作停止且被授权的工作完成时，人工审批才能提供有效控制。我们形式化了拒绝安全性与有界授权完备性，并审计三个执行边界：模型选择调用、harness调度并恢复该调用、工作流将决策路由到受保护的效果。配对决策、精确轨迹和原生业务状态见证支持了涵盖三个模型、五个prompt组、四种运行时审批设计、两个额外框架重放以及100个公开工作流来源的实验。配对模型面板在零个被拒绝效果的情况下仍有300个审批中的7个未完成；并行确认在每个模型中有三个任务丢失已批准分支，恢复机制遗漏了336/672个CrewAI审批，59个可比n8n工作流中有4个在Reject后仍然执行。对比意图、生成调用、分发与原生效果可以定位首个可观测的分歧点及其修复目标。由此得出一个实用的审计契约，使拒绝安全性和授权完备性均可独立验证，将人工审批从程序性形式转化为意图与真实世界效果之间可强制执行的控制边界。
translation.brief: 该论文解决人工审批在LLM agent执行链中是否真正生效的问题，方法是通过跨模型、harness和工作流层面的配对决策审计契约来形式化并验证拒绝安全性与授权完备性。

papers.title: HyperDBDiag: Multi-Root-Cause Identification and Operator-Level Localization for Database Performance Anomalies
papers.abstract: Database performance anomalies in modern production environments are not always triggered by a single cause. Instead, they often arise from the concurrent interaction of multiple causes within the same time window, posing substantial challenges to accurate operator-level root-cause analysis. When multiple root causes interact through shared resources, metric anomalies may be amplified, attenuated, or masked. Consequently, salient local anomalies may no longer correspond directly to the actual root causes, making conventional single-path diagnosis and shallow correlation-based methods prone to misdiagnosis. To address this challenge, we propose HyperDBDiag, a method for multi-root-cause identification and operator-level localization of database performance anomalies. HyperDBDiag connects root causes, performance metrics, SQL templates, and execution operators in a knowledge graph, captures joint anomaly patterns across metrics with a metric hypergraph, and uses a constrained LLM to determine the final root-cause set and provide remediation suggestions. When finer-grained localization is possible, HyperDBDiag also identifies the associated anomalous SQL statements and execution operators. We evaluate HyperDBDiag on a database performance anomaly dataset constructed using DB-MAGS. Experimental results show that HyperDBDiag effectively reduces graph complexity while improving root-cause localization accuracy.

translation.title: HyperDBDiag：面向数据库性能异常的多根因识别与算子级定位
translation.abstract: 现代生产环境中的数据库性能异常并非总是由单一原因触发，而是常由同一时间窗口内多个原因的并发交互引起，这给精确的算子级根因分析带来巨大挑战。当多个根因通过共享资源交互时，指标异常可能被放大、衰减或掩蔽。因此，显著的局部异常可能不再直接对应实际根因，使常规的单路径诊断和浅层相关性方法容易误诊。为应对这一挑战，我们提出HyperDBDiag，一种数据库性能异常的多根因识别与算子级定位方法。HyperDBDiag在知识图谱中连接根因、性能指标、SQL模板和执行算子，用指标超图捕获跨指标的联合异常模式，并用受约束的LLM确定最终根因集合并提供修复建议。在可进行更细粒度定位时，HyperDBDiag还能识别相关的异常SQL语句和执行算子。我们在使用DB-MAGS构建的数据库性能异常数据集上评估了HyperDBDiag。实验结果表明，HyperDBDiag在有效降低图复杂度的同时提升了根因定位准确率。
translation.brief: 该论文解决多根因并发导致数据库性能异常难以准确定位的问题，方法是将根因、指标、SQL与算子构建为知识图谱并结合指标超图与受约束LLM进行根因识别和算子级定位。

papers.title: Agentic On-Policy Distillation Implicitly Reshapes LLMs' ReAct Patterns
papers.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers specialized capabilities to language-model agents, but its cross-domain effects on interaction remain unclear. We investigate how OPD reshapes ReAct interaction patterns across mathematics, ALFWorld, and $\tau^2$-bench, focusing on reasoning, actions, and observation acquisition. General-reasoning supervision reduces mathematical tool attempts from 70.4% to 14.4% while increasing accuracy from 16.7% to 38.0%; code-interpreter supervision improves household actions and retail queries. In contrast, ALFWorld supervision reduces $\tau^2$-bench accuracy from 41.5% to 6.6%, accompanied by frequent tool calls that violate user-information dependencies. To address negative transfer using only source-domain training trajectories, we explore selective OPD guided by teacher preference changes before and after domain-specific RL. Retaining the top 95% of positions raises $\tau^2$ accuracy from 11.5% to 29.9% with a source-learning trade-off.

translation.title: Agentic在策略蒸馏隐式重塑LLM的ReAct模式
translation.abstract: 在策略蒸馏（OPD）将专门能力迁移给语言模型agent，但其对交互的跨域影响尚不清楚。我们研究OPD如何在数学、ALFWorld和$\tau^2$-bench上重塑ReAct交互模式，关注推理、动作和观察获取。通用推理监督使数学工具尝试率从70.4%降至14.4%，同时准确率从16.7%升至38.0%；代码解释器监督改善家务动作和零售查询。相比之下，ALFWorld监督使$\tau^2$-bench准确率从41.5%降至6.6%，并伴随大量违反用户信息依赖的工具调用。为仅使用源域训练轨迹来应对负迁移，我们探索了由领域特定RL前后教师偏好变化引导的选择性OPD。保留前95%的token位置使$\tau^2$准确率从11.5%升至29.9%，但以源域学习为代价。
translation.brief: 该论文研究在策略蒸馏如何跨域改变LLM agent的ReAct交互模式并引发负迁移，方法是基于教师偏好变化进行选择性OPD以缓解负迁移。

papers.title: KaleidoKV: Rearranging Evidence for Efficient KV Cache Reuse in Offline RAG Inference
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) augments large language models (LLMs) on question-answering (QA) tasks with retrieved evidence at inference time. Related questions in an offline batch often retrieve overlapping evidence, but prefix caching reuses key-value (KV) states only for identical token prefixes, making reuse dependent on evidence order. Although all questions and evidence are known before execution, existing reordering methods commit to early grouping decisions and can miss sharing opportunities that require several requests to move together. Evaluating alternative layouts can incur planning costs that offset inference savings, while concurrent requests may still recompute shared prefixes before their KV states become available. To address these challenges, we propose KaleidoKV, a framework that plans evidence orders across the batch and controls when requests enter the engine while preserving each request's evidence set and content. Joint layout planning revises formed groups through coordinated request moves and keeps a move only if it lowers planned prefill, the computation required when each shared prefix is computed once. A global prefix index selects evidence orders by locating reusable prefixes and evaluates each move incrementally from only the affected request paths. Prefix-ready admission tracks nested prefix dependencies, delaying requests whose shared prefixes are still being computed while allowing independent requests to proceed. Experiments on four QA workloads and four LLMs show that KaleidoKV achieves the highest throughput and lowest mean time to first token in all 16 settings, with approximately 1.24-1.75x the throughput of the strongest baseline, including planning time. With Llama-3.1-8B under the default configuration, actual prefill stays within 0.5% of planned prefill across all four workloads.

translation.title: KaleidoKV：为离线RAG推理中高效KV缓存复用而重排证据
translation.abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）在推理时用检索到的证据增强大语言模型（LLM）的问答（QA）能力。离线批次中的相关问题往往检索到重叠证据，但前缀缓存只对完全相同的token前缀复用键值（KV）状态，使复用依赖于证据顺序。尽管所有问题和证据在执行前已知，现有重排方法会过早提交分组决策，可能错过需要多个请求一起移动才能实现的共享机会。评估不同布局可能产生抵消推理收益的规划成本，而并发请求仍可能在共享KV状态就绪前重算共享前缀。为应对这些挑战，我们提出KaleidoKV，一个在批次间规划证据顺序并控制请求何时进入引擎的框架，同时保持每个请求的证据集合和内容不变。联合布局规划通过协调的请求移动修订已形成的分组，仅当移动降低计划prefill（每个共享前缀只计算一次所需的计算量）时才保留该移动。全局前缀索引通过定位可复用前缀来选择证据顺序，并仅从受影响的请求路径增量评估每次移动。前缀就绪准入跟踪嵌套的前缀依赖，延迟那些共享前缀仍在计算中的请求，同时让独立请求继续推进。在四个QA工作负载和四个LLM上的实验表明，KaleidoKV在全部16种设置中取得最高吞吐量和最低平均首token时间，吞吐量约为最强基线的1.24-1.75倍（含规划时间）。在默认配置下的Llama-3.1-8B上，实际prefill在所有四个工作负载中与计划prefill的偏差保持在0.5%以内。
translation.brief: 该论文解决离线RAG批次中重叠证据因顺序不同而无法复用KV缓存的问题，方法是通过联合证据布局规划、增量移动评估和前缀就绪请求准入来最大化前缀复用。

papers.title: Read Boundaries in Agent Memory: Consistency, Completeness, and Repair
papers.abstract: Agent-memory services assemble evidence through several reads across connections or stores. An update between those reads can pair an assertion with source content from another revision. We protect the complete recall, including enrichment and materialization, and evaluate the resulting evidence and service behavior in Hindsight and Cognee. A 600-run Cognee study compares unprotected recall, a repeated recall, a read/write lock, and optimistic epoch validation under default incremental updates and full rebuilds. At approximately 20 recalls/s, unprotected default updates yield 199 conflicting responses among 12,010 scheduled recalls with spaced writes and 284 among 12,010 with bursts. The lock and epoch validation each deliver complete, compatible evidence for all 24,020 default-update recalls. With default bursts, epoch validation reduces update p95 by 109 ms while adding 290 ms to recall p95 relative to the lock. A separate 160-run incremental-failure study distinguishes mixed revisions from complete new derived content whose canonical source record remains old. Both protected policies refuse service after failure; the first default retry restores all 80 fault runs through native full-rebuild fallback. In Hindsight, a shared PostgreSQL snapshot removes the mismatch in ten controlled pairs, with recall p95 rising from 19 ms to 29 ms. These results identify the read boundary needed for coherent evidence and the publication and recovery conditions governing service after an update fails.

translation.title: Agent 记忆中的读边界：一致性、完整性与修复
translation.abstract: Agent 记忆服务通过跨连接或存储的多次读取来组装证据。这些读取之间发生的更新可能将断言与另一版本的内容配对。我们保护完整的召回过程，包括富化和物化，并在 Hindsight 和 Cognee 中评估由此产生的证据和服务行为。一项 600 次运行的 Cognee 研究比较了无保护召回、重复召回、读写锁以及乐观 epoch 校验在默认增量更新和完全重建下的表现。在约每秒 20 次召回的情况下，无保护的默认更新在间隔写入时于 12,010 次计划召回中产生 199 个冲突响应，在突发写入时产生 284 个。锁和 epoch 校验在全部 24,020 次默认更新召回中都提供了完整且兼容的证据。在默认突发写入下，相对于锁，epoch 校验将更新 p95 降低 109 ms，同时使召回 p95 增加 290 ms。另一项 160 次运行的增量失败研究区分了混合版本与规范源记录仍为旧版的完整新派生内容。两种保护策略在失败后均拒绝服务；通过原生完全重建回退，第一次默认重试即恢复了全部 80 个故障运行。在 Hindsight 中，共享 PostgreSQL 快照在十组受控对比中消除了不一致，召回 p95 从 19 ms 升至 29 ms。这些结果明确了连贯证据所需的读边界，以及更新失败后治理服务发布的恢复条件。
translation.brief: 研究 agent 记忆服务中多次读取之间的更新竞争导致证据不一致的问题，采用读写锁与乐观 epoch 校验等读边界保护策略并配合完全重建回退机制解决。

papers.title: Small Harnesses, Default Checks, Limited Coverage: Bounded Model Checking in Practice
papers.abstract: The growing use of AI to generate software and verification artifacts has increased the need for automated systems that provide reliable software assurance. Bounded model checking (BMC) offers a practical foundation for such systems by automatically checking correctness and security properties directly on software. However, effective verification requires choices about properties, input assumptions, function models, and execution bounds that influence the guarantees obtained. Little systematic evidence exists on how practitioners make these choices, limiting the empirical foundation for developing automated verification systems. We present an empirical study of BMC practices in open-source C and Rust projects using CBMC and Kani. Through LLM-assisted open coding, static analysis, and artifact execution, we characterize verification properties, artifact complexity, and verification outcomes. Our findings reveal diverse verification objectives and generally small harnesses, but also property-specification errors and extensive use of execution bounds and environment models. Most artifacts complete verification quickly and achieve high coverage within their scope, while repository-level coverage decreases with project size. Our findings and annotated dataset provide empirical baselines for verification automation and motivate improved techniques for property validation, harness generation, and scaling verification breadth.

translation.title: 小型测试工具、默认检查、有限覆盖：实践中的有界模型检测
translation.abstract: 使用 AI 生成软件和验证工件的日益增多，提升了对此类自动化系统提供可靠软件保障的需求。有界模型检测通过直接在软件上自动检查正确性和安全属性，为此类系统提供了实用基础。然而，有效的验证需要关于属性、输入假设、函数模型和执行边界的种种选择，这些选择影响所获得的保证。目前几乎没有关于从业者如何做出这些选择的系统性证据，限制了开发自动化验证系统的经验基础。我们基于 CBMC 和 Kani 对开源 C 和 Rust 项目中的 BMC 实践进行了实证研究。通过 LLM 辅助的开放编码、静态分析和工件执行，我们刻画了验证属性、工件复杂度和验证结果。我们的发现揭示了多样的验证目标和普遍较小规模的测试工具，但也发现属性规约错误以及大量使用执行边界和环境模型。大多数工件能快速完成验证并在其作用范围内实现高覆盖率，而仓库级覆盖率随项目规模增大而下降。我们的发现和标注数据集为验证自动化提供了经验基线，并推动了属性验证、测试工具生成和扩展验证广度等改进技术。
translation.brief: 实证研究开源 C/Rust 项目使用 CBMC 和 Kani 进行有界模型检测的实践方式，通过 LLM 辅助编码与静态分析刻画验证属性、工件复杂度与结果。

papers.title: Beyond Clumsy Agentic Tool Calling: How Cueing and Spotting Make the Difference
papers.abstract: LLM-based task-oriented agents depend on tools to interact with their environments, but may overlook execution feedback, repeat ineffective calls, or persist with unproductive strategies. These behaviors can hinder agents' ability to use tools autonomously and sustain task progress. We characterize tool-use symptoms at two temporal granularities: local clumsy tool-use behaviors and tool-use detours spanning multiple interactions. Towards greater autonomy in tool use, we present ToolPulse, an online middleware supporting autonomous tool use through cueing and spotting. ToolPulse tracks execution state and temporal interaction patterns, monitoring proposed calls before dispatch and inspecting execution feedback prior to the agent resumes reasoning. It combines state-based rules, semantic sequence analysis, and interaction-feature similarity to identify intervention opportunities and provide verbal reminders, structured feedback, or context-specific advice from auxiliary models. Our process-oriented evaluation distinguishes trigger validity, behavioral cessation, and substantive correction alongside task outcomes and resource costs. Using SWE-agent with three backbone models, we evaluate 1,350 trajectories on 90 Python, C++, and Java bug-fix tasks, comparing unassisted execution with four assistance strategies. Substantive responses follow 61.6-90.9% of valid triggers for tool-use detours. Concise reminders achieve the highest observed aggregate substantive-response rate; more elaborate assistance offers symptom-dependent benefits and can be less effective. Aggregate repair outcomes remain close to baseline, with token savings in selected settings. These findings support proactive runtime assistance for autonomous tool use. The gap between behavioral adjustment and aggregate repair gains calls for careful decisions on intervention timing and assistance strategy in autonomous agents.

translation.title: 超越笨拙的 Agentic 工具调用：提示与识别如何带来改变
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的任务型 agent 依赖工具与环境交互，但可能忽略执行反馈、重复无效调用或坚持低效策略。这些行为会妨碍 agent 自主使用工具并维持任务进展。我们在两个时间粒度上刻画工具使用症状：局部的笨拙工具使用行为和跨越多次交互的工具使用绕路。为提升工具使用的自主性，我们提出 ToolPulse，一个通过提示和识别支持自主工具使用的在线中间件。ToolPulse 跟踪执行状态和时间交互模式，在分发前监控提议的调用，并在 agent 恢复推理前检查执行反馈。它结合基于状态的规则、语义序列分析和交互特征相似度来识别干预时机，并提供口头提醒、结构化反馈或来自辅助模型的上下文相关建议。我们的面向过程评估区分了触发有效性、行为停止和实质性纠正，同时兼顾任务结果和资源成本。使用 SWE-agent 和三个骨干模型，我们在 90 个 Python、C++ 和 Java 修 bug 任务上评估了 1,350 条轨迹，将无辅助执行与四种辅助策略进行比较。针对工具使用绕路，61.6-90.9% 的有效触发了实质性响应。简洁提醒获得了最高的总体实质性响应率；更精细的辅助带来症状相关的收益，有时反而效果较差。总体修复结果接近基线，部分设置下节省了 token。这些发现支持为自主工具使用提供主动的运行时辅助。行为调整与总体修复收益之间的差距要求在自主 agent 中审慎决定干预时机和辅助策略。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM agent 工具调用中忽略反馈、重复无效调用等问题，提出在线中间件 ToolPulse，通过状态规则、语义序列分析和相似度识别干预时机并实时提供反馈。

papers.title: Rethinking KV Caching for LLM Decode: Free-Space Optical KV Regeneration for Reduction of Memory Traffic
papers.abstract: Long-context large language model (LLM) decoding repeatedly reads the historical key-value (KV) cache, making multi-head attention (MHA) memory-bandwidth-bound. Caching layer-input activations instead halves historical-cache storage and traffic, but requires regenerating KV from each cached activation. On digital accelerators such as GPUs, this regeneration takes far longer than fetching the activation from HBM. The KV regeneration overhead outweighs the savings from reduced memory traffic, shifting decode attention from a memory bottleneck to a compute bottleneck. We present OptiDecode, a hybrid optoelectronic decode-attention accelerator that regenerates historical KV using free-space optics and computes attention digitally. Projection weights remain resident on optical tiles, exploiting reuse across historical tokens for high-throughput optical regeneration. Scaling to large models introduces two challenges. First, distributing weights across tiles requires sending the same activations to every head group, while each readout die produces only partial KV. Activation replay shares one set of electrical-to-optical converters across head groups without costly broadcast. In-situ attention avoids transferring partial KV from readout dies to reducers by computing on them locally and exchanging only partial scores, probabilities, and partial outputs. Second, processing an activation chunk through all dependent stages takes longer than one activation-fetch interval. Chunk pipelining overlaps successive chunks so that OptiDecode sustains the HBM activation-fetch rate. OptiDecode demonstrates 1.92-1.99x decode-attention speedup over an ideal GPU KV-read baseline at equal peak HBM bandwidth (A100-B200), for 32K-token contexts across evaluated 30B-175B MHA models, approaching the 2x upper bound from halving historical memory traffic.

translation.title: 重新思考 LLM 解码中的 KV 缓存：用自由空间光学 KV 再生降低内存流量
translation.abstract: 长上下文大语言模型解码反复读取历史键值缓存，使多头注意力受内存带宽限制。改为缓存层输入激活可将历史缓存存储和流量减半，但需要从每个缓存激活重新生成 KV。在 GPU 等数字加速器上，这种再生远比从 HBM 取回激活耗时。KV 再生开销超过减少内存流量带来的收益，使解码注意力从内存瓶颈转变为计算瓶颈。我们提出 OptiDecode，一种混合光电解码注意力加速器，使用自由空间光学再生历史 KV，并以数字方式计算注意力。投影权重常驻于光学芯片上，利用跨历史 token 的复用实现高吞吐光学再生。扩展到大模型带来两个挑战。第一，将权重分布在多个芯片上需要向每个头组发送相同激活，而每个读出裸片只产生部分 KV。激活重放让一组电光转换器在头组间共享而无需昂贵的广播。原位注意力通过在读出裸片上本地计算、只交换部分分数、概率和部分输出，避免了将部分 KV 从读出裸片传输到归约器。第二，一个激活块通过所有依赖阶段的处理时间长于一个激活取回间隔。块流水线重叠相继的块，使 OptiDecode 能维持 HBM 激活取回速率。在相同峰值 HBM 带宽下，OptiDecode 在所评估的 30B-175B MHA 模型、32K token 上下文中，相比理想 GPU KV 读取基线实现了 1.92-1.99 倍解码注意力加速，接近减半历史内存流量的 2 倍上限。
translation.brief: 针对 MHA 解码受内存带宽限制的问题，提出混合光电加速器 OptiDecode，用自由空间光学再生 KV 缓存并以块流水线和原位注意力等技术克服扩展难题。

papers.title: Spreads Don't Price a Rival Market Maker's Information
papers.abstract: When one market maker becomes better informed, do its competitors widen their bid-ask spreads? Adverse-selection reasoning suggests that they should, because the better-informed maker avoids toxic order flow and leaves more of it to the others, and the closest model of competition with an informed dealer predicts more conservative quotes by the uninformed dealers. We study this question in a stochastic quoting game in which one maker receives a private signal of varying precision about a persistent state that drives order flow. Strategies are learned with independent reinforcement learning, which we benchmark against an exact dynamic-programming solution of the single-agent case. In none of the configurations we examine does the average spread of the uninformed makers increase with the rival's precision. Where competition for order flow is weak, the slope of their spread in precision is statistically equivalent to zero within half an action tick; where competition is strong, their spread tightens. The informed maker's own spread tightens markedly in every configuration and serves as a positive control. These results hold with two, three and four makers, across an eightfold variation in the depth of the background liquidity, with a background quote that reprices after toxic fills, and under price-time priority. Our measurements point to a competitive trade-off. In the model the total toxicity of the flow does not depend on any maker's information. A better-informed maker avoids more of it, and where this leaves more toxic flow to its competitors, it also quotes more tightly, so that a wider quote would cost them more order flow than it would save in adverse selection. The uninformed makers adjust the skew of their quotes and their inventory instead, and the rival's information changes the distribution of profits across makers while quoted spreads remain nearly unchanged.

translation.title: 价差并不能为竞争对手做市商的信息定价
translation.abstract: 当一位做市商获得更好信息时，其竞争对手会扩大买卖价差吗？逆向选择推理表明应该扩大，因为信息更充分的做市商避开有毒订单流，把更多留给其他人，而与知情交易商竞争的最接近模型预测不知情交易商会报出更保守的报价。我们在一个随机报价博弈中研究该问题，其中一位做市商收到关于驱动订单流的持续状态的、精度可变的私有信号。策略通过独立强化学习学习，并以单智能体情形的精确动态规划解作为基准。在我们考察的所有配置中，不知情做市商的平均价差都没有随对手精度增加而扩大。当订单流竞争较弱时，其价差对精度的斜率在半个动作 tick 内统计上等价于零；竞争强烈时，其价差反而收紧。知情做市商自身的价差在每个配置中都明显收紧，起到了阳性对照作用。这些结果在两、三、四位做市商、八倍变化的后台流动性深度、毒单成交后重新定价的后台报价以及价格-时间优先规则下均成立。我们的测量指向一种竞争性权衡。模型中订单流的总毒性不取决于任何做市商的信息。信息更充分的做市商避开更多毒性，当这把更多有毒订单流留给竞争对手时，其报价也更紧，以至于更宽的报价损失订单流的代价超过其在逆向选择上省下的收益。不知情做市商转而调整报价偏斜和库存，对手的信息改变了各做市商之间的利润分布，而报价价差几乎保持不变。
translation.brief: 研究知情做市商信息优势是否会促使竞争对手扩大价差的问题，采用带私有信号的随机报价博弈和独立强化学习，发现价差不随对手信息精度扩大，对手转而调整报价偏斜与库存。

papers.title: Optional Traps: An Empirical Study of LLM Agents Against Credential Deception and Alert-Driven Revocation
papers.abstract: Deception (honeypots, decoys and canary credentials) rests on a simple premise: legitimate users never touch a fake asset, so any touch is a high-confidence signal. We ask whether that premise holds when the attacker is a large language model (LLM) agent, and what deception contributes once ordinary hardening is in place. We built an isolated, hash-chained lab around a mock Records API and report four studies. (1) In an exploratory run, a local 9.7B-parameter model ignored every optional decoy, read a genuinely leaked service key from a debug endpoint and exported the protected records in both static and adaptive deception modes. (2) After removing the leak, planting a canary credential in its place and revoking the offending client, a frozen 60-session study with a 4B-parameter model found export success of 20/20 at baseline, 0/20 with hardening alone and 0/20 with hardening plus deception (exact paired McNemar p = 1.9e-6 baseline vs. defended; p = 1 hardened vs. defended). Deception added detection and per-client revocation in 19 of 20 defended sessions, but no measurable prevention beyond hardening. (3) On Google Cloud, a real OpenCanary login alert was authenticated, signed and turned into revocation of the attacking client; the first denied export followed within an observed upper bound of 303 ms, a separate legitimate client completed 100/100 requests, and all 14 control checks passed. (4) In multi-agent swarm engagements, agents that used the canary were revoked 39-59 s after the bait was served without affecting siblings, but one model-driven legitimate agent also took the bait, a false-positive risk specific to LLM clients. Against LLM agents, traps must sit on the attacker's path rather than beside it, closing real weaknesses does the preventive work, and deception's measurable value is fast, attributable detection. All results are lab-scale and are not a production claim.

translation.title: 可选陷阱：LLM 智能体面对凭据欺骗与告警驱动撤销的实证研究
translation.abstract: 欺骗（蜜罐、诱饵和金丝雀凭据）基于一个简单前提：合法用户从不接触虚假资产，因此任何接触都是高置信度信号。我们探究当攻击者是大型语言模型（LLM）智能体时该前提是否成立，以及在常规加固到位后欺骗还有何贡献。我们围绕一个模拟 Records API 构建了隔离的、哈希链记录的实验环境，并报告四项研究。（1）在一次探索性运行中，一个本地 9.7B 参数模型忽略了所有可选诱饵，从调试端点读取了真实泄露的服务密钥，并在静态和自适应欺骗模式下导出了受保护记录。（2）移除泄露、在原处植入金丝雀凭据并撤销违规客户端后，对 4B 参数模型进行的 60 会话冻结研究发现：基线导出成功率为 20/20，仅加固时为 0/20，加固加欺骗时为 0/20（精确配对 McNemar p = 1.9e-6 基线 vs. 防御；p = 1 加固 vs. 防御）。欺骗在 20 个防御会话中的 19 个提供了检测和按客户端撤销，但在预防方面相比加固没有可测量的额外收益。（3）在 Google Cloud 上，一条真实的 OpenCanary 登录告警经过认证、签名并转化为对攻击客户端的撤销；首次被拒导出在观测上限 303 ms 内发生，另一独立合法客户端完成 100/100 请求，全部 14 项对照检查通过。（4）在多智能体蜂群对抗中，使用金丝雀的智能体在诱饵投放后 39-59 秒被撤销且不影响同级智能体，但一个模型驱动的合法智能体也中了诱饵，这是 LLM 客户端特有的误报风险。面对 LLM 智能体，陷阱必须位于攻击者的路径上而非路径旁；封堵真实弱点才起到预防作用；欺骗的可衡量价值是快速且可归因的检测。所有结果均为实验室规模，不构成生产环境声明。
translation.brief: 研究欺骗防御（金丝雀凭据等）对 LLM 攻击智能体的作用，发现其价值在于快速可归因的检测与撤销而非预防，通过隔离实验环境开展多组对照与真实云端验证。

papers.title: Staged Semantic Distillation: Preserving Free-Form Semantics in a Low-Compute Non-LLM Surrogate of a Staged LLM Agent
papers.abstract: Staged LLM agents make market and social simulators realistic, but one 102-day run of a 200-agent, ten-index market simulator issues 203,100 language-model calls and returns one realization. Conventional low-compute distillation drops their free-form intermediate state. We present staged semantic distillation, a low-compute method that preserves non-structured semantics in a non-LLM student trained from one recorded trace. A frozen encoder maps each teacher output to a 1024-d vector; the student sees typed stage-tagged vectors with stage-specific visibility, is jointly supervised, and trains with scheduled self-history. One TwinMarket trace yields a 13.2M-parameter deterministic student that trains in 1,658 seconds on one 8-GB GPU and runs with zero teacher or decoder calls and no text generation (0.14 ms per decision). Its analysis stays close to the teacher (cosine 0.943), and swapping semantic inputs between agents moves 64.7% of decisions against 12.8% for a matched donor, so the channel is preserved and live. We use the surrogate to study what the transfer carries. It reaches 0.8347 balanced accuracy on the teacher-forced replay and 0.7783 [0.766,0.791] on the deployment decoder; the five-seed gain over a no-semantic retrain is +2.2 [1.21,3.14]. Against the teacher's own re-sampling level, round-one R is 97.1% [95.8,98.4] and 92.3% [89.0,95.4]; R is a diagnostic, not an accuracy. A five-seed content-by-schedule study isolates the gain: scheduled self-history carries it (+2.2 [1.21,3.14]); shuffled and constant content controls reproduce it, while content matters teacher-forced. The design rule: invest in the deployment schedule, let content earn its place at the teacher-forced operating point. A 20-seed, 200,000-decision sweep takes 12 minutes with zero LLM calls, versus three hours for the teacher. The paper is a method-and-case-study contribution on one simulator and trace.

translation.title: 分阶段语义蒸馏：在分阶段 LLM 智能体的低算力非 LLM 代理中保留自由格式语义
translation.abstract: 分阶段 LLM 智能体使市场和社会模拟更真实，但一次 200 智能体、十指数市场模拟的 102 天运行会发出 203,100 次语言模型调用且仅返回一次实现。常规低算力蒸馏会丢弃其自由格式的中间状态。我们提出分阶段语义蒸馏，一种低算力方法，在由单条录制轨迹训练的非 LLM 学生模型中保留非结构化语义。冻结编码器将每个教师输出映射为 1024 维向量；学生接收带有阶段特定可见性的类型化、阶段标记向量，接受联合监督，并以调度的自历史进行训练。一条 TwinMarket 轨迹可训练出 13.2M 参数的确定性学生模型，在单个 8-GB GPU 上训练耗时 1,658 秒，运行时零教师或解码器调用且无文本生成（每次决策 0.14 ms）。其分析结果与教师保持接近（余弦 0.943），且在智能体之间交换语义输入会改变 64.7% 的决策，而匹配的供体对照仅为 12.8%，说明该语义通道被保留且有效。我们利用该代理研究迁移所携带的信息。它在教师强制回放中达到 0.8347 的平衡准确率，在部署解码器上达到 0.7783 [0.766,0.791]；相对无语义重训的五种子增益为 +2.2 [1.21,3.14]。相对于教师自身的重采样水平，第一轮 R 为 97.1% [95.8,98.4] 和 92.3% [89.0,95.4]；R 是诊断指标而非准确率。一项五种子的内容-调度对照研究分离出增益来源：调度的自历史承载了增益（+2.2 [1.21,3.14]）；打乱和恒定内容的对照也能复现该增益，而内容仅在教师强制时有影响。设计规则：投资于部署调度，让内容在教师强制工作点上证明其价值。一次 20 种子、200,000 决策的扫描仅需 12 分钟且零 LLM 调用，而教师需三小时。本文是在单一模拟器和轨迹上的方法与案例研究贡献。
translation.brief: 提出分阶段语义蒸馏方法，用冻结编码器将 LLM 教师输出转为语义向量，训练一个低算力、无文本生成的非 LLM 学生代理来保留自由格式语义。

papers.title: Fundamental Limits of Statistical Watermarking for LLMs with Fixed and Optimizable Common Randomness
papers.abstract: Watermarking has emerged as an important technique for distinguishing AI-generated text from human-written text. However, most existing work is primarily empirical, relies on ad hoc watermarking designs, and lacks a fundamental understanding of the performance limits. In this paper, we propose a unified theoretical framework for statistical watermarking of large language models (LLMs), casting the problem as an independence test between generated text and common randomness and jointly designing the watermarking embedder and the detector. Our objective is to maximize detection power while controlling the worst-case false positive rate (FPR) and limiting distortion to text quality. A central focus of our framework is the design of the common randomness, which plays a critical role in both watermark embedding and detection. We characterize the fundamental limits of statistical watermarking under both fixed and optimizable common randomness. Our results show that optimizing the common randomness does not improve the fundamental limits: the best achievable performance is the same as that with fixed common randomness. Nevertheless, common randomness design remains highly important because it can substantially simplify detector design. In particular, with optimizable common randomness, a fixed, deterministic, and model-agnostic detector can achieve optimal performance. We further study a practical setting with fixed uniform common randomness and a fixed deterministic detector, and characterize its performance gap relative to the optimizable case, thereby demonstrating the practical value of optimizable common randomness.

translation.title: 固定与可优化公共随机性下 LLM 统计水印的基本极限
translation.abstract: 水印已成为区分 AI 生成文本与人类撰写文本的重要技术。然而，现有工作大多以实证为主，依赖临时设计的水印方案，缺乏对性能极限的基本理解。本文为大型语言模型（LLM）的统计水印提出统一的理论框架，将问题转化为生成文本与公共随机性之间的独立性检验，并联合设计水印嵌入器与检测器。我们的目标是在控制最坏情况误报率（FPR）并限制对文本质量失真的前提下最大化检测功效。该框架的核心焦点是公共随机性的设计，它在水印嵌入和检测中都起关键作用。我们刻画了固定和可优化公共随机性下统计水印的基本极限。结果表明，优化公共随机性并不能改善基本极限：可达到的最佳性能与固定公共随机性相同。尽管如此，公共随机性的设计仍然非常重要，因为它能大幅简化检测器设计。特别是，采用可优化公共随机性时，一个固定、确定且与模型无关的检测器即可达到最优性能。我们进一步研究了固定均匀公共随机性与固定确定性检测器的实用场景，并刻画了其相对于可优化情形的性能差距，从而证明了可优化公共随机性的实用价值。
translation.brief: 提出 LLM 统计水印的统一理论框架，将问题建模为文本与公共随机性的独立性检验，并刻画固定与可优化公共随机性下的检测功效基本极限。

papers.title: Macro Control and Capability Evaluation of Black-Box World Models: A Two-Regime Framework for LLM-Agent Markets
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can be organized into multi-agent markets that act as world models, mapping macro information to emergent macro dynamics while the evaluator observes only macro inputs and outputs. This paper separates a model's capability into two stages that a single aggregate score cannot separate: information simulation, from macro information to micro behavior, and macro emergence, from micro behavior to the macro outcome. We introduce a soft macro-control method that announces a public reference path day by day without touching individual decisions, orders, or matching, and a two-regime evaluation framework that measures both stages from macro observations alone. In the reference-only regime the symmetric true and flipped references share a common level R, which measures realization under the announced reference, while their paired gap B measures structural bias; in the information-injection regime external information dilutes the reference, so only the true-flipped gap Delta remains interpretable. On five single-index LLM-agent markets, announcing a target path shifts the realized path toward the announced target on both announced references under both information conditions. Relative to the no-reference path, the tracking score is higher by 0.306 and 0.415 without news and by 0.183 and 0.329 with news; within the stock/cash scan structural bias is lowest at 70/30 (B=0.042); realization peaks at a 3:7 technical share (R=0.894 versus 0.358 for technical-only); and Delta is 0.0341 with fundamental data and 0.0487 with news. Both stages use the same two observable scores, each read in the regime where it is interpretable.

translation.title: 黑盒世界模型的宏观控制与能力评估：LLM 智能体市场的双机制框架
translation.abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体可以组成作为世界模型的多智能体市场，将宏观信息映射到涌现的宏观动态，而评估者仅观察宏观输入与输出。本文将模型能力分离为单一综合分数无法区分的两个阶段：信息模拟（从宏观信息到微观行为）和宏观涌现（从微观行为到宏观结果）。我们提出一种软宏观控制方法，逐日公布公共参考路径而不触碰个体决策、订单或撮合，并建立双机制评估框架，仅从宏观观测衡量两个阶段。在仅参考机制下，对称的真参考与翻转参考共享共同水平 R，衡量在公布参考下的实现程度，而它们的配对差距 B 衡量结构性偏差；在信息注入机制下，外部信息稀释了参考，因此只有真-翻转差距 Delta 保持可解释性。在五个单指数 LLM 智能体市场上，公布目标路径在两种信息条件下均使实现路径向公布目标偏移。相对于无参考路径，无新闻时追踪分数提高 0.306 和 0.415，有新闻时提高 0.183 和 0.329；在股票/现金扫描中结构性偏差在 70/30 时最低（B=0.042）；实现在技术仓位占 3:7 时达到峰值（R=0.894，而纯技术为 0.358）；Delta 在基本面数据下为 0.0341，新闻下为 0.0487。两个阶段使用相同的两个可观测分数，各自在其可解释的机制中读取。
translation.brief: 提出软宏观控制与双机制评估框架，将 LLM 智能体市场世界模型的能力分解为信息模拟与宏观涌现两阶段，仅凭宏观观测进行测量。

papers.title: Hardening Agentic Web Populations Through Multi-Criterion Competitive Co-Evolution: Lessons from Wargame Strategy Optimization
papers.abstract: Agents on the open web will face adversaries that keep adapting, so a defense that is only tested once will eventually be found and broken. We propose treating jailbreak attacks and safety guardrails as two populations that evolve against each other, rather than as a fixed attacker probing a fixed defense. This idea comes directly from wargame strategy optimization, where two-population competitive co-evolution with alternating evolution cycles and cross-play evaluation has already been shown to produce strategies that are robust to a moving opponent, and where a companion line of work has shown that the same machinery can measure how much competitive pressure a population must absorb. However, real-world applications can never rely on a single criterion as a key performance indicator, rather must use multiple conflicting criteria, such as, cost and efficiency. We describe how this mechanism transfers to language model safety, argue why the resulting multi-criteria, competitive and coevolutionary arms race is a genuinely networked, population-level problem rather than a two-agent toy setting, and lay out the open problems that stand between the wargame version of this idea and an agentic web version of it.

translation.title: 通过多准则竞争性协同进化加固智能体网络群体：来自兵棋策略优化的启示
translation.abstract: 开放网络上的智能体将面对持续适应的对手，因此只测试一次的防御最终会被找到并攻破。我们提出将越狱攻击与安全护栏视为相互进化的两个群体，而非固定攻击者探测固定防御。这一想法直接来自兵棋策略优化，其中带有交替进化周期和交叉对局评估的双群体竞争性协同进化已被证明能产生对移动对手鲁棒的策略，且配套的一系列工作表明同样的机制可以衡量一个群体必须吸收多大的竞争压力。然而，现实应用无法依赖单一准则作为关键性能指标，而必须使用多个相互冲突的准则，如成本与效率。我们描述了该机制如何迁移到语言模型安全领域，论证为何由此产生的多准则、竞争性和协同进化军备竞赛是一个真正的网络化、群体层面问题而非双智能体玩具设定，并梳理了介于该想法的兵棋版本与智能体网络版本之间的开放问题。
translation.brief: 提出将越狱攻击与安全护栏视为相互对抗进化的两个群体，借鉴兵棋策略优化的多准则竞争性协同进化机制来加固智能体网络防御。

papers.title: Orbit AI: Evaluating Tool-Augmented Agents For Enterprise Question Answering
papers.abstract: Enterprise information is commonly stored across multiple platforms rather than in one centralized location. Answering questions about workplace activities may require information from several sources, including project documents, task management systems, and team conversations. Therefore, we evaluate Orbit AI, a tool-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system that uses a ReAct agent implemented with LangGraph to retrieve and combine information from three different workspace sources. We compare three configurations: (1) a standalone LLM without retrieval, (2) document-based RAG, and (3) a multi-tool agent with access to all three sources. The held-out evaluation set contains 80 questions designed for Phase 3 workspace; Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite achieves an accuracy of 86.25% with the complete agent. Document-only RAG achieves 60.00% (26.25 pp higher), and the plain LLM achieves 23.13%. For multi-source questions, the full agent answers 84.38%, while document-only RAG answers 40.63%, a 43.75 pp increase. The evaluated Llama 3.2 configuration with local inference achieves 5.50% overall correctness under rubric v2.2. The Llama 3.2 full-agent configuration achieves a held-out accuracy of 52.50%, which is 1.88 pp higher than the accuracy of document-only RAG. The gain of Gemini is equivalent to 26.25 pp. The comparison must be taken with a pinch of salt, because Gemini was accessed via an API hosted by them, while Llama was run locally via Ollama and the models are of different size. It is therefore not possible to isolate the cause of the performance gaps in this experiment. The paper also addresses the constraints of the evaluation such as the small artificial workspace and the similarity of the Q53 problem to a problem in the system prompt.

translation.title: Orbit AI：评估面向企业问答的工具增强型智能体
translation.abstract: 企业信息通常分散存储在多个平台而非集中于一处。回答有关工作场所活动的问题可能需要来自多个来源的信息，包括项目文档、任务管理系统和团队对话。因此，我们评估了 Orbit AI，这是一个基于工具的检索增强生成（RAG）系统，它使用由 LangGraph 实现的 ReAct 智能体，从三种不同的工作区来源检索并整合信息。我们比较了三种配置：（1）无检索的独立 LLM，（2）基于文档的 RAG，（3）可访问全部三个来源的多工具智能体。留出评估集包含为 Phase 3 工作区设计的 80 个问题；Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite 在完整智能体下达到 86.25% 的准确率。仅文档 RAG 达到 60.00%（高出 26.25 个百分点），纯 LLM 达到 23.13%。对于多来源问题，完整智能体回答了 84.38%，而仅文档 RAG 为 40.63%，提升 43.75 个百分点。在 rubric v2.2 下，采用本地推理的 Llama 3.2 配置总体正确率为 5.50%。Llama 3.2 完整智能体配置的留出准确率为 52.50%，比仅文档 RAG 高 1.88 个百分点。Gemini 的提升相当于 26.25 个百分点。该比较须谨慎看待，因为 Gemini 通过其托管的 API 访问，而 Llama 通过 Ollama 在本地运行，且模型规模不同。因此本实验无法隔离性能差距的原因。本文还讨论了评估的限制，例如人工构建的小型工作区，以及 Q53 问题与系统提示中某个问题的相似性。
translation.brief: 评估一个基于 ReAct 的多工具 RAG 智能体能否整合多个企业工作区来源回答问题，并与纯 LLM 和仅文档 RAG 进行配置对比。

papers.title: From Mutation to Medication: Characterizing Failures of Clinical LLMs to Respect Genomic Resistance
papers.abstract: Language models are increasingly proposed to support molecular tumour boards, but may recommend cancer therapies despite genomic evidence of resistance. We evaluated ten models on 1,464 resistance cases from five curated oncology knowledge bases, collecting 58,910 judgments. Models endorsed resisted therapies in 21.8-81.4% of cases. However, raw rates can reflect a tendency to agree rather than an ability to distinguish resistance from drug sensitivity: one open-weight model endorsed 81.4% of resistance cases and 82.3% of sensitivity controls. We therefore compared endorsement within matched gene and evidence-level groups. This analysis is exploratory because it was specified after the pre-registered analysis, which yielded null-to-weak results. Measured failures depended strongly on the reference knowledge base and evidence strength. When a second source independently confirmed resistance, four models across three vendors endorsed at most 2.4% of cases; at weaker evidence tiers, discrimination was not measurable. Models sometimes acknowledged resistance yet recommended the therapy. Repeating a model's own resistance conclusion reduced endorsement to 0.0-3.5% on cases where it had stated resistance. Falsely attributing the opposite conclusion increased endorsement above baseline for all seven hosted models, reaching 95.2% for GPT-4o; an instruction without an attributed conclusion changed endorsement by only 0.9 percentage points. Providing the correct curated evidence reduced unqualified strong recommendations to 0.3-3.5%, testing evidence use under an oracle condition rather than retrieval.

translation.title: 从突变到用药：刻画临床 LLM 不尊重基因组耐药证据的失败
translation.abstract: 语言模型越来越多地被提议用于支持分子肿瘤委员会，但即使存在基因组耐药证据，它们仍可能推荐癌症疗法。我们在来自五个精选肿瘤学知识库的 1,464 个耐药案例上评估了十个模型，共收集 58,910 条判断。模型在 21.8%–81.4% 的案例中认可了耐药疗法。然而，原始比率可能反映的是认同倾向而非区分耐药与药物敏感的能力：一个开源权重模型认可了 81.4% 的耐药案例和 82.3% 的敏感性对照。因此我们在匹配的基因和证据级别组内比较认可率。该分析具有探索性，因为它是在预注册分析之后设定的，后者产生了从无到弱的结果。测得的失败在很大程度上取决于参考知识库和证据强度。当第二个来源独立确认耐药时，来自三个供应商的四个模型最多认可 2.4% 的案例；在较弱证据层级下，区分能力无法测量。模型有时会承认耐药却仍推荐该疗法。重复模型自身的耐药结论可将其认可率降至 0.0%–3.5%（在其曾表述耐药的案例上）；错误地赋予相反结论则使所有七个托管模型的认可率高于基线，GPT-4o 达到 95.2%；不带归因结论的指令仅改变 0.9 个百分点的认可率。提供正确的精选证据将无保留的强推荐降至 0.3%–3.5%，这测试的是在理想（oracle）条件而非检索条件下的证据使用。
translation.brief: 系统量化临床 LLM 在存在基因组耐药证据时仍推荐癌症疗法的失败，并采用匹配基因与证据层组的认可率对比及结论归因干预来刻画失败模式。

papers.title: OmitEHR: Scalable Omission Detection in LLM-Generated Clinical Summaries
papers.abstract: Health systems increasingly rely on large language models (LLMs) to draft summaries of patient medical records, yet evaluations now find omissions, the absence of clinically important information, to be the most common failure mode. Detecting omissions in an LLM-generated summary requires knowing which facts in the record are salient, a signal that existing methods hand-specify, ignore, or recompute at inference with costly LLM judges. We present OmitEHR, a reference-free omission detector that learns clinical salience from historical clinician-written summaries predating widespread LLM use. OmitEHR learns to predict which source-note sentences clinicians include in their summaries, then surfaces high-salience sentences not covered by an LLM-generated summary as candidate omissions. We apply OmitEHR to brief hospital course (BHC) summarization using 5,000 admissions from a large academic medical center. On held-out admissions, OmitEHR outperformed all evaluated baselines at predicting salient source sentences, including a prompted LLM judge. The full omission detection pipeline took 17.7 to 19.5 seconds and cost \$0.03 to \$0.13 per summary depending on the base model, 1.6 to 1.7 times faster and 5.6 to 6.7 times cheaper than scoring every source sentence with an LLM judge. In a blinded review of 25 admissions, two board-certified clinicians confirmed a mean of 5.6 clinically meaningful omissions per summary surfaced by OmitEHR, compared with 3.3 for a full LLM pipeline, counting candidates confirmed by at least one clinician. The efficiency and validity of OmitEHR make it a practical tool for health systems to flag omissions before a summary reaches the clinician.

translation.title: OmitEHR：LLM 生成的临床总结中的可扩展遗漏检测
translation.abstract: 医疗系统日益依赖大语言模型（LLM）起草患者病历摘要，然而评估发现，遗漏（临床重要信息的缺失）已成为最常见的失败模式。检测 LLM 生成摘要中的遗漏需要知道病历中哪些事实是重要的，而现有方法要么人工指定该信号，要么忽略它，要么在推理时用昂贵的 LLM 评判器重新计算。我们提出 OmitEHR，一个免参考的遗漏检测器，它从 LLM 广泛使用之前的历史临床医生撰写摘要中学习临床显著性。OmitEHR 学习预测临床医生会在其摘要中纳入哪些源病历句子，然后将 LLM 生成摘要未覆盖的高显著性句子作为候选遗漏呈现出来。我们将 OmitEHR 应用于简短住院病程（BHC）摘要，使用来自一所大型学术医疗中心的 5,000 次住院记录。在留出的住院数据上，OmitEHR 在预测显著源句子方面优于所有评估基线，包括被提示的 LLM 评判器。完整的遗漏检测流程耗时 17.7 至 19.5 秒，每份摘要成本 0.03 至 0.13 美元（取决于基础模型），比用 LLM 评判器为每句源句子打分快 1.6 至 1.7 倍、便宜 5.6 至 6.7 倍。在对 25 次住院的盲评中，两名执业认证的临床医生确认 OmitEHR 每份摘要平均呈现 5.6 个有临床意义的遗漏（以至少一位医生确认的候选计），而完整 LLM 流程为 3.3 个。OmitEHR 的效率和有效性使其成为医疗系统在摘要送达临床医生之前标记遗漏的实用工具。
translation.brief: 提出免参考遗漏检测器 OmitEHR，通过从历史医生撰写摘要中学习临床显著性来识别 LLM 生成临床总结中被遗漏的重要信息，避免了昂贵的人工规则或 LLM 评判。

papers.title: SMELL: Sparsity-aware Memory Efficient Federated Fine-tuning for Long-context LLMs
papers.abstract: Federated fine-tuning enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to collaboratively adapt to distributed private data. However, long-context fine-tuning on resource-constrained devices faces substantial challenges arising from excessive activation memory, heterogeneous token-importance patterns across clients, and communication overhead. To address these challenges, we propose SMELL, a Sparsity-aware and Memory-Efficient federated fine-tuning framework for Long-context LLMs. SMELL integrates three complementary mechanisms: Local Sparse-Forward Adaptation (LSFA), Consensus-Anchored Sparsity Coordination (CASC), and Communication-Efficient Progressive Update Recovery (CPUR). These mechanisms jointly enable memory-efficient local adaptation, heterogeneity-aware sparsity coordination, and lightweight model-update transmission. Experiments on OPT-350M and LLaMA2-7B demonstrate that SMELL reduces peak memory consumption by up to 88.35% compared with conventional fine-tuning and 13.25% compared with forward-only LoRA fine-tuning at a 16K context length. Furthermore, SMELL improves fine-tuning performance under certain non-IID settings and supports compact update transmission with progressive reconstruction, demonstrating its potential for resource-efficient federated long-context LLM adaptation.

translation.title: SMELL：面向长上下文 LLM 的稀疏感知内存高效联邦微调
translation.abstract: 联邦微调使大语言模型（LLM）能够协作地适应分布式私有数据。然而，在资源受限设备上进行长上下文微调面临重大挑战，包括过多的激活内存、客户端间异构的 token 重要性模式以及通信开销。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 SMELL，一个面向长上下文 LLM 的稀疏感知、内存高效联邦微调框架。SMELL 集成了三个互补机制：本地稀疏前向适配（LSFA）、共识锚定稀疏协调（CASC）和通信高效渐进式更新恢复（CPUR）。这些机制共同实现了内存高效的本地适配、异构感知的稀疏协调以及轻量级模型更新传输。在 OPT-350M 和 LLaMA2-7B 上的实验表明，在 16K 上下文长度下，SMELL 相比常规微调可将峰值内存消耗降低最多 88.35%，相比仅前向 LoRA 微调降低 13.25%。此外，SMELL 在某些非 IID 设置下提升了微调性能，并支持通过渐进式重建实现紧凑的更新传输，展示了其在资源高效的联邦长上下文 LLM 适配方面的潜力。
translation.brief: 提出 SMELL 框架，通过本地稀疏前向适配、共识锚定稀疏协调和渐进式更新恢复，解决资源受限设备上长上下文联邦微调的内存、异构性和通信开销问题。

papers.title: A Comparative Evaluation of BERT-Based and LLM-Based Models for Indic Sentence Similarity
papers.abstract: The relative effectiveness of BERT-based encoders and large language model (LLM)-based embeddings for Indic semantic textual similarity remains insufficiently characterized. We compare eight BERT-based and five LLM-based models on the 1,500-pair STS Benchmark development set translated into ten Indic languages and on the native Marathi MahaSTS test set. IndicSBERT achieves the highest Pearson correlation in all ten translated language sets, with a macro-average of 0.843, followed by BGE-M3 at 0.792. Harrier-270M is the strongest LLM-based model on translated STS-B, with a macro-average of 0.751. On MahaSTS, IndicSBERT and Bhasha-Embed-v0 achieve Pearson correlations of 0.901 and 0.900, respectively, while EmbeddingGemma leads the LLM-based models at 0.871. The highest-scoring BERT-based model thus exceeds the highest-scoring LLM-based model in both settings, although the magnitude of the difference varies across benchmarks. These findings indicate that LLM-derived embeddings do not uniformly improve Indic sentence similarity over established encoders and motivate evaluation that accounts for language coverage, task supervision, and benchmark construction.

translation.title: 基于 BERT 与基于 LLM 的模型在印度语系句子相似度上的比较评估
translation.abstract: 基于 BERT 的编码器与大语言模型（LLM）嵌入在印度语系语义文本相似度上的相对有效性仍未得到充分刻画。我们在翻译成十种印度语系的 1,500 对 STS Benchmark 开发集以及本土马拉地语 MahaSTS 测试集上比较了八个基于 BERT 的模型和五个基于 LLM 的模型。IndicSBERT 在全部十个翻译语言集上取得最高的 Pearson 相关系数，宏观平均为 0.843，其次是 BGE-M3 的 0.792。Harrier-270M 是翻译 STS-B 上最强的基于 LLM 的模型，宏观平均为 0.751。在 MahaSTS 上，IndicSBERT 和 Bhasha-Embed-v0 分别取得 0.901 和 0.900 的 Pearson 相关系数，而 EmbeddingGemma 以 0.871 领先基于 LLM 的模型。因此，在两种设置下，得分最高的基于 BERT 的模型均超过得分最高的基于 LLM 的模型，尽管差距大小因基准而异。这些发现表明，LLM 衍生的嵌入并不会在印度语系句子相似度上一致地优于成熟编码器，并促使人们开展考虑语言覆盖、任务监督和基准构建方式的评估。
translation.brief: 通过在翻译的 STS-B 与马拉地语 MahaSTS 上系统对比 BERT 类与 LLM 类嵌入模型，检验哪类模型更适合印度语系语义文本相似度任务。

papers.title: SliceWise: Traffic-Aware Multi-Agent RL with Temporal Encoding for Joint Slice Admission and Resource Orchestration in O-RAN
papers.abstract: Ultra-reliable low-latency communication (URLLC) services in mission-critical applications such as industrial automation, remote healthcare, and autonomous systems demand stringent quality-of-service (QoS) guarantees under dynamic, resource-constrained wireless conditions. Open radio access networks (O-RAN) offer a software-defined and programmable foundation for embedding AI-driven control. This letter proposes SliceWise, a traffic-aware multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (MARL) framework for joint admission control, user-slice association, and resource orchestration in O-RAN. The control problem is modeled as a cooperative multi-agent Markov decision process, with long short-term memory (LSTM) networks capturing temporal traffic dynamics and dueling double deep Q-networks (D3QN) ensuring stable learning. Simulation results show that SliceWise substantially reduces delay violations and packet drops while improving slice-level reliability and resource efficiency, offering a scalable orchestration solution for AI-native O-RAN deployments.

translation.title: SliceWise: 面向 O-RAN 中切片接纳与资源编排联合优化的流量感知多智能体强化学习与时序编码方法
translation.abstract: 工业自动化、远程医疗和自主系统等关键任务应用中的超可靠低时延通信（URLLC）服务，要求在动态且资源受限的无线条件下提供严格的服务质量（QoS）保障。开放无线接入网（O-RAN）为嵌入 AI 驱动的控制提供了软件定义、可编程的基础。本信件提出 SliceWise，一种面向 O-RAN 中接纳控制、用户-切片关联和资源编排联合优化的流量感知多智能体深度强化学习（MARL）框架。该控制问题被建模为协作式多智能体马尔可夫决策过程，利用长短期记忆（LSTM）网络捕获时序流量动态，并采用 dueling double deep Q-networks（D3QN）确保学习稳定。仿真结果表明，SliceWise 大幅减少时延违约和丢包，同时提升切片级可靠性和资源利用效率，为 AI 原生 O-RAN 部署提供了可扩展的编排方案。
translation.brief: 针对 O-RAN 中 URLLC 业务的接纳控制与资源编排联合优化问题，提出结合 LSTM 时序编码与 D3QN 的流量感知多智能体强化学习框架 SliceWise。

papers.title: One Run Is Not Enough: Reminding a small Gemma 4 coding agent of its last finding made no measurable difference in a paired test
papers.abstract: When a coding agent runs out of room, its earlier findings are cut and it forgets them. We tested a simple fix: automatically putting the agent's last finding back in front of it. We fixed the rules in advance and ran 98 paired coding tasks with and without this reminder, using Gemma 4 31B (QAT, 4-bit) in the Gemma 4 Developer Agent harness. The reminder made no measurable difference: across all 98 tasks, 47 were solved with it and 48 without (-1.0 points, 95% interval [-8.3, +6.3], exact McNemar p=1.0). The primary outcome (a documented deviation from our preregistration), the first 48 pairs, was 29/48 with memory against 25/48 without (+8.3 points, [-2.1, +18.3], p=0.22); the extension of 50 tasks, decided after that result, pointed the other way (18/50 against 23/50, -10.0 points, p=0.125), so the sign did not replicate. With 19% of tasks flipping between two identical no-memory runs, the combined interval excludes harms larger than about 8 points and gains larger than about 6, and the design had 80% power only for effects of about +-12 points or more. The model almost never wrote notes (2 of 16 and 4 of 32 runs), and memory cost context: the first request is larger and something was injected at only 47% to 65% of compactions. The registered secondary, repeated actions per compaction, was also null. Two directional hypotheses found on Modal did not replicate on Kaggle. We also report an A/A calibration and a validity funnel (129 tasks, 105 valid). Together these results show that single-run memory claims on task sets of this size sit inside run-to-run noise. The treatment is a harness mechanism and does not test agent-written memory.

translation.title: 一次运行并不足够：配对测试中，提醒小型 Gemma 4 编码智能体其上一次发现未产生可测量的差异
translation.abstract: 当编码智能体的上下文用尽时，其早先的发现会被截断并被遗忘。我们测试了一个简单的修复方法：自动将该智能体上一次发现重新放到它面前。我们事先固定规则，在 Gemma 4 Developer Agent 框架中使用 Gemma 4 31B（QAT，4-bit）运行了 98 个配对编码任务，分别带与不带该提醒。该提醒未产生可测量的差异：在全部 98 个任务中，带提醒解决 47 个，不带解决 48 个（-1.0 分，95% 区间 [-8.3, +6.3]，精确 McNemar p=1.0）。主要结果（已记录的偏离预注册的偏差）即前 48 对为带记忆 29/48 对不带记忆 25/48（+8.3 分，[-2.1, +18.3]，p=0.22）；在该结果之后决定追加的 50 个任务则指向相反方向（18/50 对 23/50，-10.0 分，p=0.125），因此符号未能复现。由于 19% 的任务在两次完全相同的无记忆运行之间翻转，合并区间排除了大于约 8 分的危害和大于约 6 分的收益，且该设计的 80% 统计功效仅能检测约 ±12 分或更大的效应。该模型几乎从不写笔记（16 次运行中 2 次、32 次中 4 次），且记忆消耗上下文：首个请求更大，且仅在 47% 到 65% 的压缩时刻注入了内容。注册的次要指标——每次压缩的重复动作数——也为零效应。在 Modal 上发现的两个方向性假设未能在 Kaggle 上复现。我们还报告了 A/A 校准和有效性漏斗（129 个任务，105 个有效）。综合来看，这些结果表明在如此规模的任务集上，单次运行的记忆效应主张落在运行间噪声之内。该处理是一种框架机制，并未测试智能体自行书写的记忆。
translation.brief: 研究在编码智能体上下文压缩时自动重放其上一次发现是否有助任务解决，通过在 Gemma 4 31B 上进行 98 对预注册配对实验发现无显著效应。

papers.title: CausalGloss: Multi-Evidence Action Control for a Simultaneous Mandarin Speech-to-ASL Gloss Cascade
papers.abstract: Simultaneous Mandarin speech-to-American Sign Language (ASL) gloss translation requires deciding when an evolving utterance supports committing each gloss. Fixed Wait-k cannot adapt to source-gloss reordering, while training only on reference histories causes exposure bias. We present CausalGloss, an English-prefix-to-ASL-gloss action policy for a Mandarin-speech cascade. It combines lexical and semantic evidence, bounded delay, negation constraints, burst WRITE actions, and incomplete-history recovery. On a frozen 500-example How2Sign-derived benchmark with weak LLM-generated references, CausalGloss improves the fixed Wait-k frontier and nearly matches a three-seed TransLLaMA-style learned adaptive baseline at k = 5 in Token F1 (0.7047 versus 0.7067), with 54.4% lower LAAL. Against CLERC Epee human-gloss references, it achieves 0.649 Token F1 and Pareto-dominates three-seed TransLLaMA-style k = 5 and fixed k = 5, 7, reducing LAAL by 58.2-69.9%. Ablations separate timing from retention. A synthetic Mandarin-speech cascade preserves a smaller computation-aware latency gain, although outputs remain over-long. We also construct ChineseSpeech-ASLGloss-v1, a 19,924-utterance, 36.54-h controlled evaluation corpus.

translation.title: CausalGloss: 面向普通话语音到 ASL Gloss 同步级联的多证据动作控制
translation.abstract: 普通话语音到美国手语（ASL）gloss 的同步翻译需要决定何时让不断演变的语音支持提交每个 gloss。固定的 Wait-k 无法适应源与 gloss 之间的重排序，而仅在参考历史上训练则会导致 exposure bias。我们提出 CausalGloss，一种面向普通话语音级联的英语前缀到 ASL gloss 的动作策略。它结合了词汇与语义证据、有界延迟、否定约束、突发 WRITE 动作以及不完整历史恢复。在一个基于 How2Sign 冻结的 500 样本弱 LLM 生成参考基准上，CausalGloss 改进了固定 Wait-k 前沿，并在 Token F1 上（0.7047 对 0.7067）几乎达到三种子 TransLLaMA 风格的学习型自适应基线在 k=5 的水平，同时 LAAL 降低 54.4%。针对 CLERC Epee 人工 gloss 参考，其 Token F1 达到 0.649，并在帕累托意义上优于三种子 TransLLaMA 风格 k=5 以及固定 k=5、7，LAAL 降低 58.2–69.9%。消融实验区分了时机与保留的作用。合成的普通话语音级联保留了较小的计算感知时延收益，尽管输出仍然偏长。我们还构建了 ChineseSpeech-ASLGloss-v1，一个包含 19,924 条语音、36.54 小时的受控评估语料库。
translation.brief: 针对普通话语音到 ASL gloss 同步翻译中固定 Wait-k 无法自适应重排与 exposure bias 的问题，提出融合词汇与语义等多证据的动作策略 CausalGloss 来控制 gloss 提交时机。

papers.title: Does a completed simulation run mean a usable urban wind result for AI agents?
papers.abstract: AI agents based on large language models (LLMs) can now configure and run computational fluid dynamics (CFD) solvers, but a completed run does not ensure that delivered metrics can be recomputed from raw outputs. This gap was examined for urban wind simulation, where multi-case comparisons must hold non-target conditions fixed and reported values must be traceable to raw samples. UrbanWind-AgentBench, comprising 200 tasks and 367 cases in 10 engineering task families, was constructed. Public task contracts specify variable factors, fixed conditions, numerical thresholds and deliverable requirements, and two-layer scoring separates a structural score for deliverables, run provenance and raw evidence from a numerical score obtained by independent recomputation against references. WindPilot was then proposed as an execution framework that incorporates contract parsing, execution provenance, deterministic verification and bounded acceptance review into the LLM execution loop. On 30 OpenFOAM tasks with independent references, at least the structural maximum of 60 points was reached by a base agent on 28 tasks, but numerical credit was obtained on only 6. With the same model name and budget, WindPilot increased the number of tasks with numerical credit to 17, full-score tasks from 0 to 3 and the mean task score from 62.5 to 72.5. Mean action steps fell from 130.4 to 104.9, and mean token consumption decreased by 12.9%. The mean gain for atmospheric boundary layer (ABL) tasks was 18.5 points. A completed simulation run is therefore not sufficient for a usable urban wind result; usability depends on checks that tie reported metrics to raw evidence during execution.

translation.title: 一次完成的仿真运行就意味着对 AI 智能体可用的城市风场结果吗？
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的 AI 智能体现在可以配置并运行计算流体动力学（CFD）求解器，但一次完成的运行并不能确保所交付的指标可以从原始输出中重新计算得到。我们针对城市风场仿真研究了这一差距，其中多案例比较必须固定非目标条件，且报告值必须可追溯至原始样本。我们构建了 UrbanWind-AgentBench，包含 10 个工程任务族的 200 个任务和 367 个案例。公开的任务契约规定变量因素、固定条件、数值阈值和交付物要求；两层评分将针对交付物、运行溯源和原始证据的结构分与通过独立重算对照参考获得的数值分分开。随后我们提出 WindPilot 作为一种执行框架，将契约解析、执行溯源、确定性验证和有界接受审查纳入 LLM 执行循环。在 30 个具有独立参考的 OpenFOAM 任务上，基础智能体在 28 个任务上至少达到结构满分 60 分，但仅在 6 个任务上获得数值分。在相同模型名称和预算下，WindPilot 将获得数值分的任务数提升到 17，满分任务从 0 增至 3，平均任务分从 62.5 提升到 72.5。平均动作步数从 130.4 降至 104.9，平均 token 消耗降低 12.9%。大气边界层（ABL）任务的平均增益为 18.5 分。因此，一次完成的仿真运行并不足以产生可用的城市风场结果；可用性取决于在执行过程中将报告指标与原始证据绑定起来的检查。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 智能体完成 CFD 仿真后结果可用性不足的问题，构建 UrbanWind-AgentBench 并提出带契约解析与溯源验证的执行框架 WindPilot。

papers.title: From Facts to Personas: Interpretable Role Unlearning in LLMs via Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract: LLMs are widely adopted in multi-role dialogue and persona simulation.
