However, their strong ability to imitate role-specific linguistic and behavioral patterns can introduce privacy risks, reinforce social biases, and lead to unsafe or uncontrollable outputs. To address these issues, we introduce the Role-playing Unlearning task, which aims to selectively forget the style and knowledge associated with target roles while preserving the language ability and behaviors of the remaining roles. Unlike prior unlearning tasks that focus solely on removing factual information, our task additionally requires forgetting persona-specific characteristics, making the control over model generation more fine-grained. We propose RoleMoE, a Mixture-of-Experts framework that maps different roles to more independent expert subspaces, improving role separation and structural interpretability. To further distinguish role-specific features, RoleMoE incorporates two complementary losses: a specialization loss that drives roles to adopt distinct expert distributions, and a disentanglement loss that encourages experts to develop distinct capability subspaces. This decomposed structure enables role unlearning to focus selectively on target-role experts. We finally propose RoleBench-Unlearn for evaluation, and experiments on multiple backbone LLMs show that RoleMoE enables precise and controllable role forgetting, while better preserving the linguistic quality, knowledge, and persona consistency of non-target roles. All code and datasets are publicly available at: this https URL.

translation.title: 从事实到角色人格：基于 Mixture-of-Experts 的 LLM 可解释角色遗忘
translation.abstract: LLM 被广泛应用于多角色对话和角色人格模拟。然而，其强大的模仿特定角色语言和行为模式的能力可能带来隐私风险、强化社会偏见，并导致不安全或不可控的输出。为解决这些问题，我们引入角色扮演遗忘（Role-playing Unlearning）任务，旨在选择性地遗忘与目标角色相关的风格和知识，同时保留其余角色的语言能力和行为。与以往仅关注移除事实信息的遗忘任务不同，我们的任务还要求遗忘角色人格特有特征，使对模型生成的控制更加细粒度。我们提出 RoleMoE，一种 Mixture-of-Experts 框架，将不同角色映射到更独立的专家子空间，提升角色分离度和结构可解释性。为进一步区分角色特有特征，RoleMoE 引入两个互补损失：驱动各角色采用不同专家分布的专门化损失，以及鼓励各专家形成不同能力子空间的解耦损失。这种分解结构使角色遗忘能够选择性地聚焦于目标角色的专家。我们最后提出 RoleBench-Unlearn 用于评估，在多个骨干 LLM 上的实验表明，RoleMoE 实现了精确且可控的角色遗忘，同时更好地保留了非目标角色的语言质量、知识和角色一致性。所有代码和数据集公开于：this https URL。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 中目标角色风格与知识的精细遗忘问题，提出基于 Mixture-of-Experts 的 RoleMoE 框架，通过专门化与解耦损失将角色映射到独立专家子空间以实现选择性遗忘。

papers.title: Do Rule-Based Tools Help LLMs Translate Endangered Uralic Languages in the Prompt or over MCP?
papers.abstract: Komi-Zyrian, Moksha, Erzya and Udmurt have mature rule-based resources, among them finite-state analysers, constraint grammars and bilingual dictionaries, which language models do not use. We ask whether giving a model access to these resources improves machine translation from the four languages into English, and whether it matters how the access is provided: as analyses computed in advance and written into the prompt, or as tools that the model calls itself through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We evaluate manually: an expert linguist read every English output of the strongest model under three conditions, 816 sentences in all, accepted or rejected each one, and named the main error in every rejected translation. With the analyses in the prompt, the number of accepted translations rises from 13 to 43 out of 272; with the tools attached it rises to 55. The gain comes from the bilingual dictionary. For Udmurt, whose dictionary has no English side, the prompt-based condition brings no gain at all, while for the other three languages an English gloss reaches the prompt for 74 to 80% of the source words. Tool calling is also much harder to get working than prompt injection. Of 31 open-weight models, 14 never call a tool, 11 of them because they cannot produce a usable call, and half of the calls that are made name a language the toolkit does not support. We release the data set, every model output and all tool-call logs.

translation.title: 基于规则的工具能在 Prompt 中或通过 MCP 帮助 LLM 翻译濒危的乌拉尔语言吗？
translation.abstract: 科米-济良语（Komi-Zyrian）、莫克沙语（Moksha）、埃尔齐亚语（Erzya）和乌德穆尔特语（Udmurt）拥有成熟的基于规则的资源，包括有限状态分析器、约束语法和双语词典，但语言模型并未使用这些资源。我们探究让模型访问这些资源是否能改进这四种语言到英语的机器翻译，以及访问方式是否有影响：是将预先计算好的分析结果写入 prompt，还是让模型通过 Model Context Protocol（MCP）自行调用工具。我们进行人工评估：一位专家语言学家逐一阅读最强模型在三种条件下的全部英文输出，共 816 个句子，对每个输出进行接受或拒绝判定，并为每个被拒绝的翻译指出主要错误。将分析结果放入 prompt 后，接受数量从 272 中的 13 提升到 43；附加工具后提升到 55。这一增益来自双语词典。对于词典没有英语一侧的乌德穆尔特语，基于 prompt 的条件完全没有增益；而其他三种语言中 74% 到 80% 的源词能以英文释义进入 prompt。工具调用也比 prompt 注入难得多：在 31 个开放权重模型中，有 14 个从不调用工具（其中 11 个是无法生成可用的调用），且一半的调用指定了工具包不支持的语言。我们发布了数据集、所有模型输出和全部工具调用日志。
translation.brief: 研究将濒危乌拉尔语言的双语词典等规则资源以 prompt 注入或 MCP 工具调用两种方式提供给 LLM 以改进其到英语的翻译，并人工验证增益主要来自双语词典。

papers.title: CLEW: Log-Anchored Backward Tracing for Root-Cause Code Localization
papers.abstract: Failures in industrial software systems may involve multiple components and be difficult to reproduce outside the production environment. Root-cause code localization therefore often relies on issue descriptions and runtime logs. However, log evidence may be noisy or incomplete, and the code reporting a symptom may differ from the code containing the underlying defect. These conditions make it challenging to identify relevant log evidence and determine which functions could have caused the reported failure. To address this gap, we introduce CLEW, an agentic approach that combines rule-based log-to-code anchoring with LLM-guided backward code tracing. CLEW organizes selected observations into diagnostic states, guides source exploration from anchored symptom functions, and returns ranked candidate functions, an affected module, and an explanation comprising a proposed mechanism path and associated log events. For evaluation, we construct LogLoc, a benchmark comprising 192 real-world issue and fault-injection cases. Against three baselines, CLEW records the highest observed Acc@1 (77.3%) and MRR (81.3%) on LogLoc-Issues and matches the leading baselines at 97.6% Acc@1 on LogLoc-Airflow. Averaged over all 192 cases, CLEW's wall-clock time is approximately 73% lower than LocAgent's at a similar average inference cost. No aggregate degradation is observed under the tested perturbations, with modest changes in Acc@1 and MRR across the evaluated seeds and base models. These results suggest that CLEW can combine function-level localization with evidence links and runtime efficiency under the evaluated conditions.

translation.title: CLEW：基于日志锚定的反向追踪根因代码定位
translation.abstract: 工业软件系统中的故障可能涉及多个组件，且在生产环境之外难以复现，因此根因代码定位往往依赖问题描述和运行时日志。然而日志证据可能嘈杂或不完整，且报告症状的代码可能不同于包含底层缺陷的代码，这些情况使得识别相关日志证据并确定哪些函数可能导致所报告故障变得困难。为此，我们提出 CLEW，一种将基于规则的日志-代码锚定与 LLM 引导的反向代码追踪相结合的智能体方法。CLEW 将选定的观测组织成诊断状态，从锚定的症状函数出发引导源码探索，并返回排序后的候选函数、受影响模块以及包含疑似机制路径和相关日志事件的解释。为进行评估，我们构建了 LogLoc 基准，包含 192 个真实问题和故障注入案例。与三个基线相比，CLEW 在 LogLoc-Issues 上取得了最高的 Acc@1（77.3%）和 MRR（81.3%），并在 LogLoc-Airflow 上以 97.6% 的 Acc@1 与最强基线持平。在全部 192 个案例上平均，CLEW 的墙钟时间比 LocAgent 低约 73%，而平均推理成本相近。在测试的扰动下未观察到总体退化，Acc@1 和 MRR 在不同种子和基座模型间仅有适度变化。这些结果表明 CLEW 能在评估条件下兼顾函数级定位、证据链和运行时效率。
translation.brief: 提出 CLEW，用规则将日志锚定到代码，再由 LLM 从症状函数反向追踪源码，以定位故障根因函数。

papers.title: Program Distillation: Transferring LLM Capability from System 2 to System 0
papers.abstract: Recent studies leverage large language models (LLMs) to construct executable programs through environment interaction, feedback analysis, and code revision. However, prior work has mainly treated LLMs as optimizers, overlooking their ability to transfer knowledge across system levels. We propose Program Distillation (PD), a framework that formalizes the transfer of abilities from System 2 to System 0. During learning, the LLM provides task knowledge and draft strategies; at deployment, a student program executes the resulting policy. We show that this approach can improve performance while reducing inference time. We introduce PDBench, a benchmark comprising 27 discrete- and continuous-control tasks with fixed initial policies, and PDMetaHarness, a model-harness-independent meta-system for monitoring and guiding the learning process. The strongest model achieves a normalized mean score of 0.728, surpassing PPO (0.656) and Jev-like decision models (0.239), while running exclusively on CPUs and reducing inference costs. Our analysis shows that performance is largely driven by the first breakthrough during learning, and structural modifications have a slightly lower success rate than parameter modifications but typically yield larger gains. We further introduce style distillation, which enables interpretable stylistic control over the learning process. Overall, we present an analytical framework for PD and demonstrate its practical viability.

translation.title: 程序蒸馏：将 LLM 能力从 System 2 迁移到 System 0
translation.abstract: 近期研究利用大语言模型（LLM）通过环境交互、反馈分析和代码修改来构建可执行程序。然而，先前的工作主要将 LLM 视为优化器，忽视了其在系统层级之间迁移知识的能力。我们提出程序蒸馏（Program Distillation, PD），一个将能力从 System 2 迁移到 System 0 的形式化框架。学习阶段，LLM 提供任务知识和初步策略；部署阶段，一个学生程序执行由此得到的策略。我们证明该方法能在降低推理时间的同时提升性能。我们引入了包含 27 个离散与连续控制任务且带固定初始策略的 PDBench 基准，以及一个与模型和 harness 无关、用于监控和引导学习过程的元系统 PDMetaHarness。最强模型取得 0.728 的归一化平均分，超过 PPO（0.656）和 Jev 类决策模型（0.239），且完全在 CPU 上运行并降低了推理成本。我们的分析表明性能主要由学习过程中的首次突破驱动，结构修改的成功率略低于参数修改，但通常带来更大增益。我们进一步提出风格蒸馏，使学习过程获得可解释的风格控制。总体而言，我们给出了 PD 的分析框架并证明其实用可行性。
translation.brief: 提出程序蒸馏框架，让 LLM 在学习期生成策略（System 2），部署期由编译出的学生程序执行（System 0），以降低推理成本并提升性能。

papers.title: VAST: Compiling Grounded Vulnerability Scenarios into Verifiable, Multi-Step Environments for Evaluating LLM Red-Team Agents
papers.abstract: Evaluating Large Language Model (LLM) security agents requires reproducible environments whose workflow difficulty can be varied and whose failures can be diagnosed. We present VAST (Verifiable Adversarial Scenario Training & Evaluation), a declarative range compiler separating vulnerability scenarios from a compiler-introduced workflow-hardening layer. Following a post-hoc code and AST audit across all topics, the main benchmark retains 109 seed edges (45 with strict upstream CVE annotations), 72 family identifiers (62 under shared-HMAC relay grouping), 81 topic configurations (76 core plus 5 bounded execution models), and 1,387 instances (359 canonical four-gate-revalidated specs plus 1,028 seed variants) in a 42:39 partition. On the TopicServer compiler stratum, a budget-matched 270-episode prompt contrast across 10 compiled mechanism-family clusters (30 P2/P3/P4 instances, 40 turns, temperature 0.0) shows that glm-5.3, grok-4.7, and deepseek-v4-pro solve 12/90 instances under contract_only and 14/90 under generic_hint (cluster sign p=1.00), whereas supplying the shared workflow protocol in full_guide lifts completion to 76/90 (28/30, 23/30, 25/30; cluster sign p<=0.00391). On the separate ranges_v2 ledger, a 126-episode evaluation across 6 non-TopicServer workflows and multi-container Docker/Linux stacks solves 88/126 (69.8%) (28/42, 31/42, 29/42), while an 18-episode intervention on asynchronous Redis worker chaining (v2_02) lifts solves from 0/18 to 18/18 (100%) in 4-6 turns when installed worker modules are disclosed in GET /sched/directory. Finally, a three-seed (s in {42, 1024, 2025}) LoRA recipe comparison on Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct across 37 lineage-disjoint families (231 episodes on 33 held-out instances) yields 0/33 for Base, 1.67 +/- 2.89 / 33 for Golden SFT, and 4.67 +/- 2.31 / 33 for Header-Recovery SFT, with all solves on v2_03.

translation.title: VAST：将接地漏洞场景编译为可验证的多步骤环境以评估 LLM 红队智能体
translation.abstract: 评估大语言模型（LLM）安全智能体需要可复现的环境，其工作流难度可调、故障可诊断。我们提出 VAST（Verifiable Adversarial Scenario Training & Evaluation），一个声明式靶场编译器，将漏洞场景与编译器引入的工作流加固层分离。经过对所有主题的事后代码与 AST 审计，主基准保留了 109 条种子边（其中 45 条带有严格的上游 CVE 标注）、72 个族标识符（62 个采用共享 HMAC 中继分组）、81 个主题配置（76 个核心加 5 个有界执行模型）以及 1,387 个实例（359 个经四重门禁复验的规范规格加 1,028 个种子变体），按 42:39 划分。在 TopicServer 编译层上，跨 10 个编译机制族聚类的预算匹配 270 次实验 prompt 对比（30 个 P2/P3/P4 实例、40 轮、temperature 0.0）显示：glm-5.3、grok-4.7 和 deepseek-v4-pro 在 contract_only 下解决 12/90 个实例，在 generic_hint 下 14/90（聚类符号检验 p=1.00），而在 full_guide 中提供完整工作流协议后将完成数提升到 76/90（28/30、23/30、25/30；聚类符号检验 p<=0.00391）。在独立的 ranges_v2 台账上，跨 6 个非 TopicServer 工作流和多容器 Docker/Linux 栈的 126 次评估解决 88/126（69.8%）（28/42、31/42、29/42）；而在 GET /sched/directory 披露已安装 worker 模块的干预下，18 次异步 Redis worker 链式调用（v2_02）实验在 4-6 轮内将解决数从 0/18 提升到 18/18（100%）。最后，在 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct 上跨 37 个谱系不相交族的三个随机种子（s∈{42, 1024, 2025}）LoRA 配方对比（33 个保留实例上 231 次实验）得到：Base 0/33、Golden SFT 1.67±2.89/33、Header-Recovery SFT 4.67±2.31/33，所有解决均在 v2_03 上。
translation.brief: 提出 VAST 声明式编译器，将接地漏洞场景编译为可验证、难度可调的多步骤环境，用于评估 LLM 红队智能体。

papers.title: Successive Convexification in Learned World Models for Safe Offline Planning
papers.abstract: World models learned from offline data allow an agent to plan without further interaction with the environment, but the sampling-based planners used with them handle safety constraints only by scoring or rejecting sampled action sequences. We instead pose safe planning in the latent space of a learned world model as a successive convex program (SCP), in which a learned discrete-time control barrier function is imposed as a constraint at every step of the horizon. SCP requires smooth dynamics, so we build the networks from smoothed MaxMin activations and spectrally normalised layers, and bound the resulting linearisation error in terms of the Lipschitz bound and the smoothing width. As SCP is a local method, we start it from a sampled plan. On two Safety-Gymnasium navigation tasks with offline data, this planner has fewer violations than MPPI and CEM drawing 128 times as many samples at equal wall-clock time in our main comparison, though not significantly, and earns greater return at longer horizons, and is much safer than SCP without a sampled start. SCP converged more often on Lipschitz-bounded models. Unlike sampling, it also reports at each step whether its plan is a feasible, first-order optimal KKT point of the planning problem in the model, or that no feasible plan was found nearby. Our implementation is publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: 在学习的世界模型中利用逐次凸化进行安全离线规划
translation.abstract: 从离线数据学习的世界模型使智能体无需与环境进一步交互即可规划，但与之配合的基于采样的规划器只能通过评分或拒绝采样的动作序列来处理安全约束。我们转而在学习到的世界模型的潜空间中将安全规划表述为逐次凸规划（SCP），其中在每个时域步骤上都将一个学习到的离散时间控制障碍函数施加为约束。SCP 需要光滑动力学，因此我们用平滑的 MaxMin 激活和谱归一化层构建网络，并用 Lipschitz 界和平滑宽度对由此产生的线性化误差给出上界。由于 SCP 是局部方法，我们从一条采样得到的规划出发启动它。在两个使用离线数据的 Safety-Gymnasium 导航任务上，在主对比的相同墙钟时间内，该规划器的违规次数少于采样量为其 128 倍的 MPPI 和 CEM（尽管差异不显著），在更长时域下获得更高回报，且比无采样起点的 SCP 安全得多。SCP 在 Lipschitz 有界的模型上收敛更频繁。与采样方法不同，它还能在每一步报告其规划是否是模型中规划问题的可行一阶最优 KKT 点，或附近无可行规划。我们的实现已在公开网址提供。
translation.brief: 将安全离线规划表述为学习世界模型潜空间中的逐次凸规划，用学习到的控制障碍函数作为约束并从采样规划热启动。

papers.title: Towards Informed Autonomy Design: Understanding the Interplay of Function Characteristics and Autonomy Preferences in Automotive Agents
papers.abstract: Proactive, autonomous interactions receive high interest in the field of intelligent assistants, including the automotive domain. A central challenge, however, is identifying appropriate levels of autonomy for different functions while maintaining user acceptance and trust. This work examines how function characteristics relate to suitable autonomy levels and whether these relationships generalize across functions. We conducted an expert workshop to define autonomy levels and identify relevant function characteristics. We then collected data from 126 participants, who rated 14 in-vehicle functions regarding autonomy preferences and function characteristics, from which we trained machine learning models to predict appropriate autonomy levels. Building on our findings, we developed our prototypical Autonomy Design Assistant that supports designers in making autonomy-related decisions, which we evaluated qualitatively with nine experts. Our results suggest that function characteristics can rank functions by their suitable level of autonomy and thereby guide more informed autonomy design decisions, whereas predictions for individual users remain uncertain.

translation.title: 迈向知情的自主性设计：理解汽车智能体中功能特性与自主性偏好的交互关系
translation.abstract: 主动式、自主性的交互在智能助手领域（包括汽车领域）受到高度关注。然而，一个核心挑战是在保持用户接受度和信任的同时，为不同功能确定合适的自主性水平。本工作研究了功能特性如何与合适的自主性水平相关，以及这些关系能否跨功能泛化。我们组织了一场专家研讨会来定义自主性水平并识别相关功能特性。随后，我们收集了126名参与者的数据，他们对14项车载功能在自主性偏好和功能特性方面进行评分，并据此训练机器学习模型来预测合适的自主性水平。基于研究发现，我们开发了一个原型系统 Autonomy Design Assistant，支持设计师进行自主性相关决策，并邀请9位专家进行了定性评估。结果表明，功能特性可以按其合适的自主性水平对功能进行排序，从而指导更知情的自主性设计决策，而对个体用户的预测仍存在不确定性。
translation.brief: 为解决车载功能应设定何种自主性水平的问题，该研究通过专家研讨与126名用户的评分训练机器学习模型，基于功能特性预测合适的自主性等级，并构建了 Autonomy Design Assistant 辅助设计决策。

papers.title: Evaluating and Improving Natural Language Autoencoders
papers.abstract: Natural language autoencoders (NLAs) are a method for generating natural language explanations of LLM activations. We develop evaluations based on auditing tasks that test the ability of NLAs to surface latent knowledge, identify whether a model was misled by a hint, and catch a silent fabrication. We also develop extensions to NLAs that let them use activation information from multiple layers and positions, let us apply them more effectively to long transcripts, and reduce the number of false claims they make. These extensions result in improvements on both our auditing evaluations and auxiliary evaluations adapted from prior work. We also use the evaluations to study how different auditing capabilities change over the course of NLA training, and find that although every evaluation improves early in training, extended training can hurt performance on some of our auditing evaluations.

translation.title: 评估与改进自然语言自编码器
translation.abstract: 自然语言自编码器（NLA）是一种为 LLM 激活生成自然语言解释的方法。我们基于审计任务开发了一系列评估，测试 NLA 揭示潜在知识、识别模型是否被提示误导、以及发现隐蔽伪造行为的能力。我们还开发了 NLA 的扩展，使其能够利用来自多层和多个位置的激活信息，从而更有效地应用于长对话记录，并减少其作出的虚假陈述。这些扩展在我们的审计评估和改编自先前工作的辅助评估上都带来了改进。我们还利用这些评估研究了不同审计能力在 NLA 训练过程中的变化，发现尽管每项评估在训练早期都有所提升，但过长的训练可能损害部分审计评估的性能。
translation.brief: 为解决如何评估并改进 LLM 激活解释方法（NLA）的问题，该研究基于审计任务构建评估体系，并提出利用多层多位置激活信息等扩展来提升 NLA 性能。

papers.title: Sada-ASR: A Production Multidialectal Arabic Speech Recognition System
papers.abstract: Callers to Arabic customer-service lines speak their own dialect, while speech recognizers are built and evaluated mainly on Modern Standard Arabic (MSA). A recognizer that mishears the dialect breaks the call before anything else can help. We present Sada-ASR, the speech recognizer of EchoNova's production Arabic voice agent. On a 120-hour test set of MSA and eight dialects, it has the lowest word and character error rates of twelve systems, against eleven from Microsoft, ElevenLabs, Google, OpenAI, Speechmatics, IFM, Cohere, NVIDIA and Audar: 11.69% word error rate against 13.51% for the strongest, Microsoft's MAI-Transcribe-2 (a lead of 0.74 points on clips unaffected by that system's fixed number and script conventions), and 15.52% against 16.96% averaged over varieties. Its largest margins are on Omani (4.30 points), Egyptian (3.78) and Saudi (2.19) speech; it is level on Syrian and loses on Lebanese (24.96% against 23.05%), mostly because it writes Lebanese words in MSA forms and is less verbatim. On six public test sets its average word error rate under the leaderboard's current scoring is 17.17%, below every published figure we found, among them Falcon-ASR (20.92%), Jais-ASR (22.85%) and Audar-ASR-V1-Turbo (23.17%), though none of these states that it used that scoring, so the comparison is indicative. We describe the data pipeline and methodology behind Sada-ASR and release a 20-hour subset of the test set with our scoring code.

translation.title: Sada-ASR：一个生产级多方言阿拉伯语语音识别系统
translation.abstract: 拨打阿拉伯语客服热线的来电者说着自己的方言，而语音识别系统主要是基于现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）构建和评估的。一个听错方言的识别器会在其他任何手段提供帮助之前就中断通话。我们提出 Sada-ASR，即 EchoNova 生产级阿拉伯语语音智能体所使用的语音识别器。在一个包含 MSA 和八种方言的120小时测试集上，它在12个系统（其中11个来自 Microsoft、ElevenLabs、Google、OpenAI、Speechmatics、IFM、Cohere、NVIDIA 和 Audar）中拥有最低的词错误率和字符错误率：11.69% 的词错误率，对比最强的 Microsoft MAI-Transcribe-2 的13.51%（在不受该系统固定数字和书写约定影响的片段上领先0.74个百分点），各语言变体平均为15.52% 对 16.96%。其最大优势体现在阿曼（4.30分）、埃及（3.78分）和沙特（2.19分）语音上；在叙利亚方言上持平，在黎巴嫩方言上落后（24.96% 对 23.05%），主要原因是它将黎巴嫩词汇写成 MSA 形式，转写不够逐字。在六个公开测试集上，按排行榜当前评分方式，其平均词错误率为17.17%，低于我们找到的所有已发表数字，其中包括 Falcon-ASR（20.92%）、Jais-ASR（22.85%）和 Audar-ASR-V1-Turbo（23.17%），但这些系统均未说明使用了该评分方式，因此该比较仅具参考性。我们描述了 Sada-ASR 背后的数据流水线和方法，并发布了测试集的一个20小时子集及我们的评分代码。
translation.brief: 针对阿拉伯语客服场景中各方言识别失效的问题，该研究构建了覆盖 MSA 及八种方言的生产级语音识别系统 Sada-ASR，并在词错误率上超越多个主流商用系统。

papers.title: Objectify, Don't Delete: Complaint-Derived Evaluation of Ambient Clinical Notes
papers.abstract: Evaluating the quality of AI-generated clinical notes is hard: standard metrics like ROUGE measure lexical similarity to reference notes, while expert checklists encode what committees believe matters. Neither captures what clinicians actually complain about. Recent work has shown that evaluation criteria can be mined from user feedback and filtered to criteria that LLM judges can reliably enforce. We argue that this is where much of the value is lost. The criteria that fail enforceability are disproportionately the ones clinicians raise most often, because high-frequency complaints are stated as several questions glued together. No yes/no judgment can grade such composites as posed. We introduce an objectification step that rewrites such criteria into sets of scoped, determinate decisions. We demonstrate the approach through an evaluation pipeline that mines criteria from complaints, objectifies them, and deploys LLM judges against both planted defects and production notes. Across eleven defects planted into ACI-bench reference notes, objectified judges localize violations with median recall of 0.95, while reference metrics change by at most 0.037. Given the complaint as one broad question, the same judges still find every planted defect, but they also flag 70% of the unperturbed reference notes; one section-pair question per call raises Youden's J from 0.30 to 0.72 (by 0.19 to 0.26 with prompt effort matched). We release ACI-Defect, a perturbation benchmark; clinician-reviewed instance-level labels showing quality gaps in the ACI-bench gold standard (32 of 40 notes contain hallucinations; 40 of 40 omit discussed facts); and grounding-judge verdicts. On 1,446 production notes, mean instance-rate burden falls at every clinician-rating step (rho=-0.15), a small association. Defect counts have to be kept per span rather than collapsed into one pass/fail bit per note.

translation.title: 对象化而非删除：基于抱怨的环境式临床记录评估
translation.abstract: 评估 AI 生成的临床记录的质量很难：像 ROUGE 这样的标准指标衡量与参考记录的词汇相似性，而专家检查清单则体现委员会认为重要的内容。两者都无法捕捉临床医生真正抱怨的问题。近期工作表明，评估标准可以从用户反馈中挖掘，并筛选出 LLM 评审能够可靠执行的标准。我们认为价值流失正发生在这里。未能通过可执行性筛选的标准，恰恰是临床医生最常提出的那些，因为高频抱怨往往表述为几个粘合在一起的问题。这样的复合问题无法用一个是/否判断来评分。我们引入一个对象化步骤，将这类标准改写为一组范围明确、可判定的决策。我们通过一个评估流水线展示了该方法：从抱怨中挖掘标准、将其对象化，并部署 LLM 评审以检测植入的缺陷和生产记录。在向 ACI-bench 参考记录植入的11个缺陷中，对象化评审定位违规的中位召回率为0.95，而参考指标的变化最多为0.037。若将抱怨作为一个宽泛问题给出，同样的评审仍能发现所有植入缺陷，但也会对70%未受干扰的参考记录发出警示；每次调用使用一个节段对问题可将 Youden's J 从0.30提升到0.72（在提示词工作量匹配的情况下提升0.19到0.26）。我们发布了 ACI-Defect 扰动基准；经临床医生审核的实例级标签，显示 ACI-bench 黄金标准存在质量缺口（40份记录中32份含幻觉，40份均遗漏了讨论过的事实）；以及接地评审的判定结果。在1446份生产记录上，每个临床医生评分步骤的实例率负担均下降（rho=-0.15），这是一个较小的关联。缺陷计数必须按片段保留，而不能折叠为每份记录一个通过/失败位。
translation.brief: 针对临床记录评估指标无法反映医生真实抱怨的问题，该研究提出将投诉中挖掘出的复合评估标准对象化为可判定的细粒度决策，再用 LLM 评审检测缺陷。

papers.title: PathLoop: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Reasoning for Evidence-Grounded Whole-Slide Image Analysis
papers.abstract: Analyzing whole-slide images (WSIs) requires combining evidence across tissue regions and spatial scales. Multi-agent systems offer a promising approach to this task. However, existing systems make limited use of molecular evidence, often select visually prominent but less representative regions while overlooking global context, and struggle to reuse experience from previous cases. To address these challenges, we present PathLoop, a self-evolving multi-agent framework that integrates omics data for evidence-grounded WSI analysis. Specifically, PathLoop coordinates visual and omics interpreters across slide, patch, and pixel levels, using molecular signals to guide region selection and combining local tissue details with global slide features. A judgment agent then checks the consistency of the collected evidence against Pathology-Wiki, a knowledge base built from 48 entries across 24 organ systems, and triggers re-examination when the evidence is inconsistent. To reuse past experience, a four-level memory stores reasoning trajectories, practical tips, skills, and tools to guide future cases, forming a loop of evidence collection, review, and memory update. We evaluate PathLoop on four TCGA cohorts with biomarker prediction, survival prediction, and subtype classification. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of PathLoop across these tasks and support its use for evidence-grounded WSI analysis.

translation.title: PathLoop：面向证据支撑的全切片图像分析的自进化多智能体推理
translation.abstract: 分析全切片图像（WSI）需要跨组织区域和空间尺度整合证据。多智能体系统为该任务提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，现有系统对分子证据的利用有限，往往选择视觉上突出但代表性较低的区域而忽视全局上下文，且难以复用以往病例的经验。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 PathLoop，一个融合组学数据进行证据支撑的 WSI 分析的自进化多智能体框架。具体而言，PathLoop 在切片、图像块和像素层面协调视觉与组学解释器，利用分子信号引导区域选择，并将局部组织细节与全局切片特征相结合。随后，一个判断智能体对照 Pathology-Wiki（一个由24个器官系统48个条目构建的知识库）检查所收集证据的一致性，并在证据不一致时触发重新检查。为复用过往经验，一个四级记忆库存储推理轨迹、实用技巧、技能和工具，以指导未来病例，形成证据收集、审查与记忆更新的循环。我们在四个 TCGA 队列上评估 PathLoop，任务包括生物标志物预测、生存预测和亚型分类。结果证明了 PathLoop 在这些任务上的有效性，支持其用于证据支撑的 WSI 分析。
translation.brief: 为解决 WSI 分析中分子证据利用不足、区域选择欠代表和经验难复用的问题，该研究提出自进化多智能体框架 PathLoop，融合组学信号引导证据收集并借助知识库与四级记忆形成循环。

papers.title: LLM Trading Agents Earn Beta, Not Alpha: A Look-Ahead-Free Benchmark
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) trading agents now trade stocks for their users, and benchmarks rank models by their agents' returns. Yet a single run's return says little about skill. In our study, two runs of the same model that differed only in the random seed ended 5.2 points apart on average, so telling skill from luck takes many backtests across markets, models and seeds. However, live arenas trade each day only once, and backtests either use the few months after a model's training cutoff or run on years the model may remember, often with news joined to prices by calendar date. In this paper, we present rta-bench-1, a backtest over three US markets (a rally, a bear market and a crash). It shows each headline only after its publication minute, plays each period blind and named, and checks every run for look-ahead. It also splits each return into factor exposure and alpha and scores every decision against random choices of the same day and sector. In 91 runs of six models from four vendors, no alpha was significant, market and style exposure accounted for a median 78% of the return, and the decisions did no better than random stocks of the same sector. The agents bought the stocks with the most positive news, yet in ablations they earned as much without their headlines. Still, the agents carried out rules reliably, since a single cash rule in the prompt cut a GPT-based agent's share in stocks by 30.3 points in all six pairs. Builders should therefore supply the edge themselves and report exposures and alpha, and benchmarks should replay news by publication time.

translation.title: LLM 交易智能体赚的是 Beta 而非 Alpha：一个无未来信息的基准
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）交易智能体如今为用户交易股票，基准测试按智能体的收益率给模型排名。然而单次运行的收益几乎说明不了任何技能水平。在我们的研究中，同一模型的两次运行仅在随机种子上不同，结果平均相差 5.2 个点，因此要区分技能与运气需要在多个市场、模型和种子上进行大量回测。但实盘竞技场每天只交易一次，回测要么使用模型训练截止后仅有的几个月数据，要么使用模型可能记住的历史年份，而且新闻往往按日历日期与价格拼接。本文提出 rta-bench-1，一个覆盖三个美国市场阶段（上涨、熊市和崩盘）的回测。它只在新闻发布分钟之后才展示该标题新闻，对各阶段进行盲测并按名称进行，并检查每次运行是否存在未来信息泄露。它还将每次收益分解为因子暴露和 alpha，并将每个决策与同日同板块的随机选择进行对比。在对四家厂商六个模型的 91 次运行中，没有任何 alpha 是显著的，市场和风格暴露占收益的中位数 78%，且决策表现不优于同板块随机选股。智能体买入的是利好新闻最多的股票，但在消融实验中，即使不给标题新闻它们也能赚得同样多。不过，智能体能够可靠地执行规则：提示词中的一条现金规则在全部六组对比中使基于 GPT 的智能体的股票仓位降低了 30.3 个点。因此，开发者应当自己提供超额收益来源，并报告暴露与 alpha，而基准测试应按发布时间回放新闻。
translation.brief: 论文要解决 LLM 交易智能体收益无法区分技能与运气、且存在未来信息泄露的问题，核心方法是在三个市场阶段构建按新闻发布时间回放、分解暴露与 alpha 并对照随机基线的回测基准 rta-bench-1。

papers.title: Agent Authenticator: Passkey-Grade, Hardware-Bound Authentication for AI Agents
papers.abstract: AI coding agents now push code, publish packages, call model APIs and operate cloud resources on behalf of developers. They authenticate to these services with the same bearer secrets humans use, personal access tokens, API keys and package-registry tokens, stored where the model, its subprocesses and any co-resident malware can read them. Incidents in 2025 and 2026, including prompt-injection attacks on coding agents and self-propagating supply-chain worms, show that this arrangement fails in predictable ways. Passkeys solved the analogous problem for humans, but they require a human gesture on every use and cannot be operated by an autonomous process. We present the Agent Authenticator, a design that gives agents passkey-grade authentication properties: per-service hardware-bound keys, no shared secrets, origin binding enforced by the runtime rather than the model, normalized attestation of the execution environment, human-signed scoped mandates, and cross-device human approval for high-risk actions. The same protocol serves agents on developer laptops and in cloud enclaves, and it deploys as a profile over existing mechanisms, MCP authorization, OAuth token exchange including the Identity Assertion JWT Authorization Grant, git and SSH, rather than as a new identity system. The authenticator also produces a signed, hash-chained record of each action it authorizes. We analyze the design against a threat model centered on prompt injection and same-host compromise, map it onto five documented incidents, and discuss its limits.

translation.title: Agent Authenticator：面向 AI 智能体的 Passkey 级、硬件绑定认证
translation.abstract: AI 编码智能体如今代表开发者推送代码、发布软件包、调用模型 API 并操作云资源。它们使用与人类相同的持有式机密进行认证——个人访问令牌、API 密钥和包注册表令牌——存储在模型、其子进程以及任何共驻恶意软件都能读取的位置。2025 年和 2026 年的若干事故，包括针对编码智能体的提示注入攻击和自我传播的供应链蠕虫，表明这种安排会以可预见的方式失效。Passkey 为人类解决了类似问题，但它们要求每次使用时都有人工手势操作，无法由自主进程执行。我们提出 Agent Authenticator，一种为智能体提供 passkey 级认证属性的设计：每服务硬件绑定密钥、无共享机密、由运行时而非模型强制执行源绑定、执行环境的规范化证明、人工签名的范围化授权书，以及针对高风险操作的跨设备人工批准。同一协议既服务于开发者笔记本电脑上的智能体，也服务于云 enclave 中的智能体，并以现有机制（MCP 授权、OAuth 令牌交换（包括 Identity Assertion JWT Authorization Grant）、git 和 SSH）之上的一个 profile 形式部署，而非一种新的身份体系。认证器还为每个授权动作生成带签名的哈希链记录。我们针对以提示注入和同主机攻陷为核心的威胁模型分析了该设计，将其映射到五个已记录的事故上，并讨论其局限性。
translation.brief: 论文要解决 AI 智能体依赖可被窃取的持有式机密进行认证的问题，核心方法是设计一种以硬件绑定密钥、运行时强制源绑定和人工授权为核心、部署在现有机制之上的智能体认证协议。

papers.title: Continuation-Guided LLM Evolution of Program Policies and Goal Compilers in Craftax
papers.abstract: Coding agents can synthesize and optimize code-based policies from simulator feedback, allowing the resulting program to act with zero inference model calls. But for long horizon tasks, two challenges arise: local improvements can hurt final success and switching to a new objective requires another expensive synthesis run. We propose a framework that first develops competence by refining the policy through a feedback cascade, moving from episode returns to hierarchical goals and belief updates which can be scored densely from simulator. In the Craftax game, a partially observed and procedurally generated environment, refinements via episode level feedback stall at <1% final-level arrival, whereas with the feedback cascade the optimized policy reaches the final stage 50% of time (28% final boss defeats). Furthermore, to make this competence reusable towards new goals, we factor the previous controller into an environment interpreter $I$ (models, memory, skills) and a rule program $p_0$, and we show that coding agents can optimize a reusable goal compiler $C_{\theta}$ that maps structured tasks $g$ into new rule programs $p_g$. Across five independent compiler searches trained only on short tasks, the resulting compilers successfully transfer zero-shot to longer tasks without any task-specific tuning nor inference-time LLM calls: continuation-scored feedback and a fixed machine with an editable program together turn a single-task competent policy into a reusable one. Code at: this https URL

translation.title: Craftax 中延续引导的 LLM 程序化策略与目标编译器进化
translation.abstract: 编码智能体可以根据模拟器反馈合成并优化基于代码的策略，使所得程序在推理时无需模型调用即可行动。但对于长时程任务，会出现两个挑战：局部改进可能损害最终成功率，而切换到新目标则需要另一次昂贵的合成运行。我们提出一个框架，首先通过反馈级联精炼策略来发展能力，从回合回报推进到可由模拟器密集评分的分层目标和信念更新。在 Craftax 游戏（部分可观测、程序化生成）中，通过回合级反馈的精炼在最终关卡到达率上停滞于不到 1%，而使用反馈级联后，优化后的策略有 50% 的时间到达最终阶段（28% 最终击败 boss）。此外，为使这种能力可向新目标复用，我们将先前的控制器分解为环境解释器 $I$（模型、记忆、技能）和规则程序 $p_0$，并证明编码智能体可以优化一个可复用的目标编译器 $C_{\theta}$，将结构化任务 $g$ 映射到新的规则程序 $p_g$。在仅用短任务训练的五次独立编译器搜索中，所得编译器无需任何任务特定调优和推理时 LLM 调用即可零样本迁移到更长的任务：延续评分的反馈与带有可编辑程序的固定机器，共同将单任务胜任的策略转化为可复用的策略。代码见：this https URL
translation.brief: 论文要解决长时程任务中程序化策略优化的局部改进失效与目标切换需重新合成的问题，核心方法是模拟器密集评分的反馈级联和可复用的目标编译器设计。

papers.title: Beyond Prompts: Runtime Contracts for Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Coding agents act on repositories through shell commands and file edits, and teams steer them with written engineering rules. Industrial settings expect such rules to be enforced and their application to be evidenced, and a rule given as prompt text provides neither. We test whether executable contracts enforced while the agent works reduce rule violations compared with the same rules in the prompt, retrieved as guidance, or checked only after generation. Violations are scored by an oracle whose methods differ from the in-loop checks, and the oracle is validated by two human reviewers and a model reviewer. Across three studies on two model families (240, 112 and 108 runs), enforcement during execution produced no oracle-detected violation in 104 paired runs, against 21 to 55% of runs without rules, and no loss of functional correctness in the two confirmatory studies. In the confirmatory study on tasks aimed at known failure situations (Study 3, protocol hashed before the first run), enforcement lowered the share of violating runs by 31 percentage points relative to no rules (Holm-adjusted p = 0.014); the 17-point difference from prompted rules was not significant (p = 0.12), and neither was any contrast in Study 2, where only 3 of 14 tasks produced a violation. Prompted rules removed some violation types but not recursive deletes of scratch directories, and checks after generation repaired file edits but not commands that had already run. That enforcement satisfies the rules it enforces is expected by construction; what the data add is where prompting falls short, the absence of a functional cost, and the limits of the rules and of the oracle themselves. The studies use low-cost models and one small fixture.

translation.title: 超越提示词：面向编码智能体的运行时契约
translation.abstract: 编码智能体通过 shell 命令和文件编辑作用于代码仓库，团队则通过书面的工程规则来引导它们。工业场景期望这些规则被强制执行且其应用有证据可查，而以提示文本形式给出的规则两者皆不能提供。我们检验在智能体工作时强制执行的可执行契约，相比将相同规则放在提示中、作为指导检索或仅在生成后检查，是否能减少违规。违规由一个与在环检查方法不同的 oracle 打分，该 oracle 由两名人工评审员和一个模型评审员验证。在两个模型家族上的三项研究（240、112 和 108 次运行）中，执行期间的强制在 104 组配对运行中未产生任何 oracle 检测到的违规，而无规则时违规率为 21% 至 55%，且在两项确认性研究中功能正确性没有损失。在针对已知失败情形的确认性研究（研究 3，协议在首次运行前哈希固定）中，强制执行将违规运行占比相对无规则情形降低了 31 个百分点（Holm 校正 p = 0.014）；与提示规则的 17 个百分点差异不显著（p = 0.12），研究 2 中任何对比也不显著——该研究中 14 个任务只有 3 个出现违规。提示规则消除了部分违规类型，但对临时目录的递归删除无效；生成后检查能修复文件编辑，却无法阻止已运行的命令。强制执行满足其规则是构造使然；数据补充的是提示的不足之处、功能成本的缺失，以及规则和 oracle 自身的局限。这些研究使用低成本模型和一个小型测试装置。
translation.brief: 论文要检验编码智能体的工程规则以提示形式给出无法被强制执行的问题，核心方法是将规则变为执行期间强制生效的可执行契约并与提示及事后检查进行对比实验。

papers.title: TrustBound: Mechanized Completeness for Payment Epochs Initiated by AI Agents
papers.abstract: Payment operations requested by an AI agent may remain executable, or their outcomes unresolved, after the agent has stopped. We study when a trusted payment service can account for every payment in an epoch and exclude further payments under earlier authority. We give a Lean model in which operations are recorded before they receive execution authority and both actions are serialized with an admission fence. We prove that fencing fixes a journal that covers every modeled effect and outstanding right; that discharging those rights prevents further effects; and that truthful outcomes for the recorded identities then give exact accounting. A provider-contract model, mapped to the admission model, makes created payment objects inert until registered. Premise-removal mutations confirm that each key premise is needed. We connect the models to an executable service: six service histories are checked against the model in Lean, and bounded schedules, scripted clients and concurrent workers exercise its reconciliation. The concurrent experiments uncovered a conflict caused by reordered provider reads, which serializing retrieval with journal updates removes in all tested cases. The result separates two obligations that are easily conflated in practice - preventing future payments and accounting for past ones - and states precisely which service guarantees establish each.

translation.title: TrustBound：由 AI 智能体发起的支付纪元的机械化完备性
translation.abstract: AI 智能体请求的支付操作在智能体停止后可能仍可执行，或其结果处于未决状态。我们研究可信支付服务何时能对一个纪元（epoch）内的每笔支付进行核算，并排除在更早授权下进一步付款的可能。我们给出一个 Lean 模型，其中操作在被赋予执行权限之前先被记录，且这两个动作通过准入围栏（admission fence）串行化。我们证明：围栏机制确保日志覆盖每个被建模的效果和未决权利；解除这些权利可阻止进一步的效果；而对已记录身份的真实结果随后给出精确核算。一个映射到准入模型的提供者契约模型使新创建的支付对象在注册前保持惰性。前提删除变异确认每个关键前提都是必要的。我们将模型连接到可执行服务：在 Lean 中对六份服务历史进行检查，并使用有界调度、脚本化客户端和并发工作进程来检验其对账能力。并发实验发现了一个由提供者读取乱序引起的冲突，将检索与日志更新串行化后在所有测试用例中消除了该冲突。结果区分了实践中容易混淆的两项义务——阻止未来支付与核算过去支付——并精确说明了哪些服务保证分别确立这两项义务。
translation.brief: 论文要解决智能体停止后其发起的支付仍可能执行且历史无法精确核算的问题，核心方法是在 Lean 中机械化证明先记录后授权、配准入围栏的支付纪元模型的完备性。

papers.title: Inquest: Log-Guided Root-Cause Code Localization with a Staged Agent
papers.abstract: When a production issue is reported, engineers get a description and some logs, but no failing test and no way to reproduce the fault. The logs show where the failure was noticed, not where it was caused: in 49% of the real reports we study, the text names none of the files that the fix later changed. We built a benchmark for this setting from two public datasets and 27 open-source projects (Apache, Red Hat, MongoDB, MariaDB, Qt and Sakai). It holds 38,001 resolved issue reports with their pasted logs, the code as it was while the bug was still present, and the files the fix changed. We present INQUEST, an agent that finds the faulty code using a 27B open-weights model. Code, not the model, controls the procedure. It first gathers the evidence, including the files fixed in similar past issues that were resolved before the report was filed. The model then makes only three bounded decisions: which files to open, what role each file plays in the failure, and how to rank them. On 26,544 evaluation reports, INQUEST ranks a changed file first for 68.6% and in the top five for 85.9%, names the correct module for 90.2%, and ranks a changed function first for 53.8%. On the reports that name no faulty file, it reaches 52.8% and 73.6%. A free agent loop with the same model and tools finds files equally well, but names the faulty function 14 points less often. On a 1,000-report sample, INQUEST beats our reimplementations of two published agents by 7 and 20 points of top-1 accuracy (4 and 16 counting only the reports those agents answered), and the same model used as a re-ranker by 6. We report the cost of every system and the results that go against us, and we release the benchmark, both systems and every run transcript.

translation.title: Inquest：基于日志引导的分阶段智能体根因代码定位
translation.abstract: 当生产环境中报告一个问题时，工程师只能得到问题描述和一些日志，却没有失败的测试用例，也无法复现故障。日志显示的是故障被发现的位置，而不是其产生的位置：在我们研究的真实报告中，49%的文本完全没有提及修复时改动的文件。我们基于两个公开数据集和27个开源项目（Apache、Red Hat、MongoDB、MariaDB、Qt和Sakai）为这一场景构建了基准，包含38,001条已解决的issue报告及其附带日志、bug存在时的代码以及修复所改动的文件。我们提出INQUEST，一个使用27B开放权重模型的智能体来定位有缺陷的代码。由代码而非模型控制流程：它先收集证据，包括报告提交之前已解决的相似历史issue中被修复的文件；然后模型只做三个有约束的决策：打开哪些文件、每个文件在故障中扮演什么角色、以及如何排序。在26,544条评估报告中，INQUEST将改动文件排在第一位和前五位的比例分别为68.6%和85.9%，正确模块识别率为90.2%，改动函数排名第一的比例为53.8%；在未提及故障文件的报告中，分别达到52.8%和73.6%。使用相同模型和工具的自由智能体循环在文件定位上表现相当，但函数定位低14个百分点。在1,000份报告样本上，INQUEST比两个已发表智能体的复现版本分别高出7和20个top-1准确率点（仅统计这些智能体给出答案的报告时为4和16点），比相同模型作为重排序器高出6点。我们报告了每个系统的成本以及不利于我们的结果，并发布了基准、两个系统和所有运行记录。
translation.brief: 研究在只有问题描述和日志、无法复现故障的场景下定位根因代码的问题，提出由代码控制流程、模型仅做三个受限决策的分阶段智能体INQUEST。

papers.title: Behavioral Assurance for Socially Deployed AI Agents
papers.abstract: AI agents are increasingly deployed in socially consequential settings, yet existing evaluations provide limited assurance that they behave consistently with their intended characteristics across diverse interactions. We introduce an evaluation framework for measuring the behavioral consistency of socially deployed AI agents. The framework operationalizes agent behavior along five measurable axes and uses a standardized evaluation battery spanning six socially salient interaction settings to assess behavioral differentiation, consistency, and drift. Controlled persona configurations serve as experimental anchors, enabling systematic testing of whether intended behavioral differences persist across contexts rather than appearing only as stylistic variation. Preliminary analyses demonstrate measurable differentiation across configurations and suggest associations between behavioral profiles and interaction outcomes. By shifting the focus from persona design to behavioral assurance, this work provides a foundation for evaluating whether socially deployed AI agents behave as intended, consistently and measurably, across the situations in which users encounter them.

translation.title: 社会性部署AI智能体的行为保证
translation.abstract: AI智能体越来越多地被部署在具有社会影响的场景中，但现有评估对它们在多样交互中是否与预期特质保持一致只能提供有限的保证。我们提出一个用于衡量社会性部署AI智能体行为一致性的评估框架。该框架沿五个可测量的维度刻画智能体行为，并使用涵盖六种社会敏感交互场景的标准化评估套件来评估行为分化、一致性与漂移。受控的人设配置作为实验锚点，能够系统性地测试预期的行为差异是否在不同情境中持续存在，而非仅表现为风格上的变化。初步分析表明各配置之间存在可测量的分化，并提示行为特征与交互结果之间存在关联。通过将焦点从人设设计转向行为保证，这项工作为评估社会性部署的AI智能体在用户遇到的各种情境中是否以一致且可测量的方式按预期行事奠定了基础。
translation.brief: 研究如何验证社会性部署的AI智能体行为是否与预期一致的问题，提出沿五个维度、跨六种交互场景评估行为分化、一致性与漂移的标准化评估框架。

papers.title: Learning from Mutants: Teaching Small Language Models to Synthesise Loop Invariants
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have proven promising for synthesising loop invariants, a long-standing obstacle to automated program verification. Yet, frontier LLMs are typically accessible only through third-party APIs, hampering reproducibility and local deployment. Small language models (SLMs) sidestep these obstacles but require task-specific fine-tuning, for which high-quality training data is needed. We present a failure-driven data curation method for fine-tuning language models to synthesise loop invariants. Inspired by mutation testing, our approach applies semantic mutation operators to ground-truth invariants, producing semantic mutants that induce verification failure. Each mutant is paired with verifier feedback and its ground-truth counterpart, yielding training examples for feedback-guided invariant refinement. Whereas the vast space of mutants is a long-standing burden in mutation testing, it becomes an asset when generating training data, multiplying the examples obtainable from a fixed set of verified programs. We implement our approach for Dafny, augmenting an existing synthetic dataset of verified programs, and introduce a framework that iteratively refines candidate invariants using verifier feedback. On 472 DafnyBench programs, our best-performing fine-tuned Gemma-4-E4B configuration verifies 50.8% of programs zero-shot, compared to 8.1% for the base model, a 6.3$\times$ improvement. Higher-order mutants prove more effective as training data than first-order mutants, and adding mutation-based examples to direct synthesis examples, in which invariants are removed rather than mutated, improves performance under iterative refinement. Our approach also transfers to Qwen3.5-4B, whose zero-shot verification rate rises from 9.3% to 53.6%.

translation.title: 从变异体中学习：教小型语言模型合成循环不变式
translation.abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）在合成循环不变式这一自动程序验证的长期障碍上展现出前景。然而，前沿LLM通常只能通过第三方API访问，妨碍了可复现性和本地部署。小型语言模型（SLM）可规避这些障碍，但需要任务特定的微调，而微调需要高质量训练数据。我们提出一种失败驱动的数据策展方法，用于微调语言模型以合成循环不变式。受变异测试启发，我们的方法对真值不变式应用语义变异算子，产生会导致验证失败的语义变异体。每个变异体与验证器反馈及其真值对应版本配对，构成用于反馈引导的不变式精炼的训练样例。虽然庞大的变异体空间一直是变异测试的负担，但在生成训练数据时它却成为资产，成倍增加了从固定已验证程序集中可获得的样例数量。我们为Dafny实现了该方法，扩充了现有的已验证程序合成数据集，并引入一个利用验证器反馈迭代精炼候选不变式的框架。在472个DafnyBench程序上，我们表现最佳的微调Gemma-4-E4B配置零样本验证了50.8%的程序，而基座模型仅为8.1%，提升6.3倍。高阶变异体作为训练数据优于一阶变异体，在直接合成样例（删除而非变异不变式）基础上加入变异样例可提升迭代精炼下的性能。该方法还可迁移至Qwen3.5-4B，其零样本验证率从9.3%升至53.6%。
translation.brief: 研究如何让小型语言模型合成循环不变式的问题，提出受变异测试启发的失败驱动数据生成方法，用语义变异体配合验证器反馈构造训练样例进行微调。

papers.title: Diagnosis as Percolation on an Evidence Graph: Root-Cause Recoverability in Network Fault Diagnosis
papers.abstract: Diagnosing failures from incomplete observations presents three challenges: determining whether sufficient evidence connects a possible cause to a symptom, distinguishing the true cause from plausible alternatives, and assessing when a diagnosis can be trusted. We introduce an evidence-graph framework that separates these challenges and uses percolation theory to analyze how missing information affects cause-symptom connectivity. In controlled simulations with an average degree of four, a giant connected component emerges when approximately 25% of evidence is retained, but a specific cause-alarm pair reaches 50% connectivity only after slightly more than half is retained. Even connectivity does not guarantee correct cause identification. We apply this framework to multi-LLM diagnosis of IEEE 802.11 packet captures. A final reconciliation pass improves evidence-grounding weighted F1 from 0.912 to 0.964, primarily by removing isolated citations rather than connecting previously separate evidence chains, consistently across three graph constructions. However, connectivity is not a reliable confidence measure: its association with diagnostic quality becomes statistically insignificant after controlling for capture length, citation count, within-capture dependence, and multiple comparisons. Further experiments show that directed and weighted edges help selectively, while simpler overlap measures or domain-specific methods sometimes perform better. These findings establish evidence graphs as a framework for separating evidence availability, causal distinguishability, and confidence reliability, while demonstrating that connected evidence alone cannot certify diagnostic correctness.

translation.title: 将诊断视为证据图上的渗流：网络故障诊断中的根因可恢复性
translation.abstract: 从不完整的观测中进行故障诊断面临三个挑战：判断是否有足够证据将可能的原因与症状联系起来、区分真正原因与貌似合理的替代原因、以及评估诊断何时可信。我们提出一个证据图框架来分离这些挑战，并利用渗流理论分析信息缺失如何影响原因-症状的连通性。在平均度为四的受控仿真中，当保留约25%的证据时出现巨大连通分量，但特定的原因-告警对只有在保留略超过一半证据后才能达到50%的连通性。即使连通也不保证能正确识别原因。我们将该框架应用于基于多LLM的IEEE 802.11数据包捕获诊断。最终的和解步骤将证据支撑加权F1从0.912提升到0.964，主要是通过移除孤立引用而非连接先前分离的证据链，且在三种图构建方式上保持一致。然而，连通性并不可靠的置信度度量：在控制捕获长度、引用数量、捕获内依赖及多重比较后，其与诊断质量的关联在统计上不再显著。进一步实验表明，有向和加权边的作用是有选择性的，而更简单的重叠度量或领域特定方法有时表现更好。这些发现确立了证据图作为分离证据可得性、因果可区分性和置信度可靠性的框架，同时证明仅有连通的证据不足以证明诊断正确。
translation.brief: 研究不完整观测下故障诊断中证据充分性、因果可区分性与置信可信度问题，提出用证据图和渗流理论分析信息缺失对原因-症状连通性的影响。

papers.title: Protecting the System, Stranding the User: The Limits of Multi-Agent Authorization
papers.abstract: Current multi-agent authorization architectures prioritize system integrity over human outcomes. While recent models successfully prevent privilege escalation, they externalize the cost of failure onto the human operator. Re-centering authorization around human impact exposes four structural vulnerabilities in current paradigms. First, calling an agent's understanding of user intent verified is misleading. Intent has no formal definition, so no check against it can be definitive. Systems should instead report an openly probabilistic estimate and scale their caution with the risk of the action. Second, we argue that dynamic trust scores do not survive multi-agent handoffs; transmitting algorithmic judgment across a company boundary without underlying evidence risks violating Contextual Integrity. Third, treating a safely halted workflow as a successful refusal is a category error if it strands the user; compensating actions must be bound directly to the capability token, not only to the planning layer. Finally, we hypothesize that frictionless automated recovery introduces a moral hazard, disincentivizing developers from building robust initial intent checks. We conclude by proposing an architectural synthesis to bridge the gap between deterministic security and human outcomes, alongside the fundamental theoretical limits that remain unresolved.

translation.title: 保护了系统，却困住了用户：多智能体授权的局限
translation.abstract: 当前的多智能体授权架构优先考虑系统完整性而非人的结果。虽然近期模型成功阻止了权限提升，但它们把失败的成本转嫁给了人类操作者。以人的影响为中心重新审视授权，可以揭示当前范式中四个结构性缺陷。第一，声称验证了智能体对用户意图的理解具有误导性：意图没有形式化定义，因此任何针对意图的检查都不可能是决定性的。系统应改为报告公开的概率估计，并随行动风险调整谨慎程度。第二，我们论证动态信任评分无法在多智能体交接中存续：在没有底层证据的情况下跨公司边界传输算法性判断，有违反情境完整性（Contextual Integrity）的风险。第三，将被安全中止的工作流视为成功拒绝是一种范畴错误，如果它让用户陷入困境；补偿性动作必须直接绑定到能力令牌上，而不仅绑定在规划层。最后，我们假设无摩擦的自动恢复会引入道德风险，使开发者失去构建健壮初始意图检查的动力。我们最后提出一种架构综合方案，以弥合确定性安全与人的结果之间的鸿沟，并指出尚未解决的基本理论极限。
translation.brief: 研究多智能体授权架构重系统完整性而轻人类后果的问题，通过以人为中心的分析揭示四个结构性缺陷并提出架构综合方案。

papers.title: A Hierarchical Statistical Framework for Evaluating Agent Reliability
papers.abstract: Agents operating in complex scenarios often face uncertainty due to incomplete information about the environment they operate in, ambiguous user queries, complex business rules and the inherently stochastic dynamics of the governing policy. Several new benchmarks have been proposed to evaluate LLM-based agents on complex tasks in multi-tool environments, including settings with policy constraints and varying levels of intent ambiguity. These conditions make it important to evaluate agentic systems systematically and quantify their performance under different conditions to assess their reliability in production. This need is evident in the recently introduced Thinkingbox benchmark, where even the strongest models struggle to perform consistently across diverse business scenarios. This paper presents a statistical framework for evaluating uncertainty and reliability in agentic systems. We define a hierarchy of scenarios, instances, and samples to assess model performance and variability systematically. We apply this framework to common metrics found in the literature: mean pass rate, $pass@k$, and $passhat^k$, with uncertainty estimates for each metric. Aggregating metrics at different levels of the hierarchy reveals different structures and properties of the policy model; we connect this hierarchical aggregation with the known process of \emph{coarse-graining} as intended in the physics and statistical literature. We independently derive exact finite-sample expressions for the sampling variances of the unbiased $pass@k$ and $passhatk$ estimators; related results also appear in recent submissions. Our central contribution is a constructive derivation of hierarchical uncertainty propagation, making explicit its correspondence with coarse-graining and separating execution noise from task heterogeneity.

translation.title: 评估智能体可靠性的分层统计框架
translation.abstract: 在复杂场景中运行的智能体常因环境信息不完整、用户查询模糊、复杂业务规则以及控制策略固有的随机动态而面临不确定性。近来提出了多个基准，用于在多工具环境中评估基于 LLM 的智能体完成复杂任务的能力，其中包括存在策略约束和不同意图模糊程度的场景。这些条件使得系统性地评估智能体系统、量化其在不同条件下的性能以评估其在生产环境中的可靠性变得十分重要。这一需求在最近提出的 Thinkingbox 基准中尤为明显，即使最强的模型也难以在多样业务场景中保持一致表现。本文提出一个评估智能体系统不确定性与可靠性的统计框架。我们定义了场景、实例与样本的层级结构，以系统性地评估模型性能与变异性。我们将该框架应用于文献中常见指标：平均通过率、$pass@k$ 和 $passhat^k$，并为每个指标给出不确定性估计。在不同层级聚合指标可揭示策略模型的不同结构与性质；我们将这种分层聚合与物理及统计学文献中的粗粒化过程相联系。我们独立推导了无偏 $pass@k$ 与 $passhatk$ 估计量抽样方差的精确有限样本表达式；相关结果也见于近期的一些提交。我们的核心贡献是分层不确定性传播的构造性推导，明确其与粗粒化的对应关系，并将执行噪声与任务异质性区分开来。
translation.brief: 针对智能体系统可靠性难以系统量化的问题，提出基于场景-实例-样本层级的统计框架，为 pass@k 等指标推导不确定性传播并区分执行噪声与任务异质性。

papers.title: Toward Planning Representations That Separate Task Structure from Visual Content
papers.abstract: Effective planning requires representations that preserve task-relevant geometry and object identity while ignoring visual variation that does not alter the task. Existing evaluations of visual generalization often change several factors simultaneously, making the source of a failure difficult to identify. We introduce a controlled evaluation of object-goal navigation (ObjectNav), the task of reaching an instance of a named object category, in procedurally generated ProcTHOR houses. Training and evaluation houses share floor plans, object locations, goals, and start states, while visual factors are changed individually or in combination. Across model-free reinforcement learning (RL), model-based RL, and agents using frozen pretrained visual representations, our results show that appearance changes impair navigation, but their effects differ sharply by factor. Surface material changes account for most of the average change in success, whereas clutter and lighting have little effect. The magnitude of a global image statistics shift does not reliably predict performance: changing only the goal object's appearance can substantially impair an end-to-end agent despite a small image-level change. We found that a model based agent that plans over frozen features from the pretrained DINOv2 image encoder achieves the highest success (0.83) under the full shift, but remains sensitive to surface appearance. Our experiments reveal an important requirement for planning representations: they must separate invariant spatial task structure from appearance.

translation.title: 迈向将任务结构与视觉内容分离的规划表示
translation.abstract: 有效的规划需要能保留与任务相关的几何和物体身份、同时忽略不改变任务的视觉变化的表示。现有的视觉泛化评估往往同时改变多个因素，使失败原因难以定位。我们在程序化生成的 ProcTHOR 房屋中引入对物体目标导航（ObjectNav）——即到达指定物体类别的一个实例——的受控评估。训练与评估房屋共享户型、物体位置、目标和起始状态，而视觉因素被单独或组合地改变。在无模型强化学习（RL）、基于模型的 RL 以及使用冻结预训练视觉表示的智能体上，结果表明外观变化会损害导航，但其影响因因素而显著不同。表面材质变化占据了成功率平均变化的大部分，而杂乱和光照几乎没有影响。全局图像统计偏移的幅度并不能可靠预测性能：尽管图像级变化很小，仅改变目标物体的外观也会显著损害端到端智能体。我们发现基于模型的智能体在预训练 DINOv2 图像编码器的冻结特征上进行规划，在完全偏移下取得最高成功率（0.83），但仍对表面外观敏感。实验揭示了规划表示的一个重要要求：必须将不变的空间任务结构与外观分离开来。
translation.brief: 针对视觉泛化评估中失败来源难以定位的问题，在受控 ObjectNav 环境中逐因素改变视觉外观，发现规划表示需将空间任务结构与外观分离。

papers.title: Data-Driven Heuristic-Guided Business Process Redesign
papers.abstract: Business process redesign (BPR) has a long-standing catalog of best-practice redesign heuristics, yet, applying them remains a mostly manual task that requires extensive domain knowledge. Despite recent advances using Large Language Models (LLMs) for conversational process model redesign, limitations remain. For example, redesign is user-driven instead of data-driven and is not guided by best practices such as the redesign heuristics. Moreover, only one change can be handled at a time. To address these limitations, given an event log and a BPMN model, we present the DH-BPR framework to realize data-driven heuristic-guided BPR using LLMs. To design DH-BPR, we first conducted an analysis of which redesign heuristics can be automatically detected and applied given information contained in an event log such as the fraction of cases that bypass an activity. Based on this, DH-BPR detects and validates heuristic candidates through a combination of rule-based techniques and an LLM. After that, DH-BPR jointly designs and records an application plan for valid candidates, before finally yielding a redesigned BPMN model and an updated resource model (the way resources execute the process). Evaluation based on simulation using a synthetic benchmark and two real-world event logs shows that the framework's redesign reduces the mean case completion time by up to 61.5%.

translation.title: 数据驱动的启发式引导业务流程重构
translation.abstract: 业务流程重构（BPR）拥有一套长期积累的最佳实践重构启发式方法目录，然而应用它们仍然主要依赖需要大量领域知识的人工操作。尽管最近在使用大语言模型（LLM）进行会话式流程模型重构方面取得了进展，但仍存在局限。例如，重构由用户驱动而非数据驱动，且不受重构启发式等最佳实践的引导；此外每次只能处理一个变更。为解决这些局限，给定事件日志和 BPMN 模型，我们提出 DH-BPR 框架，利用 LLM 实现数据驱动、启发式引导的 BPR。在设计 DH-BPR 时，我们首先分析了哪些重构启发式可以基于事件日志中的信息（如绕过某活动的事例比例）被自动检测和应用。基于此，DH-BPR 通过基于规则的技术与 LLM 的结合来检测并验证启发式候选。随后，DH-BPR 为有效候选联合设计并记录应用计划，最终输出重构后的 BPMN 模型和更新的资源模型（资源执行流程的方式）。基于合成基准和两个真实事件日志的仿真评估表明，该框架的重构可将平均案例完成时间最多降低 61.5%。
translation.brief: 针对 BPR 启发式应用依赖人工且 LLM 重构缺乏数据驱动的问题，提出 DH-BPR 框架，结合规则与 LLM 从事件日志自动检测并应用重构启发式生成新 BPMN 模型。

papers.title: Well-Log Reconstruction with Pre-trained Geological Knowledge: A Knowledge-Conditioned Large-Language-Model Generative Agent
papers.abstract: Missing well-log intervals make subsurface reconstruction ill-posed. Existing numerical regression models lack geological prior knowledge to constrain ambiguous inverse mappings. We propose GeoLog-Agent, a knowledge-conditioned generative agent using pre-trained large language models (LLMs) as a source of geological priors. A universal Geo-Harness translates LLM stratigraphic reasoning into formation-anchored petrophysical trajectories, feature-wise linear modulation, and conditional adversarial constraints. On the Norwegian North Sea benchmark, GeoLog-Agent achieves a mean $R^2$ of 0.9307 and a peak $R^2$ of 0.9713. It exceeds the nine-baseline average $R^2$ of 0.8387 by 0.0920, with a 30.97% average RMSE reduction, and exceeds the strongest baseline by 0.0274--0.0498 in $R^2$, with 16.25%--24.05% lower RMSE. Ablations confirm the effectiveness and synergy of geological prior reasoning, multi-scale dilated generation, and conditional adversarial modules. Transferring the coupling mechanism to six conventional deep learning models improves their $R^2$ by 0.0162--0.0789 with cross-well stability. These results demonstrate how foundation-model domain reasoning can constrain deep generative reconstruction of missing petrophysical measurements.

translation.title: 基于预训练地质知识的测井重建：知识条件化大语言模型生成智能体
translation.abstract: 测井数据的缺失区间使地下重建成为不适定问题。现有数值回归模型缺乏地质先验知识来约束模糊的逆映射。我们提出 GeoLog-Agent，一种知识条件化的生成智能体，将预训练大语言模型（LLM）用作地质先验的来源。通用 Geo-Harness 将 LLM 的地层推理转化为地层锚定的岩石物理轨迹、逐特征线性调制以及条件对抗约束。在挪威北海基准上，GeoLog-Agent 取得 0.9307 的平均 $R^2$ 和 0.9713 的峰值 $R^2$。相比九个基线平均 $R^2$ 0.8387 超出 0.0920，平均 RMSE 降低 30.97%；相比最强基线 $R^2$ 超出 0.0274–0.0498，RMSE 降低 16.25%–24.05%。消融实验证实了地质先验推理、多尺度扩张生成和条件对抗模块的有效性及协同作用。将该耦合机制迁移到六个常规深度学习模型，可将其 $R^2$ 提升 0.0162–0.0789 且具有跨井稳定性。这些结果展示了基础模型的领域推理如何约束缺失岩石物理测量值的深度生成重建。
translation.brief: 针对缺失测井区间重建不适定且缺乏地质先验的问题，提出 GeoLog-Agent，通过 Geo-Harness 将 LLM 地质推理注入生成模型以约束测井重建。

papers.title: ROUNDS: Source-Framed Diagnostic Revision after Multi-Turn Clinical Evidence
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve high scores on medical benchmarks, but does this performance translate into reliable diagnosis as a conversation unfolds? In diagnostic conversations, users can provide clinical findings across multiple turns, ask for a diagnosis without supplying answer options, and introduce opinions from others. Models must therefore form diagnoses from the available evidence and decide how to respond to subsequent advice. We introduce ROUNDS, a framework that evaluates these abilities after a fixed sequence of clinical evidence delivered over multiple turns. ROUNDS compares diagnosis with and without answer options, presents the same incorrect diagnosis under clinician and lay framing, and varies support for competing diagnoses in written five-clinician panels. Across seven models and 1,035 cases from five datasets, average accuracy was 76.9% with answer options and 57.0% without them. Clinician-framed misleading advice produced lower final accuracy than lay-framed advice in every model, with differences of 4.6 to 38.2 percentage points. Initially correct diagnoses more often became incorrect answers than abstentions, and many adopted the suggested disease. Conversely, accuracy increased as more panel members supported the correct diagnosis, including when the majority opinion remained unchanged. These findings reveal a gap between medical benchmark performance and reliable diagnosis in conversation: models respond to external opinions, but remain vulnerable to abandoning correct diagnoses without new clinical evidence.

translation.title: ROUNDS：多轮临床证据后的源框架化诊断修订
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在医学基准上取得高分，但这种性能是否能转化为对话展开过程中可靠的诊断？在诊断对话中，用户可能跨多轮提供临床发现，在未提供答案选项的情况下要求诊断，并引入他人的意见。因此模型必须基于可用证据形成诊断，并决定如何回应后续建议。我们提出 ROUNDS，一个在固定顺序多轮临床证据之后评估这些能力的框架。ROUNDS 对比有无答案选项的诊断，在医生与外行框架下呈现同一错误诊断，并在书面五人医生小组中改变对相互竞争诊断的支持程度。在七个模型和来自五个数据集的 1035 个案例上，有答案选项时平均准确率为 76.9%，无选项时为 57.0%。在所有模型中，医生框架的误导性建议导致的最终准确率均低于外行框架，差距为 4.6 至 38.2 个百分点。初始正确的诊断更常变为错误答案而非弃权，且许多模型采纳了所建议的疾病。相反，当更多小组成员支持正确诊断时准确率上升，即使多数意见保持不变时也是如此。这些发现揭示了医学基准性能与对话中可靠诊断之间的差距：模型会响应外部意见，但在没有新临床证据的情况下仍容易放弃正确诊断。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 诊断在对话中可靠性未知的问题，提出 ROUNDS 框架，在多轮临床证据下系统评估模型对外部意见与框架化建议的易感性。

papers.title: SG-LegalClarify: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Legal Reasoning and Ambiguity Recognition in Singapore Law
papers.abstract: Singapore offers a distinctive testbed for legal reasoning by large language models (LLMs). Its legal system combines inherited English common law with jurisdiction-specific statutes, requiring models to distinguish local doctrine from generic common-law intuition. This setting also highlights the challenge of recognizing underspecification in lay legal queries, because the facts material to a legal outcome depend on the governing doctrine. Yet legal benchmarks rarely cover Singapore law or test this form of ambiguity recognition. To address these gaps, we introduce SG-LegalClarify, a large-scale benchmark for open-ended legal reasoning and ambiguity recognition in Singapore law. SG-LegalClarify contains 1,100 lawyer-authored source questions spanning 10 legal domains, including 340 fully specified and 760 underspecified questions. Each underspecified question has a fixed hidden-fact assignment and a fully specified counterpart, yielding 1,860 evaluation instances. Responses are graded with lawyer-authored Issue, Rule, Application, and Conclusion (IRAC) rubrics. We evaluate 19 LLMs, closed-book and with web search, using a multi-turn pipeline in which models decide whether to answer or clarify, and a user simulator reveals hidden facts only when asked. We find the benchmark far from saturated: the best models satisfy only 69.8% of mandatory rubric items closed-book (average 53.8%) and 77.8% with web search (average 63.0%). Models also struggle to recognize when clarification is necessary. We will release the public split of our benchmark, the model outputs on it, and the evaluation pipeline to support future research.

translation.title: SG-LegalClarify：面向新加坡法律的法律推理与歧义识别大规模基准
translation.abstract: 新加坡为大语言模型（LLM）的法律推理提供了一个独特的测试平台。其法律体系融合了承袭的英国普通法与本地专门制定法，要求模型区分本地法理与通用普通法直觉。这一环境也凸显了识别外行法律查询中欠约束表述的挑战，因为决定法律结果的关键事实取决于适用的法理。然而现有法律基准很少涵盖新加坡法律，也鲜少测试这类歧义识别能力。为填补这些空白，我们提出 SG-LegalClarify，一个面向新加坡法律开放式法律推理与歧义识别的大规模基准。SG-LegalClarify 包含 1,100 道由律师撰写的原始问题，覆盖 10 个法律领域，其中 340 道为完全明确问题，760 道为欠约束问题。每道欠约束问题都有固定的隐藏事实设定和一个完全明确版本，共产生 1,860 个评测实例。回答由律师撰写的 IRAC（问题、规则、适用、结论）评分标准进行评分。我们评估了 19 个 LLM，包括闭卷和使用网络搜索两种设置，采用多轮流程：模型自行决定是回答还是追问澄清，用户模拟器仅在被询问时透露隐藏事实。我们发现该基准远未饱和：最好的模型在闭卷设置下仅满足 69.8% 的必达评分项（平均 53.8%），使用网络搜索为 77.8%（平均 63.0%）。模型也难以识别何时需要澄清。我们将发布基准的公开部分、模型输出和评测流程，以支持未来研究。
translation.brief: 构建律师撰写的覆盖新加坡法律的大规模开放式法律推理与歧义识别基准，通过隐藏事实与 IRAC 评分多轮评测考察模型的法律推理及澄清能力。

papers.title: LoopFill: Pipelined Multi-Token Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers
papers.abstract: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying the same Transformer layers. During autoregressive decoding, however, generating each token requires several sequential passes through these layers, leading to high decoding latency. Pipelined self-speculative methods use shallow-loop predictions to process tokens at different loops in the same batch, but each token must reach the drafting depth before the next can enter the pipeline. We introduce LoopFill, a training-free speculative decoding algorithm for looped LLM that combines multi-token suffix drafts with shallow-loop predictions in a single draft tree. Both drafters contribute to one tree, so a suffix lookup can immediately extend a shallow prediction and several future tokens can enter the pipeline together. The shared block computes the highest-scoring draft candidates at different loop depths in one batch, and full-depth verification preserves the model's autoregressive output distribution. Across seven benchmarks, LoopFill's average speedup over greedy autoregressive decoding is $5.85\times$ on Ouro-2.6B and $5.13\times$ on Huginn-3.5B. The speedups exceed those of LoopAhead, the strongest baseline, by \(40\%\) on Ouro-2.6B and \(25\%\) on Huginn-3.5B.

translation.title: LoopFill：面向循环 Transformer 的流水线多 token 投机解码
translation.abstract: Looped Transformer 通过反复复用同一组 Transformer 层来提高参数效率。但在自回归解码中，生成每个 token 需要多次串行经过这些层，导致解码延迟很高。流水线式自投机方法用浅层循环的预测让不同 token 在同一 batch 的不同循环深度处理，但每个 token 必须先达到起草深度，下一个 token 才能进入流水线。我们提出 LoopFill，一种免训练的循环 LLM 投机解码算法，将多 token 后缀草稿与浅层循环预测结合到同一草稿树中。两个起草器共同贡献一棵树，因此后缀查找可以立即扩展浅层预测，多个未来 token 也可同时进入流水线。共享模块在一个 batch 中以不同循环深度计算得分最高的草稿候选，全深度验证则保持模型原有的自回归输出分布。在七个基准上，LoopFill 相对贪心自回归解码的平均加速在 Ouro-2.6B 上为 $5.85\times$，在 Huginn-3.5B 上为 $5.13\times$。相比最强基线 LoopAhead，加速比在 Ouro-2.6B 上高出 40%，在 Huginn-3.5B 上高出 25%。
translation.brief: 针对循环 Transformer 解码慢的问题，提出免训练的 LoopFill 算法，通过多 token 后缀草稿与浅层预测共享一棵草稿树并流水线化验证来加速投机解码。

papers.title: LLM Facilitation of Group Decision-Making
papers.abstract: Human groups often fail to integrate information distributed across their members, converging on incorrect decisions. We ask whether large language models (LLMs) can help groups reach the correct decision in such settings. In an online, chat-based experiment, 138 three-person groups (N = 414) completed a hidden-profile hiring task that required selecting the best candidate using public information available to all group members and private information available only to individual members. The randomized human-subject experiment included three conditions: no facilitation, an individual-level LLM that messaged each member privately, and a group-level LLM that messaged the whole group. The LLM facilitation consisted of adaptive interventions that summarized the discussion, nudged quiet members, and played devil's advocate. The LLM did not know which candidate was correct. Both LLM conditions significantly increased the rate at which groups reached consensus on the correct candidate, from 32.6% without facilitation to 56.5% with LLM facilitation. LLM-facilitated groups exchanged more consensus messages signaling agreement on the group's choice. Participants in the group-level condition also disclosed significantly more information about the correct candidate, whereas those receiving individual-level facilitation repeated public information less often. Finally, group-level facilitation received more favorable usability ratings than individual-level facilitation. These results show that LLMs can deliver adaptive, theory-informed interventions that improve group decision-making, and that the design of these interventions may shape how people respond to them.

translation.title: LLM 促进群体决策
translation.abstract: 人类群体常常无法整合成员各自掌握的信息，从而达成错误决策。我们研究大语言模型（LLM）能否帮助群体在此类情境下做出正确决策。在一项基于在线聊天实验中，138 个三人小组（N = 414）完成了一项隐藏档案招聘任务，需要利用所有成员共有的公开信息和仅个别成员持有的私密信息选出最佳候选人。这项随机对照实验包含三种条件：无促进、向每位成员单独发消息的个体级 LLM，以及向整个小组发消息的群体级 LLM。LLM 促进包括自适应干预：总结讨论、鼓励沉默成员发言，以及扮演“魔鬼代言人”角色。LLM 并不知道哪个候选人是正确的。两种 LLM 条件都显著提高了群体就正确候选人达成共识的比率，从无促进时的 32.6% 提升到有 LLM 促进时的 56.5%。LLM 促进的群体交换了更多表示认同群体选择的共识消息。群体级条件下的参与者显著更多地透露了关于正确候选人的信息，而接受个体级促进的参与者更少重复公开信息。最后，群体级促进获得了比个体级促进更高的可用性评分。这些结果表明，LLM 能够提供自适应的、有理论依据的干预来改善群体决策，而这些干预的设计方式会影响人们的响应。
translation.brief: 通过在线随机对照实验研究 LLM 以个体级或群体级自适应干预能否帮助群体整合分散信息、在隐藏档案任务中达成正确共识。

papers.title: When AI Agents Should Repair, Replan, or Abandon: A Threshold Theory of Plan Commitment
papers.abstract: AI agents often discover mid-execution that their plan is broken, for example when an action fails or a tool is withdrawn. Deployed systems use conventions such as retry loops or "always replan," and a recent benchmark finds no fixed strategy dominates. This paper derives the optimal policy. In the model, a disruption destroys the causal support of part of a plan; repair is a partial reset that preserves the plan's structure, replanning is a full reset, and changing a plan is costly because others have conditioned on it. The optimal policy is a threshold in effective disruption depth: repair shallow damage, replan after deep damage, and abandon the goal when even a fresh plan is not worth its cost. Depth depends on plan structure. In expectation, a single broken action forces 1+R(G)/n actions to be revalidated, where R(G) counts the pairs of actions joined by a dependency path; to first order, a fully serial plan switches to replanning at raw damage about w times smaller than a plan of w parallel chains. A closed-form stability-price threshold determines when a worse repaired plan should be kept over a better fresh one. As language-model planners push replanning costs toward zero, the stability price becomes the only force sustaining plan commitment. Under repeated disruptions, revision frictions make commitment hysteresis optimal: the agent keeps executing a plan it would never choose fresh, and each repair adds patch debt until the debt outweighs repair's cost advantage and the agent rebuilds. A value-of-diagnosis result states when measuring damage is worth its compute and shows that "always replan" is optimal when damage is predictably deep and replanning is the better fallback. A separately implemented numerical checker tests each proposition (zero violations; 1.6 million static-model evaluations), and the model's regime map reproduces that benchmark's regime flips qualitatively.

translation.title: AI 智能体何时应修复、重新规划还是放弃：计划承诺的阈值理论
translation.abstract: AI 智能体常在执行中途发现计划已失效，例如某个动作失败或某个工具被撤回。已部署系统采用重试循环或“总是重新规划”等约定，而近期的一个基准发现没有任何固定策略占优。本文推导出最优策略。在模型中，一次扰动破坏了计划部分行动的因果支撑；修复是保留计划结构的部分重置，重新规划是完全重置，而更改计划是有代价的，因为他人已经依赖于该计划。最优策略是有效扰动深度上的一个阈值：浅层损坏选择修复，深层损坏选择重新规划，当即使重新规划也不值得其代价时放弃目标。深度取决于计划结构。在期望意义上，一个损坏的动作会迫使重新验证 1+R(G)/n 个动作，其中 R(G) 统计由依赖路径连接的动作对；一阶近似下，一条完全串行计划的切换阈值对应的原始损坏约为由 w 条并行链组成计划的 1/w 倍。一个闭式稳定性-价格阈值决定何时应保留较差的已修复计划而非较好的新计划。随着语言模型规划器使重新规划成本趋于零，稳定性价格成为维系计划承诺的唯一力量。在反复扰动下，修订摩擦使承诺滞回成为最优：智能体持续执行一个它绝不会重新选择的计划，每次修复都会累积补丁债务，直到债务超过修复的成本优势，智能体才重建计划。一个诊断价值结果给出了何时测量损坏值得其计算开销，并表明当损坏可预测地很深且重新规划是更好的备选时，“总是重新规划”是最优的。一个独立实现的数值检查器对每个命题进行验证（160 万次静态模型评估，零违例），该模型的策略区域图在定性上复现了该基准的策略切换。
translation.brief: 针对智能体计划执行中断后应修复、重新规划还是放弃的问题，建立扰动深度阈值理论并推导出最优计划承诺策略及其解析条件。

papers.title: Score-Based Stochastic Closure Modeling via Offline Indirect Learning and Online Data Assimilation
papers.abstract: Stochastic closure modeling is an emerging area in reduced-order modeling of large and complex (e.g., multiscale, multi-physics) systems, for which the computationally affordable reduced-order physical descriptions (e.g., digital twins for additive manufacturing, world models for AI agents) in numerical simulations inevitably lead to information losses that cannot be well addressed by classical deterministic closures. However, learning stochastic closures typically requires closure data that are difficult to obtain from measurements or often prohibitively expensive to compute using first-principles simulations. In this work, we develop a stochastic closure modeling framework that builds on score-based diffusion models, leveraging indirect offline training and online data assimilation without requiring the direct data of closures. Numerical experiments on two-dimensional turbulent flows demonstrate that indirect offline learning captures key closure statistics and improves predictions of system state. In addition, combining the learned closure with known physical dynamics leads to better generalization capability across different regimes than purely data-driven models that directly predict system state. Compared to standard data assimilation methods with a Gaussian assumption, the posterior-score assimilation better represents non-Gaussian features of the learned closure, and its combination with state-level data assimilation further improves prediction of the system state. The proposed framework enables stochastic closure modeling in realistic and challenging scenarios of complex dynamical systems in mechanics and engineering problems, where non-Gaussian statistics of model-form uncertainties are non-negligible (e.g., due to the nonlinearities of the system dynamics and/or the observations) and true closure data are not available, for both offline learning and online assimilation.

translation.title: 基于离线间接学习与在线数据同化的分数随机闭合建模
translation.abstract: 随机闭合建模是大型复杂系统（如多尺度、多物理场系统）降阶建模的一个新兴领域。在这类系统的数值模拟中，计算上可承受的降阶物理描述（如增材制造的数字孪生、AI 智能体的世界模型）不可避免地造成信息损失，经典确定性闭合难以很好地处理这类损失。然而，学习随机闭合通常需要闭合数据，而这些数据难以从测量中获取，用第一性原理模拟计算又往往代价高昂。本工作开发了一个基于分数扩散模型的随机闭合建模框架，利用间接离线训练与在线数据同化，无需直接观测闭合数据。在二维湍流上的数值实验表明，间接离线学习能够捕捉关键闭合统计量并提升系统状态预测。此外，将学到的闭合与已知物理动力学结合，相比直接预测系统状态的纯数据驱动模型，在不同流态下具有更好的泛化能力。与基于高斯假设的标准数据同化方法相比，后验分数同化能更好地刻画所学习闭合的非高斯特征，且与状态级数据同化相结合可进一步提升系统状态预测。所提框架使随机闭合建模能够应用于力学与工程问题中复杂动力系统的现实且具挑战性的场景，其中模型形式不确定性的非高斯统计不可忽略（例如由于系统动力学和/或观测的非线性），且真实闭合数据对离线学习和在线同化均不可得。
translation.brief: 针对闭合数据难以获取的随机闭合建模问题，提出基于分数扩散模型的间接离线学习与在线数据同化框架，无需直接闭合数据即可提升复杂系统预测。

papers.title: Attacker Diversity Reduction in Adaptive LLM Red Teaming
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning can make automated red-teaming more successful while narrowing the attacks it produces. Co-training an attacker and a defender with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) has been reported to reduce attacker diversity. This experiment reproduces attack diversity reduction using three runs with a Qwen2.5-14B attacker and a Phi-4-mini defender trained by direct preference optimization (DPO). The attacker receives a success-only reward and uses a length-unbiased loss, bounded updates, warm-up and ratio clipping. The attacker is evaluated on 26 AdvBench behaviors. Training ended after 12 rounds, following a decision based on development checkpoints, so the reported intervals are nominal. Attack Diversity Retention (ADR) compares the within-behavior of the trained attacker spread with the untrained attacker. In order for an attack diversity to be consider as having been reduced, a criterion requires the ADR to be below a 0.75 target with a 95% confidence interval together with continued attacker effectiveness. Therefore, if an attacker narrows its attack vector by 25% consistently its considered less diverse. After 24 attacker and 12 defender LORA-based updates, ADR for the three runs were 0.63, 0.61 and 0.63, respectively. Each run met the criterion at round 12; the earlier checks at rounds 4 and 8 fell short. Despite attacks being less diverse, attack success continued to improve as the attacker was updated after each training run.

translation.title: 自适应 LLM 红队测试中攻击者多样性的降低
translation.abstract: 强化学习可以在提升自动化红队测试成功率的同时收窄其产生的攻击范围。已有报道称，使用群体相对策略优化（GRPO）共同训练攻击者与防御者会降低攻击者多样性。本实验使用 Qwen2.5-14B 攻击者和由直接偏好优化（DPO）训练的 Phi-4-mini 防御者，通过三次运行复现了攻击多样性的降低。攻击者只接受基于成功与否的奖励，并采用长度无偏损失、有界更新、预热和比例裁剪。攻击者在 26 个 AdvBench 行为上进行评估。基于开发检查点的决策使训练在 12 轮后结束，因此所报告的区间为名义值。攻击多样性保留率（ADR）用于比较训练后攻击者与未训练攻击者的行为内离散程度。判定攻击多样性被降低的标准要求 ADR 在 95% 置信区间内低于 0.75 的目标，同时攻击者保持有效性。因此，如果攻击者持续将其攻击向量收窄 25%，则被认为多样性降低。经过 24 次攻击者和 12 次防御者的 LORA 更新后，三次运行的 ADR 分别为 0.63、0.61 和 0.63。每次运行在第 12 轮满足标准，而第 4 轮和第 8 轮的早期检查未达标。尽管攻击多样性降低，但随着攻击者在每次训练后更新，攻击成功率持续提升。
translation.brief: 该论文验证 LLM 红队对抗训练中攻击者多样性会降低的问题，通过用 GRPO/DPO 共同训练 Qwen2.5-14B 攻击者与 Phi-4-mini 防御者并测量 ADR 指标加以复现。

papers.title: Where Should LLM Agents Adapt at Test Time? In Context, in Weights, or Both
papers.abstract: LLM agents operating repeatedly in the same environment, such as a code repository, a database, or an application suite, encounter tasks that share latent structure. Experience can reveal this structure, allowing agents to reuse environment knowledge and learn from environmental feedback. Agents can adapt at test-time using this experience through two channels: retaining it in context and updating their weights. These channels are usually studied separately, leaving unclear what each contributes and when they complement each other. We compare in-context learning (ICL), reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards using GRPO, and self-distillation using SDPO, alone and in combination, using a shared online protocol and modular framework. Agents encounter matched task streams, are evaluated on each task before adapting to it, and learn only from their own attempts and environment feedback. We evaluate 14 adaptation mechanisms and a stateless baseline with Qwen3.5-9B on 109 tasks from four environments drawn from SWE-bench Verified, AppWorld, ScienceWorld, and BIRD-Critic-SQLite, using five task orders per environment. ICL provides the largest standalone gain: its best policy raises mean success across environments from 28.8% to 49.4%. Adding GRPO to this policy achieves the highest mean success, 51.6%. While adding GRPO improves the overall mean under every ICL policy, SDPO has mixed effects. Trace analyses show fewer lookups and shorter attempts under ICL, consistent with reusing knowledge of the shared structure. However, ICL also frequently skips inspection and verification for the current task. Adding GRPO to ICL helps restore these behaviors while preserving its reduced environment lookups. These observations suggest that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards can refine how agents use retained experience, motivating the joint study of context management and weight updates.

translation.title: LLM 智能体应在测试时于何处适应？上下文中、权重中，还是两者兼用
translation.abstract: 在相同环境中反复运作的 LLM 智能体，例如在代码仓库、数据库或应用套件中，会遇到共享潜在结构的任务。经验可以揭示这种结构，使智能体能够复用环境知识并从环境反馈中学习。智能体可在测试时通过两条通道利用经验进行适应：将经验保留在上下文中，以及更新自身权重。这两条通道通常被分开研究，导致各自贡献以及何时互补尚不清楚。我们使用共享的在线协议和模块化框架，比较上下文学习（ICL）、基于可验证奖励的强化学习（GRPO）和使用 SDPO 的自蒸馏，单独使用及组合使用。智能体面对匹配的任务流，在适应每个任务之前先在该任务上进行评估，且仅从自身尝试和环境反馈中学习。我们使用 Qwen3.5-9B 在来自 SWE-bench Verified、AppWorld、ScienceWorld 和 BIRD-Critic-SQLite 四个环境的 109 个任务上，评估了 14 种适应机制和一个无状态基线，每个环境使用五种任务顺序。ICL 提供了最大的单独增益：其最佳策略将各环境的平均成功率从 28.8% 提升至 49.4%。在该策略上加入 GRPO 达到最高的平均成功率 51.6%。尽管在每个 ICL 策略下加入 GRPO 都能提升总体均值，SDPO 的效果则好坏参半。轨迹分析显示，ICL 下查找次数更少、尝试更短，与复用共享结构知识相一致。然而，ICL 也经常跳过对当前任务的检查与验证。在 ICL 基础上加入 GRPO 有助于恢复这些行为，同时保留其减少的环境查找。这些观察表明，基于可验证奖励的强化学习可以优化智能体使用所保留经验的方式，从而推动对上下文管理与权重更新的联合研究。
translation.brief: 该论文研究 LLM 智能体测试时适应应依靠上下文学习还是权重更新的问题，通过统一在线协议系统比较 ICL、GRPO、SDPO 及其组合。

papers.title: Found, but Not Fixed : From Software Vulnerability Discovery to Fixes with Iterative LLM Pipelines
papers.abstract: Software vulnerabilities persist as a critical threat despite the deployment of sophisticated detection tools and AI assistants. While detection has advanced, the subsequent code repair phase remains a primary bottleneck; manual intervention is inherently slow, costly, and prone to introducing secondary regressions and issues. In this paper, we investigate whether an iterative, LLM-based pipeline can provide a robust solution for the automated repair of vulnerable functions in real-world code. We propose a generalized framework that leverages the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) through a multi-stage feedback loop. We benchmark this approach against state-of-the-art models, including GPT-4o, GPT-5.1, and Gemini 3 Flash, demonstrating that such a pipeline can achieve high-quality code repair. To support the broader security community, we provide our evaluation framework, fine-tuned weights, and comprehensive experimental dataset on our website: this https URL

translation.title: 发现了，但未修复：利用迭代式 LLM 流水线从软件漏洞发现到修复
translation.abstract: 尽管部署了复杂的检测工具和 AI 助手，软件漏洞仍然是关键威胁。虽然检测技术已经进步，但后续的代码修复阶段仍是主要瓶颈；人工干预本身缓慢、成本高，且容易引入二次回归和问题。本文研究基于 LLM 的迭代式流水线能否为真实代码中易受攻击函数的自动修复提供稳健的解决方案。我们提出了一个通用框架，通过多阶段反馈循环利用大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。我们将该方法与 GPT-4o、GPT-5.1 和 Gemini 3 Flash 等最先进模型进行基准对比，证明此类流水线可以实现高质量的代码修复。为支持更广泛的安全社区，我们在网站上提供了评估框架、微调权重和完整的实验数据集：this https URL
translation.brief: 该论文解决真实代码中漏洞函数自动修复的难题，提出通过多阶段反馈循环利用 LLM 推理能力的迭代式修复流水线。

papers.title: MIAO: Microscaling Intermediate Accumulation Optimization
papers.abstract: Microscaling (MX) quantization enables lower-precision large language model (LLM) inference with limited accuracy degradation, reducing memory requirement and multiplication cost. However, despite reduced operand precision, accumulation is often retained at high floating-point precisions, leaving a substantial hardware cost that operand quantization alone does not address. In particular, systolic arrays, as used in tensor accelerators such as Google TPU and AWS Trainium, distribute accumulation across distinct processing elements but conventionally use uniform accumulator precision throughout the array. This spatial organization offers an opportunity to reduce hardware cost by tailoring precision to individual accumulation stages.
