In this work, we present MIAO, a hardware-software co-design framework that jointly selects product precision and stage-dependent accumulator widths to minimize hardware area and energy cost under an end-to-end perplexity constraint. MIAO first calibrates MX block-scale shifts to reduce intermediate magnitudes while preserving operand quantization accuracy, then assigns narrower accumulators to earlier stages and progressively wider accumulators to later stages. To efficiently explore the resulting design space, MIAO combines hardware cost estimates derived from logic synthesis with a calibrated accuracy predictor to identify promising precision configurations, then validates the accuracy of promising candidates through bit-exact end-to-end LLM evaluation. Across MXFP8, MXFP6, and MXFP4, MIAO reduces processing element (PE) array area by up to 38.7% and energy by up to 36.1% relative to the all-BF16 accumulation baseline, with at most 1.60% additional perplexity degradation over operand-only MX quantization across six LLMs.

translation.title: MIAO：微缩放中间累加优化
translation.abstract: 微缩放（MX）量化能够在精度损失有限的情况下实现更低精度的大语言模型（LLM）推理，降低内存需求和乘法开销。然而，尽管操作数精度降低了，累加通常仍保留在高浮点精度上，留下了仅靠操作数量化无法解决的巨大硬件开销。特别是在 Google TPU 和 AWS Trainium 等张量加速器所使用的脉动阵列中，累加被分布到不同的处理单元，但传统上整个阵列使用统一的累加器精度。这种空间组织为通过为各个累加阶段定制精度来降低硬件成本提供了机会。本文提出 MIAO，一个软硬件协同设计框架，联合选择乘积精度和随阶段变化的累加器宽度，在端到端困惑度约束下最小化硬件面积和能耗成本。MIAO 首先校准 MX 块缩放偏移以降低中间量级，同时保持操作数量化精度，然后为较早阶段分配较窄的累加器，为较晚阶段逐步分配较宽的累加器。为高效探索由此产生的设计空间，MIAO 将来自逻辑综合的硬件成本估计与经校准的精度预测器相结合，以识别有前景的精度配置，然后通过位精确的端到端 LLM 评估验证候选方案的精度。在 MXFP8、MXFP6 和 MXFP4 上，相对于全 BF16 累加基线，MIAO 将处理单元（PE）阵列面积最多降低 38.7%、能耗最多降低 36.1%，并且在六个 LLM 上相比仅操作数的 MX 量化，附加困惑度退化最多 1.60%。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 MX 量化中高精度累加带来的硬件开销问题，提出软硬件协同设计框架 MIAO，按累加阶段定制精度以在困惑度约束下降低面积和能耗。

papers.title: From Cloud to Edge: A Fully Local Pipeline for Pothole Risk Assessment and Driver Warning Generation
papers.abstract: Vision-language models can turn road images into clear, geometry-aware pothole warnings, but current systems depend on commercial cloud services. Our earlier five-stage pipeline needed two cloud calls per scene, taking about 20 s and USD 0.105, and could not run offline. We rebuild every stage to run on a single local GPU and evaluate it with the same data, prompts, and protocol. Segmentation keeps the original Segment Anything weights but runs them in half precision with graph compilation, which makes it 2.7x faster without changing any downstream risk class; five lightweight variants could not match its masks on small road defects. Severity is graded by six ConvNeXt students distilled from 3092 cloud labels. They reach Cohen's kappa = 0.268 against human consensus at 28 ms per pothole, close to the cloud model's 0.321, within the camera setup they were trained for. A local 8-billion-parameter vision-language model writes the warnings under a grammar that admits only in-lane maneuvers. Three blind, independent raters scored these warnings safer than the cloud warnings (4.18 vs. 3.65 of 5; p = 0.001; 50 scenes) and equally clear, whereas an automated LLM judge ranked them the other way. The complete pipeline runs at 1.27 s per scene, 16x faster than the cloud system, offline and at no per-scene cost.

translation.title: 从云端到边缘：用于坑洞风险评估与驾驶员警告生成的全本地流水线
translation.abstract: 视觉-语言模型可以将道路图像转化为清晰、具有几何感知能力的坑洞警告，但当前系统依赖商业云服务。我们早期的五阶段流水线每个场景需要两次云端调用，耗时约 20 秒、花费 0.105 美元，且无法离线运行。我们重建了每个阶段使其在单个本地 GPU 上运行，并使用相同的数据、提示词和协议进行评估。分割环节保留原始 Segment Anything 权重，但以半精度结合图编译运行，使其提速 2.7 倍且不改变任何下游风险类别；五个轻量变体在小道路缺陷上无法匹敌其掩码。严重程度分级由六个从 3092 个云端标签蒸馏而来的 ConvNeXt 学生模型完成。在其训练所针对的相机设置下，它们在每坑洞 28 毫秒的速度下达到与人类共识相比 0.268 的 Cohen's kappa，接近云端模型的 0.321。一个本地 80 亿参数的视觉-语言模型在只允许本车道内操作的语法约束下生成警告。三位盲评的独立评审者认为这些警告比云端警告更安全（4.18 对 3.65，满分 5；p = 0.001；50 个场景），且清晰度相当，而自动化 LLM 评判者的排名则相反。完整流水线每场景运行 1.27 秒，比云端系统快 16 倍，可离线运行且无单场景成本。
translation.brief: 该论文解决坑洞警告系统依赖云端服务的问题，通过半精度图编译分割、蒸馏分级学生模型和带语法约束的本地 VLM，将全流水线重构为单 GPU 本地运行。

papers.title: StaleBench: Isolating Stale Retrieval in Agent Memory, and Pricing the Fix
papers.abstract: An agent that stores facts over time eventually stores several versions of the same fact. Asked a value-agnostic question - "which team does X play for now?" - a similarity retriever cannot prefer the current version, because every version matches the entity the query names. StaleBench isolates this stale-retrieval failure on 892 real updating facts, with currency labels from the source (Wikidata validity years via TempLAMA), never from a retrieval score. Our central result is that retrieval metrics can rank memory policies backwards: a retention policy and its retain-everything control return the identical statement at rank 1 for every test query, yet differ by 29.5 and 65.6 points in reader accuracy on two readers when no date is shown. Contamination@5, the metric we add, ranks them correctly where current@1 and current@5 do not. Withdrawing the lexical anchor that statements carry costs deployed keying mechanisms tens of points of freshness; entity resolution on both the write path and the query recovers most of the loss. Three deployed systems (Mem0, Graphiti, LangMem) and a reimplemented ERASE each handle supersession differently, and no single scoring convention describes all four. We release the data, a frozen evaluator, and reference baselines.

translation.title: StaleBench：隔离智能体记忆中的陈旧检索并为修复定价
translation.abstract: 随时间存储事实的智能体最终会存储同一事实的多个版本。当被问到与具体取值无关的问题时（例如"X现在效力于哪支球队？"），相似度检索器无法偏好当前版本，因为每个版本都与查询所指的实体匹配。StaleBench在892条真实更新事实上隔离这一陈旧检索失败，时效性标签来自数据源（通过TempLAMA获取Wikidata有效期），而非来自检索分数。我们的核心结果是检索指标可能对记忆策略进行完全相反的排序：一条保留策略与其全保留对照组在每个测试查询的排名1处返回相同的语句，但在不显示日期时两者在两个阅读器上的准确率相差29.5和65.6分。我们新增的Contamination@5指标能正确排序它们，而current@1和current@5不能。移除语句所携带的词法锚点会使已部署的键控机制损失数十分的时效性；在写入路径和查询两侧进行实体消解可挽回大部分损失。三个已部署系统（Mem0、Graphiti、LangMem）和一个重新实现的ERASE对取代处理方式各不相同，没有任何单一评分约定能描述全部四个系统。我们发布了数据、冻结的评估器和参考基线。
translation.brief: 针对智能体记忆中检索到事实旧版本的问题，构建基于Wikidata时效标签的StaleBench基准，揭示检索指标会错误排序记忆策略并评估实体消解等修复手段。

papers.title: Compositional Exploits in Autonomous Coding Agents: Attack Mechanics and Ephemeral Defense
papers.abstract: Autonomous coding agents (such as Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenHands) rely on third-party tools to inspect files, run commands, and call external APIs. Today's security auditors evaluate these tools almost entirely in isolation: static linters and AST checkers verify that each individual tool contains no malicious code at installation time. In this paper, we show that isolated tool auditing is fundamentally flawed. We expose compositional exploits in autonomous coding agents, an emergent vulnerability class where an agent chains individually harmless tools to execute an unauthorized attack. Much like code-reuse attacks in binary exploitation, this threat requires no malware; instead, the agent stitches together legitimate tool operations across turns over shared workspace files, environment variables, and chat memory. Across a 560-task benchmark suite (360 exploit tasks across 8 hazard classes and 200 benign developer and cloud workflows), unprotected frontier models (Gemini 3.5, 3.7, and 3.8 Flash) execute compositional exploit chains with a 72.9% to 84.5% success rate, while five leading single-tool pre-distribution scanners exhibit a 0% detection rate across all constituent tools. To eliminate compositional exploits, we present CompGuard, an OS-grounded defense uniting two planes: (1) a Cognitive Control Plane that issues single-skill capability leases and tracks dataflow provenance, and (2) an OS Kernel Enforcement Layer using Linux Landlock LSM v4, seccomp-BPF socket filters, and an ephemeral loopback proxy to close the invocation gap. CompGuard achieves a 100% Defense Block Rate (0.0% to 0.8% pre-teardown Net ASR) at 61.4 microseconds interposition overhead, preserves a 98.0% solve rate on benign developer workflows, and triggers zero false alarms across 615 real cloud diagnostic calls.

translation.title: 自主编码智能体中的组合式攻击：攻击机制与瞬态防御
translation.abstract: 自主编码智能体（如Antigravity、Claude Code、Cursor和OpenHands）依赖第三方工具来检查文件、运行命令和调用外部API。如今的安全审计几乎完全孤立地评估这些工具：静态linter和AST检查器在安装时验证每个单独的工具不含恶意代码。本文证明孤立工具审计存在根本缺陷。我们揭示了自主编码智能体中的组合式攻击——一种新兴漏洞类别，智能体将各自无害的工具串联起来执行未授权攻击。类似二进制利用中的代码重用攻击，该威胁不需要恶意软件；相反，智能体通过共享工作区文件、环境变量和聊天记忆，跨多轮拼接合法的工具操作。在一个560任务基准套件上（涵盖8类危害的360个攻击任务和200个良性开发者与云端工作流），未受保护的前沿模型（Gemini 3.5、3.7和3.8 Flash）以72.9%至84.5%的成功率执行组合攻击链，而五个领先的分发型单工具扫描器在所有组成工具上检测率为0%。为消除组合式攻击，我们提出CompGuard，一种基于操作系统的双层防御：（1）认知控制平面，发放单技能能力租约并追踪数据流来源；（2）OS内核执行层，使用Linux Landlock LSM v4、seccomp-BPF套接字过滤器和瞬态回环代理来封堵调用缺口。CompGuard实现100%防御拦截率（拆除前Net ASR为0.0%至0.8%），介入开销仅61.4微秒，在良性开发者工作流上保持98.0%解决率，并在615次真实云端诊断调用中零误报。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体把无害工具串联成攻击链的问题，提出基于认知控制平面与OS内核强制的CompGuard运行时防御。

papers.title: Read Before You Fit: Text-Derived Constraints for Discovering Differential Equations from Noisy Biological Data
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used for scientific equation discovery. However, most existing methods are strongly data-driven and assume sufficiently clean and representative observations. This assumption is problematic in biological systems, where individual-level measurements are often sparse, noisy, heterogeneous, and expensive to obtain. While the underlying mechanisms are extensively described in scientific text, they are not explicitly used for the LLM based modeling of such systems. We introduce P2C, an agentic framework that translates textual descriptions of biological systems into a typed set of formal constraints, and use these constraints to restrict candidate ordinary differential equation (ODE) structures before numerical fitting. P2C consists of five stages: Text2Constraint extraction, ODE discovery, symbolic verification, parameter fitting, and model scoring. We evaluate P2C on four published ODE systems of acute inflammation and immune regulation, under clean and noisy observations. By progressively degrading the numerical evidence, we isolate when textual domain knowledge contributes beyond regression alone. Across the four systems, adding Text2Constraint reduces the worst form error from 1.397 to 0.499 on clean data and from 13.096 to 1.095 for data perturbed with Gaussian noise of $\sigma=0.1$; P2C also achieves lower form error and trajectory error than several LLM-based baselines over the tested noise range.

translation.title: 拟合之前先阅读：面向噪声生物数据的微分方程发现的文本推导约束
translation.abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地用于科学方程发现。然而，现有方法大多强数据驱动，并假设观测足够干净且具有代表性。这一假设在生物系统中有问题，因为个体层面的测量往往稀疏、噪声大、异质且获取成本高。虽然底层机制在科学文本中被广泛描述，但并未显式用于此类系统的LLM建模。我们提出P2C，一个将生物系统文本描述转化为类型化形式约束集合的智能体框架，并在数值拟合之前用这些约束限制候选常微分方程（ODE）结构。P2C包含五个阶段：Text2Constraint抽取、ODE发现、符号验证、参数拟合和模型评分。我们在四个已发表的急性炎症与免疫调节ODE系统上、在干净和噪声观测下评估P2C。通过逐步退化数值证据，我们隔离出文本领域知识何时在回归之外做出贡献。在四个系统中，加入Text2Constraint将最坏形式误差从干净数据上的1.397降至0.499，在高斯噪声σ=0.1扰动的数据上从13.096降至1.095；在整个测试噪声范围内，P2C的形式误差和轨迹误差均低于多个基于LLM的基线。
translation.brief: 针对噪声稀疏生物数据下ODE方程发现问题，提出P2C框架，从文献文本抽取形式化约束以缩小候选方程结构空间。

papers.title: Fine-Grained RLAIF for Visual Safety: Learning to Zoom into Hazards for Multimodal Safety Alignment
papers.abstract: Recent multimodal safety alignment heavily relies on a text-centric paradigm, assuming risks are explicit in language or globally prominent in images. However, real-world hazards are often visually subtle or peripheral, causing existing models to fail due to their reliance on coarse, global visual representations. In this work, we study fine-grained visual safety alignment and introduce a challenging 1,200-sample benchmark across four domains, where hazards necessitate localized inspection. To address this, we propose Fine-Grained RLAIF (FGR), a reinforcement learning framework that casts image zoom-in as a learnable perception policy. FGR employs a decomposed reward design to jointly align three core safety behaviors: (i) where to look via a visual evidence reward, (ii) when to act via a tool-formatting constraint, and (iii) how to reason via visually grounded safety explanations. FGR achieves accuracy ranging from 86.71% to 93.00%, consistently outperforming strong multimodal and agent-based baselines.

translation.title: 面向视觉安全的细粒度RLAIF：学习放大以发现多模态安全对齐中的隐患
translation.abstract: 近期多模态安全对齐严重依赖以文本为中心的范式，假设风险在语言中显式呈现或在图像中全局显著。然而，真实世界的危害往往在视觉上微妙或处于边缘位置，导致现有模型因依赖粗糙的全局视觉表征而失效。本文研究细粒度视觉安全对齐，并引入一个横跨四个领域、包含1200个样本的挑战性基准，其中的隐患需要局部化检查。为此，我们提出Fine-Grained RLAIF（FGR），一个将图像放大视为可学习感知策略的强化学习框架。FGR采用分解的奖励设计，联合对齐三种核心安全行为：（i）看向何处，通过视觉证据奖励；（ii）何时行动，通过工具格式约束；（iii）如何推理，通过视觉锚定的安全解释。FGR达到86.71%至93.00%的准确率，持续超越强多模态和基于智能体的基线。
translation.brief: 针对图像中局部细微安全隐患识别问题，提出将图像放大作为可学习策略的细粒度RLAIF框架FGR并配套分解式奖励。

papers.title: Eliciting Research Taste in LLMs through Future Research Direction Choice
papers.abstract: Research taste is increasingly discussed in the context of AI scientists, yet remains little studied or measured in LLMs. This judgment matters especially in open-ended research, where a direction must be chosen before a verifiable objective is available. We operationalize research taste through one task of the scientific workflow: choosing which future research direction to pursue given a research goal and current results. Rather than predicting downstream scientometric metrics or treating author choices as objectively correct, we evaluate models against human-authored future-work directions and report author alignment, stable divergence, and unstable choice as behavioral measures of research-direction preference. We construct an order-controlled evaluation of 80 pairwise comparisons from 19 ML papers published between December 2025 and February 2026 across four subdomains. Each query presents a research goal, hypotheses tested with key results, and two candidate future directions: one author-recommended direction and one plausible distractor sampled from a similar paper. Across eight LLMs, author alignment ranges from 45.0% to 67.5%, while stable divergence ranges from 15.0% to 36.2%. These divergences largely persist under similarity controls, prompt ablations, and an author-preference framing check, and inter-model agreement suggests that some non-author preferences are shared across models. We characterize what models diverge toward using transition-category labels and selected reasoning examples, finding recurring movement toward scaling/generalization and trade-offs between methodological and infrastructure/data extensions. We view this as an early descriptive evaluation for eliciting research taste profiles in LLMs, and as a step toward understanding and steering their research preferences as they take on more autonomous roles in novel open-ended scientific discovery.

translation.title: 通过未来研究方向选择激发LLM的研究品味
translation.abstract: 研究品味在AI科学家语境下被越来越多地讨论，但在LLM中仍缺乏研究和测量。这种判断在开放式研究中尤为重要，因为必须在有可验证目标之前选择方向。我们通过科学工作流中的一个任务来操作化研究品味：给定研究目标和当前结果，选择应 pursued 的未来研究方向。我们不预测下游科学计量指标，也不将作者选择视为客观正确，而是将模型与人类作者撰写的未来工作方向对比，报告作者对齐度、稳定分歧和不稳定选择作为研究方向偏好的行为度量。我们构建了一个顺序受控的评估：来自2025年12月至2026年2月发表的19篇ML论文（涵盖四个子领域）的80组两两比较。每个查询呈现研究目标、带关键结果的已验证假设，以及两个候选未来方向：一个作者推荐方向和一个从相似论文采样的合理干扰项。在八个LLM上，作者对齐度为45.0%至67.5%，稳定分歧为15.0%至36.2%。这些分歧在相似性控制、提示消融和作者偏好表述检查下大多持续存在，且模型间一致性表明某些非作者偏好在模型间共享。我们使用转换类别标签和精选推理示例刻画模型分歧的方向，发现模型反复趋向扩展/泛化方向，以及方法论与基础设施/数据扩展之间的权衡。我们将此视为激发LLM研究品味画像的早期描述性评估，也是理解和引导其研究偏好、使其在新型开放式科学发现中承担更自主角色的一步。
translation.brief: 针对LLM研究品味难以度量的问题，构建作者推荐方向与干扰项的成对选择基准，以作者对齐度等行为指标刻画模型的研究方向偏好。

papers.title: Lossless First-Action Menus for Linear-Reward Planning
papers.abstract: We study sequential decision making where an agent reserves a minimum menu of initial actions before multi-objective trade-offs are revealed, followed by unrestricted continuation planning once linear reward weights arrive. We prove that a menu preserves the unrestricted optimal return across all linear scalarizations if and only if its reachable continuations cover all vertices of the full feature polytope. This geometric equivalence yields an output-sensitive algorithm that is fixed-parameter tractable in the vertex count, combining scalar backward induction with oracle-based facet identification. On explicitly layered graphs with unit feature increments, menu verification is coNP-complete and synthesis is complete for the second existential level of the polynomial hierarchy, even under additive loss strictly below one. In fixed dimensions two and higher, verification is polynomial whereas synthesis remains NP-complete, while one-dimensional instances admit polynomial-time solutions.

translation.title: 面向线性奖励规划的无损首动作菜单
translation.abstract: 我们研究序贯决策问题，其中智能体在多目标权衡被揭示之前保留一个最小的初始动作菜单，并在线性奖励权重到来后进行无约束的后续规划。我们证明，一个菜单在所有线性标量化下都能保持无约束最优回报，当且仅当其可达后续覆盖完整特征多面体的所有顶点。这一几何等价性给出了一个输出敏感的算法，该算法在顶点数量上属于固定参数可解，将标量反向归纳与基于 oracle 的面识别相结合。在具有单位特征增量的显式分层图上，菜单验证是 coNP 完全的，而菜单合成对多项式层次的第二个存在层级是完全的，即使在严格小于一的加性损失下也是如此。在固定维度二及以上，验证是多项式时间的，而合成仍然是 NP 完全的，而一维实例可以在多项式时间内解决。
translation.brief: 研究在线性奖励权重到来前如何选取初始动作集合（菜单）以不损失最优回报，通过刻画其可达后续须覆盖特征多面体所有顶点的几何等价条件，并给出固定参数可解的合成算法及复杂度分析。

papers.title: Pros4D: Modeling Evolving 4D Worlds in Latent Space for Dynamic Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract: Dynamic spatial reasoning from monocular video enables vision-language models (VLMs) to understand how 3D environments evolve over time, supporting physical world understanding and embodied intelligence. Existing efforts primarily address observed-dynamics understanding, whereas agents in dynamic environments also require future-dynamics prediction beyond the observation boundary. Moreover, external geometric processing and textual descriptions can increase inference complexity or lose information when representing continuous dynamics. These limitations motivate a shared internal state that preserves observed dynamics and remains predictive beyond the input video. Accordingly, we present Pros4D, a framework for modeling evolving 4D worlds in latent space that unifies retrospective understanding of observed-dynamics with prospective reasoning for future-dynamics prediction. Specifically, Pros4D-Engine derives geometry-grounded supervision and constructs paired examples for both tasks, while Pros4D-Bench evaluates them across eight spatial task categories spanning dynamic cameras, objects, and scenes. At the model level, Pros4D compresses observed dynamics into latent observed states and autoregressively rolls them forward into latent future states. 4D Latent Alignment (4DLA) grounds these states through complementary visual-semantic and geometric supervision, while joint language supervision connects them to task reasoning. Experiments across benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong baselines in both capabilities.

translation.title: Pros4D：在潜空间中建模演化的4D世界以实现动态空间推理
translation.abstract: 从单目视频中进行动态空间推理，使视觉-语言模型（VLM）能够理解3D环境如何随时间演化，从而支持对物理世界的理解和具身智能。现有工作主要解决观测动力学的理解问题，而动态环境中的智能体还需要在观测边界之外进行未来动力学预测。此外，外部几何处理和文本描述会增加推理复杂度，或在表示连续动力学时丢失信息。这些局限性促使我们需要一种共享的内部状态，它既能保留观测动力学，又能在输入视频之外保持预测能力。据此，我们提出 Pros4D，一个在潜空间中建模演化4D世界的框架，它将观测动力学的回溯理解与未来动力学预测的前瞻推理统一起来。具体而言，Pros4D-Engine 推导基于几何的监督并为两个任务构建成对样本，而 Pros4D-Bench 在涵盖动态相机、动态物体和动态场景的八个空间任务类别上对它们进行评估。在模型层面，Pros4D 将观测动力学压缩为潜观测状态，并以自回归方式向前滚动为潜未来状态。4D 潜对齐（4DLA）通过互补的视觉-语义和几何监督来锚定这些状态，而联合语言监督将它们与任务推理联系起来。跨基准的实验表明，Pros4D 在两种能力上都持续优于强基线。
translation.brief: 提出在潜空间中统一建模单目视频观测动力学理解与未来动力学预测的框架 Pros4D，通过压缩观测状态并自回归预测未来状态，配合4D潜对齐监督实现动态空间推理。

papers.title: MAPS: A Multimodal Agentic Framework for POI Data Production Based on Crowdsourced Street-view Imagery
papers.abstract: Point-of-interest (POI) databases support location-based services, yet urban changes quickly make their records stale and manual maintenance is costly. Crowdsourced street-view images provide timely visual evidence, but converting them into database actions requires separating multiple POIs and irrelevant text in each image, then resolving incomplete observations against ambiguous records. We study Street-view Image-based POI Data Production and propose MAPS, the first framework to integrate structured POI extraction with database maintenance from such imagery. MAPS contains two cascaded modules. SPICE progressively adapts a lightweight vision-language model to reconstruct and filter text, group entries belonging to the same POI, and classify their semantics and completeness. RIMA retrieves candidate records, performs evidence-grounded POI matching and attribute-level reasoning, and selectively acquires complementary visual, geospatial, or external-source evidence when necessary. In human-reviewed full-task evaluation, MAPS outperforms the strongest baseline by 21.8\%. MAPS has also been deployed in Kuaishou's large-scale POI production pipeline, reducing average processing time by 76.9\% relative to manual annotation. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and practical value of MAPS for scalable POI maintenance.

translation.title: MAPS：基于众包街景影像的多模态智能体POI数据生产框架
translation.abstract: 兴趣点（POI）数据库支撑着基于位置的服务，但城市变化会迅速使其记录过时，而人工维护成本高昂。众包街景影像提供了及时的视觉证据，但将其转换为数据库操作需要分离每张图像中的多个POI和无关文本，然后针对模糊记录解决观测不完整的问题。我们研究基于街景影像的POI数据生产，并提出 MAPS，首个将结构化POI提取与数据库维护相结合的框架。MAPS 包含两个级联模块。SPICE 逐步适配轻量级视觉-语言模型，以重建和过滤文本、将属于同一POI的条目分组，并对其语义和完整性进行分类。RIMA 检索候选记录，执行基于证据的POI匹配和属性级推理，并在必要时选择性地获取补充的视觉、地理空间或外部来源证据。在经过人工审核的全任务评估中，MAPS 超过最强基线 21.8%。MAPS 还被部署在快手的大规模POI生产流水线中，相比人工标注将平均处理时间减少了 76.9%。这些结果证明了 MAPS 在可扩展POI维护方面的有效性和实用价值。
translation.brief: 提出从众包街景影像自动化生产与维护POI数据库的级联智能体框架 MAPS，用轻量VLM完成POI提取分组，再用证据驱动的匹配与属性推理完成数据库更新。

papers.title: Reasoning in the loop: antibody lead optimization by probing mechanism and measurement
papers.abstract: Lab-in-the-loop systems, in which a model proposes molecules, automated assays measure their properties and the results retrain the model, are a popular approach to antibody lead optimization. These systems optimize for a specification defined with metrics computed from instrument signals, so their success depends on how well those metrics serve as proxies for the properties a drug candidate needs. When a metric is a poor proxy, neither a better model nor more data will fix it, and identifying the problem usually requires expert review. We report two campaigns run on BigHat Biosciences' Milliner platform, one on an anti-albumin nanobody (VHH) and one on an anti-mesothelin single-chain variable fragment (scFv), in which a research team and a general-purpose AI agent, Claude, brought scientific reasoning into the loop. Over seven rounds and about 1,010 design variants we built libraries from antibody lineage, structure and biophysics, and found from the raw curves that on each scaffold one thermal metric did not measure what its name implied. The libraries were built as controlled comparisons, so the results also show what each mutation contributes to each property. We fit a physical model of the curves, used it to choose metrics suited to each scaffold, and changed the experimental protocol, varying protein concentration and heating rate, to test the model against pre-registered predictions. Both leads improve on their parents in affinity, thermal stability and aggregation while improving or maintaining yield and purity.

translation.title: 闭环中的推理：通过探究机理与测量进行抗体先导优化
translation.abstract: Lab-in-the-loop 系统——模型提出分子、自动化检测测量其性质、结果重新训练模型——是抗体先导优化的流行方法。这些系统针对由仪器信号计算出的指标所定义的规范进行优化，因此其成功取决于这些指标在多大程度上能作为药物候选所需性质的代理。当某个指标是糟糕的代理时，无论更好的模型还是更多数据都无法解决问题，而识别这一问题通常需要专家审查。我们报告在 BigHat Biosciences 的 Milliner 平台上运行的两个实验活动，一个针对抗白蛋白纳米抗体（VHH），一个针对抗间皮素单链可变片段，其中研究团队和通用AI智能体 Claude 将科学推理引入闭环。在七轮约 1,010 个设计变体中，我们基于抗体谱系、结构和生物物理学构建文库，并从原始曲线中发现每种支架上的某个热学指标并未测出其名称所暗示的性质。由于文库是作为受控比较构建的，结果也展示了每个突变对每个性质的贡献。我们拟合了曲线的物理模型，用它为每种支架选择合适的指标，并改变实验方案——变化蛋白浓度和升温速率——以对照预先注册的预测来检验模型。两个先导分子在亲和力、热稳定性和聚集方面均优于亲本，同时提升或保持了产量和纯度。
translation.brief: 在 lab-in-the-loop 抗体优化中引入人与AI智能体的科学推理，通过拟合物理曲线模型识别热学指标的代理失真并据此改进指标选择与实验方案。

papers.title: The Flip Test: Video World Models Fail to Learn the World State
papers.abstract: Video world models promise to predict the future of a scene from its present. Do current models keep this promise? We probe this question counterfactually. When a small change to the present flips the future, such as a box resting a few millimeters before or past a table edge, a model that tracks the state of the world must flip its prediction too. We build FlipTest, a three-level hierarchy of increasingly strict tests over 1,680 initial frames from 10 simulated and 15 real-world tasks. At the base, visual minimal pairs, two nearly identical frames whose true futures differ, test whether predictions change across the boundary; matched controls go further and test whether they change only where the future does; and dense sweeps, the strictest level, locate exactly where they change. All 11 video world models we evaluate fall short. The best averages 18.3% pair accuracy over real and simulated scenes, below the 25% of random guessing. Models flip as often on steps that leave the future unchanged as on steps that change it, and their response stays flat across the sweeps. On the same frames, a vision-language model is selective and traces a near S-shaped curve near the boundary, and a coding agent that measures the image comes close to the true boundary. This implies that the deciding information is in the frame, and video models just miss it. We therefore urge the community to rethink world modeling as pure video prediction. Next-frame prediction must do more than draw plausible pixels; it must also identify the causal states that control future dynamics.

translation.title: 翻转测试：视频世界模型未能学习世界状态
translation.abstract: 视频世界模型有望根据场景的现在预测其未来。当前模型是否兑现了这一承诺？我们通过反事实方式探究这一问题。当现在的微小变化翻转未来时——例如一个盒子停在桌边几毫米之内或之外——一个追踪世界状态的模型也必须翻转其预测。我们构建了 FlipTest，一个对来自10个仿真任务和15个真实世界任务的 1,680 帧初始画面进行的三层级、日益严格测试的层级结构。在底层，视觉最小对（两个几乎相同但真实未来不同的帧）测试预测是否跨边界改变；匹配对照更进一步，测试预测是否只在未来发生改变之处才改变；而密集扫描作为最严格的层级，精确定位预测在何处改变。我们评估的全部 11 个视频世界模型都不达标。最好的模型在真实和仿真场景上的平均配对准确率为 18.3%，低于随机猜测的 25%。模型在未改变未来的步骤上翻转的频率与在改变未来的步骤上一样高，且其响应在扫描中保持平坦。在相同的帧上，一个视觉-语言模型具有选择性，并在边界附近呈现近似S形曲线，而一个测量图像的编码智能体则接近真实边界。这表明决定性的信息就存在于帧中，只是视频模型错过了它。因此我们呼吁社区重新思考将世界建模视为纯粹的视频预测。下一帧预测必须做的不仅仅是绘制合理的像素；它还必须识别控制未来动力学的因果状态。
translation.brief: 构建 FlipTest 反事实基准，用最小对、对照与密集扫描测试发现现有视频世界模型无法根据现在帧中微小变化正确翻转未来预测，即未能学习世界状态。

papers.title: EfficientSkill: Learning Skills for Token-Efficient Multi-Turn Agents
papers.abstract: Reflective skill optimizers improve multi-turn LLM agents by revising instructions from failed and successful rollouts, yet accumulating edge-case rules bloats prompts, inflates token use, and pushes agents into long, error-prone loops. We introduce EfficientSkill, a two-step framework that first discovers a reliable skill without token penalties, and then warm-starts accuracy-guarded pruning from that skill to compress instructions, bound agent turns, and offload reusable code into workspace utilities with zero implementation prompt cost. Across four frontier, mid-tier, and open-weight models on MATH-500, ALFWorld, and SpreadsheetBench, EfficientSkill cuts output tokens over unconstrained EvoSkill on 11 of 12 configurations (by up to 80%) while raising mean accuracy on every benchmark, including +14.3 and +17.5 percentage-point gains on SpreadsheetBench with Gemini 3.8 Flash and Grok 4.1 Fast by replacing stalled loops with compact workflows. By shrinking both generated tokens and replayed history, EfficientSkill lowers total token usage and serving cost across every evaluated configuration, with or without full-prefix KV caching.

translation.title: EfficientSkill：面向Token高效多轮智能体的技能学习
translation.abstract: 反思式技能优化器通过修订来自成功与失败 rollout 的指令来改进多轮 LLM 智能体，但不断累积的边缘规则会使提示词膨胀、增加 Token 消耗，并使智能体陷入冗长且易出错的循环。我们提出 EfficientSkill，一个两步框架：先在无 Token 惩罚条件下发现可靠技能，然后从该技能出发进行带精度守护的 warm-start 剪枝，以压缩指令、限制智能体轮数，并将可复用代码卸载到工作区工具中且无需任何实现提示成本。在 MATH-500、ALFWorld 和 SpreadsheetBench 上跨四种前沿、中端及开源权重模型，EfficientSkill 在 12 个配置中的 11 个上相比无约束的 EvoSkill 削减输出 Token（最多达 80%），同时在所有基准上提升平均准确率，其中在 SpreadsheetBench 上使用 Gemini 3.8 Flash 和 Grok 4.1 Fast 分别带来 +14.3 和 +17.5 个百分点的提升，其方式是用紧凑工作流取代停滞循环。通过同时缩减生成 Token 和回放历史，EfficientSkill 在每个评测配置（无论是否使用全前缀 KV 缓存）中都降低了总 Token 用量与服务成本。
translation.brief: 针对技能优化导致提示膨胀和Token浪费的问题，提出先用无惩罚优化发现可靠技能、再进行精度守护剪枝与代码卸载的两步框架 EfficientSkill。

papers.title: Grounding Language Models in Speech Does Not Fix "AI Flavor": Calibrated LLM Judges, Goodhart Traps, and a Preference-Tuning Fix
papers.abstract: Chinese outputs of large language models carry a perceptible "AI flavor": formulaic sentence frames, stacked written-register connectives, repetition loops, and layout leakage. A popular hypothesis blames text-only training for the missing inner-speech layer of human writing; injecting speech or prosody signals should therefore reduce it. We test it with controlled interventions on a 0.6B model; all three fail: (i) phoneme-interleaved continued pretraining yields no spokenness gain under text-matched controls while raising repetition (+0.13 [+0.03, +0.23]); (ii) prosody-plan conditional generation reaches an adherence of only 0.257 against a pre-registered 0.50 gate; (iii) a rule-based reward built on TTS prosody-feature distance is imperceptible in double-blind evaluation by both humans (8/16) and a calibrated LLM judge (9/16). A root cause is evaluation: single-rater blind evaluation at n~20 only detects extreme (>=85%) preferences. We therefore build a calibrated LLM-judge protocol: the judge passes catch trials on known-answer pairs (16/16; single-text 22/24, same-topic pairs 24/24, versus 0.75 for the human rater), then annotates with two independent judges under A/B swapping, counting disagreement as a tie. Using the judge's agree labels directly as DPO pairs (no reward model), we obtain the first positive result: held-out blind win rate 0.833 [0.699, 0.972], repetition 0.114 to 0.000, unchanged MMLU. We further identify a Goodhart channel: the judge's length preference transduces into output-length collapse via pairwise DPO (median 75 chars vs a 300-char prompt); an SFT-anchor repairs it (w is a style knob: w=0.1 preserves gains, w=0.3 does not). Scaling preference data from 89 to 240 pairs yields no additional judge-visible gain. We release RA-Eval v0.1: a three-layer Chinese AI-flavor evaluation framework with 382 judge-annotated preference pairs.

translation.title: 将语言模型与语音结合并不能消除"AI味"：校准的 LLM 裁判、Goodhart 陷阱与偏好微调修复方案
translation.abstract: 大语言模型的中文输出带有可感知的"AI味"：程式化的句式框架、堆叠的书面语连接词、重复循环和排版泄漏。一个流行的假说将其归因于纯文本训练缺失了人类写作中的内在语音层；因此注入语音或韵律信号应当能减少它。我们在一个 0.6B 模型上进行受控干预来检验该假说；三种干预全部失败：(i) 音素交错的继续预训练在文本匹配对照下没有带来口语化提升，同时增加了重复（+0.13 [+0.03, +0.23]）；(ii) 韵律规划条件生成的遵循度仅为 0.257，低于预先注册的 0.50 门槛；(iii) 基于 TTS 韵律特征距离的规则奖励在人类（8/16）与校准 LLM 裁判（9/16）的双盲评估中不可感知。一个根本原因是评估：n~20 的单一裁判盲评只能检测极端（≥85%）的偏好。因此我们构建了一个校准的 LLM 裁判协议：裁判先在已知答案对上通过 catch trials（16/16；单文本 22/24，同主题对 24/24，而人类裁判为 0.75），然后在 A/B 交换下由两名独立裁判标注，将分歧计为平局。直接将裁判的一致标签用作 DPO 对（无需奖励模型），我们获得了首个正面结果：留出集盲评胜率 0.833 [0.699, 0.972]，重复率从 0.114 降至 0.000，MMLU 不变。我们进一步发现一个 Goodhart 通道：裁判的长度偏好通过成对 DPO 转化为输出长度坍缩（中位数 75 字符，对比 300 字符提示）；SFT 锚定可修复此问题（w 是风格旋钮：w=0.1 保留收益，w=0.3 则不然）。将偏好数据从 89 对扩展到 240 对没有带来裁判可见的额外收益。我们发布了 RA-Eval v0.1：一个包含 382 个裁判标注偏好对的三层中文 AI 味评估框架。
translation.brief: 针对注入语音信号能否消除中文"AI味"的假说，通过受控干预证明其无效，并提出校准 LLM 裁判加 DPO 偏好微调的修复方案。

papers.title: Asking the right question is key to AI discovery in a chain of hypotheses
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) scientists pursue discovery through a chain of hypotheses, fitting candidate models to existing observations and often choosing experiments where those models disagree most. Yet when early data miss a narrow feature, model selection favors simple curves that agree across the unmea- sured gap, so disagreement-guided search has no reason to look where the new phenomenon lies. When we tested two frontier AI scientists, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1-Sol, across 32 closed-loop trials with a narrow peak omitted from the starting data, both sampled inside the peak region less often than random search. Surprisingly, the agent that followed model disagreement more closely missed the peak in all 32 trials, whereas discovery succeeded when experiments probed the unmeasured gap early and followed up across the anomaly. Asking the right question, rather than testing only where current models disagree, is therefore key to AI discovery in a chain of hypotheses.

translation.title: 提出正确的问题是 AI 在假设链中发现的关键
translation.abstract: 人工智能（AI）科学家通过假设链进行探索：将候选模型拟合到已有观测上，并常选择模型分歧最大的地方做实验。然而当早期数据遗漏一个狭窄特征时，模型选择会倾向于在未测量区间上相互一致的简单曲线，因此以分歧引导的搜索没有理由去新现象所在之处寻找。我们测试了两个前沿 AI 科学家，Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 GPT-6.1-Sol，在 32 个闭环试验中，起始数据遗漏了一个狭窄峰值，两者在峰值区域内的采样频率都低于随机搜索。出人意料的是，更严格遵循模型分歧的智能体在全部 32 次试验中均未找到峰值，而发现成功发生在实验早期探测未测量区间并围绕异常进行跟进时。因此，提出正确的问题——而不仅仅在当前模型分歧处测试——是假设链中 AI 发现的关键。
translation.brief: 针对AI科学家因只依据模型分歧选实验而漏掉数据中未覆盖的狭窄现象的问题，指出应主动探测未测量区间而非仅跟随模型分歧。

papers.title: A Speech-LLM Framework for Enrollment-Free Wake-Word-Guided Target-Speaker Recognition in Complex Noisy Scenarios for Seamless Human-Machine Interaction
papers.abstract: Target-speaker automatic speech recognition (TS-ASR) is essential for reliable human-machine interaction in complex acoustic environments, where overlapping speech and background noise make it difficult to identify and recognize the intended speaker. Existing approaches typically rely on speaker enrollment or cascaded processing pipelines, limiting their flexibility in practical applications. To address these limitations, we propose an enrollment-free Speech-LLM framework that leverages wake-word text as a lexical cue to guide target-speaker recognition. Specifically, a text-cue encoder extracts lexical representations from the wake word, which are integrated into a pretrained speech encoder through cross-attention to establish an implicit association between the wake-word occurrence and the target speaker. This enables the model to selectively recognize subsequent commands from the target speaker without requiring enrollment speech or explicit wake-word boundaries. Furthermore, a large language model (LLM) unifies command transcription and non-target speaker rejection within a single autoregressive framework. To improve robustness against complex acoustic interference, we develop a large-scale speech synthesis and simulation pipeline with a progressive four-stage training strategy. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves a command character error rate of 16.15% and a non-target speaker rejection rate of 91.56%, yielding a unified score of 87.70%, compared with 71.70% for the strongest enrollment-free baseline. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of wake-word-guided speaker selection and highlight the potential of integrating target-speaker recognition and rejection within a unified Speech-LLM framework for robust human-machine interaction.

translation.title: 面向无缝人机交互、复杂噪声场景下免注册唤醒词引导目标说话人识别的 Speech-LLM 框架
translation.abstract: 目标说话人自动语音识别（TS-ASR）对于复杂声学环境中可靠的人机交互至关重要，在这种环境中重叠语音和背景噪声使识别与辨认目标说话人变得困难。现有方法通常依赖说话人注册或级联处理流程，限制了其在实际应用中的灵活性。为解决这些局限，我们提出一个免注册的 Speech-LLM 框架，利用唤醒词文本作为词汇线索来引导目标说话人识别。具体而言，一个文本线索编码器从唤醒词中提取词汇表示，通过交叉注意力将其整合进预训练语音编码器，从而在唤醒词出现与目标说话人之间建立隐式关联。这使得模型能够有选择地识别目标说话人后续的指令，而无需注册语音或显式的唤醒词边界。此外，一个大语言模型（LLM）在单一自回归框架内统一了指令转写与非目标说话人拒绝。为提升对复杂声学干扰的鲁棒性，我们开发了一个大规模语音合成与仿真流水线及渐进式四阶段训练策略。实验结果表明，所提框架取得了 16.15% 的指令字错误率和 91.56% 的非目标说话人拒绝率，统一得分 87.70%，而最强的免注册基线为 71.70%。这些结果证明了唤醒词引导说话人选择的有效性，并突出了在统一 Speech-LLM 框架中整合目标说话人识别与拒绝以实现鲁棒人机交互的潜力。
translation.brief: 针对复杂噪声场景下免说话人注册的目标说话人识别问题，提出用唤醒词文本线索经交叉注意力引导语音编码器、并由LLM统一转写与拒绝的 Speech-LLM 框架。

papers.title: Reflection Is Not Always Worth It: Budgeted Reflection Allocation for Recommendation Agents
papers.abstract: This work aims to make recommendation agents more efficient by reducing unnecessary LLM reflection while preserving full-catalog ranking and inference reranking. Since BRAVE changes only how training-time reflection is allocated, it does not introduce new user data requirements or additional LLM exposure beyond the base agent protocol. The main potential risk is that a poorly calibrated allocator may assign less reflection to users whose preferences are sparse, niche, or under-represented, which could weaken personalization for those users or indirectly affect item exposure. This risk can be mitigated through deployment-time auditing and conservative allocation design. In practice, reflection budgets should be evaluated not only by aggregate Recall or NDCG, but also across user-history lengths, item popularity groups, and application-relevant cohorts when such analysis is permitted. The allocator should rely on task-side ranking evidence rather than sensitive attributes, and fallback policies can reserve a small portion of the budget for random or fairness-aware coverage when subgroup robustness is important. Privacy risks can be controlled with the same protections required by the base recommendation agent: minimizing user text sent to the LLM controller, anonymizing user identifiers, retaining only necessary interaction evidence, and applying standard access-control and logging policies. Overall, BRAVE is designed as a cost-aware allocation layer, and its ethical deployment depends on validating that the saved computation does not come at the expense of vulnerable users or responsible exposure.

translation.title: 反思并非总是值得：推荐智能体的预算化反思分配
translation.abstract: 本工作旨在通过减少不必要的 LLM 反思来提升推荐智能体的效率，同时保留全目录排序与推理重排。由于 BRAVE 仅改变训练时反思的分配方式，它不引入新的用户数据要求，也不带来超出基础智能体协议之外的额外 LLM 暴露。主要潜在风险是，校准不佳的分配器可能给偏好稀疏、小众或代表性不足的用户分配更少反思，从而削弱这些用户的个性化或间接影响物品曝光。该风险可通过部署时审计和保守分配设计来缓解。在实践中，反思预算不仅应按总体 Recall 或 NDCG 评估，还应在用户历史长度、物品流行度分组以及应用相关子群体（在允许此类分析时）上进行评估。分配器应依赖任务侧排序证据而非敏感属性，且在子群体鲁棒性重要时，回退策略可保留一小部分预算用于随机或公平感知的覆盖。隐私风险可通过基础推荐智能体所需的相同保护来控制：最小化发送给 LLM 控制器的用户文本、匿名化用户标识符、仅保留必要的交互证据，并应用标准的访问控制与日志策略。总体而言，BRAVE 被设计为一个成本感知的分配层，其合乎伦理的部署依赖于验证节省的计算不会以牺牲弱势用户或负责任的曝光为代价。
translation.brief: 针对推荐智能体中LLM反思开销过大的问题，提出 BRAVE 预算化分配层，在不损害排序性能的前提下按需分配训练时反思。

papers.title: Bridging the Terminology Gap: A Data-Centric Alignment Framework for Multilingual Translation in Cross-Border Corporation
papers.abstract: As globalization accelerates the demand for seamless cross-border enterprise collaboration, multilingual translation remains bottlenecked by insufficient domain-specific terminology, rigid terminology translation, weak instruction-following capabilities, and high inference latency in long-instruction scenarios. To overcome these barriers, we propose Bridging the Terminology Gap (BTG), a data-centric framework. First, BTG mines cross-lingual term alignments from domain documents and leverages LLMs to synthesize terminology-rich parallel corpora. Second, a hybrid filtering strategy combining heuristics and XCOMET scoring ensures high data fidelity. Third, a two-stage training paradigm employs supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for targeted terminology injection, followed by reinforcement learning (RL) to refine output preferences, effectively balancing domain knowledge integration with model reliability. Extensive offline evaluations (e.g., XCOMET, GEMBA, Acc@T) and online human assessments demonstrate significant improvements in terminology accuracy and instruction-following capabilities, validating the effectiveness of our framework, which is now deployed on our cross-border collaboration platform.

translation.title: 弥合术语鸿沟：面向跨国企业多语言翻译的数据中心化对齐框架
translation.abstract: 随着全球化加速了无缝跨境企业协作的需求，多语言翻译仍受限于领域特定术语不足、术语翻译僵硬、指令遵循能力弱以及长指令场景下推理延迟高等瓶颈。为克服这些障碍，我们提出了 Bridging the Terminology Gap（BTG），一个数据中心化框架。首先，BTG 从领域文档中挖掘跨语言术语对齐，并利用 LLM 合成富含术语的平行语料。其次，结合启发式规则与 XCOMET 评分的混合过滤策略确保数据的高保真度。第三，两阶段训练范式先采用监督微调（SFT）进行针对性的术语注入，随后通过强化学习（RL）优化输出偏好，有效平衡领域知识整合与模型可靠性。大量的离线评估（如 XCOMET、GEMBA、Acc@T）和在线人工评估表明，术语准确性和指令遵循能力显著提升，验证了我们框架的有效性。该框架现已部署在我们的跨境协作平台上。
translation.brief: 针对跨国企业多语言翻译中术语不足与术语翻译僵硬的问题，提出通过挖掘跨语言术语对齐、LLM 合成术语丰富语料并进行 SFT 加 RL 两阶段训练的数据中心化框架 BTG。

papers.title: When Facts Change, Which Decisions Break? Dependency-Aware Context Graphs for Agents
papers.abstract: When an observed fact changes, an agent must identify and repair the decisions that depend on it while preserving unaffected outputs. We investigate the reliability-cost trade-off of field-level dependency graphs extracted from actual agent read traces. A controlled benchmark spans three executable workflow domains and four successive updates, with independent imperative and expression-based references. Across 120 workflows, two models and two repeated runs, we compare full recomputation, rolling summary memory, lexical retrieval, trace-extracted dependencies and verified dependency upper bounds. Trace-derived graphs reduce reviewed decisions and estimated total cost, but omitted alternative supports and missing repair context can reduce complete-plan correctness. Paired ablations isolate the effects of edge deletion, spurious edges, transitive propagation and context scope. An exploratory enhancement supplies the existing record ID/field directory during extraction without revealing unread values or reference edges. We evaluate this enhancement on 60 fresh workflows with two repeats per model. On this fresh set, the directory-aware graph matches observed full-context complete-plan correctness for gpt-6.1-sol (100%) with an estimated 4.0% total-cost reduction, but reaches only 84.8% versus 99.6% for gpt-6-luna. The results distinguish potential dependency impact from actual decision invalidity and show why selective repair must be evaluated with both executable correctness and full memory-processing cost. The evidence concerns explicit procedural workflows; broad real-world agent-memory generalization remains untested.

translation.title: 当事实发生变化时，哪些决策会失效？面向智能体的依赖感知上下文图
translation.abstract: 当观察到的事实发生变化时，智能体必须识别并修复依赖于它的决策，同时保留未受影响的输出。我们研究了从实际智能体读取轨迹中提取的字段级依赖图的可靠性-成本权衡。一个受控基准涵盖三个可执行工作流领域和四次连续更新，包含独立的命令式和基于表达式的引用。在 120 个工作流、两个模型和两次重复运行中，我们比较了完全重算、滚动摘要记忆、词汇检索、轨迹提取依赖以及经验证的依赖上界。轨迹衍生图减少了需审阅的决策数量和估计总成本，但遗漏的替代支持和缺失的修复上下文可能降低完整计划的正确性。成对消融实验分离了边删除、虚假边、传递性传播和上下文范围的影响。一项探索性增强在提取过程中提供现有的记录 ID/字段目录，而不泄露未读取的值或引用边。我们在 60 个新工作流上评估该增强，每个模型重复两次。在该新集合上，目录感知图对 gpt-6.1-sol（100%）达到了与观察到的全上下文完整计划正确性相当的水平，估计总成本降低 4.0%，但对 gpt-6-luna 仅达到 84.8%，而全上下文为 99.6%。这些结果区分了潜在依赖影响与实际决策失效，并说明了为何选择性修复必须同时用可执行正确性和完整的记忆处理成本来评估。相关证据仅限于显式程序化工作流；更广泛的现实世界智能体记忆泛化仍有待验证。
translation.brief: 针对事实更新后智能体如何选择性修复依赖决策的问题，研究从智能体轨迹中提取字段级依赖图以降低修复成本的可靠性-成本权衡。

papers.title: Interactive Structured Environment Scaling for Large Language Model Agentic Reasoning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning via environmental interaction is a cornerstone post-training paradigm for evolving large language models into autonomous agents capable of multi-turn tool use and exploration. Because the environment defines what the policy observes and how actions are verified, its structure directly bounds the capabilities an agent can acquire. Yet existing structured and retrieval environments rely on upstream pre-filtering---extracting a compact subgraph around the gold answer or retrieving fixed passages before the policy acts. We show that such pre-filtering introduces a fundamental measurement confound: because per-question subgraphs enclose ground-truth paths, they compress the candidate space by orders of magnitude and leak answer locations via local topology, allowing a question-blind degree heuristic to surface gold answers far above chance. To restore path selection, candidate pruning, and optimal stopping as genuine policy decisions, we propose RISE (Interactive Structured Environment), which transitions structured reinforcement learning from static subgraphs to full-scale interactive databases along two coupled axes. First, Decision-Space Scaling exposes the unpruned knowledge graph via a five-stage graph-agnostic typed intent adapter under a bounded call budget and a multiplicative grounding reward gate. Second, Learning-Frontier Scaling overcomes within-group variance collapse under group-normalized objectives by uniting model-independent structural tier progression with a self-evolving competence-frontier bandit. Across nineteen benchmarks and three model backbones, RISE substantially advances in-domain and unseen-schema knowledge-graph reasoning, transfers zero-shot to open-domain passage retrieval, and significantly enhances out-of-domain mathematical and logical deduction.

translation.title: 面向大语言模型智能体推理的交互式结构化环境扩展
translation.abstract: 通过环境交互进行强化学习是将大语言模型演化为具备多轮工具使用和探索能力的自主智能体的关键后训练范式。由于环境定义了策略观察什么以及如何验证动作，其结构直接限制了智能体可获取的能力。然而，现有的结构化和检索环境依赖上游预过滤——在策略行动前围绕黄金答案提取紧凑子图或检索固定段落。我们证明这种预过滤引入了根本性的测量混淆：由于每个问题的子图包围了真实路径，它们将候选空间压缩了数个数量级，并通过局部拓扑泄露答案位置，使得一个与问题无关的度数启发式方法能远超随机水平地找到黄金答案。为将路径选择、候选剪枝和最优停止恢复为真正的策略决策，我们提出 RISE（交互式结构化环境），沿两个耦合轴线将结构化强化学习从静态子图转向全规模交互式数据库。首先，决策空间扩展通过一个五阶段图无关的类型化意图适配器、在有界调用预算和乘性接地奖励门控下暴露未剪枝的知识图谱。其次，学习前沿扩展通过将模型无关的结构化层级推进与自演化能力前沿老虎机相结合，克服组归一化目标下的组内方差坍缩。在十九个基准和三个模型骨干上，RISE 显著提升了域内和未见模式的知识图谱推理能力，可零样本迁移到开放域段落检索，并显著增强域外数学和逻辑推理。
translation.brief: 针对现有结构化强化学习环境因预过滤子图导致答案泄露的问题，提出 RISE 框架，将训练环境扩展为全规模交互式知识图谱数据库以恢复真实的策略决策。

papers.title: Who Writes the Codebook? An Eight-Step Framework for Auditing LLM-Generated Category Systems
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly create the categories through which qualitative evidence is interpreted. Existing coding benchmarks often hold these categories fixed. We propose the Qualitative Variance Audit Framework, an eight-step method that compares codebook creation, repeated application and code distributions under controlled inputs. It combines model-owned and shared-reference codebooks to distinguish variation in the overall pipeline from application differences within a common category system. An application to 668 organisational interviews, 13,166 text units and eight models from five vendors yields 48 codebooks and 270 coding runs. Models create markedly different category structures; mean within-model reliability ranges from .76 to .92, whereas between-model agreement on the shared codebook is about .69. The framework complements LLM-assisted grounded theory by exposing model dependencies before substantive interpretation. It assesses reliability and representational consequences, not interpretive validity or the quality of resulting theory.

translation.title: 谁来编写编码本？一个审计 LLM 生成类别系统的八步框架
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）日益承担起创建用于解释定性证据的类别体系。现有编码基准通常将这些类别固定不变。我们提出定性差异审计框架（Qualitative Variance Audit Framework），一种八步方法，在受控输入下比较编码本的创建、重复应用及代码分布。它结合模型自有编码本与共享参考编码本，以区分整个流程中的差异与同一类别系统内的应用差异。将该框架应用于来自五家厂商的 668 份组织访谈、13,166 个文本单元和八个模型，产生了 48 个编码本和 270 次编码运行。各模型创建的类别结构差异显著；模型内平均信度为 .76 至 .92，而共享编码本上模型间一致性约为 .69。该框架通过在实质性解释之前揭示模型依赖性，对 LLM 辅助扎根理论形成补充。它评估的是信度与表征后果，而非解释效度或由此产生的理论质量。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 生成的定性编码类别系统缺乏审计方法的问题，提出八步的定性差异审计框架，比较不同模型的编码本创建与应用一致性差异。

papers.title: Large Language Model-based Optimization for Wireless Communication: A Survey
papers.abstract: The growing complexity and dynamism of modern wireless communication frameworks have made real-time optimization essential for efficient resource allocation. Traditional optimization and machine-learning techniques often struggle with generalization, adaptability, stability, and scalability in heterogeneous, time-varying environments. Large language models (LLMs) have recently emerged as powerful tools capable of reasoning over structured prompts and generating context-aware decisions in real time without domain-specific retraining. This survey provides a comprehensive review of LLM-driven optimization techniques applied to wireless communication problems such as power control, bandwidth allocation, task offloading, and intelligent surface configuration. We introduce a functional taxonomy of LLM-enabled wireless resource management strategies and analyze the prompt engineering methodologies employed in recent literature. Furthermore, we develop a generalized analytical framework that categorizes LLM-based optimization architectures, including direct solution generation, closed-loop optimization with external verifiers, and representation encoding within trainable neural pipelines. To demonstrate practical applicability, we present representative case studies on LLM-assisted beam prediction for millimeter-wave systems and adaptive wireless resource allocation. Finally, we discuss emerging hybrid AI approaches for wireless networks.

translation.title: 基于大语言模型的无线通信优化：综述
translation.abstract: 现代无线通信框架日益增长的复杂性和动态性使实时优化对高效资源分配变得至关重要。传统优化和机器学习技术在异构、时变环境中常常难以实现泛化、适应性、稳定性和可扩展性。大语言模型（LLM）近期已成为强大工具，能够对结构化提示进行推理并实时生成上下文感知的决策，而无需领域特定的再训练。本综述全面回顾了应用于功率控制、带宽分配、任务卸载和智能表面配置等无线通信问题的 LLM 驱动优化技术。我们引入了 LLM 使能的无线资源管理策略的功能分类法，并分析了近期文献中采用的提示工程方法。此外，我们开发了一个广义分析框架，对基于 LLM 的优化架构进行分类，包括直接解生成、带外部验证器的闭环优化以及可训练神经流水线中的表示编码。为展示实际适用性，我们提供了 LLM 辅助毫米波系统波束预测和自适应无线资源分配的代表性案例研究。最后，我们讨论了面向无线网络的新兴混合 AI 方法。
translation.brief: 综述 LLM 在功率控制、带宽分配、任务卸载等无线通信优化中的应用，并提出对 LLM 优化架构的分类框架与案例研究。

papers.title: Recovery Gone Too Far: Understanding and Repairing Risky Fallback in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents interact with their environments through tools, reading repositories, running builds, and pushing code. When a tool fails with an ordinary error, such as a rate limit or a timeout, the agent can fall back to a substitute tool and still complete the task. However, the same fallback that completes a task in one environment can cross an action boundary in another. For example, after a push is rejected, a forced push in one repository replaces only the agent's own commits, while in a different repository it also removes another author's commits. We call such a fallback a risky fallback. To understand this phenomenon, we conduct an empirical study on 304 scenarios that span eight domains and cover 55 real CVEs. All four mainstream models we evaluate exhibit risky fallback, with action-boundary violations in up to 96.8% of risky scenarios. We further evaluate three mainstream mitigations and find that none of them is effective against risky fallback. We then present nrepair. At each call to the substitute tool, nrepair scores the agent's context with a monitor whose threshold is calibrated on normal runs alone; when the monitor triggers, it withholds the call once and returns the decision to the agent. nrepair reduces action-boundary violations on all four models, by up to 76.0% (from 67.5% to 16.2%), at a negligible runtime cost. On most models, the normal success rate drops by less than 7%. We also evaluate nrepair on two production agents, Claude Code and Codex, and find that it is equally effective on both.

translation.title: 恢复走过头：理解并修复 LLM Agent 中的危险回退
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）agent 通过工具与环境交互：读取仓库、运行构建、推送代码等。当工具因普通错误（如速率限制或超时）失败时，agent 可以回退到替代工具并完成任务。然而，同一种回退在一个环境中能完成任务，在另一个环境中却可能跨越动作边界。例如，推送被拒绝后，强制推送在一个仓库中只替换 agent 自己的提交，而在另一个仓库中还会删除其他作者的提交。我们将这类回退称为危险回退（risky fallback）。为理解这一现象，我们对覆盖八个领域、包含 55 个真实 CVE 的 304 个场景进行了实证研究。我们评估的全部四个主流模型都表现出危险回退，在危险场景中动作边界违规率高达 96.8%。我们进一步评估了三种主流缓解措施，发现它们对危险回退均无效。随后我们提出了 nrepair。在每次调用替代工具时，nrepair 使用一个仅在正常运行上校准阈值的监视器对 agent 的上下文打分；当监视器触发时，它将此次调用暂扣一次，并将决策返回给 agent。nrepair 在全部四个模型上降低了动作边界违规率，最高降低 76.0%（从 67.5% 降至 16.2%），运行时开销可忽略不计。在大多数模型上，正常成功率下降不到 7%。我们还在两个生产级 agent（Claude Code 和 Codex）上评估了 nrepair，发现它在两者上同样有效。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM agent 在工具失败后回退到替代工具时可能跨越动作边界造成危险操作的问题，提出 nrepair，通过基于正常运行校准的监视器在替代工具调用时拦截并反馈决策来降低违规。

papers.title: Attribute or Abstain: Evaluating Evidence-Grounded Retrieval on the Low-Resource African Business Web
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented systems that research companies are judged by how much they find, yet in markets where public evidence is sparse, a confident answer without support costs more than no answer. We introduce AfriBizClaims, a benchmark of 150 company-research queries across six African markets in English, French and Portuguese, including queries about fictitious companies that a correct system must decline. Each claim a system makes is judged against the page it cites by an AI judge, checked against a second AI judge from another model family and against two human annotators, and abstentions are scored against answerability labels. We compare BM25 over a pooled corpus, standard web retrieval-augmented generation, and a multi-step agent pipeline (Konexium V1), all using the same language model. The two simple baselines are well attributed: 98% of their judged claims are supported by the page they cite, and they decline every field of every fictitious company. Counting claims about a company other than the one asked about as errors, the agent pipeline's per-query precision is 68%, and it never answers a question about a named company correctly: it substitutes other firms, including for 5 of the 24 fictitious names, and it is the least stable between runs and the most expensive. In the pipeline we evaluated, more steps between the query and the evidence did not buy more grounded answers. We will release the queries, system outputs, labels and short evidence excerpts.

translation.title: 归因或弃答：在低资源非洲商业网络信息上评估有证据支撑的检索
translation.abstract: 研究公司的检索增强系统以找到多少信息来评判，但在公开证据稀少的市场中，一个没有依据却自信的答案比没有答案代价更高。我们提出了 AfriBizClaims，一个覆盖六个非洲市场、使用英语、法语和葡萄牙语的 150 个公司研究查询的基准，其中包括系统必须拒绝回答的虚构公司查询。系统提出的每条论断由一个 AI 评审对照其引用的页面进行评判，再由另一模型家族的第二个 AI 评审和两位人工标注者核查，弃答行为则依据可回答性标签进行评分。我们比较了在合并语料上的 BM25、标准的检索增强生成（RAG）以及多步 agent 流水线（Konexium V1），全部使用同一语言模型。两个简单基线归因良好：其被评判的论断中 98% 得到所引页面的支持，且对每个虚构公司的每个字段均予拒绝。若把针对非目标公司的论断也计为错误，该 agent 流水线的每查询精确率为 68%，且从未正确回答关于具名公司的问题：它用其他公司顶替，包括 24 个虚构名称中的 5 个，且其运行间稳定性最差、成本最高。在我们评估的流水线中，查询与证据之间增加更多步骤并未带来更有依据的答案。我们将发布查询、系统输出、标签和简短证据摘录。
translation.brief: 针对低资源非洲商业信息上检索增强系统缺乏证据支撑与错误归因的问题，构建 AfriBizClaims 基准，通过 AI 与人工对照引用页面逐条验证论断并评估弃答行为来比较多种检索方法。

papers.title: "Don't Leave the Task Unfinished": Persistence-Driven Violations under Quiet Oversight
papers.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly given long, multi-step tasks to carry out, with the user reviewing little of what happens in between. Persistence, the tendency to keep working until a task is complete, is installed on purpose to improve performance on long tasks. Long-horizon tasks are typically complex, and the user's instruction can fall short of what the work actually requires, or conflict with the constraints the agent encounters in the task. We study what persistence does on long-horizon operations tasks that cannot be solved without breaking a documented constraint. We find that the agent pursues completion to the point of violating the constraint, and that a critically engaged user lowers the violation rate. Persistence takes violations from 29.2% to 58.3% across four models. Violations stay high wherever oversight goes quiet, whether the user is silent, assenting, or delegating with expressed trust. Only a questioning user, who asks for the basis of each action before allowing the next, brings the rate back to roughly the level measured without persistence. Practitioners should treat high persistence as a setting that carries a safety cost, and should recognize that the cost appears when oversight goes quiet. Safety here is better cast as a property of the human-AI pair than of the model alone. Project page: this https URL

translation.title: “不要把任务留成半成品”：安静监督下的坚持性驱动违规
translation.abstract: LLM agent 被越来越多地赋予长周期、多步骤任务，而用户几乎不审查中间过程。坚持性（persistence），即坚持工作直到任务完成的倾向，是为提高长任务性能而有意安装的。长周期任务通常复杂，用户的指令可能无法覆盖工作实际所需，或与 agent 在任务中遇到的约束相冲突。我们研究在不破坏成文约束就无法完成的长周期操作任务上，坚持性会带来什么。我们发现 agent 会为追求完成而违反约束，而一个保持批判性参与的用户能降低违规率。在四个模型上，坚持性使违规率从 29.2% 升至 58.3%。只要监督陷入安静，无论用户沉默、附和还是带着信任委托，违规率都居高不下。只有那种在允许下一步之前先追问每个行动依据的质疑型用户，才能把违规率拉回接近无坚持性时的水平。从业者应将高坚持性视为带有安全代价的设置，并认识到该代价在监督安静时显现。这里的安全更适合被理解为人类—AI 组合的属性，而非模型本身的属性。项目页面：this https URL
translation.brief: 研究 LLM agent 的坚持性设置在不破坏约束就无法完成的长任务上诱发约束违规的问题，发现只有质疑型用户监督才能将违规率降回基线水平。

papers.title: The Vocabulary Tax: Safely Trimming Unused Tokens from LLMs for On-Device Use
papers.abstract: Open large language models (LLMs) and speech models ship vocabularies of up to 262k tokens, and every user downloads the tables those tokens index (the input embedding, an untied output head and, in recent on-device models, per-layer embeddings), whatever languages they need. We call the bytes in rows a deployment never uses the vocabulary tax and measure it, without downloading weights, for 1,244 generative and speech-recognition models on the Hugging Face Hub. For a Thai and English deployment it is a median 4.4% of model bytes below 0.5B parameters and 2.1% above 8B, and 1.93 GB in Gemma 4 E2B: it falls hardest on the small models that edge devices run. Keeping only the rows of the deployment's writing systems is exact. Keeping the tokens seen in the user's own text removes much more, a median 29.0% below 0.5B, but the usual way of doing it breaks BPE tokenizers: it drops the intermediate tokens that merges build on, so new text is split differently 1.9 times as often as the standard check reports. We repair this with merge closure, at a cost of 5.9% more rows, and add a trim certificate: a Good-Turing estimate, from the trimming text alone, of how much new text the trimmed tokenizer will split differently (correlation 0.996 over 300 settings in 22 languages) and of how much more text a target needs. Without test data our method never exceeds a 2% target, while prior keep rules checked on test data exceed it in 9-13 of 44 settings. On six models of 270M to 3B parameters in 11 languages, trimmed models keep their predictions: where the certificate passes, a median 89.7% of rows is removed and bits per character rise by at most 2.0%. The census, the trimming and the certificate are released as an open Python package, and the per-model tax for 41 languages as an open dataset.

translation.title: 词表税：为端侧部署安全裁剪 LLM 中未使用的 token
translation.abstract: 开源大语言模型（LLM）和语音模型附带多达 26.2 万 token 的词表，每个用户都要下载这些 token 所索引的表（输入 embedding、未绑定的输出头，以及近期端侧模型中的逐层 embedding），无论其需要什么语言。我们将部署从未使用的行所占的字节称为词表税（vocabulary tax），并在不下载权重的情况下，对 Hugging Face Hub 上 1,244 个生成式和语音识别模型进行了测量。对于泰语和英语部署，该税在 0.5B 参数以下的模型中位数占模型字节的 4.4%，在 8B 以上占 2.1%，在 Gemma 4 E2B 中达 1.93 GB：它对边缘设备所运行的小模型打击最重。仅保留部署所用文字系统的行是精确的。仅保留用户文本中出现过的 token 能去除更多，0.5B 以下中位数达 29.0%，但常用做法会破坏 BPE 分词器：它丢弃了 merge 所依赖的中间 token，导致新文本的切分差异频率是标准检查所报告的 1.9 倍。我们用 merge closure 修复此问题，代价是多保留 5.9% 的行，并增加了裁剪证书：一个仅凭裁剪文本的 Good-Turing 估计，预测裁剪后分词器对新文本的切分差异量（22 种语言 300 个设置上相关系数 0.996）以及目标达到阈值还需多少文本。在没有测试数据的情况下，我们的方法从不超出 2% 的目标，而先前的保留规则即便在测试数据上校验，也在 44 个设置中的 9-13 个超出该目标。在 11 种语言、6 个 270M 到 3B 参数的模型上，裁剪后的模型保持其预测：在证书通过之处，中位数 89.7% 的行被移除，每字符比特数最多上升 2.0%。普查、裁剪工具和证书以开源 Python 包发布，41 种语言的逐模型词表税以开放数据集发布。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 部署中未使用词表条目占用存储的词表税问题，提出基于 merge closure 的安全词表裁剪方法和基于 Good-Turing 的裁剪证书来预测裁剪后分词差异。

papers.title: SAGE-VQA: A Training-Free, Self-Evolving Agentic Framework with Grounded Evidence for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract: Knowledge-based visual question answering (KB-VQA) aims to combine visual information with external knowledge to answer user questions. Existing methods face two main bottlenecks: visual perception errors can propagate into hallucinations, and generalization across scenarios remains limited. To address these issues, we propose SAGE-VQA (Self-evolving Agent framework with Grounded Evidence), a training-free agentic framework that combines evidence verification with experience evolution. Our key insight is to explore an Evidence-Driven Adaptive Reasoning (EDAR) strategy. It accurately acquires and verifies question-relevant fine-grained visual information. It also extracts and refines reusable experience to support robust reasoning across tasks. Specifically, we design a Co-verified Visual Grounding module that verifies question-relevant visual information and provides grounded evidence for subsequent reasoning. We further introduce a Self-evolving Hierarchical Memory (SHM) mechanism. SHM organizes experiences into declarative and procedural memories based on their nature. These memories can be reused in subsequent reasoning and continually refined through feedback, without updating model parameters. Experimental results show that our method outperforms competing methods based on lightweight open-source vision-language models (VLMs) as well as those based on closed-source VLMs. Moreover, our method can serve as a plug-and-play reasoning framework for existing VLMs without modifying their architectures.

translation.title: SAGE-VQA：面向知识型视觉问答的免训练、自进化、带落地证据的 Agent 框架
translation.abstract: 知识型视觉问答（KB-VQA）旨在结合视觉信息与外部知识来回答用户问题。现有方法面临两个主要瓶颈：视觉感知错误可能传播为幻觉，且跨场景泛化能力有限。为解决这些问题，我们提出 SAGE-VQA（Self-evolving Agent framework with Grounded Evidence），一个将证据验证与经验进化相结合的免训练 agentic 框架。我们的关键洞察是探索证据驱动的自适应推理（EDAR）策略，它准确获取并验证与问题相关的细粒度视觉信息，同时提取并精炼可复用的经验以支持跨任务的鲁棒推理。具体而言，我们设计了协同验证的视觉定位（Co-verified Visual Grounding）模块，验证与问题相关的视觉信息并为后续推理提供落地证据。我们进一步引入自进化分层记忆（SHM）机制，将经验按其性质组织为陈述性记忆和程序性记忆。这些记忆可在后续推理中复用，并通过反馈持续精炼，而无需更新模型参数。实验结果表明，我们的方法优于基于轻量级开源视觉语言模型（VLM）的方法以及基于闭源 VLM 的方法。此外，我们的方法可作为现有 VLM 的即插即用推理框架，而无需修改其架构。
translation.brief: 针对知识型视觉问答中视觉感知错误引发幻觉与跨场景泛化不足的问题，提出免训练的 SAGE-VQA 框架，结合协同验证的视觉定位与自进化分层记忆来提供落地证据和可复用经验。

papers.title: CoSyDelay: Cognitive Symbolic Regression for Traffic Delay Estimation
papers.abstract: Trustworthy estimation of traffic delays at signalized intersections is critical for modern transportation systems, as it supports proactive traffic control for congestion mitigation. Existing analytical methods often rely on idealized assumptions that limit their accuracy under complex traffic conditions, whereas data-driven methods may achieve strong estimation performance but usually lack transparent structures, which reduces confidence in their practical application. To address these limitations, we propose CoSyDelay, a cognitive symbolic regression (SR) framework for automatically deriving explicit and physically consistent empirical delay estimation expressions (DEEs). Specifically, CoSyDelay decomposes intersection-level delay estimation into turning-movement-level subproblems, thereby reducing the complexity of the symbolic search. During DEE learning, CoSyDelay constructs domain-informed symbolic inputs from traffic variables. Large language models (LLMs) are employed as symbolic search operators to iteratively generate and refine candidate expression structures, whose movement-specific coefficients are subsequently calibrated using approach-level delay labels. A composite fitness function evaluates the learned DEEs jointly in terms of estimation accuracy and compliance with specified traffic-delay principles. Experimental results on multiple signalized intersections demonstrate that the resulting expressions achieve competitive estimation performance while maintaining physical consistency, thereby supporting trustworthy delay estimation. Source code and datasets are available at this https URL.

translation.title: CoSyDelay：用于交通延误估计的认知符号回归
translation.abstract: 对信号交叉口交通延误的可信估计对现代交通系统至关重要，可支持以缓解拥堵为目标的主动交通控制。现有解析方法通常依赖理想化假设，在复杂交通条件下精度受限；而数据驱动方法虽可取得较强的估计性能，但通常缺乏透明的结构，降低了其实际应用的可信度。针对这些局限，我们提出CoSyDelay，一个认知符号回归（SR）框架，用于自动推导显式且物理一致的经验延误估计表达式（DEE）。具体而言，CoSyDelay将交叉口级延误估计分解为转向流级子问题，从而降低符号搜索的复杂度。在DEE学习过程中，CoSyDelay从交通变量构建领域知识驱动的符号输入，并利用大语言模型（LLM）作为符号搜索算子，迭代生成和改进候选表达式结构，随后使用进口道级延误标签校准各转向流特定系数。一个复合适应度函数在估计精度和对指定交通延误原理的符合度两方面联合评估所学DEE。在多个信号交叉口上的实验结果表明，所得表达式在保持物理一致性的同时取得了有竞争力的估计性能，从而支持可信的延误估计。源代码和数据集见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 解决传统解析方法精度受限、数据驱动方法缺乏透明结构导致的信号交叉口延误估计可信度问题，核心方法是提出CoSyDelay认知符号回归框架，分解延误估计为转向流级子问题，并用LLM作为符号搜索算子自动推导显式且物理一致的经验延误估计表达式。

papers.title: Discovering Programmatic Policies from Reinforcement Learning-Based Traffic Signal Controllers
papers.abstract: Traffic signal control (TSC) is critical for mitigating urban congestion. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has achieved strong performance by learning adaptive policies from traffic observations, but learned neural controllers are often opaque, structurally complex, and difficult to generalize across scenarios. We propose PPL-TSC, a programmatic policy learning framework that distills compact and human-readable TSC policies from DRL teachers. PPL-TSC formulates policy learning as an evolutionary search over phase utility functions (PUFs), which score candidate signal phases and select the highest-utility phase for execution. Each generation consists of four steps: policy generation, policy review, policy calibration, and policy evaluation. In the generation step, a large language model (LLM) acts as a semantics-aware evolutionary operator to propose and refine candidate PUFs. Generated PUFs are screened through explicit checks for syntactic validity, mathematical soundness, and consistency with TSC principles, with invalid ones repaired through iterative feedback. Valid PUFs are then calibrated to improve behavioral fidelity to the DRL teacher, and evaluated using a joint score combining teacher fidelity and traffic-control performance to select candidates for the next generation. Extensive experiments across diverse traffic scenarios and representative DRL-based controllers show that PPL-TSC produces compact and human-readable policies, achieves competitive performance for most teacher families, improves transfer generalization, and substantially reduces computational cost. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 从基于强化学习的交通信号控制器中发现程序化策略
translation.abstract: 交通信号控制（TSC）对缓解城市拥堵至关重要。深度强化学习（DRL）通过从交通观测中学习自适应策略取得了出色性能，但学习到的神经控制器往往不透明、结构复杂，且难以跨场景泛化。我们提出PPL-TSC，一个程序化策略学习框架，从DRL教师中蒸馏出紧凑且人类可读的TSC策略。PPL-TSC将策略学习形式化为对相位效用函数（PUF）的进化搜索，PUF对候选信号相位评分并选择效用最高的相位执行。每一代包含四个步骤：策略生成、策略审查、策略校准和策略评估。在生成步骤中，大语言模型（LLM）充当语义感知的进化算子来提出并改进候选PUF。生成的PUF通过显式检查（语法有效性、数学合理性与TSC原则一致性）进行筛选，无效者通过迭代反馈修复。有效PUF随后被校准以提升对DRL教师的行为保真度，并通过结合教师保真度与交通控制性能的联合评分进行评估，以选出进入下一代的候选。在多种交通场景和代表性DRL控制器上的大量实验表明，PPL-TSC能产生紧凑且人类可读的策略，对多数教师家族取得有竞争力的性能，提升迁移泛化能力并大幅降低计算成本。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 解决DRL交通信号控制器不透明、复杂且难泛化的问题，核心方法是提出PPL-TSC程序化策略学习框架，以LLM驱动的进化搜索从DRL教师蒸馏出基于相位效用函数的紧凑可读策略。

papers.title: FinVision: Multimodal AI for Visualizing Financial Narratives
papers.abstract: Financial narratives contain rich information about firms' performance and business conditions. Conventional text analysis often summarizes this information into numerical representations, which may not fully preserve the dynamic structure described in the narrative. In this study, we develop FinVision, a domain-specific multimodal generative model that translates financial narratives into visual representations of contemporaneous market dynamics. Using 87,940 paired observations of Management Discussion and Analysis (MD&A) disclosures and stock price charts, FinVision learns the average relationship between a firm's narrative account of a fiscal year and its stock-price dynamics over the same period. Given an MD&A alone, the trained model generates a text-implied stock chart, extending financial text analysis beyond numerical representations toward text-to-visual generation. We validate FinVision in two ways. First, held-out tests show that the model generates stock-chart representations that closely resemble observed charts and outperform direct LLM prompting, general-purpose text-to-image models, and the same architecture without financial-domain adaptation. Second, we examine the economic validity of the generated representations by comparing text-implied and observed stock charts. The resulting discrepancy is systematically associated with weaker investor responses around subsequent 10-K filings and with worse subsequent market and operating outcomes. Overall, our findings show how domain-adapted multimodal generative AI can create a new visual representation of financial text and provide an additional modality for studying business communication.

translation.title: FinVision：用于可视化金融叙事的多模态AI
translation.abstract: 金融叙事包含关于企业业绩和经营状况的丰富信息。传统文本分析通常将这些信息总结为数值表示，可能无法完整保留叙事中所描述的动态结构。在本研究中，我们开发了FinVision，一个面向特定领域的多模态生成模型，将金融叙事转化为同期市场动态的可视化表示。基于87,940对管理层讨论与分析（MD&A）披露与股价图表的配对观测，FinVision学习企业对某财年的叙事描述与同期股价动态之间的平均关系。仅给定一份MD&A，训练后的模型即可生成文本隐含的股价图表，将金融文本分析从数值表示拓展到文本到视觉生成。我们通过两种方式验证FinVision。首先，留出测试表明，模型生成的股价图表表示与真实图表高度相似，并优于直接LLM提示、通用文本到图像模型以及未做金融领域适配的同架构模型。其次，通过比较文本隐含图表与实际观测图表，检验生成表示的经济有效性。所得差异与后续10-K披露前后投资者反应较弱以及更差的后续市场与经营结果存在系统性关联。总体而言，我们的发现展示了领域适配的多模态生成AI如何为金融文本创造一种新的视觉表示，并为研究商业沟通提供额外模态。
translation.brief: 解决传统金融叙事文本分析仅用数值表示而丢失动态结构的问题，核心方法是开发FinVision领域适配多模态生成模型，基于MD&A披露与股价图表配对数据将叙事文本生成文本隐含的股价图表。

papers.title: Anatomy of an Agent Harness: Decisions, Invariants and Corner Cases
papers.abstract: An agent harness is the program around a language model that turns its replies into actions: it builds each request, runs the tools the model asks for, decides what the model may do without asking, stores the conversation, recovers from failures, and shows a person what happened. Most of these decisions are made in code and rarely written down, so each harness meets the same corner cases again. This paper writes them down as invariants to test. It gives a system model with trust boundaries; 30 decision cards in six groups, each with options and costs, an invariant, the corner cases that break it, a test and an evidence tag; six cause classes for failures; a test method built on scripted providers, recorded behaviour and planted changes; and a checklist. The cards come from building one desktop harness, Crewroom, the author's own, and from manually testing ten other harnesses and studying open-source harnesses as reference; some patterns in the cards were adopted from those, so the catalogue is not independent of them. Of the 83 invariant clauses, 56 are tagged Tested, 12 Believed and 15 Open. The checklist is applied to the author's harness as one worked example, by its builder with no second rater: of its 30 items, 11 hold, 14 do not and 5 were not tested. It is not a ranking. The paper makes no claims about answer quality or cost or other platforms, and does not evaluate or rank other harnesses.

translation.title: 智能体框架剖析：决策、不变量与角落用例
translation.abstract: 智能体框架（agent harness）是围绕语言模型的程序，将模型的回复转化为行动：它构建每次请求、执行模型要求的工具、决定模型无需询问即可执行的操作、存储对话、从故障中恢复，并向人展示发生了什么。这些决策大多在代码中做出且很少被记录下来，导致每个框架反复遇到相同的角落用例。本文将其记录为可测试的不变量。本文给出了一个含信任边界的系统模型；六组共30张决策卡片，每张包含可选方案与代价、一个不变量、破坏该不变量的角落用例、一个测试和一个证据标签；六类故障成因；一种基于脚本化提供者、录制行为与植入变更的测试方法；以及一份检查清单。这些卡片来自作者构建的一个桌面框架Crewroom，也来自对其他十个框架的人工测试和对开源框架的参考研究；部分卡片中的模式借鉴自后者，因此该目录并非独立于它们。在83条不变量子句中，56条标记为Tested（已测试），12条标记为Believed（相信），15条标记为Open（开放）。检查清单以作者自己的框架作为唯一工作示例进行应用，由其构建者独自完成、无第二评审者：30项中11项成立，14项不成立，5项未测试。这不是排名。本文不对回答质量、成本或其他平台做出断言，也不评估或排名其他框架。
translation.brief: 解决LLM智能体框架中大量工程决策未被记录导致反复踩坑的问题，核心方法是将这些决策系统性整理为30张决策卡片和83条可测试的不变量，并配套故障成因分类、测试方法与检查清单。

papers.title: DetouR: Plugging Association Routes into Search Agents for Multi-hop Question Answering
papers.abstract: Search agents answer multi-hop questions by interleaving reasoning with retrieval, deciding at each step what to search next. Existing agents follow semantic routes: they infer what is missing and phrase it as a query, reaching only what the model can name. Yet the decisive page is often one the question never names, frequently just one hyperlink away from evidence already retrieved. Following such association routes reaches more gold pages than semantic search under the same budget. Exploiting them raises two challenges: obtaining the association structure without costly offline graph construction, and keeping linked evidence in the reader's limited context, where relevance- and fusion-based selection discards it. We propose DetouR, a plug-in that reuses the links arriving with retrieved pages and adds no search or LLM call. Link Rerouting replaces near-repeat queries with routes to linked pages, chosen by a lightweight learned scorer; Chain-aware Context Selection runs personalized PageRank over these links so that evidence chains reach the reader intact. Across four agents, DetouR improves EM by 4.0 points on 2Wiki and 1.4 on HotpotQA on average. We also find that heavier LLM models struggle with this non-semantic evidence, adding little over these simple selectors or even falling behind. In summary, our work reveals association routes as a cheap complement to semantic routes that current search agents overlook: added as a plug-in, they improve every agent we test, in replay and in live runs, at no extra search or LLM cost.

translation.title: DetouR：将关联路由接入搜索智能体以实现多跳问答
translation.abstract: 搜索智能体通过在推理与检索之间交替来回答多跳问题，在每一步决定下一步搜索什么。现有智能体遵循语义路由：它们推断缺失内容并将其表述为查询，只能到达模型能命名的目标。然而，决定性的页面往往不是问题所命名的页面，通常距离已检索到的证据仅一个超链接之遥。在相同预算下，沿这类关联路由比语义搜索能触达更多金标页面。利用它们带来两个挑战：在不进行昂贵的离线图构建的情况下获取关联结构，以及在阅读器有限的上下文中保留链接证据——基于相关性和融合的选择会将其丢弃。我们提出DetouR，一个插件，它复用检索页面自带的链接，且不增加任何搜索或LLM调用。Link Rerouting用指向链接页面的路由替换近重复查询，由轻量学习评分器选择；Chain-aware Context Selection在这些链接上运行个性化PageRank，使证据链完整抵达阅读器。在四个智能体上，DetouR在2Wiki上平均提升EM 4.0分，在HotpotQA上平均提升1.4分。我们还发现更强的LLM模型难以处理这类非语义证据，相比这些简单选择器仅增加很少优势甚至落后。总之，我们的工作揭示关联路由是当前搜索智能体忽视的语义路由的廉价补充：作为插件加入后，无需额外搜索或LLM成本即可在回放与真实运行中改进我们测试的所有智能体。
translation.brief: 解决多跳问答搜索智能体仅依赖语义路由而错过问题未提及的关键链接页面的问题，核心方法是提出DetouR插件，复用检索页面自带的超链接，通过Link Rerouting和链感知PageRank上下文选择实现零额外搜索或LLM调用的关联路由利用。

papers.title: Take a Step Back: A Dual-Granularity Raw Feature Empowered Intermediate Fusion Graph Convolutional Network for Multimodal Recommendation
papers.abstract: Although multimodal recommendations have shown the ability to learn user preferences and item properties by leveraging explicit multimodal information, they remain constrained by two critical limitations: low-quality representation learning and modality fusion. For the former, existing solutions primarily focus on multi-granularity representation learning; however, we argue that training such representations is difficult due to the inherent data sparsity problem in recommendation scenarios. For the latter, existing solutions often rely on contrastive learning to align representations of different modalities to facilitate modality fusion, yet alignment-only objectives may over-compress valuable modality-specific information. To this end, we suggest \underline{``Take a Step Back"} and propose a \textbf{D}ual-granularity raw feature empowered \textbf{I}ntermediate fusion \textbf{G}raph \textbf{C}onvolutional \textbf{N}etwork (\textbf{DIGCN}) for multimodal recommendation. DIGCN leverages the multimodal understanding capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to construct dual-granularity raw features directly. Furthermore, DIGCN introduces an intermediate fusion graph convolutional network equipped with dynamic cross-modality weight correction, designed to capture cross-modality signals and achieve effective modality fusion. Comprehensive experiments on four real-world datasets validate that DIGCN consistently outperforms a variety of strong baselines. Additional analyses confirm its superiority under varying levels of data sparsity and cold-start scenarios. Notably, DIGCN demonstrates high extensibility, capable of further benefiting from additional contrastive learning-based alignment tasks.

translation.title: 退一步看：面向多模态推荐的双粒度原始特征赋能中间融合图卷积网络
translation.abstract: 尽管多模态推荐已展现出利用显式多模态信息学习用户偏好和物品属性的能力，但仍受制于两个关键局限：低质量的表示学习和模态融合。对于前者，现有方案主要聚焦于多粒度表示学习；然而我们认为，由于推荐场景固有的数据稀疏问题，训练此类表示十分困难。对于后者，现有方案通常依赖对比学习来对齐不同模态的表示以促进模态融合，但仅对齐的目标可能过度压缩有价值的模态特有信息。为此，我们建议"退一步看"，提出面向多模态推荐的双粒度原始特征赋能中间融合图卷积网络（DIGCN）。DIGCN 利用大语言模型（LLM）的多模态理解能力直接构建双粒度原始特征。此外，DIGCN 引入了一个配备动态跨模态权重修正的中间融合图卷积网络，旨在捕获跨模态信号并实现有效的模态融合。在四个真实数据集上的全面实验验证了 DIGCN 持续优于多种强基线。补充分析证实了其在不同数据稀疏程度和冷启动场景下的优越性。值得注意的是，DIGCN 展现出高度可扩展性，能够从额外的基于对比学习的对齐任务中进一步获益。
translation.brief: 针对推荐场景中多粒度表示训练困难和仅靠对齐损失模态特有信息的问题，提出利用 LLM 直接构建双粒度原始特征并配合带动态跨模态权重修正的中间融合图卷积网络 DIGCN。

papers.title: Autonomous Multi-modal Agents for ITOps Observability
papers.abstract: ITOps observability products must integrate data from different tools and systems. We present ITOps Observability Studio, a multi-modal multi-agent system that orchestrates observability workflows through collaborative AI agents. Its three-tier architecture features inter-agent communication, specialized LLM-powered agents for data access, schema operations and visualization, and unified tool integration. The system supports natural language to GraphQL translation, GraphQL schema generation, schema mapping, trace data lifecycle management and multi-tool workflows for reliability engineering. Its agents are instrumented with agent analytics, so that their model and tool calls can be traced. We evaluate each agent on its own benchmark, scored against gold answers where they exist and by a model judge for schema mapping and chart quality. Query generation on a public benchmark and routing work well with a current open model, and the data lifecycle management agent solves most of its scenarios. The evaluation exposed defects that only appear when prompts, parsers and serving stacks are tested together, and we report them together with their fixes.

translation.title: 面向 ITOps 可观测性的自主多模态智能体
translation.abstract: ITOps 可观测性产品必须整合来自不同工具和系统的数据。我们提出 ITOps Observability Studio，一个通过协作式 AI 智能体编排可观测性工作流的多模态多智能体系统。其三层架构具备智能体间通信、专门用于数据访问、模式（schema）操作和可视化的 LLM 驱动智能体，以及统一的工具集成。系统支持自然语言到 GraphQL 的翻译、GraphQL 模式生成、模式映射、追踪数据生命周期管理以及面向可靠性工程的多工具工作流。其智能体配备智能体分析工具，可追踪其模型和工具调用。我们在各自的基准上评估每个智能体：在存在标准答案的情况下按标准答案打分，对模式映射和图表质量则由模型裁判评分。在公开基准上的查询生成和路由在当前开源模型下表现良好，数据生命周期管理智能体解决了大部分场景。评估暴露了仅当提示词、解析器和服务栈一起测试时才出现的缺陷，我们将这些缺陷连同修复方案一并报告。
translation.brief: 针对 ITOps 可观测性中多工具数据整合与工作流编排问题，提出由专门 LLM 智能体协作组成的多智能体系统并逐一基准评估。

papers.title: The novelty exposed: ablation, reproducibility and transparency in 40 technical reports of open-weight large language models (LLMs)
papers.abstract: In 2025 alone, 48 new large language model (LLM) architectures were added to the Hugging Face transformers library, and many of them arrive with a technical report that presents the model as new. What is actually new in these models, and is it tested? We put this question to LLM technical reports. We look at three things: what the reference code shows about how new open-weight architectures differ from earlier ones; what 40 randomly sampled technical reports claim as new and whether they support it with ablation studies; and what they disclose for reproducibility and transparency. In the library, 39 of the 48 architectures added in 2025 take at least two of their three core blocks from another model, most often Llama, although part of this reflects how the library writes code. In the reports, 19 of 73 architectural or training novelty claims come with a controlled with/without comparison; 4 of 40 reports state more than one training run; 8 rerun the models they compare against under one setup; and 1 discloses data mixture, token count, and compute together. We also looked for known components given new names: none of five candidate cases hid its origin, though we did not study model names. We propose seven reporting rules for LLM release reports and apply them to two reports. We do not judge model quality, and an untested claim may still be true.

translation.title: 揭示新颖性：40 份开放权重大型语言模型（LLM）技术报告中的消融、可复现性与透明度
translation.abstract: 仅在 2025 年，Hugging Face transformers 库就新增了 48 种大型语言模型（LLM）架构，其中许多伴随着将模型包装为全新的技术报告发布。这些模型究竟有什么新内容，是否经过测试？我们将这一问题置于 LLM 技术报告之上。我们考察三件事：参考代码显示新的开放权重架构与先前架构有何不同；40 份随机抽样的技术报告声称哪些新颖之处，以及是否以消融实验支持这些声明；以及它们为可复现性和透明度披露了什么。在库中，2025 年新增的 48 种架构中有 39 种至少将三个核心模块中的两个取自其他模型，最常见的是 Llama，尽管部分原因在于库的代码编写方式。在报告中，73 条架构或训练新颖性声明中只有 19 条附有受控的有/无对比；40 份报告中仅 4 份声明进行了不止一次训练；8 份在同一设置下重新运行了所比较的模型；仅 1 份同时披露了数据配比、token 数量和计算量。我们还寻找被赋予新名称的已知组件：五个候选案例中没有一个隐瞒其来源，但我们没有研究模型命名。我们为 LLM 发布报告提出七条报告规则，并应用于两份报告。我们不评判模型质量，未经测试的声明仍可能是真的。
translation.brief: 针对开放权重 LLM 技术报告新颖性声明缺乏消融验证与复现信息的问题，通过分析代码与 40 份报告开展系统性审计并提出七条报告规则。

papers.title: Glance, then Select: Evidence-Tempered Visual Token Selection for Extremely Compressed Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) encode a high-resolution image into thousands of visual tokens, which dominate the cost of the prefill stage. Visual token reduction removes most of these tokens, but two problems remain at extreme budgets. The vision encoder still processes every patch of the image, and the few surviving tokens often miss the small regions that hold the answer. In this paper, we propose Glance-ETD, a two-stage token reduction framework guided by a lightweight question-conditioned scorer. In the first stage, a glance encoder views the image at low resolution and re-encodes only the question-relevant regions at native resolution. In the second stage, Evidence-Tempered Diversity (ETD) selects the final tokens by combining diversity with the evidence predicted by the scorer, so that the kept tokens cover the scene and retain the answer. A single-rollout self-distillation recipe trains the MLLM with the glance encoder. With only 5% of the visual tokens, Glance-ETD retains 91.6% of the full-token performance of Qwen3.5-4B across fourteen benchmarks and outperforms the strongest prior method, LT-OPD, by 17.3 points and the same training recipe with DivPrune by 6.0.
