It also speeds up the time to first token on 4K images by 3.1x and generalizes to three other MLLMs and to high-resolution document benchmarks, with the largest gains on text-rich tasks.

translation.title: 先一瞥再选择：面向极度压缩多模态 LLM 的证据调节视觉 token 选择
translation.abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）将高分辨率图像编码为数千个视觉 token，这些 token 主导了预填充阶段的成本。视觉 token 削减可移除其中大部分 token，但在极端预算下仍存在两个问题：视觉编码器仍需处理图像的每一个 patch，且幸存的少数 token 常常遗漏包含答案的小区域。本文提出 Glance-ETD，一个由轻量级问题条件化打分器引导的两阶段 token 削减框架。第一阶段中，一瞥编码器以低分辨率查看图像，并仅对与问题相关的区域以原生分辨率重新编码。第二阶段中，证据调节多样性（ETD）将多样性与打分器预测的证据相结合来选择最终 token，使保留的 token 既覆盖场景又保留答案。单次 rollout 的自蒸馏方案用于训练带有 glance 编码器的 MLLM。仅使用 5% 的视觉 token，Glance-ETD 在十四个基准上保留了 Qwen3.5-4B 全 token 性能的 91.6%，比最强先前方法 LT-OPD 高 17.3 分，比采用相同训练方案的 DivPrune 高 6.0 分。它还将 4K 图像的首 token 时间加速 3.1 倍，并能泛化到其他三个 MLLM 和高分辨率文档基准，在文本丰富的任务上增益最大。
translation.brief: 针对极端视觉 token 压缩下编码器仍处理全部 patch 且保留 token 易丢失答案区域的问题，提出两阶段 Glance-ETD 框架，用问题条件化打分器引导的证据调节多样性选择机制筛选 token。

papers.title: Offline-First Quantized AI: Design and Evaluation of an On-Device Maternal-Health Assistant for Low-Connectivity Environments
papers.abstract: Offline language models could extend access to maternal-health information where internet connectivity is unreliable, but deployment requires both clinically appropriate responses and feasible local execution. This study presents an offline Android assistant integrating ready-made quantized language models, a clinically validated local knowledge package, conversational context, and model-initiated local retrieval. Gemma 4 E2B and Qwen3.5 0.8B were compared across 45 conversations and 312 turns per configuration, including a dedicated offline agentic benchmark. Gemma achieved higher response-quality, context-retention, and safety scores; Qwen offered faster generation and lower memory use. Clinician assessment of 150 Gemma responses across nine clinical domains yielded a mean quality score of 3.80/4, with 147 responses meeting the acceptance criterion. A paired RAG-on/off experiment evaluated 74 questions: retrieval improved 11 responses, left 56 neutral, produced four adverse response changes, and left three pairs unassessable. RAG-on had descriptively higher mean usefulness, safety, correctness, and actionability in the conditional 70-pair subset excluding the four flagged pairs from both conditions. Physical-device testing demonstrated offline responses on a 6 GB Android handset, with a 14.3 s median latency, alongside successful reconnection synchronization in the integrated application. Together, the findings document clinical response quality and practical performance of the integrated offline maternal-health assistant.

translation.title: 离线优先的量化 AI：面向低连接环境的设备端孕产妇健康助手的设计与评估
translation.abstract: 离线语言模型可以在互联网连接不可靠的地区扩展孕产妇健康信息的获取，但部署既需要临床适宜的回答，也需要可行的本地执行。本研究提出一个离线 Android 助手，集成现成的量化语言模型、经临床验证的本地知识包、对话上下文以及模型发起的本地检索。Gemma 4 E2B 和 Qwen3.5 0.8B 在每种配置 45 段对话、312 轮的条件下进行比较，包括专门的离线 agentic 基准。Gemma 在回答质量、上下文保持和安全性上得分更高；Qwen 生成更快、内存占用更低。临床医生对 150 条 Gemma 跨九个临床领域的回答进行评估，平均质量分为 3.80/4，其中 147 条满足接受标准。一项配对的 RAG 开/关实验评估了 74 个问题：检索改进了 11 条回答，56 条无变化，产生了 4 条不良变化，3 对无法评估。在剔除 4 对被标记回答后的条件性 70 对子集中，RAG 开启时在有用性、安全性、正确性和可操作性上的均值描述性更高。物理设备测试证明了在 6 GB Android 手机上的离线回答能力，中位延迟为 14.3 秒，并实现了集成应用中成功的重连同步。这些发现共同记录了集成式离线孕产妇健康助手的临床回答质量和实际性能。
translation.brief: 针对低连接环境下孕产妇健康信息获取问题，设计集成量化离线语言模型与本地临床知识包及 RAG 检索的 Android 助手并进行临床与设备端评估。

papers.title: D'BEAST: Logged Bad Experiences as Explanation for Autonomous Driving Agents
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning agents learn from mistakes, yet their decisions can be difficult to trace back to those experiences. We investigate whether a tabular agent's decisions can be explained by its bad experiences, defined as the training transitions associated with safety or task events. A fixed training log is replayed from the same initial Q-table under three conditions. FULL retains all updates, SKIP omits bad-experience updates, and NEUTRALIZE retains those updates without their event penalties. We illustrate the method on six classic Markov decision processes and evaluate it in closed-loop driving in CARLA. On the full driving task, FULL reached the goal from 33 of 40 test starts, whereas SKIP and NEUTRALIZE reached it from none, indicating that the bad experiences carry decision-relevant information. At the local level, for 47 decisions shortly before a failure of SKIP or NEUTRALIZE, removing or neutralizing a small group of bad experiences, with a median size of one, caused the trained agent to select the failing policy's action in 46 cases. For this agent, the results indicate that its decisions can be explained by its bad experiences.

translation.title: D'BEAST：将已记录的不良经验作为自主驾驶智能体的解释
translation.abstract: 强化学习智能体从错误中学习，但其决策往往难以追溯到这些经验。我们研究表格型智能体的决策能否由其不良经验来解释，不良经验被定义为与安全或任务事件相关联的训练转移。我们从相同的初始Q表回放一份固定的训练日志，并在三种条件下进行：FULL保留所有更新，SKIP省略不良经验的更新，NEUTRALIZE保留这些更新但去除其事件惩罚。我们在六个经典马尔可夫决策过程上说明该方法，并在CARLA中于闭环驾驶中进行评估。在完整驾驶任务中，FULL在40个测试起点中的33个到达目标，而SKIP和NEUTRALIZE均无一到达，这表明不良经验携带与决策相关的信息。在局部层面，对于SKIP或NEUTRALIZE失败前不久的47个决策，移除或中和一小簇不良经验（中位数大小为1）会导致训练后的智能体在46个案例中选择失败策略的动作。对于该智能体而言，结果表明其决策可以由其不良经验来解释。
translation.brief: 解决强化学习驾驶智能体决策难以追溯的问题，通过回放训练日志并移除或中和不良经验来验证其是否构成决策的解释依据。

papers.title: The Grid's Own Language: A Common Information Model Layer for LLM Grid Assistants
papers.abstract: Assistants built on large language models (LLMs) are entering power system operation. Current designs delegate computations to validated solvers, but the agent still infers the type, role and state of each element from its name and tool-specific formats, and errors propagate to every study. The Common Information Model (CIM), the IEC standard in which operators already exchange network models, defines unambiguously what each element is and how it connects. We propose a CIM layer for LLM grid assistants and implement it in CONDUCTOR, an open-source assistant. Both the agent and its power-system studies read the layer. It labels the provenance of each fact (stated in the data, suggested only by a name, or inferred from topology), loads operators' CGMES models directly, and builds in $\leq$1\,s on the 9,241-bus PEGASE network. Deterministic checks compare every answer with solver results and the layer. On 37 tasks about the CIGRE medium-voltage and IEEE 30-bus networks, the agent gets right 97\,\% of the graded facts with the layer, such as a unit's energy source or a switch's normal state, against 55\,\% without it. We argue that a CIM layer should be a default component of grid assistants.

translation.title: 电网自身的语言：面向LLM电网助手的公共信息模型层
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的助手正在进入电力系统运行领域。当前设计将计算委托给经过验证的求解器，但智能体仍需从元素名称和工具特定格式中推断每个元素的类型、角色和状态，错误会传播到每项研究中。公共信息模型（CIM）是运营商已用于交换网络模型的IEC标准，它明确定义了每个元素是什么以及如何连接。我们为LLM电网助手提出一个CIM层，并在开源助手CONDUCTOR中实现。智能体及其电力系统研究都读取该层。它为每条事实标注来源（数据中明确给出、仅由名称暗示、或从拓扑推断），直接加载运营商的CGMES模型，并在9,241节点的PEGASE网络上以不超过1秒的时间构建。确定性检查将每个答案与求解器结果和该层进行对比。在关于CIGRE中压网络和IEEE 30节点网络的37项任务中，使用该层时智能体在分级事实（如机组的能源类型或开关的正常状态）上达到97%的正确率，而不用时仅为55%。我们主张CIM层应成为电网助手的默认组件。
translation.brief: 解决LLM电网助手仅凭名称和格式推断电网元素信息导致错误传播的问题，通过引入IEC CIM标准层为事实提供明确语义与来源标注。

papers.title: Towards Agentic Scientific Discovery in Distributed Systems
papers.abstract: We investigate when adaptive tool selection helps identify a shared equation across clients with different input coverage. Query-ATLAS (query-conditioned Agentic Tool-based Learning for Aggregating Symbolic Equations) uses an LLM to guide symbolic search from client errors and previous proposals in a simulated distributed system. A four-architecture comparison reveals task-dependent opportunities: relative to fixed PySR-LLM, validation acceptances rise from 3/12 to 7/12 on CRK3 and from 11/12 to 12/12 on oscillator2, while MatSci3 favors the fixed workflow. Across 72 settings in a post-hoc six-task subset of eight development tasks, Query-ATLAS achieves 64 validation and 64 in-distribution passes, versus 62 and 59 for the fixed workflow; both pass 47/60 eligible out-of-distribution tests. The fixed workflow retains lower median errors and cost. Broader query coverage emerges as a promising benefit, motivating task-aware tool selection and client-aware fitting for scientific agents.

translation.title: 迈向分布式系统中的智能体化科学发现
translation.abstract: 我们研究自适应工具选择何时有助于在具有不同输入覆盖范围的客户端之间识别共享方程。Query-ATLAS（查询条件化的智能体工具学习用于聚合符号方程）利用LLM在模拟分布式系统中根据客户端误差和先前提议引导符号搜索。四架构对比揭示了任务相关的机会：相对于固定的PySR-LLM，验证接受率在CRK3上从3/12升至7/12，在oscillator2上从11/12升至12/12，而MatSci3则更适合固定工作流。在八个开发任务的事后六任务子集的72种设置中，Query-ATLAS取得64次验证通过和64次分布内通过，而固定工作流分别为62和59；两者在60项符合条件的分布外测试中均通过47项。固定工作流保持更低的中位数误差和成本。更广的查询覆盖成为有前景的收益，促使为科学智能体设计任务感知的工具选择和客户端感知的拟合。
translation.brief: 解决多客户端分布式系统中跨不同输入覆盖识别共享符号方程的工具选择问题，提出由LLM引导条件化符号搜索的Query-ATLAS框架。

papers.title: The Hidden Methodological Layer: Uncovering Threats to Validity in LLM-Assisted Empirical Software Engineering
papers.abstract: Context: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded in empirical software engineering (ESE) workflows, supporting tasks such as classification, coding, extraction, synthesis, and evaluation. Their probabilistic and opaque behavior, however, introduces methodological concerns that may affect empirical rigor. Aims: This paper investigates threats to validity introduced by LLM-assisted empirical workflows and examines how LLM interactions influence empirical studies. Method: We conducted a secondary analysis of 50 primary studies comprising 69 LLM-assisted research tasks identified through a systematic literature review. We examined the extent to which LLM-related threats were reported, how these threats were characterized, and how they related to established validity dimensions. Results: LLM-related threats remain substantially underreported. We identified recurring threats including classification errors, prompt-dependent interpretation, workflow instability, evaluator bias, downstream propagation of outputs, and model dependence. These threats can affect multiple validity dimensions depending on where and how LLM outputs enter the workflow. Conclusion: We introduce the concept of hidden methodological layer as a conceptual lens for understanding how LLMs influence empirical software engineering workflows. We argue that rigorous LLM-assisted ESE requires making prompts, model configurations, interaction protocols, validation procedures, and downstream reuse of LLM-generated outputs visible as part of the research method.

translation.title: 隐藏的方法论层：揭示LLM辅助实证软件工程中的效度威胁
translation.abstract: 背景：大语言模型（LLM）日益嵌入实证软件工程（ESE）工作流，支持分类、编码、抽取、综合与评估等任务。然而其概率性和不透明的行为引入了可能影响实证严谨性的方法论问题。目标：本文研究LLM辅助实证工作流引入的效度威胁，并考察LLM交互如何影响实证研究。方法：我们通过系统文献综述对50项包含69个LLM辅助研究任务的一手研究进行二次分析。我们考察了LLM相关威胁被报告的程度、这些威胁如何被刻画，以及它们与既有效度维度的关系。结果：LLM相关威胁仍被大量低报。我们识别出反复出现的威胁，包括分类错误、依赖提示的解释、工作流不稳定、评估者偏见、输出的下游传播以及模型依赖。依据LLM输出进入工作流的位置和方式，这些威胁可能影响多个效度维度。结论：我们提出“隐藏方法论层”这一概念透镜，用于理解LLM如何影响实证软件工程工作流。我们主张，严谨的LLM辅助ESE需要将提示、模型配置、交互协议、验证程序以及LLM生成输出的下游复用作为研究方法的一部分加以显性化。
translation.brief: 解决LLM辅助实证软件工程中效度威胁被低报且缺乏系统认识的问题，通过对50项研究的二次分析归纳威胁类型并提出“隐藏方法论层”概念框架。

papers.title: EchoSpec: Training Search Agents to Weigh Evidence Above Echoes
papers.abstract: Search agents trained with reinforcement learning decide what to retrieve, when to search again, and when to answer. In real corpora, one claim is copied and paraphrased across many pages while the primary source settling a question appears once. We show that reinforcement-learned search agents grant echoes the credence of independent sources and lose their ability to abstain. Across five base models from 3B to 32B and seven released RL agents on multi-hop Wikipedia questions with primary evidence intact, eight paraphrased false-claim echoes overturn 58-73% of previously correct answers, while exact-match RL drives deleted-evidence abstention below 15%. Conditioning on retrieval localizes the failure to evidence acquisition: once primary evidence enters context, agents overrule eight echoes as reliably as one, whereas echoes fill top ranks and halt search early, so larger budgets, forced search turns, or passive passage filtering alone fail to recover displaced evidence. We introduce EchoSpec, specifying reliability across five corpus transformations with known target answers and training in two stages. Verification warm-start teaches multi-hop bridge-entity recovery past echoes, after which group RL optimizes an evidence-gated $\lambda$-reward with an outcome-independent acquisition bonus and scale-preserving advantages retaining the optimal rule $\lambda/(1+\lambda)$. Across Qwen2.5-3B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Llama-3.1-8B backbones on nine evaluation suites, EchoSpec cuts eight-echo deference by 30-44 points on Qwen2.5-7B down to 29-31%, nearly quadruples eight-echo reach to 26-27% with zero-shot transfer to unseen BGE and BM25 retrievers, and raises standalone QA precision to 47-55%. Code is publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: EchoSpec：训练搜索智能体在回声之上权衡证据
translation.abstract: 经强化学习训练的搜索智能体决定检索什么、何时再次搜索以及何时回答。在真实语料库中，同一论断被复制和改写于许多页面，而解决问题的关键一手来源只出现一次。我们表明，强化学习搜索智能体给予回声与独立来源同等的信任度，并丧失弃权能力。在从3B到32B的五个基础模型和七个已发布的RL智能体上，针对保留一手证据的多跳Wikipedia问题，八个改写的虚假论断回声推翻了58-73%原本正确的答案，而精确匹配的RL使证据被删除时的弃权率降至15%以下。以检索为条件可将失败定位于证据获取环节：一旦一手证据进入上下文，智能体推翻八个回声与推翻一个同样可靠；而回声占据前列排名并使搜索过早停止，因此仅靠更大预算、强制搜索轮次或被动式段落过滤无法找回被挤走的证据。我们提出EchoSpec，在五种已知目标答案的语料库变换上指定可靠性并分两阶段训练。验证热启动教会智能体跨回声恢复多跳桥接实体，随后组RL优化带结果无关获取奖励并保留最优规则λ/(1+λ)的尺度保持优势的证据门控λ-奖励。在Qwen2.5-3B、Qwen2.5-7B和Llama-3.1-8B骨干以及九个评估套件上，EchoSpec在Qwen2.5-7B上将八回声顺从降低30-44个百分点至29-31%，将八回声触及率近四倍提升至26-27%并零样本迁移到未见过的BGE和BM25检索器，同时将独立问答精度提升至47-55%。代码已在https URL公开。
translation.brief: 解决RL搜索智能体将重复出现的虚假论断回声误当独立证据并丧失弃权能力的问题，提出EchoSpec两阶段训练：验证热启动加证据门控λ-奖励的组RL，增强一手证据获取与可弃权性。

papers.title: IsaGraphLib: Formally Verified Efficient Graph Algorithms in Isabelle/HOL
papers.abstract: We present a library of formally verified graph algorithms in Isabelle/HOL. The library covers the main problems of combinatorial optimisation on graphs: reachability, shortest paths, minimum spanning trees, matching, maximum flow, and minimum-cost flow. The algorithms in the library use most of the standard algorithm design techniques: graph search, greedy algorithms on matroids, dynamic programming, augmenting paths, blossom contraction, blocking flows, push-relabel, scaling, the primal-dual method, randomisation, and certificate checking. The library has adaptors between different types of graphs (directed, undirected, multigraphs), which allow results to be reused. Each algorithm is verified independently of its data structures, and the main algorithms are refined to efficient imperative implementations, from which we generate code in Standard ML, Scala, and Go. We developed parts of the library with large language models (LLMs), improved the quality of their proofs with a method based on statistics of our own proofs, and labelled which parts were developed by humans, by LLMs, or collaboratively. We perform a detailed experimental analysis of representative algorithms in our library, comparing it with state-of-the-art mainstream libraries, showing that our implementations are practical.

translation.title: IsaGraphLib：Isabelle/HOL 中经过形式化验证的高效图算法
translation.abstract: 我们在 Isabelle/HOL 中构建了一个经过形式化验证的图算法库。该库涵盖了图上组合优化的主要问题：可达性、最短路径、最小生成树、匹配、最大流和最小费用流。库中的算法使用了大多数标准算法设计技术：图搜索、拟阵上的贪心算法、动态规划、增广路径、花收缩、阻塞流、push-relabel、缩放、原始-对偶方法、随机化以及证书检查。该库为不同类型的图（有向图、无向图、多重图）提供了适配器，从而可以复用各种结果。每个算法的验证都独立于其数据结构，并且主要算法被精化（refine）为高效的命令式实现，我们据此生成 Standard ML、Scala 和 Go 代码。我们利用大语言模型（LLM）开发了该库的部分内容，通过一种基于我们自己证明统计数据的方法提升了其证明质量，并标注了哪些部分由人类、LLM 或二者协作开发。我们对库中代表性算法进行了详细的实验分析，与最先进的主流库进行比较，结果表明我们的实现是实用的。
translation.brief: 该论文形式化验证了一整套高效图算法并生成可用代码，通过数据结构无关的验证与精化方法解决形式化验证与实际性能脱节的问题。

papers.title: A Dataset for Misogyny Detection in Polish Social Media: Transferability of Hateful Speech Detection from General to Specific Types of Hate
papers.abstract: Harmful language detection is commonly evaluated on broadly defined hate speech and toxicity benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether models that successfully detect harmful language in general can transfer this capability to more specific forms of hate. We investigate this problem for misogyny detection in Polish, an area for which dedicated resources remain scarce. We introduce a new dataset of Polish social media comments annotated for misogyny, gender-directed hateful speech. Using this resource, we first assess the reliability of LLM-assisted annotation and then evaluate general-to-specific transfer by comparing models trained on general harmful language data, safety-specialized models, and models fine-tuned directly for misogyny detection. Our results show that strong performance on general harmful language detection does not transfer uniformly to misogyny; safety-specialized models demonstrate substantially stronger generalization ability. The study contributes a new Polish resource for gender-directed harmful language and demonstrates that the scope and granularity of prior safety training are important factors in transferring harmful language detection from general to specific forms of hate.

translation.title: 波兰社交媒体厌女内容检测数据集：从一般仇恨言论检测到特定仇恨类型的可迁移性
translation.abstract: 有害语言检测通常在宽泛定义的仇恨言论和毒性基准上进行评估，然而，能够成功检测一般有害语言的模型是否能将这种能力迁移到更具体的仇恨形式，仍不清楚。我们针对波兰语厌女内容检测研究这一问题，该领域的专用资源仍然稀缺。我们引入了一个新的波兰语社交媒体评论数据集，针对厌女（即针对性别的仇恨言论）进行了标注。利用这一资源，我们首先评估了 LLM 辅助标注的可靠性，然后通过比较在一般有害语言数据上训练的模型、安全专精模型以及直接针对厌女检测微调的模型，评估从一般到特定的迁移能力。结果表明，在一般有害语言检测上的强大性能并不能均匀地迁移到厌女检测；安全专精模型表现出明显更强的泛化能力。本研究贡献了一个新的针对性别有害语言的波兰语资源，并证明此前安全训练的范围和粒度是将有害语言检测从一般形式迁移到特定仇恨形式的重要因素。
translation.brief: 该论文构建了波兰语社交媒体厌女内容标注数据集，用以评估一般有害语言检测能力向特定仇恨类型迁移的效果。

papers.title: Security of Deep Research Agents: Attack Surface, Defenses, Benchmarks, and Agenda Seeding against Research Planning
papers.abstract: Deep research and agentic search agents autonomously retrieve content from the open web and generate reports with citations, and their outputs are often taken directly as research conclusions. This paper systematizes security research in this area along four stages, namely retrieval, planning, evidence integration, and report generation. We present a unified threat model, a taxonomy of attacks and defenses, and a review of evaluation benchmarks, and we align the area dimension by dimension with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) poisoning, prompt injection, and generative engine optimization (GEO). Coding 34 primary studies shows that only 26.5% of them involve the planning stage, and none performs an end-to-end poisoning evaluation on commercial products. To address this gap, we propose the agenda seeding attack, in which the attacker writes no instructions and only introduces a fictitious evaluation metric. Across 3,520 sandboxed research runs under the same budget, GEO and prompt injection are nearly ineffective, whereas agenda seeding makes the attacker's target the top pick in 16% to 28% of reports. Injection detection and query anchoring fail against it, verification prompting hurts utility, and our proposed provenance tagging preserves utility but can be bypassed by multi-site bait. Finally, we propose eight research directions.

translation.title: 深度研究智能体的安全性：攻击面、防御、基准与针对研究规划的议程植入
translation.abstract: 深度研究与智能体搜索系统自主地从开放网络检索内容并生成带引用的报告，其输出常被直接当作研究结论。本文沿四个阶段系统化梳理了这一领域的安全研究，即检索、规划、证据整合和报告生成。我们提出了统一的威胁模型、攻击与防御的分类体系，并综述了评估基准，同时在各个维度上将其与检索增强生成（RAG）投毒、提示注入和生成式引擎优化（GEO）进行对齐。对 34 项原始研究的编码分析表明，只有 26.5% 涉及规划阶段，且没有任何研究对商业产品进行端到端投毒评估。为填补这一空白，我们提出议程植入攻击，攻击者不书写任何指令，仅引入一个虚构的评估指标。在同等预算下的 3,520 次沙箱研究运行中，GEO 和提示注入几乎无效，而议程植入使攻击者的目标在 16% 到 28% 的报告中成为首选。注入检测和查询锚定对其无效，验证式提示损害实用性，而我们提出的来源标注在保持实用性的同时可被多站点诱饵绕过。最后，我们提出了八个研究方向。
translation.brief: 该论文系统化梳理深度研究智能体的安全研究，并提出仅靠虚构评估指标就能操纵研究规划的议程植入攻击及其防御分析。

papers.title: The Frontier Must Grow - Self-proposed, interpreter-labelled training roughly doubles a 4B model's accuracy on a fresh exam as its verified frontier grows
papers.abstract: A model can learn from problems it poses itself when an executable oracle supplies the answers. Qwen3-4B proposed Lua 5.1 programs; those it predicted wrong at least once in four samples joined a pool labelled by the interpreter, each round adding twice as many programs as the last (300, 900, 2100 in total), and each round trained a fresh adapter from the base on the pool. On the original exam the procedure met its registered criterion, an item-level test of each adapter against its predecessor. On a 2340-item exam drawn afterwards, accuracy rose from 8.3% to 16.7%; that follow-up's registered criteria were not met because round 1 gained nothing, while rounds 2 and 3 added 5.0 and 2.9 points on average, both intervals above zero. One fit on the same amount of base-proposed frontier data reached 14.6%, so the rounds' 2.1-point advantage is inconclusive. Three earlier registered series met no per-lineage criterion, and the same loop showed no gain on repository tasks or for a 27B agent in those configurations.

translation.title: 前沿必须增长——随着经过验证的前沿不断扩大，自提出、解释器标注的训练使 4B 模型在新考试上的准确率大约翻倍
translation.abstract: 当可执行的神谕（oracle）提供答案时，模型可以从自己提出的问题中学习。Qwen3-4B 提出 Lua 5.1 程序；其中在四次采样中至少有一次预测错误的程序进入由解释器标注的题池，每轮新增的程序数量翻倍（总计 300、900、2100），并且每轮都从基础模型出发在题池上训练一个全新的适配器。在原始考试中，该流程达到了其注册的判据，即对每个适配器与其前代进行题目级测试。在随后抽取的 2340 题考试中，准确率从 8.3% 升至 16.7%；该后续测试未达到其注册判据，因为第 1 轮没有收益，而第 2 和第 3 轮平均分别带来 5.0 和 2.9 点的增益，两个区间均大于零。仅用相同数量的基础模型提出的前沿数据进行一次拟合达到 14.6%，因此各轮次 2.1 点的优势尚无定论。三个此前的注册系列未达到任何按谱系的判据，且同样的循环在仓库任务或 27B 智能体的这些配置中没有收益。
translation.brief: 该论文用模型自生成程序、解释器标注答案的迭代训练方法，提升小型模型在自出题考试上的准确率。

papers.title: Turning Errors into Successes: Designing LLM Tutoring Around Scaffolded Error Correction
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) could make personalized tutoring available at scale, but it remains unclear how they can best support the instructional processes that make one-on-one instruction effective. We compared two ways of using LLMs after students make errors: providing personalized explanations of those errors, or engaging students in additional cycles of scaffolded practice and feedback, with a Socratic tutor guiding students toward the correct answer. In a preregistered online experiment, 400 adults practiced setting up constraint equations and, after each attempt, received the correct answer, a generic explanation, a personalized LLM explanation of their error, or Socratic tutoring. Socratic tutoring helped: participants resolved 64% of their errors through the dialogue and scored 0.24 SD higher on practice-aligned posttest questions than those who received generic or personalized explanations. Socratic participants also found the session more interesting, less frustrating, and less costly, even though it took nearly twice as long. In contrast, we found no evidence of a benefit of personalized explanations over generic ones, and neither type of explanation reliably outperformed simply seeing the correct answer. These findings suggest that LLM tutors may add the most value not by explaining errors more precisely but by helping students correct those errors themselves through scaffolded practice. This pattern fits a mastery-experience account of tutoring, in which an effective tutor notices when a student is struggling, steps in with guidance, and works with the student until the struggle resolves into success. AI tutors may be most effective when designed around this principle.

translation.title: 化错误为成功：围绕脚手架式纠错设计 LLM 辅导
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以使个性化辅导大规模普及，但尚不清楚它们如何最好地支持那些使一对一教学有效的教学过程。我们比较了学生在出错后使用 LLM 的两种方式：对错误提供个性化解释，或让学生参与额外的脚手架式练习与反馈循环，由苏格拉底式导师引导学生走向正确答案。在一项预注册的在线实验中，400 名成年人练习建立约束方程，并在每次尝试后收到正确答案、通用解释、对其错误的个性化 LLM 解释，或苏格拉底式辅导。苏格拉底式辅导有所帮助：参与者通过对话解决了 64% 的错误，在练习对应的后期测试中得分比接受通用或个性化解释的参与者高 0.24 个标准差。苏格拉底式辅导的参与者还认为课程更有趣、更少挫败感、代价更低，尽管其耗时几乎翻倍。相比之下，我们没有发现个性化解释优于通用解释的证据，且两种解释都不能可靠地胜过仅仅看到正确答案。这些发现表明，LLM 辅导者的最大价值可能不在于更精确地解释错误，而在于通过脚手架式练习帮助学生自己纠正错误。这一模式契合辅导的掌握经验（mastery-experience）理论：有效的导师注意到学生陷入困境，提供指导介入，并与学生合作直到困境化为成功。围绕这一原则设计的 AI 辅导可能最为有效。
translation.brief: 该论文通过预注册实验证明 LLM 苏格拉底式脚手架纠错辅导比个性化错误解释更能提升学生的学习效果。

papers.title: Mandarin Wh-Indefinites Follow Nonveridicality in Multilingual LLMs, Unlike English any
papers.abstract: Multilingual LLMs learn mostly from English. Do they carry English polarity licensing over to other languages? English any is licensed by downward-entailing (DE) contexts, Mandarin wh-indefinites such as shenme 'what/something' by nonveridical ones, and the two classes come apart: perhaps licenses shenme but not any, while only licenses any but entails existence. We test this dissociation in a pre-registered study of twelve open LLMs (0.5B-9B, four families), using 48 matched bilingual frames in 21 contexts and a log-probability difference-in-differences normalised by negation. All 11 models that pass the measurement gate license Mandarin wh-indefinites under possibility, necessity and evidential adverbs, at 0.42-2.33 times the strength of negation, while English any gets nothing in the same contexts. An exploratory extension to Qwen2.5-32B shows the same. The English side is weaker: any under only, first and regret is licensed but at a fraction of negation, so only 3 models show the full double dissociation in sentence probabilities. When prompted to choose between sentences, most gated models show it. In exploratory directional ablations, a direction that carries English licensing, held-out classes included, does not reach Mandarin licensing in most models. The models do not simply apply the English rule to Mandarin.

translation.title: 多语言LLM中普通话wh-不定代词遵循非真实性许可，而英语any则不然
translation.abstract: 多语言LLM的训练数据以英语为主。它们是否将英语的极性许可规则迁移到了其他语言？英语的any由向下蕴涵（DE）语境许可，普通话的wh-不定代词（如shenme'什么/某个'）由非真实性（nonveridical）语境许可，这两类语境并不重合：perhaps（也许）许可shenme但不许可any，而only（只有）许可any却蕴涵存在。我们通过一项预注册研究，在12个开源LLM（0.5B-9B，四个模型家族）上检验了这种分离，使用48个匹配的双语框架、21种语境，以及经否定归一化的对数概率双重差分方法。所有通过测量门槛的11个模型都在可能性、必然性和证据副词下许可普通话wh-不定代词，强度为否定语境的0.42-2.33倍，而英语any在相同语境下毫无许可。对Qwen2.5-32B的探索性扩展显示出同样的结果。英语一侧较弱：any在only、first和regret下虽被许可但仅为否定语境的一部分强度，因此只有3个模型在句子概率上表现出完全的双重分离。当让模型在句子间做选择时，大多数通过门槛的模型表现出了这种分离。在探索性的方向消融实验中，承载英语许可的方向（包括留出的类别）在大多数模型中并不能触及普通话的许可机制。可见，模型并非简单地将英语规则套用到普通话上。
translation.brief: 研究多语言LLM是否将英语极性词any的许可规则错误迁移到普通话wh-不定代词，通过双语匹配框架和对数概率差分测量发现两种语言遵循不同的许可条件。

papers.title: Decode Early, Verify Late: Streaming Offline Speech Recognizers Without Accuracy Loss
papers.abstract: Voice agents need accurate transcripts soon after a user stops speaking. We propose Decode Early, Verify Late (DEVL), a training-free framework for streaming inference with offline ASR models. The server keeps partial transcripts as drafts and verifies the latest against the complete audio in one forward pass at turn end. Under stated input and decoding conditions, the final equals the model's greedy offline output in exact arithmetic. We adapt DEVL to four model families. In our five-recognizer comparison, 95-100% of final transcripts are byte-identical to the offline transcripts, WER stays within 0.13 points of offline, and single-stream time to final falls 1.5-7.3x. Serving Qwen3-ASR-1.7B on one A100, DEVL returns finals a median 22-26 ms after turn end at up to 64 streams, 2.7-3.9x sooner than the official streaming mode. It is the only system we tested that meets a 100 ms p99 target, up to 80 streams on Pipecat-STT and 64 on WildASR.

translation.title: 早解码、晚验证：不损失精度的流式离线语音识别器
translation.abstract: 语音代理需要在用户停止说话后尽快给出准确的转写结果。我们提出Decode Early, Verify Late（DEVL），一个无需训练的框架，使离线ASR模型能够进行流式推理。服务器将部分转写作为草稿保留，并在轮次结束时通过一次前向传播将其与完整音频进行验证。在给定的输入和解码条件下，最终结果在精确算术意义上等于模型的贪心离线输出。我们将DEVL适配到四个模型家族。在五识别器对比中，95-100%的最终转写与离线转写字节完全一致，WER与离线的差距在0.13点以内，单流最终结果时间下降1.5-7.3倍。在一块A100上服务Qwen3-ASR-1.7B时，DEVL在轮次结束后的中位22-26毫秒内返回最终结果（最多64流），比官方流式模式快2.7-3.9倍。它是我们测试中唯一满足100毫秒p99目标的系统，在Pipecat-STT上支持最多80流，在WildASR上支持64流。
translation.brief: 提出无需训练的DEVL框架，通过保留草稿并在语音结束后单次前向验证，让离线ASR模型实现无精度损失的流式低延迟推理。

papers.title: Consensus-based Economic Dispatch for Self-organized Local Energy Communities
papers.abstract: The increasing penetration of distributed energy resources (DERs) is transforming traditional distribution networks into dynamic, decentralized systems, creating a pressing need for scalable, autonomous coordination mechanisms that do not rely on centralized control or full system observability. In particular, local energy communities need to self-organize and coordinate energy schedules while respecting network constraints, especially voltage limits, despite lacking detailed knowledge of the distribution grid's topology and parameters. Existing distributed optimization approaches either neglect such physical constraints or assume perfect knowledge of the network model. This paper addresses the Voltage-Constrained Economic Dispatch (VCED) problem in a fully decentralized, consensus-based manner, without any coordinating entity. We use sparse-group LASSO regression to learn a linear surrogate of nodal voltages from local power and voltage measurements alone. The surrogate serves a dual purpose: it enters each agent's local problem as a voltage penalty and induces the communication graph over which the agents reach consensus. We provide a theoretical bound on the optimality loss caused by the surrogate voltage estimator inaccuracy. Our numerical results, on an IEEE-33 network, show that the scheme reduces the share of bus-timesteps voltage violations from 30\% to below 3\%, while staying within 1\% of a centralized benchmark computed with full network knowledge. We further quantify how the sparsity of the communication graph affects both the optimality gap and the residual violations.

translation.title: 面向自组织本地能源社区的基于共识的经济调度
translation.abstract: 分布式能源资源（DER）渗透率的提高正在使传统配电网转变为动态、去中心化的系统，迫切需要可扩展、自主且不依赖集中控制或全局可观测性的协调机制。尤其是本地能源社区需要在缺乏配电网拓扑和参数详细信息的情况下自组织并协调能源调度，同时遵守网络约束，特别是电压限制。现有的分布式优化方法要么忽视这类物理约束，要么假设对网络模型有完全的了解。本文以完全去中心化、基于共识的方式解决电压约束经济调度（VCED）问题，无需任何协调实体。我们使用稀疏群组LASSO回归，仅从本地功率和电压测量中学习节点电压的线性代理模型。该代理模型具有双重作用：既作为电压惩罚项进入每个代理的本地问题，又诱导代理间达成共识的通信图。我们为代理电压估计不准确导致的最优性损失提供了理论界。在IEEE-33网络上的数值结果显示，该方案将母线-时刻电压越限占比从30%降至3%以下，同时保持在基于完整网络知识的集中式基准的1%以内。我们还量化了通信图稀疏性对最优性间隙和残余越限的影响。
translation.brief: 提出完全去中心化的共识经济调度方案，用稀疏群组LASSO从本地测量学习电压代理模型，兼作电压惩罚和通信图诱导，解决电压约束下的能源社区协调问题。

papers.title: The Silent Cost of Conversation History in LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) in multi-turn information systems accumulate their own earlier replies and a growing task state. We asked whether this conversation history lowers accuracy, and whether process-level quality metrics warn before it does. Each analysis was fixed before its outcomes were computed. In Study 1, on 48 sharded math tasks, retaining its replies lowered final success by 0.21 for GPT-4o-mini and 0.29 for Mistral-7B (Holm-adjusted p = 0.026 and 0.004); Llama-4 Scout showed the same direction, not significant. Study 2 introduces CDR-Stream, 100-turn state-tracking dialogues with an exact answer per turn and per-model difficulty calibration. With the full history, accuracy fell from about 0.6 to 0.1 within twenty turns at matched difficulty, whereas a solver-verified state summary kept it 0.52-0.59 higher (Holm-adjusted p less than 0.001). Consistency and logical coherence fell far less than accuracy, and stability rose. None of these metrics, a paired readiness measure or calibrated single-stream drift detectors gave robust, model-general early warning, although in Study 2 the repeat-based metrics were complete only for GPT-4o-mini. In the monitors we tested, a single 100-turn stream had power only for very large drops. Systems built on LLMs should keep task state outside the transcript and monitor across sessions.

translation.title: LLM推理中对话历史的隐性代价
translation.abstract: 多轮信息系统中的大语言模型（LLM）会积累自己先前的回复和不断增长的任务状态。我们考察这种对话历史是否会降低准确率，以及过程级质量指标能否在准确率下降前发出预警。每项分析均在其结果计算前预先固定。研究1中，在48个分片数学任务上，保留自身回复使GPT-4o-mini的最终成功率降低0.21，Mistral-7B降低0.29（Holm校正p=0.026和0.004）；Llama-4 Scout呈相同方向但不显著。研究2引入CDR-Stream：100轮状态跟踪对话，每轮有精确答案并进行按模型难度校准。在完整历史下，同等难度时准确率在二十轮内从约0.6降至0.1，而使用求解器验证的状态摘要可将准确率保持高出0.52-0.59（Holm校正p<0.001）。一致性和逻辑连贯性的下降远小于准确率，稳定性反而上升。这些指标、一个成对就绪度度量以及校准的单流漂移检测器均无法提供稳健、跨模型的可靠早期预警，尽管在研究2中基于重复的指标仅对GPT-4o-mini完整。在我们测试的监控器中，单条100轮流仅对极大幅度的下降有检出能力。基于LLM构建的系统应将任务状态保存在对话记录之外，并跨会话进行监控。
translation.brief: 实证研究对话历史积累如何降低LLM多轮推理准确率，发现现有过程级质量指标无法提前预警，建议将任务状态外置于对话记录。

papers.title: SGIP: Learning Scene-Grounded Interaction Priors for Scene-Aware Human Motion Prediction
papers.abstract: Human motion prediction (HMP) aims to forecast future movement from an observed motion sequence, and recent methods have incorporated 3D scene geometry and object semantics to improve long-term plausibility. However, the destination of future motion remains ambiguous in cluttered scenes: the same observed motion can lead to different interaction targets or navigation modes. Existing methods either handle this ambiguity implicitly or rely on auxiliary signals like gaze that are hard to obtain in practice. To address this, we propose SGIP, which explicitly predicts where in the scene future motion will be grounded across both objects and open navigation regions, and uses it to condition future trajectory and full-body pose prediction. This scene-grounded interaction prior is learned via intent distillation: at training time only, a teacher model scores candidate scene regions by combining an LLM prompted with a textual description of the person's intent with geometric motion-scene features. A student model learns to reproduce these scores from only the observed motion and 3D scene, making intent and LLM unnecessary at test time. Across multiple benchmark datasets, SGIP outperforms prior scene-aware baselines on both trajectory and pose accuracy in a realistic deployment setting where neither gaze nor intent is available at inference, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed framework. The project page is available at this https URL.

translation.title: SGIP：学习场景接地的交互先验用于场景感知人体运动预测
translation.abstract: 人体运动预测（HMP）旨在从观测到的运动序列预测未来动作，近期方法已引入3D场景几何与物体语义以提升长期合理性。然而在杂乱场景中未来运动的目的地仍是模糊的：相同的观测运动可能导向不同的交互目标或导航模式。现有方法要么隐式处理这种模糊性，要么依赖实际中难以获得的凝视等辅助信号。为此，我们提出SGIP，显式预测未来运动将在场景中的何处接地——既包括物体也包括开放导航区域——并以此条件化未来的轨迹和全身姿态预测。这一场景接地交互先验通过意图蒸馏学习：仅在训练时，教师模型将LLM（以人物意图文本描述为提示）与几何的运动-场景特征结合，对候选场景区域进行打分；学生模型仅凭观测运动和3D场景学习复现这些分数，使测试时无需意图和LLM。在多个基准数据集上，SGIP在推理时既无凝视也无意图的现实部署设定下，在轨迹和姿态精度上均超越先前场景感知基线，验证了所提框架的有效性。项目页面见此https链接。
translation.brief: 提出SGIP框架，通过意图蒸馏显式预测未来运动在场景中的接地位置（物体与开放区域），以条件化轨迹和姿态预测解决杂乱场景中运动目的地的歧义问题。

papers.title: Infrastructure-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Attention for Highway Ramp Merging
papers.abstract: On-ramp merging is a typical safety and throughput problem on highways. Without proper coordination, human drivers and self-interested autonomous vehicles may make risky manoeuvres and cause accidents or congestion. With recent advances in connected autonomous vehicles (CAVs) and multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), vehicles can be trained to coordinate for safe and efficient merging. However, in dense traffic, forming an effective observation of the traffic state is challenging. For example, observing only the neighbouring vehicles may lead to locally optimal decisions, while observing the entire traffic can introduce much irrelevant information. In this paper, we propose a transformer-based MARL vehicle control model to address these problems. A roadside infrastructure controller receives the states of all CAVs via vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) communication and sends control commands back to them. An attention-based observation encoder is designed where each vehicle can filter the relevant vehicle information from the global traffic state. The proposed model is evaluated in SUMO against three baselines: a model that observes only the neighbouring vehicles, a model that encodes the global traffic information, and the rule-based SUMO model. The results show that our model achieves the highest traffic flow, safety and smoothness. Furthermore, in a four-hour simulation with dynamic traffic demand, our model successfully avoids traffic jams, while other baseline models fail at high traffic flow. We also show that our model remains effective when human-driven vehicles are present. We further show that our model, trained in ideal communication conditions, can still remain collision-free and maintain throughput under realistic V2I communication errors. Finally, we visualise the relevance weights that an ego vehicle assigns to other vehicles in multiple traffic situations.

translation.title: 基于基础设施与注意力机制的多智能体强化学习用于高速公路匝道合流
translation.abstract: 匝道合流是高速公路上典型的安全与通行效率问题。缺乏合理协调时，人类驾驶员和自利的自动驾驶车辆可能做出危险操作，导致事故或拥堵。随着车联网自动驾驶车辆(CAV)和多智能体强化学习(MARL)的最新进展，可以训练车辆实现安全高效的合流协调。然而，在密集交通中构建有效的交通状态观测极具挑战性。例如，仅观测邻近车辆可能导致局部最优决策，而观测整个交通状况又会引入大量无关信息。本文提出一种基于transformer的MARL车辆控制模型来解决这些问题。路侧基础设施控制器通过车路协同(V2I)通信接收所有CAV的状态，并向其回传控制指令。我们设计了基于注意力的观测编码器，使每辆车能够从全局交通状态中过滤出相关车辆信息。该模型在SUMO中与三个基线进行对比评估：仅观测邻近车辆的模型、编码全局交通信息的模型以及基于规则的SUMO模型。结果显示我们的模型在交通流量、安全性和平顺性方面均达到最优。此外，在动态交通需求的四小时仿真中，我们的模型成功避免了交通拥堵，而其他基线模型在高流量下均失效。我们还证明模型在存在人类驾驶车辆时依然有效。进一步地，在理想通信条件下训练的模型，在真实V2I通信误差下仍能保持零碰撞并维持通行量。最后，我们可视化了自车在多种交通场景下分配给其他车辆的相关性权重。
translation.brief: 针对密集交通下匝道合流观测难以构建的问题，提出基于transformer的MARL模型，用路侧基础设施收集全局状态并通过注意力编码器过滤相关车辆信息以协调车辆合流。

papers.title: FRAAC: A French Multimodal Large Language Model and Dataset forPictogram-Based Augmentative and Alternative Communication
papers.abstract: Pictograms are a core modality in augmentative and alternative communication (AAC), yet recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) cannot reliably interpret or produce pictogram sequences. Two obstacles explain this gap: the absence of a standardized pictogram grammar and the scarcity of parallel text-pictogram data. We introduce Retrieval-Augmented Pictogram Selection (RAPS), an annotation method that refines a rule-based transcription system's output with LLM-based concept extraction and retrieval over a pictogram vocabulary, handling cases where hand-written rules fail (named entities, numbers, polysemous words) without requiring new rules. Applied to French, RAPS yields a synthetic corpus of 1.4 million parallel pairs, of which 300k are publicly released. In a human ranking study where annotators order four pictogram transcriptions of the same sentence, RAPS outperforms the rule-based state of the art. Moreover, we show that standard reference-based metrics separate systems of clearly different quality but fail to rank strong systems against each other. Finally, we build an instruction-tuned model that supports interaction in several AAC modalities: it accepts pictogram or text input and answers in pictograms, speech, or text.

translation.title: FRAAC：面向基于象形图辅助沟通的法语多模态大语言模型与数据集
translation.abstract: 象形图是辅助沟通(AAC)的核心模态，然而近期的多模态大语言模型(MLLM)尚无法可靠地解读或生成象形图序列。造成这一差距的两个障碍是：缺乏标准化的象形图语法，以及文本-象形图平行数据的稀缺。我们提出了检索增强象形图选择(Retrieval-Augmented Pictogram Selection, RAPS)，这是一种标注方法，通过基于LLM的概念抽取和在象形图词表上的检索来改进基于规则的转录系统的输出，无需编写新规则即可处理手写规则失效的情况(命名实体、数字、多义词)。将RAPS应用于法语，生成了140万对平行语料的合成语料库，其中30万对已公开发布。在一项人类排序研究中，标注者对同一句子的四种象形图转录进行排序，RAPS优于基于规则的现有最佳方法。此外，我们表明标准的基于参考的指标能够区分质量差异明显的系统，却无法在强系统之间做出排序。最后，我们构建了一个指令微调模型，支持多种AAC模态的交互：它接受象形图或文本输入，并以象形图、语音或文本作答。
translation.brief: 针对象形图缺乏标准语法与平行数据稀缺的问题，提出RAPS方法结合LLM概念抽取与检索生成大规模法语平行语料，并构建支持多模态AAC交互的指令微调模型。

papers.title: Making Preemption Productive in Long-Output LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Reasoning LLMs generate long outputs whose key--value (KV) caches occupy GPU memory for minutes. When memory fills, the server preempts requests, and a preempted request can repeatedly lose and recover its state while producing little new output. We call this behavior KV thrashing. In certain cases, existing systems leave more than a fifth of requests stalled for over a minute. Because preemption cannot be avoided without delaying admission, we ask how to make it productive. We present Stint, a serving system that preserves a preempted request's work, bounds how long it waits, and gives it fresh output after it returns. Stint stores fixed-length KV snapshots in a contiguity-first CPU pool with an exact-extent allocator, and moves them with fused K/V gather/scatter kernels and double buffering. Age-based readmission brings stalled requests back, and protection gives them a turn of fresh decoding before another preemption. Remaining-length estimates from decoding hidden states guide victim selection. On olympiad-math replays with Qwen3-32B on H200 GPUs, no request pauses for more than 50 seconds under Stint and p99 time per output token falls by 50.7\% relative to recomputation in the same engine. The replay as a whole finishes 10.7\% sooner (12.0\% higher throughput), because the requests that baselines starve no longer finish last.

translation.title: 让抢占在长输出LLM服务中变得高效
translation.abstract: 推理型LLM生成的长输出其键值(KV)缓存会在GPU内存中占用数分钟。当内存耗尽时，服务端会抢占请求，而被抢占的请求可能在几乎不产生新输出的情况下反复丢失和恢复其状态。我们将这种行为称为KV抖动(KV thrashing)。在某些情况下，现有系统会让超过五分之一的请求停滞超过一分钟。由于不推迟请求接纳就无法避免抢占，我们思考如何让抢占变得高效。我们提出Stint，一个能够保留被抢占请求的工作成果、限制其等待时间并在其返回后给予新输出的服务系统。Stint将定长KV快照存储在以连续性优先的CPU池中，并使用精确范围分配器，通过融合的K/V gather/scatter内核和双缓冲来移动数据。基于年龄的重新准入使停滞的请求重新获得服务，保护机制则让它们在被再次抢占前获得一轮全新解码。基于解码隐状态的剩余长度估计指导受害者选择。在H200 GPU上使用Qwen3-32B进行奥数题重放实验中，Stint下没有任何请求暂停超过50秒，与同一引擎中的重计算方式相比，p99每输出token时间下降50.7%。整个重放提前10.7%完成(吞吐量提高12.0%)，因为被基线饿死的请求不再最后完成。
translation.brief: 针对LLM服务中长输出请求因内存抢占反复丢失状态造成停滞的问题，提出Stint系统，通过CPU侧KV快照保留、基于年龄的重新准入与保护机制，使抢占后的请求能高效恢复并产生新输出。

papers.title: SAFER: Navigating the Exploration-Exploitation Dilemma in World-Model-Based Planning for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: An autonomous vehicle must foresee the consequences of its actions, especially in the rare, time-critical situations where crashes happen. A world model offers this foresight, but only within the coverage of its training data, which poses an exploration-exploitation dilemma. Within this coverage a planner can hardly improve on the data, and beyond it the model's errors mislead it. Logs of competent driving rarely contain the failures that would widen the coverage, and agents that learn from interaction gain them only by failing themselves, without being shown what to do instead. We propose SAFER, a framework that learns offline from failures that others make, judged by an expert, and keeps learning online from its own driving. Offline, partially trained agents and scripted, recoverable perturbations Stage failures in simulation, and an expert Annotates every visited state with its action and value, so that much of what the planner explores is covered before it drives. In planning, a chunked latent world model Foresees the consequences fast enough for real-time use, and a risk-aware sampling-based planner Evaluates candidate maneuvers by their return minus a bounded collision penalty. Online, a loop continuously Refines the model wherever this driving leaves the coverage of the offline data. In closed-loop evaluation against the compared methods, SAFER reaches the highest route completion and reward per step on the CARLA Leaderboard routes, 0.95 and 0.77 from a privileged bird's-eye view, and the highest episode reward in MetaDrive, 53.4 in regular and 49.0 in safety-critical traffic. Project page: this https URL.

translation.title: SAFER：在世界模型自动驾驶规划中应对探索-利用困境
translation.abstract: 自动驾驶车辆必须预见其行为的后果，尤其是在发生事故的罕见、时间紧迫的情境中。世界模型可以提供这种预见能力，但仅限于其训练数据的覆盖范围之内，这带来了探索-利用困境。在覆盖范围内，规划器难以超越数据本身；超出覆盖范围时，模型的误差又会误导规划。优秀驾驶的日志很少包含能扩大覆盖范围的失败案例，而通过交互学习的智能体只有通过自身失败才能获得这些经验，却不知道正确的做法。我们提出SAFER框架，从他人被专家评判的失败中离线学习，并在自身驾驶过程中持续在线学习。离线阶段，通过部分训练的智能体和脚本化的可恢复扰动在仿真中制造失败场景，由专家对每个访问过的状态标注其动作和价值，使规划器探索的大部分场景在真实驾驶前已被覆盖。在规划阶段，分块的潜在世界模型足以实时快速预见行为后果，风险感知的基于采样的规划器通过收益减去有界碰撞惩罚来评估候选机动。在线阶段，一个循环在驾驶超出离线数据覆盖范围之处持续精化模型。在与对比方法的闭环评估中，SAFER在CARLA Leaderboard路线上以特权鸟瞰视角取得了最高的路线完成率和每步奖励(0.95和0.77)，并在MetaDrive中取得最高的回合奖励(常规交通53.4，安全关键交通49.0)。项目页面：this https URL。
translation.brief: 针对世界模型规划中的探索-利用困境，提出SAFER框架，通过离线利用专家标注的他人失败场景扩大数据覆盖，并结合在线持续精化的分块潜在世界模型与风险感知规划器进行实时驾驶规划。

papers.title: CECAR: Cache & Expert Co-Aware Routing Accelerates On-Device Inference of MoE LLMs
papers.abstract: Despite growing interest in on-device LLM deployment, large-scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models remain impractical on resource-constrained devices, as sparse expert activation still requires all expert weights to be memory-resident. To address this, we identify three key observations for on-device MoE inference: (a) cache hit rates are fundamentally bounded even under Belady's optimal policy; (b) these bounds are insufficient for low-latency on-device inference; and (c) prior cache-aware routing based on binary cache presence can induce routing instability. Based on these insights, we propose CECAR (Cache & Expert Co-Aware Routing), a MoE inference system that jointly considers expert routing and cache management. Unlike prior cache-aware routing methods, CECAR uses an ML-based cache policy to predict the expected reuse distance of each expert and prioritizes routing and execution toward experts with smaller predicted reuse distances. On the Qwen3-30B-A3B model, CECAR achieves 12.5 tokens/s on a consumer-grade GPU with only 16 GB of VRAM, where non-resident experts are fetched from SSD, delivering a 4.5x speedup over conventional MoE inference and exceeding the decode speed of baselines that keep the entire model fully resident in DRAM. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: CECAR：缓存与专家协同感知路由加速MoE大语言模型的端侧推理
translation.abstract: 尽管端侧LLM部署日益受到关注，大规模混合专家(MoE)模型在资源受限设备上仍不实用，因为稀疏的专家激活仍然要求所有专家权重常驻内存。为此，我们识别出端侧MoE推理的三个关键观察：(a)即使在Belady最优策略下缓存命中率也存在本质上界；(b)这些上界不足以支撑低延迟端侧推理；(c)先前基于二元缓存存在性的缓存感知路由会引发路由不稳定。基于这些洞察，我们提出CECAR(缓存与专家协同感知路由)，一个联合考虑专家路由与缓存管理的MoE推理系统。与先前的缓存感知路由方法不同，CECAR使用基于ML的缓存策略预测每个专家的期望重用距离，并将路由和执行优先导向预测重用距离更小的专家。在Qwen3-30B-A3B模型上，CECAR在仅有16GB显存的消费级GPU上达到12.5 tokens/s，非常驻专家从SSD获取，相比传统MoE推理实现4.5倍加速，并超过将整个模型完整常驻DRAM的基线的解码速度。代码见this https URL。
translation.brief: 针对端侧MoE模型推理内存受限的问题，提出CECAR系统，用ML预测专家重用距离并协同优化专家路由与缓存管理，实现仅16GB显存下的高效推理。

papers.title: Can AI Judge You? An Empirical Audit of Deployment Readiness in LLM-assisted Hiring Systems
papers.abstract: Delegating resume screening to large language models (LLMs) requires organizations to establish whether they can distinguish candidates by relevant qualifications while allowing only authorized users to change screening rules or approve exceptions. To this end, we develop a system architecture that separates candidate evidence, evaluation, permission controls, and assessment record, and empirically examine two complementary dimensions of its deployment readiness. First, we assess its operational readiness on four LLMs using a controlled experiment on 210 resumes across 14 job roles and six decision interfaces. Second, we assess its compliance readiness by testing how it handles unauthorized user requests and instructions embedded in resumes. We find that operational performance depends on the choice of evaluation interface: scalar scores generally distinguish qualification changes better than simple pass/fail judgments, while comparative judgments are sensitive to presentation order. Explicit permission rules and separation of resume content from instructions reduce unauthorized compliance, to a varying degree of effectiveness across LLMs and usage contexts. Finally, we find that LLM evaluators often diverge between their decisions and offered justifications. Going beyond simply evaluating LLMs for hiring tasks, our framework supports an audit of a fully configured resume evaluation system to enable its deployment decision.

translation.title: AI 能评判你吗？对 LLM 辅助招聘系统部署就绪度的实证审计
translation.abstract: 将简历筛选委托给大语言模型（LLM）要求组织确认其能够按相关资历区分候选人，同时只允许授权用户修改筛选规则或批准例外。为此，我们开发了一种将候选人证据、评估、权限控制和评估记录相互分离的系统架构，并从两个互补维度实证考察其部署就绪度。首先，我们在四个 LLM 上通过一项涵盖 210 份简历、14 个岗位角色和六种决策界面的受控实验评估其运行就绪度。其次，我们通过测试系统对未授权用户请求和简历中嵌入指令的处理情况来评估其合规就绪度。我们发现运行性能取决于评估界面的选择：标量分数通常比简单的通过/不通过判断更能区分资历变化，而比较型判断则对呈现顺序敏感。显式权限规则以及简历内容与指令的分离可以降低未授权合规，其有效性在不同 LLM 和使用场景下存在差异。最后，我们发现 LLM 评估者的决策与其给出的理由之间经常出现分歧。我们提出的框架超越了单纯评估 LLM 招聘任务的做法，支持对完全配置好的简历评估系统进行审计，从而支持其部署决策。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 辅助招聘系统部署前如何审计其运行与合规就绪度的问题，采用将证据、评估、权限与记录分离的系统架构，并结合受控实验与越权/提示注入测试进行实证检验。

papers.title: HEAMS: Holistic Evaluation of Agent Memory Systems
papers.abstract: Memory systems allow AI agents to persist information across interactions, making them more personalized and more capable on long-horizon tasks. This persistence introduces new risks: stored information can be disclosed in inappropriate contexts, resist correction or deletion, be retained beyond what users desire, or be poisoned to influence later agent behaviour. Yet memory systems are typically evaluated on task performance and efficiency alone. We argue that a memory system should instead be understood as the custodian of its user's persistent information, with responsibilities that extend beyond helping an agent complete its tasks, and that it should be evaluated holistically against all such responsibilities. We present Holistic Evaluation of Agent Memory Systems (HEAMS), an open-source framework for evaluating agent memory systems in this way. First, we state the responsibilities of agent memory systems as explicit behavioural desiderata spanning performance, efficiency, security, privacy, and user sovereignty. Second, we assemble a benchmark suite that covers these desiderata and acknowledge the gaps that remain. Third, we develop MilaMem, a prototype memory system, and a governance layer that can wrap any memory system, enabling controlled study of memory system design choices. Fourth, we compare memory systems across the full HEAMS benchmark suite. We find that no memory system leads every performance benchmark, and strong performance scores may coexist with poor privacy, user-sovereignty, and security scores. Governance strongly influences results: recall policies can reduce inappropriate disclosure at a cost in helpfulness, while both recall and retention policies improve poisoning resistance. Performance and efficiency benchmarks alone therefore cannot reveal how well a memory system meets its responsibilities. Code: this https URL

translation.title: HEAMS：智能体记忆系统的整体评估
translation.abstract: 记忆系统使 AI 智能体能够在交互之间持久化信息，使其更具个性化并更擅长长时程任务。这种持久化带来了新的风险：存储的信息可能在不恰当的上下文中被泄露、抗拒更正或删除、在用户意愿之外被保留，或被投毒以影响智能体后续行为。然而记忆系统通常仅在任务性能和效率上进行评估。我们主张应将记忆系统理解为用户持久信息的保管者，其职责超越帮助智能体完成任务，并应针对所有这些职责进行整体评估。我们提出智能体记忆系统整体评估（HEAMS），一个以此方式评估记忆系统的开源框架。首先，我们将记忆系统的职责表述为涵盖性能、效率、安全、隐私和用户主权的行为性期望。其次，我们构建了覆盖这些期望的基准套件，并承认仍存在的缺口。第三，我们开发了原型记忆系统 MilaMem 以及可包裹任意记忆系统的治理层，支持对记忆系统设计选择的受控研究。第四，我们在完整的 HEAMS 基准套件上比较各记忆系统。我们发现没有任何记忆系统在所有性能基准上领先，且高性能分数可能与糟糕的隐私、用户主权和安全分数并存。治理层对结果影响很大：召回策略能以牺牲有用性为代价减少不当泄露，而召回和保留策略都能提高抗投毒能力。因此，仅靠性能和效率基准无法揭示记忆系统履行其职责的好坏。代码：this https URL
translation.brief: 该论文解决记忆系统评估仅限于性能与效率的问题，提出涵盖性能、效率、安全、隐私和用户主权五大职责的开源整体评估框架 HEAMS。

papers.title: Evacuating from Eventually Emerging Targets on the Line
papers.abstract: We introduce and study Eventually Emerging Linear Search, an online evacuation problem on the line that, to the best of our knowledge, has not been studied before. In this problem, $n$ unit-speed agents with wireless communication start at the origin and search for a hidden target at location $x$, where $|x|\geq1$, that becomes detectable at an unknown time $T$. Visiting $x$ before time $T$ reveals nothing, and the search terminates only when all agents have reached the target. We study two competitive measures. In the emergence-aware model, the target location becomes known to the offline algorithm at time $T$, giving cost $T+|x|$. In the fully-informed model, the offline algorithm knows $x$ from the beginning, giving cost $\max\{|x|,T\}$. For one agent, the optimal competitive ratio is $9$ under both measures, as in classical cow-path search. For two agents, we give an algorithm with competitive ratio $3+\sqrt6$ under both measures, and prove it optimal within the class of origin-separated algorithms, in which each agent performs strictly expanding origin-return excursions on a fixed half-line. We also prove the unconditional lower bounds $4.35$ and $4.38$ for the emergence-aware and fully-informed measures, respectively. These bounds are computer-assisted; we derive finite linear programming relaxations for arbitrary algorithms and certify their infeasibility using exact rational Farkas certificates. For three agents, we prove analytically the unconditional lower bounds $3.1014$ and $3.2823$ for the emergence-aware and fully-informed measures, respectively, and introduce a geometric three-peak family. Different parameter choices give the corresponding upper bounds $4.010599$ and $4.340445$. These bounds lie below the corresponding two-agent lower bounds, so a third agent provably improves both measures.

translation.title: 直线上对延迟出现目标的疏散问题
translation.abstract: 我们提出并研究延迟出现线性搜索（Eventually Emerging Linear Search），据我们所知这是一个此前未被研究过的直线上在线疏散问题。在该问题中，$n$ 个具有无线通信能力、速度为单位的智能体从原点出发，搜索位于位置 $x$（$|x|\geq1$）的隐藏目标，该目标在未知时刻 $T$ 才变得可检测。在时刻 $T$ 之前访问 $x$ 不会获得任何信息，且只有当所有智能体都到达目标时搜索才终止。我们研究两种竞争度量。在 emergence-aware 模型中，离线算法在时刻 $T$ 才得知目标位置，代价为 $T+|x|$。在 fully-informed 模型中，离线算法从一开始就知道 $x$，代价为 $\max\{|x|,T\}$。对于单个智能体，两种度量下的最优竞争比均为 $9$，与经典的 cow-path 搜索相同。对于两个智能体，我们给出在两种度量下竞争比为 $3+\sqrt6$ 的算法，并证明其在 origin-separated 算法类（每个智能体在固定半直线上执行严格扩张的原点返回游走）中是最优的。我们还证明了 emergence-aware 与 fully-informed 度量下分别为 $4.35$ 和 $4.38$ 的无条件下界。这些下界借助计算机辅助；我们对任意算法推导出有限线性规划松弛，并使用精确的有理数 Farkas 证书证明其不可行。对于三个智能体，我们解析地证明了 emergence-aware 与 fully-informed 度量下分别为 $3.1014$ 和 $3.2823$ 的无条件下界，并引入一个几何上的三峰参数族。不同的参数选择给出相应上界 $4.010599$ 和 $4.340445$。这些上界低于对应的两个智能体下界，因此第三个智能体被证明能同时改进两种度量。
translation.brief: 该论文提出并分析目标在未知时刻才可检测的直线疏散问题，通过设计算法、证明下界（含计算机辅助 LP/Farkas 证书）刻画不同智能体数量下的最优竞争比。

papers.title: Risk-certified prompt optimization for LLM-as-a-judge guardrails
papers.abstract: LLM-as-a-judge guardrails are often controlled primarily through system prompts, yet standard prompt optimization methods target average performance rather than explicit safety constraints. This paper studies system-prompt selection as a constrained optimization problem: maximize benign pass rate while keeping the missed-attack rate below a user-specified level {\alpha} with finite-sample statistical control. The framework combines LLM-based judging, automatic prompt generation, and distribution-free risk certification. This work instantiates it in two procedures: CPS and CRISP. CPS generates a fixed pool of prompts from training data, then certifies candidates on a held-out evaluation set using simultaneous upper confidence bounds and selects the certified prompt with the highest benign utility. CRISP instead integrates risk feedback into an adaptive search, using hard example-guided rewriting and a reusable-holdout interface to steer generation toward the feasible utility frontier. Experiments on four datasets covering prompt injection, system-prompt leakage, and sensitive-information disclosure show that risk-certified selection consistently respects the target missed-attack level on heldout tests, while utility improves as the permitted risk is relaxed. CRISP is especially useful when fixed-pool search fails to produce certifiable high-utility candidates.

translation.title: 面向 LLM-as-a-judge 护栏的风险认证提示优化
translation.abstract: LLM-as-a-judge 护栏通常主要通过系统提示进行控制，但标准的提示优化方法针对的是平均性能而非显式安全约束。本文将系统提示选择研究为一个约束优化问题：在有限样本统计控制下，使良性通过率最大化，同时将漏检攻击率保持在用户指定的水平 {\alpha} 以下。该框架结合了基于 LLM 的评判、自动提示生成和无分布风险认证。本工作以两种流程将其实例化：CPS 和 CRISP。CPS 从训练数据生成固定的提示池，然后在留出的评估集上使用同时上置信界对候选提示进行认证，并选择认证后良性效用最高的提示。CRISP 则将风险反馈融入自适应搜索，使用难例引导的重写和可复用留出集接口，引导生成朝向可行效用前沿。在涵盖提示注入、系统提示泄露和敏感信息泄露的四个数据集上的实验表明，风险认证选择在留出测试上一致遵守目标漏检攻击水平，同时效用随允许风险的放宽而提升。当固定池搜索无法产生可认证的高效用候选时，CRISP 尤其有用。
translation.brief: 该论文解决系统提示优化缺乏显式安全约束的问题，将提示选择建模为带有限样本风险认证的约束优化，并提出 CPS 和 CRISP 两种认证式优化流程。

papers.title: Weights & Caches: LLMs Can Program Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Neural networks are typically programmed through optimization, rather than by explicitly specifying their computations. Recent work on weight-space programming suggests that large language models (LLMs) can instead reason about and manipulate neural-network weights directly. In this work, we show that LLMs can directly program statistical computations in tabular foundation models (TFMs), whose parameters enable inference across different datasets. We investigate three complementary settings using GPT-6 Astra, without gradient-based optimization. First, Astra directly programs nanoTabPFN from zero-initialized weights, achieving a mean ROC AUC of 0.849 across 20 TabArena datasets, compared to 0.876 for a pretrained baseline. Second, Astra diagnoses and repairs a signed-product regression failure in pretrained TabPFN-3.5, restoring near-perfect predictions on held-out synthetic datasets while preserving performance on TabArena-Lite, with only a 0.08% average relative increase in error. Third, it writes KV-cache-editing programs that steer TabPFN-3.5's predictions on unseen synthetic datasets, demonstrating transformations such as reversing linear trends and converting sine waves into approximate square waves, without modifying model weights. Together, our findings suggest that LLM-driven programming could complement gradient-based optimization across TFMs' development and usage, while offering a new way to investigate and intervene in their internal computations.

translation.title: Weights & Caches：LLM 可以为表格基础模型编程
translation.abstract: 神经网络通常通过优化来编程，而非显式指定其计算。近期关于权重空间编程的研究表明，大语言模型（LLM）可以转而直接推理和操作神经网络权重。在这项工作中，我们展示了 LLM 可以直接为表格基础模型（TFM）中的统计计算编程，TFM 的参数使其能在不同数据集上进行推理。我们使用 GPT-6 Astra 在不依赖基于梯度的优化的情况下考察三种互补场景。第一，Astra 从零初始化权重直接为 nanoTabPFN 编程，在 20 个 TabArena 数据集上取得平均 ROC AUC 0.849，而预训练基线为 0.876。第二，Astra 诊断并修复了预训练 TabPFN-3.5 中的一个带符号乘积回归失败问题，在留出的合成数据集上恢复了近乎完美的预测，同时在 TabArena-Lite 上保持性能，平均相对误差仅增加 0.08%。第三，它编写了 KV-cache 编辑程序来引导 TabPFN-3.5 对未见合成数据集的预测，实现了诸如反转线性趋势、将正弦波转换为近似方波等变换，而无需修改模型权重。总之，我们的发现表明 LLM 驱动的编程可以在 TFM 的开发和使用中补充基于梯度的优化，同时为研究和干预其内部计算提供了新途径。
translation.brief: 该论文探索 LLM 能否直接为表格基础模型编程，通过零初始化权重编程、缺陷诊断修复和 KV-cache 编辑三种无梯度场景验证其可行性。

papers.title: Do We Still Need Fine-Tuned Classifiers? Swapping Typed Decision Models into 24 ACL-Venue Papers
papers.abstract: Typed Decision Models such as TypeSafe's Jev, also called System One or System 1 models, answer typed questions about an input with a probability for each option, and they need no training. Many NLP papers still fine-tune a task-specific classifier, and prompted large language models (LLMs) trail such classifiers on most text classification benchmarks. We ask how many of these fine-tuned classifiers a Typed Decision Model can replace under each paper's own evaluation, and what is needed where it cannot. We swap the predictors of 24 ACL-venue papers for Jev, keep each paper's splits, label definitions and metric, and check the results with Cloudflare's Clef, Microsoft-Decision-1 and OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna Decisions. The resulting 46 English test sets, with their questions and published scores, form the TDM-Gauntlet benchmark. With a zero-shot prompt, Jev directly replaced the paper's predictor on 12 of the 46 test sets, mostly single judgments with plain labels, but rarely where the paper's method was trained on its labels. Where Jev scored lower, we most often attributed the shortfall to an annotation convention that the label name does not state. With 500 training labels plus validation and no user-managed GPU, calibration and GEPA-style prompt optimization closed a median 72% of the gap to the paper's method, about twice what off-the-shelf GEPA closed, for a median $1.66 per search. On the same labels, fine-tuned encoders such as RoBERTa and DeBERTa closed 59%, and LoRA fine-tuning of the open LLM Qwen3.8-27B closed 97%. Fine-tuning remains the most accurate option, but a zero-shot prompt is often enough for plain labels, and prompt optimization closes most of the remaining gap.

translation.title: 我们还需要微调分类器吗？将 Typed Decision Model 替换到 24 篇 ACL 会议论文中
translation.abstract: Typed Decision Model（如 TypeSafe 的 Jev，也称为 System One 或 System 1 模型）以每个选项的概率回答关于输入的类型化问题，无需训练。许多 NLP 论文仍在微调任务专用分类器，而提示驱动的大语言模型（LLM）在大多数文本分类基准上落后于这类分类器。我们探究在这些论文各自的评估设置下，Typed Decision Model 能替换多少个微调分类器，以及在无法替换之处需要什么。我们将 24 篇 ACL 会议论文的预测器替换为 Jev，保留每篇论文的数据划分、标签定义和指标，并用 Cloudflare 的 Clef、Microsoft-Decision-1 和 OpenAI 的 GPT-6 Luna Decoins 验证结果。由此得到的 46 个英文测试集，连同其问题和已发表分数，构成 TDM-Gauntlet 基准。通过零样本提示，Jev 在 46 个测试集中的 12 个上直接替换了原论文的预测器，主要是标签简单的单次判断，但在原方法在其标签上训练过的情况下很少成功。在 Jev 得分较低之处，我们最常将差距归因于标签名称未表述的标注约定。仅用 500 个训练标签加验证集，且无需用户管理 GPU，校准和 GEPA 风格的提示优化中位数弥补了与原论文方法 72% 的差距，约为现成 GEPA 效果的两倍，每次搜索中位数成本 1.66 美元。在相同标签上，微调编码器如 RoBERTa 和 DeBERTa 弥补了 59%，开源 LLM Qwen3.8-27B 的 LoRA 微调弥补了 97%。微调仍是最准确的选择，但对于简单标签，零样本提示往往已足够，而提示优化可弥补大部分剩余差距。
translation.brief: 探究无需训练的 Typed Decision Model（Jev）能否替代 NLP 论文中的微调分类器，通过在 24 篇 ACL 论文的原评估设置下进行替换实验并结合提示优化来量化差距。

papers.title: How Specification Explicitness Shapes Failure in LLM-Generated Code
papers.abstract: When LLMs turn requirements into code, every underspecified constraint becomes behavior that the model must decide during generation. We test when specifications move beyond structure and begin to control generated behavior. In a controlled experiment, 72 participants implemented and revised Python tasks with an LLM under three levels of specification explicitness. The results show a clear break between lightweight structure and explicit behavioral obligations. Lightweight structure reduced hidden-test failures by only 8.7%. Requiring participants to specify constraints, invariants, negative requirements, edge cases, tie-breaking rules, and exception handling cut failures by 47.2% and reduced the number of distinct failure modes by 20.5%. The largest drops were in failure modes tied to implicit obligations. Invariant violations fell by 66.1%, and unsupported assumptions fell by 59.5%. After a requirement change, specifications with explicit behavioral obligations produced regressions in more submissions, but each affected submission lost less previously correct behavior. Explicit specifications also changed how developers judged generated code. Without explicit obligations, participants overestimated generated-code correctness by about 23 percentage points. With explicit obligations, they produced better code but judged it more cautiously. Thus, the lesson is sharper than "better specifications help." Lightweight structure barely helped, while explicit behavioral obligations nearly halved failures, made regressions shallower, and improved calibration.

translation.title: 规约明确程度如何影响 LLM 生成代码中的失败
translation.abstract: 当 LLM 将需求转化为代码时，每个未明确规定的约束都变成模型必须在生成过程中自行决定的行为。我们测试规约何时从结构性描述过渡到能够控制生成行为。在一项对照实验中，72 名参与者在三种规约明确程度下用 LLM 实现和修订 Python 任务。结果显示轻量级结构与明确的行为义务之间存在明显分界。轻量级结构仅将隐藏测试失败减少了 8.7%。要求参与者明确约束、不变量、负面需求、边界情况、平局规则和异常处理则将失败削减了 47.2%，并将不同失败模式的数量减少了 20.5%。降幅最大的是与隐含义务相关的失败模式：不变量违反下降了 66.1%，不成立的假设下降了 59.5%。需求变更后，含明确行为义务的规约在更多提交中产生了回归，但每个受影响提交丢失的既有正确行为更少。明确的规约还改变了开发者对生成代码的评判：没有明确义务时，参与者对生成代码正确性的高估约达 23 个百分点；有了明确义务，他们写出了更好的代码，但评判更审慎。因此，结论比“更好的规约有帮助”更为尖锐：轻量级结构几乎无帮助，而明确的行为义务几乎将失败减半，使回归更浅，并改善了校准。
translation.brief: 通过 72 人对照实验研究规约明确度对 LLM 代码生成质量的影响，发现明确的行为义务（约束、不变量、边界情况等）可将失败率近乎减半。

papers.title: SWE-CoWork: Benchmarking Coding Agents as Digital Employees in Organizations
papers.abstract: A coding agent working within a software organization must establish what to build, collaborate with colleagues, and verify what it delivers. We introduce SWE-CoWork, a benchmark comprising 101 development assignments across 101 real repositories, 11 programming languages, and 12 application domains. Each assignment places an agent in a simulated engineering organization with 26 colleagues who have distinct responsibilities, bounded knowledge, and controlled collaboration behavior. Starting from a brief handoff, agents must recover requirements distributed across colleagues and workplace records, reconcile conflicting evidence, and implement changes evaluated by private executable tests. We evaluate eleven models and find a substantial gap between partial implementation and complete task delivery. The two leading models satisfy approximately 63% of fail-to-pass (F2P) tests but complete fewer than 8% of assignments. Providing complete requirements upfront improves F2P by approximately 16 percentage points for Seed Evolving and GPT-6 Astra, yet leaves complete task success unchanged. Requirement-level trajectory analysis reveals failures throughout the delivery process: Claude-Opus-5.5 directs a mean of 93% of first questions about queried cards to their accountable owners across runs but obtains only 64% of colleague-held requirements. Deferred questions go unfollowed, implementations remain incomplete even after requirements are acquired, and 31% of requirements reported as completed fail their tests. These findings highlight sustained requirement tracking, from clarification through implementation, verification, and handoff, as a key challenge for reliable autonomous software engineering.

translation.title: SWE-CoWork：将编程智能体作为组织中的数字员工进行基准评测
translation.abstract: 在软件组织中工作的编程智能体必须确定要构建什么、与同事协作并验证其交付成果。我们提出 SWE-CoWork，这是一个包含 101 个开发任务的基准，涵盖 101 个真实仓库、11 种编程语言和 12 个应用领域。每个任务将智能体置于一个模拟的工程组织中，该组织有 26 位职责各异、知识受限且协作行为受控的同事。从简短的交接开始，智能体必须从同事和工作场所记录中恢复分散的需求，调和相互冲突的证据，并实现由私有可执行测试评估的变更。我们评估了 11 个模型，发现部分实现与完整任务交付之间存在显著差距。两个领先的模型满足约 63% 的 fail-to-pass（F2P）测试，但完成的任务不足 8%。预先提供完整需求使 Seed Evolving 和 GPT-6 Astra 的 F2P 提升约 16 个百分点，但完整任务成功率不变。需求层面的轨迹分析揭示了整个交付过程中的失败：Claude-Opus-5.5 在各次运行中平均将 93% 的关于被查询卡片的首次提问导向其责任所有者，但只获得了 64% 的同事掌握的需求。延迟提问无人跟进，即使获取需求后实现仍不完整，31% 被报告为已完成的需求未通过测试。这些发现凸显了从澄清、实现、验证到交接的持续需求跟踪，是可靠自主软件工程的关键挑战。
translation.brief: 提出模拟工程组织的 SWE-CoWork 基准（101 个真实仓库任务加 26 位模拟同事），评估编程智能体完整交付任务的能力，发现需求跟踪贯穿全程是主要瓶颈。

papers.title: Understanding Users' Security, Privacy, and Trust Concerns in Healthcare AI Systems
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly integrated into healthcare systems, from clinical information retrieval to workflow automation and decision support, which introduces new security, privacy, and trust risks with direct implications for patient care. While prior work has examined these risks from technical and regulatory perspectives, less is known about how these risks are naturally discussed in online communities. To address this gap, we conduct a large-scale analysis of 14 medical communities on Reddit and extract 6,514 relevant posts. Through systematic qualitative coding and LLM-assisted classification, we investigate concerns expressed in healthcare AI discussions, their prevalence, and how they evolve over time. Our analysis reveals that users perceive healthcare AI as expanding traditional healthcare trust boundaries and attack surfaces through integrations with electronic health records, third-party services, cloud platforms, and automated clinical workflows. Posts express concerns about over-privileged access to sensitive records, opaque data flows, unauthorized secondary use, and unsafe automation can amplify the consequences of errors and misuse. We identify four attitudes toward these risks: exploring questions of accountability and harm, cautiously accepting AI with stronger safeguards, skepticism about system trustworthiness, and resignation to growing data exposure and automation. Longitudinal analysis shows that SP&T discussions have increased significantly, with shifts coinciding with major healthcare AI deployments, privacy incidents, and regulatory developments. These findings illuminate changing trust relationships and data-governance challenges, informing the design and governance of safer, more transparent, and accountable healthcare AI systems.

translation.title: 理解用户在医疗 AI 系统中的安全、隐私与信任顾虑
translation.abstract: 人工智能正日益融入医疗系统，从临床信息检索到工作流自动化和决策支持，这带来了直接影响患者护理的安全、隐私和信任风险。尽管已有工作从技术和监管角度考察了这些风险，但对这些风险在在线社区中如何被自然讨论知之甚少。为填补这一空白，我们对 Reddit 上的 14 个医疗社区进行了大规模分析，提取了 6,514 条相关帖子。通过系统的定性编码和 LLM 辅助分类，我们研究了医疗 AI 讨论中表达的顾虑、其普遍程度以及随时间的演变。我们的分析显示，用户认为医疗 AI 通过与电子健康记录、第三方服务、云平台和自动化临床工作流的集成，扩展了传统医疗的信任边界和攻击面。帖子表达了对敏感记录的过度特权访问、不透明的数据流、未经授权的二次使用，以及可能放大错误和滥用后果的不安全自动化的担忧。我们识别出对这些风险的四种态度：探讨问责与伤害问题、在更强保障下谨慎接受 AI、对系统可信度的怀疑，以及对数据暴露和自动化不断加剧的无奈。纵向分析显示 SP&T（安全、隐私与信任）讨论显著增加，其变化与重大医疗 AI 部署、隐私事件和监管发展相吻合。这些发现揭示了不断变化的信任关系和数据治理挑战，为设计和管理更安全、更透明、更负责任的医疗 AI 系统提供了依据。
translation.brief: 对 Reddit 14 个医疗社区的 6,514 条帖子进行大规模定性分析，归纳用户对医疗 AI 的安全、隐私与信任顾虑及其四类态度和随时间的演变。

papers.title: Impatience Makes Matching NP-Hard
papers.abstract: Motivated by emerging applications such as online marketplaces and quantum switches, we study a dynamic bipartite matching model with impatient agents, where the two sides represent customers and suppliers. Agents of each type arrive according to an independent Poisson process, and the platform decides which pairs of agents to match. The agents are possibly impatient and may leave the system if not matched before their patience expires. The platform aims to maximize throughput, i.e., the number of matches per unit time. In this paper, we reveal an interesting phase transition in the computational hardness of throughput maximization. In particular, we show that approximating the optimal long-run throughput within a sufficiently small fixed relative error is NP-hard, even when all agents have rate-one exponential patience. This result implies a computational barrier to constructing near-optimal, efficiently executable matching policies that induce a matching process with fast mixing. On the other hand, when all agents on at least one side have infinite patience, we provide a simple polynomial-time algorithm that maximizes the throughput.

translation.title: 不耐烦使匹配问题成为 NP 难
translation.abstract: 受在线市场和量子开关等新兴应用的启发，我们研究具有不耐烦智能体的动态二部匹配模型，其中两侧分别代表客户和供应商。各类型智能体按独立泊松过程到达，平台决定匹配哪些智能体对。智能体可能不耐烦，若在耐心耗尽前未被匹配则可能离开系统。平台的目标是最大化吞吐量，即单位时间的匹配数。本文揭示了吞吐量最大化计算复杂度中一个有趣的相变现象。特别地，我们证明在足够小的固定相对误差内逼近最优长期吞吐量是 NP 难的，即使所有智能体都具有速率为一的指数耐心。这一结果意味着构建近最优、可高效执行的匹配策略存在计算障碍——此类策略诱导的匹配过程应具有快速混合性。另一方面，当至少一侧的所有智能体具有无限耐心时，我们给出了一个简单的多项式时间算法来最大化吞吐量。
translation.brief: 研究带不耐烦智能体的动态二部匹配吞吐量最大化，证明小相对误差逼近在有限耐心下是 NP 难的，而在至少一侧无限耐心时给出多项式时间最优算法。

papers.title: Scaling large language model-assisted line-of-therapy adjudication with human-in-the-loop evidence-calibrated selection
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled the ability to scale clinical adjudication tasks traditionally dependent on exhaustive manual review. Line-of-therapy (LoT) adjudication, a major bottleneck in oncology cohort construction, is a prime example. Line boundaries must be inferred from longitudinal treatment histories according to nuanced, study-specific definitions, at every regimen transition for every patient. LLMs can apply this adjudication at scale, but their reliability varies across patients. Treatment histories differ in complexity, and ambiguous or atypical patterns depend on expert clinical judgment. Reliable automation thus requires verified support for model assignments and the ability to identify cases that warrant manual review. Here, we present evidence-calibrated selection (ECS), a human-in-the-loop framework for scaling LLM-assisted LoT adjudication. ECS derives confidence from observed clinician adjudications, prioritizes patients with the least-supported assignments for follow-up review, and returns completed adjudications to the model as precedent. As the evidence base grows, ECS continuously calibrates confidence to estimate residual error, thus enabling more efficient use of clinician time. In simulations on 136 clinician adjudicated patients with multiple myeloma, ECS achieved a residual error of 5% after review of 44.6% of patients, compared to 62.2% when review was directed by LLM self-reported confidence and 81.9% under random sampling. These results support a scalable approach to study-specific LoT adjudication, using clinician evidence to inform automated predictions, minimize error, and reduce review burden.

translation.title: 基于人在回路证据校准选择的大语言模型辅助治疗方案线判定规模化
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）使传统上依赖详尽人工审核的临床判定任务得以规模化，肿瘤队列构建中的主要瓶颈——治疗方案线（LoT）判定便是典型例子。治疗方案线边界必须根据细致的、研究特定的定义，从纵向治疗史中为每位患者的每次方案转换进行推断。LLM 可以规模化执行此类判定，但其可靠性因患者而异。治疗史复杂程度不同，模糊或非典型的模式依赖专家临床判断。因此，可靠的自动化需要对模型判定结果提供经过验证的支持，并能识别需要人工审核的病例。我们提出证据校准选择（ECS），一个用于规模化 LLM 辅助 LoT 判定的人在回路框架。ECS 从已观察到的临床医生判定结果中推导置信度，将证据支持最弱的病例优先安排复审，并将已完成的判定作为先例反馈给模型。随着证据库增长，ECS 持续校准置信度以估计残余错误，从而更高效地利用临床医生时间。在 136 名经临床医生判定的多发性骨髓瘤患者的模拟中，ECS 在复审 44.6% 的患者后将残余错误降至 5%，而由 LLM 自报告置信度指导复审时为 62.2%，随机抽样为 81.9%。这些结果支持一种可扩展的研究特定 LoT 判定方法，利用临床医生证据指导自动预测、最小化错误并降低复审负担。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 批量判定肿瘤治疗方案线时可靠性不一、需人工复核的问题，核心方法是提出证据校准选择（ECS）人在回路框架，用临床医生判定证据校准置信度并优先复审最不确定的病例。

papers.title: Estimating Outpatient Visit Prices from Hospital Price Transparency Data using Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Objective: Hospital care prices in the United States have increased substantially, yet patients lack effective tools to access and compare costs. We aimed to develop and evaluate an LLM-based approach for improving access to and use of hospital price transparency (PT) data. Materials and Methods: To estimate visit prices, we used a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework to analyze PT files from three major hospitals in Maryland and the surrounding region. We compared BM25, OpenAI embedding models, and a GPT-BM25 hybrid against a no-RAG baseline for cost estimation of individual procedures and procedure groups, then evaluated the best approach for symptom-based visit cost estimation using synthetic simulations. Results: Across hospitals, the GPT-BM25 retriever achieved the best performance, with average price MAPE of 19.44% for individual procedures and 4.90% for groups, compared with 147.98% and 82.82%, respectively, for the no-RAG baseline. In simulations, our framework correctly identified approximately 50% of reference procedures and reduced MAPE relative to the LLM-only baseline at two of the three hospitals, while achieving comparable performance at the third. Discussion: Our framework uses RAG to improve care price estimation in real-world settings. Compared with the no-RAG baseline, it substantially improved cost estimates for both individual procedures and procedure groups. Improvements were smaller in synthetic simulations, likely because inferring procedures from clinical information is more complex. Practical challenges remain, including heterogeneous PT file formats, unexplained duplicate entries, and limited availability of insurer-negotiated rates. Conclusion: LLMs that effectively integrate PT data show strong potential to provide patients with more accessible and accurate healthcare cost estimates.

translation.title: 利用大语言模型从医院价格透明度数据估计门诊就诊价格
translation.abstract: 目的：美国医院诊疗价格大幅上涨，但患者缺乏获取和比较费用的有效工具。我们旨在开发并评估一种基于 LLM 的方法，以改善医院价格透明度（PT）数据的获取和使用。材料与方法：为估计就诊价格，我们使用检索增强生成（RAG）框架分析马里兰州及周边地区三家主要医院的 PT 文件。我们比较了 BM25、OpenAI 嵌入模型和 GPT-BM25 混合检索器与无 RAG 基线在单个诊疗项目和项目组费用估计上的表现，并通过合成模拟评估最优方法在基于症状的就诊费用估计中的效果。结果：在各医院中，GPT-BM25 检索器表现最佳，单个诊疗项目的平均价格 MAPE 为 19.44%，项目组为 4.90%，而无 RAG 基线分别为 147.98% 和 82.82%。在模拟中，我们的框架正确识别了约 50% 的参考诊疗项目，并在三家医院中的两家将 MAPE 降至仅 LLM 基线之下，在第三家取得相当的性能。讨论：我们的框架利用 RAG 改进真实场景下的诊疗价格估计。与无 RAG 基线相比，它显著改进了单个诊疗项目和项目组的费用估计。合成模拟中的改进较小，可能因为从临床信息推断诊疗项目更为复杂。实际挑战依然存在，包括 PT 文件格式不一、无法解释的重复条目以及保险公司协商费率可得性有限。结论：有效整合 PT 数据的 LLM 在为患者提供更易获取、更准确的医疗费用估计方面展现出强大潜力。
translation.brief: 解决患者难以从医院价格透明度文件中获取可比费用的问题，核心方法是用 RAG 框架（以 GPT-BM25 混合检索为最佳）让 LLM 检索价格数据来估计门诊诊疗费用。

papers.title: GNN-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning for Coastal Emergency Response under Extreme Water Levels
papers.abstract: When a storm surge approaches a coastal town, the emergency plan must be put into action quickly using water-level forecasts, flood extent, road access, vulnerable residents and shelters. Bringing this information together under time pressure is slow and depends on the duty officer's expertise. This paper is one step in a wider research line from data to safe decisions: machine learning to understand the hazard, reinforcement learning and planning to choose actions, large language models (LLMs) to explain and cross-check them, and an assurance layer that keeps people in charge. Here we address the action step on a real place. We ask whether a policy can learn the timing of emergency actions from decades of real events. Lido di Venezia is represented as a heterogeneous graph built from public elevation, road, building and census data and driven by hourly tide-gauge records from 1983 to 2024, with seven actions taken from the municipal emergency plan. A PPO policy is trained on this graph and compared, on storm windows unseen in training, with a rule-based system simulating the officer's discretionary decisions. On 18 historical test scenarios, PPO achieves a similar reduction in population exposure to the rule. With uncertain forecasts and limited protection it again performs similarly but does not outperform the tuned rule, and removing graph message passing does not substantially reduce performance. PPO therefore learns an effective protective response from an outcome-based reward alone: it is given the plan's actions and when each is allowed, but not the thresholds that tell the comparator when to act. Next steps test harder edge cases, move closer to a digital twin of the territory, and replace the simulated officer with assessment by emergency-management stakeholders, supported by LLM-based interpretation of each recommendation.

translation.title: 基于 GNN 的深度强化学习应对极端水位下的沿海应急响应
translation.abstract: 当风暴潮逼近沿海城镇时，必须迅速依据水位预报、淹没范围、道路可达性、弱势居民和避难所启动应急预案。在时间压力下整合这些信息既缓慢又依赖值班官员的专业经验。本文是“从数据到安全决策”这一更广泛研究方向中的一步：用机器学习理解灾害，用强化学习与规划选择行动，用大语言模型（LLM）解释并交叉验证，再通过保障层确保人类保持掌控。本文针对真实地点的行动选择步骤：探究策略能否从数十年的真实事件中学习应急行动的时机。我们将 Lido di Venezia 表示为一个由公开高程、道路、建筑和人口普查数据构建的异构图，并由 1983 至 2024 年的小时级潮位记录驱动，行动集合取自市应急计划的七项措施。在该图上训练 PPO 策略，并在训练中未见过的风暴时间窗口上与模拟值班官员裁量决策的规则系统进行比较。在 18 个历史测试场景中，PPO 实现了与规则系统相近的人口暴露降低。在预报不确定且防护资源有限的情况下，两者表现相近但 PPO 并未超越调优后的规则，而移除图消息传递并未显著降低性能。因此 PPO 仅凭基于结果的奖励就学到了有效的防护响应：它获得了计划中的行动及各项行动的允许时机，但未获得规则系统行动时机的阈值。后续工作包括测试更难的边界情形、向区域数字孪生靠近，并用应急管理利益相关方的评估替代模拟官员，辅以基于 LLM 的逐条建议解读。
translation.brief: 解决风暴潮应急响应行动时机选择依赖人工经验的问题，核心方法是将威尼斯 Lido 建模为异构图并用 PPO 强化学习从历史事件中学习应急行动策略。

papers.title: Visual Marking as a Native Reasoning Capability for Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract: Visual reasoning often requires maintaining intermediate spatial states that are difficult to express in text. Existing approaches either rely on external drawing tools or image generators, or encode these states in latent tokens without explicit spatial correspondence to the input image. We introduce SelfMark, which enables MLLMs to construct and use visual marks directly in their native visual feature space. By treating the visual token grid as a canvas, SelfMark establishes explicit spatial correspondence between marks and images. This is achieved through a locate-mark-read procedure, where the model identifies relevant locations, constructs task-dependent mark features, and reads the resulting visual features to guide its reasoning. We jointly train a single model on spatial planning, dense counting, high-resolution VQA, and line tracing. Across six benchmarks, SelfMark outperforms state-of-the-art MLLM-based methods specialized for individual tasks. These improvements also persist with a stronger backbone, demonstrating the effectiveness of visual marking across different model capabilities. Overall, SelfMark provides a unified approach to visual reasoning by integrating spatially grounded marks directly into the visual feature space of MLLMs.

translation.title: 视觉标记作为多模态大语言模型的原生推理能力
translation.abstract: 视觉推理往往需要维持难以用文本表达的中间空间状态。现有方法或依赖外部绘图工具和图像生成器，或将这些状态编码在与输入图像没有明确空间对应的潜空间 token 中。我们提出 SelfMark，使 MLLM 能够在其原生视觉特征空间中直接构建和使用视觉标记。通过将视觉 token 网格视为画布，SelfMark 在标记与图像之间建立明确的空间对应。这通过“定位—标记—读取”流程实现：模型识别相关位置、构建任务相关的标记特征，并读取由此产生的视觉特征以引导推理。我们在空间规划、密集计数、高分辨率 VQA 和线条追踪上联合训练单一模型。在六个基准上，SelfMark 超越了针对单个任务的专用 MLLM 方法。这些改进在更强的骨干模型下依然保持，证明视觉标记在不同模型能力下的有效性。总体而言，SelfMark 通过将空间锚定的标记直接整合到 MLLM 的视觉特征空间中，提供了一种统一的视觉推理方法。
translation.brief: 解决多模态 LLM 视觉推理中难以用文本表达中间空间状态的问题，核心方法是提出 SelfMark，让模型直接在原生视觉特征空间中定位、构造和读取视觉标记以引导推理。

papers.title: Benchmarking LLM Inference on Desktop-Scale NVIDIA Grace Blackwell Clusters
papers.abstract: Two NVIDIA DGX Spark GB10 systems connect directly over 200 GbE to serve larger language models and increase inference capacity, but the benefits depend on how they are deployed. We benchmark 17 open-weight checkpoints spanning dense and mixture-of-experts architectures, 8B to 235B parameters and four weight precisions on one and two RDMA-connected systems. Using vLLM, we compare tensor parallelism (TP=2), pipeline parallelism (PP=2) and a two-replica baseline at concurrency 1 to 64, with three independent launches per configuration.
