TP=2 delivers a median 1.59x peak-throughput gain over one Spark, versus 1.39x for PP=2 and has higher throughput in 93 of 96 matched comparisons with separated 95% Welch intervals. It reduces unloaded inter-token latency to 0.52x to 0.73x of one Spark, whereas PP=2 provides little reduction. TP=2 also achieves the highest goodput under a strict 100 ms inter-token latency objective wherever both strategies are supported and the objective is met. For models fitting on one Spark, TP=2 generally favors low-concurrency serving, while replication offers higher throughput at high concurrency. One Spark uses less GPU energy per output token at matched concurrency. Across three precision ladders, NVFP4 reduces unloaded latency more than adding a second Spark at BF16. NCCL microbenchmarks and comparisons with an earlier TCP campaign suggest that collective communication overhead contributes to the advantage of TP=2. These results provide deployment guidance for desktop-scale inference.

translation.title: 桌面级 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell 集群上的大语言模型推理基准测试
translation.abstract: 两台 NVIDIA DGX Spark GB10 系统通过 200 GbE 直接互联，可服务更大的语言模型并提升推理容量，但其收益取决于部署方式。我们在单台和两台 RDMA 互联的系统上，对涵盖稠密与混合专家架构、8B 到 235B 参数、四种权重精度的 17 个开源权重检查点进行基准测试。使用 vLLM，我们在并发 1 到 64 下比较张量并行（TP=2）、流水线并行（PP=2）和双副本基线，每种配置独立启动三次。TP=2 相对单台 Spark 实现中位数 1.59 倍的峰值吞吐提升，PP=2 为 1.39 倍，且 TP=2 在 96 组匹配比较中的 93 组吞吐更高（95% Welch 区间相互分离）。TP=2 将无负载的 token 间延迟降至单台 Spark 的 0.52 至 0.73 倍，而 PP=2 几乎没有降低。在 100 ms token 间延迟的严格目标下，TP=2 在两种策略均可用且目标可达的所有情形中取得最高的有效吞吐。对于可放入单台 Spark 的模型，TP=2 通常更适合低并发服务，而副本在高并发下提供更高吞吐。在相同并发下单台 Spark 每个 output token 消耗更少 GPU 能量。在三种精度阶梯中，NVFP4 比增加第二台 Spark（BF16）更能降低无负载延迟。NCCL 微基准测试及与此前 TCP 实验的比较表明，集合通信开销是 TP=2 优势的来源之一。这些结果为桌面级推理部署提供了指导。
translation.brief: 解决双机 DGX Spark 集群上 LLM 推理部署策略选择不明确的问题，核心方法是用 vLLM 对多种模型、精度与并行策略进行系统性基准测试以给出部署指导。

papers.title: Where the Savings Go: The Limits of Hiding Cross-Tenant Cache Hits in LLM Serving
papers.abstract: LLM serving engines cache prompt prefixes; a cache hit skips computation and returns faster, so a shared cache reveals whether others have sent a given text. Per-account salting closes this channel but forgoes cross-tenant reuse and isolates only whole accounts, even where access is redistributed or trust domains are subdivided below them. Defenses that share globally but hide hits promise reuse without relying on account boundaries. Hiding a hit requires everything tenants observe afterwards to be distributed as if it had missed. The defenses we examine target the hit-miss gap; we instead follow where the saved time goes. Step-based schedulers that never idle while work waits pass it in full to every request queued behind the hit, shifting each earlier by the same amount. An attacker within ordinary rate limits brackets a probe with two groups of listeners that each return one token, sends them in one short burst, and counts in how many steps they finish. Replaying a production trace on one vLLM instance at up to half capacity, a single probe detects cached texts of 256 tokens or more with advantage at least 0.98. Hiding only the hit request falls to one probe on vLLM and SGLang; random delays must reach about ten times the shift or more to cut the advantage to 0.1; narrowing what is shared gives no guarantee against this inference. Since any observable tenant benefit is also a signal, we prove that a rate-limited tenant's gain from content written by k other accounts is at most of order k times the leakage allowed, whatever the provider does with identities; at zero leakage, only the provider keeps the savings. Exact hiding is attainable in principle on one instance, but mechanisms that only pause or hold work know skipped work's duration only approximately, so under saturated prefill they must pad every step that may hold a hit, at a price that grows with time rather than with hits.

translation.title: 节省时间去哪了：隐藏 LLM 服务中跨租户缓存命中的极限
translation.abstract: LLM 服务引擎会缓存 prompt 前缀；缓存命中可跳过计算并更快返回，因此共享缓存会泄露他人是否发送过某段文本。按账号加盐可封堵该信道，但放弃了跨租户复用，且只在整账号层面隔离，即使访问被重新分配或信任域被细分到账号之下也无能为力。全局共享但隐藏命中的防御方案承诺在不依赖账号边界的情况下实现复用。隐藏命中要求租户事后观察到的一切都按未命中时的分布呈现。我们考察的防御方案针对的是命中与未命中的差距，而我们则追踪节省下来的时间去了哪里。在工作排队时永不空闲的基于 step 的调度器会把节省的时间完整传递给命中请求之后排队的每个请求，使每个请求提前相同的量。处于普通速率限制内的攻击者用两组各自返回一个 token 的监听请求夹住一个探测请求，在短时间内突发发送，并统计它们在多少个 step 内完成。在一个 vLLM 实例上以最高半容量重放生产 trace，单个探测即可检测 256 token 及以上的缓存文本，优势至少 0.98。仅隐藏命中请求在 vLLM 和 SGLang 上一个探测即告失效；随机延迟必须达到约十倍以上的偏移量才能把优势降到 0.1；缩小共享范围也无法对此推断提供保证。由于任何可观察到的租户收益同时也是信号，我们证明无论提供者如何处理身份，受速率限制的租户从 k 个其他账号写入的内容中获得的收益至多为 k 乘以允许泄露量的量级；在零泄露时，只有提供者保留这些节省。精确隐藏在原则上可在单实例上实现，但仅暂停或扣留工作的机制对被跳过工作的时长只有近似估计，因此在 prefill 饱和时必须对每个可能包含命中的 step 进行填充，其代价随时间而非随命中次数增长。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 服务中跨租户缓存命中带来的侧信道泄露问题，通过追踪调度器把缓存节省的时间传递给后续请求的机制设计探测攻击，并证明隐藏命中与租户收益不可兼得的理论极限。

papers.title: Reliable Mining of Heterogeneous AI Coding-Agent Data: Context-Aware Prediction and Resource-Aware Ranking
papers.abstract: Operational records from AI coding agents differ across agents, repositories, tasks, and workflows. We study 71,677 pull requests (PRs) from six agents and show that pooling these records can reverse descriptive and predictive conclusions. PRs carrying a co-authorship trailer have a 55.6% merge rate, compared with 77.5% without the trailer, but removing the dominant agent flips this -21.8 percentage-point gap to +23.7 points. We treat this Simpson-type reversal as a data-veracity problem and represent source, environment, and workflow context in a feature cascade. Gradient-boosting merge-prediction AUC increases from 0.774 to 0.832; the advantage persists under temporal evaluation (0.801) and unseen repositories (0.807). The co-authorship coefficient changes from -1.09 to +1.44 after conditioning, whereas repository-clustered AIPW intervals show no stable adjusted trailer association. A strict PR-creation-time model reaches 0.741 AUC in standard evaluation and 0.710 on unseen repositories, although its temporal AUC falls to 0.641. Finally, a separately cross-fitted analysis of an observed-mode functional estimates a +12.3-point doubly robust gain at a 30% allocation budget on the non-Codex population, only 0.5 points above risk ranking. This last result is retrospective decision support over metadata states, not a causal effect of assigning human review.

translation.title: 异构 AI 编码智能体数据的可靠挖掘：上下文感知预测与资源感知排序
translation.abstract: AI 编码智能体的运维记录在智能体、仓库、任务和工作流之间存在差异。我们研究了来自六个智能体的 71,677 个 pull request（PR），表明合并这些记录可能逆转描述性和预测性结论。带有共同作者 trailer 的 PR 合并率为 55.6%，而无 trailer 的为 77.5%，但剔除占主导的智能体后，这一 -21.8 个百分点的差距会翻转为 +23.7 个百分点。我们将这种 Simpson 型逆转视为数据真实性（data-veracity）问题，并在特征级联中表示来源、环境和工作流上下文。梯度提升合并预测的 AUC 从 0.774 提升至 0.832；该优势在时间评估（0.801）和未见仓库（0.807）下仍然保持。条件化后共同作者系数从 -1.09 变为 +1.44，而基于仓库聚类的 AIPW 区间显示没有稳定的调整后 trailer 关联。严格的 PR 创建时间模型在标准评估中达到 0.741 AUC，在未见仓库上为 0.710，但其时间 AUC 降至 0.641。最后，对观测模式函数的独立交叉拟合分析估计，在非 Codex 人群中 30% 分配预算下 doubly robust 增益为 +12.3 个百分点，仅比风险排序高 0.5 个百分点。最后这一结果是对元数据状态的回溯性决策支持，而非分配人工审查的因果效应。
translation.brief: 解决多智能体 PR 数据合并导致的 Simpson 逆转等数据真实性偏差问题，通过在特征级联中引入来源、环境和工作流上下文来改进合并预测与资源分配排序。

papers.title: Simulating access to alcohol screening, brief intervention, referral to and receipt of specialty treatment for alcohol use disorder in California and Texas: A study protocol for an agent-based modeling study (AUDTxSim)
papers.abstract: Alcohol use disorder (AUD) affects millions of US adults. Primary care-based screening, brief intervention, and referral to treatment (SBIRT) is a leading strategy for identifying heavy drinking early, but access to primary care, screening, and specialty treatment differs markedly across subgroups. Whether scaling SBIRT and expanding treatment capacity narrows or widens these differences is unknown and cannot feasibly be tested in a randomized trial. We present AUDTxSim (AUD Treatment Simulation), a stochastic, spatially explicit, individual-based model of alcohol use, AUD, SBIRT, and specialty treatment for the adult populations of California and Texas. Agents represent every adult in synthetic populations of the two states (28.0 and 19.3 million adults), each geo-located to a Census tract and linked to nearby treatment facilities. In daily time steps, the model simulates: (1) annual transitions among eight alcohol use and AUD states; (2) healthcare visits, screening, brief intervention, and referral; (3) treatment seeking, standalone medication for AUD, mutual help, and requests for hospitalization, residential, or outpatient care; (4) a treatment manager that allocates individuals to facilities by preference, geography, and capacity, with telehealth substitution and waitlists; and (5) treatment progression, stepdown between levels of care, and post-treatment mutual help. It is implemented in Python with Repast4Py to run in parallel on a computing cluster. Once calibrated to state, rural-urban, and demographic targets for healthcare visits, heavy drinking and AUD prevalence, and mortality, AUDTxSim will project population-level and subgroup-specific effects of alternative SBIRT reach and treatment capacity scenarios on AUD prevalence, treatment receipt, and mortality. We report the model structure, decision logic, data sources, and calibration plan.

translation.title: 模拟加州和得州酒精使用障碍的筛查、简短干预、转介与专科治疗可及性：一项基于智能体建模的研究方案（AUDTxSim）
translation.abstract: 酒精使用障碍（AUD）影响数百万美国成年人。基于初级保健的筛查、简短干预和转介治疗（SBIRT）是早期识别重度饮酒的主要策略，但初级保健、筛查和专科治疗的可及性在不同亚组间差异显著。扩大 SBIRT 规模并增加治疗容量是缩小还是扩大这些差异尚不清楚，且无法通过随机试验进行检验。我们提出 AUDTxSim（AUD Treatment Simulation），一个针对加州和得州成年人群的随机、空间显式、基于个体的酒精使用、AUD、SBIRT 和专科治疗模型。智能体代表两个州合成人群中的每位成年人（2800 万和 1930 万成年人），每个智能体按地理位置对应一个人口普查区（Census tract）并关联到附近的治疗机构。模型以天为时间步长模拟：（1）八种酒精使用和 AUD 状态间的年度转移；（2）就医、筛查、简短干预和转介；（3）求治、AUD 独立药物治疗、互助组织以及住院、住院部或门诊护理请求；（4）根据偏好、地理和容量将个体分配到机构的治疗管理者，包括远程医疗替代和候补名单；（5）治疗进展、照护级别间的降级以及治疗后互助。模型用 Python 和 Repast4Py 实现以在计算集群上并行运行。在校准到州级、城乡和人口学层面的就医、重度饮酒和 AUD 患病率以及死亡率目标后，AUDTxSim 将预测不同 SBIRT 覆盖和治疗容量情景对 AUD 患病率、治疗接受和死亡率在人群和亚组层面的影响。我们报告了模型结构、决策逻辑、数据来源和校准计划。
translation.brief: 构建针对加州和得州成年人群的随机、空间显式基于个体模型 AUDTxSim，模拟 SBIRT 与专科治疗全流程，用于预测不同干预规模情景对人群和亚组 AUD 结局的影响。

papers.title: Beyond Service Discovery: Coverage Awareness in LLM-Driven Service Composition
papers.abstract: Large language models increasingly support the automated discovery and composition of services. In federated data ecosystems, this creates new opportunities for reusing existing data products and transformation services when constructing service-based data exchange modeled as data-sharing pipelines. However, finding relevant reusable assets does not imply that the available assets are sufficient to satisfy a consumer request. In this paper, we distinguish reuse discovery, the ability to identify relevant published assets, from reuse coverage, the extent to which the available assets support the transformations required by a request. We further consider coverage awareness, the ability of a composition system to recognize insufficient coverage. We investigate this distinction using PipeFinder, an LLM-driven framework for composing data-sharing pipelines, and evaluate 99 consumer requests against a fixed catalogue of data products and transformation services. Our experiments show that relevant data products can be discovered reliably, while successful composition remains considerably more difficult. More importantly, when required transformation services are missing, the framework typically constructs a pipeline from the available services rather than recognizing that the request cannot be satisfied. Explicitly incorporating coverage checking into the planning procedure substantially improves recognition of such cases. These results suggest that coverage awareness should be treated as an explicit concern in LLM-driven service composition and cannot be assumed to follow from improved discovery or model capability.

translation.title: 超越服务发现：LLM 驱动服务组合中的覆盖感知
translation.abstract: 大语言模型日益支持服务的自动发现与组合。在联邦数据生态系统中，这为构建以数据共享管道建模的基于服务的数据交换时复用现有数据产品和转换服务创造了新机会。然而，找到相关的可复用资产并不意味着可用资产足以满足消费者请求。本文区分复用发现（识别相关已发布资产的能力）与复用覆盖（可用资产对请求所需转换的支持程度），并进一步考虑覆盖感知，即组合系统识别覆盖不足的能力。我们使用 PipeFinder（一个 LLM 驱动的数据共享管道组合框架），针对固定的数据产品和转换服务目录评估 99 个消费者请求来考察这一区分。实验表明，相关数据产品可以被可靠地发现，而成功组合仍然相当困难。更重要的是，当所需的转换服务缺失时，框架通常会从可用服务构建管道，而不是识别出请求无法满足。在规划过程中显式纳入覆盖检查显著提升了对这类情况的识别。这些结果表明，覆盖感知应被视为 LLM 驱动服务组合中的显式关注点，不能假设它会随发现能力或模型能力的提升而自然具备。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 服务组合中可用资产不足以满足请求却仍强行组合的问题，提出在 PipeFinder 规划流程中显式加入覆盖检查以识别请求不可满足的情形。

papers.title: When Should Decision Models Compare Candidates?
papers.abstract: Language-model agents frequently select among candidate actions, such as tools and web elements. Should decision models score candidates independently or allow their scores to depend on other candidates? We investigate this question by comparing three approaches: Pointwise scoring, Setwise scoring, and Candidate Attention. Across five agent-decision benchmarks, Pointwise scoring remains competitive, while Setwise scoring performs better on some tool-selection and binary-decision tasks. Candidate Attention does not consistently improve upon Pointwise scoring, despite allowing cross-candidate interaction. Using two controlled synthetic tasks, we further examine whether models learn to use candidate-set information. With targeted relational training, Setwise models learn candidate dependencies and generalize to shifted inputs, while Candidate Attention shows weaker transfer. Our results show that access to other candidates does not guarantee effective comparison, and that its benefits depend on both task requirements and training.

translation.title: 决策模型何时应比较候选对象？
translation.abstract: 语言模型智能体经常需要在候选动作（如工具和网页元素）之间进行选择。决策模型应独立为候选对象打分，还是允许其分数依赖于其他候选对象？我们通过比较三种方法来研究这个问题：Pointwise 打分、Setwise 打分和 Candidate Attention。在五个智能体决策基准上，Pointwise 打分依然有竞争力，而 Setwise 打分在某些工具选择和二元决策任务上表现更好。尽管允许候选间交互，Candidate Attention 并未持续优于 Pointwise 打分。我们进一步用两个受控合成任务考察模型是否学会使用候选集信息。通过针对性的关系训练，Setwise 模型能学习候选间依赖并泛化到偏移输入，而 Candidate Attention 的迁移能力较弱。我们的结果表明，能访问其他候选对象并不保证有效比较，其收益取决于任务需求和训练方式。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 智能体决策时候选对象应独立打分还是相互比较的问题，通过对比 Pointwise、Setwise 和 Candidate Attention 三种打分方式及受控合成任务分析候选间交互何时有益。

papers.title: Words Speak Louder? Exploring the Language Shortcut of LLM-Driven Incomplete Multimodal Learning
papers.abstract: Is a face or a voice still heard once the words are known? Incomplete multimodal learning increasingly uses large language models (LLMs) as fusion engines: modality features enter as token blocks and missing modalities become placeholders. We find that LLM-driven fusion can override non-verbal evidence it can read. Contrasting its full-input prediction with counterfactual views, the same model shown one modality or no content, we identify language shortcuts. We build MR-Bench: MR-Bench-A types every test sample of four sentiment benchmarks; MR-Bench-H contains 900 human-validated clips (620 language-shortcut, LS; 280 non-verbal-shortcut, NS) from seven sources, and every model is scored on all of them. Zero-shot MLLMs solve at most 32.7% of the LS clips; adding the transcript to the muted video lowers vision-language accuracy by 46.1-53.1 points. Yet inverting a text-only model's answers solves 94.4%, so LS accuracy alone cannot establish use of non-verbal evidence. Inside the fusion LLM, fused states align increasingly with the text view late in the decoder. Counterfactual-View Reliability learning (CoVeR) trains views as unimodal judges and withholds fused supervision where they disagree. It achieves state-of-the-art results on five benchmarks without extra inference cost in accuracy mode. On MR-Bench-H, it reaches 61.7% LS and 93.6% NS accuracy; robust mode raises LS accuracy to 63.0% while lowering NS accuracy to 84.8%. Among LS clips solved without text, adding text causes errors on 30.1% with CoVeR versus 32.2% with LLM-Fusion. Project page: this https URL.

translation.title: 言语更有说服力？探索 LLM 驱动的不完整多模态学习中的语言捷径
translation.abstract: 一旦知道了话语内容，表情或声音还重要吗？不完整多模态学习越来越多地使用大语言模型（LLM）作为融合引擎：模态特征作为 token 块输入，缺失模态则变成占位符。我们发现 LLM 驱动的融合会覆盖它本可读取的非语言证据。通过将该模型的全输入预测与反事实视图（例如只展示一个模态或不展示任何内容）进行对比，我们识别出了语言捷径。我们构建了 MR-Bench：MR-Bench-A 对四个情感基准的每个测试样本进行类型标注；MR-Bench-H 包含来自七个来源的 900 个经人工验证的片段（620 个语言捷径 LS；280 个非语言捷径 NS），所有模型均在全部片段上评测。零样本 MLLM 最多只能解决 32.7% 的 LS 片段；给静音视频加上字幕文本会使视觉-语言准确率下降 46.1–53.1 个百分点。然而，反转纯文本模型的答案可解决 94.4% 的 LS 片段，因此仅凭 LS 准确率无法证明模型使用了非语言证据。在融合 LLM 内部，融合状态在解码器后期越来越与文本视图对齐。反事实视图可靠性学习（CoVeR）将各视图训练为单模态裁判，并在它们不一致时暂停融合监督。该方法在五个基准上取得最先进结果，且准确率模式下无额外推理开销。在 MR-Bench-H 上，它达到 61.7% 的 LS 准确率和 93.6% 的 NS 准确率；鲁棒模式将 LS 准确率提升至 63.0%，但 NS 准确率降至 84.8%。在无文本即可解决的 LS 片段中，加入文本后 CoVeR 在 30.1% 的样本上产生错误，而 LLM-Fusion 为 32.2%。项目页面：this https URL。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 融合中忽视非语言证据的语言捷径问题，通过构建 MR-Bench 基准诊断捷径并提出反事实视图可靠性学习（CoVeR）来约束融合行为。

papers.title: Straight to the Product: What Online Retailers Miss When Shoppers Ask AI First
papers.abstract: When people ask an AI assistant what to buy, what happens next at the store? We link the same people's assistant conversations to their later browsing at twenty large online retailers. People go to the product the assistant named: among shoppers who had not visited the store in the past week, visits to the named product within a day rise from 0.02 to 2.07 per 100 answers (+2.0 points [1.7, 2.4]), and on days with a product-page visit at the store, 44% show a product from their own answer, against 1.5% for a matched answer given to someone else. The result replicates in a separate five-month period. Few arrive through the assistant's link: 89% of visits carry no sign of it, and 54% follow a web search, the same share as their usual visits. When a search comes just before the first visit, it names the answer's product 28% of the time (1% in earlier weeks), as if the search box were an address bar. The chat names the product; the store logs a search. Once there, shoppers keep browsing. We propose product follow-through, the share of answers followed by a visit to the product they named, as a way to evaluate shopping assistants and agents by what people do next: it needs no referral data or provider logs and can be computed for each assistant.

translation.title: 直达商品：当购物者先问 AI 时，在线零售商错过了什么
translation.abstract: 当人们向 AI 助手询问该买什么时，接下来在商店会发生什么？我们将同一批人的助手对话与他们在二十家大型在线零售商的后续浏览行为关联起来。人们会前往助手提到的商品：在近一周内未访问该商店的购物者中，100 条回答内一天内访问被提及商品的次数从 0.02 升至 2.07（+2.0 个百分点 [1.7, 2.4]）；在有商品页访问的日子里，44% 访问了来自自己回答中的商品，而匹配给他人回答的比例仅为 1.5%。该结果在另一个独立的五个月时间段内得到复现。很少有人通过助手的链接到达：89% 的访问没有任何链接痕迹，54% 通过网页搜索进入，与他们通常的访问比例相同。当搜索恰好发生在首次访问之前时，28% 的情况下搜索词是回答中的商品（此前几周仅 1%），仿佛搜索框被当作地址栏使用。聊天中提到了商品；商店日志里记录的却是一次搜索。一旦到达，购物者会继续浏览。我们提出商品跟进率（product follow-through），即回答之后用户访问其所提及商品的比例，作为根据用户后续行为评估购物助手和智能体的方式：它无需推荐数据或服务商日志，且可针对每个助手分别计算。
translation.brief: 解决如何评估 AI 购物助手的实际影响问题，通过将用户对话与零售商浏览日志关联，提出以用户是否访问所提商品来衡量的“商品跟进率”指标。

papers.title: Where the Evidence Lives: Measuring Privacy and Diagnosability of Exported AI-Agent Traces
papers.abstract: Execution traces help diagnose AI-agent failures, but sharing them can expose customer identities. For example, detecting that an agent handled the wrong customer's records requires knowing whether the records belong to the requested customer, but not necessarily knowing who that customer is. Our executable benchmark measures what a trace export reveals and whether a proposed repair restores the correct output in synthetic multi-tenant workflows. Conventional redaction can remove evidence needed for repair while leaving encoded identifiers recoverable. Two exports preserve ownership comparisons by reporting the match as a comparison fact or by using pseudonyms consistent within each execution. Both preserve the original diagnostic program's repairs. The tested identifier matchers identify no requested customer from either export. An independently written program produces correct outputs on 39 of 42 faulty cases with comparison facts and on all 42 with execution-scoped pseudonyms. Row counts still expose identities. With prior knowledge of customers' row counts, an attacker uniquely identifies the requested customer in 97 of 240 executions under each of the 15 export policies. Removing selected counters from the comparison-fact export stops this attack and preserves the original program's repairs. The benchmark lets engineers test what their diagnostic program can repair and what an attacker can still infer from the same export.

translation.title: 证据之所在：测量导出 AI 智能体执行轨迹的隐私性与可诊断性
translation.abstract: 执行轨迹有助于诊断 AI 智能体故障，但共享它们可能暴露客户身份。例如，检测智能体是否处理了错误客户的记录，需要知道记录是否属于所请求的客户，但未必需要知道该客户是谁。我们的可执行基准在合成多租户工作流中测量轨迹导出所泄露的信息，以及提议的修复方案能否恢复正确输出。传统的脱敏处理可能删除修复所需的证据，同时留下可被恢复的编码标识符。两种导出方式能保留所有权比较：一种是将匹配结果作为比较事实报告，另一种是在每次执行内使用一致的假名。两者都保留了原始诊断程序的修复能力。所测试的标识符匹配器无法从任一导出中识别出所请求的客户。一个独立编写的程序在比较事实方式下对 42 个故障案例中的 39 个给出正确输出，在执行范围假名方式下对全部 42 个给出正确输出。但行数仍会泄露身份：在预先知道客户行数的情况下，攻击者在 15 种导出策略的每一种下，都能在 240 次执行中的 97 次里唯一识别出所请求的客户。从比较事实导出中移除特定的计数器可以阻止该攻击，同时保留原程序的修复能力。该基准让工程师能够测试其诊断程序可修复什么、以及攻击者从同一导出中还能推断什么。
translation.brief: 解决共享 AI 智能体执行轨迹时隐私泄露与故障可诊断性的冲突问题，通过可执行基准量化导出策略的隐私与修复能力，并设计了保留所有权比较的假名/比较事实导出方案。

papers.title: Deploying a Control-Logic LLM Assistant in Air-Gapped Power Plants: Lessons in Source Authority and Bounded Retrieval
papers.abstract: Deploying Large Language Model (LLM) assistants in industrial operational technology environments poses constraints largely absent from cloud applications: site policies restrict engineering and operational data from leaving the plant, on-premises compute is limited, and incorrect causal attribution can mislead incident response. We report lessons from deploying a control-logic evidence layer that underpins a broader on-premises operator assistance system at two gas power plants. Two prototypes revealed where generative models added avoidable uncertainty and cost. The first used a Vision Language Model (VLM) to reconstruct control topology from PDF printouts routinely exchanged by engineers. Across the full 6,979-page document, extraction reached 0.51 connection precision and required 3.1 hours on 4xH200 GPUs; consultation with controls engineers then revealed a native structured export from the authoring system. The second used an LLM tool-calling agent to plan repeatedly over eight predefined graph operations. In a controlled benchmark of 40 template-generated questions, replacing this agent with explicit execution plans reduced mean token use by 20x and median latency by 3x, with identical retrieved node sets across repeated runs. The deployed design ingests the authoritative export into a versioned knowledge graph, executes bounded graph operations in fixed software, and confines the local LLM to fallback intent classification and evidence-grounded explanation. At one site, the graph contains 221K nodes across seven controllers. Our experience suggests a practical division of labor for high-consequence AI: LLMs interpret natural-language requests and explain results, while deterministic software constructs and retrieves technical evidence grounded in authoritative sources. Abstention, entity disambiguation, graph versioning, and read-only integration provide additional safeguards.

translation.title: 在物理隔离（Air-Gapped）电厂部署控制逻辑 LLM 助手：关于来源权威性与受限检索的经验
translation.abstract: 在工业运营技术环境中部署大语言模型（LLM）助手面临云端应用中基本不存在的约束：站点政策限制工程和运行数据离开电厂、本地算力有限，且错误的因果归因可能误导事故响应。我们报告在两座燃气电厂部署支撑更广泛本地操作员辅助系统的控制逻辑证据层的经验。两个原型揭示了生成式模型带来的可避免的不确定性和成本。第一个原型使用视觉语言模型（VLM）从工程师日常交换的 PDF 打印件中重建控制拓扑；在全部 6,979 页文档上，抽取的连接精确率为 0.51，需在 4xH200 GPU 上耗时 3.1 小时；随后与控制工程师的沟通发现源系统本身就有原生结构化导出。第二个原型使用 LLM 工具调用智能体反复在八种预定义图操作上进行规划。在一个包含 40 个模板生成问题的受控基准中，用显式执行计划替代该智能体使平均 token 用量降低 20 倍、中位延迟降低 3 倍，且多次运行检索到的节点集合完全相同。部署的设计将权威导出数据导入版本化知识图谱，在固定软件中执行受限图操作，并将本地 LLM 限定于回退意图分类和基于证据的解释。在一个站点，图谱包含跨七个控制器的 221K 节点。我们的经验表明，面向高风险 AI 的实用分工是：LLM 解释自然语言请求并解释结果，而确定性软件基于权威来源构建和检索技术证据。拒绝回答、实体消歧、图谱版本化和只读集成提供了额外保障。
translation.brief: 解决在物理隔离电厂中部署 LLM 助手的不确定性与成本问题，通过以权威结构化导出构建版本化知识图谱、用确定性软件执行受限检索，并将 LLM 限定于意图分类与结果解释。

papers.title: Implicit-Reasoning-Enabled Elastic Semantic Communications for AI-Agent Networks
papers.abstract: AI-agent networks introduce new communication demands driven by proactive interactions and autonomous task execution. Existing adaptive semantic communication schemes primarily adjust semantic representations and resource configurations within predefined processing scales and capability sets, which may be insufficient for evolving task requirements. To address this gap, we introduce elastic semantic communications (ESC), a task-driven framework that extends semantic adaptation to the runtime execution and participation of task-supporting capabilities. ESC comprises two complementary dimensions: vertical elasticity adjusts the execution intensity of existing capabilities, while horizontal elasticity reconfigures the participating capability set. The framework connects these dimensions through the expected marginal value of additional information and computation. To realize ESC, we propose an implicit-reasoning-enabled device--edge mechanism that supports variable-depth local inference through shared-parameter state updates and edge-side continuation through wireless transfer of intermediate reasoning states. Experiments on Sudoku-Extreme demonstrate that the benefits of additional inference depend on wireless conditions, while task-aware edge invocation can preserve task accuracy with substantially lower state-transfer overhead.

translation.title: 面向 AI 智能体网络的隐式推理赋能的弹性语义通信
translation.abstract: AI 智能体网络由主动交互和自主任务执行引入了新的通信需求。现有自适应语义通信方案主要在预定义的处理尺度和能力集合内调整语义表示和资源配置，可能不足以应对不断变化的任务需求。为填补这一空白，我们提出弹性语义通信（ESC），一个任务驱动的框架，将语义适配扩展到支持任务的能力的运行时执行与参与。ESC 包含两个互补维度：垂直弹性调整现有能力的执行强度，水平弹性重新配置参与的能力集合。该框架通过额外信息与计算的期望边际价值连接这两个维度。为实现 ESC，我们提出一种隐式推理赋能的设备—边缘机制，通过共享参数状态更新支持可变深度的本地推理，并通过无线传输中间推理状态实现边缘侧的延续。在 Sudoku-Extreme 上的实验表明，额外推理的收益取决于无线条件，而任务感知的边缘调用可以在显著降低状态传输开销的同时保持任务准确率。
translation.brief: 解决现有语义通信无法适应 AI 智能体网络动态任务需求的问题，提出弹性语义通信框架及基于隐式推理的设备—边缘机制，实现推理深度的垂直与水平弹性调整。

papers.title: When the Cheapest Feasible Router Fails: Auditing Deployment Commitments in Cost-Aware LLM Routing
papers.abstract: Cost-aware LLM routing often selects the cheapest policy meeting empirical risk and coverage constraints. Yet a router that passes an audit can violate its fixed service contract on new requests, even when candidate policies are constructed independently. We study this deployment-commitment decision with disjoint construction, audit, and test samples. Across 19 RouterBench task families, the cheapest audit-feasible router deploys in 91.82% of opportunities but violates the held-out contract in 32.22% of deployments. We introduce Menu-Aware Routing Commitment (MARC), which qualifies policies using audit evidence and a serving-cost tolerance to retain the apparent winner, deploy a supported alternative, or defer. Its practical policywise variant (MARC-P) reduces observed conditional failure to 0.73% at 85.79% deployment, with higher serving cost; fixed-margin and formal risk-control procedures provide competitive alternatives. Nested audits show how added evidence changes deployable policy sets, and learned semantic routing exhibits the same commitment failure. These results establish deployment commitment as a distinct operational decision connecting router evaluation, service reliability, and inference cost.

translation.title: 当最便宜可行路由器失效时：成本感知 LLM 路由中的部署承诺审计
translation.abstract: 成本感知 LLM 路由通常选择满足经验风险和覆盖约束的最便宜策略。然而，即使候选策略是独立构建的，通过审计的路由器在新请求上也可能违反其固定的服务契约。我们在互不重叠的构建、审计和测试样本下研究这一部署承诺决策。在 19 个 RouterBench 任务族上，最便宜的可审计路由器在 91.82% 的机会中部署，却在 32.22% 的部署中违反了保留测试契约。我们提出 Menu-Aware Routing Commitment（MARC），利用审计证据和服务成本容忍度对策略进行资格认定，以保留表面最优者、部署有支持的替代方案或推迟部署。其实用的逐策略变体（MARC-P）在 85.79% 的部署率下将观测到的条件失败率降至 0.73%，但服务成本更高；固定边际和形式化风险控制程序提供了有竞争力的替代方案。嵌套审计展示了新增证据如何改变可部署策略集，学习型语义路由也表现出相同的承诺失败。这些结果确立了部署承诺作为一个独特运营决策的地位，连接了路由器评估、服务可靠性和推理成本。
translation.brief: 解决审计通过的路由器在新数据上违反服务契约的部署承诺问题，核心方法是提出基于审计证据与服务成本容忍度的 MARC 框架来决定保留、替换或推迟部署。

papers.title: FinVerify: A Verification Framework for Financial Agents
papers.abstract: Financial agents produce numerical claims that can be wrong even when their calculations execute correctly, due to mismatched reporting periods, unsupported sources, incompatible units, or incorrect financial definitions. We introduce FinVerify, an evidence-grounded framework for verifying financial agents' numerical claims. Based on an analysis of 190 incorrect trajectories from the Agent Finance Reasoning dataset, we define five error categories--temporal integrity, source fidelity, comparability, accounting integrity, and financial-model fidelity--and operationalize them as verification protocols. An LLM structures claims and supporting evidence, while deterministic validators check financial requirements; when authoritative formulas are available, Z3 checks consistency with grounded inputs. FinVerify accepts only if all applicable checks pass, rejects proven violations, and abstains when evidence is insufficient. We evaluate the framework against a Direct baseline and an LLM judge across five fixed-candidate benchmarks. On Agent Finance Reasoning, accepted-claim precision increases from 56.4% for the LLM judge to 76.7% at 81.2% coverage. On XBRLFiling, FinVerify achieves 99.8% accepted-claim precision and 97.0% decision accuracy; on FinanceBench-67, it reaches 87.9% accepted-claim precision versus 69.7% for the judge. Improvements are smaller on FinQA and TAT-QA, where authoritative evidence is limited. These results suggest that explicit, evidence-backed verification can improve financial-agent reliability while exposing trade-offs between correctness, false rejection, and abstention.

translation.title: FinVerify：面向金融智能体的验证框架
translation.abstract: 金融智能体产生的数值论断即使计算正确执行也可能出错，原因包括报告期间不匹配、来源缺乏支持、单位不兼容或财务定义错误。我们提出 FinVerify，一个以证据为基础的金融智能体数值论断验证框架。基于对 Agent Finance Reasoning 数据集中 190 条错误轨迹的分析，我们定义了五类错误——时间完整性、来源忠实性、可比性、会计完整性和金融模型忠实性——并将其转化为验证协议。一个 LLM 负责结构化论断和支持证据，而确定性验证器检查金融要求；当存在权威公式时，Z3 检查与落地输入的一致性。FinVerify 仅在所有适用检查通过时接受，拒绝已证实的违规，在证据不足时弃权。我们在五个固定候选基准上与直接基线和 LLM 评审进行对比评估。在 Agent Finance Reasoning 上，接受论断的精度从 LLM 评审的 56.4% 提升到 81.2% 覆盖率下的 76.7%。在 XBRLFiling 上，FinVerify 达到 99.8% 的接受论断精度和 97.0% 的决策准确率；在 FinanceBench-67 上，其接受论断精度为 87.9%，而评审为 69.7%。在权威证据有限的 FinQA 和 TAT-QA 上改进较小。这些结果表明，显式的、基于证据的验证可以提升金融智能体的可靠性，同时揭示了正确性、误拒和弃权之间的权衡。
translation.brief: 解决金融智能体数值论断不可靠的验证问题，核心方法是定义五类错误验证协议并结合 LLM 结构化、确定性验证器与 Z3 一致性检查进行证据支撑的验证。

papers.title: TrainExplorer: Autonomous LLM Post-Training via Plan-and-Decouple Exploration
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents can automate model post-training, accelerating progress toward recursive self-improvement. Despite their promise, existing approaches remain under-explored and face two main challenges: (1) strategy lock-in that limits exploration beyond the initial strategy; and (2) coupled execution that obscures the effects of individual modifications. To address these challanges, we propose TrainExplorer, a multi-agent framework for autonomous post-training, that incorporates strategy planning and execution decoupling, to achieve broaden strategy exploration. First, strategy planning draws on scientific literature to construct a candidate search space of training strategies. Then, decoupled execution enables single-component interventions and attribution to guide strategy exploration. Extensive experiments on PostTrainBench demonstrate that TrainExplorer achieves a weighted aggregate score of 39.02, outperforming Claude Code using the same LLM by 7.32 and surpassing GPT-5.6 Sol-powered Codex, which scores 36.23. Code will be available.

translation.title: TrainExplorer：通过规划与解耦探索实现自主 LLM 后训练
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的智能体可以自动化模型后训练，加速迈向递归自我改进。尽管前景可观，现有方法仍然探索不足，并面临两个主要挑战：（1）策略锁定，限制了超越初始策略的探索；（2）耦合执行，模糊了单个修改的效果。为解决这些挑战，我们提出 TrainExplorer，一个用于自主后训练的多智能体框架，融合策略规划与执行解耦，以实现更广泛的策略探索。首先，策略规划借鉴科学文献构建训练策略的候选搜索空间。然后，解耦执行支持单组件干预和归因，以指导策略探索。在 PostTrainBench 上的大量实验表明，TrainExplorer 取得了 39.02 的加权总分，比使用相同 LLM 的 Claude Code 高出 7.32，并超过由 GPT-5.6 Sol 驱动、得分为 36.23 的 Codex。代码将公开。
translation.brief: 解决自动化 LLM 后训练中的策略锁定与执行耦合问题，核心方法是结合基于文献的策略规划与解耦执行的多智能体框架。

papers.title: Learning from Distribution: Rethinking One-Hot Supervision for ASR and QA in Speech Language Models
papers.abstract: Speech language models (SLMs) exhibit strong capabilities in automatic speech recognition (ASR) and general-purpose speech understanding, yet ASR-specific training often degrades spoken question answering (QA) performance. We revisit this conflict from the perspective of task-specific input--output mappings and one-hot supervision. Our findings reveal pronounced task-asymmetric effects: ASR-only training severely limits QA capability, whereas QA-only training retains reasonable ASR performance. We hypothesize that the relatively deterministic mapping of ASR, combined with single-reference supervision, biases models toward transcription-specific behavior. Motivated by this perspective, we advocate broadening ASR learning objectives while preserving recognition accuracy. We propose Learning from Distribution (LFD), which aligns speech-conditioned predictions with the conditional output distributions of a pretrained text LLM. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LFD improves both ASR and QA performance, exhibits superior data efficiency, and remains effective under full-parameter fine-tuning. CoT-ASR further supports the broader applicability of our proposed supervision principle.

translation.title: 从分布中学习：重新思考语音语言模型中 ASR 与 QA 的独热监督
translation.abstract: 语音语言模型（SLM）在自动语音识别（ASR）和通用语音理解方面表现出强大能力，但 ASR 专用训练往往会降低语音问答（QA）性能。我们从任务特定的输入-输出映射和独热监督的角度重新审视这一冲突。研究发现揭示出显著的任务不对称效应：仅 ASR 训练严重限制 QA 能力，而仅 QA 训练则保留了合理的 ASR 性能。我们假设 ASR 相对确定性的映射，加上单参考监督，使模型偏向转写特定行为。基于这一视角，我们主张在保持识别准确率的同时拓宽 ASR 学习目标。我们提出 Learning from Distribution（LFD），将语音条件下的预测与预训练文本 LLM 的条件输出分布对齐。大量实验表明，LFD 同时提升了 ASR 和 QA 性能，表现出更优的数据效率，并在全参数微调下仍然有效。CoT-ASR 进一步支持了我们所提出的监督原则的更广泛适用性。
translation.brief: 解决 ASR 专用训练损害语音 QA 性能的任务冲突问题，核心方法是提出 LFD 将语音条件预测与预训练文本 LLM 的条件输出分布对齐以拓宽监督目标。

papers.title: Abstention Direction in Large Language Models: Mechanistic Interpretability of Abstention Across Query Ambiguity, Knowledge Limits, and Safety Alignment
papers.abstract: Abstention, the withholding of a response by a large language model (LLM) under uncertainty or safety risks, is essential for trustworthy models. The causes of abstention fall into three perspectives: ambiguity in the Query (Q), limits of Model Knowledge (MK), and misalignment with Human Values (HV). However, prior analyses of internal representations have focused on HV, using a refusal direction computed from harmful and harmless queries. No study has analyzed the three perspectives jointly. We therefore extend the refusal direction framework to all three perspectives. Specifically, for each perspective, we construct counterfactual pairs that share a template and differ only in the abstention-inducing factor, and compute an abstention direction by normalizing the difference in mean activations between the two polarities. Activation steering experiments show that intervening in middle layers increases or decreases abstention across all three perspectives. Moreover, steering yields cross-perspective effects, indicating that the abstention directions share a common directional component.

translation.title: 大语言模型中的弃答方向：跨查询歧义、知识极限与安全对齐的弃答机制可解释性
translation.abstract: 弃答，即大语言模型（LLM）在不确定性或安全风险下拒绝给出回答，对可信模型至关重要。弃答的原因可归为三个视角：查询（Q）中的歧义、模型知识（MK）的极限，以及与人类价值观（HV）的不对齐。然而，先前对内部表示的分析集中于 HV，使用由有害与无害查询计算得到的拒绝方向。尚无研究联合分析这三个视角。因此，我们将拒绝方向框架扩展到所有三个视角。具体而言，对于每个视角，我们构建共享模板、仅在诱发弃答因素上不同的反事实对，并通过归一化两个极性之间平均激活的差异来计算弃答方向。激活引导实验表明，在中间层进行干预可以在所有三个视角上增加或减少弃答。此外，引导产生跨视角效应，表明弃答方向共享一个共同的方向性成分。
translation.brief: 解决大语言模型弃答内部机制缺乏跨歧义、知识与安全三视角联合分析的问题，核心方法是用反事实对计算各视角的弃答方向并通过激活 steering 验证其共同成分。

papers.title: Overview of the Plagiarism Detection Task at PAN 2026
papers.abstract: The generative plagiarism detection task at PAN 2026 aims at retrieving the original scientific sources for given automatically generated textual plagiarism. We created two novel datasets of synthetically generated plagiarism following the premise of a malicious actor trying to generate papers with minimal effort while evading detection of undisclosed re-use. We utilized four widely available LLMs: GPT-OSS 120B, Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen 3.5 27B FP8, and DeepSeek-R1 Distill Llama 8B. In this task overview paper, we outline the creation of this dataset and summarize and compare the results of all participants with three baselines. For this year's task, we received 26 submissions from six teams that significantly outperformed our baselines.

translation.title: PAN 2026 抄袭检测任务综述
translation.abstract: PAN 2026 生成式抄袭检测任务旨在为给定的自动生成文本抄袭检索出原始科学文献来源。我们按照恶意行为者试图以最小成本生成论文同时规避未披露复用检测的前提，构建了两个新颖的合成抄袭数据集。我们使用了四种广泛可用的 LLM：GPT-OSS 120B、Llama 3.1 8B、Qwen 3.5 27B FP8 和 DeepSeek-R1 Distill Llama 8B。在这篇任务综述论文中，我们介绍了该数据集的构建过程，并总结和比较了所有参赛者与三个基线方法的结果。今年该任务共收到来自六个团队的 26 份提交，其性能显著超过了我们的基线。
translation.brief: 该任务通过用多个 LLM 生成规避检测的合成抄袭数据集，评测为自动生成抄袭文本检索原始科学来源的方法。

papers.title: IntentFlow: An Intent-Driven Real-Time Multimodal Search System with Image-Text Queries at Xiaohongshu
papers.abstract: Multimodal search with image-text queries helps users find notes in user-generated content (UGC) communities and serves as a key search tool for multimodal search agents. For such queries, query-note relevance depends on the user's retrieval intent and cannot be determined by visual or topical similarity alone. Simply reranking visual search results cannot fully address this challenge, as notes relevant to the user's intent may be missing from the initial candidate set. This motivates explicit intent modeling to align candidate retrieval and reranking under consistent relevance criteria. We present IntentFlow, an intent-driven real-time multimodal search system deployed at Xiaohongshu over an index on the order of ten billion entries. IntentFlow represents retrieval objectives with a hierarchical intent taxonomy and uses intent-specific relevance criteria to guide data construction, representation learning, and reranking. An offline agentic data workflow acquires candidates and verifies their relevance under these criteria to produce training supervision. The embedding model combines intent-aware contrastive learning, graded ranking, and distribution distillation, while a compact reranker assesses query-candidate evidence conditioned on predicted hierarchical intents. Evaluations demonstrate that IntentFlow delivers substantial gains in search engagement while supporting real-time search at industrial scale. In a user-level A/B test on the Xiaohongshu platform, IntentFlow outperforms the existing production system based on visual search followed by reranking, achieving relative gains of 28.17% in Top-4 query click-through rate, 18.96% in query click-through rate, and 12.56% in average time spent on search results pages per user. Production monitoring records an end-to-end P50 latency of 1.07 s.

translation.title: IntentFlow：小红书基于意图驱动的图文查询实时多模态搜索系统
translation.abstract: 图文查询的多模态搜索帮助用户在用户生成内容（UGC）社区中查找笔记，并作为多模态搜索智能体的关键搜索工具。对于此类查询，查询-笔记相关性取决于用户的检索意图，无法仅凭视觉或主题相似度判定。简单地对视觉搜索结果重排无法完全解决这一挑战，因为与用户意图相关的笔记可能在初始候选集中缺失。这促使我们进行显式意图建模，以在一致的相关性标准下对齐候选检索与重排。我们提出 IntentFlow，一个部署于小红书的意图驱动实时多模态搜索系统，其索引规模达百亿量级。IntentFlow 用层次化意图分类体系表示检索目标，并使用意图特定的相关性标准来指导数据构建、表示学习和重排。离线 agentic 数据工作流获取候选并在这些标准下验证其相关性，以产生训练监督。嵌入模型结合了意图感知对比学习、分级排序和分布蒸馏，而一个紧凑的重排器在预测的层次化意图条件下评估查询-候选证据。评估表明，IntentFlow 在支持工业规模实时搜索的同时带来了显著的搜索参与度提升。在小红书平台的用户级 A/B 测试中，IntentFlow 超越了现有基于视觉搜索加重排的生产系统，Top-4 查询点击率相对提升 28.17%，查询点击率提升 18.96%，用户在搜索结果页的平均停留时长提升 12.56%。生产监控记录的端到端 P50 延迟为 1.07 秒。
translation.brief: 该系统针对图文查询中意图决定相关性的问题，通过层次化意图分类体系与意图感知的检索、训练和重排机制实现实时多模态搜索。

papers.title: MAGE: Meta-path Adaptive Graph Evidence for Transferable Multimodal Graph Learning
papers.abstract: Multimodal graphs integrate textual and visual attributes with relational structures, providing a rich representation of complex real-world data. To enable the broad applicability and reuse of graph models, it is crucial for models trained on source graphs to generalize to unseen graph domains. However, this is challenging because cross-modal interactions among neighbors and the neighboring information needed for prediction can vary across target nodes and graph domains. This gives rise to two key challenges: adaptive cross-modal neighborhood fusion, which captures and integrates cross-modal interactions among neighbors to accommodate variations across nodes and domains; and target-specific evidence selection, which identifies the neighboring textual and visual information needed for each target node to support LLM-based prediction. In light of these challenges, we propose MAGE (Meta-path Adaptive Graph Evidence Prompting), a framework for transferable multimodal graph learning. MAGE represents textual and visual node views separately in a heterogeneous graph and introduces two complementary components. Meta-path Adaptive Multimodal Propagation (MAMP) adaptively aggregates neighborhood information along heterogeneous meta-paths and compresses it into graph-aware soft tokens. Evidence-Guided Instruction Tuning (EGIT) selects relevant neighboring evidence for each query and incorporates its graph-aware representations into instructions for a frozen multimodal LLM. Together, these components support transfer from multiple source graphs to unseen target graphs without target-domain parameter updates. Experiments with three source graphs and four unseen target graphs demonstrate strong cross-domain transfer performance on node classification and link prediction, without requiring parameter updates on the target domains.

translation.title: MAGE：面向可迁移多模态图学习的元路径自适应图证据
translation.abstract: 多模态图将文本和视觉属性与关系结构相整合，为复杂现实数据提供了丰富的表示。为了让图模型具有广泛的适用性和可复用性，在源图上训练的模型必须能泛化到未见过的图域。然而这极具挑战性，因为邻居间的跨模态交互以及预测所需的邻居信息会随目标节点和图域而变化。这带来两个关键挑战：自适应跨模态邻居融合，即捕捉并整合邻居间的跨模态交互以适应节点与域的变化；以及目标特定证据选择，即为每个目标节点识别所需的邻居文本与视觉信息以支持基于 LLM 的预测。针对这些挑战，我们提出 MAGE（Meta-path Adaptive Graph Evidence Prompting），一个可迁移多模态图学习框架。MAGE 在异构图中分别表示文本和视觉节点视图，并引入两个互补组件：元路径自适应多模态传播（MAMP）沿异构元路径自适应聚合邻居信息并将其压缩为图感知软 token；证据引导指令微调（EGIT）为每个查询选择相关邻居证据，并将其图感知表示融入冻结多模态 LLM 的指令中。二者共同支持从多个源图到未见目标图的迁移，且无需目标域参数更新。在三个源图和四个未见目标图上的实验表明，该方法在节点分类和链接预测上具有强大的跨域迁移性能，且无需在目标域进行参数更新。
translation.brief: 针对多模态图跨域迁移难题，该框架通过元路径自适应多模态传播和证据引导指令微调，将图证据注入冻结多模态 LLM 以实现无需目标域更新的图迁移学习。

papers.title: KVMARK: Fragile Watermarking for KV-Cache Integrity in Latent Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Latent multi-agent communication directly transfers Key-Value (KV) cache tensors between transformer-based agents, bypassing text serialization entirely. While computationally efficient and reasoning accurate, this communication channel is opaque and vulnerable to man-in-the-middle tampering, a threat vector unaddressed by existing text-based or behavioral watermarks, which cannot operate on continuous internal representations. To address this vulnerability, we propose KVMark, a training-free, zero-bit KV-cache watermarking framework to verify inter-agent handoff integrity. Our framework introduces four core technical components: (1) position-dependent sign patterns that guarantee first-order statistical invisibility while preserving downstream attention survival; (2) per-head sign patterns with aligned detection to defeat head-averaging attacks; (3) a three-tier depth-aware strength schedule that equalizes detection sensitivity across transformer layers while maintaining invisibility against nine statistical profiling strategies; and (4) content-bound key derivation that cryptographically binds watermarks to input contexts, preventing replay attacks under Kerckhoffs's principle. Empirical evaluation on a four-agent latent pipeline demonstrates $100\%$ detection across $1{,}500$ handoffs with a $0.0\%$ false positive rate ($\text{AUROC}=1.0$), $100\%$ layer-level tamper localization ($17/17$ attacked layers identified with $0/19$ false positives), and no statistically significant reasoning accuracy degradation across four benchmarks ($N{=}300$--$500$). Furthermore, the framework enables multi-hop cascade verification to isolate compromised agents (500/500 detection at three hops), withstands adaptive white-box adversaries and the Out-of-Sight DiffMean attack (up to $\alpha=8.0$), and generalizes seamlessly to Qwen3-8B without re-tuning (1,500/1,500 TPR).

translation.title: KVMARK：面向潜在多智能体系统中 KV-Cache 完整性的脆弱水印
translation.abstract: 潜在多智能体通信直接在基于 transformer 的智能体之间传递 Key-Value（KV）cache 张量，完全绕过文本序列化。虽然这种通信在计算上高效且推理准确，但该信道是不透明的，容易受到中间人篡改——这一威胁向量是现有基于文本或行为的水印无法应对的，因为它们无法作用于连续的内部表示。为解决这一脆弱性，我们提出 KVMark，一个免训练、零比特的 KV-cache 水印框架，用于验证智能体间交接的完整性。该框架包含四个核心技术组件：（1）位置相关的符号模式，在保证一阶统计不可见性的同时保留下游注意力存活；（2）逐头符号模式与对齐检测，以击败头平均攻击；（3）三层深度感知强度调度，在各 transformer 层间均衡检测灵敏度，同时抵御九种统计剖析策略；（4）内容绑定的密钥派生，以密码学方式将水印绑定到输入上下文，依据 Kerckhoffs 原则防止重放攻击。在四智能体潜在流水线上的实证评估显示：1500 次交接中检测率 100%、误报率 0.0%（AUROC=1.0），层级篡改定位率 100%（17/17 受攻击层被识别，0/19 误报），且在四个基准（N=300–500）上推理精度无统计显著下降。此外，该框架支持多跳级联验证以隔离被攻陷的智能体（三跳 500/500 检测），可抵御自适应白盒对手和 Out-of-Sight DiffMean 攻击（最高 α=8.0），并可无缝泛化到 Qwen3-8B 而无需重新调参（1,500/1,500 TPR）。
translation.brief: 针对潜在多智能体 KV cache 传输易受中间人篡改的问题，提出免训练的零比特 KV-cache 脆弱水印框架以验证智能体交接完整性并定位篡改层。

papers.title: Embeddings vs. Grep: Rethinking the Dense Advantage in Code Search
papers.abstract: Code-search benchmarks show dense encoders well ahead of BM25, yet coding agents do well with \texttt{grep}. What does this dense advantage measure? Existing benchmarks cannot tell: they use curated queries, old code and a handicapped BM25. To find out, we build Repo-Premium, a realistic repository-level code-search benchmark. It ranks files in real repositories, with curated and raw queries in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Rust and Java, pull requests from 2022 to 2026, and a preregistered test pool over $91$ repositories. Our experiments trace the advantage to two sources: evaluation choices that favor dense retrieval, such as splitting files into chunks for BM25 and counting edited tests as relevant, and queries that lack the code's rare identifiers. Expanding the query with LLM-written identifiers (generate-then-grep) helps BM25 far more than dense retrieval, letting it match dense retrieval in every Python pool, even on pull requests opened after the LLM was released. No method we tried predicts which retriever will win on a given query. From these results we derive three guidelines: measure dense gains against a fair lexical baseline, fuse dense retrieval with BM25, and add the code's words to queries that lack them.

translation.title: Embeddings 与 Grep：重新思考代码搜索中的稠密检索优势
translation.abstract: 代码搜索基准显示稠密编码器远超 BM25，然而 coding agents 用 grep 却表现良好。这种稠密优势到底衡量了什么？现有基准无法回答：它们使用精选查询、陈旧代码并被削弱的 BM25。为此，我们构建了 Repo-Premium，一个贴近现实的仓库级代码搜索基准。它对真实仓库中的文件排序，包含 Python、JavaScript、TypeScript、Go、Rust 和 Java 的精选与原始查询、2022 至 2026 年的 pull request，以及超过 91 个仓库的预注册测试池。我们的实验将这种优势追溯到两个来源：偏向稠密检索的评测选择（如将文件切块供 BM25 使用、将被修改的测试算作相关），以及查询中缺少代码的罕见标识符。用 LLM 生成的标识符扩展查询（generate-then-grep）对 BM25 的帮助远大于稠密检索，使其在所有 Python 测试池中都能匹敌稠密检索，即使是在 LLM 发布之后才创建的 pull request 上也是如此。我们尝试的所有方法都无法预测某个查询上哪个检索器会胜出。基于这些结果，我们提出三条准则：用公平的词法基线衡量稠密检索收益、将稠密检索与 BM25 融合、为缺少代码词汇的查询补充这些词汇。
translation.brief: 该论文构建了贴近现实的仓库级代码搜索基准 Repo-Premium，揭示稠密检索优势主要源于有偏评测和查询缺少代码标识符，并提出改进评测与检索的三条准则。

papers.title: Agent-Guided Configuration Tuning for SMT Solvers
papers.abstract: SMT solvers expose many configuration choices that determine how well their existing algorithms perform on a workload. We present, to our knowledge, the first workflow that uses general-purpose LLM agents to tune SMT solver configurations. Agents read solver documentation, source code, and persistent experiment records to propose option changes, and a deterministic harness measures each proposal, validates the returned models, and selects changes separately for each competition Division. Over roughly nine weeks, our tuning campaign recorded 4,545 proposals for cvc5 across 13 Divisions and 36 logics. We evaluate the tuned configurations on the 2026 and 2025 SMT-COMP ModelValidation benchmarks under a 24-second cutoff. On problems not used for training, they validate more problems than official cvc5 in ten of the 13 Divisions in 2026 and in eight in 2025, with geometric-mean gains of 7.8% and 6.8% across Divisions. On the complete official selections, which include training problems, the tuned floating-point counts exceed those of every individual competition participant in both years. Further studies show how configuration changes make existing algorithms effective by changing access to strategies, scheduling, and option compatibility, and how benchmark families trade off against one another. The agents' experiment traces contain hypothesis-based proposals in every tuning group, and 64.3% of the extracted hypotheses draw on prior measurements. These results show that agent-guided tuning can specialize a mature SMT solver and that accumulated experimental evidence informs sustained search.

translation.title: Agent 引导的 SMT 求解器配置调优
translation.abstract: SMT 求解器提供了大量配置选项，决定了其现有算法在工作负载上的表现。据我们所知，我们提出了首个使用通用 LLM agent 调优 SMT 求解器配置的工作流。Agent 阅读求解器文档、源代码和持久化实验记录来提出配置修改建议，一个确定性 harness 对每个建议进行测量、验证返回的模型，并为每个竞赛 Division 单独选择修改。在大约九周时间里，我们的调优活动针对 cvc5 记录了跨 13 个 Division 和 36 个逻辑的 4,545 条建议。我们在 2026 和 2025 年 SMT-COMP ModelValidation 基准上以 24 秒超时评估调优后的配置。在未用于训练的问题上，这些配置在 2026 年 13 个 Division 中的 10 个、2025 年的 8 个中验证的问题多于官方 cvc5，各 Division 几何平均提升分别为 7.8% 和 6.8%。在包含训练问题的完整官方选题上，调优后的浮点数成绩在两年中都超过了所有单独的竞赛参赛者。进一步研究展示了配置修改如何通过改变策略访问、调度和选项兼容性使现有算法生效，以及基准测试族之间如何相互权衡。Agent 的实验轨迹在每个调优组中都包含基于假设的建议，且 64.3% 的提取假设利用了先前的测量结果。这些结果表明 agent 引导的调优可以使成熟的 SMT 求解器专门化，且积累的实验证据能够支撑持续的搜索。
translation.brief: 解决如何自动调优 SMT 求解器配置的问题，采用读取文档、源码与实验记录的 LLM agent 结合确定性测试 harness 提出并验证配置修改。

papers.title: PromptPoseFX: Authoring Pose-Driven Visual Effects through Augmented Prompting and Interactive Refinement
papers.abstract: Human pose-driven visual effects offer a compelling way for enhancing video expressiveness and storytelling. Authoring such effects with traditional video editing tools is a complex and time-consuming task that requires considerable technical expertise and manual effort. While generative AI models can simplify the workflow by reducing manual scripting through language-driven generation, existing approaches suffer from imprecise alignment between visual effects and pose data, failure to preserve original video content, and limited support for fine-grained, iterative refinement. To address these challenges, we present PromptPoseFX, an interactive system that allows creators to author pose-driven visual effects through augmented language prompts and interactive refinement. Our system leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to translate high-level user intent into parameterized procedural graphics scripts, automatically mapping pose-tracking data to specific effect parameters, allowing precise alignment with human motion. This script-based approach manages effects as independent layers, thereby preserving the original content of the underlying video. To reduce language ambiguity, our interface offers controls across spatial, temporal, and parameter domains, enabling the precise, intuitive, and iterative authoring of pose-driven visual effects. We evaluated PromptPoseFX through a comparative study against a text-only LLM interface, followed by an exploratory study. In the comparative study, participants rated PromptPoseFX significantly higher than the text-only baseline on measures of perceived control and precision. The exploratory study examined usability and creativity support in open-ended authoring tasks.

translation.title: PromptPoseFX：通过增强提示与交互式精修创作姿态驱动的视觉特效
translation.abstract: 基于人体姿态的视觉特效为增强视频表现力和叙事提供了有力手段。使用传统视频编辑工具创作此类特效是一项复杂且耗时的任务，需要大量技术专长和手工操作。虽然生成式 AI 模型可以通过语言驱动生成减少手工脚本编写来简化工作流，但现有方法存在视觉特效与姿态数据对齐不精确、无法保留原始视频内容以及缺乏对细粒度迭代精修支持等问题。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 PromptPoseFX，一个让创作者通过增强语言提示和交互式精修来创作姿态驱动视觉特效的交互式系统。我们的系统利用大语言模型（LLM）将高层用户意图转化为参数化的程序化图形脚本，自动将姿态跟踪数据映射到具体特效参数，实现与人体运动的精确对齐。这种基于脚本的方式将特效管理为独立图层，从而保留底层视频的原始内容。为减少语言歧义，我们的界面提供跨空间、时间和参数域的控制，支持精确、直观且可迭代的姿态驱动特效创作。我们通过与纯文本 LLM 界面的对比研究及一项探索性研究评估了 PromptPoseFX。在对比研究中，参与者在感知控制和精度指标上对 PromptPoseFX 的评分显著高于纯文本基线。探索性研究考察了开放式创作任务中的可用性和创造力支持。
translation.brief: 解决姿态驱动视觉特效创作繁琐且对齐不精确的问题，采用 LLM 将语言提示转化为参数化程序化图形脚本并结合交互式精修。

papers.title: EVIDENT: Evaluating Evidence Grounding in GUI Agents
papers.abstract: GUI agents are increasingly evaluated by whether they complete web tasks, but surface success can hide a critical failure: the final answer may not be supported by evidence observed during navigation. We introduce EVIDENT, an evidence-driven benchmark for evaluating whether GUI agents ground their decisions in observable web evidence. EVIDENT contains 220 real-world English and Korean tasks spanning semantic grounding, contextual inference, and visual grounding, each paired with human-curated evidence metadata specifying what must be verified. We further separate surface task completion from evidence-grounded success using three metrics: TSR, ESR, and GSR, which respectively measure outcome success, required evidence observation, and claim-level evidence support. Experiments on commercial and open-source GUI agents reveal substantial gaps between surface success and evidence-grounded success, especially in contextual and visual tasks. These results show that current evaluations can overestimate agent reliability and highlight the need to assess not only whether agents answer, but whether they verify.

translation.title: EVIDENT：评估 GUI Agent 的证据依据
translation.abstract: GUI agent 越来越多地以是否能完成 web 任务来评估，但表面上的成功可能掩盖一个关键失败：最终答案可能没有导航过程中观察到的证据支持。我们提出 EVIDENT，一个以证据为驱动的基准，用于评估 GUI agent 是否将其决策建立在可观察的 web 证据之上。EVIDENT 包含 220 个涵盖英语和韩语的真实任务，涉及语义依据、上下文推理和视觉依据，每个任务都配有由人工整理的证据元数据，指明必须验证的内容。我们进一步用三个指标将表面任务完成与基于证据的成功区分开来：TSR、ESR 和 GSR，分别衡量结果成功、必要证据的观察以及断言级别的证据支持。在商业和开源 GUI agent 上的实验揭示了表面成功与基于证据的成功之间的巨大差距，尤其是在上下文和视觉任务中。这些结果表明当前评估可能高估 agent 的可靠性，并凸显了不仅需要评估 agent 是否回答，还要评估其是否进行验证的必要性。
translation.brief: 解决 GUI agent 评估只看任务结果而忽视证据依据的问题，构建含人工证据元数据的 EVIDENT 基准并用 TSR/ESR/GSR 三指标加以衡量。

papers.title: How Reliable Is Visual Token Selection? Rethinking Pruning in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract: Visual token pruning improves the efficiency of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by removing redundant visual tokens, yet the reliability of existing selection signals has not been systematically examined. We analyze token selection under semantics-preserving perturbations and across representative pruning criteria, revealing two limitations. First, attention-based importance shifts non-uniformly under perturbations, so magnitude alone cannot distinguish stable evidence from unstable saliency (local instability). Second, attention- and diversity-based methods select substantially different subsets despite comparable performance, showing that useful evidence is not confined to a unique subset (global inconsistency). These findings motivate reliable token-set construction. We instantiate this perspective in CoRePruner, a training-free framework combining instruction-aware diversity with reliability-aware attention. Across image benchmarks, multiple MLLM architectures, and token budgets, CoRePruner improves performance, especially under aggressive pruning, and remains competitive on video benchmarks. Our results establish reliability as a central consideration in visual token selection.

translation.title: 视觉 Token 选择有多可靠？重新思考多模态大语言模型中的剪枝
translation.abstract: 视觉 token 剪枝通过移除冗余视觉 token 提升多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的效率，但现有选择信号的可靠性尚未得到系统性检验。我们在保语义扰动下并跨代表性剪枝准则分析 token 选择，揭示了两个局限。首先，基于注意力的重要性在扰动下非均匀地变化，因此仅凭大小无法区分稳定的证据与不稳定的显著性（局部不稳定性）。其次，基于注意力和基于多样性的方法尽管性能相当，却选择了差异很大的子集，表明有用的证据并不局限于唯一的子集（全局不一致性）。这些发现促使我们构建可靠的 token 集合。我们将这一视角具体化为 CoRePruner，一个结合指令感知多样性与可靠性感知注意力的免训练框架。在图像基准、多种 MLLM 架构和 token 预算上，CoRePruner 提升了性能，尤其在激进剪枝下，并在视频基准上保持竞争力。我们的结果将可靠性确立为视觉 token 选择中的核心考量。
translation.brief: 解决视觉 token 剪枝选择信号不可靠的问题，分析其局部不稳定性与全局不一致性并提出免训练的 CoRePruner 结合指令感知多样性与可靠性感知注意力。

papers.title: Optimizing Query Decomposition for Reliable Validation
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have made querying databases more accessible, but cannot guarantee that the SQL they generate is correct. Without a trusted reference query, a validator (human or LLM) must decide whether a generated query answers the intended question. Enterprise questions often require queries with multiple joins, nested subqueries, and multi-level aggregation, and validating such a query in one judgment is error-prone. Decomposition simplifies this task by rewriting a query into smaller queries (blocks) that recompose to the original, each checked against its own sub-question. Decompositions differ, however: smaller blocks make each judgment easier but require more judgments, and the best balance depends on the validator's ability. We formulate validation-aware query decomposition as an optimization problem. Just as a query optimizer chooses among equivalent plans by estimated cost, we choose among decompositions by how reliably a given validator is expected to check them. We model how task difficulty and validator ability jointly affect reliability and define an objective that balances reliability against the number of judgments. Over a space of decompositions derived from logical-plan rewrites, our search finds an optimal one. We implement it in DecoVal, a pipeline that presents each block with its sub-question and input interface, combines local verdicts into a query-level decision, and localizes errors to blocks. A user study shows that decomposition helps human validators catch and locate errors: with DecoVal, participants caught 91% of the errors, up from 36% without decomposition, and located the error in nearly every rejection. Experiments on BEAVER and Spider 2.0 with LLM validators show that DecoVal also raises error-detection recall over whole-query validation while keeping precision high, and that the best granularity depends on the validator.

translation.title: 面向可靠验证的查询分解优化
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）使查询数据库更加便捷，但无法保证其生成的 SQL 是正确的。在没有可信参考查询的情况下，验证者（人类或 LLM）必须判断生成的查询是否回答了预期的问题。企业问题往往需要包含多表连接、嵌套子查询和多级聚合的查询，一次性验证这样的查询容易出错。分解通过将查询重写为可重组回原查询的较小查询（块），每块对照其自身的子问题进行检查，从而简化这一任务。然而分解方式各不相同：更小的块使每次判断更容易但需要更多判断，最佳平衡取决于验证者的能力。我们将验证感知的查询分解形式化为一个优化问题。正如查询优化器通过估计代价在等价执行计划之间选择，我们依据给定验证者预期的检查可靠性在不同分解之间选择。我们建模任务难度和验证者能力如何共同影响可靠性，并定义了在可靠性与判断数量之间权衡的目标函数。在由逻辑计划重写导出的分解空间上，我们的搜索找到最优分解。我们将其实现为 DecoVal，一个流水线：为每个块呈现其子问题和输入接口，将局部判定合并为查询级决策，并将错误定位到块。用户研究表明分解帮助人类验证者发现并定位错误：使用 DecoVal 时参与者发现了 91% 的错误，而不使用分解时仅为 36%，且几乎每次拒绝都能定位错误。在 BEAVER 和 Spider 2.0 上使用 LLM 验证者的实验表明，DecoVal 相比整查询验证还提高了错误检测召回率，同时保持高精确率，且最佳粒度取决于验证者。
translation.brief: 解决复杂 SQL 查询整体验证不可靠的问题，将验证感知的查询分解形式化为优化问题并实现 DecoVal 流水线按块验证与定位错误。

papers.title: Beyond the Patch: Reconstructing an Incomplete-Fix Patch Bypass in LLM Agent Frameworks with Control-Gated, Benign Probes
papers.abstract: Replaying a vulnerability's original proof-of-concept after patching tests whether its reported trigger remains reproducible, but does not establish that the underlying security invariant holds on other code paths. We present a benign, control-gated reconstruction method and a pilot study across four LLM agent frameworks and four invariant classes. For PraisonAI, we compare original-trigger replay (B0) with a distinct sibling-path probe (M). We also perform five before/after reconstructions across Langroid, Agno, and CrewAI. Each run reports VIOLATION, NO_VIOLATION_OBSERVED, or INCONCLUSIVE, gated by a positive authorized control. Probes use inert markers or builtins-reachability checks. At PraisonAI 4.6.31, the original tool-loading trigger is blocked while the tool_override path still violates the invariant. This reproduces the publicly documented CVE-2026-44334 bypass of CVE-2026-40287; neither tested path shows a violation at 4.6.32. For CrewAI, we observe a violation in tested release 1.11.0 and confinement in 1.11.1, without claiming the earliest fixed release. Fourteen harness-validation scenarios produced their expected verdicts. Only one same-version B0-versus-M divergence is demonstrated. The PraisonAI probes invoke loader functions directly and establish boundary behavior under the supplied setup, not a full end-to-end exploit. A non-violation verdict applies only to the tested probe, version, and configuration and is not a proof of safety. This pilot reconstructs a known incomplete fix; it neither introduces a new testing technique nor estimates vulnerability prevalence.

translation.title: 超越补丁：利用控制门控的良性探针重构 LLM Agent 框架中的不完整修复补丁绕过
translation.abstract: 在打补丁后重放漏洞的原始 proof-of-concept 只能测试其报告的触发路径是否仍可复现，并不能证明底层安全不变量在其他代码路径上依然成立。我们提出一种良性的、控制门控的重构方法，并在四个 LLM agent 框架和四类不变量上开展了试点研究。针对 PraisonAI，我们将原始触发路径重放（B0）与不同的兄弟路径探针（M）进行对比。我们还在 Langroid、Agno 和 CrewAI 上进行了五次修复前后的重构。每次运行在获得授权的正向控制门控下，报告 VIOLATION、NO_VIOLATION_OBSERVED 或 INCONCLUSIVE 三种结论之一。探针使用惰性标记或 builtins 可达性检查。在 PraisonAI 4.6.31 版本中，原始的工具加载触发路径被阻断，而 tool_override 路径仍违反不变量。这复现了公开记录的 CVE-2026-44334 对 CVE-2026-40287 的绕过；而在 4.6.32 版本中两条测试路径均未显示违规。对于 CrewAI，我们在测试的 1.11.0 版本中观察到违规，在 1.11.1 版本中观察到约束生效，但不声称其为最早修复版本。十四个 harness 验证场景均产出了预期结论。实验仅展示了一次同一版本下 B0 与 M 的结论分歧。PraisonAI 探针直接调用 loader 函数，在给定设置下确立的是边界行为，而非完整的端到端 exploit。非违规结论仅适用于所测试的探针、版本和配置，并非安全性证明。本试点研究重构了一个已知的不完整修复，既不引入新的测试技术，也不估计漏洞的普遍性。
translation.brief: 针对补丁只堵原始触发路径的问题，用控制门控的良性兄弟路径探针在四个 LLM agent 框架中重构并验证不完整修复的绕过。

papers.title: ReconPotBench: Evaluating LLM Honeypots in Multi-Round Linux Reconnaissance
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to build interactive honeypots, yet existing evaluations mainly assess isolated command outputs and cannot determine whether a system remains believable when later commands depend on earlier results. We present ReconPotBench, a multi-round benchmark for Linux reconnaissance honeypots. It contains 1{,}032 three-round reconnaissance interactions across eight reconnaissance categories, with reference outputs collected from a real Linux environment. Under a unified testing protocol, we compare Cowrie, open-source LLMs, and closed-source LLMs along three dimensions: round-level authenticity, cross-round contextual consistency, and hacker-oriented reconnaissance value. Results show that multi-round evaluation exposes failures hidden by single-round testing, as authenticity declines with interaction depth and both open-source and closed-source LLMs struggle to maintain coherent state across rounds. LLM-based honeypots nevertheless outperform Cowrie in authenticity and reconnaissance value, while Cowrie remains more consistent because of its rigid templated behavior. Category-level analysis further shows that tasks requiring systems to preserve network relationships across rounds are harder than tasks centered on explicit entities such as ports. ReconPotBench enables reproducible evaluation of LLM honeypots across authenticity, entity consistency, and hacker-perspective utility in dependent multi-round interactions. The dataset is available at: this https URL

translation.title: ReconPotBench：在多轮 Linux 侦察中评估 LLM 蜜罐
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于构建交互式蜜罐，但现有评估主要考察孤立的命令输出，无法判断当后续命令依赖先前结果时系统是否仍然可信。我们提出 ReconPotBench，一个面向 Linux 侦察蜜罐的多轮基准。它包含 1,032 个三轮侦察交互，覆盖八个侦察类别，参考输出采集自真实 Linux 环境。在统一测试协议下，我们从三个维度比较 Cowrie、开源 LLM 和闭源 LLM：轮次级真实性、跨轮上下文一致性以及对黑客的侦察价值。结果表明，多轮评估揭示了单轮测试掩盖的失败：真实性随交互深度下降，开源和闭源 LLM 都难以在轮次之间维持连贯状态。尽管如此，基于 LLM 的蜜罐在真实性和侦察价值上优于 Cowrie，而 Cowrie 因其僵化的模板化行为保持更高的一致性。类别级分析进一步表明，需要系统跨轮保留网络关系的任务比以端口等显式实体为中心的任务更难。ReconPotBench 使得在真实性、实体一致性和黑客视角实用性方面对 LLM 蜜罐进行可复现评估成为可能。数据集可在：this https URL 获取。
translation.brief: 针对现有蜜罐评估无法测试跨轮依赖一致性的问题，构建多轮 Linux 侦察基准 ReconPotBench，从真实性、一致性和侦察价值三方面评估 LLM 蜜罐。

papers.title: RemeshingAgent: An Iterative Agent for Repair-Based Decimation of Generated Building Meshes
papers.abstract: Aggressively simplifying a generated high-poly building mesh to 0.5-1% of its faces confronts a hard limit. The surface looks complete, yet the mesh is topologically shattered: 10^3-10^4 connected components and non-manifold thin walls. Below a certain budget, every practical decimator "melts": it deletes parts, welds thin walls, or breaks the error tolerance. We attribute this to instance-specific pathology: which components are significant and where the cliff sits vary from mesh to mesh, so no single fixed algorithm suffices, and decimation becomes an iterative loop of cleaning, simplifying, and verifying. We present RemeshingAgent, an agent that turns this loop into a validated process. The melting follows from a triangle-budget decomposition into curvature, crease, component, and genus terms: below the component floor, no output satisfies the repair contract, and cleaning first is the theory-mandated response. At a 0.5% budget the agent stays topology-clean where QEM and vertex clustering melt, matches a commercial remesher on 20 unseen city buildings, and on the 24 training buildings a nine-participant single-workstation blind study prefers our outputs 168:48 (p = 0.0195, subject-level sign test). The trained skill deploys as retrieval replay: 11.7 seconds per mesh on CPU, with no LLM calls.

translation.title: RemeshingAgent：一种基于修复的生成建筑网格迭代抽取 Agent
translation.abstract: 将生成的高面数建筑网格激进地简化至 0.5-1% 的面数会遭遇一个硬性极限。表面看起来完整，但网格在拓扑上是破碎的：包含 10^3-10^4 个连通分量和非流形薄壁。低于某个预算时，每个实用的抽取器都会“熔化”：删除部件、焊接薄壁或破坏误差容限。我们将此归因于实例特有的病理：哪些分量是重要的、悬崖位于何处因网格而异，因此没有单一的固定算法足够，抽取成为清理、简化和验证的迭代循环。我们提出 RemeshingAgent，一个将该循环转化为已验证过程的 agent。熔化现象源于将三角形预算分解为曲率、折痕、分量和亏格各项：低于分量下限时，没有任何输出满足修复契约，先清理是理论所要求的应对。在 0.5% 预算下，该 agent 在 QEM 和顶点聚类都熔化的情况下保持拓扑干净，在 20 个未见过的城市建筑上与商业 remesher 相当，且在 24 个训练建筑上，一项九人单工作站盲测以 168:48 偏好我们的输出（p = 0.0195，受试级符号检验）。训练得到的技能以检索重放方式部署：CPU 上每个网格 11.7 秒，无需 LLM 调用。
translation.brief: 针对高面数建筑网格在极低预算下拓扑破碎导致传统抽取器失效的问题，将清理-简化-验证循环形式化为迭代 agent RemeshingAgent，并在部署时用检索重放替代 LLM 调用。

papers.title: VAHBench: A Harness Benchmark for Agentic Long-Video Generation
papers.abstract: AI agents are commonly used for everyday information retrieval and coding. We ask whether they can also interpret human requests and turn them into complete videos. We introduce VAHBench, a benchmark that tests this ability through five short-drama briefs specifying story, characters, dialogue and duration. Agents plan and carry out production using shared generation tools. Evaluation combines video completeness and basic quality with checks of production reliability and reporting accuracy. Across 240 runs covering 48 configurations of general-purpose and video-specific agents, higher quality scores do not necessarily mean more complete delivery. Missing episodes, repeated footage and static filler reveal gaps between producing a video file and fulfilling the brief. Added composition tools help some agents but do not consistently improve performance. VAHBench measures how well agents translate user intent into finished video content and helps identify where that process breaks down.

translation.title: VAHBench：面向 Agentic 长视频生成的测试基准
translation.abstract: AI agent 普遍用于日常信息检索和编码。我们询问它们是否也能解读人类请求并将其转化为完整视频。我们提出 VAHBench，一个通过五份短剧简报测试该能力的基准，简报规定了故事、角色、对白和时长。Agent 使用共享的生成工具进行规划和制作。评估将视频完整性和基本质量与制作可靠性及汇报准确性检查相结合。在覆盖通用型和视频专用 agent 的 48 种配置、共 240 次运行中，更高的质量分数并不一定意味着更完整的交付。缺失的剧集、重复的片段和静态填充揭示了生成视频文件与完成简报之间的差距。增加的组合工具对某些 agent 有帮助，但并不能持续提升性能。VAHBench 衡量 agent 将用户意图转化为成片视频内容的能力，并有助于识别该过程中的失效环节。
translation.brief: 针对无法评估 agent 能否将用户简报完整转化为成片视频的问题，构建 VAHBench 基准，从完整性、质量、制作可靠性和汇报准确性多维度考察 agentic 长视频生成。

papers.title: Changing a View Is Not Amending a Record: Timing and Visibility in a Model of Public Correction
papers.abstract: An accusation may remain on the public record after its author has changed their mind. Observers can respond either to what a person says now or to an earlier statement that has never been explicitly amended. We examine the consequences of these two signals with a generative agent-based model that separates private evidence updates, current expression, and revisions linked to a specific declaration. In paired worlds, evidence, prehistory, and opportunities to revisit that declaration remain fixed. When expression and amendment are synchronized and fully observed, the feedback channels produce identical trajectories. With sparse review, record-based feedback leaves 19.44 percentage points more eligible accusations unamended after 24 rounds (paired-world 95 percent bootstrap interval 13.89 to 25.31). The comparison averages 50 eligible worlds, containing 556 agents, from 128 newly generated worlds. Event traces show how a persistent public cue changes subsequent amendment propensity; an exact small-state calculation independently establishes the timing boundary. Reducing record salience can erase or reverse the increment, and a generic held-state process reproduces the dynamics. The findings show when current expression ceases to track correction of a particular public statement.

translation.title: 改变观点不等于更正记录：公开更正模型中的时机与可见性
translation.abstract: 一项指控在其作者已经改变想法之后，可能仍留在公开记录中。观察者可以回应一个人现在的言论，或回应一条从未被明确更正的早期声明。我们使用一个生成式 agent 模型考察这两种信号的后果，该模型将私下证据更新、当前表达和与特定声明相关联的更正分离开来。在配对世界中，证据、历史以及重审该声明的机会保持不变。当表达与更正同步且被完全观测时，两条反馈通道产生相同的轨迹。在稀疏审查下，基于记录的反馈在 24 轮后使未更正的合格指控多出 19.44 个百分点（配对世界 95% bootstrap 区间 13.89 至 25.31）。该比较对来自 128 个新生成世界中包含 556 个 agent 的 50 个合格世界取平均。事件轨迹展示了一个持久的公开线索如何改变后续的更正倾向；一个精确的小状态计算独立确立了时机边界。降低记录的显著性可以消除或逆转该增量，且一个通用的保持状态过程可复现该动态。研究结果揭示了当前表达在何时不再追踪对特定公开声明的更正。
translation.brief: 研究指控在作者改变想法后仍留存于公开记录的问题，用生成式 agent 模型比较即时表达与显式更正两种反馈通道，揭示稀疏审查下公开记录的滞后如何阻碍更正。

papers.title: RoShift: Lazy Shift and Weight-aware Rotation for Activation Sparsity in LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Activation sparsity accelerates LLM decoding by skipping unnecessary weight reads and computation. However, SiLU-based LLMs exhibit little natural sparsity, and imposing high sparsity can substantially degrade accuracy. We propose RoShift, a training-free method that transforms activations into sparsity-friendly representations. RoShift introduces lazy shift, which recenters SiLU activation distributions around zero and defers correction to the end of the FFN to obtain additional sparsity. It also reduces sparsification-induced output error through rotation that jointly accounts for activation and weight information. By fusing the corrections required for shifting and rotation, RoShift translates these gains into decoding speedup. At 50% and 60% sparsity, RoShift improves average accuracy over TEAL by 1.60 and 3.29 percentage points, respectively, across five models. It achieves up to $1.72\times$ decoding speedup over the dense model on an RTX 5090 at 50% sparsity and yields a better accuracy-speedup Pareto frontier than TEAL. Code is available at this https URL

translation.title: RoShift：面向大语言模型推理激活稀疏性的惰性平移与权重感知旋转
translation.abstract: 激活稀疏性通过跳过不必要的权重读取和计算来加速 LLM 解码。然而，基于 SiLU 的 LLM 几乎没有天然稀疏性，且施加高稀疏性会显著降低准确率。我们提出 RoShift，一种免训练方法，可将激活变换为利于稀疏化的表示。RoShift 引入惰性平移（lazy shift），将 SiLU 激活分布重新居中于零附近，并将修正推迟到 FFN 末尾以获得额外稀疏性。它还通过同时考虑激活与权重信息的旋转，减少稀疏化引起的输出误差。通过融合平移和旋转所需的修正，RoShift 将这些收益转化为解码加速。在 50% 和 60% 稀疏度下，RoShift 在五个模型上分别比 TEAL 平均提升 1.60 和 3.29 个百分点的准确率。在 50% 稀疏度下，它在 RTX 5090 上比稠密模型实现最高 1.72 倍的解码加速，并取得优于 TEAL 的准确率-加速 Pareto 前沿。代码见此 URL。
translation.brief: 解决 SiLU 模型激活稀疏性低且高稀疏化损精度的问题，采用免训练的惰性平移与权重感知旋转将激活变换为稀疏友好表示以实现解码加速。

papers.title: Weight-Space Programming Changes How an LLM Uses Python for Computational Biology
papers.abstract: Weight-space programming allows a language model to edit another model's weights without gradient-based training. We used Claude Opus 5.5 to edit Qwen3.5-0.8B and investigated how the edits changed its use of Python on computational biology problems. We compared four initial edited checkpoints with the original model on 50 test problems across three test seeds, yielding 600 paired evaluations. Strictly correct answers increased from 44 to 77, and technically correct answers, which included correct final values rejected for formatting, increased from 64 to 100. Repeated Python calls decreased from 1,834 to 1,044. Among the 64 pairs in which only the edited response was technically correct, the original model had already computed the correct value in 36 but did not submit a technically correct final answer. The edited model corrected the computation in 13 of the 64 pairs. With six additional checkpoints on the same 50 problems, technically correct answers rose from 96 to 154 across 900 pairs. We explored three selected problems with ten test seeds for each of ten checkpoints. On the melting-temperature problem, correct Python outputs decreased from 60 to 22 while technically correct final answers increased from 0 to 18. Weight editing changed both the calculations Qwen ran and whether it submitted a correct answer.

translation.title: 权重空间编程改变了 LLM 在计算生物学中对 Python 的使用方式
translation.abstract: 权重空间编程允许一个语言模型在无需基于梯度的训练的情况下编辑另一个模型的权重。我们使用 Claude Opus 5.5 编辑 Qwen3.5-0.8B，并研究这些编辑如何改变其在计算生物学问题上对 Python 的使用。我们将四个初始编辑后的检查点与原始模型在三个测试种子下的 50 个测试问题上进行对比，共获得 600 次成对评估。严格正确的答案从 44 增加到 77，技术正确答案（包括因格式原因被拒绝但最终值正确的答案）从 64 增加到 100。重复的 Python 调用从 1,834 次减少到 1,044 次。在仅编辑后回答为技术正确的 64 对中，原始模型有 36 对已经计算出正确值但未提交技术正确的最终答案。编辑后的模型在 64 对中的 13 对修正了计算。在同一 50 个问题上增加六个检查点后，技术正确答案在 900 对中从 96 上升到 154。我们对十个检查点中的三个选定问题各使用十个测试种子进行探索。在熔化温度问题上，正确的 Python 输出从 60 降至 22，而技术正确的最终答案从 0 增至 18。权重编辑既改变了 Qwen 运行的计算，也改变了它是否提交正确答案。
translation.brief: 解决不训练而改进小模型计算生物学解题行为的问题，采用权重空间编程（由 Claude 编辑 Qwen3.5-0.8B 权重）改变其 Python 使用与提交正确答案的能力。

papers.title: ToolGraph as a Q-Function for Test-Time Scaling of Tool-Use Agents
papers.abstract: Tool-use agents must chain interdependent calls, yet which outputs satisfy which later inputs in a deployed catalog is not something a general-purpose language model reliably infers from tool descriptions alone. We compile that structure once into a reusable external representation. ToolGraph is a directed, weighted dependency graph over a tool catalog: parameter matching and interventional probes, which execute a candidate chain with and without its proposed predecessor, propose edges whose evidence is combined into an edge confidence. Prior work uses such graphs to retrieve tools, search for tool paths, or score the next call. We ask instead whether the same structure can supply a \emph{multi-step} value by composing graph paths into a goal-conditioned action value \(Q(s,a,g)\). We study three estimators (dynamic programming over entity sets, a GraphSAGE estimator distilled from it, and an LLM scorer conditioned on graph evidence) plus a verbalizer that returns action--goal feedback to the agent, which keeps final action selection. Across two tool-use benchmarks and three backbones, we compare value ranking against personalized-PageRank retrieval over the identical graph, and against direct and reflective agents. Composition pays off only when the estimator also reads the concrete state: the LLM estimator improves on PageRank in every benchmark--backbone setting, by \(8.3\) points on average, while the two purely structural estimators fall below it, because a value defined over tool types cannot separate a correct tool called with a wrong argument. Graph construction is a one-time cost; we report it separately rather than assume it amortized away (at our scale it is comparable to request-time cost) and sweep four knobs controlling how much graph evidence to expose against success and tokens.

translation.title: 作为工具使用智能体测试时扩展 Q 函数的 ToolGraph
translation.abstract: 工具使用智能体必须串联相互依赖的调用，然而在已部署的工具目录中，哪些输出满足哪些后续输入，并非通用语言模型仅凭工具描述就能可靠推断的。我们将该结构一次性编译为可复用的外部表示。ToolGraph 是工具目录上的有向加权依赖图：通过参数匹配和干预式探测（分别执行含与不含候选前驱的调用链）提出边，并将其证据合并为边置信度。已有工作使用此类图来检索工具、搜索工具路径或对下一次调用打分。我们转而探究同一结构能否通过将图路径组合为目标条件动作价值 Q(s,a,g) 来提供多步价值。我们研究了三种估计器（实体集上的动态规划、由其蒸馏的 GraphSAGE 估计器、以图证据为条件的 LLM 打分器），以及一个向智能体返回动作-目标反馈的 verbalizer，最终动作选择仍由智能体完成。在两个工具使用基准和三个骨干模型上，我们将价值排序与同一图上的个性化 PageRank 检索、以及直接型和反思型智能体进行对比。只有当估计器同时读取具体状态时，组合才见效：LLM 估计器在所有基准-骨干设置中都优于 PageRank，平均提升 8.3 分，而两个纯结构估计器则低于 PageRank，因为定义在工具类型上的价值无法区分以错误参数调用的正确工具。图构建是一次性成本；我们单独报告该成本而非假定其已摊销（在我们的规模下它与请求时成本相当），并扫描了四个控制向智能体暴露多少图证据的旋钮，以观察其对成功率和 token 数的影响。
translation.brief: 解决工具智能体难以从工具描述推断调用间依赖的问题，将工具依赖编译为 ToolGraph 并组合图路径构成目标条件 Q 函数用于测试时多步价值估计。

papers.title: Language Models Meet Vibration Testing for LEO Constellation Satellites with Calibrated Response Prediction from Few-show Sweeps
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly drive engineering analysis end to end, turning textual records into the inputs of numerical programs, but a plausible and wrong value can pass silently into a decision. We propose deterministic validation gates for LLM-driven engineering analysis, a general paradigm in which a typed configuration produced by LLMs is consumed only after it passes deterministic checks on units, physical consistency, verbatim quotes, agreement between independent models, consistency with measurement exports and the applicability of trained models. The gates target hallucinations from two directions, since quote checking catches fabricated content while agreement between models catches errors of omission that quote checking misses. We instantiate the paradigm on sine vibration acceptance testing for low Earth orbit mega-constellation satellites, where DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Qwen-plus read Chinese test records and extract a configuration of 76 fields. Fact-level F1 ranged from 0.98 to 1.0 on five input variants, with all repairs frozen on development inputs and evaluated on held-out inputs. With all gates, 20 of 20 configurations produced notching results bit for bit identical to the gold run, and all 17 real and injected errors in consumed fields were stopped, of which 16 would have run without gates. Retraining the bound model on a dataset built from an LLM configuration reproduced its results within GPU nondeterminism. We also report a negative result of practical value. Direct LLM curve forecasting only matches linear extrapolation, whereas a small physics-structured network reduces the over-notched bandwidth by 86% to 89% at calibrated coverage c = 0.90, which delineates where direct LLM prediction should give way to a trained model.

translation.title: 语言模型应用于 LEO 星座卫星振动测试：基于少样本扫描的校准响应预测
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）日益端到端地驱动工程分析，将文本记录转化为数值程序的输入，但一个看似合理却错误的值可能悄然进入决策。我们为 LLM 驱动的工程分析提出确定性验证门控这一通用范式：LLM 生成的类型化配置只有在通过单位、物理一致性、逐字引用、独立模型间一致性、与测量导出数据的一致性以及训练模型的适用性等确定性检查后才被消费。门控从两个方向针对幻觉：引用检查捕捉捏造内容，模型间一致性捕捉引用检查遗漏的遗漏性错误。我们在低地球轨道巨型星座卫星的正弦验收振动测试上实例化该范式，其中 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 和 Qwen-plus 阅读中文测试记录并提取 76 个字段的配置。在五个输入变体上事实级 F1 为 0.98 至 1.0，所有修复均在开发集输入上冻结并在留出输入上评估。启用全部门控后，20 个配置中的 20 个产生了与金标准运行逐位一致的 notch 结果，被消费字段中的全部 17 个真实和注入错误均被拦截，其中 16 个在无门控时会被执行。用 LLM 配置构建的数据集重新训练约束模型，其结果在 GPU 非确定性范围内复现。我们还报告了一个具有实践价值的负面结果：直接的 LLM 曲线预测仅相当于线性外推，而一个小型物理结构网络在校准覆盖率 c=0.90 下将过度 notch 带宽降低 86% 至 89%，这划定了直接 LLM 预测应让位于训练模型的范围。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 工程分析中错误配置可能悄然进入决策的问题，提出对 LLM 生成配置施加多重确定性验证门控并结合小型物理结构网络进行振动响应预测。

papers.title: A Self-Evolving Agent Runs Like a Gas: Describing and Predicting Its Evolution with Fluid Dynamics
papers.abstract: A self-evolving LLM agent improves in service by rewriting its own plugin library under a validation gate. Agent engineering is converging on exactly such agents: single systems in continuous operation, carrying populations of runtime instances (plugins, skills, tools) past the point where anyone can read the library and still predict what the system will do. Yet the run itself, the aggregate motion of that population across hundreds of edit rounds, is unstudied: no theory says whether it relaxes, oscillates, or freezes. A recent kinetic theory supplies the missing level: under four architectural properties, the plugin instances of one agent behave as identical hard spheres whose density obeys a master equation, and the theory is candid that its gate injects and drains credit, momentum is not conserved, and waves are excluded by construction. We argue the boundary is architectural; keeping the four safety theorems, we stack conservation axioms on top. A closed-credit ledger makes credit a collision invariant and unlocks acoustic waves at a measurable, engineerable speed; a zero-sum projection gate conserves centroid momentum unconditionally, for any proposal stream. Both layers are proven and executed: the axis total is conserved to the digit over 66 interventions under a live gate, and the pre-registered decisive probe returns the theory's directional verdict: linear wavefronts where the ledger holds, dissipation where it does not, replicated across two population sizes. For agents that must never stop, the gas description is not a metaphor: it is the measurement interface through which their future becomes readable.

translation.title: 一个如气体般运行的自进化智能体：用流体动力学描述与预测其演化
