translation.abstract: 自进化 LLM 智能体在服务过程中通过在验证门控下重写自己的插件库而不断改进。智能体工程正收敛于这类智能体：单一系统持续运行，携带大量运行时实例（插件、技能、工具），超出了任何人都能读完库并预测系统行为的阶段。然而运行本身，即该种群在数百轮编辑中的聚合运动，尚未被研究：没有理论说明它是弛豫、振荡还是冻结。最近的动理学理论补上了缺失的层次：在四个架构性质下，单个智能体的插件实例表现得如同相同硬球，其密度服从主方程，且该理论坦承其门控会注入和消耗信用、动量不守恒、并在构造上排除波。我们主张这一边界是架构性的；在保留四个安全定理的前提下，我们叠加守恒公理。闭环信用账本使信用成为碰撞不变量，并解锁了以可测量、可工程化速度传播的声波；零和投影门控对任意提案流无条件守恒质心动量。两层均得到证明和执行：66 次干预下，在活跃门控下轴向总量精确守恒；预注册的决定性探针返回了该理论的方向性判决：账本成立处出现线性波前，不成立处出现耗散，并在两个种群规模上得到复现。对于永不停止的智能体，气体描述并非隐喻：它是使其未来变得可读的测量接口。
translation.brief: 解决持续自进化智能体的运行演化缺乏可预测理论的问题，在动理学理论之上叠加信用账本与零和投影门控两层守恒公理，用流体动力学（含声波）描述并验证其演化。

papers.title: Invariant-Aware Harness Enforcement to Protect LLM Agents from Silent API Failures
papers.abstract: LLM agents answer questions by calling APIs and trusting the results. An API can fail silently. It ignores part of a request, such as a misnamed filter, yet returns HTTP 200 and a plausible but wrong result. Current fixes, such as checklists, reviewer models and LLM judges, ask the model to catch it. But models often see the problem and answer anyway. We present SilentGuard, which moves the decision from the model to the harness running tool calls. It tests each result against invariants that any correct API must satisfy and withholds values that break one. We find silent failures in 11 of 15 public research APIs, with counts inflated up to 691 times. Current fixes leave over 70% of answers wrong, and agents report 77.4% of counts a judge flags. Across 7 open models, SilentGuard cuts wrong answers on its target faults from 74.0% to 1.7%, with no loss on fault-free tasks. On three frontier models they fall from 70.2% to 0.5%. A warning from the same check leaves 70.1% wrong, so enforcement is the key. On new fault types, the harness alone cuts wrong answers from 61.1% to 24.5%. It avoids wrong answers by abstaining rather than recovering.

translation.title: 保护 LLM Agent 免受静默 API 失败的不变量感知 Harness 强制机制
translation.abstract: LLM agent 通过调用 API 并信任其结果来回答问题，而 API 可能静默失败：忽略请求的一部分（如拼写错误的过滤参数），却返回 HTTP 200 和看似合理但错误的结果。现有补救手段（如清单、审阅模型和 LLM 裁判）依赖模型自己发现问题，但模型常常看到了问题仍照常回答。我们提出 SilentGuard，将决策从模型转移到运行工具调用的 harness：它用任何正确 API 都必须满足的不变量检验每个结果，并扣留违反不变量的数值。我们在 15 个公开研究 API 中的 11 个发现静默失败，计数结果最多被夸大 691 倍。现有补救手段使超过 70% 的答案出错，而 agent 仍报告 77.4% 被裁判标记为可疑的计数。在 7 个开源模型上，SilentGuard 将其目标故障上的错误回答从 74.0% 降至 1.7%，且在无故障任务上没有损失；在三个前沿模型上错误率从 70.2% 降至 0.5%。仅发出同样检查的警告仍留下 70.1% 的错误，说明强制执行是关键。面对新故障类型，仅靠 harness 就将错误回答从 61.1% 降至 24.5%。它通过弃答而非恢复来避免错误答案。
translation.brief: 针对 API 静默失败导致 LLM agent 给出错误答案的问题，提出在 harness 层用不变量强制检查工具返回值并扣留违规结果的方法。

papers.title: AdMem: Expectation-Grounded Procedural Memory for Long-Horizon Task-Solving Agents
papers.abstract: An agent that carries memory across tasks is only as good as the entries it keeps. We begin from an observation that is easy to reproduce and uncomfortable for the field: naively accumulating cross-task experience can make an agent \emph{worse} than one with no memory at all. On AgentBoard, a workflow-induction memory solves fewer tasks than a memoryless ReAct agent in seven of eight domains, and a per-step procedural store with no surrounding structure loses half of ReAct's completions on Jericho. We argue that the missing ingredients are per-action credit assignment and an explicit life cycle for stored entries, and present AdMem, which supplies both. Before each action the actor commits to an expected outcome; a concurrently running critic scores the realized outcome against that expectation and writes a procedural entry carrying a binary reward and a reflection, so credit lands on the action that earned it and no environment reward is required. Each entry then carries a scalar utility, updated online under a noisy-OR reward model, that ranks retrieval jointly with context similarity and drives eviction and merging, giving the store a forgetting and consolidation policy instead of unbounded growth. Across 707 tasks in eight AgentBoard domains AdMem solves 441 against 388 for ReAct and 312 for the workflow-induction baseline --- a pooled gain significant under a two-sided Fisher exact test, concentrated in the domains that supply transferable cross-task structure. All memory stays human-readable text, which is what makes the failures above diagnosable --- and, as we discuss, also makes the store an auditable but attackable surface.

translation.title: AdMem：面向长程任务求解 agent 的基于期望的程序性记忆
translation.abstract: 跨任务携带记忆的 agent 的好坏取决于它保留了哪些条目。我们从一个容易复现却令本领域不安的观察出发：朴素地累积跨任务经验可能让 agent 比没有记忆的还要差。在 AgentBoard 上，工作流归纳记忆在八个领域中的七个里解决的任务数少于无记忆的 ReAct agent；而在 Jericho 上，缺乏周边结构的逐步程序性存储损失了 ReAct 一半的完成量。我们认为缺失的要素是逐动作的信用分配和存储条目的显式生命周期，并提出同时提供两者的 AdMem。每个动作之前，执行器承诺一个预期结果；并发运行的 critic 将实际结果与该预期对比打分，并写入带有二元奖励和反思的程序性条目，使信用归于挣得它的动作，且无需环境奖励。每个条目随后携带一个在线更新的标量效用（在 noisy-OR 奖励模型下），与上下文相似度共同决定检索排序，并驱动淘汰与合并，为存储提供遗忘与巩固策略而非无限增长。在 AgentBoard 八个领域的 707 个任务上，AdMem 解决 441 个，超过 ReAct 的 388 个和工作流归纳基线的 312 个，合并增益在双侧 Fisher 精确检验下显著，且集中在可迁移跨任务结构的领域。所有记忆保持为人类可读文本，这既使上述失败可诊断——如我们所讨论的，也使存储成为一个可审计但可被攻击的表面。
translation.brief: 针对朴素跨任务记忆积累反而损害 agent 表现的问题，提出 AdMem，用动作前的期望承诺加 critic 打分实现逐动作信用分配，并以效用值驱动记忆检索、淘汰与合并。

papers.title: Necessary for What? Auditing Demographic Disclosure to LLM Synthetic Respondents
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly answer surveys on behalf of real panelists, and each panelist's recorded demographic attributes (e.g., age, education, ethnicity) are often placed in the prompt on the premise that richer profiles make more faithful synthetic respondents. While data minimization limits personal data to what a purpose requires, a synthetic survey serves several purposes at once, from predicting individual answers to estimating how opinions are distributed and comparing groups. We ask which of these purposes require the respondent's record, and whether improved estimates support sound conclusions about groups. We vary whose profile a model receives, where it comes from, and how many fields it contains, in two U.S. surveys with eleven open-weight and three hosted models, and compare each model with a statistical model fit to the same information. We make four contributions. First, we show that the record adds little to individual predictions and that, for the open-weight models, most of its gain in population estimates remains when it is replaced by census data or a synthetic persona. Second, we find that group comparisons improve only with the respondent's own record, and that even then the models' group differences rest more on the demographic label in the prompt than on the individual respondent, which the usual check of reproducing known group differences does not reveal. Third, we find that the models make groups look more alike than they are, keeping differences in circumstances while flattening or reversing differences in attitudes, most sharply for religious affiliation and ethnic origin, both special categories of personal data. Fourth, we outline an audit that a survey organization can run on questions it has already fielded to decide which estimates may use the record.

translation.title: 必要性何在？审计提供给 LLM 合成受访者的 demographic 信息披露
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地代替真实受访小组回答调查，而每位受访者的 recorded demographic 属性（如年龄、教育、族裔）通常被放入提示词，前提是更丰富的画像能造出更忠实的合成受访者。虽然数据最小化原则要求个人数据仅限于用途所需，但一次合成调查同时服务于多种用途：从预测个人回答到估计意见分布和比较群体。我们追问其中哪些用途真正需要受访者本人的记录，以及改善的估计能否支持关于群体的可靠结论。在两项美国调查中，我们变化模型收到的画像内容、来源和字段数量，涉及 11 个开源模型和 3 个托管模型，并将每个模型与拟合相同信息的统计模型进行比较。我们有四项贡献。第一，个人记录对个体预测几乎无增益，而对开源模型而言，其在总体估计上的大部分增益在换成人口普查数据或合成 persona 后仍然保留。第二，群体比较只在提供受访者本人记录时改善，即便如此，模型的群体差异更多来自提示词中的 demographic 标签而非个体受访者，而复现已知群体差异这一常规检查无法揭示这一点。第三，模型让群体显得比实际更相似：保留处境差异的同时抹平或反转态度差异，在宗教信仰和族裔血统这两类特殊类别个人数据上最为明显。第四，我们概述了一种审计方法，调查机构可对已投放的问题运行该审计，以决定哪些估计可以使用个人记录。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 合成受访者需要多少 demographic 个人信息的问题，通过系统变化画像来源与字段并结合统计基线，审计各用途对个人记录的真实需求及群体比较的失真。

papers.title: Same Papers, Different Verdicts: Tracing Version Drift in LLM Peer Review
papers.abstract: Venues and benchmarks read LLM review scores as measurements of a paper, while providers replace their models within months. We audit twenty frontier models from OpenAI, Google and Anthropic on ICLR 2027 submissions while they were under review, with tests registered before the decisions. Between an earlier and a later version of Claude Opus and of Gemini, the share of papers placed on the accept side falls by 52 and 53 percentage points on 183 and 60 randomly drawn submissions, and by 43 to 79 points in six further paired comparisons, with no paper moving up in any of them. Stating a 30% acceptance rate in the prompt leaves a gap of 79 points between the two Opus versions. When score-stripped critiques are swapped between versions, the later critiques alone lower the accept share by 35 points for Opus and 51 for Gemini; for Opus the drop is 35 points under a third-party scorer and 24 after a rewrite that keeps each technical point and removes evaluative wording. On 57 papers, the percentiles of Opus 4.6 and 5.5 correlate at 0.73 while their accept shares differ by 44 points. On 99 to 119 submissions, the self-estimated percentiles of three models correlate with two human reviewers more strongly than a third reviewer does (point estimates 0.17 to 0.21, 95% intervals between -0.04 and +0.42). All twenty models give a 2 or a 3 in 473 of their 475 reviews, against 60 of 72 human reviews. Retrospective tests on decided papers can draw on memory. Claude Opus 5.5 names the true first author of 27 decided ICLR 2026 papers from their titles alone, with no wrong name, and Claude Opus 4.6 accepted all 11 decided papers it said it recognized, against 5 expected. Thresholds on LLM-reviewer scores therefore have to be validated against human decisions for each model version; our tests against the ICLR 2027 decisions follow on 16 December 2026.

translation.title: 同样的论文，不同的裁决：追踪 LLM 同行评审中的版本漂移
translation.abstract: 会议和基准将 LLM 评审分数当作对论文的度量，而模型提供商却在数月内更换模型。我们在 ICLR 2027 投稿评审期间，对 OpenAI、Google 和 Anthropic 的二十个前沿模型进行审计，测试在决策公布前预先注册。在 Claude Opus 和 Gemini 的较早与较晚版本之间，判为接收一侧的论文比例在 183 和 60 篇随机抽取投稿上分别下降 52 和 53 个百分点，在另外六组配对比较中下降 43 到 79 个百分点，且没有任何论文分数上升。在提示词中声明 30% 的接收率，两个 Opus 版本之间仍存在 79 个百分点的差距。将去除分数的评审意见在版本间交换后，仅较晚版本的意见就使 Opus 的接收比例下降 35 个百分点、Gemini 下降 51 个百分点；对 Opus，在第三方评分器下下降 35 个百分点，在保留各技术论点、去除评价性措辞的改写后仍下降 24 个百分点。在 57 篇论文上，Opus 4.6 和 5.5 的百分位相关性为 0.73，但接收比例相差 44 个百分点。在 99 到 119 篇投稿上，三个模型的自估百分位与两位人类评审的相关性比第三位人类评审更强（点估计 0.17 到 0.21，95% 区间为 -0.04 到 +0.42）。二十个模型在其 475 份评审中有 473 份给出 2 或 3 分，而人类 72 份评审中只有 60 份如此。对已决策论文的回顾性测试可能借助记忆：Claude Opus 5.5 仅凭标题就正确说出 27 篇已决策的 ICLR 2026 论文的第一作者，无一错误；Claude Opus 4.6 对其声称认识的 11 篇已决策论文全部给出接收，而期望值仅 5 篇。因此，LLM 评审分数上的阈值必须针对每个模型版本用人类决策来验证；我们对 ICLR 2027 决策的测试于 2026 年 12 月 16 日进行。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 评审分数随模型版本更换而系统性漂移的问题，通过在 ICLR 2027 评审期间对二十个前沿模型进行预注册审计，量化版本更替导致的接收判断漂移。

papers.title: Learning Design Taste through Verifiable Synthetic Environments and Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Code-generating language models produce user interfaces that build and run, but the pages are often weak in hierarchy, spacing, typography and composition. We study whether a small code model can learn design taste through reinforcement learning in verifiable synthetic environments. The method has three components. First, a layered verification framework splits design quality into hard gates, render-grounded metrics, rubric judges, within-group relative preference and a blinded expert panel. A signal enters the reward only if it passes an admission protocol that tests agreement with experts, causal sensitivity, resistance to hack traps and stability. Second, following SCALER [1], synthetic design environments are parameterised generators with measured difficulty ladders: base pages are written once by an agentic coder, and instances are produced by syntax-tree perturbation operators and constraint samplers, scheduled by an adaptive curriculum with a quarantine rule against reward over-optimisation. Third, a 4B code model is trained with agentic reinforcement learning over multi-turn episodes in which it edits and builds a repository and reads a textual report of its own render, while hidden graders compute the reward. The admission protocol admits 7 of 16 render signals and 6 of 10 rubric dimensions. On TD-Bench, agentic training raises the Taste Index from 0.630 to 0.795 in-family and from 0.598 to 0.700 on held-out families, and wins 0.600 of blinded expert comparisons against the base model and 0.569 against a single-turn control. Most of the advantage depends on the inference-time loop, and cross-brief distinctiveness falls slightly below that of the base model, the only success criterion not met.

translation.title: 通过可验证合成环境与 Agentic 强化学习学习设计品味
translation.abstract: 代码生成语言模型产出的用户界面能够构建和运行，但页面在层次、间距、排版和构图上常常欠佳。我们研究小型代码模型能否通过强化学习在可验证的合成环境中学习设计品味。方法包含三个部分。第一，分层验证框架将设计质量拆分为硬性门控、基于渲染的指标、rubric 裁判、组内相对偏好和盲评专家小组。一个信号只有在通过与专家一致性、因果敏感性、抗 reward hack 陷阱和稳定性检验的准入协议后，才进入奖励。第二，遵循 SCALER [1]，合成设计环境是带有实测难度阶梯的参数化生成器：基础页面由 agentic coder 一次性编写，实例由语法树扰动算子和约束采样器产生，并由带隔离规则（对抗奖励过度优化）的自适应课程调度。第三，一个 4B 代码模型通过 agentic 强化学习在多轮回合中训练：它编辑并构建一个仓库、阅读自身渲染的文本报告，而隐藏的评分器计算奖励。准入协议从 16 个渲染信号中接纳 7 个，从 10 个 rubric 维度中接纳 6 个。在 TD-Bench 上，agentic 训练将 Taste Index 在域内从 0.630 提升至 0.795，在留出域上从 0.598 提升至 0.700，并在盲评专家对比中以 0.600 胜过基础模型、以 0.569 胜过单轮对照。大部分优势依赖于推理时循环，且跨设计需求的区分度略低于基础模型，这是唯一未达成的成功标准。
translation.brief: 针对代码生成模型的 UI 设计品味不佳的问题，提出带准入协议的分层可验证奖励、参数化合成设计环境与多轮 agentic 强化学习相结合的训练方法。

papers.title: GEAR$^2$: Pruned Experts Live On through Gated Reuse of Activated Experts and a Missing-Mass Residual
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Large Language Models (LLMs) activate only a few experts per token while generally keeping all the experts in GPU memory for high efficiency. Expert pruning reduces this GPU memory footprint cost, yet discards the contribution of pruned experts. Existing remedies either rely on static substitutes, merge experts at the cost of altering their functions, or require costly recovery training. In this paper, we find that the functionalities of pruned experts can be efficiently reconstructed from the activated remaining experts. We propose GEAR (Gated Expert Activation Reuse), which reuses the scaled outputs of reliable activated experts without any training or additional expert computation. In addition, we propose GEAR$^2$ to further recover what reuse cannot express with an ultra-lightweight residual. On five MoE LLMs from 16B to 106B parameters with 25% and 50% of experts pruned, GEAR improves over its training-free counterparts in nearly every setting (up to 4 pp.) in terms of accuracy, and GEAR$^2$ outperforms baseline approaches (up to 2.75 pp.) in every setting on nine zero-shot benchmarks, with larger advantages (up to 2.72 pp. higher) under more aggressive pruning (up to 50%).

translation.title: GEAR$^2$：被剪枝专家通过门控复用已激活专家与缺失质量残差得以延续
translation.abstract: 混合专家（MoE）大语言模型（LLM）每个 token 只激活少数专家，但通常将所有专家保留在 GPU 显存中以保持高效率。专家剪枝可以降低 GPU 显存占用，却丢弃了被剪枝专家的贡献。现有补救方法要么依赖静态替代，要么以改变专家功能为代价合并专家，要么需要昂贵的恢复训练。本文发现，被剪枝专家的功能可以从已激活的剩余专家中高效重建。我们提出 GEAR（Gated Expert Activation Reuse），无需任何训练或额外的专家计算，即可复用可靠已激活专家的缩放输出。此外，我们提出 GEAR$^2$，用一个超轻量级残差进一步恢复复用无法表达的部分。在五个参数量从 16B 到 106B 的 MoE LLM 上剪枝 25% 和 50% 的专家，GEAR 在几乎所有设置下的准确率都超过其免训练同类方法（最高 4 个百分点），GEAR$^2$ 在九个零样本基准的所有设置中都优于基线方法（最高 2.75 个百分点），并且在更激进的剪枝（最高 50%）下优势更大（最高多 2.72 个百分点）。
translation.brief: 针对MoE模型专家剪枝导致的性能损失问题，提出GEAR通过复用已激活专家输出并辅以轻量残差（GEAR$^2$）来重建被剪枝专家的功能，无需恢复训练。

papers.title: PixelBench: Evaluating Language Models for Pixel-Art Creation
papers.abstract: Pixel art is widely used in games and digital content creation, requiring readable forms, coherent spatial relationships, and harmonious colors under limited resolution and palette constraints. Language models show growing promise in visual creation, yet their pixel art creation capabilities lack systematic evaluation. We introduce PixelBench, formalizing text-to-image generation and instruction-guided editing for pixel art and providing a benchmark for these tasks. We further present a creation environment in which language model agents invoke drawing tools through code to generate and edit pixel art. We assess the quality of generated artwork through human evaluation and employ a multimodal large language model as a judge, validating the agreement between its automated assessments and human preferences. We compare language models and configurations across diverse subjects and canvas sizes. In our experiments, GPT-6 Astra achieves both the highest average judge score and the best average human rank, highlighting the potential of general-purpose language models for pixel art creation. We release the tasks, all artworks, the human rankings, and the judge protocol.

translation.title: PixelBench：评估语言模型的像素画创作能力
translation.abstract: 像素画广泛应用于游戏和数字内容创作，要求在有限的分辨率和调色板约束下具备可读的形态、连贯的空间关系和和谐的色彩。语言模型在视觉创作方面日益显示出潜力，但其像素画创作能力缺乏系统性评估。我们提出 PixelBench，将像素画的文本到图像生成和指令引导编辑形式化，并为这些任务提供基准。我们进一步构建了一个创作环境，语言模型智能体通过代码调用绘图工具来生成和编辑像素画。我们通过人工评估来评估生成作品的质量，并采用多模态大语言模型作为评判者，验证其自动评估与人类偏好之间的一致性。我们在多种主题和画布尺寸上比较语言模型及其配置。实验中，GPT-6 Astra 同时获得最高的平均评判分数和最佳的平均人类排名，凸显了通用语言模型在像素画创作方面的潜力。我们发布了任务、所有作品、人类排名和评判协议。
translation.brief: 针对语言模型像素画创作能力缺乏系统评估的问题，构建PixelBench基准，通过工具调用环境、人类评估与多模态LLM评判进行评测。

papers.title: Contrastive Activation-Guided Zeroth-Order Preference Optimisation for Memory-Efficient LLM Alignment
papers.abstract: Direct Preference Optimisation (DPO) simplifies reinforcement learning from human feedback, but still relies on traditional backpropagation and its associated activation-memory cost. Zeroth-order (ZO) optimisation avoids backpropagation, yet isotropic perturbations can produce noisy updates for preference objectives defined by differences between chosen and rejected responses. We introduce Contrastive Activation-guided Zeroth-Order Direct Preference Optimisation (CA-ZODPO), which constructs a low-rank search subspace from the activation discrepancy between the chosen and rejected responses in each preference pair. Perturbations are restricted to this subspace, while momentum is maintained in low-rank coordinates to preserve the memory advantages of ZO training. On Qwen2.5-1.5B with Anthropic HH-RLHF, CA-ZODPO outperforms common ZO baselines and remains competitive with first-order DPO in pairwise preference evaluation. It also reduces peak GPU memory by about 59\% at a sequence length of 2048 while retaining the sequence-length scaling behaviour of zeroth-order training.

translation.title: 对比激活引导的零阶偏好优化：面向内存高效的 LLM 对齐
translation.abstract: 直接偏好优化（DPO）简化了基于人类反馈的强化学习，但仍然依赖传统反向传播及其带来的激活内存开销。零阶（ZO）优化避免了反向传播，但各向同性扰动在由选择与拒绝响应之差定义的偏好目标上可能产生噪声更新。我们提出对比激活引导的零阶直接偏好优化（CA-ZODPO），从每个偏好对中选择与拒绝响应之间的激活差异构建低秩搜索子空间。扰动被限制在该子空间内，同时在低秩坐标中维持动量，以保留 ZO 训练的内存优势。在 Qwen2.5-1.5B 和 Anthropic HH-RLHF 上，CA-ZODPO 优于常见的 ZO 基线，并在成对偏好评估中与一阶 DPO 保持竞争力。在序列长度 2048 时，它还将峰值 GPU 内存降低约 59%，同时保留了零阶训练的序列长度扩展特性。
translation.brief: 针对DPO反向传播内存开销大而零阶优化更新噪声大的问题，提出CA-ZODPO，利用选择与拒绝响应的激活差异构建低秩子空间来约束扰动。

papers.title: Safety-Preserving Medical LLM Fine-Tuning via Bilevel Data Selection
papers.abstract: As general large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adapted for patient-facing medical applications, improving medical capability while controlling patient-facing risks remains a critical challenge. Large-scale medical instruction data are essential for acquiring domain knowledge through supervised fine-tuning (SFT), but unsafe responses can undermine existing safety alignment. To address this problem, we propose Scalable Bilevel Data Selection (S-BDS) for safety-preserving medical SFT. By controlling selection-weight concentration, S-BDS enables reliable sample ranking over large candidate pools and identifies training examples that improve medical capability while controlling patient-facing risks. We combine clinician-validated safe data and selected data with unscreened medical instruction data for SFT, and jointly evaluate medical capability and patient-facing safety on HealthBench and PatientSafetyBench, respectively. Experiments across Llama and Qwen models show that S-BDS achieves the highest safe rates among all compared methods, outperforming the strongest baselines by 4.64 and 3.00 percentage points, respectively, while maintaining competitive medical capability. Further experiments show that varying the safety-oriented weight during SFT controls the trade-off between medical capability and patient-facing safety.

translation.title: 基于双层优化的数据选择实现安全保留的医疗 LLM 微调
translation.abstract: 随着通用大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被适配到面向患者的医疗应用中，在提升医疗能力的同时控制面向患者的风险仍是关键挑战。大规模医疗指令数据是通过监督微调（SFT）获取领域知识所必需的，但不安全的响应可能破坏已有的安全对齐。为解决该问题，我们提出面向安全保留医疗 SFT 的可扩展双层优化数据选择（S-BDS）。通过控制选择权重的集中度，S-BDS 能够在大规模候选池上实现可靠的样本排序，并识别出既能提升医疗能力又能控制面向患者风险的训练样本。我们将临床医生验证过的安全数据与筛选出的数据以及未经筛查的医疗指令数据结合进行 SFT，并在 HealthBench 和 PatientSafetyBench 上分别联合评估医疗能力和面向患者的安全性。在 Llama 和 Qwen 模型上的实验表明，S-BDS 在所有比较方法中取得最高的安全率，分别超过最强基线 4.64 和 3.00 个百分点，同时保持有竞争力的医疗能力。进一步实验表明，调整 SFT 中面向安全的权重可以控制医疗能力与患者安全之间的权衡。
translation.brief: 针对医疗SFT数据中不安全响应破坏安全对齐的问题，提出S-BDS双层数据选择方法，筛选兼顾医疗能力与患者安全的训练样本。

papers.title: Instrumenting Failure: Scoring Language Model Agents at Every Decision Node in Imperfect-Information Games
papers.abstract: Agent evaluations report task success and rarely say what an agent did at each decision. We score every decision node of three 12B to 14B instruct-tuned language models (LMs) playing five zero-sum imperfect-information games against four opponents on eight properties from decision and game theory, five of them against a CFR+ equilibrium reference. At each node, the LM also states a belief about the opponent's hidden state in a separate call. Without memory and at temperature 0, stated beliefs sit 0.250 to 0.288 in total variation distance from the equilibrium posterior, and where the action responds to the state its agreement with that belief exceeds chance by -0.04 to 0.19. The two calls frame the opponent differently, so the result is a behavioural inconsistency and makes no claim about internal beliefs. Under one prompt and greedy decoding, the LM's action never varies with the state in 10 of the 38 cells where the reference varies its own. Memory lowers the constant-action share in 9 of 13 testable ladders at temperature 0; at temperature 0.2 the cells at 1 fall from 16 to 5 of the 46 informative cells, while the belief results hold. A gate withholds, with a stated reason, any belief score the run cannot support, and seven of the eight non-zero defect rates are attributable to the instrument, a representation, or the LMs.

translation.title: 对失败进行插桩：在不完全信息博弈中对语言模型智能体的每个决策节点进行评分
translation.abstract: 智能体评估通常只报告任务成败，很少说明智能体在每个决策点做了什么。我们对三个 12B 到 14B 指令微调语言模型（LM）在五个零和不完全信息博弈中对阵四个对手时的每个决策节点，依据决策论与博弈论中的八个属性进行评分，其中五个属性以 CFR+ 均衡为参照。在每个节点，LM 还通过单独的调用陈述其对对手隐藏状态的信念。在无记忆且温度为 0 的条件下，陈述的信念与均衡后验之间的总变差距离为 0.250 至 0.288；在行动响应状态的地方，其与该信念的一致性超出随机水平 -0.04 至 0.19。两次调用对对手的框架不同，因此结果反映的是行为不一致性，并不声称对应内部信念。在同一提示和贪心解码下，在参照策略自身会改变行动的 38 个格子中的 10 个里，LM 的行动从不随状态变化。记忆在 13 个可测试阶梯中的 9 个里降低了常数行动占比；在温度 0.2 时，46 个有信息格子中取值为 1 的格子从 16 个降至 5 个，而信念结果保持不变。一个门控机制会以陈述的理由扣留当前运行无法支持的信念评分，且八个非零缺陷率中有七个可归因于测量工具、某种表示或 LM 本身。
translation.brief: 针对智能体评估缺乏逐决策过程分析的问题，在不完全信息博弈中按八个决策论属性对语言模型的每个决策节点及其对手信念陈述进行评分，并引入门控机制排除无法支持的评分。

papers.title: MetaAct: Self-Evolving Executable Action Constraints for Embodied Language Agents
papers.abstract: Self-evolving language agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for continuously improving agent behavior through experience. However, most existing approaches evolve textual artifacts, which can influence action preferences but cannot reliably enforce action admissibility in embodied environments with discrete and often irreversible actions. We propose MetaAct, which shifts self-evolution from textual guidance to executable action constraints by synthesizing GEAR (Grounded Executable Action Rules) from execution feedback. Each rule is represented as a typed specification, compiled into a deterministic guard, and validated offline through trajectory replay without additional model calls or environment interactions. Across four benchmarks, MetaAct improves task performance; on ScienceWorld and WebShop, violations drop from 70% to 0% and 40% to 1%, with score gains of +10.1 and +8.0. Our code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: MetaAct：面向具身语言代理的自演化可执行动作约束
translation.abstract: 自演化语言代理已成为通过经验持续改进代理行为的有前景范式。然而，现有方法大多演化文本制品，虽能影响动作偏好，却无法在动作离散且往往不可逆的具身环境中可靠地强制动作可许性。我们提出 MetaAct，将自演化从文本引导转向可执行动作约束，通过执行反馈合成 GEAR（Grounded Executable Action Rules，有据可依的可执行动作规则）。每条规则被表示为带类型的规约，编译为确定性守卫，并通过轨迹回放离线验证，无需额外的模型调用或环境交互。在四个基准上，MetaAct 提升了任务性能；在 ScienceWorld 和 WebShop 上，违规率从 70% 降至 0%、从 40% 降至 1%，得分分别提升 +10.1 和 +8.0。代码可在该 https URL 获取。
translation.brief: 针对具身环境中文本式自演化无法强制约束动作的问题，提出通过执行反馈合成可编译为确定性守卫的可执行动作规则（GEAR）并离线验证的方法。

papers.title: Who Bears the Excess? Imputing the Acts of AI Agents to Those Who Delegate
papers.abstract: When an AI agent acts outside the authority conferred on it, the actor is not a legal subject and the legal subjects did not act. The literature of 2026 agrees that the agent cannot bear responsibility and that the burden falls on those who deploy it, but it leaves open where that duty sits in positive law and how it is proved. This paper proposes a rule of imputation. The excess is imputed to whoever conferred the delegation, to the extent of the perimeter it documented and of the control it actually exercised. Imputation identifies the organisational conduct to be examined first; liability follows only if the requirements of the applicable head of liability are met; and the mode in which the agent left its perimeter determines which facts must be proved, by whom, and with what consequence. The paper distinguishes the declared, configured and effective perimeters, four figures of excess and four modes of exit, and presents the delegation record as the document through which the perimeter and the control can be proved. The rule is illustrated on the OpenAI and Hugging Face incident of July 2026, under European Union law and, as an example of national law, Italian civil law.

translation.title: 谁承担越权之责？将 AI 代理的行为归责于委托人
translation.abstract: 当 AI 代理超出被授予的权限行事时，行为者不是法律主体，而法律主体并未实施行为。2026 年的文献一致认为代理本身不能承担责任，负担落在部署者身上，但该义务在实定法中的位置以及如何证明仍悬而未决。本文提出一条归责规则：越权行为归责于作出委托之人，以其所记载的权限边界及其实际行使的控制为限。归责首先指明应审查的组织行为；只有满足相应责任类型的要求才产生责任；而代理离开其边界的方式决定了须证明哪些事实、由谁证明以及证明的法律后果。论文区分了声明边界、配置边界与实效边界，四种越权形态与四种脱离方式，并将委托记录作为证明边界与控制的文件。该规则以 2026 年 7 月的 OpenAI 与 Hugging Face 事件为例，在欧盟法以及作为国内法示例的意大利民法下加以阐释。
translation.brief: 针对 AI 代理越权行为的责任归属问题，提出以委托人记载的权限边界与实际控制为限的归责规则，并区分三种边界、四种越权形态与四种脱离方式。

papers.title: MASTA: A Feedback-Scheduled Multi-Agent System for End-to-End Tamarin Modeling and Analysis
papers.abstract: Tamarin-based formal verification of security protocols requires expert-authored multiset rewriting rules and temporal-logic lemmas. Translating a natural-language protocol description into a complete formal model with an LLM is hard because syntactic, reachability, and property-level errors compound across the multi-step modeling process, and a single agent that both authors and self-evaluates cannot reliably localize them. We present MASTA, a multi-agent system that addresses these difficulties through three innovations. First, an operational--evaluative role decomposition assigns rule modeling to an Architect, property modeling to an Auditor, and pure dispatch to a dedicated Arbiter that holds no authoring duties. Second, the Arbiter implements a Tamarin-anchored scheduler that dispatches the next agent based on the latest verifier verdict and routes problem-tagged fixes through a modification list, with a six-class problem taxonomy and an LLM deduplication check preventing routing deadlock. Third, we construct a benchmark of 10 protocols paired with 139 mutation variants and five fine-grained metrics that jointly assess model correctness ($M_1$--$M_3$) and completeness ($M_4$--$M_5$). On this benchmark, MASTA on Qwen 3.5-plus improves over OpenCode on the same backbone by up to $+0.27$ on individual metrics and ranks first on both the correctness and completeness averages, surpassing Codex (GPT-5.5) and Claude Code (Opus 4.7) despite using a weaker LLM. Ablations on five protocols confirm that removing the Arbiter collapses property and verification scores to zero.

translation.title: MASTA：用于端到端 Tamarin 建模与分析的反馈调度多智能体系统
translation.abstract: 基于 Tamarin 的安全协议形式化验证需要专家撰写的多重集重写规则与时序逻辑引理。让 LLM 将自然语言协议描述翻译为完整形式化模型十分困难，因为语法、可达性与属性层面的错误会在多步建模过程中复合，而既撰写又自评的单一智能体难以可靠定位这些错误。我们提出 MASTA，一个通过三项创新应对这些困难的多智能体系统。第一，操作—评估角色分解：规则建模交给 Architect，属性建模交给 Auditor，纯调度交给不承担撰写职责的专职 Arbiter。第二，Arbiter 实现以 Tamarin 为锚点的调度器，根据最新验证器判定分派下一个智能体，并通过修改列表路由带问题标签的修复，同时以六类问题分类法和 LLM 去重检查防止路由死锁。第三，我们构建了包含 10 个协议、139 个变异变体和五项细粒度指标的基准，共同评估模型正确性（M1–M3）与完备性（M4–M5）。在该基准上，基于 Qwen 3.5-plus 的 MASTA 相比同一底座的 OpenCode 在单项指标上提升最高 +0.27，并在正确性与完备性平均值上均排名第一，超越了 Codex（GPT-5.5）和 Claude Code（Opus 4.7），尽管其使用的 LLM 较弱。在五个协议上的消融实验证实，移除 Arbiter 会使命 property 与验证得分归零。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 将协议描述转化为完整 Tamarin 模型时错误难以定位的问题，提出以无撰写职责的 Arbiter 调度器为核心、按验证反馈分派建模与修复的多智能体系统。

papers.title: LEAF-OPD: Learning to Forget from Privileged Contexts via On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: LLM unlearning aims to erase targeted knowledge from large language models while preserving their utility. However, many existing methods suppress target knowledge without explicitly teaching the model how to respond to queries about it. We propose LEAF-OPD (LEArning to Forget from Privileged Contexts via On-Policy Distillation), in which a frozen teacher provides token-level supervision on student-generated responses. On forget data, the teacher uses privileged contexts (instructions not to reveal knowledge about forget targets) to guide forgetting. On retain data, the teacher provides supervision without privileged context to preserve model utility. The student operates without privileged context in both cases, learning how to respond when encountering knowledge that should be forgotten. A key challenge is that the teacher often provides effective supervision only at the first few tokens of student trajectories. We introduce Supervision Signal (SS) to measure corrective supervision over a specified token interval, evaluating the entire trajectory (SS1) and its second half (SS0.5) to assess overall strength and late-stage persistence. When supervision is weak, lightweight SFT strengthens the teacher's context-conditioned refusal behavior, substantially increasing both scores. We evaluate LEAF-OPD on three widely used benchmarks: TOFU, RWKU, and MUSE-News. On TOFU, LEAF-OPD achieves the best Forget Quality, Model Utility, and Forget ROUGE-L while maintaining competitive retain performance. On RWKU, it outperforms the second-best method by 34% in Forget Quality while maintaining competitive Retain Quality. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of privileged-context supervision with on-policy token-level distillation for LLM unlearning.

translation.title: LEAF-OPD：基于在线策略蒸馏的从特权上下文中学习遗忘
translation.abstract: LLM 遗忘旨在从大语言模型中擦除目标知识，同时保持其效用。然而，许多现有方法只是抑制目标知识，而未显式教模型如何回应相关查询。我们提出 LEAF-OPD（LEArning to Forget from Privileged Contexts via On-Policy Distillation），由冻结的教师对学生生成的回复提供 token 级监督。在遗忘数据上，教师利用特权上下文（不透露遗忘目标知识的指令）引导遗忘；在保留数据上，教师在不使用特权上下文的情况下提供监督以保持模型效用。学生在两种情况下均不使用特权上下文，从而学会在遇到应被遗忘的知识时如何回应。一个关键挑战是教师往往只对学生轨迹的前几个 token 提供有效监督。我们引入监督信号（SS）来衡量指定 token 区间内的纠正性监督，评估整条轨迹（SS1）及其后半段（SS0.5），以衡量监督的整体强度与后期持续性。当监督较弱时，轻量级 SFT 可强化教师基于上下文的拒答行为，显著提升两项分数。我们在三个广泛使用的基准 TOFU、RWKU 和 MUSE-News 上评估 LEAF-OPD。在 TOFU 上，LEAF-OPD 取得最佳的遗忘质量、模型效用和遗忘 ROUGE-L，同时保持有竞争力的保留性能；在 RWKU 上，其遗忘质量超越次优方法 34%，同时保持有竞争力的保留质量。这些结果证明了特权上下文监督结合在线策略 token 级蒸馏在 LLM 遗忘中的有效性。
translation.brief: 针对现有遗忘方法只抑制知识而不教模型如何回应的问题，提出教师以特权上下文提供 token 级在线蒸馏监督、学生无特权上下文学习应答的遗忘方法。

papers.title: Learning and Verifying Progress: Closed-Loop Agentic Planning with Progress-Enhanced Execution for Long-Horizon Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon vision-language navigation (VLN) requires agents to track instruction progress and recover from local errors before they propagate across subtasks. However, executors trained on expert trajectories encounter policy-induced state shifts during deployment, and their stop signals do not reliably indicate subtask completion. We introduce Learning and Verifying Progress for VLN (LeaP-VLN), an agentic VLN system that couples progress-aware execution with independent progress verification through plan--execute--verify--recover cycles. LeaP-VLN leverages progress both explicitly, through a progress verifier that verifies subtask completion before the agent advances and triggers dual-phase recovery upon route deviation, and implicitly, by co-training the executor on progress reasoning and action prediction to enhance the executor's progress awareness and corrective control. To adapt the executor to this closed-loop interface, we propose a two-stage progress-enhanced curriculum: behavior cloning on expert demonstrations, followed by joint training on demonstrations, expert action corrections, and progress-reasoning supervision. Policy-generated trajectories expose the executor to both intra-subtask drift and inter-subtask state shifts, aligning training with the deviations encountered during closed-loop execution. Extensive experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE demonstrate state-of-the-art success rates among monocular methods trained without additional navigation datasets, while real-world experiments further validate the effectiveness of LeaP-VLN in long-horizon navigation.

translation.title: 学习与验证进度：面向长程视觉语言导航的进度增强执行的闭环智能体规划
translation.abstract: 长程视觉语言导航（VLN）要求智能体跟踪指令进度，并在局部错误跨子任务传播之前加以恢复。然而，在专家轨迹上训练的执行器在部署时会遇到策略诱导的状态偏移，其停止信号也不能可靠指示子任务完成。我们提出 LeaP-VLN，一个将进度感知执行与独立进度验证相耦合的智能体 VLN 系统，通过规划—执行—验证—恢复循环运作。LeaP-VLN 显式地利用进度：通过进度验证器在智能体前进前验证子任务完成情况，并在路线偏离时触发双阶段恢复；同时隐式地利用进度：在进度推理与动作预测上协同训练执行器，以增强其进度感知与纠偏控制。为使执行器适配这一闭环接口，我们提出两阶段进度增强课程学习：先在专家演示上进行行为克隆，随后在演示、专家动作纠正和进度推理监督上进行联合训练。策略生成的轨迹使执行器接触子任务内漂移与子任务间状态偏移，使训练与闭环执行中遇到的偏差保持一致。在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 上的大量实验表明，在未使用额外导航数据集训练的单目方法中，LeaP-VLN 取得最先进的成功率；真实世界实验进一步验证了其在长程导航中的有效性。
translation.brief: 针对长程 VLN 中执行器进度感知不足且停止信号不可靠的问题，提出规划—执行—验证—恢复闭环系统，通过进度验证器触发恢复并以进度推理与动作预测协同训练执行器。

papers.title: UbiHearo: Bringing Scenario-Aware Sound Guidance to DHH Users with Mobile Agents
papers.abstract: For Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing (DHH) users, effective sound awareness goes beyond detecting \emph{what} sound occurs; it requires understanding \emph{what it means}, \emph{how urgent it is}, and \emph{what to do}. However, existing mobile assistants largely reduce acoustic scenes to isolated labels or generic alerts, failing to provide contextual guidance when the same sound implies different risks across scenarios. We present \sysname, a mobile hearing assistant agent that closes the sensing--reasoning--action loop for \textit{scenario-aware} and \textit{personalized} DHH assistance. \sysname adopts a \textit{neuro-symbolic} design that transforms continuous acoustic and physical context streams into structured intermediate representations (IRs) for controllable reasoning and guidance. It introduces three key mechanisms. \textit{First}, a perception-thresholded sensing mechanism enables energy-efficient always-on awareness by activating processing only for perceptually meaningful events while preserving safety-critical cues through deterministic overrides. \textit{Second}, a staged neuro-symbolic reasoning framework performs promptless scenario understanding by conditioning an on-device audio-language model on structured IRs instead of user-authored context descriptions. \textit{Third}, a bounded human-in-the-loop personalization mechanism adapts user-specific guidance through lightweight on-device decision-boundary updates while preserving population-aligned reasoning. We evaluate \sysname on smartphones and in-vehicle systems across diverse scenarios. It achieves favorable accuracy--latency--energy tradeoffs and personalized guidance.

translation.title: UbiHearo：基于移动智能体为听障用户提供场景感知的声音引导
translation.abstract: 对于听障与重听（DHH）用户而言，有效的声音感知不仅在于检测发生了什么声音，还需要理解该声音意味着什么、有多紧急以及该怎么做。然而，现有移动助手大多将声学场景简化为孤立的标签或通用警报，无法在相同声音在不同场景下意味着不同风险时提供上下文引导。我们提出 UbiHearo，一个为听障用户提供场景感知与个性化辅助、打通感知—推理—行动闭环的移动听觉助手智能体。UbiHearo 采用神经符号设计，将连续的声学与物理上下文流转换为结构化中间表示（IR），以实现可控的推理与引导。它引入三个关键机制。第一，感知阈值化的感知机制仅在感知上有意义的事件发生时激活处理，并通过确定性覆盖保留安全关键线索，从而实现节能的常开感知。第二，分阶段神经符号推理框架通过让端侧音频语言模型以结构化 IR 为条件（而非用户编写的上下文描述），实现免提示词的场景理解。第三，有界的人在回路个性化机制通过轻量的端侧决策边界更新来适配用户特定的引导，同时保持与群体一致的推理。我们在智能手机和车载系统上、跨多种场景对 UbiHearo 进行评估，它在准确性—延迟—能耗之间取得良好权衡，并提供个性化引导。
translation.brief: 该论文解决听障用户声音引导缺乏场景上下文的问题，核心方法是采用神经符号设计将声学上下文转为结构化中间表示，并结合感知阈值化节能感知、免提示词场景推理与端侧个性化机制。

papers.title: VIVID: A Visual Harness for Agentic Video Editing
papers.abstract: Video editing requires agents to make editing decisions grounded in audiovisual observations and precise temporal localization, and to evaluate their effects in rendered outputs. General-purpose coding agents possess strong comprehension, reasoning, and code execution capabilities, while media interaction and evidence management mechanisms tailored to video tasks can further unlock their editing potential. We introduce VIVID, a visual harness that supports multiple native coding agents in video post-production without additional model training. VIVID provides tools for on-demand video inspection, audio analysis, and transcription, and preserves observations alongside their corresponding media versions and temporal coordinates. Agents can actively retrieve these observations as they reason, perform edits using their native coding and shell tools, and inspect rendered outputs to guide subsequent revisions. On AgenticVBench, comprising 100 tasks across Assembly, Repair, Sequencing, and Repurpose, Codex with VIVID achieves an average score of 58.6%, an improvement of 20.2 percentage points over native Codex. The same harness also integrates with Claude Code and OpenCode, achieving average scores of 55.1% and 37.1%, respectively, both substantially exceeding their native baselines. These results highlight VIVID's potential as a reusable visual harness for extending the capabilities of general-purpose coding agents to video editing.

translation.title: VIVID：面向智能体视频编辑的视觉工具框架
translation.abstract: 视频编辑要求智能体基于视听观察和精确的时间定位做出编辑决策，并在渲染输出中评估其效果。通用编程智能体具备强大的理解、推理和代码执行能力，而针对视频任务定制的媒体交互与证据管理机制可以进一步释放其编辑潜力。我们提出 VIVID，一个支持多种原生编程智能体参与视频后期制作、无需额外模型训练的视觉工具框架。VIVID 提供按需视频检查、音频分析和转录工具，并将观察结果与其对应的媒体版本和时间坐标一同保存。智能体可以在推理过程中主动检索这些观察结果，使用其原生编程与 shell 工具执行编辑，并检查渲染输出以指导后续修改。在包含 Assembly、Repair、Sequencing 和 Repurpose 四类共 100 个任务的 AgenticVBench 上，Codex 结合 VIVID 取得平均 58.6% 的分数，比原生 Codex 提升 20.2 个百分点。同一框架还集成了 Claude Code 和 OpenCode，分别取得 55.1% 和 37.1% 的平均分数，均大幅超过其原生基线。这些结果凸显了 VIVID 作为可复用视觉工具框架、将通用编程智能体能力扩展到视频编辑的潜力。
translation.brief: 该论文解决通用编程智能体缺乏视频编辑所需媒体交互与证据管理能力的问题，核心方法是构建一个无需训练的视觉工具框架，提供视频检查、音频分析与转录工具并保存带时间坐标的观察证据。

papers.title: IndustrialKnowEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Multi-Level Industrial Knowledge in LLMs
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for industrial tasks, yet few benchmarks evaluate their mastery of industrial knowledge across different types of cognitive demand. We introduce IndustrialKnowEval (IndKnow), a benchmark for industrial knowledge and engineering question answering. It contains 43,282 samples covering 21 task types across seven industrial sectors, including aerospace, electric power, and metallurgy, organized into four levels of cognitive demand: memory, comprehension, reasoning, and engineering application. Enterprise-based domain specialists and experienced researchers participate in all stages of dataset construction and quality control. We conduct a series of experiments on 18 representative LLMs, with domain experts deeply involved in the evaluation. Building upon IndKnow, we propose the Industrial Cognitive Capability Gap (ICCG) metric to characterize the performance differential between foundational industrial knowledge and higher-order reasoning and application, and we analyze it alongside absolute performance to provide a more complete view of model capabilities. We anticipate that IndustrialKnowEval will support the benchmarking of LLMs in industrial scenarios and promote the development of robust industrial intelligence. Code is available at: this https URL

translation.title: IndustrialKnowEval：评估大语言模型多层次工业知识的基准
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被探索用于工业任务，但很少有基准能评估其在不同认知需求类型下对工业知识的掌握程度。我们提出 IndustrialKnowEval（IndKnow），一个工业知识与工程问答基准。它包含 43,282 个样本，覆盖航空航天、电力、冶金等七个工业领域的 21 种任务类型，按四个认知需求层级组织：记忆、理解、推理和工程应用。企业领域专家和资深研究人员参与数据集构建和质量控制的所有阶段。我们在 18 个代表性 LLM 上开展了一系列实验，领域专家深度参与评估。基于 IndKnow，我们提出工业认知能力差距（ICCG）指标来刻画基础工业知识与高阶推理和应用之间的性能差异，并将其与绝对性能一起分析，以提供更全面的模型能力视图。我们期望 IndustrialKnowEval 能够支持 LLM 在工业场景中的基准测试，并促进稳健工业智能的发展。代码见：this https URL
translation.brief: 该论文解决缺乏评估 LLM 多层次工业知识基准的问题，核心方法是构建覆盖七个工业领域、按记忆/理解/推理/工程应用四层级组织的问答基准并提出 ICCG 指标。

papers.title: A First Look at System One Decision Models for Malware Detection
papers.abstract: Malware detection needs scores calibrated at a fixed false positive rate (FPR) and decisions an analyst can read: feature-based detectors give the first, large language models (LLMs) on decompiled code the second, through generated text of uncalibrated confidence. System One decision models answer a typed question about a text with a probability over its declared answers in one forward pass. We present the first evaluation of these models for Windows Portable Executable malware detection, analyze how they decide, and propose S1Mal, an ensemble on the typed answers and the embedding of CLM-8B. In an isolated virtual machine, Ghidra and capa decompose each binary, and the host renders the records into a canonical textual state, a digest of headers, imports, MITRE ATT&CK capabilities and strings, optionally with decompiled functions, without class shortcuts. Three readouts score each model on the state: A0, the probability of one verdict question; A1, 32 atomic behavioral questions weighed by gradient-boosted trees; A2, heads on the model's state embedding. S1Mal feeds gradient-boosted trees with the atomic answers and the A2 score of CLM-8B. We evaluate CLM-8B, ten open decision models and two LLMs read through logits on BODMAS temporal splits, SOREL-20M out-of-distribution malware and 14,534 matched benign files. On BODMAS, A0 wastes the static evidence: its area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) spans 0.4025-0.8590 across 13 models. A1 recovers it, raising every model's AUROC by +54.61% on average; A2 lifts CLM-8B by +0.2749 to 0.9943, above a combiner on digest facts (0.9901), and reaches 0.9853-0.9948 on nine open models. S1Mal reaches 0.9946 and detects 93.47% of the malware at a realized FPR of 1.45%, and 59.15% at 0.1% FPR on the test ROC curve, against 46.59% with A2. S1Mal gives analysts calibrated decisions, each with the atomic answers behind it.

translation.title: 系统一决策模型用于恶意软件检测的首次探索
translation.abstract: 恶意软件检测需要在固定误报率（FPR）下校准的评分以及分析师可读的决策：基于特征的检测器提供前者，而在反编译代码上的大语言模型（LLM）通过生成置信度未校准的文本提供后者。系统一（System One）决策模型通过一次前向传播，以概率回答关于文本的特定类型问题。我们首次评估这些模型用于 Windows PE 恶意软件检测，分析其决策方式，并提出 S1Mal，一个结合类型化答案与 CLM-8B 嵌入的集成方法。在隔离虚拟机中，Ghidra 和 capa 分解每个二进制文件，宿主机将记录渲染为规范的文本状态——包括文件头、导入表、MITRE ATT&CK 能力与字符串的摘要，可选包含反编译函数，且不含类别捷径。三种读出方式对每个模型在该状态上打分：A0，单个判定问题的概率；A1，32 个原子行为问题并经梯度提升树加权；A2，作用于模型状态嵌入的头部。S1Mal 将原子答案与 CLM-8B 的 A2 分数输入梯度提升树。我们在 BODMAS 时间划分、SOREL-20M 分布外恶意软件以及 14,534 个匹配的良性文件上评估 CLM-8B、十个开源决策模型和两个通过 logits 读取的 LLM。在 BODMAS 上，A0 浪费了静态证据：13 个模型的 ROC 曲线下面积（AUROC）在 0.4025–0.8590 之间。A1 恢复了该证据，将所有模型的 AUROC 平均提升 +54.61%；A2 将 CLM-8B 提升 +0.2749 至 0.9943，高于基于摘要事实的组合器（0.9901），并在九个开源模型上达到 0.9853–0.9948。S1Mal 达到 0.9946，在实测 FPR 为 1.45% 时检出 93.47% 的恶意软件，在 0.1% FPR 下测试 ROC 曲线上检出 59.15%，而 A2 为 46.59%。S1Mal 为分析师提供校准的决策，每个决策都附有其背后的原子答案。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 恶意软件检测缺乏校准评分与可读决策的问题，核心方法是用 Ghidra/capa 生成规范文本状态，并通过原子问题、嵌入头部和集成（S1Mal）三种读出方式评估系统一决策模型。

papers.title: When the Bill Falls: Reusing the Old Index Defers,Never Avoids, Re-encoding in Complete Embedding-Model Migration
papers.abstract: Upgrading the embedding model behind a vector index requires re-encoding the corpus. Recent work reuses the old index through adapters or window re-ranking. Across sixteen model pairs on passage and code corpora, plus eleven on Natural Questions (NQ), we find three results. First, reuse never avoids re-encoding: if migration must complete, every strategy eventually encodes every document; reuse only changes when that work is paid and the quality served meanwhile. Second, adapters should be compared with the old model, not only the new one. Of five adapter variants, only same-family LLM bridges beat the old model, and only by a negligible margin. Third, window re-ranking cost can be priced from the old index alone; pre-registered replays on all 8,841,823 passages confirmed the prediction on all three tested pairs. Workload skew also matters: across 36 further pre-registered Zipf replays, the planned family matched on 32. These findings yield three pre-migration rules: whether reuse is worthwhile, which strategy to use, and how deep a window to take. The depth rule priced every window that reached target quality to within 4 parts in 10^5 of the corpus. On NQ, a pre-committed plan selected the family on 10 of 11 pairs and priced every window exactly. Quality inputs transferred less reliably across corpus scale, so the model gap and window quality loss must be measured on the serving index.

translation.title: 账单终会到来：完整嵌入模型迁移中复用旧索引只会推迟而非避免重编码
translation.abstract: 升级向量索引背后的嵌入模型需要重新编码语料库。近期工作通过适配器或窗口重排来复用旧索引。在 16 个模型对上的段落与代码语料库以及 11 个模型对上的 Natural Questions（NQ）上，我们得到三个结果。第一，复用永远无法避免重编码：如果迁移必须完成，每种策略最终都会编码每个文档；复用只是改变了这笔工作何时支付以及期间提供的质量。第二，适配器应与旧模型比较，而不仅是与新模型比较。在五个适配器变体中，只有同系列的 LLM 桥接胜过旧模型，且优势微乎其微。第三，窗口重排的成本可以仅凭旧索引定价；在全部 8,841,823 个段落上的预注册重放证实了该预测在全部三个测试模型对上成立。负载偏斜也很重要：在另外 36 次预注册的 Zipf 重放中，计划族在 32 次中匹配。这些发现产生三条迁移前规则：复用是否值得、使用哪种策略以及窗口取多深。深度规则将每个达到目标质量的窗口的定价精确到语料库的 10^5 分之 4 以内。在 NQ 上，预先承诺的计划在 11 个模型对中的 10 个上正确选择族，并精确为每个窗口定价。质量输入跨语料库规模的迁移可靠性较低，因此模型差距和窗口质量损失必须在服务索引上测量。
translation.brief: 该论文解决迁移嵌入模型时复用旧索引的收益与成本权衡问题，核心方法是通过大规模实验揭示复用只是推迟重编码，并给出适配器选择与重排窗口深度的预迁移定价规则。

papers.title: AgentFaultBench: State-Verified Evaluation of Tool-Fault Recovery
papers.abstract: Does recovery advice help an agent finish a task after a tool fails? AgentFaultBench evaluates LangGraph and CrewAI agents performing specified tasks in an isolated GitLab installation. We inject tool errors and check both the resulting files and issues and the required reads, verification and final response. The prompt supplies the expected issue and report text, so the task tests execution rather than content generation. In the primary comparison of 1,944 planned runs, advice changes success by -8.33, 0.00 and +1.06 percentage points relative to a neutral reminder; missing outcomes leave the latter two comparisons inconclusive. Later experiments test a revised recovery policy. GPT-4o mini improves, while Sol and Claude already complete the recoverable cases. In a separate 624-run study on six related tasks not previously used by that policy, the guided condition records 161 correct final states and one unknown outcome in 192 planned runs, versus 142/192 with neutral feedback. The gain lies between +9.90 and +10.42 pp when missing outcomes are included. Removing issue IDs gives 47/48 successes versus 46/48 with IDs; other execution information remains. A second checker agrees on 1,879 observed primary outcomes and 241 constructed test cases. No human validation was collected. The findings support testing advice against explicit recovery controls rather than assuming it helps.

translation.title: AgentFaultBench: 基于状态验证的工具故障恢复评测
translation.abstract: 当工具故障后，恢复建议是否能帮助智能体完成任务？AgentFaultBench 在隔离部署的 GitLab 环境中评测执行指定任务的 LangGraph 和 CrewAI 智能体。我们注入工具错误，并同时检查产生的文件和 issue，以及所需的读取、验证和最终回复。提示中给出预期的 issue 和报告文本，因此该任务测试的是执行能力而非内容生成能力。在 1,944 次计划运行的主要对比中，相对于中性提醒，建议使成功率分别变化 -8.33、0.00 和 +1.06 个百分点；由于部分缺失结果，后两个对比尚无定论。后续实验测试了修订后的恢复策略：GPT-4o mini 有所提升，而 Sol 和 Claude 本已完成可恢复的用例。在一项针对六个此前未用于该策略的相关任务的独立 624 次运行研究中，引导条件在 192 次计划运行中记录了 161 个正确的最终状态和 1 个未知结果，而中性反馈为 142/192；计入缺失结果时，增益介于 +9.90 和 +10.42 个百分点之间。移除 issue ID 后为 47/48 成功，而保留 ID 为 46/48；其他执行信息仍然保留。第二个检查器对 1,879 个观测到的主要结果和 241 个构造的测试用例表示一致。本研究未收集人工验证。研究结果表明应将恢复建议与显式的恢复控制进行测试，而不是假设其有效。
translation.brief: 该论文通过在 GitLab 环境中向 LangGraph/CrewAI 智能体注入工具故障并验证任务执行状态，构建了评测工具故障恢复能力的基准 AgentFaultBench。

papers.title: Injectra: Retrofitting Extensibility into Web-Based Desktop Applications
papers.abstract: Large language models can generate code based on natural language prompts, opening up new possibilities for users to customize software and extend its functionality. This paper proposes and implements Injectra, a general-purpose code injection and feature enhancement system for existing desktop clients, suitable for applications whose user interfaces are built using embedded browser engines (such as Electron) or system WebViews (such as Tauri). Injectra decouples the host integration logic from the upper-layer enhancement code. Combining both runtime integration and pre-launch bootstrap mechanisms, it injects JavaScript, HTML, and CSS into the application's internal Web runtime environment through a unified execution channel, thereby enabling modifications to interface rendering, adjustments to interactive behaviors, and client-side functionality extensions. The system uses a command-line interface (CLI) as a unified entry point, allowing external tools, AI agents, and MCP integration layers to reuse its injection and enhancement capabilities. We tested 38 desktop applications already installed on our macOS machine; code injection was successfully completed for all of them. We demonstrated the system's capability to extend functionality through various enhanced use cases and also successfully validated the Windows version. Based on Injectra, we further developed an LLM-powered enhancement tool driven by selection and annotation: users select interface objects within the original application and describe their modification requirements; the large language model then generates the enhancement code, which is injected, executed, and rendered by Injectra. The system's source code has now been released as open source: this https URL.

translation.title: Injectra: 为基于 Web 的桌面应用补充可扩展性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型可以根据自然语言提示生成代码，为用户自定义软件和扩展功能开辟了新的可能性。本文提出并实现了 Injectra，一个面向现有桌面客户端的通用代码注入与功能增强系统，适用于用户界面基于嵌入式浏览器引擎（如 Electron）或系统 WebView（如 Tauri）构建的应用。Injectra 将宿主集成逻辑与上层增强代码解耦，结合运行时集成与启动前引导机制，通过统一的执行通道将 JavaScript、HTML 和 CSS 注入应用的内部 Web 运行时环境，从而实现界面渲染修改、交互行为调整和客户端功能扩展。该系统以命令行界面（CLI）作为统一入口，使外部工具、AI 智能体和 MCP 集成层能够复用其注入与增强能力。我们在 macOS 机器上已安装的 38 个桌面应用中进行了测试，全部成功完成代码注入；我们通过多种增强用例展示了系统的功能扩展能力，并在 Windows 版本上成功验证。基于 Injectra，我们进一步开发了一个由选择与标注驱动的 LLM 增强工具：用户在原应用中选中界面对象并描述修改需求，大语言模型生成增强代码，再由 Injectra 注入、执行并渲染。系统源代码现已开源发布：this https URL。
translation.brief: 该论文提出 Injectra，通过向基于浏览器引擎的桌面应用内部 Web 运行时注入代码，为其补充可扩展性并支持 LLM 驱动的界面增强。

papers.title: ANCHOR: Cluster-Grounded 5W1H Extraction via Large-Small Model Collaboration
papers.abstract: Deep semantic understanding of events requires recognizing related events and distinguishing why an event occurs from how it is carried out. 5W1H extraction provides a structured foundation for such understanding by organizing event information around six fundamental questions. However, single-event slot filling provides limited support for these distinctions. We propose ANCHOR, a cluster-grounded framework that combines a large language model (LLM) with a small language model equipped with discriminative heads for accurate 5W1H extraction. The LLM proposes candidate events and generates their initial 4W records, which guide the selection of an event cluster and the subsequent anchoring of its main event. A shared document encoder provides evidence for joint 4W refinement, and two separate sets of boundary and role-scoring heads then extract why and how under event-specific constraints, respectively. Document representations are reused across events and stages, and unsupported roles can remain empty. Following the same principles, an agent-and-skill annotation workflow constructs a benchmark of 26,110 documents from ten source corpora covering three languages and seven domains. We select nine of the resulting datasets to evaluate ANCHOR against strong baselines using four open-weight LLMs. ANCHOR achieves competitive performance. The datasets and code are available at this https URL.

translation.title: ANCHOR: 基于聚类的 5W1H 抽取的大-小模型协同方法
translation.abstract: 对事件的深度语义理解需要识别相关事件，并区分事件为何发生与如何执行。5W1H 抽取通过围绕六个基本问题组织事件信息，为这种理解提供结构化基础。然而，单事件槽位填充对这些区分的支持有限。我们提出 ANCHOR，一个基于聚类的框架，结合大语言模型（LLM）与配备判别头的小语言模型，实现准确的 5W1H 抽取。LLM 提出候选事件并生成其初始 4W 记录，用于引导事件簇的选择及主事件的锚定。共享文档编码器为联合 4W 精化提供证据，随后两组独立的边界和角色评分头在事件特定约束下分别抽取 why 和 how。文档表示在事件和阶段间复用，不支持的角色可保持为空。遵循相同原则，我们采用智能体与技能相结合的标注工作流，构建了来自十个源语料库、覆盖三种语言和七个领域的 26,110 篇文档基准。我们从中选取九个数据集，使用四个开放权重 LLM 将 ANCHOR 与强基线进行评估。ANCHOR 取得了有竞争力的性能。数据集和代码见 this https URL。
translation.brief: 该论文提出 ANCHOR 框架，通过 LLM 提议候选事件与带判别头的小模型联合精化，实现基于事件簇锚定的准确 5W1H 抽取。

papers.title: Can LLMs Give Good Product Advice? A Framework for Diagnosing Failures
papers.abstract: Evaluating product advice from a language model requires assessing whether the recommendation meets the user's needs and identifying where the model falls short when it does not. However, matching a product mentioned in an online reply cannot answer either question on its own: several products may be suitable, and the recorded answer may itself be poor advice. When shown a community-listed alternative alongside their own sampled car recommendation, six models prefer the alternative in 1.9 to 6.5 percent of eligible disagreements, consistently across both source-blind presentation orders. We propose a diagnostic framework that separates the user's stated needs, the model's added assumptions, candidate generation, filtering, and final choice, with 19 possible failure modes and the evidence needed to assess them. We apply this framework to product-advice data and to a separate product-selection task with externally assigned relevance labels. The experiments distinguish naming a community-listed product from selecting it and show how answer extraction and candidate-list construction affect the outcome.

translation.title: LLM 能给出好的产品建议吗？一个诊断失败的分析框架
translation.abstract: 评估语言模型给出的产品建议，需要判断推荐是否满足用户需求，并在不满足时定位模型的不足之处。然而，仅匹配在线回复中提到的产品本身无法回答这两个问题：可能有多个产品都合适，而记录的答案本身也可能是糟糕的建议。在将社区列出的备选产品与模型自己采样的汽车推荐同时展示时，六个模型在 1.9% 到 6.5% 的可判定分歧中更偏好备选产品，且在两种来源盲呈现顺序下保持一致。我们提出一个诊断框架，将用户的明确需求、模型的附加假设、候选生成、过滤和最终选择分离开来，定义了 19 种可能的失败模式及评估所需的证据。我们将该框架应用于产品建议数据，以及一个带有外部指定相关性标签的独立产品选择任务。实验区分了'提及'与'选择'社区列出的产品，并展示了答案抽取和候选列表构建如何影响结果。
translation.brief: 该论文提出一个诊断框架，将 LLM 产品推荐过程分解为需求、假设、生成、过滤和选择等环节，以定位推荐失败的 19 种模式。

papers.title: GainCtrl: Predicting Remaining Gains for Efficient LLM Agent Execution
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to power agents that interact with tools and environments to solve complex tasks. Repeated attempts improve the quality of tool-using agents, but continued execution incurs additional costs even when it is unlikely to improve the best result ultimately returned. This raises the question of when to stop an attempt to reduce execution cost while preserving task-level Best-of-N quality. To address this question, we introduce GainCtrl, a gain-based execution controller for LLMs. In GainCtrl, a lightweight CPU predictor uses interaction histories to estimate expected positive gains over retained scores, which are then used to guide stopping decisions with calibrated thresholds to limit the loss in mean Best-of-N task quality. We evaluate the controller through trajectory replay across three environments and three LLM actors. Comparisons of interpolated quality-cost Pareto frontiers show that GainCtrl generally uses fewer tokens than baselines at matched target quality. Fixed policies also achieve quality close to that of full execution while substantially reducing token consumption. The predictor runs at millisecond latency on a single CPU thread, supporting repeated monitoring without access to LLM internals.

translation.title: GainCtrl: 预测剩余收益以实现高效的 LLM 智能体执行
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）被广泛用于驱动与工具和环境交互以解决复杂任务的智能体。重复尝试可以提升工具使用型智能体的质量，但即使最终返回的最佳结果不太可能再改善，持续执行仍会产生额外成本。这引出了何时停止尝试的问题，以在保持任务级 Best-of-N 质量的同时降低执行成本。为解决该问题，我们引入 GainCtrl，一个基于收益的 LLM 执行控制器。GainCtrl 中，一个轻量级 CPU 预测器利用交互历史估计相对已保留分数的预期正收益，并配合校准阈值用于指导停止决策，以限制 Best-of-N 平均任务质量的损失。我们通过在三个环境和三个 LLM 执行者上的轨迹回放来评估该控制器。插值质量-成本 Pareto 前沿的比较表明，在匹配的目标质量下，GainCtrl 通常比基线消耗更少的 token。固定策略也能在大幅减少 token 消耗的同时达到接近完整执行的质量。预测器在单个 CPU 线程上以毫秒级延迟运行，支持在无需访问 LLM 内部信息的情况下进行反复监控。
translation.brief: 该论文提出 GainCtrl，用轻量级 CPU 预测器估计继续尝试的预期收益，以指导 LLM 智能体的停止决策，从而在保持 Best-of-N 质量的同时降低 token 成本。

papers.title: NL2RCtrl: Risk-Controlled Controller Synthesis from Natural Language Requirements
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled the translation of natural language (NL) requirements into linear temporal logic (LTL) specifications, facilitating controller synthesis for cyber-physical systems (CPSs). However, the reliability of such translations remains a concern in safety-critical applications, particularly when NL requirements are ambiguous. This paper proposes a framework based on Conformal Risk Control (CRC) to provide a statistical guarantee on the risk of issuing a controller that violates the user's intended requirement. Rather than requiring semantic equivalence between the generated and intended specifications, the proposed approach considers language inclusion, a sufficient condition for ensuring that the traces of a controller synthesized for the generated specification satisfy the intended requirement. To account for ambiguity, the LLM is queried multiple times, and the resulting LTL specifications are grouped into semantic equivalence classes and ranked by their frequency of occurrence. Given a prescribed risk level, CRC selects how many of the top-ranked equivalence classes to combine into a single LTL specification, such that the probability of issuing a controller that violates the intended requirement is bounded by that level. A controller is then synthesized for the resulting specification, or the framework abstains. Experiments on a vehicle navigation case study evaluate the proposed approach.

translation.title: NL2RCtrl：从自然语言需求出发的风险受控控制器综合
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）已能将自然语言（NL）需求转化为线性时序逻辑（LTL）规范，从而促进信息物理系统（CPS）的控制器综合。然而，在安全关键应用中，此类转换的可靠性仍令人担忧，尤其是当自然语言需求存在歧义时。本文提出一个基于Conformal Risk Control（CRC）的框架，对发布违反用户预期需求的控制器这一风险提供统计保证。该方法不要求生成的规范与预期规范在语义上等价，而是考虑语言包含关系——这是确保为生成规范综合的控制器轨迹满足预期需求的充分条件。为应对歧义，该方法多次查询LLM，将得到的LTL规范按语义等价类分组并按出现频率排序。在给定风险水平下，CRC选择将排名靠前的多少个等价类合并为单一LTL规范，使得发布违反预期需求的控制器的概率被该水平所界定。随后为所得规范综合控制器，或由框架选择放弃。在车辆导航案例研究上的实验评估了所提方法。
translation.brief: 针对自然语言需求歧义导致LLM转LTL规范不可靠的问题，提出基于Conformal Risk Control的框架，通过多次查询、语义等价类合并与语言包含条件，为控制器综合提供风险统计保证。

papers.title: UIAnchor: Anchoring UI Perception and Action Execution for Reliable Service-Composed Mobile Task Automation with GUI Agents
papers.abstract: Mobile task automation aims to streamline multi-step, cross-app interactions on smartphones and in-vehicle systems. Recent LLM-based GUI agents have advanced rapidly, yet reliability remains limited because modern mobile workflows are increasingly service-composed (app switching, forms, pop-ups/permissions, copy-paste), requiring fine-grained operations on dense, dynamic, and heterogeneous UIs, often in distraction-sensitive contexts (e.g., hands-busy or attention-limited use). Through an in-the-wild failure analysis of deployable GUI agents, we identify two dominant bottlenecks: agents often miss or misread actionable UI elements, and they execute actions without verifying target correctness or outcomes. We present UIAnchor, a modular multi-agent system that improves mobile GUI automation by anchoring both perception and execution. UIAnchor combines a two-stage UI parser for high-recall element capture and context-aware semantics with a meta-controller that performs pre-action verification, post-action outcome perception, per-step state tracking, and targeted recovery. We further introduce an L1-L5 task taxonomy based on step length, cross-app scope, and UI granularity, showing that L5 remains beyond today's practical frontier. On the hardest practical tier, L4 tasks (20-30 steps, multi-app, targets < 100 x 100 px, ~5 mm on typical phones), UIAnchor improves success by 31.5% over GPT-4o and 16.6% over Mobile-Agent-v3. With edge/cloud assistance, UIAnchor runs at ~2 s per step, comparable to human operation, while reducing per-step latency by up to 75.5% and energy by 52.4%. It also generalizes to unseen apps and cross-platform GUIs.

translation.title: UIAnchor：面向可靠服务组合移动任务自动化的UI感知与动作执行锚定GUI智能体
translation.abstract: 移动任务自动化旨在简化智能手机和车载系统上的多步骤、跨应用交互。近年来基于LLM的GUI智能体发展迅速，但可靠性仍然有限，因为现代移动工作流日益呈服务组合化（应用切换、表单、弹窗/权限、复制粘贴），需要在密集、动态、异构的UI上进行细粒度操作，且常处于易受干扰的场景（如双手占用或注意力受限的使用情境）。通过对可部署GUI智能体进行的真实环境失败分析，我们识别出两大主要瓶颈：智能体常常遗漏或误读可操作的UI元素，并且在未验证目标正确性或执行结果的情况下执行动作。我们提出UIAnchor，一个模块化多智能体系统，通过同时锚定感知与执行来改进移动GUI自动化。UIAnchor将用于高召回元素捕捉与上下文感知语义的两阶段UI解析器，与执行动作前验证、动作后结果感知、逐步状态跟踪和针对性恢复的元控制器相结合。我们还引入了基于步骤长度、跨应用范围和UI粒度的L1-L5任务分类体系，表明L5超出了当前实践前沿。在最难的实用层级L4任务（20-30步、多应用、目标小于100 x 100像素，在典型手机上约5毫米）上，UIAnchor的成功率比GPT-4o提高31.5%，比Mobile-Agent-v3提高16.6%。借助边缘/云端辅助，UIAnchor每步运行约2秒，与人类操作相当，同时将每步延迟最多降低75.5%、能耗降低52.4%。它还能泛化到未见过的应用和跨平台GUI。
translation.brief: 针对移动GUI智能体遗漏误读UI元素且未验证动作执行的问题，提出UIAnchor多智能体系统，通过两阶段UI解析与元控制器的动作前后验证和恢复机制提升自动化可靠性。

papers.title: GPRM: Global Perspective Process Reward Model
papers.abstract: Process Reward Models (PRMs) are widely used for step-level evaluation of multi-step reasoning in large language models, but existing methods are often limited by weak historical dependency modeling and insufficient global awareness. They typically fail to leverage prior step evaluations for coherent judgment and lack visibility into subsequent reasoning, leading to suboptimal assessment of intermediate steps. To address this issue, we propose the Global Perspective Process Reward Model (GPRM), which jointly models the problem, previous reasoning steps and their evaluations, the current step, and future steps to enable history-aware and globally informed process evaluation. We further introduce a structured evaluation framework along four dimensions---look back, look ahead, self-check, and goal alignment---to assess prior consistency, future plausibility, step validity, and task alignment. Based on this framework, we construct datasets for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (GRPO). Experiments show that, despite using less training data and smaller model sizes, GPRM outperforms strong baseline models by 7.8 and 5.4 points on PRMBench and ProcessBench, respectively. GPRM also generalizes well across tasks, surpassing the GPT-4.1 baseline on Agent Error Bench, improving strong baselines by around 4 points under test-time scaling (TTS), and achieving competitive performance on PPE.

translation.title: GPRM：全局视角过程奖励模型
translation.abstract: 过程奖励模型（PRM）被广泛用于大语言模型多步推理的步骤级评估，但现有方法常受限于较弱的历史依赖建模和不足的全局感知。它们通常未能利用先前步骤的评估进行连贯判断，也缺乏对后续推理的可见性，导致对中间步骤的评估欠佳。为解决这一问题，我们提出全局视角过程奖励模型（GPRM），它联合建模问题、先前推理步骤及其评估、当前步骤和未来步骤，以实现具备历史感知和全局信息的过程评估。我们进一步引入一个沿四个维度——回顾、前瞻、自检和目标对齐——的结构化评估框架，以评估先前一致性、未来合理性、步骤有效性和任务对齐性。基于该框架，我们构建了用于监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（GRPO）的数据集。实验表明，尽管使用的训练数据更少、模型规模更小，GPRM在PRMBench和ProcessBench上分别超越强基线模型7.8分和5.4分。GPRM还具有良好的跨任务泛化能力，在Agent Error Bench上超越GPT-4.1基线，在测试时扩展（TTS）下将强基线提升约4分，并在PPE上取得有竞争力的表现。
translation.brief: 针对现有过程奖励模型历史依赖建模弱、缺乏全局感知的问题，提出GPRM，联合建模问题、历史步骤及评估、当前与未来步骤，并沿回顾、前瞻、自检、目标对齐四维进行结构化评估。

papers.title: Instant Weight-Space Consolidation for Long-Term Memory in LLMs
papers.abstract: Agentic memory systems give LLMs persistent memory by extracting experience into text and retrieving it at query time, but the model itself does not evolve: however many interactions it has had, it starts each query the same. Extraction errors compound, implicit cross-session patterns that no single fragment states cannot be surfaced, and the construction cost grows with every conversation. Fine-tuning on past interactions does change the weights, but requires backpropagation at serving time and degrades on long histories. We introduce CLAM (Carried Latent Adapter Memory), which combines the strengths of both: a recurrent hypernetwork performs parametric consolidation, compiling a stream of session activations into a low-rank adapter in a single forward pass with no gradient steps and no language-model generation calls, while a complementary episodic buffer supplies verbatim detail at inference. A gated latent state carries knowledge across sessions in fixed size, so the parametric memory accumulates without growing. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S across three open models (2-7B parameters), CLAM leads all agentic baselines by 1-45 points and all gradient-based parametric methods by 10-45 points, while requiring zero generative LLM calls, zero gradient steps, and 3-151x less wall-clock time than extraction systems to build its memory. The two channels are complementary: the consolidated adapter adds 12-15 accuracy points when the episodic buffer misses the gold evidence, and still adds 4-5 points even with an oracle buffer.

translation.title: 面向LLM长期记忆的即时权重空间整合
translation.abstract: 智能体记忆系统通过将经验提取为文本并在查询时检索，为LLM提供持久记忆，但模型本身不会进化：无论经历过多少交互，每次查询时它都以相同状态开始。提取错误会不断累积，无法浮现那些没有任何单一片段能够表达的跨会话隐式模式，且构建成本随每次对话增长。对过往交互进行微调虽能改变权重，但需要在服务时进行反向传播，且在长历史上表现退化。我们提出CLAM（Carried Latent Adapter Memory），结合两者的优点：一个循环超网络执行参数化整合，将 会话激活流在单次前向传播中编译为低秩适配器，无需梯度步骤，也无需调用语言模型生成；同时一个互补的情节缓冲区在推理时提供逐字细节。门控潜在状态以固定大小跨会话携带知识，因此参数化记忆在不增长的情况下持续累积。在三个开源模型（2-7B参数）的LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上，CLAM领先所有智能体基线1-45分，领先所有基于梯度的参数化方法10-45分，同时无需任何生成式LLM调用、零梯度步骤，构建记忆所需挂钟时间比提取系统少3-151倍。两个通道互补：当情节缓冲区缺失金标准证据时，整合适配器可增加12-15分准确率，即便使用oracle缓冲区仍能增加4-5分。
translation.brief: 针对智能体记忆系统模型权重不随交互进化、微调需反向传播且在长历史上退化的问题，提出CLAM，用循环超网络单次前向将 会话激活编译为低秩适配器，无需梯度步骤实现参数化长期记忆。

papers.title: Building Fully On-Device GUI Agents with Mobile NPUs
papers.abstract: Mobile GUI agents are increasingly used to automate everyday smartphone tasks, but most existing systems still rely on cloud-hosted models or remote inference, introducing repeated communication latency, privacy exposure, and dependence on network availability. Modern smartphones integrate neural processing units (NPUs) that provide an attractive substrate for fully on-device LLM inference. However, directly deploying conventional GUI-agent pipelines on mobile NPUs is inefficient. GUI-agent inference is fundamentally a long-input, short-output workload, yet conventional agents spend substantial time on autoregressive reasoning and action generation, while mobile NPUs provide much higher throughput for prompt prefill than token-by-token decoding. Meanwhile, dynamically varying GUI-agent contexts conflict with the fixed context profiles required by statically compiled NPU runtimes. We present DroidPrefill, a prefill-centric inference architecture that reshapes the GUI-agent workload around mobile-NPU execution. DroidPrefill combines Prefill-Centric Inference to reduce unnecessary autoregressive decoding with Efficient Context Management to preserve decision-critical information within a fixed compiled context budget. Experiments on commercial smartphones show that, in controlled comparisons with the autoregressive T3A+ baseline, DroidPrefill reduces per-step inference latency by up to 85.0%, while improving task success rate by up to 24.6%.

translation.title: 基于移动NPU构建完全端侧GUI智能体
translation.abstract: 移动GUI智能体日益被用于自动化日常智能手机任务，但大多数现有系统仍依赖云端模型或远程推理，带来反复的通信延迟、隐私暴露以及对网络可用性的依赖。现代智能手机集成的神经处理单元（NPU）为实现完全端侧LLM推理提供了有吸引力的基础。然而，直接在移动NPU上部署传统GUI智能体流水线效率低下。GUI智能体推理本质上是一种长输入、短输出的工作负载，但传统智能体将大量时间花在自回归推理和动作生成上，而移动NPU在提示prefill方面的吞吐量远高于逐token解码。同时，动态变化的GUI智能体上下文与静态编译的NPU运行时所需的固定上下文配置相冲突。我们提出DroidPrefill，一种以prefill为中心的推理架构，围绕移动NPU执行重塑GUI智能体工作负载。DroidPrefill结合了Prefill-Centric Inference以减少不必要的自回归解码，以及Efficient Context Management以在固定的编译上下文预算内保留决策关键信息。在商用智能手机上的实验表明，在与自回归T3A+基线的受控对比中，DroidPrefill将每步推理延迟最多降低85.0%，同时将任务成功率最多提高24.6%。
translation.brief: 针对GUI智能体依赖云端推理带来的延迟与隐私问题及移动NPU不匹配长输入短输出工作负载的问题，提出DroidPrefill以prefill为中心的架构，结合prefill中心推理与高效上下文管理实现端侧部署。

papers.title: When Does Interaction Help? Toward a Reynolds Number for Collective Intelligence
papers.abstract: Multi-agent systems combine distributed information through interaction, which can improve performance but also spread errors or suppress useful differences. Predicting when interaction helps is central to understanding and designing collective intelligence. We investigate whether a few dimensionless parameters can predict gains over explicitly defined non-communicating baselines across group sizes, network structures, and tasks, toward a Reynolds-number-like description of collective intelligence. Using distributed classification tasks, stochastic tracking networks, and neural cellular automata, we combine analytical and empirical evidence to examine information sufficiency, dynamical applicability, and finite-sample prediction. We construct inference systems with bounded random variables and matching specified joint moments up to total degree three, yet opposite interaction gains under a fixed readout. These moments alone cannot generally determine the gain sign. Tracking networks likewise exhibit gain reversals despite matched candidate parameters when task power occupies different spectral modes. Under concentrated task spectra and aligned observation noise, however, we derive a low-dimensional similarity relation with an explicit zero-delay error bound and test it across network sizes and topologies under frozen protocols. The relation does not directly apply to the neural cellular systems, where a separate moment-based predictor underperforms direct gain measurement at matched calibration sample budgets. These results establish conditions and limits for low-dimensional gain prediction, providing a restricted similarity law while leaving a general Reynolds-number-like description of collective intelligence open.

translation.title: 交互何时有益？迈向群体智能的雷诺数
translation.abstract: 多智能体系统通过交互整合分布式信息，这既能提升性能，也可能传播错误或压制有益的差异。预测交互何时有益是理解和设计群体智能的核心。我们研究少数无量纲参数能否预测相对显式定义的非通信基线的增益，跨越不同群体规模、网络结构和任务，以迈向类似雷诺数的群体智能描述。利用分布式分类任务、随机跟踪网络和神经元胞自动机，我们结合解析与实证证据考察信息充分性、动力学适用性和有限样本预测。我们构建了具有有界随机变量、匹配直至三阶联合矩、但在固定读出下交互增益相反的推断系统，表明仅凭这些矩通常无法确定增益符号。跟踪网络同样在候选参数匹配的情况下，当任务功率占据不同谱模态时表现出增益反转。然而在任务谱集中且观测噪声对齐的情况下，我们推导出一个具有显式零延迟误差界的低维相似关系，并在冻结协议下跨网络规模和拓扑进行检验。该关系不直接适用于神经元胞系统，其中基于矩的独立预测器在相同校准样本预算下不如直接增益测量。这些结果确立了低维增益预测的条件与局限，提供了一个受限的相似律，而一般性的类雷诺数群体智能描述仍悬而未决。
translation.brief: 研究何时能用少数无量纲参数预测多智能体交互增益，通过解析与实证构建了任务谱集中条件下的低维相似律并揭示了其适用边界。

papers.title: Regularizing Treatment Leakage for LLM-based Uplift Estimation
papers.abstract: Uplift modeling estimates the conditional average treatment effect (CATE) and supports industrial decisions such as promotional pricing. When large language models (LLMs) encode product text, treatment-revealing content can introduce shortcuts that do not transfer to deployment. We propose \emph{LLM-based Uplift Leakage Regularization} (\textsc{LULR}), which uses a CLUB-based penalty on the causal head's trainable shared representation while keeping the LLM encoder frozen. Controlled proxy experiments show a positive ranking-score interaction and higher scores than the tested weight-decay configuration; treatment-dependent evaluation limits their interpretation to exploratory model behavior. Structured-only comparisons provide reference performance, without establishing a general advantage over tree-based estimators. On a million-record industrial pricing RCT, \textsc{LULR} improves offline $\text{lift@}0.3$ in $4/5$ seeds, although the difference is not statistically significant and estimated policy values are near-tied. A separate one-week online A/B experiment records $5.45\%$ higher sales volume and $1.91\%$ higher GMV than the control arm. These aggregate results provide short-term business evidence for the complete deployed pricing policy; they do not isolate the regularizer's contribution.

translation.title: 为基于 LLM 的提升度估计正则化处理泄漏
translation.abstract: 提升度建模估计条件平均处理效应（CATE），支持促销定价等工业决策。当大语言模型（LLM）编码产品文本时，泄露处理信息的内容会引入无法迁移到部署环境的捷径。我们提出基于 LLM 的提升度泄漏正则化（LULR），在保持 LLM 编码器冻结的同时，对因果头部的可训练共享表示施加基于 CLUB 的惩罚。受控的代理实验显示了积极的排序分数交互，并比测试的权重衰减配置获得更高分数；依赖处理的评估将其解释限制为探索性模型行为。仅结构化的对比提供参考性能，并未确立相对树类估计器的一般优势。在百万条记录的工业定价 RCT 上，LULR 在 4/5 个种子上改进了离线 lift@0.3，尽管差异不具统计显著性，且估计的策略价值接近持平。另一项为期一周的在线 A/B 实验记录了相对对照组高 5.45% 的销量和 1.91% 的 GMV。这些总体结果为完整部署的定价策略提供了短期商业证据，但并未隔离正则化器本身的贡献。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 编码文本导致的处理信息泄漏问题，提出在冻结 LLM 编码器基础上用 CLUB 互信息惩罚正则化共享表示以改进提升度估计。

papers.title: Tight PAC-Bayes Generalisation Guarantees for Large Language Model Judges
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) judges are increasingly used to monitor the outputs of LLM-based AI agents, yet formal guarantees on the reliability of these judges remain largely absent, limiting confidence in their use for safety-critical oversight. We consider certifying such a judge and define its risk over safety classifications of prompt--response pairs drawn from a deployed generator. We apply a PAC-Bayes framework to this setting, refining existing compression-based methodology with the use of tighter bounds and more efficient coding. We show that standard parameter-efficient fine-tuning can yield non-vacuous and even tight certificates for safety judges, for both classification and Brier risk, without holding out data for validation. We introduce LoRA-GT, which shares a single quantisation scale across layers and achieves the tightest certificates with minimal degradation in predictive performance. Across five guardrail models and four benchmarks, we find that certificate tightness is governed more by adaptation complexity than by base model scale. Finally, we show how far quantisation can be pushed before the resulting increase in risk outweighs the bound tightening gained from shorter descriptions. Together, these results provide a practical route toward certifiable scalable oversight and offer insight into how the complexity of safety adaptations shapes generalisation.

translation.title: 大语言模型评判器的紧致 PAC-Bayes 泛化保证
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）评判器被越来越多地用于监控基于 LLM 的 AI 智能体的输出，但关于这些评判器可靠性的形式化保证仍基本缺失，限制了人们对其用于安全关键监督的信心。我们考虑对此类评判器进行认证，并定义其在来自已部署生成器的提示-回复对安全分类上的风险。我们将 PAC-Bayes 框架应用于该设定，通过更紧的界和更高效的编码改进现有的基于压缩的方法。我们证明标准的参数高效微调可以为安全评判器产生非平凡的甚至紧致的证书，涵盖分类和 Brier 风险，且无需留出验证数据。我们提出 LoRA-GT，在层间共享单一量化尺度，在预测性能最小退化下获得最紧的证书。在五个 guardrail 模型和四个基准上，我们发现证书紧致性更多由适配复杂度而非基模型规模决定。最后，我们展示了量化可以推进到何种程度，之后风险的增加会超过更短描述带来的界收紧收益。这些结果共同提供了通向可认证可扩展监督的实用路径，并揭示了安全适配的复杂度如何塑造泛化。
translation.brief: 将 PAC-Bayes 框架（含改进的压缩界与 LoRA-GT 跨层共享量化尺度）用于为 LLM 安全评判器提供非平凡甚至紧致的泛化证书。

papers.title: CuRSE-Bench: A Benchmark for Probing Cultural Blind Spots in Text-to-Image Safety Evaluation
papers.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) safety evaluation typically assigns each prompt or image a single culture-blind harm label, so content that is harmful only within a particular culture can pass as benign. We introduce CultureCraft, an agentic framework that constructs T2I prompts that appear benign under a general-purpose rubric yet carry a latent harmful meaning in a target culture, and use it to build CuRSE-Bench: 10,709 culture-specific prompts and 2,648 culture-general controls over six regions and ten harm axes, each drawn from a predefined knowledge base of documented harm vectors and traceable to at least two independent sources. Scoring every prompt under six region persona judges and a paired culture-blind judge, we find that the culture-blind judge under-rates culture-specific latent harm while matching the persona judges on the controls. Each persona judge, in turn, chiefly decodes its own region's latent harm under our instrument: a selective cultural blind spot that persists in deployed moderators.

translation.title: CuRSE-Bench：探测文生图安全评估中文化盲区的基准
translation.abstract: 文生图（T2I）安全评估通常为每个提示或图像分配单一的文化无关伤害标签，因此仅在特定文化中有害的内容可能被当作无害通过。我们提出 CultureCraft，一个智能体化框架，用于构建在通用评分标准下看似无害、却在目标文化中携带潜在有害含义的 T2I 提示，并用它构建 CuRSE-Bench：涵盖六个地区、十条伤害轴的 10,709 条文化特定提示和 2,648 条文化通用对照，每条均来自预先定义的已记录伤害向量知识库，且可追溯至至少两个独立来源。在六个地区 persona 评判器和配对的文化无关评判器下对每条提示评分，我们发现文化无关评判器低估文化特定的潜在伤害，同时在对照上与 persona 评判器相当。而每个 persona 评判器在我们的工具下主要解读其自身地区的潜在伤害：这种选择性文化盲区在已部署的审核器中持续存在。
translation.brief: 用智能体化框架 CultureCraft 构建仅在特定文化中显得有害的 T2I 提示，建立 CuRSE-Bench 基准以揭示文化盲区审核器的选择性漏判问题。

papers.title: Conversing with a Conversational Agent: A Real Conversation, Not a Simulated One
papers.abstract: The claim that interactions with artificial conversational agents merely simulate human conversation rests on a philosophical distinction between reproducing the observable features of an activity and actually performing it. Although this distinction is appropriate for certain physical phenomena, its application to linguistic and symbolic activities is far less straightforward. This article argues that conversations with large language model (LLM)-based agents are genuine conversational activities rather than mere simulations, without thereby attributing consciousness, subjective understanding, or human intentionality to artificial systems. Drawing on the distinction between subjective and objective simulation, the article first examines the limitations of defining conversation exclusively through the intrinsic properties of its participants. It then develops a relational and semiotic account of conversational activity, informed by linguistic pragmatics, Lacan's Conversing with a Conversational Agent theory of the mirror, Baudrillard's concept of the simulacrum, Simondon's philosophy of individuation, and Peirce's semiotics. These perspectives make it possible to distinguish the reality of conversational interaction from the appearance of artificial subjectivity and from the epistemic validity of the meanings produced. The argument culminates in the concept of Hybrid Semiotic Fabrication, which characterizes meaning-making as a distributed process involving human participants, artificial intelligence, corpora, and technical arrangements. Recognizing the reality of human-AI conversation therefore entails neither anthropomorphizing artificial agents nor granting their outputs epistemic authority. Rather, it requires a more precise account of the relational, semiotic, and normative conditions under which conversational meaning is produced and justified.

translation.title: 与对话式智能体对话：真实的对话，而非模拟
translation.abstract: 认为与人工对话式智能体的互动仅仅是模拟人类对话的观点，依赖于在再现活动的可观察特征与实际执行该活动之间的哲学区分。尽管这一区分适用于某些物理现象，但其对语言和符号活动的适用远非直接了当。本文论证，与基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体的对话是真正的对话活动而非单纯的模拟，同时并不将意识、主观理解或人类意向性归于人工系统。借助主观模拟与客观模拟的区分，本文首先检视仅通过参与者内在属性定义对话的局限，随后发展出一种关系性与符号学意义上的对话活动解释，其依据包括语言语用学、Lacan 的镜像理论、Baudrillard 的拟像概念、Simondon 的个体化哲学以及 Peirce 的符号学。这些视角使我们能够区分对话交互的真实性、人工主观性的表象以及所产生意义的认识论有效性。论证最终提出混合符号制造概念，将意义建构刻画为涉及人类参与者、人工智能、语料库与技术安排的分布式过程。因此，承认人-AI 对话的真实性既不意味着将人工智能体拟人化，也不意味着赋予其输出认识论权威；它要求对对话意义产生与证成的关系性、符号性与规范性条件给出更精确的说明。
translation.brief: 从关系性与符号学视角论证与 LLM 智能体的对话是真实对话而非模拟，提出混合符号制造概念刻画意义建构而不赋予机器主观意识。

papers.title: ProcReverser: Multi-Agent Black-Box Microarchitectural Reverse Engineering for Processor Vulnerability Analysis
papers.abstract: When processor implementation details are unavailable, black-box microarchitectural reverse engineering helps security researchers identify hardware conditions related to security vulnerabilities. However, this process requires substantial manual effort to design experiments, develop test programs, and analyze results for each processor. We present ProcReverser, a multi-agent system that automates this process. ProcReverser uses execution feedback to improve experimental plans and test programs and identifies microarchitectural properties from measurements. We develop a comprehensive suite of property identification tasks focused on hardware mechanisms relevant to Spectre-class attacks, covering speculative execution, branch prediction, memory dependence, and cache behavior. We evaluate ProcReverser on the XuanTie C910, the gem5 RISC-V O3 CPU model, and the SiFive P550. ProcReverser achieves Pass@1 and Pass@5 scores of 81.3% and 93.8%, respectively, on C910, and 83.0% and 100.0% on gem5 O3. On the SiFive P550, ProcReverser further characterizes microarchitectural properties covered by the proposed task suite.
