These findings highlight the potential of automated microarchitectural reverse engineering to support processor vulnerability analysis and defense evaluation.

translation.title: ProcReverser：面向处理器漏洞分析的多智能体黑盒微体系结构逆向工程
translation.abstract: 当处理器实现细节不可用时，黑盒微体系结构逆向工程可帮助安全研究人员识别与安全漏洞相关的硬件条件。然而，该过程需要大量人工投入，包括为每个处理器设计实验、开发测试程序和分析结果。我们提出ProcReverser，一个自动化该过程的多智能体系统。ProcReverser利用执行反馈来改进实验计划和测试程序，并从测量中识别微体系结构特性。我们开发了一套全面的特性识别任务套件，聚焦于与Spectre类攻击相关的硬件机制，涵盖推测执行、分支预测、内存依赖和缓存行为。我们在玄铁C910、gem5 RISC-V O3 CPU模型和SiFive P550上评估了ProcReverser。ProcReverser在C910上取得了81.3%的Pass@1和93.8%的Pass@5，在gem5 O3上取得了83.0%和100.0%。在SiFive P550上，ProcReverser进一步表征了所提任务套件覆盖的微体系结构特性。这些发现凸显了自动化微体系结构逆向工程在支持处理器漏洞分析和防御评估方面的潜力。
translation.brief: 该论文解决处理器黑盒微体系结构特性逆向工程依赖大量人工的问题，提出利用执行反馈的多智能体系统自动化生成实验与测试程序来识别与Spectre类攻击相关的硬件特性。

papers.title: Evidence Diet: When Graph Evidence Helps LLMs Rank Competing Candidates
papers.abstract: When several candidates have graph support, does it matter which candidate receives which supporter and path counts? We study how LLM rankers use collaborative evidence on Amazon Books and MovieTV. Swapping user-level evidence degrades ranking, while matched item substitutions have little effect. On fixed clean-trained checkpoints, unrelated catalog text lowers Hit@1 from 44.77% to 38.70%, with 99.9% of rankings still valid. Across all three paired seeds, the NDCG@5 difference between count and path prompts was larger after count training than after path training. Degree matching preserves target paths while giving more rivals support. Across the full degree-matched development pools, adding candidate-level graph records to history improves NDCG@5 by 2.28 points on Books and 2.54 on MovieTV. When the target and a rival both have support, path- and count-trained rankers benefit from retaining counts. On these development queries, adding counts numerically to history scores outperforms presenting them as text. For count-trained rankers, exchanging intact count pairs among supported candidates preserves support and token length, yet lowers NDCG@5 by 4.06 points on 141 Books queries and 3.26 on 104 MovieTV queries. A frozen evaluation on 274 previously unused Books users with supported targets and rivals confirms the attribution effect: correct assignment improves pairwise accuracy by 6.07 percentage points (95% CI [4.18, 8.00]).

translation.title: 证据配比：图证据何时帮助LLM对竞争候选排序
translation.abstract: 当多个候选都获得图支持时，哪个候选获得哪些支持者和路径数量是否有影响？我们研究LLM排序器如何使用协同证据，在Amazon Books和MovieTV数据集上进行实验。交换用户级证据会降低排序质量，而匹配的商品替换几乎没有影响。在固定的干净训练检查点上，无关目录文本使Hit@1从44.77%降至38.70%，而99.9%的排序仍然有效。在所有三对随机种子中，count与path提示之间的NDCG@5差异在count训练后大于path训练后。度数匹配在保留目标路径的同时给更多对手提供支持。在全部度数匹配的开发池上，向历史中添加候选级图记录使Books上的NDCG@5提升2.28点，MovieTV上提升2.54点。当目标和竞争对手都有支持时，path训练和count训练的排序器都能从保留count中受益。在这些开发查询上，将count数值化加入历史分数优于以文本形式呈现。对于count训练的排序器，在有支持的候选间交换完整的count对可保持支持与token长度，但在141条Books查询上使NDCG@5降低4.06点，在104条MovieTV查询上降低3.26点。在274名此前未使用过的、目标与对手均有支持的Books用户上的冻结评估证实了归因效应：正确分配使成对准确率提升6.07个百分点（95% CI [4.18, 8.00]）。
translation.brief: 该论文研究LLM排序器如何使用图证据进行候选排序，通过交换、替换和度数匹配等受控干预实验确定证据的正确分配对排序性能的影响。

papers.title: DetourBench: Trajectory-Level Evaluation of Interactive Agents with Exact Minimum-Action Bounds
papers.abstract: Benchmarks judge language-model agents mainly by whether they reach the correct final state, not by how they got there. Endpoint scoring cannot separate an agent that retrieved exactly the evidence a decision required from one that read most of the environment, nor an agent that never located the evidence from one that stopped a single action short. Settling this needs a reference cost, and authored solutions establish only that a task is solvable, not that no shorter route exists. We present DetourBench, which constrains the environment until that minimum is computable. Each task is a finite, partially observable transition system with unit-cost accesses whose resources become globally addressable after discovery. Exhaustive search yields the full-information minimum action count $L_0$ with a replayable witness; from graph-recoverable terminal states it also yields exact residual work $R_T$, which separates an episode that stopped one access short from one that wandered, while an irreversible wrong commitment is recorded as having no finite residual distance rather than assigned one. Success, attainment, residual progress, and normalized detour are reported separately. Across 375 scored episodes --- five model endpoints, 25 integrated tasks, three repeats --- success ranges from 58.7% to 96.0% while conditional attainment ranges from 0.803 to 0.890 and orders the models differently. Among recoverable failures, residual work separates near-complete trajectories from costly incompletion and from irreversible commitment. We open-source the instances, oracle witnesses, and evaluation harness at this https URL.

translation.title: DetourBench：基于精确最小动作边界的交互式智能体轨迹级评估
translation.abstract: 基准测试主要通过语言模型智能体是否达到正确的最终状态来评判，而不看其如何达成。端点评分无法区分恰好检索到决策所需证据的智能体与读了大部分环境的智能体，也无法区分从未找到证据的智能体与只差一个动作就停止的智能体。解决这一问题需要一个参考成本，而人工编写的解答只能证明任务可解，不能证明不存在更短路径。我们提出DetourBench，通过约束环境使该最小值可计算。每个任务是一个有限的、部分可观察的迁移系统，具有单位成本的访问，其资源在发现后变为全局可寻址。穷举搜索得出全信息最小动作数$L_0$及可重放的见证；对于图可恢复的终止状态，还能得出精确的剩余工作量$R_T$，从而区分只差一次访问就停止的回合与漫无目的游荡的回合，而不可逆的错误承诺被记为没有有限剩余距离而非被赋予一个值。成功、达成度、剩余进度和归一化绕路分别报告。在375个评分回合中——五个模型端点、25个集成任务、三次重复——成功率从58.7%到96.0%，而条件达成度从0.803到0.890，且对模型的排序不同。在可恢复的失败中，剩余工作量将近乎完成的轨迹与代价高昂的不完整轨迹以及不可逆承诺区分开来。我们在开源地址发布实例、预言机见证和评估框架。
translation.brief: 该论文解决传统端点评分无法区分智能体轨迹效率的问题，提出通过构造可穷举计算最小动作数的环境实现精确的轨迹级评估基准DetourBench。

papers.title: Synapse: Optimizing Natural-Language Agent Skills through Program Repair
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can improve task performance by optimizing reusable natural-language skills without updating model parameters. Execution feedback reveals failures but does not directly identify which instructions to edit, which related instructions matter, or which tasks an edit may break. We propose Synapse, which casts skill optimization as generate-and-validate repair over a partial program view. A deterministic compiler translates recognized skill constructs into SkIR, a source-linked intermediate representation, while retaining other requirements in the text. Synapse combines execution traces with control-flow and dependence relations to localize faults, propose typed mutations, and select related repair tests, including previously passing ones. Each mutation is written back to its mapped source span and recompiled; validation determines acceptance. Every accepted patch yields a well-formed skill and preserves untargeted instruction spans. Under a one-hop-local execution assumption, selected tests include every test an edit can affect. On DocVQA and LiveMath with three execution models, Synapse improves task success rates over SkillOpt by 3.74-4.54 and 2.40-4.00 percentage points, respectively, and outperforms Trace2Skill and SkillBoost in all six settings. Replacing SkIR-based repair and its test screening with constrained text editing screened only on failing tests lowers DocVQA success rates by 2.40 and 2.67 percentage points for two models. In two recorded repair runs, structural relations add tests for 23 of 37 patches; in one repair, a test added through a control-flow relation exposes a regression missed by coverage of the edited instruction.

translation.title: Synapse：通过程序修复优化自然语言智能体技能
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体可以通过优化可复用的自然语言技能来提升任务性能，而无需更新模型参数。执行反馈能揭示失败，但不能直接指出应编辑哪些指令、哪些相关指令有影响、或某次编辑可能破坏哪些任务。我们提出Synapse，将技能优化转化为对部分程序视图的生成-验证式修复。确定性编译器将识别出的技能构造翻译为SkIR（一种源码链接的中间表示），其余要求保留在文本中。Synapse结合执行轨迹与控制流和依赖关系来定位故障、提出类型化变异，并选择相关的修复测试，包括此前通过的测试。每个变异被写回其映射的源码区间并重新编译；验证决定是否接受。每个被接受的补丁都产生格式良好的技能，并保留未针对的指令区间。在一跳局部执行假设下，所选测试包含编辑可能影响的所有测试。在DocVQA和LiveMath上使用三个执行模型，Synapse较SkillOpt分别将任务成功率提升3.74-4.54和2.40-4.00个百分点，并在全部六种设置中优于Trace2Skill和SkillBoost。用仅在失败测试上筛选的受约束文本编辑替代基于SkIR的修复及其测试筛选，使两个模型的DocVQA成功率分别下降2.40和2.67个百分点。在两次记录的修复运行中，结构化关系为37个补丁中的23个增加了测试；在其中一次修复中，通过控制流关系增加的测试暴露了被编辑指令覆盖检查漏掉的回归。
translation.brief: 该论文解决自然语言技能优化无法确定编辑位置与影响范围的问题，提出将技能优化建模为基于中间表示SkIR的生成-验证式程序修复方法Synapse。

papers.title: It Depends on the Task: Rethinking Rhetorical Segmentation of Dutch Judicial Decisions
papers.abstract: Classifying the material facts, submissions, judicial reasoning, and the court's decision (rhetorical roles) in case law is a prerequisite for high-quality performance across virtually all NLP-in-law tasks, including legal information retrieval, summarisation, and LLM-based analysis. These rhetorical roles often intertwine and shift sentence by sentence, making reliable classification difficult. This paper introduces the first sentence-level annotated dataset of Dutch judicial decisions, labelled across four legally meaningful categories: material facts, submissions, judicial reasoning, and the court's decision, alongside non-annotated (None) content, and compares several classification strategies, including a staged pipeline that separates None detection from the rhetorical roles, and a Bayesian update that leverages information about the section-header a sentence belongs to. Our results show that no single strategy dominates on both precision and recall: header priors help most when the None sentences are excluded and offer little benefit for None detection itself. These trade-offs matter in practice. For instance, extractive summarisation depends more on recall so it does not miss relevant facts, whereas outcome prediction depends more on precision regarding decision and facts sentences so that the predicted ruling is not contaminated by noise. We use these trade-offs and map the approaches tested in this study onto a set of representative legal NLP use cases.

translation.title: 因任务而异：重新思考荷兰司法判决的修辞切分
translation.abstract: 对判例法中的实体事实、诉讼请求、司法推理和法院裁决（修辞角色）进行分类，是几乎所有法律NLP任务（包括法律信息检索、摘要和基于LLM的分析）高质量表现的先决条件。这些修辞角色常常交织并逐句转换，使可靠分类变得困难。本文引入首个句子级标注的荷兰司法判决数据集，按四个具有法律意义的类别标注：实体事实、诉讼请求、司法推理和法院裁决，以及未标注（None）内容，并比较多种分类策略，包括将None检测与修辞角色分离的分阶段流水线，以及利用句子所属章节标题信息的贝叶斯更新。我们的结果表明，没有单一策略在精确率和召回率上都占优：标题先验在排除None句子时帮助最大，而对None检测本身收益甚微。这些权衡在实践中很重要。例如，抽取式摘要更依赖召回率以免遗漏相关事实，而结果预测更依赖关于裁决和事实句子的精确率，以使预测的判决不被噪声污染。我们利用这些权衡，将本研究测试的方法映射到一组有代表性的法律NLP用例上。
translation.brief: 该论文解决荷兰司法判决句子级修辞角色分类缺乏数据集与策略比较的问题，发布首个荷兰判决句子级标注数据集并比较多种分类策略的精确率-召回率权衡。

papers.title: Re-Reading Is Not Free: Token Traces and Cache-Aware Energy Estimation for LLM Agents in Software Engineering
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) evolve from conversational assistants into autonomous agents embedded in software development workflows, estimating their environmental footprint requires moving beyond conventional token-based accounting. Existing energy estimators focus on isolated request-response interactions, overlooking the repeated processing of accumulated context, cache reuse, and work delegated to subagents. We analyze nearly one billion tokens collected across 42 sessions and 752 task episodes over ten weeks of real-world AI-assisted software development. Cached-context reads make up 94.8% of all API-reported tokens, while uncached input accounts for only 0.017%; for every generated token, approximately 260 cached tokens are read. Context grows 5.3-fold over a session compared with 1.4-fold within individual tasks. To quantify the energy implications, we extend an existing analytical inference-energy model to account for cached-context processing, yielding a cache-aware hybrid estimator. It estimates approximately 250 kWh for the workload, compared with approximately 10 kWh from the output-based estimator EcoLogits, a 25-fold difference largely driven by cached-context reads. Neither estimator has been validated on long cached contexts, but no modeling assumption we varied closes the gap. Starting each task from a fresh context would lower our estimate by about 60%. We also find that parent-session logs report only a subagent's final internal call, undercounting delegated tokens by a factor of ten; for this workload the correction changes the energy estimate by about 5%, but token-volume studies are fully exposed to it. Our findings expose a substantial gap between how current energy estimators and agentic workloads treat context, highlighting the need for workflow-level energy accounting that captures context accumulation, cache reuse, and delegated execution.

translation.title: 重读并非免费：面向软件工程中 LLM Agent 的 Token 轨迹与缓存感知能耗估计
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）从对话助手演变为嵌入软件开发工作流的自主 agent，估计其环境足迹需要超越传统的基于 token 的核算方式。现有能耗估计器聚焦于孤立的请求-响应交互，忽略了对累积上下文的重复处理、缓存复用以及委派给子 agent 的工作。我们分析了在为期十周的真实 AI 辅助软件开发中收集的近十亿 token，覆盖 42 个会话和 752 个任务片段。缓存上下文读取占 API 报告 token 总数的 94.8%，而未缓存输入仅占 0.017%；每生成一个 token，约需读取 260 个缓存 token。与单个任务内 1.4 倍的增长相比，上下文在一个会话内增长 5.3 倍。为了量化能耗影响，我们扩展了现有的解析推理能耗模型以考虑缓存上下文处理，得到一个缓存感知的混合估计器。它估计该工作负载约消耗 250 kWh，而基于输出的估计器 EcoLogits 仅估计约 10 kWh，这一 25 倍的差距主要由缓存上下文读取造成。两个估计器都未在长缓存上下文上得到验证，但我们改变任何建模假设都无法弥合这一差距。如果每个任务都从全新上下文开始，可将我们的估计降低约 60%。我们还发现父会话日志只报告子 agent 的最终内部调用，将委派 token 低估了十倍；对于该工作负载，这一修正只改变约 5% 的能耗估计，但 token 数量研究对此完全暴露。我们的发现揭示了当前能耗估计器与 agentic 工作负载在处理上下文上的巨大差距，凸显了对能够捕捉上下文积累、缓存复用和委派执行的工作流级能耗核算的需求。
translation.brief: 针对现有 LLM 能耗估计忽略缓存上下文重复读取和子 agent 委派的问题，提出缓存感知的混合能耗估计器并分析真实开发工作流的 token 轨迹。

papers.title: Accelerate Bench: Evaluating Agents for Application-Level Program Optimization
papers.abstract: Application optimization requires coding agents to discover useful changes and coordinate them across a complete program while preserving the required computation. We introduce Accelerate Bench, a benchmark of 32 CPU optimization tasks adapted from scientific applications and supercomputing competitions. Each task provides a working program and specifies the workload, correctness requirements, timing boundaries, and permitted edits, leaving agents to choose where and how to optimize. Public testing supports iterative development, and a separate verifier scores the final submission. On benchmark version 1.1, we evaluate 16 coding agents, each pairing a model with a harness. Their Score@1 ranges from 25.5% to 67.4%. Most of their programs are correct, and the size of the speedup separates them: the two leading agents are at least 2x faster on 22 or more of the 32 tasks, while the other fourteen reach 2x on 8 to 17 and leave 125 of their 412 correct outcomes below 1.25x. Controlled replays show why coordination across an application matters: identical source code runs between 0.29x and 2.12x depending only on build and runtime settings, and one code change is worth 1.01x or 6.4x depending on another. Accelerate Bench pairs executable workloads with agents' programs and trajectories to evaluate both their gains and the process behind them.

translation.title: Accelerate Bench：面向应用级程序优化的 Agent 评测
translation.abstract: 应用优化要求编码 agent 发现有用的改动并在完整程序上协调这些改动，同时保持所需的计算。我们提出 Accelerate Bench，这是一个包含 32 个 CPU 优化任务的基准，改编自科学应用和超级计算竞赛。每个任务提供一个可运行的程序，并规定工作负载、正确性要求、时间边界和允许的修改范围，由 agent 自行决定在何处以及如何优化。公开测试支持迭代开发，并由独立的验证器对最终提交进行评分。在基准版本 1.1 上，我们评估了 16 个编码 agent（每个由模型与 harness 组合而成），其 Score@1 在 25.5% 到 67.4% 之间。大多数程序是正确的，区分它们的是加速比的大小：两个领先的 agent 在 32 个任务中的至少 22 个上达到 2 倍以上加速，而其余十四个仅在 8 到 17 个任务上达到 2 倍，并且在它们 412 个正确结果中有 125 个低于 1.25 倍。受控重放展示了跨应用协调为何重要：相同的源代码仅因构建和运行时设置不同，运行速度可在 0.29 倍到 2.12 倍之间变化；而某一项代码改动的效果（1.01 倍或 6.4 倍）取决于另一项改动。Accelerate Bench 将可执行工作负载与 agent 的程序和轨迹配对，以同时评估其收益及其背后的过程。
translation.brief: 为评测编码 agent 在完整应用级程序优化中的能力，构建了包含 32 个 CPU 优化任务、可执行工作负载与独立验证器的基准 Accelerate Bench。

papers.title: Nearly Settling the Complexity of Connected $\varepsilon$-Envy-Free Cake Cutting
papers.abstract: Envy-free cake cutting has been one of the central problems in fair division. In cake cutting, agents' preferences over the cake are accessed through Robertson--Webb (RW) queries. For three or more agents, no algorithm that makes finitely many RW queries can always find a contiguous, exactly envy-free allocation. For contiguous $\varepsilon$-envy-free allocations, however, Hollender and Rubinstein~(JACM, 2025) showed that $\poly(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ RW queries suffice for four agents, leaving open whether such a bound is possible for five or more agents. In this paper, we establish a striking change in query complexity: $\poly(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ RW queries suffice for up to five agents, whereas $(1/\varepsilon)^{\Omega(1)}$ queries are necessary for seven or more agents, even when valuations are additive. Thus, we resolve the five-agent case and, more broadly, determine whether polylogarithmic query complexity is possible for every number of agents except six. We also explore the computational complexity of finding contiguous $\varepsilon$-envy-free allocations. When monotone Lipschitz valuations are given by polynomial-time evaluation procedures (e.g., arithmetic circuits and efficiently computable Turing machines), we show that an $\varepsilon$-envy-free division can be computed in polynomial time for five agents. In contrast, even for additive valuations, finding an $\varepsilon$-envy-free division is UEOPL-hard for every fixed number of agents $n\ge7$ and PPAD-complete for every fixed $n\ge13$.

translation.title: 几乎解决连通 ε-无嫉妒蛋糕切割的复杂度问题
translation.abstract: 无嫉妒蛋糕切割一直是公平分配中的核心问题之一。在蛋糕切割中，agent 对蛋糕的偏好通过 Robertson--Webb（RW）查询来获取。对于三个或更多 agent，不存在任何进行有限次 RW 查询的算法总能找到连通的、精确无嫉妒的分配。然而，对于连通的 ε-无嫉妒分配，Hollender 和 Rubinstein（JACM, 2025）证明了对四个 agent，poly(log(1/ε)) 次 RW 查询即可，而对于五个或更多 agent 是否能达到此界仍是开放问题。本文确立了查询复杂度的显著变化：poly(log(1/ε)) 次 RW 查询对最多五个 agent 足够，而对七个或更多 agent，即使估值是可加的，也需要 (1/ε)^{Ω(1)} 次查询。因此，我们解决了五个 agent 的情形，更广泛地确定了除六个 agent 之外，对每个 agent 数量是否可能达到多对数查询复杂度。我们还探讨了寻找连通 ε-无嫉妒分配的计算复杂度。当单调 Lipschitz 估值由多项式时间求值程序给出（如算术电路和高效可计算的图灵机）时，我们证明五个 agent 的 ε-无嫉妒分配可以在多项式时间内计算。相反，即使对于可加估值，对每个固定 agent 数 n≥7，寻找 ε-无嫉妒分配是 UEOPL-hard 的；对每个固定 n≥13，则是 PPAD-complete 的。
translation.brief: 针对连通 ε-无嫉妒蛋糕切割的查询与计算复杂度问题，证明五个 agent 时多对数 RW 查询可行而七个及以上需要多项式倒数次查询，并给出相应的计算复杂度刻画。

papers.title: From Recursion to Convolution: Parallel Self-Improvement for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Multi-agent self-improvement enables agents to improve through interaction and feedback. However, sequential dependencies across agents and refinement rounds can propagate errors, increase computational costs, and limit parallelism. Moreover, refining individual features or agents in isolation can overlook their dependencies and restrict collective coordination. To address these challenges, we propose ConvRSI, a framework for parallelizing multi-agent self-improvement through convolution. ConvRSI couples intra-agent convolution, which jointly refines related agent features, with inter-agent graph convolution, which aggregates messages according to the collaboration topology. Both stages operate in latent space, enabling parallel updates without repeatedly decoding and re-encoding intermediate messages. Experiments on MATH-500 show that ConvRSI achieves 5.04% performance improvement while reducing 17.27% inference cost, and 45.11% latency compared with RecursiveMAS. It also supports diverse collaboration patterns by representing their topologies as adjacency matrices. These results demonstrate the potential of convolutional co-evolution for efficient multi-agent self-improvement. Our code and datasets are provided in this https URL.

translation.title: 从递归到卷积：多智能体系统的并行自我改进
translation.abstract: 多智能体自我改进使 agent 能够通过交互和反馈进行改进。然而，跨 agent 和改进轮次的顺序依赖会传播错误、增加计算成本并限制并行性。此外，孤立地改进单个特征或 agent 可能忽视其依赖关系并限制集体协调。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 ConvRSI，一个通过卷积实现多智能体自我改进并行化的框架。ConvRSI 将联合改进相关 agent 特征的 agent 内卷积与根据协作拓扑聚合消息的 agent 间图卷积相结合。两个阶段都在潜空间中运行，无需反复解码和再编码中间消息即可实现并行更新。在 MATH-500 上的实验表明，与 RecursiveMAS 相比，ConvRSI 实现了 5.04% 的性能提升，同时减少了 17.27% 的推理成本和 45.11% 的延迟。它还通过将协作模式的拓扑表示为邻接矩阵来支持多样化的协作模式。这些结果展示了卷积式协同演化在高效多智能体自我改进方面的潜力。我们的代码和数据集见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体自我改进中顺序依赖导致的错误传播与并行性受限问题，提出 ConvRSI 框架，用潜空间中的 agent 内卷积与 agent 间图卷积实现并行化自我改进。

papers.title: Disaggregated LLM Inference in Space: A Communication Feasibility Study
papers.abstract: Orbital data centers could enable large-scale AI inference, but efficiently serving a frontier language model to many users may require several compute satellites to cooperate over optical links. While disaggregated inference, which splits large language model (LLM) serving across machines, is well established in terrestrial data centers, its viability under the unique constraints of orbital deployments remains an open question. This article investigates how link capacity and satellite separation affect two types of disaggregated LLM serving, in both compact satellite formations and distributed constellations. Prefill-decode disaggregation (PDD) migrates a large KV cache once per request, while attention-FFN disaggregation (AFD) exchanges small activations at every mixture-of-experts layer for every generated token. The two respond to distance in different ways. PDD is limited mainly by link capacity and, with fast enough links, tolerates separations of up to a thousand kilometers. AFD is limited mainly by propagation delay, which accumulates layer by layer and forces attention and expert instances within about a kilometer of each other. Based on these results, we propose a hierarchical orbital inference architecture and provide network design guidelines for future orbital data centers, including the role of ground access latency.

translation.title: 空间中的分离式 LLM 推理：一项通信可行性研究
translation.abstract: 轨道数据中心可以实现大规模 AI 推理，但向大量用户高效服务一个前沿语言模型可能需要多颗计算卫星通过光学链路协作。虽然分离式推理——即将大语言模型（LLM）服务拆分到多台机器上——在地面数据中心已很成熟，但其在轨道部署独特约束下的可行性仍是一个开放问题。本文研究了链路容量和卫星间距如何影响两种类型的分离式 LLM 服务，涵盖紧凑卫星编队和分布式星座两种场景。Prefill-decode 分离（PDD）每个请求只需迁移一次大型 KV 缓存，而 attention-FFN 分离（AFD）在每生成一个 token 时于每个 mixture-of-experts 层交换小的激活值。二者对距离的响应方式不同。PDD 主要受链路容量限制，在链路足够快时可容忍高达一千公里的间距。AFD 主要受传播延迟限制，延迟逐层累积，迫使 attention 和专家实例相距约一公里以内。基于这些结果，我们提出了一种分层轨道推理架构，并为未来的轨道数据中心提供了网络设计指南，包括地面接入延迟的作用。
translation.brief: 针对轨道数据中心上分离式 LLM 推理的通信可行性问题，分析 PDD 与 AFD 两种模式受链路容量与传播延迟的不同约束并提出分层轨道推理架构。

papers.title: Auditing a Moving Target: Evidence Anchoring and the Expiry of Fairness Audits of Provider-Served Language Models
papers.abstract: Organizations increasingly use large language models (LLMs) for decisions about people, such as hiring, investment and employee evaluation, and rely on them over long periods of time. Fairness audits of such systems, however, are conducted only once. We examine how the biases of LLMs change over time. In a venture screening setting, models from five providers decided whether and how much to invest in startups whose founders differed only in gender, origin and university. We repeated this audit three times over 13 months (248,400 API calls). Study 1 shows that the same model, called under the same identifier one year later, displayed a significantly different bias pattern. Study 2 shows that the successors of retired models carried the same bias as their predecessors, but in a significantly different size and form. Study 3 shows that the bias does not depend on the industry of the startup. A document analysis further shows that providers change and retire models at their discretion, with notice periods of zero to six months. Drawing on these findings, we develop a theory of evidence anchoring. We theorize that bias resides in the model class and persists, whereas audit evidence is anchored to a single model and expires when the provider decides. We derive policy advice for organizations and regulators, namely audits of model classes instead of single models, a version record for every model response, and re-audits triggered by model changes.

translation.title: 审计一个移动的靶标：证据锚定与服务商提供语言模型的公平性审计失效
translation.abstract: 组织日益将大型语言模型（LLM）用于涉及人的决策，如招聘、投资和员工评估，并长期依赖它们。然而，此类系统的公平性审计通常只进行一次。我们考察LLM的偏见如何随时间变化。在一个创业筛选场景中，来自五家供应商的模型决定是否投资以及投资多少给创始人仅在性别、出身和大学上不同的初创公司。我们在13个月内重复该审计三次（248,400次API调用）。研究1表明，一年后在相同标识符下调用的同一模型显示出显著不同的偏见模式。研究2表明，已退役模型的后继者继承了前代相同的偏见，但规模和形式显著不同。研究3表明，偏见不依赖于初创公司所处行业。文档分析进一步表明，供应商可自行决定更改和退役模型，通知期为零至六个月。基于这些发现，我们发展了证据锚定理论。我们认为偏见存在于模型类中并持续存在，而审计证据锚定于单一模型，并在供应商决定时失效。我们为组织和监管者提出政策建议：审计模型类而非单一模型、为每次模型响应记录版本，以及在模型变更时触发重新审计。
translation.brief: 针对LLM公平性审计结果随供应商更新模型而失效的问题，通过13个月内重复审计实验提出证据锚定理论，并建议审计模型类而非单一模型。

papers.title: Multi-LLM Agentic AI at the Edge: Joint Agent Scheduling and Resource Allocation
papers.abstract: In this paper, an edge-enabled multi-large language model (LLM) agentic AI architecture is proposed, where one supervisor AI agent and multiple worker AI agents cooperatively execute users' requests at the edge. The supervisor AI agent decouples the user request into a series of sub-tasks and dynamically dispatches them to LLM-equipped worker AI agents via two agentic workflows, i.e., parallel and serial workflows, with a two-level retry mechanism to enhance execution reliability. To prolong the service duration of worker AI agents, the energy minimization problems are formulated by jointly considering AI agent selection and resource allocation, subject to task execution latency and quality of service (QoS) constraints. A resource allocation scheme based on alternating optimization (AO) is proposed. Specifically, for the parallel workflow, the scheme decouples the original problem into bandwidth allocation, retrieval selection and AI agent selection sub-problems, which are iteratively solved by the proposed successive convex approximation (SCA), Lagrangian relaxation (LR), and Gale-Shapley (GS) or LLM-based algorithms, respectively. For the serial workflow, the problem is similarly decoupled into service time allocation, retrieval selection and AI agent selection sub-problems; the optimal service time allocation is obtained via Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions, while the latter two sub-problems are addressed by extending the proposed algorithms to the serial scenario. Simulation results show that the proposed resource allocation scheme can reduce system energy consumption compared with other benchmarks, while experiments on a multi-LLM agentic AI system based on Qwen and Llama demonstrate improved task execution success rates.

translation.title: 边缘侧多LLM智能体AI：联合智能体调度与资源分配
translation.abstract: 本文提出一种边缘使能的多大型语言模型（LLM）智能体AI架构，其中一个监督AI智能体和多个工作AI智能体在边缘协作执行用户请求。监督AI智能体将用户请求解耦为一系列子任务，并通过两种智能体工作流（并行和串行工作流）动态调度给配备LLM的工作AI智能体，同时采用两级重试机制以增强执行可靠性。为延长工作AI智能体的服务时长，本文在任务执行时延和服务质量（QoS）约束下，联合考虑智能体选择与资源分配，构建能量最小化问题。提出一种基于交替优化（AO）的资源分配方案。具体而言，对于并行工作流，该方案将原问题解耦为带宽分配、检索选择和智能体选择子问题，分别通过所提出的逐次凸逼近（SCA）、拉格朗日松弛（LR）以及Gale-Shapley（GS）或基于LLM的算法迭代求解。对于串行工作流，问题同样被解耦为服务时间分配、检索选择和智能体选择子问题；最优服务时间分配通过Karush-Kuhn-Tucker（KKT）条件获得，后两个子问题通过将所提算法扩展到串行场景来处理。仿真结果表明，所提资源分配方案相比其他基准可降低系统能耗，基于Qwen和Llama的多LLM智能体AI系统实验显示任务执行成功率得到提升。
translation.brief: 针对边缘多LLM智能体系统的能耗问题，提出监督者-工作者架构并结合交替优化方法联合求解智能体调度与资源分配。

papers.title: Experience Rot: Experienced Agents Fail Where Novices Succeed
papers.abstract: Agents are increasingly built to learn from experience: they keep conversation histories, memory files, retrieved notes and skills, and reuse what worked before. We show that this experience turns against them when their tools change silently. We test a range of models with tools defined as in the Model Context Protocol (MCP). After a silent change, experienced agents fail on most tasks, while agents new to the task mostly succeed. We call this failure Experience Rot. Experienced agents copy their earlier call instead of checking the current interface, even when the tool definition shows the change. Then they report success. When the documentation is incomplete, experience is what makes agents succeed. After a change, the same experience leaves them worse off than no experience at all. The failure appears in every form of memory we test and grows with the amount of experience. Simple remedies fall short: announcing the update barely helps, and pointing the agent to the documentation fails whenever the documentation does not spell out the answer.

translation.title: 经验腐化：有经验的智能体在新手成功之处失败
translation.abstract: 越来越多智能体被设计为从经验中学习：它们保存对话历史、记忆文件、检索笔记和技能，并复用过去有效的方法。我们表明，当工具发生静默变化时，这种经验会反噬它们。我们用按Model Context Protocol（MCP）方式定义的工具测试了一系列模型。在静默变更之后，有经验的智能体在大多数任务上失败，而初次接触该任务的智能体大多成功。我们将这种失败称为经验腐化（Experience Rot）。有经验的智能体复制其早期调用而不检查当前接口，即使工具定义已显示变更。然后它们报告成功。当文档不完整时，经验正是智能体成功的原因。变更之后，同样的经验使它们比毫无经验更糟糕。这种失败出现在我们测试的每一种记忆形式中，并随经验量增长。简单的补救措施收效甚微：宣布更新几乎无济于事，而只要文档未明确给出答案，将智能体指向文档也会失败。
translation.brief: 针对智能体因记忆过时经验而在工具静默变更后失败的问题，通过MCP工具实验揭示并命名了经验腐化现象。

papers.title: Navital Gym: Rule-Graded Agent Environments for Indian Workflows
papers.abstract: AI agents are being deployed on Indian workflows such as payments, tax, forms, travel and customer support in Hindi and Hinglish. Public agent evaluations rarely cover these workflows, and many score with another language model. We present Navital Gym, a set of six open environments with 321 public tasks in five task families: trip planning, UPI payments and disputes, GST invoicing and returns, form filling (including a multi-document split) and customer support in Hindi, Hinglish and three experimental Indian languages. Every task is graded by named, deterministic rules that recompute the outcome from a synthetic sandbox world. No language model judges any score. We report one run per task for three models on all six environments, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 4.5, and for Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite on two (UPI and the Support core). Opus solves 315 of 321 tasks, Sonnet 302 and Haiku 205. Trip planning and Hindi/Hinglish support separate the models most. We also describe a private held-out set that is not published, and a 7B adapter trained in the gym. Code is Apache-2.0 and task data is CC BY 4.0. The rules are a documented simplification of Indian practice, not the live systems.

translation.title: Navital Gym：面向印度工作流的规则评分智能体环境
translation.abstract: AI智能体正被部署于印度工作流，如支付、税务、表格、旅行以及印地语和Hinglish的客户支持。公开的智能体评估很少涵盖这些工作流，且许多使用另一个语言模型打分。我们提出Navital Gym，一套包含六个开放环境、321个公开任务的集合，涵盖五个任务族：行程规划、UPI支付与争议、GST发票与申报、表单填写（包括多文档拆分）以及印地语、Hinglish和三种实验性印度语言的客户支持。每个任务由具名的确定性规则评分，这些规则从合成沙盒世界重新计算结果。没有任何语言模型参与评分。我们报告三个模型在全部六个环境上每任务一次运行的结果，即Claude Opus 5.5、Claude Sonnet 5.5和Claude Haiku 4.5，以及Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite在两个环境（UPI和Support核心）上的结果。Opus解决了321个任务中的315个，Sonnet为302个，Haiku为205个。行程规划和印地语/Hinglish支持最能区分各模型。我们还描述了一个未公开的私有保留集，以及在该gym中训练的一个7B适配器。代码采用Apache-2.0许可，任务数据采用CC BY 4.0许可。这些规则是对印度实践的已记录简化，并非真实系统。
translation.brief: 针对智能体评估缺乏印度工作流覆盖且依赖LLM评分的问题，构建了六套基于确定性规则评分的开放智能体评测环境。

papers.title: LEDGER: Auditable Agent Memory Under Change
papers.abstract: Agent memory systems are mostly evaluated on fixed histories, and only their final answers are scored. In real use, facts change, sources differ in reliability, and users ask the agent to forget things. We present LEDGER, a memory layer in which a language model proposes facts and explicit rules decide which value is current, which source to trust, and what to delete. Each fact keeps its source and the period in which it held. LEDGER+EP adds a search over raw conversation turns for questions the ledger does not cover, and scrubs these turns on deletion. We compare both against no memory, full-history replay, retrieval over raw transcripts, and Mem0, with the same answering model and prompt, on a synthetic multi-session coding-agent workload and a 210-question subset of LongMemEval, and we score both the evidence each memory sends to the model and the answer. On the coding workload, LEDGER+EP in fallback mode answers 94.3% of questions correctly on five development seeds and 91.1% on five held-out seeds, against 82.1% and 83.3% for full replay, the strongest baseline. When a deletion request only describes the fact, no deleted value reached our systems' evidence in any evaluated probe. On LongMemEval, LEDGER+EP in augment mode has the same observed accuracy as full replay (74.8%) with 1% of its context. The main limitation is that the coding workload is synthetic and built by us; on LongMemEval, the differences between the strongest systems are within the confidence intervals.

translation.title: LEDGER：变更下可审计的智能体记忆
translation.abstract: 智能体记忆系统大多在固定历史上评估，且仅对其最终答案评分。在真实使用中，事实会变化，来源可靠性不同，用户还会要求智能体遗忘内容。我们提出LEDGER，一个记忆层，其中语言模型提出事实，显式规则决定哪个值是当前值、信任哪个来源以及删除什么。每个事实保留其来源及其成立的时间段。LEDGER+EP增加对原始对话轮次的搜索，以应对账本未覆盖的问题，并在删除时清理这些轮次。我们将两者与无记忆、全历史重放、原始转录检索以及Mem0在相同回答模型和提示下比较，采用合成多会话编码智能体工作负载和LongMemEval的210题子集，并对记忆发送给模型的证据和答案均进行评分。在编码工作负载上，LEDGER+EP回退模式在五个开发种子上正确回答94.3%的问题，在五个保留种子上为91.1%，而最强基线全重放分别为82.1%和83.3%。当删除请求仅描述事实时，在所有评估探测中均无被删值进入我们系统的证据。在LongMemEval上，LEDGER+EP增强模式的观测准确率与全重放相同（74.8%），但仅使用其1%的上下文。主要局限是编码工作负载为合成的且由我们构建；在LongMemEval上，最强系统之间的差异在置信区间内。
translation.brief: 针对智能体记忆难以应对事实变更、来源冲突和删除请求的问题，提出LEDGER，用显式规则管理事实来源与有效期以实现可审计记忆。

papers.title: Jev-as-a-Reward: Validating Probabilistic Safety Judges for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Probabilistic safety judges return the probability of a safety label and cheaply score reinforcement learning rollouts. A confidence gate sends only uncertain verdicts to a stronger LLM judge, which leaves confidently passed harm in a blind spot. Policies can exploit this blind spot, and commercial judges release new versions. We propose a protocol that validates such a judge before and during training, separates the share of confidently passed harm from its amount, and re-validates it after each judge change. We apply it to two versions of Jev, a commercial decision-only judge, and to an open guard classifier. Under the probability reward of Jev, passed harm shrinks in all 11 runs under the primary reference, mostly more slowly than caught harm, and concentrates in the blind spot. Binarizing this judge meets the escape criterion on Llama, and the open guard classifier shows an escape signal in one seed under a second reference. Guard classifiers share this blind spot, and even frontier LLM judges catch at most one of 10 human-labeled confident misses. Without a trained reward model, the probability reward with a helpfulness term lowers HarmBench attack success on Llama-3.1-8B from 0.287 to at most 0.033 at the final checkpoint.

translation.title: Jev-as-a-Reward：面向强化学习的概率安全裁判验证
translation.abstract: 概率安全裁判返回安全标签的概率，并以低成本为强化学习 rollout 打分。置信度门控只将不确定的判定发送给更强的 LLM 裁判，这会使高置信度通过的有害内容成为盲区。策略可能利用这一盲区，且商用裁判会发布新版本。我们提出一个协议，在训练前和训练中对这类裁判进行验证，将高置信度通过的有害内容的份额与其数量分离，并在每次裁判变更后重新验证。我们将其应用于两个版本的 Jev（一个商用仅输出决策的裁判）和一个开源 guard 分类器。在 Jev 的概率奖励下，在主要参考下全部 11 次运行中通过的有害内容均收缩，但大多慢于被捕获的有害内容，并集中在盲区。对该裁判进行二值化后在 Llama 上满足逃逸准则，开源 guard 分类器在第二个参考下在一个种子上出现逃逸信号。Guard 分类器共享这一盲区，即使是前沿 LLM 裁判，在 10 个人工标注的高置信度漏检中也至多捕获 1 个。在无需训练奖励模型的情况下，带 helpfulness 项的概率奖励将 Llama-3.1-8B 在最终检查点上的 HarmBench 攻击成功率从 0.287 降至至多 0.033。
translation.brief: 针对概率安全裁判置信门控造成有害内容盲区的问题，提出一套在训练前后分离并验证“高置信度通过的有害内容”的协议，并评估商用裁判与 guard 分类器。

papers.title: From Vision to Interaction: Evaluating Dynamic Social Intelligence of VLM Agents in ALIVE-World
papers.abstract: As AI agents are increasingly deployed in real-world applications and take on social roles, dynamic social intelligence, the ability to continuously perceive multimodal cues, infer latent cognitive states, intervene through embodied actions, and ultimately achieve social goals, has become essential. However, existing evaluations largely fragment social intelligence into text-based abstractions, static reasoning tasks, or embodied simulators that lack social dynamics. These approaches fail to capture the multimodal, continuous, and interpersonal complexity of authentic human interactions. To bridge this gap, we introduce ALIVE-World, an embodied simulation environment supporting dynamic multimodal interactions encompassing egocentric vision, language, and non-verbal action. To provide socially grounded interactive feedback, we populate this environment with counterpart agents driven by a profile-conditioned, dual-system (intuitive-affective and logical-cognitive) architecture. Building upon this platform, we propose ALIVE-Bench to transform the assessment of social intelligence into a trackable quantitative framework. By deeply leveraging underlying environmental states and agents' internal variables, ALIVE-Bench systematically evaluates Vision-Language Model (VLM) agents across four critical dimensions: perception, understanding, influence, and outcome. Extensive evaluations reveal that dynamic social intelligence is fundamentally multi-dimensional and scenario-dependent. We identify a critical bottleneck between upstream perception and downstream social intervention, exposing VLM vulnerabilities in fine-grained proxemic awareness, adaptive intervention, and multi-party coordination. By uncovering these limitations and the diverse interaction strategies they produce, this benchmark provides actionable insights for the future behavioral alignment of multimodal agents.

translation.title: 从视觉到交互：在 ALIVE-World 中评估 VLM 智能体的动态社会智能
translation.abstract: 随着 AI 智能体越来越多地部署于现实应用并承担社会角色，动态社会智能——持续感知多模态线索、推断潜在认知状态、通过具身行动进行干预并最终实现社会目标的能力——变得至关重要。然而，现有评估大多将社会智能割裂为基于文本的抽象、静态推理任务或缺乏社会动态的具身模拟器。这些方法无法捕捉真实人际交互的多模态、持续性和人际复杂性。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 ALIVE-World，一个支持涵盖自我中心视觉、语言和非言语行动的动态多模态交互的具身仿真环境。为提供扎根于社会的交互反馈，我们以由画像条件化、双系统（直觉-情感与逻辑-认知）架构驱动的对手智能体填充该环境。在该平台基础上，我们提出 ALIVE-Bench，将社会智能评估转化为可追踪的量化框架。通过深度利用底层环境状态与智能体内部变量，ALIVE-Bench 从感知、理解、影响和结果四个关键维度系统评估视觉-语言模型（VLM）智能体。大量评估表明，动态社会智能本质上是多维且依赖场景的。我们发现上游感知与下游社会干预之间存在关键瓶颈，暴露了 VLM 在细粒度近距感知、自适应干预与多方协调上的脆弱性。通过揭示这些局限及其产生的多样交互策略，该基准为多模态智能体未来的行为对齐提供了可操作的洞见。
translation.brief: 针对现有评估割裂社会智能、缺乏真实多模态交互的问题，构建具身仿真环境 ALIVE-World 与量化基准 ALIVE-Bench，从感知、理解、影响、结果四维评估 VLM 智能体的动态社会智能。

papers.title: Adaptive-Elbow Graph Traversal for Schema Retrieval in Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract: LLM-based natural-language interfaces to relational databases are gated by a schema-retrieval step: the generator can only be as good as the slice of schema it is shown. On a database with hundreds of tables, that slice must be selected and the selection is two-sided---omit a needed table and the query becomes unrecoverable, include too many and the irrelevant ones act as noise that degrades the model's output. When an agentic retriever that lets the model inspect the schema can be too costly or too slow, the fallback is an embedder that ranks tables by cosine similarity and keeps a top-k. This fallback has two weaknesses: a fixed budget is suboptimal question by question, and embedding similarity overlooks foreign-key-linked tables that are necessary for joins. We present Adaptive-Elbow Graph Traversal (AEGT, ElbowHop for short), a property-graph table retriever that addresses both: an adaptive elbow cutoff replaces the fixed budget with a per-question one under a single aggressiveness parameter, and bidirectional foreign-key traversal deterministically recovers the bridge tables embedding similarity misses. We evaluate the retriever on 3 corpora of increasing candidate-pool size (BIRD Mini-Dev queried per database, 3--13 tables; its eleven schemas merged, 74; and a merged Spider-train graph, 546) and isolate the two mechanisms under a per-question budget-matched protocol. Across these settings the adaptive elbow emerges as the dominant mechanism---at matched recall it roughly doubles precision over a fixed budget on the larger pools, the margin widening as the pool grows---while the foreign-key traversal pays off on the join-critical bridge tables dense retrieval cannot reach, in the single-hop tight-budget case. We characterize the method as a low-cost, recall-robust first stage for schema retrieval on which a downstream selection or generation step can build.

translation.title: 面向 Text-to-SQL 模式检索的自适应肘部图遍历
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的关系数据库自然语言接口受模式检索步骤制约：生成器的质量取决于其所见的模式切片。在拥有数百张表的数据库上，必须选择该切片，且选择是双向的——漏掉所需表则查询无法恢复，纳入过多则无关表成为噪声、降低模型输出。当让模型检视模式的智能体检索器过于昂贵或缓慢时，退路是使用按余弦相似度排序并保留 top-k 的嵌入器。这一退路有两个弱点：固定预算对每个问题并非最优，且嵌入相似度会遗漏连接所需的外键关联表。我们提出自适应肘部图遍历（AEGT，简称 ElbowHop），一个属性图表检索器，同时解决两者：自适应肘部截断在单一激进程度参数下用逐问题预算取代固定预算，双向外键遍历确定性地恢复嵌入相似度遗漏的桥接表。我们在三个候选池规模递增的语料上评估该检索器（BIRD Mini-Dev 按数据库查询，3–13 张表；其十一个 schema 合并，74 张；以及合并的 Spider-train 图，546 张），并在逐问题预算匹配协议下分离两种机制。在所有设置中，自适应肘部是主导机制——在相同召回率下，在较大候选池上其精确率约为固定预算的两倍，且差距随池增大而扩大——而外键遍历在密集检索无法触及的连接关键桥接表上，于单跳紧预算情形下见效。我们将该方法定位为模式检索的低成本、召回稳健的第一阶段，下游选择或生成步骤可在其上构建。
translation.brief: 针对 top-k 嵌入式模式检索固定预算次优且遗漏外键桥接表的问题，提出 ElbowHop，用自适应肘部截断确定逐问题预算并通过双向外键图遍历恢复桥接表。

papers.title: GRACE: Parallel Best-of-N Multi-Agent Analysis of Closed-Form Questions over Dataframes with Guardrail Selection and Adaptive Retry
papers.abstract: LLM agents answer closed-form questions over a tabular dataframe by writing and executing Python, almost always as a single rollout: one interpretation, one script, one result, accepted without comparison. The few pipelines that produce several candidates reconcile them by answer-agreement voting, which needs a single comparable scalar and always returns one, even when every candidate is wrong. We present GRACE (Generative, Ranked, Adaptive Code Ensemble), a production-oriented pipeline that instead runs parallel best-of-N selection specialised to dataframe code. N agents run concurrently under a strict, machine-checkable output contract, diversified by persona hints, per-retry rotation, and a two-regime temperature schedule. Rather than vote, GRACE judges the executed artefacts: a pairwise tournament pre-filters the pool and a domain-specialised guardrail either selects the best candidate or, when none is defensible, rejects the whole pool and abstains with a diagnosis (an option voting structurally lacks), which in turn drives an adaptive retry with per-agent feedback. On InfiAgent-DABench (DAEval, M = 246), using Qwen3.6-35B-A3B as the backbone, GRACE raises answer match from 39% for a single-rollout baseline to 71% (+32 pp, 1.8x), recovering 53% of previously wrong answers. On the same DAEval task, the smaller dense Qwen3.5-9B lifts answer match from 38% to 63% (+25 pp, 1.7x). A controlled 3 x 3 study that sweeps the number of parallel agents against the retry budget finds, on the 35B backbone, the two levers largely substitutable: once either one is generous, the other adds little, identifying a cheap operating point for deployment. The same directional pattern replicates on the independent DataBench benchmark, again on the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B backbone, where answer match rises by 15 percentage points (from 70% to 85%) across 400 sampled questions.

translation.title: GRACE：带护栏选择与自适应重试的 dataframe 封闭式问题并行 Best-of-N 多智能体分析
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体通过编写并执行 Python 来回答关于表格 dataframe 的封闭式问题，几乎总是单次 rollout：一个解读、一个脚本、一个结果，不做比较便被接受。少数产出多个候选的流水线通过答案一致性投票来调和，这需要一个可比较的标量，并且即使所有候选都错也会返回一个答案。我们提出 GRACE（Generative, Ranked, Adaptive Code Ensemble），一个面向生产、专注于 dataframe 代码的并行 best-of-N 选择流水线。N 个智能体在严格、机器可校验的输出契约下并发运行，并通过 persona 提示、每次重试的轮换和双区间温度调度实现多样化。GRACE 不投票，而是评审执行产物：成对锦标赛预筛选候选池，一个领域专用的护栏要么选出最佳候选，要么在无候选可辩护时拒绝整个池并附诊断弃权（投票机制在结构上不具备此选项），进而驱动带逐智能体反馈的自适应重试。在 InfiAgent-DABench（DAEval，M = 246）上，以 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 为骨干，GRACE 将答案匹配率从单次 rollout 基线的 39% 提升至 71%（+32 个百分点，1.8 倍），修复了 53% 的此前错误答案。在同一 DAEval 任务上，更小的稠密模型 Qwen3.5-9B 将答案匹配率从 38% 提升至 63%（+25 个百分点，1.7 倍）。一项扫描并行智能体数与重试预算的受控 3×3 研究发现，在 35B 骨干上两个杠杆基本可互换：一旦其中一个足够充裕，另一个增益甚微，从而确定了廉价的部署运行点。相同方向的模式在独立基准 DataBench 上、同样在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 骨干上复现：400 个抽样问题中答案匹配率提升 15 个百分点（从 70% 到 85%）。
translation.brief: 针对单次 rollout 或答案投票无法鉴别全错候选的问题，提出 GRACE 并行 best-of-N 流水线，通过锦标赛预筛、护栏选择或弃权诊断及自适应重试提升 dataframe 问答准确率。

papers.title: Hivemind: A Federated Protocol for AI-Mediated Tacit Knowledge Sharing in Organisations
papers.abstract: This paper presents Hivemind, a federated protocol that enables AI agents to exchange tacit knowledge on behalf of their users, asynchronously and without requiring any direct human interaction. Individual AI memory systems capture the decisions, reasoning, and contextual knowledge that surface during AI-assisted work. Hivemind creates the shared space in which this captured knowledge can flow between individuals across team and departmental boundaries, addressing a structural gap that neither centralised knowledge repositories nor existing AI tooling closes, even where partial solutions such as expert-finding systems exist. The paper evaluates centralised versus decentralised design approaches, proposes a federated architecture grounded in Nonaka and Takeuchi's (1995) Socialisation, Externalisation, Combination and Internalisation (SECI) model, and demonstrates a proof-of-concept implementation using Design Science Research (DSR) methodology. Measuring the enterprise benefit of federated tacit expertise sharing remains an open task for future work.

translation.title: Hivemind：一种组织中 AI 介导的隐性知识共享联邦协议
translation.abstract: 本文提出 Hivemind，一种联邦协议，使 AI 智能体能够代表其用户异步交换隐性知识，无需任何直接的人际互动。个体 AI 记忆系统捕获 AI 辅助工作中浮现的决策、推理与情境知识。Hivemind 创建了这些捕获的知识得以跨越团队与部门边界在个体间流动的共享空间，弥补了集中式知识库与现有 AI 工具均未能填补的结构性空白，即便在存在专家发现系统等部分解决方案的情况下也是如此。论文评估了集中式与去中心化设计路径，提出一个基于 Nonaka 和 Takeuchi（1995）社会化、外化、组合、内化（SECI）模型的联邦架构，并采用设计科学研究（DSR）方法展示了概念验证实现。衡量联邦式隐性专长共享的企业效益仍是未来工作的开放任务。
translation.brief: 针对组织内跨团队隐性知识无法流动的问题，提出联邦协议 Hivemind，让 AI 智能体基于 SECI 模型异步代表用户交换隐性知识。

papers.title: Development of an HPLC Analytical Method Based on Large Language Models:A Case Study of the Eczema External Wash Formula
papers.abstract: Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) formulas feature complex chemical compositions, and their HPLC quality control method development is time-consuming and experience-dependent. Large language models (LLMs) provide a promising strategy for intelligently assisting analytical method construction. Taking the Eczema External Wash Formula as the research object, this work constructed a human-machine collaborative workflow involving intelligent recommendation, experimental validation and iterative optimization for HPLC method development. Among five prompt strategies tested, expert-role setting with structured reasoning performed best. After inputting formula information, the LLM proposed five chromatographic schemes. Through experimental screening and optimization, the final HPLC method used a SunShell C18 column, mobile phase of 0.1% aqueous formic acid-acetonitrile for gradient elution, with seven markers separated within 55 min. Twenty components were characterized by LC-MS. The validated method exhibited satisfactory linearity, precision, repeatability, stability and recovery. This indicates LLMs can reduce the workload of chromatographic condition exploration and boost the development efficiency of TCM formula analytical methods, supporting intelligent TCM quality control.

translation.title: 基于大语言模型的HPLC分析方法开发：湿疹外洗方案例研究
translation.abstract: 中药复方化学成分复杂，其HPLC质量控制方法开发耗时且依赖经验。大语言模型（LLM）为智能化辅助分析方法构建提供了有前景的策略。本文以湿疹外洗方为研究对象，构建了包含智能推荐、实验验证与迭代优化的人机协同HPLC方法开发工作流。在测试的五种提示策略中，专家角色设定结合结构化推理表现最佳。输入处方信息后，LLM提出了五种色谱方案。经实验筛选与优化，最终HPLC方法采用SunShell C18色谱柱、0.1%甲酸水溶液-乙腈梯度洗脱，在55 min内分离七个指标成分，并通过LC-MS表征了二十个成分。经验证的方法在线性、精密度、重复性、稳定性和回收率方面表现良好。这表明LLM可减少色谱条件探索的工作量，提升中药复方分析方法的开发效率，支持中药质量控制智能化。
translation.brief: 该论文针对中药复方HPLC质控方法开发耗时且依赖经验的问题，构建了LLM智能推荐结合实验验证与迭代优化的人机协同方法开发工作流。

papers.title: OpenMAS-GApp: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Domain-Adaptive Multi-Agent Application Construction
papers.abstract: Constructing multi-agent system (MAS) applications across domains requires translating diverse requirements into executable systems, involving task decomposition, agent and tool selection, and execution organization. Existing studies have explored individual aspects of MAS construction, including agent generation, architecture design, workflow generation, and component selection. However, these methods are often developed and evaluated independently, using different task specifications, component resources, and execution settings. This makes it difficult to compare their construction capabilities or determine how they can be applied to different domains. To address this problem, we propose OpenMAS-GApp, a One-for-All benchmark for MAS application construction across diverse domains. It standardizes task inputs, component resources, construction interfaces, and execution environments to support MAS construction under consistent conditions. Within OpenMAS-GApp, we provide Graph Harness as a reference construction method that derives task dependencies, selects compatible agents and tools, and organizes their interactions into executable graphs. We evaluate construction methods across 19 benchmark datasets under 20 evaluation settings spanning four application types and four professional domains.

translation.title: OpenMAS-GApp：面向领域自适应多智能体应用构建的综合基准
translation.abstract: 跨领域构建多智能体系统（MAS）应用需要将多样化需求转化为可执行系统，涉及任务分解、智能体与工具选择以及执行组织。现有研究已探索MAS构建的多个方面，包括智能体生成、架构设计、工作流生成和组件选择，但这些方法往往在不同的任务规范、组件资源和执行设置下独立开发和评估，难以比较其构建能力或确定其在不同领域的适用性。为此，我们提出OpenMAS-GApp，一个面向多领域MAS应用构建的One-for-All基准。它标准化了任务输入、组件资源、构建接口和执行环境，以在一致条件下支持MAS构建。我们在OpenMAS-GApp中提供Graph Harness作为参考构建方法，可推导任务依赖关系、选择兼容的智能体和工具，并将其交互组织为可执行图。我们在19个基准数据集、20种评估设置下评估构建方法，涵盖四种应用类型和四个专业领域。
translation.brief: 该论文针对MAS构建方法因评估条件不一致而难以比较的问题，提出标准化任务输入、组件资源和执行环境的统一基准OpenMAS-GApp及参考构建方法Graph Harness。

papers.title: Does the Voice Matter? Evaluating Frustration Detection on Deployed Clinical Voice-Agent Calls
papers.abstract: Autonomous voice agents now conduct routine clinical follow-up calls, so some automated triage is unavoidable. A patient becoming frustrated is one thing that triage should catch. These systems typically read only the transcript the speech-to-text stage produces, not the voice, and whether that is enough is largely untested on real clinical speech. We study per-turn frustration detection on real patient calls from a deployed clinical voice agent: 150 turns from six calls labelled by three annotators, with a length-matched acted corpus as a control, and 714 turns from 30 calls. Patient turns are overwhelmingly short: across the deployed calls, roughly 59% are one or two words, against 13% in the full acted corpus, and a corpus accuracy gap remains even after the acted set is length-matched. On one-word turns, transcript-only detection does not exclude chance. Across five audio-capable language models, the transcript flags 3 or 4 of the 39 frustrated one-word turns in the 30 calls, and a classifier given only the word count reaches 57.3%. Whether audio helps depends on the model and on the instruction. Asked to attend to delivery, two Gemini 2.5 models gain 3.0 pp over the transcript across 30 calls (-1.0 to 7.5 pp). Of the turns they confidently clear, 6.9% were in fact frustrated for audio against 13.0% for the transcript, a difference of 6.1 pp (2.2 to 10.4 pp). Across the 30 calls, given one prompt identical for both inputs, no model's audio-text interval excludes zero. Under the input-specific prompts, a newer Gemini model and two smaller open models do worse with audio than with the transcript (-3.5, -8.6 and -10.6 pp). A WavLM probe trained on the clinical calls matches the best prompted model overall (71.6%) but misses every frustrated one-word turn in the 24 added calls. When a patient's turn is short, the transcript alone is not enough to rule out frustration.

translation.title: 语音重要吗？在已部署临床语音智能体通话中评估挫败感检测
translation.abstract: 自主语音智能体现在可执行常规临床随访通话，因此自动分诊不可避免，而患者产生挫败感是分诊应捕捉的情况之一。这类系统通常只读取语音转文本阶段生成的文本，而不读取语音本身，这是否足够在真实临床语音上基本未经检验。我们在已部署临床语音智能体的真实患者通话上研究逐轮次挫败感检测：由三位标注者标注的六通通话的150个轮次，配以长度匹配的表演语料作对照，以及30通通话的714个轮次。患者轮次绝大多数很短：在已部署通话中约59%仅为一两个词，而完整表演语料中为13%，且即使表演集经长度匹配后仍存在语料间准确率差距。在单词轮次上，仅用文本的检测不能排除随机水平。在五个具备音频能力的语言模型上，文本在30通通话的39个挫败感单词轮次中仅标记出3或4个，而仅凭词数的分类器即可达到57.3%。音频是否有帮助取决于模型和指令。当被要求关注语音表达方式时，两个Gemini 2.5模型在30通通话上比文本高3.0个百分点（-1.0至7.5 pp）。在其自信通过的轮次中，音频的6.9%实际为挫败感，文本为13.0%，相差6.1个百分点（2.2至10.4 pp）。在30通通话中，若对两种输入使用相同提示，没有任何模型的音频-文本区间排除零。在使用输入特定提示时，一个更新的Gemini模型和两个较小的开源模型使用音频反而不如文本（-3.5、-8.6和-10.6 pp）。在临床通话上训练的WavLM探针总体上与最佳提示模型相当（71.6%），但在新增24通通话中漏检了所有挫败感单词轮次。当患者轮次很短时，仅凭文本不足以排除挫败感。
translation.brief: 该论文研究已部署临床语音智能体真实通话中的逐轮次挫败感检测，评估仅用文本转录与结合音频的差异，发现当患者轮次极短时仅凭文本不足以排除挫败感。

papers.title: K2-Horizon: A Frontier Fleet of Open Source Language Models
papers.abstract: We present K2-Horizon, a fleet of six fully open language models, from a 0.9B dense model to a 375B-A23B MoE, built for general-purpose reasoning and agentic work across math and science, software engineering, deep research, office automation, and beyond. The models lead or are competitive with strong open models of their size on agentic and coding benchmarks. On the modeling side, to strengthen reasoning, we introduce Mixture-of-Value Attention (MoVA), applying MoE to attention value projections, and softplus attention gating, a more flexible, theoretically motivated gate. Our 36B-A4B model uses both and nearly matches a 32B dense model trained on the same data, with one-seventh the active parameters. We also introduce Uno, lossless diffusion adapters that speed up decoding by up to 2.2x without a separate draft model. Our release follows the LLM360 definition of open source for transparency and reproducibility: the full development history, including intermediate checkpoints from every training stage, pre-training data, training logs, and all training, evaluation, and infrastructure code, notably our production-scale xLLM framework for dense and MoE training and the RL360 reinforcement-learning stack. Beyond the data itself, we release and document in detail every pipeline that built it, the part of model development that open releases most rarely disclose. These pipelines produced roughly 10T synthetic pre-training tokens, showing that synthetic data can be a major ingredient of pre-training at scale. Four of the models share one 22T-token pre-training corpus and recipe, revealing consistent scaling behavior and enabling controlled studies of scale and sparsity. All artifacts are available at this https URL

translation.title: K2-Horizon：一个前沿开源语言模型舰队
translation.abstract: 我们提出K2-Horizon，包含六个完全开源的语言模型，从0.9B稠密模型到375B-A23B MoE，面向通用推理与智能体工作，涵盖数学与科学、软件工程、深度研究、办公自动化等领域。这些模型在智能体和编码基准上领先或可与其规模相当的强开源模型竞争。在建模方面，为增强推理能力，我们提出Mixture-of-Value Attention（MoVA），将MoE应用于注意力价值投影，并提出softplus注意力门控，一种更灵活且有理论依据的门控机制。我们的36B-A4B模型同时使用两者，以七分之一的激活参数量接近在相同数据上训练的32B稠密模型。我们还提出Uno，一种无损扩散适配器，无需单独的draft模型即可将解码加速至多2.2倍。我们的发布遵循LLM360开源定义以保证透明性和可复现性：完整开发历史，包括每个训练阶段的中间checkpoint、预训练数据、训练日志以及全部训练、评估和基础设施代码，特别是用于稠密与MoE训练的生产级xLLM框架和RL360强化学习栈。除数据本身外，我们还详细发布并记录了构建数据的每条流水线，这是开源发布中极少披露的部分。这些流水线生成了约10T合成预训练token，表明合成数据可成为大规模预训练的重要组成部分。其中四个模型共享一个22T token的预训练语料与配方，展现出一致的scaling行为，并支持对规模与稀疏性的受控研究。所有资源可通过此https URL获取。
translation.brief: 该论文发布K2-Horizon六款完全开源语言模型（0.9B至375B-A23B），并引入MoVA、softplus注意力门控和Uno扩散适配器等建模技术及完整可复现的开源训练体系。

papers.title: MemDoctor: Stage-wise Error Attribution and Repair for MLLM Agent Memory
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) now assist users across sessions of images and text, carried by an external memory of what was said and shown. When such an assistant answers wrongly, the failure usually began earlier, in how a record was written, updated or retrieved, and the answer alone does not say where. We formalize multimodal memory as four stages, Write, Update, Retrieve and Answer, and define nine error types across them. A stage-resolved analysis on Mem-Gallery traces most failures to a source stage, and most of those lie before the answer. Injecting known errors against fact-preserving control edits, we then follow each tainted record downstream. Early errors survive to the answer as apparent evidence, and hurt most when no other record holds the fact. A diagnosis that trusts the quoted evidence therefore blames the stage where the error surfaces, not the one where it began. We propose MemDoctor, in which the MLLM that built the memory diagnoses its own failures. It traces each needed fact backward through the four stages, accepts a diagnosis only when the cited evidence is found in memory, and repairs that stage before answering again. On a 4B backbone, MemDoctor improves accuracy on both Mem-Gallery and MemLens, outperforming all evaluated 8B baselines, and the same loop also improves MuRAG and A-Mem.

translation.title: MemDoctor：面向MLLM智能体记忆的分阶段错误归因与修复
translation.abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）现在可以跨图像和文本会话辅助用户，其依托的是一个记录所述与所显示内容的外部记忆。当此类助手回答错误时，失败往往在更早处就已发生，即在记录的写入、更新或检索环节，而仅凭答案无法定位。我们将多模态记忆形式化为四个阶段，Write、Update、Retrieve和Answer，并定义了跨阶段的九种错误类型。在Mem-Gallery上的分阶段分析将大多数失败追溯到某个源阶段，且多数位于回答之前。在事实保持型对照编辑之外注入已知错误后，我们追踪每条受污染记录的下游影响。早期错误会作为表面证据存续到答案中，并在没有其他记录持有该事实时危害最大。因此，只信任所引用证据的诊断会归咎于错误显现的阶段而非其起始阶段。我们提出MemDoctor，让构建记忆的MLLM对自身失败进行诊断。它将每个所需事实沿四个阶段向后追溯，仅当引用的证据在记忆中找到时才接受诊断，并在再次回答前修复相应阶段。在4B骨干上，MemDoctor提升了Mem-Gallery和MemLens的准确率，优于所有评估过的8B基线，且同一循环也改善了MuRAG和A-Mem。
translation.brief: 该论文针对MLLM智能体记忆错误难以定位的问题，将记忆形式化为Write、Update、Retrieve、Answer四阶段并定义九种错误类型，提出让模型自我回溯诊断并修复源阶段的MemDoctor框架。

papers.title: SWE-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Coding
papers.abstract: In this work, we study on-policy distillation (OPD) for transferring agentic coding capabilities from a large teacher model to a smaller student model. Prior work has focused primarily on reasoning and short-horizon agentic tasks. We present SWE-OPD, a minimal OPD study for software engineering, where the student interacts with executable repositories and the teacher supervises the prefixes visited by the student. Across three teacher--student pairs, two training sources, and three SWE benchmarks, we find that on-policy supervision transfers coding capability: supervision from Qwen3.6-27B increases the SWE-bench Pro resolve rate of Qwen3.5-9B from 35.9% to 39.4%. Refreshing trajectories is not strictly required either, as an offline variant with cached teacher scores still improves over the student baselines while cutting end-to-end GPU-hours by 59.4%--72.6% and halving peak GPU allocation, at benchmark-dependent accuracy. Furthermore, we extend the offline variant to corss-tokenizer scenarios: distilling GLM-4.5-Air from DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 raises its SWE-bench Pro and Multilingual resolve rate from 35.8% to 39.7% and from 41.8% to 46.2%, around 4% and 4.6% improvement, respectively. We also find that a decreasing loss, however, does not necessarily indicate improved agent performance: under top-$K$ reverse-KL loss, one student exhibits severe repetition despite a decreasing loss. We identify a support-mass gradient term as a potential mechanism underlying this failure.

translation.title: SWE-OPD：面向智能体编程的在策略蒸馏
translation.abstract: 本文研究在策略蒸馏（OPD），用于将大型教师模型的智能体编程能力迁移到更小的学生模型。已有工作主要关注推理和短程智能体任务。我们提出 SWE-OPD，这是一个面向软件工程的极简 OPD 研究：学生与可执行代码仓库交互，教师对学生访问的前缀进行监督。在三组教师-学生对、两种训练数据来源和三个 SWE 基准上，我们发现基于在策略监督可以迁移编程能力：来自 Qwen3.6-27B 的监督将 Qwen3.5-9B 在 SWE-bench Pro 上的解决率从 35.9% 提升到 39.4%。轨迹刷新也并非严格必需，一种使用缓存教师分数的离线变体在基准相关精度下仍优于学生基线，同时将端到端 GPU 时减少 59.4%–72.6%，峰值 GPU 分配减半。此外，我们将离线变体扩展到跨 tokenizer 场景：从 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 蒸馏 GLM-4.5-Air，使其在 SWE-bench Pro 和 Multilingual 上的解决率从 35.8% 提升至 39.7%，从 41.8% 提升至 46.2%，分别提升约 4% 和 4.6%。我们还发现损失下降并不一定意味着智能体性能提升：在 top-$K$ 反向 KL 损失下，一个学生尽管损失持续下降，却出现严重重复。我们识别出支撑质量梯度项可能是这种失败的潜在机制。
translation.brief: 研究如何通过在策略蒸馏将大教师模型的智能体编程能力迁移到小学生模型，并提出可离线、可跨 tokenizer 的蒸馏变体。

papers.title: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI
papers.abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence could automate analyses of sensitive clinical data, but current agents depend on large language models (LLMs). Cloud LLMs expose patient data. Local LLMs hallucinate, and an invented value in a tool call propagates through every later step. Here we present a method to build System 1 agents: local agents that call tools without generating text. A deterministic compiler turns each tool's schema and the request into multiple-choice questions whose options come from the request and the schema, then a one-pass decision model answers them. On 1,952 requests to 157 biomedical tools, the best System 1 agent chose the right tool, or correctly declined, for 97.0% of requests, significantly ahead of all 18 local LLM-agent settings (best 95.2%). The System 1 agent filled 97.0% of 6,056 stated argument values. No System 1 call contained invented content, against 5.5-19.7% of LLM calls. The System 1 Agents framework is freely available as open-source software at this https URL.

translation.title: System 1 智能体：一种本地、可靠且快速的智能体 AI 方法
translation.abstract: 智能体人工智能可以自动分析敏感临床数据，但当前智能体依赖大语言模型（LLM）。云端 LLM 会暴露患者数据。本地 LLM 会产生幻觉，且工具调用中一个编造的值会传播到后续所有步骤。本文提出一种构建 System 1 智能体的方法：本地智能体调用工具而不生成文本。一个确定性编译器将每个工具的 schema 和请求转化为多选题，其选项来自请求和 schema，然后一个单次前向的决策模型回答这些问题。在向 157 个生物医学工具发起的 1,952 个请求上，最好的 System 1 智能体在 97.0% 的请求上选择了正确工具或正确拒绝，显著优于全部 18 种本地 LLM-智能体设置（最佳 95.2%）。System 1 智能体正确填写了 6,056 个声明参数值中的 97.0%。System 1 的调用中没有任何编造内容，而 LLM 调用中编造内容占 5.5–19.7%。System 1 Agents 框架已在 https URL 以开源软件形式免费提供。
translation.brief: 提出不生成文本、通过编译器将工具 schema 转为多选题并由单次决策模型回答的本地智能体方法，以消除 LLM 幻觉与隐私风险。

papers.title: Evaluation-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Recent self-improving coding agents have achieved strong benchmark performance by iteratively modifying their own executable implementations. A common pattern uses downstream task-derived evidence to decide which candidates or lineages continue evolving, which we term evaluate-and-select. Obtaining this signal requires repeatedly executing evolved agents on downstream tasks, so broader exploration incurs increasing evaluation cost, while repeated optimization against a fixed evaluation distribution may encourage benchmark-specific adaptation. We ask: can coding agents self-improve without downstream task evaluation inside the evolution loop? We introduce Explore-then-Integrate (ELITE), which integrates implementation mechanisms rather than selecting a single exploratory child to continue the lineage. At each generation, ELITE proposes diverse focused improvements, implements them independently from the same parent, and inspects the resulting programs to identify complementary, redundant, and conflicting mechanisms before reimplementing a compatible subset as one coherent descendant. No downstream task outcomes or task-solving trajectories of evolved candidates are used to guide evolution; only deterministic checks of structural and operational validity are used inside the loop. On SWE-bench Pro, ELITE improves the initial agent from 60.0% to 85.6%, compared with 86.7% for the Darwin Godel Machine (DGM) and 88.3% for the Huxley-Godel Machine (HGM), while using zero candidate task evaluations and reducing observed wall-clock evolution time by 8.8x and 3.2x, respectively, under the evaluated configurations. In cross-benchmark transfer without further adaptation, ELITE averages 73.3% on SWE-bench Verified and 69.3% on Polyglot. Together, these results demonstrate the feasibility of coding-agent self-improvement without downstream candidate task evaluation in our setting.

translation.title: 面向编程智能体的免评估递归自我改进
translation.abstract: 近来的自我改进编程智能体通过迭代修改自身的可执行实现取得了强劲的基准表现。一种常见模式是利用下游任务派生的证据来决定哪些候选或谱系继续演化，我们称之为“评估-选择”。获取这一信号需要反复在下游任务上执行演化后的智能体，因此更广泛的探索会带来不断增长的评估成本，而针对固定评估分布的重复优化可能导致基准特化。我们提出一个问题：编程智能体能否在演化循环内不依赖下游任务评估实现自我改进？我们提出 Explore-then-Integrate（ELITE），它整合实现机制，而不是选择单个探索性子代来延续谱系。在每一代，ELITE 提出多样的聚焦改进，从同一父代独立实现它们，并检查所得程序以识别互补、冗余和冲突的机制，然后将兼容的子集重新实现为一个连贯的后代。演化循环内不使用演化候选的下游任务结果或任务求解轨迹，只使用对结构和操作有效性的确定性检查。在 SWE-bench Pro 上，ELITE 将初始智能体从 60.0% 提升到 85.6%，相比之下 Darwin Godel Machine（DGM）为 86.7%，Huxley-Godel Machine（HGM）为 88.3%，同时候选任务评估次数为零，并在所评估配置下分别将观测到的演化真实时间缩短 8.8 倍和 3.2 倍。在不作进一步适配的跨基准迁移中，ELITE 在 SWE-bench Verified 上平均为 73.3%，在 Polyglot 上为 69.3%。这些结果共同证明了在我们的设置中无需下游候选任务评估的编程智能体自我改进的可行性。
translation.brief: 提出 ELITE 方法，使编程智能体在演化循环中不依赖下游任务评估，通过探索多个改进并整合互补机制实现自我改进。

papers.title: CoopDistill: Equilibrium-Guided Multi-Agent Policy Distillation for Cooperative Driving
papers.abstract: Cooperative driving extends autonomous driving from individual vehicle decisions to joint maneuvers that improve traffic safety and efficiency. Optimization-based methods impose safety constraints but often fix paths to simplify multi-vehicle planning, limiting spatial flexibility. Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) explores alternatives through interaction, but coordinated learning and safe execution remain challenging. Their integration nevertheless faces challenges in exploration efficiency, experience allocation, and execution reliability. To address these challenges, this paper proposes CoopDistill, an equilibrium-guided multi-agent policy distillation framework. A potential-game (PG) formulation provides a fixed-path longitudinal reference, around which a residual MARL policy learns longitudinal acceleration, conflict-approach timing, and lateral path corrections. A hard-case curriculum concentrates experience on interactions that PG leaves unresolved or substantially delayed. A comparative rollout selector evaluates the joint consequences of learned corrections against PG before choosing the executed action. Experiments in merging, roundabout, and intersection scenarios compare CoopDistill with six baselines at four connected automated vehicle penetration levels. Relative to PG, success improves by 2.1--27.1 percentage points and delay decreases by 7.3--27.3\%, with no observed collisions. Code is available at this https URL

translation.title: CoopDistill：面向协同驾驶的均衡引导多智能体策略蒸馏
translation.abstract: 协同驾驶将自动驾驶从单车决策扩展到提升交通安全与效率的联合机动。基于优化的方法施加安全约束，但常通过固定路径来简化多车规划，限制了空间灵活性。多智能体强化学习（MARL）通过交互探索替代方案，但协调学习与安全执行仍具挑战性。二者的整合还面临探索效率、经验分配和执行可靠性方面的挑战。为应对这些挑战，本文提出 CoopDistill，一个均衡引导的多智能体策略蒸馏框架。势博弈（PG）公式化提供固定路径的纵向参考，残差 MARL 策略在其基础上学习纵向加速度、冲突接近时机和横向路径修正。困难场景课程将经验集中在 PG 无法解决或显著延迟的交互上。比较式 rollout 选择器在选择执行动作前，将学习到的修正与 PG 的联合后果进行评估。实验在汇入、环岛和交叉口场景中，在四个网联自动驾驶车辆渗透率水平下，将 CoopDistill 与六个基线进行比较。相对 PG，成功率提升 2.1–27.1 个百分点，延迟降低 7.3–27.3%，且未观察到碰撞。代码见 https URL。
translation.brief: 提出均衡引导的多智能体策略蒸馏框架 CoopDistill，以势博弈提供固定路径参考、残差 MARL 学习修正并结合课程与 rollout 选择实现安全协同驾驶。

papers.title: Sage S2.1 Flash Technical Report
papers.abstract: We introduce Sage S1.5 Flash, a 320-billion-parameter general-purpose mixture-of-experts model designed to reason over scientific evidence and act in interactive environments. Sage Sci-Perception uses dedicated encoders for molecular graphs and biological sequences and represents spectra as ordered patches of measurements. Modality-specific projectors map these representations into the input space of a shared backbone, which processes them alongside text and images. To develop the model's agent capabilities, we construct verifiable environments for tool use, search, and coding, as well as specialized workflows involving machine learning experiments and scientific software. Task completion is checked against execution results, changes in environment state, or submitted artifacts. We evaluate Sage S1.5 Flash on 33 benchmarks across seven domains. In the primary comparison against five baselines, it ranks first on OfficeQA Pro (72.2), MLE-bench Lite (90.3 HumanRank), Harvey LAB, and SpreadsheetBench~2, and second on OSWorld-Verified (85.2), WebArena-Verified (67.6), and DeepResearch Bench~II (54.2). These results show particular strengths in using documentary evidence, producing verifiable workbooks, and carrying out machine learning tasks, alongside competitive performance in desktop and browser workflows that require the model to act on visual feedback.

translation.title: Sage S2.1 Flash 技术报告
translation.abstract: 我们介绍 Sage S1.5 Flash，一个 3200 亿参数的通用混合专家模型，旨在对科学证据进行推理并在交互环境中行动。Sage Sci-Perception 使用分子图和生物序列的专用编码器，并将光谱表示为有序的测量块。模态专属投影器将这些表示映射到共享骨干网络的输入空间，骨干网络将其与文本和图像一同处理。为发展模型的智能体能力，我们构建了工具使用、搜索和编程的可验证环境，以及涉及机器学习实验和科学软件的专门工作流。任务完成情况依据执行结果、环境状态变化或提交的产物进行检查。我们在七个领域的 33 个基准上评估 Sage S1.5 Flash。在与五个基线的主要比较中，它在 OfficeQA Pro（72.2）、MLE-bench Lite（90.3 HumanRank）、Harvey LAB 和 SpreadsheetBench~2 上排名第一，在 OSWorld-Verified（85.2）、WebArena-Verified（67.6）和 DeepResearch Bench~II（54.2）上排名第二。这些结果表明模型在使用文献证据、生成可验证工作簿和执行机器学习任务方面具有突出优势，同时在需要依据视觉反馈行动的桌面与浏览器工作流中也具备竞争力。
translation.brief: 介绍 3200 亿参数多模态混合专家模型 Sage S1.5 Flash，通过专用科学编码器与可验证智能体环境训练，使其能够推理科学证据并执行交互任务。

papers.title: Think2Listen: Evidence-Centric Learning For Agentic Audio Understanding With LALMS
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large audio-language models (LALMs) have broadened audio understanding across speech, sound, and music, with tool-based agents further supporting these tasks by invoking predefined audio tools. However, a persistent gap remains between perceiving acoustic content and using it as evidence for reasoning: recognizing what is audible does not ensure that a model can identify which cues resolve an uncertain decision. To bridge this gap, we propose Think2Listen, an evidence-centric learning framework for agentic audio understanding. Guided by evidence before commitment, Think2Listen couples iterative reasoning with a targeted LALM interaction to actively seek acoustic cues that distinguish competing hypotheses and revise candidate judgments based on the observations returned. It learns what to ask, how to use evidence, and when to stop, using observation-induced changes in candidate-state to inform training credit. Extensive evaluations on two benchmarks spanning seven audio categories demonstrate that Think2Listen achieves (I) enhanced multi-step audio reasoning, with gains in overall accuracy of 5.08%--17.67% over competing audio agents; and (II) improved audio understanding and reasoning across speech, sound, and music, boosting overall accuracy by 2.29%--13.10% over the corresponding baselines. The source code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: Think2Listen：基于 LALMS 的以证据为中心的智能体音频理解学习方法
translation.abstract: 大型音频-语言模型（LALM）的最新进展拓宽了对语音、声音和音乐的音频理解能力，基于工具的智能体通过调用预定义的音频工具进一步支持这些任务。然而，感知声学内容与将其用作推理证据之间仍然存在持续差距：识别出可听见的内容并不意味着模型能够确定哪些线索可以解决一个不确定的决策。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了 Think2Listen，一个面向智能体音频理解的以证据为中心的学习框架。在“先取证据、后下结论”的指导下，Think2Listen 将迭代推理与有针对性的 LALM 交互相耦合，主动寻找能够区分竞争性假设的声学线索，并根据返回的观察结果修正候选判断。它学习何时提问、如何使用证据以及何时停止，利用候选状态因观察而产生的变化来指导训练信用分配。在涵盖七个音频类别的两个基准上的大量评估表明，Think2Listen 实现了（I）增强的多步音频推理，相比竞争音频智能体总体准确率提升 5.08%--17.67%；（II）在语音、声音和音乐方面改进了音频理解与推理，相比相应基线总体准确率提升 2.29%--13.10%。源代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 解决音频模型感知与证据推理脱节的问题，提出以证据为中心的框架，将迭代推理与针对性 LALM 交互耦合以主动获取声学线索并据此修正判断。

papers.title: CompCert4Lean: Porting a Verified C Compiler to Lean in Six Weeks with Parallel Coding Agents
papers.abstract: We present CompCert4Lean, a large-scale port of CompCert 3.17's verified compiler core from Rocq to Lean, completed in approximately six weeks by one expert directing parallel LLM agents. Our migration workflow partitions the development along its dependencies, audits translated definitions and theorem statements before large-scale proof reconstruction, and then reconstructs proofs in parallel against stable interfaces. The resulting compiler covers typed CompCert C through x86-64 assembly, discharges all 4,908 recorded proof obligations without project-specific axioms, and produces executable Linux binaries. The workflow enabled the expert to concentrate on organizing the work rather than supplying technical solutions. Of 1,071 human interactions, 88.8% concerned workflow and coordination, while only three supplied technical direction. Optimization campaigns further demonstrate the benefit of the Lean port for agent-driven verified development. Under matched budgets of 24 active hours, GPT-6-astra produced a Lean candidate with 11.7% lower generated-program runtime across 29 small-tests programs, compared with 2.3% lower for its Rocq candidate, both relative to original CompCert 3.17 and while preserving the end-to-end correctness theorem. These results show that parallel LLM agents can support large-scale migration with limited human technical direction and subsequently improve the migrated compiler while retaining its formal guarantees.

translation.title: CompCert4Lean：利用并行编码智能体在六周内将经验证 C 编译器移植到 Lean
translation.abstract: 我们提出 CompCert4Lean，这是将 CompCert 3.17 的经验证编译器核心从 Rocq 大规模移植到 Lean 的工作，由一名专家指挥并行 LLM 智能体在约六周内完成。我们的迁移工作流按依赖关系划分开发任务，在大规模证明重建之前审计翻译后的定义和定理陈述，然后针对稳定接口并行重建证明。所得编译器覆盖从类型化 CompCert C 到 x86-64 汇编，在不引入项目特定公理的情况下完成全部 4,908 条证明义务，并能生成可执行的 Linux 二进制文件。该工作流使专家能够专注于组织工作而非提供技术方案。在 1,071 次人工交互中，88.8% 涉及工作流与协调，仅三次提供了技术指导。优化活动进一步证明了 Lean 移植对智能体驱动的经验证开发的好处。在 24 个活跃小时的同等预算下，GPT-6-astra 生成的 Lean 候选版本在 29 个小型测试程序上使生成程序运行时间相比原 CompCert 3.17 降低 11.7%，而其 Rocq 候选版本仅降低 2.3%，同时均保持了端到端正确性定理。这些结果表明，并行 LLM 智能体能够在有限人工技术指导下支持大规模迁移，并随后在保持形式化保证的同时改进迁移后的编译器。
translation.brief: 解决将经验证编译器 CompCert 从 Rocq 迁移到 Lean 的问题，采用按依赖划分、先审计后并行重建证明的工作流，由一名专家指挥并行 LLM 编码智能体完成。

papers.title: AudioTrace: File-Level Membership Detection for Audio Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Significant privacy and copyright concerns are raised by the use of publicly available audio recordings to train audio large language models (LLMs), yet effective auditing methods remain limited. Existing membership inference attacks typically assume knowledge of complete training examples, including their associated textual supervision. In practice, however, audio recordings may be paired with privately generated transcripts, captions, or question-answer pairs that are unavailable to owners of the recordings. This motivates audio-file-level membership inference, which determines whether a recording was used for training without assuming knowledge of its training tasks and annotations. This paper provides the first systematic investigation of this challenge and introduces AudioTraceBench, a controlled benchmark comprising 1,285 audio recordings with explicit fine-tuning membership labels. Evaluations across three audio LLMs show that existing text- and video-based membership inference methods adapted to audio perform close to random guessing. To address this challenge, AudioTrace is proposed, where audio-conditioned proxy questions are generated using the target model, and membership evidence is extracted from its responses and aggregated at the recording level. Consistent improvements over existing baselines are observed, with AUROC reaching 0.60 and increasing further under increased fine-tuning exposure or adaptation capacity. Further experiments were conducted to examine the factors influencing membership signals for audio-file-level detection. These findings establish audio-file-level membership inference as a distinct and practically important auditing challenge, with AudioTrace providing an effective initial approach to this challenge.

translation.title: AudioTrace：面向音频大型语言模型的文件级成员推断
translation.abstract: 使用公开可得的音频录音训练音频大型语言模型（LLM）引发了显著的隐私和版权担忧，但有效的审计方法仍然有限。现有的成员推断攻击通常假设已知完整的训练样本，包括其关联的文本监督。然而在实践中，音频录音可能配有私人生成的转录、描述或问答对，录音所有者无法获取这些内容。这促使了音频文件级成员推断的研究，即在不知道其训练任务和标注的情况下判断某段录音是否被用于训练。本文对这一挑战进行了首次系统性研究，并提出了 AudioTraceBench，一个包含 1,285 条带明确微调成员标签的音频录音的受控基准。对三个音频 LLM 的评估表明，现有适配到音频的基于文本和视频的成员推断方法性能接近随机猜测。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了 AudioTrace，它利用目标模型生成音频条件下的代理问题，从模型响应中提取成员证据并在录音层面进行聚合。方法相对现有基线取得了一致的改进，AUROC 达到 0.60，且在微调暴露程度或适应能力增大时进一步提升。我们还进行了进一步实验以考察影响音频文件级检测成员信号的因素。这些发现确立了音频文件级成员推断作为一个独特且具有重要实际意义的审计挑战，AudioTrace 为此提供了一个有效的初步方法。
translation.brief: 解决在不知道文本标注的情况下判断音频文件是否被用于训练音频 LLM 的问题，提出 AudioTraceBench 基准和 AudioTrace 方法，通过目标模型生成音频条件代理问题并从其响应中聚合成员证据。

papers.title: SWE-WhatIf: Simulating Real Users of Coding Agents from Recorded Session
papers.abstract: Recorded sessions between users and coding agents offer a way to evaluate how agents complete real-world tasks and interact with users. However, these sessions cannot simply be replayed with new agents, because recorded user replies may no longer apply when an agent takes a different trajectory. We introduce SWE-WhatIf, which replays recorded sessions with new agents by modeling the user's intents, the criteria for satisfying them, and the conditions under which they arise. Using this model, a user simulator generates replies that adapt to unseen agent turns while remaining grounded in the recording. Across 89 real-world sessions, SWE-WhatIf generated the replies most similar to those of real users and matched the strongest baseline when sessions were rewritten. To test adaptation, we replay sessions with agents instructed to avoid or repeat actions that the recorded user pushed back on. SWE-WhatIf produced the highest win rate for avoiding these actions (66.3%), significantly above chance. We further demonstrate its utility by ranking five LLMs as coding agents, where the highest-ranked model depended on how users specified and developed their intents, and a study with 16 users, where replaying their own sessions changed 14 participants' rankings and informed their future agent use.

translation.title: SWE-WhatIf：基于录制会话模拟编码智能体的真实用户
translation.abstract: 用户与编码智能体之间的录制会话为评估智能体如何完成真实任务以及如何与用户交互提供了一种途径。然而，这些会话不能简单地用新智能体回放，因为当智能体采取不同轨迹时，录制的用户回复可能不再适用。我们提出 SWE-WhatIf，通过建模用户的意图、满足这些意图的标准以及它们出现的条件，用新智能体回放录制会话。基于该模型，用户模拟器生成的回复能够适应未见过的智能体回合，同时始终以录制内容为依据。在 89 个真实会话上，SWE-WhatIf 生成的回复与真实用户最为相似，在会话被重写时与最强基线持平。为测试适应能力，我们用被指示避免或重复录制用户曾反对的操作的智能体回放会话。SWE-WhatIf 在避免这些操作方面取得了最高胜率（66.3%），显著高于随机水平。我们进一步展示了其效用：对五个 LLM 作为编码智能体进行排名，排名最高的模型取决于用户如何指定和发展其意图；并开展了一项有 16 名用户的研究，回放他们自己的会话改变了 14 名参与者的排名，并为其未来使用智能体提供了参考。
translation.brief: 解决录制会话无法直接用新智能体回放评估的问题，提出 SWE-WhatIf，通过建模用户意图及其触发条件来生成能适应新智能体行为且忠于原录制内容的用户模拟回复。

papers.title: CivilBench: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Multimodal Information Integration in Civil Engineering
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs), is increasingly applied in civil and structural engineering for disaster assessment, structural analysis, and engineering decision support. However, the extent to which current VLMs possess the reasoning capabilities required for reliable engineering judgments remains unclear. In this work, we introduce CivilBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLMs in civil engineering and disaster-related scenarios. CivilBench covers three major task families: Sequential Reasoning, Image-based Structural Understanding, and Open-world Understanding, encompassing numerical reasoning, structural damage assessment, risk inference, causal analysis, and repair planning. The benchmark is constructed through a systematic pipeline of domain-specific data collection, engineering-oriented captioning, expert annotation, question design, and quality verification. Evaluation of representative state-of-the-art VLMs reveals substantial limitations in domain-specific reasoning, with Sequential Reasoning emerging as a major bottleneck, particularly when models must infer numerical relationships from sparse structured observations. Further experiments show that numerical priors and external knowledge can alleviate these limitations, although their effectiveness depends on the model's ability to reliably interpret and use the available evidence. CivilBench provides a capability-oriented testbed for identifying reasoning limitations and evaluating progress toward reliable AI-assisted engineering decision-making. The benchmark will be publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: CivilBench：面向土木工程多模态信息融合的视觉-语言模型基准
translation.abstract: 人工智能（AI），特别是大型语言模型（LLM）和视觉-语言模型（VLM），正日益应用于土木与结构工程中的灾害评估、结构分析和工程决策支持。然而，当前 VLM 在多大程度上具备可靠工程判断所需的推理能力仍不清楚。在这项工作中，我们提出 CivilBench，一个用于评估 VLM 在土木工程和灾害相关场景中表现的综合性基准。CivilBench 涵盖三大任务族：序列推理、基于图像的结构理解和开放世界理解，包括数值推理、结构损伤评估、风险推断、因果分析和修复规划。该基准通过领域数据收集、面向工程的图像描述、专家标注、问题设计和质量验证的系统化流程构建。对代表性最先进 VLM 的评估揭示了其在领域专用推理方面的显著局限，其中序列推理是主要瓶颈，尤其是当模型必须从稀疏的结构化观测中推断数值关系时。进一步实验表明，数值先验和外部知识可以缓解这些局限，尽管其有效性取决于模型可靠解释和利用可用证据的能力。CivilBench 提供了一个面向能力的测试平台，用于识别推理局限并评估迈向可靠 AI 辅助工程决策的进展。该基准将在 https URL 公开发布。
translation.brief: 解决缺乏评估 VLM 在土木工程场景中推理能力的基准的问题，构建涵盖序列推理、结构理解与开放世界理解三大任务族的 CivilBench，通过系统化流程进行数据收集、专家标注与质量验证。

papers.title: Linglong Agent Service: A Runtime for Centralized Agent Reasoning and Distributed Execution
papers.abstract: LLM agents can use remote tools and cloud sandboxes, but integrating reasoning, session state, and heterogeneous execution sites remains a runtime design problem. We present Linglong Agent Service (agentsvc), a self-hosted HTTP service and embeddable Python runtime that treats execution site as a configurable dimension alongside model, tools, and context. A parent service retains inference orchestration, tool descriptions, and conversation history; each inference request selects one child environment for file, shell, terminal, and MCP operations. Direct HTTP and child-initiated WebSocket tunnels carry the same application interfaces, including portable request context and centrally managed updates. The normal core path requires no third-party Python packages, with an optional Windows pseudo-terminal dependency. We further present online_debugger as the process-scale special case of execution-site separation: an instrumented program submits exception evidence, executes session-scoped inspection tools inside the incident process, and resumes the same diagnostic session.
