Its default prompt requires failing-then-passing reproduction evidence for source changes, while runtime patch activation and failed-call recovery remain unimplemented. We explain the design through constrained expected-utility reasoning, compare concrete mechanisms with Hermes Agent, Pi, Codex, and Claude Code, and report implementation and regression-test evidence. The current evidence establishes executable contracts, not performance advantages, repair accuracy, or production recovery. The source code is open source under the MIT license at this https URL.

translation.title: Linglong Agent Service：集中式智能体推理与分布式执行运行时
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体可以使用远程工具和云端沙箱，但如何整合推理、会话状态与异构执行场所仍是一个运行时设计问题。我们提出 Linglong Agent Service（agentsvc），一个自托管的 HTTP 服务和可嵌入的 Python 运行时，它将执行场所作为与模型、工具和上下文并列的可配置维度。父服务保留推理编排、工具描述和对话历史；每个推理请求选择一个子环境来执行文件、shell、终端和 MCP 操作。直接 HTTP 和子端发起的 WebSocket 隧道承载相同的应用接口，包括可移植的请求上下文和集中管理的更新。核心正常路径无需第三方 Python 包，仅有一个可选的 Windows 伪终端依赖。我们进一步提出 online_debugger 作为执行场所分离在进程尺度的特例：被插桩的程序提交异常证据，在事故进程内执行会话作用域的检查工具，并恢复同一个诊断会话。其默认提示词要求源代码修改提供先失败后通过的复现证据，而运行时补丁激活和失败调用恢复尚未实现。我们通过受限期望效用推理解释该设计，与 Hermes Agent、Pi、Codex 和 Claude Code 比较具体机制，并报告实现与回归测试证据。当前证据确立的是可执行的契约，而非性能优势、修复准确率或生产恢复能力。源代码以 MIT 许可证在该 https URL 开源。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 智能体中推理、会话状态与异构执行场所难以整合的问题，通过将执行场所作为可配置维度的父子式运行时架构实现集中推理与分布式执行。

papers.title: How to Explain your Unexplainable Video Anomaly Detector
papers.abstract: Weakly-supervised Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) models assign anomaly scores from high-dimensional features, and their predictions remain unexplained. Saliency maps show where a model looks but not what it relies on, and the descriptions produced by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are generated by branches that the anomaly score never reads. To address this faithfulness gap, we propose \textbf{Explain The Unexplainable (ETU)}, a classifier-agnostic framework that audits frozen VAD models through counterfactual interventions in their feature space. ETU maps video features to a discrete dependency graph of agents, actions and outcomes ($A_r \to A_a \to A_o$), regenerates the features by graph-conditioned diffusion with selected nodes of the graph masked, and measures the change in the score of a frozen detector; one set of interventions is applied unchanged to every detector. The generator is trained only to reconstruct the input features, so it cannot learn the contrast it is asked to measure, and we validate the audit with experiments that test every alternative explanation of its results, from the cost of regeneration to random deletions of matched size. On UCF-Crime features obtained from a CLIP encoder, we show that substituting the scene semantics results in the largest drop for most detectors, and that removing the outcome chain of the graph ($\Delta_{rel}$) changes the anomaly score of all six audited detectors far more than removing the same number of random nodes, even though the random deletion perturbs the features about as much. We show that this targeted behavior comes from the divergence objective of the graph embedding. Without it, the two interventions become indistinguishable, and with a divergence objective in the generator as well, the score change of the detector follows the displacement of the reconstruction rather than the semantics that were removed.

translation.title: 如何解释你的不可解释视频异常检测器
translation.abstract: 弱监督视频异常检测（VAD）模型基于高维特征给出异常分数，其预测缺乏解释。显著性图只显示模型看哪里而非依赖什么，而视觉语言模型（VLM）生成的描述来自异常分数从未读取的分支。为弥合这一忠实性差距，我们提出 Explain The Unexplainable（ETU），一个与分类器无关的框架，通过在其特征空间中的反事实干预来审计冻结的 VAD 模型。ETU 将视频特征映射为智能体、动作和结果的离散依赖图（$A_r \to A_a \to A_o$），通过图条件扩散并在掩蔽所选图节点的情况下重新生成特征，然后测量冻结检测器分数的变化；同一组干预不加改变地应用于每个检测器。生成器仅被训练来重建输入特征，因此无法学会它被要求度量的对比，我们通过检验其结果所有替代解释的实验来验证该审计，从重建代价到同等规模的随机删除。在由 CLIP 编码器获得的 UCF-Crime 特征上，我们表明替换场景语义对大多数检测器造成最大分数下降，并且删除图的结果链（$\Delta_{rel}$）对六个被审计检测器异常分数的改变远大于删除相同数量的随机节点，尽管随机删除对特征的扰动程度相近。我们证明这种有针对性的行为来自图嵌入的散度目标：没有它，两种干预变得无法区分；而生成器中也加入散度目标时，检测器的分数变化跟随重建的位移而非被移除的语义。
translation.brief: 解决弱监督视频异常检测器预测不可解释的问题，通过特征空间中的图结构化反事实干预并测量冻结检测器分数变化来审计其真实依赖。

papers.title: From Repositories to Training Environments: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding Agents with Environment Evolution Loop
papers.abstract: Training coding agents for long-horizon tasks requires environments with verifiable feedback. Existing pipelines often follow a linear process that ends with validation, establishing usability but providing little guidance on improving training value. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) often requires model rollouts or model training followed by downstream evaluation, with costs and feedback delays amplified on long-horizon tasks. How can we use timely, reliable proxy signals to improve training value and synthesize environments at scale? We present RepoFactory, an automated pipeline that converts real repositories into verifiable environments where agents build complete projects from scratch given a language specification. Its Environment Evolution Loop optimizes a multiplicative objective combining validity, structural coupling, and implementation scope through proxy feedback. RepoFactory produces 10,159 environments across 17 software domains. Training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on these environments yields RepoHorizen-35B-A3B, which achieves gains of 22.6 percentage points on NL2Repo-Bench and 8.5 points on average across five benchmarks covering long-horizon coding and agentic tasks in real-world production settings, compared with 17.5 and 6.4 points without environment evolution. These results highlight the training value of RepoFactory environments and the additional gains from the Environment Evolution Loop.

translation.title: 从代码仓库到训练环境：用环境进化循环扩展长程编码智能体
translation.abstract: 训练面向长程任务的编码智能体需要具有可验证反馈的环境。现有流程通常遵循以验证结尾的线性过程，确立了可用性但对提升训练价值缺乏指导。递归自我改进（RSI）通常需要模型 rollout 或模型训练再加下游评估，其成本和反馈延迟在长程任务上被放大。如何利用及时、可靠的代理信号来提升训练价值并大规模合成环境？我们提出 RepoFactory，一个自动化流水线，将真实仓库转换为可验证环境，智能体在其中根据语言规范从零构建完整项目。其环境进化循环通过代理反馈优化结合有效性、结构耦合和实现范围的多项式目标。RepoFactory 在 17 个软件领域产出 10,159 个环境。在这些环境上训练 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 得到 RepoHorizen-35B-A3B，与没有环境进化时的 17.5 和 6.4 分相比，在 NL2Repo-Bench 上提升 22.6 个百分点，在涵盖真实生产环境长程编码和智能体任务的五个基准上平均提升 8.5 分。这些结果凸显了 RepoFactory 环境的训练价值以及环境进化循环带来的额外收益。
translation.brief: 解决长程编码智能体缺乏高价值可验证训练环境的问题，通过将真实仓库自动转化为环境并用环境进化循环基于代理反馈优化环境质量。

papers.title: Edit Recommendation: Can LLMs Anticipate Edit Requests from Users, and When?
papers.abstract: After a large language model (LLM) agent generates an artifact, users often send edit requests for it. This paper studies whether an LLM can anticipate these requests before they are sent. Such anticipation is useful in practice because it reduces the effort of user review and feedback. We formalize this task as edit recommendation and build EditRecBench, a benchmark for evaluating the performance of LLMs on this task, from real-world conversation logs in WildChat-4.8M. Through benchmarking and failure analysis, we identify a practical challenge that some cases are inherently difficult to predict in real-world settings. To address this, we introduce decision model-based gating to filter out cases where predictions are unlikely to be correct before they are presented to the user. Our trained model outperforms existing decision models and raises pass@5 among shown suggestions by 12--25 points at a gating threshold. Our code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 编辑推荐：LLM 能否以及何时预判用户的编辑请求
translation.abstract: 在大语言模型（LLM）智能体生成一个产物后，用户常常对其发送编辑请求。本文研究 LLM 能否在这些请求发出之前予以预判。这种预判在实践中很有用，因为它能减少用户审查和反馈的工作量。我们将该任务形式化为编辑推荐，并从 WildChat-4.8M 的真实对话日志构建了 EditRecBench，一个评估 LLM 在该任务上表现的基准。通过基准测试和失败分析，我们识别出一个现实挑战：某些情形在真实环境中本质上难以预测。为此，我们引入基于决策模型的门控，在预测呈现给用户之前过滤掉预测不太可能正确的情形。我们训练的模型优于现有决策模型，在给定门控阈值下将已展示建议中的 pass@5 提升 12–25 个百分点。我们的代码见该 https URL。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 生成结果后用户编辑请求难以预判的问题，将该任务形式化为编辑推荐，并用决策模型门控过滤难以预测的情形。

papers.title: A Matter of Stages: Energy-Latency Trade-offs in Multimodal LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Online serving of multimodal large language models requires deciding whether to separate visual encoding (E), prefill (P), and decode (D) across GPUs and how to configure their frequencies. EPD disaggregation enables independent stage control, but it also changes communication and queueing behavior. Lowering one stage's frequency can increase queueing and prolong execution across the EPD pipeline. Consequently, reducing power at one stage does not necessarily reduce total GPU energy per request. In this paper, we systematically characterize fused and EPD-disaggregated serving across four multimodal models under a fixed three-GPU budget, followed by single-stage and uniform downclocking experiments across 18 workload combinations. We find that disaggregation reduces GPU energy per successful request by 13.3-37.0% at nearly identical output-token throughput, but increases mean TTFT. Downclocking exhibits distinct stage sensitivities, and aggressive frequency reductions can offset power savings through queueing and longer execution. Across the evaluated workloads, uniform downclocking to 80% reduces GPU energy by 11.7-18.6% with modest mean-latency changes. Guided by these findings, we develop a budgeted frequency exploration strategy to select energy-efficient configurations under latency constraints. Evaluation shows that four probes can identify the lowest-energy feasible configuration among 25 measured candidates across all 288 evaluated positive-margin SLO scenarios. These results provide practical guidance for energy-efficient multimodal serving.

translation.title: 阶段问题：多模态 LLM 服务中的能耗-时延权衡
translation.abstract: 多模态大语言模型的在线服务需要决定是否将视觉编码（E）、预填充（P）和解码（D）分离到不同 GPU 上以及如何配置各阶段频率。EPD 分离支持各阶段的独立控制，但也会改变通信和排队行为。降低某一阶段的频率可能增加排队并延长整个 EPD 流水线的执行时间。因此，降低一个阶段的功率不一定能降低每请求的总 GPU 能耗。本文在固定三 GPU 预算下系统刻画了四种多模态模型的融合与 EPD 分离服务，随后在 18 种工作负载组合上进行了单阶段和统一降频实验。我们发现分离在几乎相同的输出 token 吞吐量下将每成功请求的 GPU 能耗降低 13.3–37.0%，但增加平均 TTFT。降频表现出明显的阶段敏感性，激进的降频可能通过排队和更长的执行抵消功率节省。在评估的工作负载中，统一降至 80% 频率可降低 11.7–18.6% 的 GPU 能耗，且平均时延变化不大。基于这些发现，我们开发了预算约束下的频率探索策略，在时延约束下选择节能配置。评估表明，四次探测即可在全部 288 个正裕量 SLO 场景中从 25 个实测候选中识别出最低能耗的可行配置。这些结果为节能的多模态服务提供了实用指导。
translation.brief: 解决多模态 LLM 服务中 EPD 分离与降频下能耗-时延权衡难以配置的问题，通过系统实验刻画各阶段敏感性并设计预算约束的频率探索策略。

papers.title: Beyond Token Stacking: Multi-scale Visual Modulation and Adaptive Fused-feature Calibration for MLLMs
papers.abstract: Current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have advanced rapidly and follow two main paradigms: one involves concatenating visual and textual tokens for input into Large Language Model (LLM), while the other injects visual knowledge into Feed-Forward Networks (FFNs) of the LLM. However, the former introduces a large number of redundant visual tokens, substantially increasing computational overhead. The latter reduces sequence length but removes images from the input stage entirely, which may hinder the activation of image-related knowledge. Moreover, naively injecting visual knowledge into the FFNs could induce activation distribution shifts due to cross-modal semantic discrepancies. To address these challenges, we develop Beyond Token Stacking (BTS), a novel visual enhancement framework for MLLMs. Specifically, we propose a Multi-scale Visual Modulation (MVM) mechanism that injects multi-scale visual information at the input stage via modulation without increasing the token sequence length. Furthermore, we develop an Adaptive Fused-feature Calibration (AFC) module that performs per-channel affine calibration to decouple visual injection from distribution alignment in the FFN layers, improving multimodal fusion stability while preserving language priors. Experiments show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance.

translation.title: 超越令牌堆叠：面向MLLM的多尺度视觉调制与自适应融合特征校准
translation.abstract: 当前多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）发展迅速，主要遵循两种范式：一种是将视觉与文本令牌拼接后输入大语言模型（LLM），另一种是将视觉知识注入LLM的前馈网络（FFNs）。然而，前者引入大量冗余视觉令牌，显著增加计算开销；后者虽缩短了序列长度，却将图像完全移出输入阶段，可能阻碍图像相关知识的激活。此外，将视觉知识直接注入FFNs可能因跨模态语义差异导致激活分布偏移。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了Beyond Token Stacking（BTS），一种新颖的MLLM视觉增强框架。具体而言，我们提出多尺度视觉调制（MVM）机制，在不增加令牌序列长度的情况下通过调制在输入阶段注入多尺度视觉信息。进一步，我们设计了自适应融合特征校准（AFC）模块，通过逐通道仿射校准将视觉注入与FFN层中的分布对齐解耦，在保留语言先验的同时提升多模态融合的稳定性。实验表明，我们的方法取得了最先进的性能。
translation.brief: 针对现有MLLM中冗余视觉令牌开销大和FFN视觉注入引发分布偏移的问题，提出在输入阶段以调制方式注入多尺度视觉信息且不增加序列长度的MVM机制，以及通过逐通道仿射校准解耦视觉注入与分布对齐的AFC模块。

papers.title: Scientific Coding with Large Language Models: Evidence from Finite Element Analysis
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer a potential route to automating scientific programming, but their usefulness depends on consistently producing numerically correct code. We extend FEM-Bench to 17 finite element tasks involving nonlinear and history-dependent mechanics and structural dynamics, and evaluate 15 models on implementation and test generation without execution feedback. The best model succeeds in 87.1% of single-pass implementation trials, but rankings differ between tracks. The leading implementer achieves 49.9% joint test success, while the leading tester reaches 82.6%. For six models, we compare single-pass generation with two agentic harnesses that allow code execution and revision. Agentic execution solves some tasks that never succeeded in single-pass trials and improves consistency on others, but gains vary across models and harnesses, and regressions also occur. Claude Opus 5 with SimpleAgent reaches 96.5% Pass@3, the probability of at least one success in three attempts, but 77.1% Pass$^3$, the probability that all three succeed. No model-harness combination exceeds 78.8% Pass$^3$. To understand why agents submit incorrect code after passing their own checks, we analyze 249 failed agentic trajectories and identify six categories of self-verification failure. The most common are inadequate test coverage (73.1%) and reliance on generic consistency checks (70.3%), and in 28.5% of cases the tests share an error with the implementation. Motivated by these findings, an exploratory configuration with separate coder and tester agents achieves the highest observed scores, with 97.6% Pass@3 and 88.8% Pass$^3$. These results identify consistency across attempts and independent verification as the main obstacles to trusting LLM-generated scientific code.

translation.title: 大语言模型驱动的科学编程：来自有限元分析的实证研究
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）为科学编程自动化提供了一条潜在路径，但其有效性取决于能否持续产出数值正确的代码。我们将FEM-Bench扩展至17个涉及非线性、历史相关力学与结构动力学的有限元任务，并在无执行反馈的条件下评估15个模型在代码实现与测试生成两方面的表现。最佳模型在单次通过实现任务中成功率达87.1%，但两个赛道上的排名并不一致：最佳实现模型的联合测试成功率为49.9%，而最佳测试模型达到82.6%。针对六个模型，我们对比了单次生成与两种允许代码执行和修订的智能体框架。智能体执行解决了部分单次生成从未成功的任务，并提升了其他任务的一致性，但增益在不同模型和框架间差异明显，也会出现性能回退。Claude Opus 5搭配SimpleAgent达到96.5%的Pass@3（三次尝试至少一次成功的概率），但Pass^3仅为77.1%（三次全部成功的概率）。没有任何模型-框架组合的Pass^3超过78.8%。为理解智能体为何在通过自身检查后仍提交错误代码，我们分析了249条失败的智能体轨迹，归纳出六类自验证失败，其中最常见的是测试覆盖不足（73.1%）和依赖通用一致性检查（70.3%），另有28.5%的案例中测试与实现共享同一错误。基于这些发现，一个由独立的编码智能体与测试智能体组成的探索性配置取得了最高的观测分数：Pass@3为97.6%，Pass^3为88.8%。这些结果表明，多次尝试间的一致性与独立验证是信任LLM生成的科学代码的主要障碍。
translation.brief: 针对LLM生成科学计算代码的正确性与可信性问题，通过扩展有限元基准FEM-Bench并分析失败轨迹中的自验证失败类别，提出采用分离的编码与测试智能体进行独立验证的方案。

papers.title: An Optimal Online Algorithm for Single-machine Scheduling with Two Agents
papers.abstract: This paper addresses the online two-agent scheduling problem on a single machine, where jobs arrive over time. The objective is to minimize the weighted sum of the agents' makespans, denoted as $C_{\max}^A + \theta C_{\max}^B$, for a given priority weight $\theta \ge 1$. A significant gap has persisted between the established theoretical lower bound on the competitive ratio and the performance of the best-known online algorithms. For the parameter range $1 \leq \theta \leq \tfrac{1+\sqrt{5}}{2}$, we propose novel online algorithm which achieves a competitive ratio of $1+\tfrac{\theta}{1+\theta}$. This result matches the theoretical lower bound.

translation.title: 两智能体单机调度的最优在线算法
translation.abstract: 本文研究作业随时间到达的单机在线两智能体调度问题，目标是在给定优先级权重 $\theta \ge 1$ 下最小化两智能体完工期的加权和 $C_{\max}^A + \theta C_{\max}^B$。长期以来，竞争比的理论下界与已知最佳在线算法的性能之间存在显著差距。对于参数范围 $1 \leq \theta \leq \tfrac{1+\sqrt{5}}{2}$，我们提出了一种新颖的在线算法，实现了 $1+\tfrac{\theta}{1+\theta}$ 的竞争比，该结果与理论下界相匹配。
translation.brief: 针对单机在线两智能体调度中最小化加权完工和的问题，提出一种在参数范围 $1\le\theta\le(1+\sqrt5)/2$ 内达到理论下界的竞争比为 $1+\theta/(1+\theta)$ 的在线算法。

papers.title: Validating LLM-Based Essay Scorers: A Comparative Analysis in Critical Online Reasoning in Medical Education
papers.abstract: Automated essay scorers (AES) based on large language models (LLMs) promise human-level accuracy. However, training, fine-tuning, and evaluating LLMs for specific assessment tasks is costly. In particular, the question arises whether these AES should be trained for specific domains or whether models based on generic LLMs might be sufficient. Human annotations, by contrast, are often more valid but far more expensive. This study evaluates whether ensembles of AES systems based on general-purpose LLMs can approximate human ratings of medical-education writing tasks by leveraging encoded linguistic and conceptual knowledge. The goal is to assess whether general-purpose models are applicable for assisting or potentially replacing human annotation in this domain. We experiment with 11 AES systems and 8 different LLMs and evaluate 668 student responses to 12 tasks, using \numprint{2076} evaluations by 7 human annotators. These ratings are aggregated to create consistent performance levels that can be used as target classes for classifiers trained on AES outputs. Our results show that learner classes based on human ratings can be accurately reconstructed using a linear SVM trained on a small set of AES features. A single classifier generalized well across tasks and domains, with reasoning and content features being most predictive. This suggests that out-of-the-box LLMs, even without domain-specific fine-tuning, can support automatic essay grading in medical education. While individual AES systems are insufficient alone, their combination approximates human evaluators, pointing to a reduced need for manual scoring or its supplementation with automated methods.

translation.title: 基于LLM的作文评分系统验证：医学教育批判性在线推理中的比较分析
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLMs）的自动作文评分系统（AES）有望达到人类水平的准确性。然而，针对特定评估任务训练、微调和评估LLM的成本高昂。尤其值得追问的是，这些AES应针对特定领域进行训练，还是基于通用LLM的模型即已足够。相比之下，人工标注往往更有效但成本高得多。本研究评估了基于通用LLM的AES系统集成能否借助其编码的语言与概念知识，逼近人类对医学教育写作任务的评分。目标是评估通用模型是否可用于辅助或潜在替代该领域的人工标注。我们试验了11个AES系统和8个不同的LLM，评估了668份学生对12个任务的回答，并使用了7位人工标注者共计2076次评分。这些评分被聚合为一致的表现等级，作为以AES输出训练的分类器的目标类别。结果表明，使用在少量AES特征上训练的线性SVM可以准确重构基于人工评分的学习者等级。单一分类器在跨任务、跨领域上泛化良好，其中推理与内容特征最具预测力。这表明开箱即用的LLM即使不经领域特定微调，也能支持医学教育中的自动作文评分。虽然单个AES系统不足以独立胜任，但它们的组合可以逼近人类评审，这意味着可以减少人工评分的需求，或以自动化方法加以补充。
translation.brief: 针对医学教育作文自动评分中领域微调成本高的问题，验证了无需微调的通用LLM评分系统组合（AES集成）结合线性SVM能否逼近人工标注效果。

papers.title: MiSTiQ: MicroScaling Trellis Quantization for Extreme KV Cache Compression
papers.abstract: Modern large language models (LLMs) increasingly support longer contexts and serve more concurrent requests, increasing both sequence lengths and batch sizes. Both trends increase KV-cache size and memory traffic during inference. KV-cache quantization reduces these costs, with recent approaches using codebook-based vector quantization to achieve extremely low bit widths. However, hardware constraints limit codebook size, and most methods reconstruct the cache in higher-precision floating-point formats for attention, limiting the computational benefits of quantization. To address these limitations, we introduce MiSTiQ, a drop-in replacement for codebook-based vector quantizers that combines trellis-coded storage with microscaling (MX) formats for low-precision computation. We combine trellis quantization with beam search to encode the KV cache over large reconstruction spaces without large codebooks. To support MX computation, we derive MX-Hash functions that generate reconstruction values directly in the target MX element format. These functions use the scale-conditioned marginal distribution of block-normalized Gaussian inputs. On Llama3 and Qwen3, MiSTiQ achieves lower WikiText perplexity and higher GSM8K accuracy than the evaluated baselines across several block-scale formats at approximately 1.25 effective bits per element. With NVFP4, it also achieves the highest LongBench average on both models.

translation.title: MiSTiQ：面向极端KV缓存压缩的MicroScaling格状量化
translation.abstract: 现代大语言模型（LLMs）日益支持更长上下文并服务更多并发请求，使序列长度与批规模同时增长。这两种趋势都增大了推理过程中的KV缓存大小与内存流量。KV缓存量化可降低这些开销，近期方法采用基于码本的向量量化以实现极低位宽。然而，硬件约束限制了码本规模，且大多数方法以更高精度的浮点格式重构缓存用于注意力计算，限制了量化带来的计算收益。为解决这些局限，我们提出MiSTiQ，一种基于码本的向量量化器的即插即用替代方案，它将格状编码存储与microscaling（MX）格式相结合以实现低精度计算。我们结合格状量化与束搜索，在大重构空间上对KV缓存进行编码，而无需大码本。为支持MX计算，我们推导了MX-Hash函数，可直接在目标MX元素格式下生成重构值。这些函数基于块归一化高斯输入在尺度条件下的边缘分布。在Llama3和Qwen3上，在约每元素1.25有效比特的条件下，MiSTiQ在多种块尺度格式下均取得低于基线的WikiText困惑度和高于基线的GSM8K准确率；配合NVFP4，它在两个模型上均取得最高的LongBench平均分。
translation.brief: 针对码本规模受限且量化缓存需以高精度格式重构的问题，提出将格状量化与束搜索编码及MX格式低精度计算相结合的MiSTiQ方法，通过MX-Hash函数直接在目标格式生成重构值。

papers.title: Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated via truthful evidence in open channel
papers.abstract: Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated through open channels such as social media, even when the information they receive is truthful. When agents fill gaps between fragments with self-induced relationships, they may accept those relationships as established facts and pass the resulting rumours to others. Drawing on cognitive theory of narrative understanding and film theory of montage, we introduce Generative Montage to operationalize this failure, termed narrative overfitting, by coordinating agents to arrange truthful fragments into misleading narratives. Across 1,090 rumour targets from six Twitter events, agents often accepted rumours overconfidently, with overall acceptance exceeding 65 percent in twelve of fourteen models. Acceptance remained above 50 percent after majority voting or review of the same evidence, showing how errors can reach downstream decisions. To explain this susceptibility, fragment interventions identify posts that influence belief within complete narratives. Synthetic controls then show that similar response patterns arise from valid evidence, separating belief influence from evidential support. This distinction motivates Grounded Monitor, a proof-of-concept neuro-symbolic runtime monitor that checks direct evidential support to guide agents' judgements, improving decision accuracy by 5.6 to 29.0 percentage points across original and anonymized settings. These findings expose a cognitive route to rumour amplification and support monitoring inferred relationships before agent-generated conclusions guide public decisions.

translation.title: 语言模型代理的信念可通过开放渠道中的真实证据被操纵
translation.abstract: 语言模型代理的信念可以通过社交媒体等开放渠道被操纵，即使它们接收到的信息是真实的。当代理用自行诱导的关系填补碎片之间的空隙时，可能将这些关系当作既定事实接受，并将由此产生的谣言传播给他人。借鉴叙事理解的认知理论和电影蒙太奇理论，我们提出 Generative Montage，通过协调代理将真实碎片排列成误导性叙事，来操作化这一被称为叙事过拟合的失效现象。在来自六个 Twitter 事件的 1,090 个谣言目标上，代理往往过度自信地接受谣言，14 个模型中有 12 个的总体接受率超过 65%。在多数投票或审阅相同证据后，接受率仍保持在 50% 以上，表明这些错误可以传导到下游决策。为解释这种易感性，碎片干预识别出在完整叙事中影响信念的帖子。随后合成对照表明，有效证据也会引发类似的响应模式，从而将信念影响与证据支持区分开来。这一区别催生了 Grounded Monitor，一个概念验证性的神经符号运行时监控器，通过检查直接证据支持来引导代理的判断，在原始和匿名化设置中将决策准确率提高 5.6 至 29.0 个百分点。这些发现揭示了谣言放大的认知路径，并支持在代理生成的结论引导公共决策之前监控推断出的关系。
translation.brief: 研究真实信息经碎片拼接诱导语言模型代理产生谣言信念的问题，提出 Generative Montage 攻击框架与检查证据支持的 Grounded Monitor 运行时监控器。

papers.title: How Developer Personality Shapes the Use of AI Coding Assistants
papers.abstract: Developers differ in personality traits that shape how they approach software development tasks, yet AI coding assistants either behave uniformly or offer personalization features whose fit with individual developers must be found through trial and error. This is because it remains unclear how personality shapes developers' experiences with AI assistants, and thus which traits personalization should account for. In other words, we provide tools with no underlying theory on what works when and why. We take a first step towards such a theory with a systematic scoping review on how users' personality relates to their perception of LLM-based tools. We identified twelve studies through general search engines, major Software Engineering (SE) venues, AI tooling, and snowballing. They all reported associations between personality and perceptions, particularly perceived usefulness, yet none addressed this in a SE context. Building on these findings, we conducted an exploratory two-wave survey with 29 and 11 developers, collecting first empirical evidence of how developers' personality (measured using the Big Five Model) relates to the perception of AI coding assistants. Higher Extraversion was associated with more positive private-use experiences in both waves, while Agreeableness was associated with negative professional experiences in the first wave and positive ones in the second. These results provide first indications that the personality effects found in the literature extend to developers. Although further studies with bigger samples are needed to build a theory, our work takes the first step towards an empirical grounded theory of developer personality and AI personalization traits.

translation.title: 开发者人格如何塑造其对 AI 编程助手的使用
translation.abstract: 开发者在人格特质上存在差异，这些特质影响他们处理软件开发任务的方式，但 AI 编程助手要么行为千篇一律，要么提供的个性化功能需要开发者反复试错才能适配。这是因为人格如何塑造开发者使用 AI 助手的体验仍不清楚，因而个性化应考虑哪些特质也无从得知。换言之，我们提供的工具缺乏关于何时有效、为何有效的底层理论。我们通过一项系统性范围综述迈出了构建该理论的第一步，考察用户人格与他们对基于 LLM 的工具感知之间的关系。我们通过通用搜索引擎、主要软件工程（SE）会议、AI 工具和滚雪球方法识别出十二项研究。它们都报告了人格与感知（尤其是感知有用性）之间的关联，但没有在 SE 语境中探讨这一问题。基于这些发现，我们开展了一项包含 29 名和 11 名开发者的两轮探索性调查，首次收集了开发者人格（用大五模型测量）与 AI 编程助手感知之间关系的实证证据。外向性较高与两轮调查中更积极的私人使用体验相关，而宜人性在第一轮与消极的职业体验相关、在第二轮与积极的职业体验相关。这些结果首次表明文献中发现的人格效应可以延伸到开发者。尽管构建理论还需要更大样本的进一步研究，我们的工作为开发者人格与 AI 个性化特质的实证扎根理论迈出了第一步。
translation.brief: 研究开发者人格与 AI 编程助手使用体验的关系，采用系统性范围综述加两轮开发者问卷调查（大五模型）进行实证探索。

papers.title: Stream of Belief: Eliciting Collective Intelligence through Latent Belief Dynamics
papers.abstract: In this work, we view multi-agent reasoning as a process of seeking a collective equilibrium of implicit belief dynamics and introduce Stream of Belief (SoB), where agents maintain continuous latent beliefs and iteratively refine them through communication and reflection. Our method seeks a collective belief state of a multi-agent system where further communication induces no meaningful information propagation. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate the generalization of SoB across tasks and model families. More Broadly, our results suggest a new perspective on scaling multi-agent reasoning from belief dynamics.

translation.title: 信念流：通过潜在信念动态激发集体智能
translation.abstract: 在这项工作中，我们将多代理推理视为寻求隐式信念动态集体均衡的过程，并提出 Stream of Belief（SoB），其中代理维持连续的潜在信念，并通过通信与反思迭代地加以精炼。我们的方法寻求多代理系统的集体信念状态，使进一步的通信不再引发有意义的信息传播。通过大量实验，我们证明了 SoB 在多种任务和模型系列上的泛化能力。更广泛地说，我们的结果为从信念动态角度扩展多代理推理提供了新的视角。
translation.brief: 研究多代理推理中的共识达成问题，提出让代理维持连续潜在信念并通过通信与反思迭代精炼至集体均衡的 SoB 方法。

papers.title: Evaluating Authorization and Trust Boundaries in Agentic Orchestration Frameworks
papers.abstract: Agentic AI systems extend large language models with tools, memory, and multi-agent collaboration, introducing security risks at orchestration boundaries. These risks depend on how identities are represented, operations are authorized, and instructions or information propagate between components. We evaluate LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, and OpenClaw through twelve experiments mapped to the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications using a common LLM (gpt-4o-mini). The experiments cover prompt injection, unauthorized resource access and command execution, memory poisoning, and inter-agent trust and identity attacks. Adversarial inputs induced unauthorized tool invocation, while tool chaining, stale filesystem validation, encoded instructions, and inter-agent delegation exposed weaknesses in authorization across component boundaries. Memory poisoning showed that untrusted state can influence responses, a risk distinct from conventional access-control violations. In the evaluated protected configurations, explicit authorization, controlled capability assignment, filesystem containment, and execution safeguards prevented specific unauthorized operations. The findings emphasize preserving authorization and information-trust boundaries throughout agentic workflows rather than treating framework capabilities or model-level instructions as sufficient security guarantees.

translation.title: 评估代理编排框架中的授权与信任边界
translation.abstract: 代理式 AI 系统通过工具、记忆和多代理协作扩展了大语言模型，在编排边界引入了安全风险。这些风险取决于身份如何表示、操作如何被授权，以及指令或信息如何在组件之间传播。我们使用统一的 LLM（gpt-4o-mini），通过映射到 OWASP Agentic Applications Top 10 的十二项实验评估了 LangChain、LangGraph、AutoGen 和 OpenClaw。实验涵盖提示注入、未授权资源访问与命令执行、记忆投毒以及代理间信任与身份攻击。对抗性输入诱发了未授权的工具调用，而工具链接、过期的文件系统校验、编码指令和代理间委托暴露了组件边界授权的薄弱环节。记忆投毒表明不可信状态可以影响响应，这是一种不同于传统访问控制违规的风险。在被评估的受保护配置中，显式授权、受控的能力分配、文件系统隔离和执行防护阻止了特定的未授权操作。研究结果强调，应在代理式工作流全程保持授权与信息信任边界，而不是把框架能力或模型层面的指令当作足够的安全保障。
translation.brief: 研究代理编排框架中授权与信任边界的安全漏洞，通过映射到 OWASP Top 10 的十二项实验对四个主流框架进行系统评估。

papers.title: Hybrid Optimization-Generative Motion Planning for Multiagent Affine Formations
papers.abstract: Formation maneuver control enables a multiagent system to cooperatively navigate through constrained environments in collective motion. While various formation controllers exist, they rely heavily on high-quality and dynamically feasible reference trajectories provided a priori, making formation motion planning (FMP) essential. To address the computational challenges for high-dimensional joint trajectories faced by conventional constrained optimization-based solutions, this paper introduces a hybrid optimization-generative framework with a focus on affine formations, which provide the necessary spatial flexibility. By formulating the planning task as a constrained Maximum-a-Posteriori estimation, we decouple multiagent objectives to leverage pre-trained single-agent diffusion priors for dynamic feasibility, obstacle avoidance, and smoothness. We then interleave the generative process with projected gradient descent (PGD) to strictly enforce affine geometric constraints with safety guarantees. Simulations demonstrate that our framework generates highly smooth, collision-free plans that are readily trackable by common distributed controllers and outperforms state-of-the-art planners in various metrics.

translation.title: 面向多代理仿射编队的混合优化-生成式运动规划
translation.abstract: 编队机动控制使多代理系统能够以集体运动的方式在受限环境中协同导航。尽管存在多种编队控制器，它们严重依赖事先提供的高质量且动态可行的参考轨迹，因此编队运动规划（FMP）至关重要。为应对传统基于约束优化的方法所面临的高维联合轨迹计算挑战，本文提出一种混合优化-生成式框架，聚焦于提供必要空间灵活性的仿射编队。通过将规划任务表述为带约束的最大后验估计，我们解耦多代理目标，以利用预训练的单代理扩散先验来实现动态可行性、避障与平滑性。随后将生成过程与投影梯度下降（PGD）交替进行，以严格满足具有安全性保证的仿射几何约束。仿真表明，我们的框架能生成高度平滑、无碰撞且易于被常见分布式控制器跟踪的规划方案，并在多种指标上优于最先进的规划器。
translation.brief: 研究多代理仿射编队的高维轨迹规划问题，提出将最大后验估计与单代理扩散先验及 PGD 约束投影交替进行的混合优化-生成式框架。

papers.title: CAE-Bench: Benchmarking AI Agents for Reusable CAE Solver Development
papers.abstract: We developed CAE-Bench, a benchmark to evaluate AI agents on Computer-Aided Engineering (CAE) solver development. A CAE solver is more than a PDE solver; it must be able to generalize across various inputs, such as different boundary conditions, geometries, and material properties. CAE-Bench evaluates the generalizability of AI-developed CAE solvers by providing the same task, such as a heat transfer problem, multiple cases, with each case specifying an input. The AI agent develops a solver for a fixed task using only a few public cases, and the resulting solver is then tested on held-out cases, i.e., cases it has never seen before. We evaluate 12 models across a range of reasoning settings on 80 computational tasks. Our experiments show that even if a solver developed by an AI agent performs well on the public cases, it may even get 0 score on held-out cases. For tasks such as fluid dynamics problems, even the solver developed by GPT-6 Astra performs poorly on held-out cases. A data format and an SDK for task registration are provided, so the researcher can use the benchmark on their own infrastructure. We hope that CAE-Bench will help the community to develop AI agents that can develop reusable CAE solvers that generalize to various inputs.

translation.title: CAE-Bench：面向可复用 CAE 求解器开发的 AI 智能体基准测试
translation.abstract: 我们开发了 CAE-Bench，一个用于评估 AI 智能体在计算机辅助工程（CAE）求解器开发方面能力的基准测试。CAE 求解器不仅仅是一个 PDE 求解器；它必须能够泛化到各种输入，如不同的边界条件、几何形状和材料属性。CAE-Bench 通过为同一任务（如传热问题）提供多个案例来评估 AI 开发的 CAE 求解器的泛化能力，每个案例指定一个输入。AI 智能体仅使用少数公开案例为固定任务开发求解器，然后在留出案例（即它从未见过的案例）上测试所得求解器。我们在 80 个计算任务上对 12 个模型在多种推理设置下进行评估。实验表明，即使 AI 智能体开发的求解器在公开案例上表现良好，它在留出案例上甚至可能得 0 分。对于流体动力学等任务，即使 GPT-6 Astra 开发的求解器在留出案例上的表现也很差。我们提供了数据格式和任务注册 SDK，使研究者可以在自己的基础设施上使用该基准。我们希望 CAE-Bench 能帮助社区开发能够开发可复用、可泛化到各种输入的 CAE 求解器的 AI 智能体。
translation.brief: 该论文提出 CAE-Bench 基准，通过公开案例训练、留出案例测试的方式评估 AI 智能体开发的 CAE 求解器能否泛化到未见过的边界条件、几何和材料输入。

papers.title: SURMA: Efficient Fine-Grained Communication Offload for SuperPOD
papers.abstract: GPU SuperPODs underpin large language model (LLM) serving, but growing bandwidth and round-trip times make inter-GPU communication consume increasing compute resources. SM-driven remote memory access occupies shared memory or registers for in-flight data and competes for SM-to-NoC bandwidth. Dedicated engines can free these resources, but must handle fine-grained transfers, down to a 576\,B KV-cache entry. NVIDIA's CopyEngine uses less than 1\% of NVLink bandwidth at 7\,KB granularity. We present SURMA, an on-die Scale-Up Remote Memory Access engine. Adapting RDMA requires overcoming slow doorbell submission, excessive per-application connection state, head-of-line blocking of completion notifications on shared connections, and costly ordering for multipath transfers. SURMA uses a credit-based shared send queue to reduce submission latency from 1.2\,$\mu$s to 400\,ns; fused write-with-atomic semantics to share connections while independently notifying each transaction; and Network Per Path Ordering to ensure data arrives before the completion flag without Sender or Receiver Ordering. We implement SURMA in RTL on a two-FPGA prototype and evaluate it with two 8-GPU NVLink servers. At 512\,B granularity, SURMA saturates attainable bandwidth with a single SM, whereas NVLink needs over 14\% of the SMs. SURMA occupies under 0.5\% of GPU area and accelerates inference on four models by 1.05--1.26$\times$ over NVLink.

translation.title: SURMA：面向 SuperPOD 的高效细粒度通信卸载
translation.abstract: GPU SuperPOD 支撑着大语言模型（LLM）服务，但不断增长的带宽需求和往返时延使得 GPU 间通信消耗越来越多的计算资源。SM 驱动的远程内存访问会为在途数据占用共享内存或寄存器，并竞争 SM 到 NoC 的带宽。专用引擎可以释放这些资源，但必须处理细粒度传输，低至 576 B 的 KV-cache 条目。NVIDIA 的 CopyEngine 在 7 KB 粒度下仅使用不到 1% 的 NVLink 带宽。我们提出 SURMA，一种片上 Scale-Up 远程内存访问引擎。适配 RDMA 需要克服缓慢的门铃提交、过多的每应用连接状态、共享连接上完成通知的队头阻塞，以及多路径传输高昂的排序开销。SURMA 使用基于信用的共享发送队列将提交时延从 1.2 μs 降至 400 ns；融合的 write-with-atomic 语义在共享连接的同时独立通知每个事务；以及 Network Per Path Ordering 确保数据在完成标志之前到达，无需 Sender 或 Receiver Ordering。我们在双 FPGA 原型上以 RTL 实现 SURMA，并用两台 8-GPU NVLink 服务器进行评估。在 512 B 粒度下，SURMA 仅用一个 SM 即可饱和可达带宽，而 NVLink 需要超过 14% 的 SM。SURMA 占用不到 0.5% 的 GPU 面积，并将四个模型的推理加速 1.05–1.26 倍（相比 NVLink）。
translation.brief: 该论文针对 GPU 集群中 SM 驱动的细粒度 GPU 间通信占用计算资源的问题，提出片上远程内存访问引擎 SURMA，通过基于信用的共享发送队列、融合原子写语义和按路径网络排序来高效卸载通信。

papers.title: Even Loose Proximity Constraints Make Makespan-optimal Unlabeled Multi-agent Pathfinding Hard
papers.abstract: We study \textsc{$r$-Connected Unlabeled Multi-agent Pathfinding} ($r$CUMAPF), a variant of MAPF where interchangeable agents have a proximity range $r\in \mathbb{N}$, and agents must form a single group in a given graph $G$ through limited-range communication at all times. The problem arises in fundamental applications such as self-reconfiguration and platooning, while standard MAPF does not capture proximity constraints. For the problem of finding a makespan-optimal solution, prior work shows \NP-hardness for $r=1$ and polynomial-time solvability when $r$ is sufficiently large; the complexity for the intermediate case $2\le r$ is largely unknown. To narrow this gap, we show that finding a solution to $r$CUMAPF with makespan at most $2$ is \NP-hard for $2\le r= O(|V|^{1-\varepsilon})$, where $0<\varepsilon\le 1$ is a fixed constant and $|V|$ is the number of vertices. As a consequence, we show that the labeled analogue of $r$CUMAPF is also \NP-hard under the same condition.

translation.title: 即使是宽松的邻近约束也使 makespan 最优的无标签多智能体路径规划变得困难
translation.abstract: 我们研究 r-连通无标签多智能体路径规划（rCUMAPF），这是 MAPF 的一个变体，其中可互换的智能体拥有邻近范围 r∈N，且智能体在给定图 G 中必须始终通过有限距离的通信形成单一群体。该问题产生于自重构和编队行驶等基础应用，而标准 MAPF 无法刻画邻近约束。对于寻找 makespan 最优解的问题，已有工作证明了 r=1 时的 NP 难性以及 r 足够大时的多项式时间可解性；而中间情形 2≤r 的复杂性在很大程度上是未知的。为缩小这一差距，我们证明当 2≤r=O(|V|^{1-ε})（其中 0<ε≤1 为固定常数，|V| 为顶点数）时，求解 makespan 至多为 2 的 rCUMAPF 是 NP 难的。由此，我们证明 rCUMAPF 的带标签类似问题在相同条件下也是 NP 难的。
translation.brief: 该论文研究带邻近通信约束的无标签多智能体路径规划 rCUMAPF 的复杂度，通过构造性归约证明即使 makespan 限制为 2 且 2≤r=O(|V|^{1-ε}) 时问题仍是 NP 难的。

papers.title: Agent-Native by Design: A Programming Language for Agentic Applications
papers.abstract: Building agentic applications requires combining large language model (LLM) operations, workflow structure and application state, and model-guided routing. With SDKs and agent frameworks, developers connect these components through supporting code that prepares model inputs, propagates state, and dispatches model-selected steps. Workflow changes can require coordinated updates to this code, increasing development and testing effort. Splitting execution logic between application code and framework internals also limits compiler visibility into control flow and state dependencies, hindering automatic optimization. We introduce Agent-Native Programming, which unifies these three components with shared execution semantics. We realize this approach in Jac, a Python-superset language, through "by llm()" for typed model operations and tool use, Object-Spatial Programming for workflow structure and state, and "visit ... by llm()" for model-guided routing. The routing construct derives the model's choices from executable workflow steps and schedules the selected steps. This explicit connection between model decisions and program execution gives the compiler and runtime a common basis for dependency analysis and automatic optimization. Across five benchmarks and five baselines, Jac achieves a 1.8-8.7x reduction in AI-integration code relative to the OpenAI SDK, with competitive observed task quality and lower coding-agent development effort. Two case studies demonstrate speculative execution and service partitioning through configuration alone, using program analysis and runtime checks to preserve workflow behavior under stated conditions.

translation.title: Agent-Native by Design：面向智能体应用的编程语言
translation.abstract: 构建智能体应用需要组合大语言模型（LLM）操作、工作流结构与应用状态，以及模型引导的路由。使用 SDK 和智能体框架时，开发者需要通过辅助代码来连接这些组件，包括准备模型输入、传播状态和分发模型选择的步骤。工作流的变更可能要求协调更新这些代码，增加了开发和测试工作量。将执行逻辑分散在应用代码和框架内部，还限制了编译器对控制流和状态依赖的可见性，阻碍自动优化。我们提出 Agent-Native Programming，以共享的执行语义统一这三个组件。我们在 Python 超集语言 Jac 中实现该方法：通过 "by llm()" 实现带类型的模型操作与工具调用，通过 Object-Spatial Programming 实现工作流结构与状态，通过 "visit ... by llm()" 实现模型引导的路由。该路由结构从可执行的工作流步骤中推导模型的选择并调度所选步骤。模型决策与程序执行之间的这种显式连接，为编译器和运行时提供了依赖分析和自动优化的共同基础。在五个基准和五个基线上，相比 OpenAI SDK，Jac 将 AI 集成代码减少了 1.8–8.7 倍，同时保持有竞争力的任务质量和更低的编码智能体开发成本。两个案例研究展示了仅通过配置即可实现推测执行和服务分区，并利用程序分析和运行时检查在既定条件下保持工作流行为。
translation.brief: 该论文针对 SDK/框架方式下 LLM 操作、工作流和状态割裂导致的代码冗余与优化困难，设计了 Python 超集语言 Jac，以统一执行语义原生融合模型操作、工作流状态和模型引导路由。

papers.title: Turing Agent: Agentic Formal Verification for Mathematical Research
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly advancing mathematical discovery, moving beyond benchmark-level problem solving to tackle frontier research problems. This progress is ushering mathematics into an era of proof abundance, raising a fundamental challenge: how can we ensure the correctness of the ever-growing volume of AI-generated proofs and transform them into trustworthy, machine-verified mathematical knowledge? We introduce Turing Agent, an agent harness designed to orchestrate end-to-end formal verification of research-level mathematics. Its wo-scale architecture integrates theorem formalization and proof formalization agents, empowered by structured proof decomposition, parallel verification, accumulated proof experience, and selective semantic review. Leveraging our collaborations with theoretical computer science (TCS) researchers, we focus our evaluation on TCS, a particularly demanding domain characterized by intricate quantification, complex dependencies, and stringent semantic requirements. Against direct generation and general-purpose coding harnesses, including Codex CLI and Claude Code, Turing Agent achieves approximately 57-62% faithful formalization success on Formal TCS Bench and 83% overall pass@1 on a TCS-focused subset of RLMEval, using GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-V4-Pro. Notably, Turing Agent, built on DeepSeek, successfully completes the formal verification of three previously unresolved TCS tasks from OpenAI's October 2026 collection. One particularly challenging TCS problem required about a hundred formally verified auxiliary claims. Moreover, by actively exploring and refining the formalization process, Turing Agent can uncover simpler alternative proofs, expose unnecessary dependencies in original proofs, and generate reusable mathematical knowledge as a byproduct of verification.

translation.title: Turing Agent：面向数学研究的智能体化形式验证
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正在快速推进数学发现，从基准级问题求解迈向前沿研究问题。这一进展使数学进入一个证明泛滥的时代，带来一个根本性挑战：如何确保不断增长的 AI 生成证明的正确性，并将其转化为可信的、机器验证的数学知识？我们提出 Turing Agent，一个用于统筹研究级数学端到端形式验证的智能体框架。其双尺度架构集成了定理形式化与证明形式化智能体，并借助结构化证明分解、并行验证、累积证明经验和选择性语义审查。基于我们与理论计算机科学（TCS）研究者的合作，我们将评估重点放在 TCS——一个以复杂量词、复杂依赖和严格语义要求为特征的极具挑战性的领域。相对于直接生成和通用编码框架（包括 Codex CLI 和 Claude Code），Turing Agent 使用 GLM-5.3 和 DeepSeek-V4-Pro，在 Formal TCS Bench 上取得约 57–62% 的忠实形式化成功率，在 RLMEval 的 TCS 子集上取得 83% 的整体 pass@1。值得注意的是，基于 DeepSeek 构建的 Turing Agent 成功完成了 OpenAI 2026 年 10 月题集中三个此前未解决的 TCS 任务的形式验证。其中一个极具挑战性的 TCS 问题需要约一百个经形式验证的辅助命题。此外，通过积极探索和改进形式化过程，Turing Agent 能够发现更简单的替代证明、揭示原证明中不必要的依赖，并作为验证的副产品生成可复用的数学知识。
translation.brief: 该论文针对 AI 生成数学证明数量激增而可信性难以保障的问题，提出 Turing Agent 双尺度智能体框架，通过证明分解、并行验证与语义审查来端到端地形式化并验证研究级数学证明。

papers.title: Can AI Mature a Model's Geometry? Training-Free Weight Baking in LLMs
papers.abstract: Can an AI make a trained language model more mature, in the sense of a better organized latent space, by looking only at the geometry of that space? An analyst model reads a fixed-size digest of topological descriptors of the layers of a frozen target and proposes a transformation, which closed-form ridge regression writes into the feed-forward weights without gradient training. Using lightweight models, 126 runs show that category purity rose on unseen words and sentences, benchmark accuracy stayed within sampling error, and the analyst matched a category-aware heuristic with gentler edits. In a five-model round robin approach, 16 pairs raised purity and four left the target unchanged. The results provide a baseline for future work on LLM-guided, training-free model editing without using raw weights.

translation.title: AI 能使模型的几何结构更成熟吗？LLM 中的免训练权重烘焙
translation.abstract: AI 能否仅通过观察语言模型潜在空间的几何结构，使其更成熟（即潜在空间组织得更好）？一个分析模型读取冻结目标模型各层拓扑描述符的固定大小摘要并提出一种变换，然后通过闭式岭回归将该变换写入前馈权重，无需梯度训练。在使用轻量级模型的 126 次实验中，未见过的词句上的类别纯度得到提升，基准准确率保持在采样误差范围内，且该分析模型能以更温和的编辑达到与类别感知启发式方法相当的效果。在五个模型的循环实验中，16 个模型对提升了纯度，4 个未改变目标。这些结果为未来无需原始权重的 LLM 引导免训练模型编辑研究提供了基线。
translation.brief: 研究仅凭模型潜在空间几何结构实现免训练的模型编辑：由分析模型提出变换并用闭式岭回归写入前馈权重。

papers.title: Benchleaking Is Accelerating: Benchmark contamination has worsened sharply in the past month -- from post-training down to pre-training base models
papers.abstract: Benchmark contamination is not new, but recent model releases show it in a sharper form. We use the term benchleaking for the case in which a benchmark's own test examples enter training data, so that a score reflects recall rather than capability. This differs from benchmaxxing, which optimizes toward a benchmark without seeing its test set. We document two escalations over the past month. First, in post-training, the traces have become explicit: recent audits show an agent stating hidden test requirements it was never given in 23% of its attempts, where its predecessor did so in none, and continuing to follow them after the task is changed to contradict them (Schaeffer and Räuker, 2026; Lo and Lo, 2026). Second, the problem has reached pre-training. Using few-shot continuation on 20 benchmarks across four public base models, we find that some base models write out other test examples---complete questions, options, and answers---that appear nowhere in their input. For the recently released ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base, 96% of HumanEval problems leak with their reference implementations and 85% of OpenBookQA questions leak with their answers, against 9% and none for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base. To quantify what a reported score owes to such examples, we define an Anti-Hack score: the benchmark score recomputed with every leaked example marked wrong and the number of examples unchanged. Averaged over the suite, it costs DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base 1.5 points and Hy3-preview-Base 1.3, against 5.0 for MiMo-V2.5-Base and 16.6 for ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base. Open base models are the foundation of much downstream research, so benchleaking now affects more than leaderboard rankings. We call for decontamination reports and contamination-adjusted scores to become standard practice.

translation.title: Benchleaking 正在加速：基准污染在过去一个月急剧恶化——从后训练蔓延到预训练基座模型
translation.abstract: 基准污染并非新问题，但近期的模型发布使其以更尖锐的形式呈现。我们将基准自身的测试样例进入训练数据、使分数反映记忆而非能力的情形称为 benchleaking，这与 benchmaxxing（未见过测试集但向基准优化）不同。我们记录了过去一个月的两次恶化。第一，在后训练中，痕迹变得显性：最近的审计显示，某智能体在 23% 的尝试中陈述了其从未被告知的隐藏测试要求（其前代为 0%），并且在任务被修改为与之矛盾后仍继续遵循这些要求（Schaeffer and Räuker, 2026; Lo and Lo, 2026）。第二，问题已蔓延到预训练阶段。通过在四个公开基座模型、20 个基准上进行 few-shot 续写，我们发现某些基座模型会写出输入中并未出现的其他测试样例——完整的题目、选项和答案。对于新发布的 ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base，96% 的 HumanEval 题目连同参考实现泄露，85% 的 OpenBookQA 题目连同答案泄露；而 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base 分别为 9% 和 0。为量化报告分数中有多少来自这类样例，我们定义了 Anti-Hack 分数：将所有泄露样例判为错误、题目数量不变后重新计算的基准分数。在整个测试套件上平均，它使 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base 损失 1.5 分、Hy3-preview-Base 损失 1.3 分，而 MiMo-V2.5-Base 损失 5.0 分、ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base 损失 16.6 分。开放基座模型是大量下游研究的基础，因此 benchleaking 的影响已超出排行榜排名。我们呼吁将去污染报告和污染调整后的分数成为标准实践。
translation.brief: 量化基准测试样例泄露进训练数据的问题：提出 Anti-Hack 分数，将泄露样例判错后重算基准分数以度量污染程度。

papers.title: TRIAGE-CPG: A Cross-Model Study of Budgeted Static Malware Triage with Large Language Models
papers.abstract: When triaging unknown binaries, security analysts must decide which samples to clear as benign, flag as malicious, or escalate for deeper analysis. Large Language Models (LLMs) could support these decisions by interpreting decompiled code, but a binary can contain hundreds or thousands of functions, making exhaustive LLM analysis impractical. We study how current LLMs behave when static triage is formulated as budgeted evidence acquisition: which functions they inspect and how they trade off benign clearance, malware detection, and escalation. To enable a controlled comparison, we implement TRIAGE-CPG, a fixed pipeline over a code property graph (CPG) of a decompiled binary. An LLM-free heuristic selects seed functions, an agent expands the resulting evidence dossier under a fixed budget, and a reporting stage produces a benign, suspicious, or malicious verdict together with a behavioral report. We evaluate eight closed-source and open-weight models on 1,000 Windows PE binaries, using a 600-sample test split and the same zero-shot protocol for every model. We assess the ternary verdicts under both a strict binary reading and triage balanced accuracy (tBA), which credits malware that is flagged or escalated and benign samples only when cleared. After analyzing about 40 of a mean 1,000 functions per binary, the highest-scoring model reaches a strict balanced accuracy of 0.805 and a tBA of 0.855, flagging 65% of malware, escalating another 12%, and clearing 94% of benign samples. The models implement different triage policies: high-specificity models produce small, malware-rich escalation queues, whereas recall-oriented models escalate or flag much more broadly. Both closed-source and open-weight models appear across this spectrum. Our results identify no universal deployment configuration: model choice itself determines the clear/flag/escalate trade-off under limited static evidence.

translation.title: TRIAGE-CPG：基于预算约束的静态恶意软件分诊与大语言模型的跨模型研究
translation.abstract: 在对未知二进制文件进行分诊时，安全分析师必须决定哪些样本可判定为良性放行、哪些标记为恶意、哪些升级做深入分析。大语言模型（LLM）可通过解释反编译代码支持这些决策，但一个二进制文件可能包含成百上千个函数，穷尽式 LLM 分析并不现实。我们研究当前 LLM 在将静态分诊建模为预算约束下的证据获取时的行为：它们检查哪些函数，以及如何在良性放行、恶意检测和升级之间权衡。为实现受控比较，我们实现了 TRIAGE-CPG——一个基于反编译二进制代码属性图（CPG）的固定流水线。无 LLM 的启发式方法选择种子函数，一个智能体在固定预算下扩展证据档案，报告阶段给出良性、可疑或恶意的判定以及行为报告。我们在 1,000 个 Windows PE 二进制文件上评估八个闭源和开源权重模型，使用 600 样本的测试划分，且所有模型采用相同的零样本协议。我们用严格的二元读法和分诊平衡准确率（tBA）评估三元判定，tBA 将被标记或升级的恶意软件记为正确，而良性样本仅在放行时记为正确。在平均 1,000 个函数中分析约 40 个后，得分最高的模型达到 0.805 的严格平衡准确率和 0.855 的 tBA，标记了 65% 的恶意软件、升级另外 12%，并放行了 94% 的良性样本。各模型采用不同的分诊策略：高特异性模型产生小而恶意软件密集的升级队列，而召回导向的模型则大范围升级或标记。闭源和开源权重模型均分布在这一谱系之中。我们的结果表明不存在通用的部署配置：在有限的静态证据下，模型选择本身就决定了放行/标记/升级的权衡。
translation.brief: 将恶意软件静态分诊建模为预算约束下的证据获取问题，用固定 CPG 流水线（种子选择+LLM 智能体扩展证据）系统比较多模型的分诊策略。

papers.title: ALIVE: Making Streaming Video Models Interactive
papers.abstract: Streaming video LLMs can continuously observe the world, yet often handle user requests in isolation. We introduce ALIVE, an interactive streaming video model supporting proactive monitoring, streaming task coordination, and feedback-seeking interaction. We construct ALIVE-SFT-288K and ALIVE-RL-3K for two-stage training. Contrastive supervised fine-tuning teaches when and how to respond, while reinforcement learning with Behavior-Aligned Credit Assignment (BACA) combines trajectory-level and local advantages to refine decisions, responses, and silence across multi-turn interactions. We also introduce FSI-Bench to evaluate feedback seeking and subsequent task completion. ALIVE achieves the highest overall scores among the compared models on four public benchmarks and FSI-Bench, demonstrating strong streaming understanding and interactive capabilities.

translation.title: ALIVE：让流式视频模型具备交互能力
translation.abstract: 流式视频 LLM 可以持续观察世界，但在处理用户请求时往往是孤立的。我们提出 ALIVE，一个支持主动监控、流式任务协调和寻求反馈式交互的交互式流式视频模型。我们构建了用于两阶段训练的 ALIVE-SFT-288K 和 ALIVE-RL-3K 数据集。对比监督微调教会模型何时以及如何响应，而采用行为对齐信用分配（BACA）的强化学习结合轨迹级与局部优势，以在多轮交互中优化决策、响应和沉默。我们还提出 FSI-Bench 用于评估反馈寻求及后续任务完成情况。ALIVE 在四个公开基准和 FSI-Bench 上取得对比模型中最高的总分，展现出强大的流式理解和交互能力。
translation.brief: 针对流式视频 LLM 无法主动与用户交互的问题，提出通过对比 SFT 和基于 BACA 的强化学习两阶段训练，使模型支持主动监控与寻求反馈的交互。

papers.title: Premise Recovery in Software Design: What Does This Decision Rest On?
papers.abstract: Design decisions shape software architecture, and writing them down preserves the reasons behind it. Architecture decision records (ADRs) capture them, each with its context, choice, and consequences. A decision can depend on earlier ones: reversing one of them would force its review. We call these its premises. Yet ADRs do not always name their premises. When a decision is reversed, engineers supersede its ADR and search by hand for what it affects. That search can miss ADRs resting on an unnamed premise. We frame this as premise recovery: given an ADR with identifiers masked, find its premises among earlier records. We collect 1,060 ADRs from 36 repositories and label 1,529 candidate pairs for 60 target ADRs. Two LLM annotators agree at \k{appa} = 0.859. An independent human annotator, blind to their labels, agrees with the stated/implicit tag on 30 of 32 premises (\k{appa} = 0.875). We compare 7 open-weight models with 2 baselines that use no LLM. Qwen3.8-27B reaches F1 0.756, against 0.466 for word overlap; 2 models added post hoc score similarly. On the 11 premises whose titles barely overlap the target, it finds 0.758, while word overlap finds none. Reasoning raises its recall of implicit premises but not its F1. Word overlap with as many predictions gains 69% as much. We find only 2 to 3 stale dependents, though we searched for unlinked ones in only 30 of 66 supersessions. Open models could thus suggest unwritten premises when a decision is reversed, with precision between 0.68 and 0.78.

translation.title: 软件设计中的前提恢复：这个决策建立在什么之上？
translation.abstract: 设计决策塑造软件架构，将其记录下来可保存架构背后的原因。架构决策记录（ADR）捕获这些决策，每条包含上下文、选择和后果。一个决策可能依赖于更早的决策：撤销后者将迫使前者重新审视。我们称之为其前提。然而 ADR 并不总是明确写出其前提。当一个决策被撤销时，工程师会废弃相应 ADR 并手工搜索其影响范围，这可能会遗漏依赖未命名前提的 ADR。我们将其形式化为前提恢复：在标识符被遮蔽的条件下，从更早的记录中找出给定 ADR 的前提。我们从 36 个代码仓库收集 1,060 条 ADR，并为 60 条目标 ADR 标注了 1,529 个候选对。两个 LLM 标注者的共识达 \k{appa} = 0.859；一名独立且不知情的人类标注者与明确/隐式标签在 32 个前提中的 30 个上一致（\k{appa} = 0.875）。我们比较了 7 个开源权重模型与 2 个不使用 LLM 的基线。Qwen3.8-27B 达到 F1 0.756，而词重叠基线为 0.466；两个事后加入的模型成绩相近。在 11 个标题与目标几乎无重叠的前提上，它找到 0.758，而词重叠基线一无所获。推理能力提升了隐式前提的召回率但未提升 F1。产生同样数量预测的词重叠基线仅达到其 69%。虽然我们只在 66 次撤销中的 30 次里搜索了未链接的依赖，但仅发现 2 到 3 个过时依赖。因此，开源模型可在决策被撤销时建议未写出的前提，精确率介于 0.68 到 0.78 之间。
translation.brief: 针对 ADR 未明确记录决策前提导致撤销决策时难以找出受影响记录的问题，将前提恢复形式化为检索任务并用开源 LLM 从历史 ADR 中识别前提。

papers.title: WeVisForensics: Self-Evolving Agent for Omni AI-Generated Video Detection
papers.abstract: Recent advances in video generation call for reliable detection grounded in explicit forensic evidence. However, current methods primarily depend on single-pass chain-of-thought reasoning that overlooks brief or localized artifacts, or on predefined multi-agent workflows that offer limited flexibility in selecting relevant inspections. Even with adaptive investigation, optimizing the investigation policy alone does not directly improve the forensic capabilities of fixed experts. We introduce WeVisForensics, an agentic framework in which a main investigator agent coordinates a self-evolving library of forensic inspector sub-agents spanning visual and audio cues. The investigator learns which artifact type to examine, over which window, and when to conclude, and these interactions provide shared feedback for both levels of agents. Our dual-timescale policy optimization strategy, DTPO, closes this loop through fast reinforcement learning of the investigator and slower refinement of the inspectors, guided by annotated artifact intervals, to report subtle artifacts they once dismissed. Furthermore, we curate ForenCue-30K, combining role-specific forensic annotations and interaction trajectories to supervise individual inspections and their coordination, with an accompanying reinforcement-learning pool. Experiments show that WeVisForensics averages 95.2% detection accuracy across in-domain, out-of-domain and agentic benchmarks, 9.0% above the strongest prior detector, while grounding its verdicts in localized evidence.

translation.title: WeVisForensics：面向全能 AI 生成视频检测的自进化智能体
translation.abstract: 视频生成技术的最新进展要求基于明确取证证据的可靠检测方法。然而，当前方法主要依赖单遍思维链推理，容易忽略短暂或局部的伪影，或依赖预定义的多智能体工作流，在选择相关检查方面灵活性有限。即使采用自适应调查，仅优化调查策略也无法直接提升固定专家的取证能力。我们提出 WeVisForensics，这是一个智能体框架，其中主调查智能体协调一个跨越视觉与音频线索、可自进化的取证检查员子智能体库。调查智能体学习检查哪种伪影类型、在哪个时间窗口检查以及何时结束，这些交互为两层智能体提供共享反馈。我们的双时间尺度策略优化策略 DTPO 通过调查智能体的快速强化学习和检查员较慢的精调来闭合这一循环，并借助标注的伪影区间引导，使检查员能够报告他们曾经忽略的细微伪影。此外，我们构建了 ForenCue-30K 数据集，结合角色专属取证标注与交互轨迹，用于监督个体检查及其协调，并配有强化学习池。实验表明，WeVisForensics 在域内、域外及智能体基准上平均检测准确率达 95.2%，比最强先前检测器高 9.0%，且其判定均基于局部化证据。
translation.brief: 针对AI生成视频检测中伪影易被忽略和取证能力固定的问题，提出由调查智能体协调自进化检查员子智能体库并用双时间尺度策略优化（DTPO）同时训练两层智能体的取证框架。

papers.title: A Crowd-Audited Atlas of Implicit Bias in LLM-Powered Agents
papers.abstract: Prior work has shown that large language models (LLMs) express implicit biases in high-publicity, one-off decision scenarios such as hiring and intelligence assessment. However, as people increasingly employ autonomous, LLM-powered AI agents that make decisions on their behalf in doing day-to-day tasks, it is of critical importance that we understand how implicit biases, based on sociodemographic assumptions, emerge across a broad milieu of workaday decision scenarios. We used the 17 domains of daily activity in the American Time Use Survey (ATUS) to generate an atlas of 506 decision scenarios in which LLMs --- endowed with personas representing different races, gender identities, and political ideologies --- expressed significant implicit bias. Next, in a crowdsourced audit, 500 participants made 8,010 binary choices about which implicitly biased decision scenarios most deserved further review. We found that participants prioritized decision scenarios that had broad relevance (e.g., about food choices), were high stakes (e.g., about health), and where all members of a simulated sociodemographic group made unanimous decisions (because it was a clear indication of stereotyping). They were less swayed by the magnitude of an observed disparity or the specific ATUS domain the decision scenario represented. When examining the rationale behind their prioritization choices, we found that participants often interpreted disparities as traits of demographic groups and judged whether those traits seemed plausible, often based on their own internalized stereotypes. We discuss implications for building personalized AI agents, digital twins, social simulations, and for using crowdsourced bias audits.

translation.title: 众包审计的 LLM 智能体内隐偏见图谱
translation.abstract: 已有研究表明，大语言模型（LLM）在高关注度、一次性决策场景（如招聘和智力评估）中会表达内隐偏见。然而，随着人们日益使用自主的 LLM 驱动 AI 智能体代其完成日常任务决策，理解基于社会人口学假设的内隐偏见如何在广泛的日常决策场景中涌现变得至关重要。我们利用 American Time Use Survey (ATUS) 的 17 个日常活动领域，生成了一个包含 506 个决策场景的图谱，在这些场景中，被赋予代表不同种族、性别认同和政治意识形态人格的 LLM 表现出显著的内隐偏见。随后，在众包审计中，500 名参与者就哪些内隐偏见决策场景最值得进一步审查做出了 8010 次二元选择。我们发现，参与者优先考虑具有广泛相关性（如食物选择）、高风险（如健康）以及模拟社会人口群体所有成员做出一致决策（这是刻板印象的明确迹象）的决策场景。他们较少受观察到的差异幅度或决策场景所属具体 ATUS 领域的影响。在考察其优先级选择背后的理由时，我们发现参与者常将差异解读为人口群体的特质，并判断这些特质是否看似合理，往往基于自身内化的刻板印象。我们讨论了对构建个性化 AI 智能体、数字孪生、社会模拟以及使用众包偏见审计的启示。
translation.brief: 针对LLM智能体在日常决策场景中内隐偏见缺乏系统刻画的问题，基于ATUS构建506个偏见决策场景图谱并通过500人众包审计研究人们对偏见的优先级判断。

papers.title: VisualArtifactSpec 1.0: Evaluating Visual Artifacts under Task Specifications
papers.abstract: Visual artifact tasks test agents' ability to translate task specifications and source materials into outputs that meet practical needs. Evaluation across artifact families helps distinguish broadly applicable authoring capabilities from strengths confined to a particular medium. We introduce VisualArtifactSpec 1.0 (VAS), a benchmark of 211 creation and modification tasks spanning presentations, static graphics, animations and videos, and web interfaces. Each task specifies authoring objectives, source materials, constraints, and deliverables. Existing benchmarks provide limited support for systematically evaluating how authoring choices suit different audiences, purposes, and media across artifact families. VAS evaluates two aspects separately: Task Fulfillment verifies explicit requirements and applicable functionality, while Artifact Performance assesses Content, Organization, Visuals, and Delivery. Task-specific rating anchors instantiate shared criteria for the intended audience, purpose, and medium, with judgments grounded in source materials and artifact inspection records. We evaluate nine model-harness configurations on all 211 tasks. Overall scores range from 42.12 to 70.52, with Artifact Performance accounting for 73.4% of the gap between the highest- and lowest-scoring configurations.

translation.title: VisualArtifactSpec 1.0：在任务规范下评估视觉伪影产物
translation.abstract: 视觉产物任务考察智能体将任务规范和源素材转化为满足实际需求输出的能力。跨产物家族的评估有助于区分广泛适用的创作能力与局限于特定媒介的强项。我们提出 VisualArtifactSpec 1.0 (VAS)，这是一个包含 211 个创作与修改任务的基准，涵盖演示文稿、静态图形、动画与视频以及网页界面。每个任务指定创作目标、源素材、约束和交付物。现有基准对系统评估创作选择如何适配不同受众、目的和媒介的支持有限。VAS 分别评估两个方面：任务完成度（Task Fulfillment）验证明确要求与可用功能，而产物表现（Artifact Performance）评估内容、组织、视觉与表达。任务专属评分锚点为预期受众、目的和媒介实例化共享标准，判断基于源素材和产物检查记录。我们在全部 211 个任务上评估了九种模型-框架配置。总体得分介于 42.12 至 70.52 之间，其中产物表现占最高分与最低分配置之间差距的 73.4%。
translation.brief: 针对现有基准难以系统评估跨媒介视觉产物创作能力的问题，构建涵盖演示文稿、图形、动画视频和网页界面的211任务基准VAS，并从任务完成度与产物表现两方面分别评估。

papers.title: A Polynomial-Time Algorithm for Constant-Factor EFX Allocations of Chores
papers.abstract: We study the fair division of indivisible chores among agents with additive disutilities, focusing on the central fairness notion of envy-freeness up to any chore (EFX), and its multiplicative approximations. Although the existence of constant-factor approximations to EFX are known, computing such an allocation in polynomial time remained open. We resolve this question by giving an algorithm that, for every $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$, computes a $(3+\varepsilon)$-EFX allocation in time polynomial in the input length and $1/\varepsilon$. Our result relies on two algorithmic contributions. First, we give a fully polynomial-time approximation scheme (FPTAS) for earning-restricted (ER) equilibria with equal earning requirements and arbitrary feasible chore earning limits. We develop a new nonconvex program with chore payouts and money-flow variables, and prove that every local maximum yields an exact ER equilibrium. We then give a mirror-ascent algorithm for this program and prove that it converges to an approximate ER equilibrium in polynomial time. Second, we give a new procedure that converts the approximate equilibrium into a $(3+\varepsilon)$-EFX-friendly allocation, a suitable starting point for the chore-swap framework of Garg and Murhekar (2026). The procedure uses a flexible price threshold to choose swap chores and their recipients together, overcoming a factor-four bottleneck in the earlier approaches while accommodating approximate earnings. We expect these ideas to be useful more broadly in fair division, including for goods and other fairness notions.

translation.title: 常数因子 EFX 家务分配的多项式时间算法
translation.abstract: 我们研究在具有可加负效用的智能体之间对不可分家务的公平分配，聚焦 envy-freeness up to any chore (EFX) 这一核心公平概念及其乘法近似。尽管已知常数因子 EFX 近似解的存在性，如何在多项式时间内计算这样的分配仍是悬而未决的问题。我们解决了这一问题：对每个 $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$，给出一个在输入长度和 $1/\varepsilon$ 的多项式时间内计算 $(3+\varepsilon)$-EFX 分配的算法。我们的结果依赖两项算法贡献。首先，我们为具有相等收入要求与任意可行家务收入上限的收入受限（ER）均衡给出全多项式时间近似方案（FPTAS）。我们开发了带有家务支出与资金流变量的新非凸规划，并证明每个局部最大值都产生精确的 ER 均衡。随后，我们为该规划给出镜像上升算法，并证明它在多项式时间内收敛到近似 ER 均衡。其次，我们给出新程序，将近似均衡转换为 $(3+\varepsilon)$-EFX 友好的分配，作为 Garg 和 Murhekar (2026) 家务交换框架的合适起点。该程序使用灵活的价格阈值同时选择交换家务及其接受者，克服了先前方法中因子为四的瓶颈，同时兼容近似收入。我们期待这些思想在公平分配的更广泛场景中发挥作用，包括物品分配及其他公平概念。
translation.brief: 针对不可分家务公平分配中常数因子EFX分配缺乏多项式时间算法的开放问题，先给出ER均衡的FPTAS，再将近似均衡转化为EFX友好分配以接入家务交换框架，实现(3+ε)-EFX。

papers.title: VideoNexus: Video Perception Beyond the Reasoning Context
papers.abstract: Understanding long videos requires locating evidence, resolving visual details, and integrating observations into an answer. Even when relevant evidence is present, performing these operations within long, dense visual sequences burdens both perception and reasoning. Video agents enable selective inspection, but returning frames to the planner still accumulates visual information in its reasoning context. Delegating perception reduces this burden, yet sparse sampling can miss decisive details, and per-frame descriptions can preserve context growth. We introduce VideoNexus, a training-free framework that separates detailed video perception from evidence-driven planning and reasoning. The planner controls where to inspect, what to resolve, and how densely to sample. Perception sub-agents process native audio-video in independent contexts and return compact, temporally grounded evidence for iterative search and verification. Using Gemini 3.8 Flash for both planning and perception, VideoNexus achieves 88.6% accuracy on full LVBench, exceeding same-backbone static ingestion and built-in agentic processing by 3.6 and 1.1 points, respectively, at 44% of the latter's measured API cost. A paired LVBench subset ablation shows lower planner input and higher accuracy. With Kimi K3 as the shared backbone, VideoNexus improves over the official Video-GAIA ReAct harness by 8.5 points in our evaluation. These results support compact evidence exchange for combining detailed observation with efficient planning and reasoning.

translation.title: VideoNexus：超越推理上下文的视频感知
translation.abstract: 理解长视频需要定位证据、解析视觉细节并将观察结果整合为答案。即使相关证据存在，在长而密集的视觉序列中执行这些操作也会同时加重感知与推理负担。视频智能体支持选择性检查，但将帧返回给规划器仍会在其推理上下文中积累视觉信息。委托感知可以减轻这一负担，但稀疏采样可能遗漏决定性细节，逐帧描述也会导致上下文增长。我们提出 VideoNexus，一个免训练框架，将精细视频感知与证据驱动的规划和推理分离。规划器控制在哪里检查、解析什么以及采样密度。感知子智能体在独立上下文中处理原生音视频，并返回紧凑的、时间对齐的证据，用于迭代搜索与验证。使用 Gemini 3.8 Flash 同时承担规划与感知，VideoNexus 在完整 LVBench 上达到 88.6% 的准确率，分别超过同骨干静态摄取与内置智能体处理 3.6 和 1.1 个百分点，且 API 成本仅为后者的 44%。在配对的 LVBench 子集消融中，规划器输入更低且准确率更高。以 Kimi K3 作为共享骨干时，VideoNexus 在我们的评估中比官方 Video-GAIA ReAct 框架提升 8.5 个百分点。这些结果支持以紧凑证据交换来结合细致观察与高效规划和推理。
translation.brief: 针对长视频理解中感知与推理负担过重的问题，提出免训练的VideoNexus框架，由规划器驱动感知子智能体在独立上下文中处理音视频并返回紧凑的时间对齐证据用于迭代搜索验证。

papers.title: Beyond Bilingual: Studying Quadrilingual Code-Switching with Conversational AI
papers.abstract: Multilingual speakers choose languages by topic and conversation partner. Large language models (LLMs) support these languages unequally. Research on code-switching with conversational AI has mostly examined bilingual pairs of well-resourced languages. In Curaçao and Aruba, many people use Dutch, English, Spanish, and the low-resource Creole Papiamentu/o. In a preregistered study, 42 university students held two five-minute chatbot conversations, one about university life and one about local food and culture. Surveys assessed language background, AI use, and switching comfort. 20 international students in Curaçao formed a comparison sample. Participants switched between turns and rarely mixed languages within a message. English dominated both conversations. Participants switched more often in the cultural conversation, where Papiamentu/o and Spanish rose from 15% to 24% of messages. Self-reports showed no lower comfort switching with the chatbot than with a person. Conversational agents must follow turn-by-turn language changes and handle local low-resource languages well.

translation.title: 超越双语：与对话式AI研究四语码切换
translation.abstract: 多语言使用者会根据话题和对话对象选择语言，而大语言模型(LLM)对这些语言的支持并不均衡。现有关于对话式AI码切换的研究大多关注资源充足的双语对。在库拉索和阿鲁巴，许多人使用荷兰语、英语、西班牙语以及低资源克里奥尔语帕皮阿门托语。在一项预注册研究中，42名大学生与聊天机器人进行了两次各五分钟的对话，一次关于大学生活，一次关于当地食物与文化；问卷评估了语言背景、AI使用情况和切换舒适度。库拉索的20名国际学生构成对比样本。参与者在轮次之间切换语言，很少在单条消息内混合语言。英语在两次对话中均占主导。在文化对话中切换更频繁，帕皮阿门托语和西班牙语的消息占比从15%升至24%。自我报告显示，与聊天机器人切换语言的舒适度并不低于与人对话。对话智能体必须能够逐轮跟随语言变化，并良好处理当地低资源语言。
translation.brief: 研究多语言用户与聊天机器人对话中的四语码切换行为，通过42名学生的预注册对话实验揭示逐轮语言切换模式及低资源语言帕皮阿门托语的使用情况。

papers.title: Efficient Modeling of Multi-Agent Systems via Structure-Aware Physics-Informed Learning
papers.abstract: Modeling large multi-agent systems poses challenges for trajectory inference and parameter identification, as network size and coupling increase computational demands and partial observations require reconstructing unobserved states. We propose MAS-PINN, a neural-network architecture with a tailored training algorithm for a physics-informed learning framework that leverages the network topology and the agents' similarity to reduce computational and memory costs of simulating and identifying multi-agent systems. Its architecture represents agent trajectories through shared temporal features and agent-specific coefficients. Training alternates between learning features, fitting coupled trajectories, and estimating physical parameters. A matrix-free update exploits local interactions to fit trajectories without forming large global matrices. Experiments on Lorenz rings, Lotka--Volterra networks, and Rössler oscillators show improved trajectory and parameter accuracy over baselines, including inference in large systems and identification under partial observations or unknown topology, alongside substantial computational savings in coefficient fitting.

translation.title: 基于结构感知物理信息学习的高效多智能体系统建模
translation.abstract: 对大型多智能体系统建模在轨迹推断和参数辨识方面面临挑战：网络规模和耦合增加了计算需求，部分观测则需要重构未观测状态。我们提出MAS-PINN，一种神经网络架构及配套训练算法，其物理信息学习框架利用网络拓扑和智能体间的相似性，降低多智能体系统仿真与辨识的计算和内存成本。该架构通过共享时间特征和智能体专属系数表示智能体轨迹。训练在学习特征、拟合耦合轨迹和估计物理参数之间交替进行。无矩阵更新利用局部交互拟合轨迹，无需构建大型全局矩阵。在Lorenz环、Lotka-Volterra网络和Rössler振子上的实验表明，相比基线方法，其轨迹和参数精度更高，包括大规模系统推断以及部分观测或未知拓扑下的辨识，同时在系数拟合上显著节省计算量。
translation.brief: 提出MAS-PINN神经网络架构，利用网络拓扑和智能体相似性以更低计算成本实现多智能体系统的轨迹推断与参数辨识。

papers.title: Harness Leverage Across Model Size: A Ladder of Five Local Agent Harnesses from 0.75B to 4.7B
papers.abstract: A harness turns a model into a system that completes tasks: it builds the prompt, exposes tools and decides when work is done. Harness comparisons hold the model fixed. Model comparisons hold the harness fixed. We vary both: five shipped harnesses, 18 artifact-producing tasks, four locally deployable open-weight models from 0.75B to 4.7B and a 35.5B anchor, with one deterministic checker scoring all 360 ladder cells. The completion-controlling harness, Mingbird, has the highest mean at every size. Of four pre-registered paired contrasts, two survive Holm correction, at 0.75B and 4.7B. Thirteen of sixteen paired intervals exclude zero under the deployment reading, with leads from 0.075 over the strongest rival to 0.819 over the weakest. The completion gate is not the carrier: disabling all six executable checks moves the mean by +0.080, +0.117, +0.003 and -0.004, every interval including zero, and only at 1.9B does disabling it create empty runs. Removing one repeat-blocking rule alone costs 0.411 at 0.75B and leaves eight of eighteen tasks with no artifact. The harness effect is a progress effect: it decides whether a run leaves anything on disk. Of 357 usable cells, 127 leave none of their declared artifacts and 85 of those exit normally, so a scorer that reads exit status credits work that was never written. Whether the effect grows or shrinks with size, four rungs cannot settle: a floor arm produces a rise, a ceiling a decline, and a cross-family rung a peak.

translation.title: 跨模型规模的Harness杠杆效应：从0.75B到4.7B的五个本地智能体Harness阶梯
translation.abstract: Harness将模型转变为能完成任务的系统：构建提示词、暴露工具并判断工作何时完成。Harness比较固定模型，模型比较固定Harness，而我们两者都改变：五个已交付的Harness、18个产出工件的任务、四个0.75B至4.7B的本地可部署开源权重模型及一个35.5B锚点模型，由一个确定性检查器对所有360个阶梯单元评分。控制任务完成的Mingbird harness在每个规模上均值最高。四个预注册配对对比中有两个通过Holm校正，分别位于0.75B和4.7B。在部署解读下，16个配对区间中13个排除零值，领先幅度从对最强对手的0.075到对最弱对手的0.819。完成门控并非效应载体：禁用全部六项可执行检查仅使均值变化+0.080、+0.117、+0.003和-0.004，所有区间均包含零，且仅在1.9B时禁用会产生空运行。仅移除一条阻止重复的规则就会在0.75B损失0.411，并使18个任务中8个不产出任何工件。Harness效应是进度效应：它决定一次运行是否会在磁盘上留下任何内容。在357个可用单元中，127个未留下声明的工件，其中85个正常退出，因此读取退出状态的评分器会为从未写出的工作记分。效应随规模增大是变强还是变弱，四个档位无法确定：下界档会产生上升，上界档产生下降，跨家族档位产生峰值。
translation.brief: 通过在五个本地Harness与四个小规模开源模型上运行360个组合实验，考察harness与模型规模对任务完成（工件产出）的交互影响，发现harness效应主要体现为决定运行是否产出工件。

papers.title: Do Embedding-Map Distances Guide LLM Ideation? Four Tests Against What Came Next
papers.abstract: A popular ideation recipe treats an embedding map of existing work as a guide: pick points far from everything and decode them into ideas. I test four ways such distances could guide ideation against what appeared later. (1) Far random directions are not text: no later item reaches a raw cosine above about 0.10 with one (after centring or whitening, 22 of 24 cells stay out of reach), and an LLM decoder shown a target's neighbours, with score-only feedback, writes those neighbours in all six target sets. A neighbour-free search writes coherent text at median cosine 0.57 and 0.47 to interior gaps, beating the nearest existing item on 15 and 14 of 20, but only 0.07 and 0.06 to far points. (2) On k-means cells of a past-only map, the registered hole score mostly tracks cell size and position; three density-based gap scores forecast which cells grow fastest at or below chance (AUC 0.30 to 0.66) and add nothing to momentum in Steam and arXiv, with patents inconclusive; more isolated new Steam games are slightly better reviewed. (3) LLM continuations of arXiv papers stay closer to the source than papers that cite it, under three user prompts and against proposal rewrites (gpt-4o) and April-December 2023 papers (OLMo). Critique lengthens this step beyond content-free revision, replicated on 150 new papers. Revealing a real follow-up's title turns the ideas by 0.032 along a follow-up-specific direction beyond revision; reviewer, oracle and distance feedback add 0.13, 0.08 and 0.34 of that turn (upper bounds 0.46, 0.46, 0.70), and their turn is not separable from revision or their longer step. (4) For inspiration material graded by distance, no inverted U was detected, on an anticipation margin that tracks format more than content. Original tests were registered before running, follow-ups (thirteen requested in two AI-agent reviews) after the main results; all are dated only by local git commits.

translation.title: 嵌入图距离能否指导LLM创意生成？针对后续发展的四项检验
translation.abstract: 一种流行的创意生成方法将现有工作的嵌入图作为指南：选取远离所有点的位置并将其解码为创意。作者用随后实际出现的内容检验了这类距离指导创意生成的四种可能方式。(1) 远处的随机方向不是文本：后续条目与其原始余弦相似度均不超过约0.10（中心化或白化后，24个单元格中22个仍不可达），而只接收分数反馈的LLM解码器在看到目标邻域时会写出那些邻域条目；无邻域搜索在内部空白处写出中位余弦0.57和0.47的连贯文本，在20例中分别15和14例胜过最近的现有条目，但对远点的余弦仅0.07和0.06。(2) 在仅用历史数据构建的地图的k-means单元格上，注册的空洞得分主要跟随单元格大小和位置；三个基于密度的空白得分对哪些单元格增长最快的预测处于机会水平或更低（AUC 0.30至0.66），且对Steam和arXiv的动量没有增量贡献，专利结果不确定；更孤立的Steam新游戏评价略好。(3) 在三种用户提示下，并与提案改写（gpt-4o）和2023年4至12月论文（OLMo）对比，arXiv论文的LLM续写比引用它的论文更接近原文。批评性反馈使这一步超出了无内容改写，在150篇新论文上得到复现。揭示真实后续论文的标题使创意沿后续特定方向偏转0.032（超出改写幅度）；审稿人、oracle和距离反馈的偏转分别为该偏转的0.13、0.08和0.34（上界0.46、0.46、0.70），且其偏转与改写或其更大步幅不可分离。(4) 对按距离分级的启发素材，未检测到倒U形，且所用预期余量更多反映格式而非内容。原始测试在运行前注册，后续测试（两次AI-agent评审中要求的十三项）在主要结果之后进行；所有测试仅由本地git提交记录标注日期。
translation.brief: 通过四项预注册检验考察嵌入图中的距离能否指导LLM创意生成，发现远处方向不可解码为相关文本、空白预测能力接近机会水平，且各类反馈对创意方向的偏转难以与普通改写区分。

papers.title: Rubric-Based AES with LLM Ensembles: Scoring of Student Responses in Critical Online Reasoning Using Ensembles of LLMs
papers.abstract: Grading student responses is costly and time-consuming. Moreover, human annotators are prone to bias, fatigue, and rater drift, which further limits grading reliability. Various methods have been employed to develop automated essay scoring (AES) systems to reduce these costs and address bias-related issues. These methods range from early text-feature-based systems to current machine-learning and transformer-based models. Specifically, large language models (LLMs) offer the potential to streamline the development of AES systems. However, they are subject to well-known limitations, such as hallucinations and prompt sensitivity. This creates a need to explore the potential of a mixed-methods approach that leverages the synergies among individual LLMs through ensemble formation. We evaluate the potential of ensembles of LLMs to match human-rater agreement when grading student responses in economics and medical education across 103 criteria. We use 631 German-language responses and corresponding human ratings by 2 to 5 annotators from a previously conducted assessment. We experiment with 523 rubric-based prompt configurations across 15 open-weight LLMs and assess their consistency with human raters using Krippendorff's alpha for inter-annotator agreement (IAA) and the Alternative Annotator Test (alt-test). Our results show that replacing one human rater with the best-performing LLM--prompt configuration maintains or improves IAA for 91 of the 103 criteria and that LLMs pass the alt-test for 90 criteria. Our findings suggest that current state-of-the-art LLMs can support AES of German responses in economics and medical education, reducing human workload and enabling faster processing, while validation against human ratings remains necessary.

translation.title: 基于评分细则的LLM集成自动作文评分：用LLM集成对批判性在线推理的学生作答进行评分
translation.abstract: 批改学生作答既昂贵又耗时，且人类标注者容易受偏见、疲劳和评分漂移影响，进一步限制评分可靠性。为降低成本并解决偏见问题，已有多种方法用于构建自动作文评分(AES)系统，从早期基于文本特征的方法到当前的机器学习和transformer模型。特别是大语言模型(LLM)有潜力简化AES系统的开发，但也存在幻觉和提示敏感等众所周知的局限。因此需要探索一种混合方法，通过集成发挥多个LLM之间的协同效应。我们评估LLM集成在经济学和医学教育中、跨103项评分标准对学生作答评分时达到人类评分者一致性的潜力。我们使用631份德语作答及来自此前评估的2至5名标注者的人类评分。我们在15个开源权重LLM上试验523种基于评分细则的提示配置，并用Krippendorff's alpha衡量标注者间一致性(IAA)以及Alternative Annotator Test (alt-test)评估与人类评分者的一致程度。结果表明，用表现最佳的LLM-提示配置替换一名人类评分者，在103项标准中有91项保持或提高了IAA，且LLM在90项标准上通过alt-test。研究结果表明，当前最先进的LLM可支持经济学和医学教育中德语作答的AES，减少人类工作量并加快处理速度，但仍需对照人类评分进行验证。
translation.brief: 提出基于评分细则的LLM集成自动评分方法，通过523种提示配置与15个开源LLM的实验证明其可在多数标准上达到或超越单一人类评分者的一致性。

papers.title: A Reinforcement Learning Method to Navigate SMEFT Operator Space
papers.abstract: In particle physics, discrepancies between experimental measurements and Standard Model (SM) predictions are commonly interpreted within new theoretical models. In this context, the Standard Model Effective Field Theory (SMEFT) provides a general framework encompassing a broad class of models. However, exploring the enormous space of possible SMEFT operators rapidly becomes a challenging combinatorial problem: many operators can contribute simultaneously to different observables, their effects are correlated, and distinct operator combinations can provide comparably good descriptions of the data. In this work, we formulate the exploration of the SMEFT operator space as a sequential decision-making problem using reinforcement learning (RL). Our RL agent employs a lightweight actor-critic architecture with approximately 40K trainable parameters in total. Rather than searching for a single best-fit theory, our method is designed to discover a diverse set of high-quality theory hypotheses. We test the method in a complex phenomenological environment comprising 132 observables across several sectors of particle physics, including 24 measurements that deviate from their SM predictions by more than $1.5\sigma$. We show that the learned RL policy efficiently constructs multi-operator theories that substantially improve the global fit. Comparisons with independent random-subset and random-sequential searches demonstrate the ability of the RL policy to navigate this large combinatorial space. Our results establish RL as a systematic framework for exploring diverse patterns of new physics (NP) interactions within SMEFT.

translation.title: 一种在SMEFT算符空间中导航的强化学习方法
translation.abstract: 在粒子物理中，实验测量与标准模型（SM）预测之间的偏差通常在新理论模型框架内解释。标准模型有效场论（SMEFT）为此提供了一个涵盖广泛模型类型的通用框架。然而，探索庞大的SMEFT可能算符空间很快成为一个困难的组合问题：许多算符可以同时贡献于不同的可观测量，其效应相互关联，且不同的算符组合可能给出相差不多的数据描述。本工作将SMEFT算符空间的探索形式化为一个基于强化学习（RL）的序贯决策问题。我们的RL智能体采用轻量级actor-critic架构，总可训练参数约40K。该方法并非寻找单一最优拟合理论，而是旨在发现一组多样化的高质量理论假设。我们在一个复杂的现象学环境中测试该方法，该环境涵盖粒子物理多个领域的132个可观测量，其中24个测量值偏离SM预测超过$1.5\sigma$。我们表明，所学到的RL策略能高效构建显著改善全局拟合的多算符理论。与独立的随机子集和随机序贯搜索的比较证明了RL策略在大组合空间中导航的能力。我们的结果确立了RL作为在SMEFT内探索多样化新物理（NP）相互作用模式的系统性框架。
translation.brief: 将SMEFT多算符理论的搜索形式化为序贯决策问题，用轻量级actor-critic强化学习智能体发现多样化且全局拟合更优的算符组合。

papers.title: Learning to Reason with Predictive Gains for Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Reasoning-enhanced generative recommendation (GR) has attracted increasing attention for leveraging the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to improve next-item prediction. However, existing methods primarily optimize reasoning through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with rule-based rewards determined by final recommendation performance, which faces two key limitations: (i) unmeasured predictive contributions within reasoning, where the predictive contributions of individual reasoning steps are not directly reflected in optimization signals, and (ii) weakly discriminative learning signals within groups, where different reasoning trajectories within the group often receive indistinguishable rewards, limiting effective policy optimization. In this paper, we propose GainReason, a simple yet effective training framework that optimizes reasoning through Predictive Gain (PG). Specifically, PG measures changes in target Semantic ID (SID) log-likelihood induced by individual reasoning sentences, providing contribution-aware and discriminative rewards. We further theoretically establish the alignment between expected PG and the recommendation ranking objective. Building on this signal, we develop PG-based Reasoning Optimization (PGRO) to optimize reasoning generation with sentence-level rewards, supported by a custom causal attention mechanism for efficient PG computation. Additionally, an auxiliary PG-based Reasoning Utilization (PGRU) task adaptively strengthens reasoning-conditioned prediction to complement PGRO. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks demonstrate that GainReason consistently outperforms competitive baselines and achieves substantial performance gains from reasoning.

translation.title: 面向生成式推荐的基于预测增益的推理学习
